description:
TriMark USA is the country’s largest provider of design services, equipment, and supplies to the foodservice industry. We proudly serve our customers by providing design services, commercial equipment, and foodservice supplies across a wide range of industries and business sectors. Headquartered in Massachusetts, with a history dating back to 1896, we have locations across the country that offer foodservice operators an unparalleled level of service by combining our unique design capabilities and our expert market knowledge with the purchasing strength, delivery, installation, and after-sales service capabilities of a national company. Our employees are focused on creating customized solutions for our clients to ensure they achieve their culinary goals while upholding our I.C.A.R.E. values: Integrity, Customer Service, Accountability, Respect, and Excellence. For more information, please visit: www.trimarkusa.com

Why you’ll love it here!

+ Benefits include Medical, Dental, Vision, Tuition Reimbursement, Pet, and Legal Insurance

+ 401k

+ Community Service Day

+ Spotlight Awards

+ National Sales Excellence Awards

+ CFSP Prep Certification Program

**POSITION SUMMARY:**

* The Associate Purchasing Coordinator reports to the Senior Manager, Purchasing
* Located in San Diego
* Full-Time
* In Office/Hybrid

The Associate Purchasing Coordinator, an entry-level role, plays a crucial part in supporting the purchasing team's operations. This position is ideal for individuals who are eager to learn and contribute to the procurement process. The Associate Purchasing Coordinator assists in various aspects of purchasing, ensuring efficient and accurate coordination of activities to meet organizational needs.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS & RESPONSIBILITIES:****Order Processing:**

* Assist in the processing of purchase orders, ensuring accuracy and timely submission.
* Collaborate with vendors to confirm order details and track shipments.

**Data Entry and Maintenance:**

* Maintain accurate records of purchase transactions in databases or systems.
* Update and organize procurement-related documentation.

**Vendor Communication:**

* Communicate with vendors to obtain quotes, negotiate terms, and address basic inquiries.
* Assist in building and maintaining positive relationships with suppliers.

**Inventory Support:**

* Collaborate with the inventory team to monitor stock levels and ensure timely replenishment.
* Assist in conducting periodic inventory checks and reconciliations.

**Documentation and Filing:**

* Organize and file purchasing documents for easy retrieval and audit purposes.
* Support in the preparation of reports related to purchasing activities.

**Assist in Research:**

* Conduct basic market research to identify potential suppliers and products.
* Assist in gathering information on pricing, product specifications, and industry trends.

**COMPETENCIES:**

* Ability to pay close attention to details to ensure accuracy in order processing and data entry.
* Clear and effective verbal and written communication to interact with vendors and internal teams.
* Strong organizational skills to manage multiple tasks and maintain well-organized records.
* Ability to work collaboratively within a team environment to achieve common goals.
* Willingness to adapt to changing priorities and tasks in a dynamic work environment.

**QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE:**

* 0 – 1 years of experience in a similar role or relevant internship experience, or equivalent military or practical experience.
* Basic proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, Outlook) and familiarity with data entry.
* Basic understanding of purchasing processes and terminology.
* Ability to successfully pass a background check post offer acceptance.

Compensation includes the posted base salary range and does not reflect potential commission, incentive, bonus, or other additional compensation opportunities, where applicable. Total compensation is determined based on experience, skills, internal equity, geographic location, and other job-related compensatory factors.

In addition to base salary, this role will be eligible for participation in TriMark’s’ benefits programs, including medical, dental, vision, 401K (with employer match), etc. Leadership positions may also qualify for participation in bonus programs commensurate with role and scope of responsibility.

description:
Family-run and customer-focused since 1994, Automann has evolved into the leading distributor of HD truck and trailer parts. We sell to regional warehouse distributors, truck/ trailer dealers and specialty repair shops throughout the US, Canada and abroad. With more than 40,000 active parts across 17 categories from Body and Cabin components, Suspension, Steering and just about everything in between. To learn more please visit our website at www.automann.com.

Automann services its distributors out of (4) US Distribution centers; Monroe Township NJ (HQ), New Lennox IL, Duncanville TX and Ontario CA and (2) distribution centers in Canada: Brampton ON and Edmonton AB.

**Summary**

We have an immediate need for Purchasing Associate with the ability to establish and maintain a positive and professional relationship with suppliers and co-workers; cultural sensitivity and ability to relate well and effectively in a diverse workplace.

**Responsibilities**

· The Purchasing Associate is responsible for ensuring the satisfactory availability of goods to customers of the company by studying inventory levels and creating a forecast for expected usage

· Schedule deliveries. Communicate with suppliers to ensure timely delivery of products to maintain required inventory levels by monitoring and expediting orders as needed.

· Communicate with suppliers to resolve shipment issues, including defective or unacceptable goods and determine corrective action.

· Negotiate best vendor terms, pricing and delivery based on budget and schedule requirements.

· Load and maintain supplier information in ERP database. Supplier information includes contact information, supplier product pricing, supplier part number, and payment terms. Verify order specifications/packaging and pricing for orders placed.

**Skills & Qualifications**

· 2 years experience / knowledge of supply management required

· 3+ years in sourcing, planning or purchasing roles

· Ability to multi-task, prioritize, and mange time effectively

· Strong attention to detail

· Strong written and verbal skills

· Detail oriented with good mathematical and analytical abilities is necessary

· Proficiency in Microsoft Excel/Word required

. Bachelor’s Degree in a related discipline

· Work is generally routine; most tasks are well defined, but with considerable variation; some phases of the work are less well defined and may require independent action.

This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive.

Automann, Inc. provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, disability, sexual orientation, sexual identity, marital status, genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other category protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: $60,000.00 - $65,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Employee discount
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Referral program
* Retirement plan
* Tuition reimbursement
* Vision insurance

Education:

* Bachelor's (Preferred)

Experience:

* Supply chain management: 2 years (Required)
* Purchasing / Sourcing: 3 years (Required)

Work Location: In person

description:
**Are you ready to join our award winning highly successful family?**

Your deep passion, relentless drive, and following our core values and mission will allow you to achieve high performance success. We separate ourselves by being at the forefront of future leading technologies in the home services market.

Core values: family, care and grow

Mission: we enrich lives through trust in the trades.

**Who we are:**

Established in 2004, WireNut Home Services is a family-owned residential company that provides Electrical, Plumbing, HVAC, and Drain Service throughout Colorado's Front Range. We have earned over 64,000 happy customer reviews and are the record holder of 10x Excellence in Customer Service Award from the BBB. Additionally, we are the recipients of the Gazette's Best Workplaces for 7 consecutive years and have enjoyed aggressive growth year-over-year.

**What You’ll Do**

As the **Purchasing Associate** you'll report to the department manager. Responsibilities include, but are not limited to, sourcing requested products from technicians, verifying product requests match customer quote, job staging, PO receiving, reconciliation and returns, and other projects as assigned.

**Basic Requirements (Required Skills/ Experience):**

* Valid driver's license and a clean driving record
* Advanced computer skills
* Ability to lift 50 lbs. and stand for most of your shift
* Ability to pass a drug test and a background check upon hire
* Trade knowledge **required**- Electrical knowledge **preferred**
* Reconciliation of orders with vendors; return coordination and processing
* Warehouse replenishment and cycle counts
* Material/job auditing
* Detail oriented with an attitude to serve others; while maintaining our core values of Family, Care, and Grow
* High school diploma or general education degree (GED), six months of related experience including use of standard maintenance related power tools, or combination of education and experience
* Good written and oral communication skills; ability to read and interpret formal, contractual documents
* Capacity to work independently
* Forklift certification (desired, not required)
* Experience with ServiceTitan customer relationship management platform preferred
* Parts ordering in accordance with submission from technicians; complete order picking and job staging

**Compensation:** $55k-$72k

*Compensation based on performance measured in metrics on monthly bonus structure*

**Benefits:**

* Competitive Compensation – Paid Weekly
* Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
* PTO AND Sick time package
* 401(k) Plans
* Paid Holidays (Office Closed)
* Life Insurance
* Legal Shield
* Disability

**Perks:**

* Provided Uniforms and WireNut gear!
* Company sponsored events
* Quarterly banquets
* Fun off-site events
* Company contests, and more!

Job Type: Full-Time M-F with Rotating Saturdays

**Healthcare Purchasing Associate – Medical Supplies & Equipment**

**Full-Time | Monday–Friday | Day Shift | NO WEEKENDS!**

**Location: Howell Township, NJ**

**NOW HIRING – APPLY TODAY!**

US Healthcare is seeking an experienced, organized, and detail-oriented Healthcare Purchasing Specialist to join our team!

In this role, you will coordinate the purchasing, ordering, and fulfillment of medical supplies and equipment for skilled nursing facilities. We're looking for someone with strong organizational skills, purchasing experience, and the ability to work effectively with vendors and healthcare teams.

**Why Join US Healthcare?**

* **Monday–Friday Day Shift – NO WEEKENDS!**
* Health, Dental & Vision Insurance
* Paid Time Off & Paid Holidays
* 401(k) Retirement Plan
* Direct Deposit
* Paid Training & Orientation
* Opportunities for Career Advancement
* Supportive, Team-Oriented Work Environment

**Key Responsibilities**

* Purchase medical supplies and equipment for skilled nursing facilities.
* Source products, obtain competitive vendor quotes, and compare pricing.
* Prepare, place, and monitor purchase orders.
* Coordinate with vendors regarding product availability, deliveries, and backorders.
* Review order confirmations and invoices for pricing and quantity accuracy.
* Work with the accounting department to process invoices.
* Verify inventory and resolve shipment discrepancies.
* Maintain accurate purchasing records and vendor information.
* Help ensure facilities receive necessary supplies in a timely and cost-effective manner.
* Perform additional purchasing and administrative duties as needed.

**Qualifications**

* High school diploma or GED required.
* Minimum 1–2 years of purchasing, procurement, or order fulfillment experience required.
* Healthcare or medical supply purchasing experience preferred.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, and Outlook.
* Experience with purchasing software preferred.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Excellent communication and problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently.

**Join Our Team!**

If you're looking for a stable, full-time opportunity with a Monday–Friday schedule, excellent benefits, and room to grow, we encourage you to apply!

APPLY TODAY AND JOIN THE US HEALTHCARE TEAM!

What does a cell phone in your pocket, a spaceship, and an electric vehicle have in common?

Ellsworth Adhesives provides materials that help make each of those products!

Ellsworth Corporation, a global, industry leading distributor of specialty chemicals and equipment and adhesive manufacturer currently has an Associate Buyer opportunity. This role reports into EDS, an Ellsworth Corporation company, located in Sparks, NV and is a fully on-site/in office position.

Want to continue to grow your career? This is an exciting time to be a part of Ellsworth, come join our team!

Ellsworth Dispensing Solutions provides the solutions to make parts. We are the knowledge leader in dispensing solutions. Ellsworth Corporation, a global, industry leading distributor of specialty chemicals and equipment and adhesive manufacturer currently has a Field Service Technician opportunity at Ellsworth Dispensing Solutions, located in Sparks, NV. Click here to find out more about the markets we serve and here to learn about our consumer and manufacturing products!

This role executes all functions of procurement up to and until the point of receipt and develops and leverages supplier relationships for operational and cost saving initiatives for assigned commodity categories. It also works with the Planning Team to ensure optimal stocking strategies to meet Customer demand at the best price point of purchase.

**Responsibilities**

* Submits daily purchase orders based on material requirements and manages the process through release, confirmation, non-conformance, and delivery.
* Negotiates returns and non-conformance with Suppliers and ensures Suppliers are adhering to negotiated pricing and the business terms of the agreement.
* Develops and maintains Supplier relationships to facilitate prompt resolution of issues (expedites, sales and customer service questions / concerns, customer specifications, product conformity, logistics, etc.,)
* Collaborates with internal and external stakeholders to resolve pricing questions, confirm current costs, and obtain quotes for products.
* Collaborates with the Planning Team to ensure accurate inventory levels throughout the Commodity.
* Provides feedback to the Sourcing Team on Supplier Scorecards and KPIs, participates in regular supplier performance reviews.
* Provides input to the Sourcing and Commercial Team for regular reviews within the commodity to ensure the right mix of Suppliers and products.

**PERKS & BENEFITS**

As an industry leader, we offer a competitive wage, bonus plan, and a comprehensive benefit package which includes Health, Prescription, Dental, Vision, Life, Disability, Flexible Spending, 401(k), Employee Assistance, Paid Time Off and Holidays, Wellness Program, Social Events, Community Involvement and much more! Click Here for a summary of Employee Benefits.

**Qualifications**

* 1+ years of experience in purchasing or related field
* Bachelor’s degree from a four-year college in Supply Chain, Finance, or related field. Other combinations of education and experience may be considered as equivalent.
* Professional certification in purchasing or supply chain management desired (Certified Purchasing Professional (CPP) through the American Purchasing Society or supply chain certification through APICS preferred.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills to build supplier relationships
* Ability to learn in a fast-paced environment and work independently within standard operating procedures.
* Ability to build understanding of the entire supply chain within a commodity and become familiar with relevant industry regulations and standards
* Effectively communicates supply disruptions throughout the business.
* Continuous Improvement experience desired

* Negotiating skills
* Analytical skills

* Attention to detail and accuracy
* Ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment
* Proficient with MS Office applications, ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning) software, etc.

Through our partnership and certifications with leading technology providers including Cisco, HPE, Palo Alto, Juniper, Microsoft, Barracuda, VM Ware, Citrix, Xerox, Dell, and many others. Our customers receive the highest quality products and services the industry has to offer.

Acordis has an immediate opening for a purchasing agent/buyer. We are seeking an experienced candidate who will be responsible for the day-to-day processing of purchase orders for material/service requests; following up on these orders; confirming lead times and costs on these material and services. The right candidate will bid on new projects, maintain scopes of work, track any changes etc.

**Purchasing Agent/Buyer**

**Primary Duties & Responsibilities**

* Requesting cost proposals and negotiating contracts and prices.
* Preparing and processing purchase orders.
* Maintaining records of all transactions, purchase orders, receipts, and payments.
* Scheduling and verifying purchase deliveries.
* Researching and comparing suppliers, goods, and services.
* Selecting the most suitable suppliers in terms of reliability, product quality, and cost-efficiency.
* Monitoring inventory levels and determining purchase needs.
* Building and maintaining positive, long-term supplier relations.

**Experience/Education Requirements**

* Minimum of 3 years expereince required; at least 2 years of IT technology purchasing experience strongly preferred.
* Associates degree required; Bachelor’s Degree in Business or related field preferred,
* Purchasing or Supply Chain Management Certification preferred
* Experience with negotiating, contracting, analytical, critical thinking and problem-solving skills with the ability to compile and present data in a format that facilitates information sharing and decision making
* Experience with Microsoft software such as Excel and Word; solid data entry
* Reliable and possess a high degree of work ethic
* Strong organizational ability

description:
An Associate Buyer is responsible for purchasing product and managing inventory from a group of manufacturers. Labatt Food Service buys only nationally branded products of high and consistent quality. The Associate Buyer uses proprietary software to replenish inventory at 5 distribution centers in Texas and New Mexico. The Buyer’s objective is to maintain high inventory turn combined with a high fill rate for customers. Buyers interact continuously both with the food manufacturers and with Labatt sales representatives throughout two states.

In addition, an associate buyer at Labatt is responsible for:

* Helping to execute marketing promotions

* Working as a team with other buyers in purchasing

* Working with sales and management to effectively problem solve

The Associate Buyers who do best at Labatt must have: the ability to think strategically, aptitude to effectively solve problems in a fast paced environment, discipline to work independently, an enjoyment for working and effectively communicating with others, and a commitment to the success of the overall organization. The most important personal characteristics of an associate buyer is cooperativeness and willingness to help.

A Bachelor’s degree is required. Successful buyers have majored in English, History, Agriculture, Finance, Marketing and Supply Chain.

Send resume to hr@labattfood.com

description:
**Job Summary:**

The Purchasing Associate is responsible for the accurate and timely processing of purchase orders and related purchasing activities for an assigned region. This position is highly administrative and detail-oriented, with a strong focus on data accuracy, order processing, vendor communication, documentation, and follow-up.

The ideal candidate is organized, comfortable performing repetitive transactional work, able to manage a high volume of requests, and committed to accuracy and timely completion of tasks. This role supports the purchasing process rather than serving as a strategic sourcing or procurement position.

**Supervisory Responsibilities:**

* None

**Essential Job Functions:**

* Create, process, and maintain purchase orders accurately and within established timelines.
* Review purchasing requests for completeness and accuracy before processing.
* Enter and maintain purchasing, vendor, item, pricing, and order information within company systems.
* Monitor open purchase orders and follow up with vendors regarding order status, availability, backorders, shipping, and expected delivery dates.
* Communicate order updates, delays, and purchasing issues to internal teams.
* Research and resolve discrepancies involving pricing, quantities, invoices, shipments, and purchase orders.
* Maintain accurate purchasing records and supporting documentation.
* Follow established purchasing procedures, approval requirements, and company policies.
* Coordinate with vendors and internal departments to ensure orders are processed and fulfilled correctly.
* Assist with vendor setup, documentation, pricing updates, and other administrative purchasing functions.
* Identify recurring order or vendor issues and escalate them appropriately.
* Maintain strong attention to detail while managing multiple requests and priorities.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**Experience & Qualifications:**

* High School Diploma or GED required; associate or bachelor's degree preferred.
* Previous experience in purchasing support, order entry, administrative operations, logistics, inventory, customer service, accounts payable, or another high-volume transactional environment preferred.
* **Exceptional attention to detail and data-entry accuracy.**
* Ability to perform repetitive, process-driven work consistently and accurately.
* Ability to manage a high volume of transactions, requests, and follow-up items.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Comfortable communicating with vendors and internal stakeholders regarding order status and discrepancies.
* Ability to follow established processes while recognizing when an issue requires escalation.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office and able to quickly learn ERP, inventory, and purchasing systems.

**Physical Requirements:**

* Prolonged periods of sitting, standing, walking, and talking on the phone, attending virtual online meetings, and working on a computer.
* Must be able to lift up to 15 pounds at times.

*We are an equal opportunity employer that welcomes and encourages diversity in the workplace. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic information, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other status protected under federal, state, or local law.*

Overview:

We are authentic, professional providers of fun, focused on building a Great Place To Work For All by staying true to our mission: “Life’s a Party, We’re Makin’ It Fun!” and “So Much Fun It’s Scary!”

At Spencer’s and Spirit, we do the right thing always-integrity, fairness, respect, and transparency are our foundation. You will find our culture to be inclusive, passionate, resilient, and one that values differences and embraces all.

**One Team / One Goal**

We are leaders and owners of our business success. Whether it’s developing new and exclusive costumes, quality testing products, or implementing technology solutions, our teams understand the value of working collaboratively to embrace change through innovation, curiosity, and thoughtfulness.

We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes:

* *Flexible work environment*
* *Career advancement*
* *Competitive base salary*
* *Bonus opportunity*
* *Vacation, Personal, Sick and Holiday pay*
* *Medical, Dental, Vision, Disability, Life and AD&D insurance*
* *401k with a company match*
* *30% merchandise discount*

Responsibilities:

The Associate Buyer manages purchasing and inventory for specific departments, driving sales and profitability through collaboration with internal teams and external partners. They assist in curating assortments, ensuring timely deliveries, and analyzing sales performance. The role also involves identifying new products and trends through research and competitive shopping. Additionally, the Associate Buyer helps guide and train Assistant Buyers and Senior Assistant Buyers.

* Responsible for building, creating & managing merchandise assortments that align with market and consumer trends, to be presented to the Buyer. Assortment creation includes selecting and developing merchandise by considering quality, sourcing, timing, delivery, mix, and price
* Analyze weekly sales and item performance to find opportunities and strategies to drive sales and margin
* Prepare merchandise and reports for weekly team meetings
* Manage entire product lifecycle from creation, tracking of the purchase orders, samples, merchandising in store, to markdowns and discards
* Responsible for making purchasing decisions independently that satisfy the customer demand and achieve sales, turn and margin plan
* Travel to store locations to review product mix, gather feedback, and share information with the merchant team
* Attend trade shows and travel to vendor locations to grow and maintain professional relationships with external partners, as well as gain insight on new trends and opportunities
* Maintain and grow professional relationships with external suppliers and internal partners via telephone, email, and face-to-face meetings
* Partner with leadership and planning counterparts to manage the OTB and to identify opportunities in style count, sales goals, and inventory flow
* Manage markdowns and promotion strategies

Qualifications:

* Bachelor's degree (B. A.) from four-year college or university; and 5+ years experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience
* Proven ability to develop and implement strategies that drive business growth
* Exceptional written and verbal communication abilities, facilitating clear and effective dialogue with stakeholders
* Ability to work independently while also thriving in collaborative environments, taking initiative to drive projects forward
* Strong aptitude for partnering with cross-functional teams to achieve shared goals and enhance organizational effectiveness
* Skilled in developing, planning, presenting, and executing strategic initiatives that align with business objectives

*The pay range reflects the potential base salary range for this role. Individual base pay is determined by various factors such as relevant experience and skills, and the scope and responsibilities of the position.*

Pay Range: $70,000 - $80,000

* Prepare merchandise and reports for weekly team meetings
* Manage entire product lifecycle from creation, tracking of the purchase orders, samples, merchandising in store, to markdowns and discards
* Responsible for making purchasing decisions independently that satisfy the customer demand and achieve sales, turn and margin plan
* Travel to store locations to review product mix, gather feedback, and share information with the merchant team
* Attend trade shows and travel to vendor locations to grow and maintain professional relationships with external partners, as well as gain insight on new trends and opportunities
* Maintain and grow professional relationships with external suppliers and internal partners via telephone, email, and face-to-face meetings
* Partner with leadership and planning counterparts to manage the OTB and to identify opportunities in style count, sales goals, and inventory flow

* Exceptional written and verbal communication abilities, facilitating clear and effective dialogue with stakeholders
* Ability to work independently while also thriving in collaborative environments, taking initiative to drive projects forward
* Strong aptitude for partnering with cross-functional teams to achieve shared goals and enhance organizational effectiveness
* Skilled in developing, planning, presenting, and executing strategic initiatives that align with business objectives

Textron Systems is part of Textron, a $14 billion, multi-industry company employing 35,000 talented makers, thinkers, creators and doers worldwide. We make things that fly, hover, zoom and launch. Things that move people. Protect soldiers. Power industries. We serve customers in industries spanning aerospace and defense, specialized vehicles, turf care and fuel systems.

This role is in Textron System’s **Supply Chain** business area. Visit TextronSystems.com & Lycoming.com to read more about who we are and the products we make\\!

***About This Role***

In this role, you will be responsible for:

* Purchase materials from supplies at the lowest cost consistent with considerations of quality, reliability of source and urgency of need
* Study market trends, interview vendors and recommends sources of supply
* Solicit and analyze quotations required to satisfy all the requirements of the authorizing source documentation
* Monitor outstanding orders to ensure timely deliveries of quality products to maintain production, following up on orders to expedite shipment and delivery as needed
* Negotiate for any adjustments resulting from price analysis, discrepant materials, surplus or obsolete materials, contract terminations or a purchase order cancellation
* Obtain certifications of delivery and conduct item delivery validation. Check and improve payment of invoices
* Develop and maintain necessary records and files for compliance purposes. Support preparation of proposal cost data
* Preferred candidate will be knowledgeable in weld process, mechanical and custom fab.

**Qualifications**

* Currently pursuing or have completed a bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain or a related field.
* Ability to plan, organize and manage multiple priorities efficiently
* Effective verbal and written communications skills
* Basic Microsoft Office application skills with emphasis in MS Excel

***How We Care***

At Textron Systems, our talented people make us successful. Our Company is committed to offering employees opportunities to grow and develop. **Job Summary:** As an Associate Fresh Buyer, you'll train and work with a BDM to learn about product assortment, placement, purchase, price negotiation, distribution, cost negotiation, reacting to customer demand, and planning future category strategy. This position is an orientation job for Partners with limited experience in Business Development Management (BDM) or Buyer functions.

**Key Responsibilities & Essential Functions:**

* Supply Chain & Inventory Management:
+ Associate Fresh Buyer is a developmental role for Fresh Buyer.
+ Works with set vendor base
+ Executes purchase orders for a pre-defined set of items.
+ Executes (buys to) pre-determined item level product specifications.
+ Somewhat seasonal with little market fluctuations
+ Executes the Supply Chain needs for determined ad/promo items
+ Executes pre-determined supply chain from Suppliers to warehouses then into stores¿
+ Purchase order replenishment
+ Days on hand Inventory levels and Freshness guarantees
+ Markdowns to move shorter dated items
+ Executes out of spec product /load rejections to ensure stores receive the highest quality products
+ Shrink management controls
+ Supplier service level targets
+ Executes the outbound product flow from the HEB warehouse network into the entire network of HEB banner stores (HEB/CM/MT/Joe V's).

* Supplier Cost & Pricing:
+ Supplier Cost Management:
+ Executes pre-determined costs that follows FB and BDM cost negotiations
+ Minimal market price knowledge needed
+ Executes pre-determined item level costing that follows category strategy
+ Executes BDM contract & cost negotiations

* Strategic Planning:
+ Supplier Cost Management
+ Executes pre-determined costs that follows FB and BDM cost negotiations
+ Basic understanding of market pricing is needed
+ Executes pre-determined item level costing that follows category strategy
+ Executes BDM contract & cost negotiations

*The responsibilities and essential functions outlined above describe the general nature and level of work assigned to this position. **Qualifications & Key Requirements:**

**Work Experience:**

* 3+ years of experience in business, merchandising / retail, or Store Operations
* Category management, buying, supply chain, promotional planning, category analysis, merchandising, or other buying related experiences are a plus

**Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:**

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office
* Ability to multi-task and perform under pressure
* Strong analytical and organizational skills
* Excellent interpersonal, communication and negotiation skills -
* Working knowledge of product information data flow (item, vendor, cost, price), category trends, promotional planning, category performance analysis, systems, process, and analysis
* Strong verbal / written communication and presentation skills
* Analytical and problem-solving skills
* Negotiating and influencing skills
* Organization and project management skills
* PC skills (MS Office and job-related software / programs)

* Ability to work collaboratively on cross-functional teams and company-wide initiatives
* Ability to navigate the organization and solve problems within / across departments
* Ability to recommend proactive solutions with limited direction and input
* Initiative: willingness to take risks

**Education:**

* Degree in business, economics, marketing, or related field preferred

**Licenses/Certifications:**

**Physical Demands & Working Conditions:**

* Function in a fast-paced, retail, office environment

description:
Since 1976, **Furniture Mart USA** has been more than just a furniture retailer, it’s a place where people come to build careers, not just jobs. We believe in hiring great people and giving them the tools to grow, thrive, and make a difference. If you're passionate about helping others transform their house into a home, you’ll feel right at home here too.

Join a team that’s built on trust, teamwork, and a shared commitment to excellence. Whether you're just starting out or looking to take your career to the next level, **Furniture Mart USA** is where your future begins.

**Our mission is simple: Transform houses into homes, employees into family, and customers into friends.** If you share our vision and values, we invite you to join our team.

**Starting Wage: $22-28/hour depending on experience**

**Summary:**

* **Full-Time (40 hrs/wk): Monday-Friday, 8:00AM-5:00PM**
* Monitor supply levels and make appropriate purchases as necessary
* Evaluate vendors to determine best price and quality of supplies purchased while negotiating prices accordingly
* Receive and process all requests for supplies made by various company departments and locations.
* Allocate appropriate cost to proper location
* Retains records on purchases/requests/filled orders
* Responsible for licensing and registration of all fleet vehicles
* Travel Arrangements-Flights, Hotels, Conference rooms
* Reviews, codes and approves all invoices related to items purchased
* Coordinates and purchases food needs for meetings and events
* Contacts suppliers to schedule or expedite deliveries, to resolve shortages, missed or late deliveries, and other concerns
* Prepares, maintains, and reviews purchasing files, reports and price lists
* Tracks the status of requisitions, contracts, and orders
* Purchasing of Cell Phones and Managing of corporate account
* Purchasing of company uniforms
* Participates in department and company improvement activities, positively contributing to the team
* Proactively communicates issues and action taken or needed with Manager and/or Supervisor
* Maintains good attendance, punctuality and safe work practices
* Work in conjunction with Fleet Manager.
* Other duties as assigned

**REQUIREMENTS/QUALIFICATIONS:**

* One-year certificate from college or technical school; or three to six months related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience
* Effective collaborator and communicator
* Strong facilitation and problem-solving skills
* Ability to communicate well with external and internal customers and management.
* Self-motivated and absolute attention to detail

**Benefits: What’s in It for You?**
As a full-time member of our Furniture Mart USA family, you will enjoy:

* Paid training
* Full benefits package: Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, Disability, Paid Time Off, and more
* 401(k) with employer match
* Big employee & family discounts on furniture and mattresses

**Furniture Mart USA is an Equal Opportunity Employer**

**International****Purchasing****&****Inventory****Associate**
--------------------------------------------------------------

**Reports****to:** R&D Purchasing
**Department:** Purchasing / Supply Chain

### **Position****summary**

The International Purchasing & Inventory Assistant supports purchasing, inventory control, and new-business coordination. The role helps ensure materials are ordered from international suppliers in line with MRP requirements, inventory records are accurate, and purchasing activities meet operational timelines.

### **Key****responsibilities**

* Review MRP requirements and prepare purchase orders for international suppliers.
* Track purchase orders and coordinate with suppliers and internal teams to support timely delivery and resolve routine order issues.
* Support inventory control by maintaining accurate records and investigating discrepancies.
* Assist with project coordination for new business, including tracking purchasing and material-related action items.
* Reconcile month-end inventory valuations and help research variances.
* Maintain purchasing and inventory data; prepare reports as needed.
* Organize and prioritize work to meet deadlines in a changing environment.
* Follow company policies, procedures, and applicable safety rules.
* Cross-train and provide support to other departments as requested.
* Perform other related duties as assigned.

### **Qualifications**

* High school diploma or equivalent.
* Strong reading comprehension, written and verbal communication, and basic math skills.
* Proficiency with Windows and Microsoft Office, including strong Excel skills.
* Previous experience in manufacturing, inventory control, or purchasing—especially international purchasing—is preferred.
* Familiarity with MRP systems is an asset.

### **Physical****and****work****requirements**

* Ability to sit or stand for extended periods, with reasonable accommodations where applicable.
* Ability to lift and carry up to 40 pounds, with reasonable accommodations where applicable.
* Regular and punctual attendance is an expectation of the role.
* Safety glasses are required in designated areas.

**JJob Summary:**

The Purchasing Associate is responsible for supporting the purchasing function through procurement, supplier management, inventory coordination, and ERP system maintenance. This role ensures timely and cost-effective acquisition of materials to support business operations.

**Supervisory Responsibilities:** None

**Duties/Responsibilities:**

· Review the ERP system (SyteLine) to place and monitor purchase orders for sales samples, production, customer, and warehouse requirements.

· Review and resolve supplier invoices.

· Review and resolve goods receipts.

· Set-up logistics for purchase order arrival.

· Enter, update, and maintain supplier pricing.

· Assist with product sourcing and purchasing projects.

· Adjust planning/purchasing parameters based on analytical review.

· Monitor and track supplier non-conformance issues for supplier quality.

· Track the accuracy of purchase orders and monitor on-time delivery metrics to ensure supplier performance meets expectations.

· Monitor inventory including managing minimum and maximum stocking levels.

· Establish and manage stocking agreements using customer forecasts, supplier MOQs, and lead times, while monitoring performance and notifying Sales of over- or under-utilization

· Resolve supplier shipping issues or damage that occurred within transportation.

· Ability to identify seasonal trends in commodity purchasing and adjust accordingly.

· Cross-functional team player with Sales, Customer Service, Production, Accounting, and Warehouse.

· Assist the Production Coordinator in daily purchasing, scheduling, and logistics activities.

· Performs other duties as assigned.

**Required Skills/Abilities:**

· Proficiency in companies operating software, MS-Word and MS-Excel. ERP experience preferred.

· Strong analytical and mathematical skills.

· Strong verbal and written communication skills.

· Demonstrate sense of urgency, strong organizational skills, sense of ownership, and possess follow-up / follow through skills.

· Strong attention to detail and appropriate sense of urgency, when working both independently and as a team.

**Education and Experience:**

· High School diploma or equivalent required. Bachelor’s degree in a related field preferred but not required.

· Prior purchasing experience in a distribution / manufacturing environment preferred.

**Physical Requirements:**

· Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.

· Working conditions are normal for an office environment.

· Must be able to lift up to 15 pounds at times.

· Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

· Occasional travel to other Illing locations or supplier sites as required.

· Work location: In-office at Illing Headquarters, Richfield, WI.

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive list of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Health insurance

* On-site gym
* Paid parental leave
* Paid time off

* Referral program
* Retirement plan
* Vision insurance

***International Shoppes*** has been delivering exceptional service and premium retail experiences to travelers since 1951. We proudly operate across some of the nation's busiest airports, including John F. Kennedy International Airport (JFK), Washington Dulles International Airport (IAD), Baltimore / Washington International Thurgood Marshall Airport (BWI), Bradley International Airport (BDL), George Bush Intercontinental Airport (IAH), Daniel K. Inouye International Airport (HNL), and Kahului Airport (OGG). We are committed to providing an outstanding shopping experience while representing many of the world's most recognized luxury, beauty, and lifestyle brands.

**Position Overview:**

The **Associate Buyer of Beauty** is responsible for providing market expertise, filtering the assortment, and establishing quantities that meet the Region's needs and financial goals within open to buy parameters. Demonstrates smart risk-taking in business and product decisions and clearly communicates and manages team to execute these decisions. Supports the Buyers by providing analysis and results for their category, recommends action against the results and follows through on executing this action. Coordinate daily activities across designated departments to facilitate responsibilities.

**Responsibilities:**

* PO Management and Execution
+ Review Brand Sell In and Write Monthly Orders with OTB
+ Review and introduce novelties for various in store activations
* Stock Maintenance- review WOS and opportunity for clean up
+ Duty Paid Allocation management and execution
- Splits/Duty Paid Transfers
- Work with store teams to determine needs of business
* Negotiate vendor returns and destructions
* Review and Implement Vendor Funded Promotions
* Quarterly Store Walkthrough /Attend Vendor Walkthroughs
* Various Ad – Hoc Reporting
* Identify product opportunities and trends which will impact the business and provide results
* Liaise with visual team to ensure that all products are properly on sales floor for optimization
* Manage product selection and assortment during market
* Analyze sales trends, key items, vendor profitability and aged inventory as well as making recommendations for driving improved performance
* Writing orders, changes, cancellations and necessary follow-up (both internally and externally) to ensure key shipments are delivered and processed.
* Monitoring of merchandise reports, Open-to-Buy monitoring, stock analysis and other ad hoc analyses.
* Manage product set up and maintenance.
* Ensure all markdowns and store promotions are entered and set up properly in system
* Establish and maintain relationships with outside vendors to stay abreast and informed of supply issues, new products, lead times and reliability
* Pull relevant sales, margin and price point reporting and make recommendations based on results to improve business portfolio.
* Performs other duties as determined by management but not limited to the above-mentioned responsibilities.

**Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent work experience.
* 4+ years of experience in Buying Role.
* Grasp and navigate a wide range of business relationships; negotiation skills.
* Creative product skills and comprehensive market knowledge.
* Ability to think conceptually and strategically regarding business; creative problem solver.
* Strong analytical and communication skills.
* Demonstrates initiative, is conscientious and provides complete follow-through on all aspects of responsibility
* Ability to multitask and focus in a busy atmosphere
* Comfortable with team-based work structure, ability to demonstrate flexibility
* Excellent time management and communication skills
* High level of proficiency in Word and Excel.

**Perks & Benefits:**

* Full - Time 40 hours/week
* Benefits: Medical, Dental, 401K
* Merchandise Discounts
* Vacation / Personal / Sick time
* Traveling opportunities
* Great work environment

**To ensure that we continue to hire competent, ethical and trustworthy individuals, all candidates will be required to complete a thorough Port Authority Security background check prior to receiving any final offer of employment from International Shoppes.**

***\\*We are an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer\\****

**Position: Per Diem Purchasing Associate**

**Location: Barlow Respiratory Hospital, 2000 Stadium Way, Los Angeles**

**Job Summary:**

The Per Diem Purchasing Associate plays a crucial role in the operations of Barlow Respiratory Hospital's Materials Management Department. This position is responsible for the efficient receipt, storage, and distribution of all materials delivered by various vendors to the hospital. The ideal candidate will ensure that all materials are handled efficiently and stored properly, contributing to the smooth operation of hospital services.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Receipt of Deliveries:** Accurately receive materials delivered to the Materials Management Department, ensuring all items are accounted for against delivery documents.
* **Storage:** Properly store all received materials in designated areas, maintaining an organized and efficient inventory system.
* **Distribution:** Timely distribute materials to various departments within the hospital, ensuring that all internal requests for materials are fulfilled accurately and promptly.
* **Inventory Management:** Assist in maintaining accurate inventory records, participating in inventory counts and reconciliations as required.
* **Vendor Coordination:** Interact with vendors during the delivery process to resolve any discrepancies or issues that may arise.
* **Compliance:** Adhere to hospital policies and procedures related to materials handling, storage, and distribution.

**Requirements:**

* Computer literacy, with proficiency in inventory management software and Microsoft Office applications.
* Valid driver’s license, with a clean driving record.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to lift and move heavy items as needed.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Flexibility to work on a per diem basis, with varying hours according to departmental needs.
* **Per Diem position**

**Education and Experience:**

* High school diploma or equivalent.
* Previous experience in materials management, inventory control, or a related field is preferred.
* Hands-on experience with purchasing software (e.g. MediTech) Preferred
* Proficient in Microsoft Word and Excel

Expected hours: 8.0 – 16.0 per week

Davis, CA, US, 95618

Employment type: Employee

Place of work: Hybrid

Offshore/Onshore: Onshore

TechnipFMC is committed to driving real change in the energy industry. Our ambition is to build a sustainable future through relentless innovation and global collaboration – and we want you to be part of it. You’ll be joining a culture that values curiosity, expertise, and ideas as well as equal opportunities, inclusion, and authenticity. Bring your unique energy to our team of more than 21,000 people worldwide, and discover a rewarding, fulfilling, and varied career that you can take in anywhere you want to go.

**Job Purpose**
---------------

Hiring an experienced Buyer to join the Schilling Robotics team in Davis, CA! This role is responsible for the procurement of materials to achieve the production schedule and support new product and supplier development as needed. Main function is to issue P.O. per demand in the ERP system, follow up on open orders, and resolve quality issues (RTV as needed). Key deliverables insure parts meet specifications, meet on-time delivery and competitive pricing. This position will interact with all Departments within the Company, vendors and Subject Matter Experts to ensure that the Schilling Robotics Supply Chain meets Customer requirement. This position may on occasion support indirect spend categories in addition to production materials and tools. Building effective supplier relationships is critical to the success of the business.

**Salary:** $74,900 - $139,100

TechnipFMC offers employees a comprehensive benefits package. Benefits provided for this position may include the following: health care benefits including medical, prescription drug, dental, and vision coverage; Flexible and Health Spending Accounts; Life and Accidental Death and Disability insurance; Supplemental Life and Accidental Death and Disability insurance for employee and dependents; retirement benefits including a 401(k) with employer and employee contributions, paid time off, paid holidays, a flexible work schedule and many voluntary benefit plans.

**Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. without restriction. For this position, we are not sponsoring or taking over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time.**

**Job Description**
-------------------

* Solicit bid pricing from current and potential new suppliers that would be qualified through the Schilling new supplier qualification process to achieve cost targets.
* Evaluates supplier for ability to maintain quality, OTD, and costs and develop plans to address gaps to targets.
* Perform all required item data updating in the ERP system: promise dates, current tiered pricing etc.

**Job Description:**

Miller Electric, an ITW Company, is seeking an Associate Buyer to join the Welding, Accessories and Cutting team. Are you a change-maker with a passion for leadership and supply chain strategy? In this role, you will leverage your strong interpersonal skills to lead, coordinate, and support critical supply chain initiatives for the **Welding Accessories & Cutting Division**. From tactical execution to strategic planning, you'll drive continuous improvement with our suppliers and manufacturing teams—all while aligning with the broader goals of the ITW Welding Group Companies.

**How you will make an impact:**

**Manage the supply chain**

* Own activities related to procurement, storage, and shipment of materials
* Document and celebrate all cost savings and avoidances
* Manage material price variance, boost inventory turns, and lead cost-reduction programs
* Align supplier schedules with real-time material requirements (MRD adjustments)
* Hit MOH targets and keep "non-active" inventory under control
* Manage raw materials during exciting new product transitions
* Spearhead strategic sourcing and resourcing projects across the division
* Collaborate daily with operations, product, and engineering teams

**Develop vendor relationships**

* Take the lead on vendor negotiations—price, delivery, and quality compliance
* Build and manage a robust supplier base
* Cultivate strong, collaborative relationships with key vendors (not just transactional!)
* Conduct impactful supplier visits, evaluations, and quality audits

**Make strategic decisions that matter**

* Champion cost, quality, delivery, productivity, and simplification initiatives
* Lead continuous improvement projects
* Drive proactive resolution through the Corrective Action Request process

**Position Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Operations/Supply Chain/Business Management required
* Has at least one year of experience in materials or supply chain
* Proven track record of setting and accomplishing short and long term strategy and goals
* Ability to work in a fast paced environment
* Must be a self-starter, conscientious, and enthusiastic with a positive attitude
* Demonstrated competency in prioritization and analytical skills
* Demonstrated excellence in the following skills: communication and negotiation
* Ability to embrace, build and promote a team environment
* Excellent leadership, interpersonal, and time management skills
* Excellent computer skills (Microsoft Office package)
* Must be willing to travel as needed

*ITW is an equal opportunity employer. We value our colleagues’ unique perspectives, experiences and ideas and create workplaces where everyone can develop their careers and perform to their full potential.*

*As an equal employment opportunity employer, ITW is committed to equal employment opportunity and fair treatment for employees, beginning with the hiring process and continuing through all aspects of the employment relationship.*

*All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, national origin, age, disability, protected Veteran status or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws.*

Job Responsibilities

* **N1 Japanese Language Proficiency required\\***
* ***We have a client requirement that entails Japanese fluency and we are seeking a recent graduate to join our team in Los Angeles as an associate procurement specialist****.*
* **Key Responsibilities:**
* **Contracting:**
+ Assist in the review and management of contracts for services and software purchases.
+ Analyze contract terms, including software licensing agreements, to ensure alignment with organizational objectives.
+ Support negotiations by providing data-driven insights on pricing, terms, and supplier performance.
* **Sourcing:**
+ Conduct market research to identify and evaluate potential service and software suppliers.
+ Assist in the development of sourcing strategies to optimize costs and improve supplier performance, focusing on service and software categories.
+ Collaborate with IT, legal, and other departments to ensure alignment of sourcing activities with business needs.
* **BI Analytics:**
+ Develop and maintain procurement dashboards using business intelligence tools, focusing on software and service spend.
+ Provide actionable insights based on procurement data to support strategic decision-making.
+ Identify trends, risks, and opportunities through data analysis and present findings to stakeholders.
* **Spend Analysis, Data Cleansing, and Data Collection:**
+ Collect, cleanse, and analyze procurement data specifically related to services and software purchases.
+ Perform spend analysis to identify cost-saving opportunities and areas for improvement in software licensing and service contracts.
+ Maintain procurement databases and ensure data integrity with a focus on software asset management.
* **Risk Management:**
+ Facilitate data collection, cleansing, and reporting for risk management activities related to services and software procurement.
+ Assist in the identification and assessment of risks, particularly in software compliance and service delivery.
+ Support the development of mitigation strategies to address identified risks, including those associated with software licensing.
* **Segmentation Support:**
+ Collect, validate, and report on segmentation data to support procurement strategies, particularly for software and services.
+ Assist in developing supplier segmentation models based on spend, risk, and performance criteria.
+ Provide analytical support for segmentation initiatives, focusing on optimizing supplier relationships in the service and software categories.

Educational Requirements & Experience

* Undergraduate Degree in Business, Economics or related field.
* Experience in creating a business plan, inclusive of financial analysis, optimization and growth strategies, and risk assessments
* Knowledge of the market for technologies, software and services related to enterprise transformation
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, both written and verbal
* Exceptional interpersonal skills, with the ability to gain the confidence and respect of senior level executives
* Has demonstrated leadership, project management and business development skills through extracurricular activities or jobs/internships, sports, etc.
* Deep knowledge of Excel, PowerPoint and MS-Project
* Able to work independently in a fast-paced environment

This role requires candidates to have a current valid work authorization to work in the United States or be Canadian or Mexican nationals eligible for NAFTA TN work authorization. Avasant will not sponsor any other work authorization for any candidates.

This role is open to those residing in the US

Posted Date 10/06/2026

Description Principal Associate, Sourcing Manager

At Capital One, we dare to dream, disrupt and deliver a better way. Our goal is simple — bring ingenuity, simplicity and humanity to an industry ripe for change. We are seeking a **Principal Associate, Sourcing Manager** to join our **Enterprise Supplier Management (ESM) Team**! In ESM, we empower associates to deliver their best by cultivating a culture of inclusion and belonging, where varying perspectives and opinions are valued. We embrace each other’s differences and encourage all team members to lean into their talents and skills to deliver experiences for both internal and external clients.

This Sourcing position will develop strategy for and execute high risk and high impact procurement efforts across the company. This is an individual contributor role. Working in concert with business partners and subject matter experts, the **Sourcing Manager** will develop an in-depth understanding of client needs and supply markets, then apply rigorous procurement methodology and analytics to ensure those client’s needs will be met by the selected supplier(s). This role will lead projects in indirect categories of spend include, but not limited to Marketing related services, Professional Services, IT related Services.

The selected candidate will have experience in strategic sourcing – ideally in the technology or financial services industry. He or she will have demonstrated the ability to drive positive business outcomes through the supply chain, have great communication and influence skills, high analytical proficiency, and demonstrated ability to negotiate complex agreements.

**Responsibilities:**

* Analyze external industry trends and benchmarks, as well as develop and share market insights

* Clearly articulates cost drivers and pricing analysis for strategy formulation. Leads the development of make–versus-buy strategies

- Leads innovative sourcing methods - balance cost, speed, and quality based on internal customer needs

* Build strong internal and external relationships, understand the procurement parameters and look for new opportunities

* Consult with internal clients and business partners to identify opportunities to drive cost savings and efficiency in the supply chain

* Build buy in and communicate across multiple levels of the organization and across multiple lines of business

* Manage multiple projects concurrently in an autonomous environment

* Develop and implement procurement strategies including RFx, eSourcing, direct negotiations, etc.

* Use procurement software tools

* Support the development and execution of category strategies

* Support the negotiation of commercial terms for large contracts

* Develop communications and presentations at the Executive level

**Basic Qualifications:**

* At least 3 years of experience in sourcing and procurement

* At least 2 years of experience in risk management

* At least 2 years of experience in negotiating supplier agreements

**Preferred Qualifications:**

Bachelor's Degree or Military Experience

* 5+ years of experience in outsourcing and procurement

* 4+ years of experience in risk management

At this time, Capital One will not sponsor a new applicant for employment authorization for this position.

The minimum and maximum full-time annual salaries for this role are listed below, by location. Please note that this salary information is solely for candidates hired to perform work within one of these locations, and refers to the amount Capital One is willing to pay at the time of this posting. Salaries for part-time roles will be prorated based upon the agreed upon number of hours to be regularly worked.

Sales Territory: $109,900 - $125,400 for Principal Assoc., Supply Chain

Plano, TX: $109,900 - $125,400 for Principal Assoc., Supply Chain

McLean, VA: $120,800 - $137,900 for Principal Assoc., Supply Chain

Richmond, VA: $109,900 - $125,400 for Principal Assoc., Supply Chain

New York, NY: $131,800 - $150,500 for Principal Assoc., Supply Chain

Riverwoods, IL: $109,900 - $125,400 for Principal Assoc., Supply Chain

Candidates hired to work in other locations will be subject to the pay range associated with that location, and the actual annualized salary amount offered to any candidate at the time of hire will be reflected solely in the candidate’s offer letter.

This role is also eligible to earn performance based incentive compensation, which may include cash bonus(es) and/or long term incentives (LTI). Incentives could be discretionary or non discretionary depending on the plan.

Capital One offers a comprehensive, competitive, and inclusive set of health, financial and other benefits that support your total well-being. Learn more at the Capital One Careers website. Eligibility varies based on full or part-time status, exempt or non-exempt status, and management level.

Principal Associate, Sourcing Manager

At Capital One, we dare to dream, disrupt and deliver a better way. Our goal is simple — bring ingenuity, simplicity and humanity to an industry ripe for change. We are seeking a **Principal Associate, Sourcing Manager** to join our **Enterprise Supplier Management (ESM) Team**! In ESM, we empower associates to deliver their best by cultivating a culture of inclusion and belonging, where varying perspectives and opinions are valued. We embrace each other’s differences and encourage all team members to lean into their talents and skills to deliver experiences for both internal and external clients.

This Sourcing position will develop strategy for and execute high risk and high impact procurement efforts across the company. This is an individual contributor role. Working in concert with business partners and subject matter experts, the **Sourcing Manager** will develop an in-depth understanding of client needs and supply markets, then apply rigorous procurement methodology and analytics to ensure those client’s needs will be met by the selected supplier(s). This role will lead projects in indirect categories of spend include, but not limited to Marketing related services, Professional Services, IT related Services.

The selected candidate will have experience in strategic sourcing – ideally in the technology or financial services industry. He or she will have demonstrated the ability to drive positive business outcomes through the supply chain, have great communication and influence skills, high analytical proficiency, and demonstrated ability to negotiate complex agreements.

**Responsibilities:**

* Analyze external industry trends and benchmarks, as well as develop and share market insights
* Clearly articulates cost drivers and pricing analysis for strategy formulation. Leads the development of make–versus-buy strategies

- Leads innovative sourcing methods - balance cost, speed, and quality based on internal customer needs

* Build strong internal and external relationships, understand the procurement parameters and look for new opportunities
* Consult with internal clients and business partners to identify opportunities to drive cost savings and efficiency in the supply chain
* Build buy in and communicate across multiple levels of the organization and across multiple lines of business
* Manage multiple projects concurrently in an autonomous environment
* Develop and implement procurement strategies including RFx, eSourcing, direct negotiations, etc.
* Use procurement software tools
* Support the development and execution of category strategies
* Support the negotiation of commercial terms for large contracts
* Develop communications and presentations at the Executive level

**Basic Qualifications:**

* At least 3 years of experience in sourcing and procurement
* At least 2 years of experience in risk management
* At least 2 years of experience in negotiating supplier agreements

**Preferred Qualifications:**

Bachelor's Degree or Military Experience

* 5+ years of experience in outsourcing and procurement
* 4+ years of experience in risk management

At this time, Capital One will not sponsor a new applicant for employment authorization for this position.

The minimum and maximum full-time annual salaries for this role are listed below, by location. Please note that this salary information is solely for candidates hired to perform work within one of these locations, and refers to the amount Capital One is willing to pay at the time of this posting. Salaries for part-time roles will be prorated based upon the agreed upon number of hours to be regularly worked.

Plano, TX: $109,900 - $125,400 for Principal Assoc., Supply Chain
McLean, VA: $120,800 - $137,900 for Principal Assoc., Supply Chain
Richmond, VA: $109,900 - $125,400 for Principal Assoc., Supply Chain
New York, NY: $131,800 - $150,500 for Principal Assoc., Supply Chain
Riverwoods, IL: $109,900 - $125,400 for Principal Assoc., Supply Chain

Candidates hired to work in other locations will be subject to the pay range associated with that location, and the actual annualized salary amount offered to any candidate at the time of hire will be reflected solely in the candidate’s offer letter.

This role is also eligible to earn performance based incentive compensation, which may include cash bonus(es) and/or long term incentives (LTI). Incentives could be discretionary or non discretionary depending on the plan.

**About Wonder**

Everything’s on the menu at Wonder. Except compromise.

Wonder is the mealtime platform built to feed every craving in one order. With Wonder, you can mix and match hundreds of dishes from 20+ exclusive restaurants in a single order, so everyone gets exactly what they’re craving. Enjoy everything from tacos to Thai with $0 delivery fees, plus dine-in or pick up at a Wonder location near you. Each dish is made to order on-site by our culinary team and served hot.

Behind the scenes, Wonder owns and operates every step of the dining experience, from recipe development to the technology that powers our experience, allowing us to deliver quality, variety, and consistency at scale.

*Join us as we work to make great food more accessible.*

**About The Opportunity**

As a Procurement Associate for Wonder you will work collaboratively & cross functionally with the merchant team, forecasting team, warehouse operations & accounts payable. You will ensure that all raw materials arrive to the Wonder production & distribution facilities in time and in specification.

**The Impact You Will Make**

* Develop & maintain positive relationships with supplier partners via e-mail, virtual meetings & direct calls.
* Sustain proper inventory levels by evaluating/submitting purchase orders & ensuring they are delivered on time.
* Address & rectify any quality concerns of raw materials presented by culinary & operational teams to supplier partners.
* Communicate forecasting changes to supplier partners.
* Work cross-functionally to meet launch dates of new raw materials.
* Evaluate reporting to minimize waste at production & distribution facilities

**What You Bring to the Table**

* 2+ years in a supply chain position, preferably food experience within foodservice or retail setting
* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain with strong analytical skills
* Team player that appreciates other points of view & ideas
* Excellent project management and leadership skills
* Has a sense of urgency & great attention to detail
* Able to grasp concepts quickly and apply the learning
* Self-starter that does not mind seeking answers & information
* Embraces a fast-paced environment & can pivot as needed

Our hybrid model requires 3 days a week in the office. That said, many team members choose to come in more often to take advantage of in-person collaboration and connection. You're welcome—and encouraged—to be in the office up to 5 days a week if it works for you.

#LI-Hybrid

**New Jersey:** $75,000 - 78,500 per year.

Wonder uses geographic-specific salary structures, which means the salary offered may vary depending on where the job is located. The final salary offer will take into account various factors, such as the candidate's skills, education, training, credentials, and experience.

**Benefits**

The benefits applicable to this role include a competitive compensation package with equity and a 401(k). We also offer a choice of medical, dental, and vision plans, company paid short and long term disability coverage, paid time off including flexible time off for exempt employees, paid vacation for non-exempt employees, and paid sick leave in compliance with applicable law in addition to paid parental leave, discounted meals and exclusive perks across the Wonder family of brands.

Eligibility, effective dates, and available plan options vary by employment classification and location. To learn more about benefits for this role, visit our Careers page here.

**A Final Note**

At Wonder, we build the best teams by hiring with an objective lens — evaluating people for their potential while championing diversity, equity, and inclusion. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, military service eligibility, veteran status, marital status, disability, or any other protected class. As part of our commitment to fair and compliant hiring practices, Wonder participates in the federal government's E-Verify program to confirm employment eligibility. If you need an accommodation during the interview process, please let your recruiter know.

**We look forward to hearing from you! We'll contact you via email or text to schedule interviews and share information about your candidacy**.

**About Xerox Holdings Corporation**

For more than 100 years, Xerox has continually redefined the workplace experience. Harnessing our leadership position in office and production print technology, we’ve expanded into software and services to sustainably power the hybrid workplace of today and tomorrow. Today, Xerox is continuing its legacy of innovation to deliver client-centric and digitally-driven technology solutions and meet the needs of today’s global, distributed workforce. From the office to industrial environments, our differentiated business and technology offerings and financial services are essential workplace technology solutions that drive success for our clients. At Xerox, we make work, work. Learn more about us at www.xerox.com.

**Overview:**
Join Xerox as an Inventory Control / Purchasing Associate. In this role, you will support purchasing, inventory control, equipment and supply management, and audiovisual (AV) order coordination. You will collaborate with vendors, customers, warehouse teams, and internal business partners to help ensure accurate purchasing, timely installations, and efficient inventory operations.

**Why Join This Team:**

* Support purchasing and inventory operations across equipment, supplies, and audiovisual products
* Collaborate with warehouse, finance, sales, and operational teams
* Build relationships with customers and external vendors
* Gain hands-on experience with purchasing, inventory, and AV installation coordination
* Work in a collaborative environment focused on accuracy, service, and operational efficiency

**What You Will Do:**

* Process equipment, supply, audiovisual, and out-of-geography receipts and maintain related records in E-Automate
* Create purchase orders, establish new items, update sales orders, and maintain equipment records
* Review AV orders for accuracy, coordinate installation schedules, place service calls, and follow up with customers
* Work with vendors on pricing, delivery timelines, discrepancies, and damage claims while supporting price comparisons
* Support inventory control activities, including quarterly physical inventories, while partnering with Accounts Payable, Billing, Leasing, and Warehouse teams

**What You Need to Succeed:**

* High school diploma or GED required; college degree preferred
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Excel, Word, and Outlook
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities
* Strong written and verbal customer service and communication skills
* Self-motivated and collaborative approach with a commitment to accurate task completion and follow-through

**How We Set You Up for Success:**

* Cross-functional collaboration with purchasing, warehouse, finance, and operational teams
* Hands-on experience with E-Automate and purchasing processes
* Exposure to vendor management, inventory control, and audiovisual order coordination
* Opportunities to strengthen customer and vendor relationship management skills
* Collaborative team environment focused on effective execution and operational support

**Job No:** 503928
**Work Type:** Staff Full Time (1500 hours or greater)
**Location:** Dayton, OH
**Category:** Research Institute Staff
**Department:** Procurement - 250231
**Pay Grade:** P1 - Exempt
**Advertised:** October 05, 2026

**Applications close:** October 18, 2026

**Position Summary:**

Join UDRI and help support cutting-edge research through effective, compliant procurement. In this role, you will work with internal teams, suppliers, and subcontractors to source materials, equipment, and services while navigating federal acquisition requirements and University procedures. This is a great opportunity for a procurement professional who enjoys problem-solving, negotiation, and supporting a mission-driven research environment.

Review and approve requests for material, equipment and services in compliance with Federal Government acquisition regulations, uniform guidance and in accordance with University policies and procedures.

Responsibilities include acquiring specifications (design drawings, SOWs, specifications, etc.); identifying and rationalizing source(s); obtaining and analyzing quotes; negotiation; and input and tracking of requisitions in an eProcurement environment.

Acquire, qualify, input and manage sponsor, subcontractor and vendor business information for UDRI.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

Bachelor’s degree in business, accounting, finance or related field OR Associates degree in business plus 3 years of purchasing experience.
Experience with ERP system.
Experience with eProcurement system.
Experience in professional role with procurement fundamentals.
Ability to read and speak English.
Strong organization skills.

Effective telephone, oral communication and interpersonal skills.+-

Proficient with Microsoft Office software suite.
Ability to prioritize work and manage multiple tasks effectively.
Due to the requirements of our research contracts with the U.S. federal government, candidates for this position must be a U.S. citizen.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

While not everyone may possess all of the preferred qualifications, the ideal candidate will bring many of the following:

Familiarity with Federal Acquisition Regulations.
Advanced experience with Deltek CostPoint modules.
Experience with Jaggaer eProcurement system.
Experience in purchasing at a not for profit, research or Government agency.
Certification through Institute for Supply Management.
Familiarity and experience with ISO.

**Special Instructions to Applicants:**

To apply please submit a cover letter addressing each minimum qualification and any applicable preferred qualifications that you meet.

**Closing Statement:**

Informed by its Catholic and Marianist mission, the University is committed to the dignity of every human being. Informed by this commitment, we seek to increase diversity in all of its forms, achieve fair outcomes, and model inclusion across our campus community. The University is committed to policies of affirmative action designed to increase the employment opportunities of individuals with disabilities and protected veterans in compliance with the Rehabilitation Act of 1973 and Vietnam Era Veterans' Readjustment Assistance Act of 1973.
