**About BLCCS**

BLCCS, LLC is a San Antonio-based commercial MEP service company providing HVAC, Electrical, Plumbing, Building Automation & Controls, Energy Services, and Preventive Maintenance.

Founded in 2017, BLCCS supports commercial and mission-critical facilities throughout the San Antonio area. As we continue to grow, we are looking for someone who can take ownership of our tools, inventory, purchasing, vehicle stock, refrigerant tracking, and warehouse operations.

**Position Summary**

The **Inventory, Warehouse & Procurement Coordinator** is responsible for maintaining accurate records of company tools, equipment, materials, vehicle inventory, refrigerant, purchasing, and purchase orders.

This is a hands-on position that combines warehouse responsibilities with administrative and technology-based work. The ideal candidate is organized, comfortable working with technicians and vendors, strong with Excel and technology, and willing to take ownership of processes from start to finish.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Maintain accurate inventory of company tools, equipment, and materials.
* Track tools assigned to employees, vehicles, jobsites, and the warehouse.
* Maintain serial numbers, purchase dates, warranty information, and assignment records.
* Manage tool check-in/check-out and replacement requests.
* Verify warranty or repair options before approving replacement purchases.
* Conduct periodic physical inventory audits.
* Maintain standard vehicle inventory and perform vehicle inventory checks.
* Track refrigerant purchases, technician usage, vehicle stock, and refrigerant logs.
* Reconcile refrigerant inventory and identify discrepancies.
* Create and process purchase orders.
* Purchase approved tools, parts, materials, equipment, and supplies.
* Obtain vendor pricing and availability and follow up on outstanding orders.
* Receive deliveries and verify materials against purchase orders.
* Coordinate returns, damaged materials, and vendor discrepancies.
* Help prevent unnecessary or duplicate purchases.
* Organize warehouse inventory and maintain designated storage locations.
* Prepare materials and equipment for technicians and projects.
* Maintain a clean, safe, and organized warehouse.
* Safely operate a forklift and assist with loading, unloading, and material movement.

**Excel & Technology Requirements**

**\\*\\*Strong Microsoft Excel skills are required.\\*\\***

The successful candidate must be comfortable using Excel to track and manage:

* Tool inventory
* Vehicle inventory
* Refrigerant logs
* Purchase orders
* Warehouse inventory
* Warranty information

Candidates should be comfortable with sorting, filtering, formulas, data organization, and basic reporting.

The position also requires the ability to learn and use inventory systems, purchasing software, mobile apps, electronic forms, ticketing systems, QR/barcode systems, and other technology used by BLCCS.

**Qualifications**

* Strong organizational and recordkeeping skills.
* High attention to detail and accuracy.
* Strong Excel and overall technology skills.
* Ability to identify and resolve inventory discrepancies.
* Comfortable working with technicians, vendors, and management.
* Comfortable holding employees accountable for assigned company tools and equipment.
* Valid driver's license.
* Clean driving record required.
* Must meet company vehicle insurance requirements.
* Must successfully pass a background check.
* Ability to safely operate a forklift; certification preferred or ability to obtain certification required.
* Ability to perform normal warehouse and material-handling duties.
* Previous inventory, purchasing, warehouse, construction, HVAC, electrical, plumbing, or facilities experience is preferred.

**Compensation**

**$18.00–$24.00 per hour, depending on experience.**

Compensation will be based on relevant experience, Excel and technology proficiency, purchasing or inventory experience, and the candidate's ability to independently manage the responsibilities of the position.

**What Success Looks Like**

The right person will help BLCCS maintain clear accountability for:

What we own, where it is, who has it, what was purchased, what is under warranty, what needs to be reordered, and what needs attention.

We are looking for someone who is organized, proactive, technology-capable, and willing to take ownership as BLCCS continues to grow.

Pay: $18.00 - $24.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Opportunities for advancement
* Paid time off
* Parental leave
* Prescription drug insurance
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

Plantain Products Company - Chifles, the number one plantain chip brand in the U.S. by dollar sales, is hiring a Logistics and Procurement Coordinator in Miami-Dade. You will own daily freight quoting and booking, shipment coordination, purchase orders for packaging, racks and displays, and fleet compliance scheduling. Execution done well and done reliably, reporting to the Director of Operations and Logistics.

This role keeps product moving and orders flowing every day. This is an individual contributor role; it does not manage people.

**Full-time, on-site.** Pay is $60,000 to $75,000 per year. Benefits include health insurance, a 401(k) match and paid time off.

**First 90 days**

* Take over daily logistics and purchasing through a 90-day handover, working beside the people who run it today.
* Run the freight quoting cycle and the weekly delivery schedule without supervision.
* Keep the carrier and supplier scorecard current.

**The Mission**
To communicate and assist with Procurement Director, Field Department, and outside growers/suppliers/drivers to deliver high quality raw materials to the Stahlbush processing plant. This role covers the documentation, planning, and coordination required to deliver materials in compliance with sustainable, organic, GAP, FSMA, SQF, DOT, and any other required 3rd party audit or process.
**Reporting Relationships**
This position will report directly to the Director of Procurement. The employee will work closely with multiple departments throughout the company along with outside growers/suppliers/contractors.
**Outcomes**

* Proactively resolve any issues related to raw product quality or delivery in a thorough and timely manner.
* Conduct internal audits of documentation to ensure compliance with third-party certification standards.
* Complete weight sheets for received products, ensuring all data aligns with traceability standards and providing accurate reports to Accounts Payable.
* Work with Procurement team to create and negotiate contracts with outside suppliers and growers to secure raw materials.
* Become an expert in our internal Transportation Management System (LOADS) to assist in transportation responsibilities, including creating, editing, and checking in shipments.
* Request freight quotes and issue Purchase Orders (POs) for inbound raw materials using the SIFI LOADS program and schedule shipments with vendors.
* Coordinate outside contract drivers and brokers to facilitate harvested crops for delivery to the processing plant.
* Assist the Field Department in pulling crop, soil, and moisture samples from the field.
* Assist in the maintenance and updating of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and specifications for raw products.
* Assist in DMV and DOT related tasks, including vehicle registrations, insurance cards, and overweight/over-width permits.
* Support and optimize Stahlbush sustainability initiatives to align with company mission statement.
* This position has been identified as holding responsibility for food safety and quality of the company. This responsibility extends over all shifts.
* During the absence, the following position serves as coverage to this position: Director of Procurement.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Food Science, Agriculture, or related field preferred
* Passion to pursue a career in the agricultural, supply chain, or food production industry
* Strong organizational and problem-solving skills
* Proficient in Microsoft Office programs including Microsoft Excel, Outlook, and Word
* Ability and willingness to work independently and improve processes
* Proficiency in procurement processes, vendor negotiations, and contract management
* Basic understanding of farming practices and the nature of the industry
* Willingness to learn current market pricing, food safety, and agriculture certifications.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

**Working Conditions**
General office environment with minimal physical effort. Requires sitting at a desk for majority of workday, but when needed, there will be periods of time work is performed outside.

The statements made in any and all of the position postings are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this classification. They are not intended to be construed, as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of personnel so classified.

Stahlbush Island Farms, Inc is an equal opportunity employer, focused on the employment and advancement of all applicants and colleagues for employment and promotion without regard to race, color, ethnicity, religion, gender, pregnancy/childbirth, age, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, genetic information, citizenship, veteran or military status, marital or domestic partner status, or any other category protected by federal, state and/or local laws.

Stahlbush Island Farms is an equal opportunity employer, program auxiliary aids and services are available upon request to individuals with disabilities.

**Job Title:** Procurement Coordinator

**Location:** Richmond or Staunton, VA

**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**Travel:** 5%–25%, domestic and international

**Compensation:** $75,000–$90,000 annually

**Benefits:** Medical, Dental, Vision, HSA with employer contributions, employer-paid Life/AD&D, employer-paid Short-Term Disability, and voluntary supplemental insurance options

**Job Summary**

Our client is seeking an experienced Procurement Coordinator to support and manage purchasing, sourcing, logistics, inventory, and supplier performance. This role is responsible for developing and maintaining effective supply chain processes that improve operational efficiency, control costs, maintain appropriate inventory levels, and support reliable product availability.

The ideal candidate will bring extensive experience in purchasing and supply chain operations, including international sourcing, importing, supplier management, contracting, lean processes, and continuous improvement.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Review and update supply chain policies and procedures to comply with new or changing environmental policies, standards, regulations, and laws, including Proposition 65 and other location-specific requirements.
* Maximize inventory and working capital turns by developing suppliers with shorter delivery cycles, improved reliability, and smaller order quantities while maintaining appropriate safety stock levels and avoiding stockouts.
* Manage supplier quality and performance issues through the Supplier Corrective Action process.
* Maintain documentation and records of supplier issues, resolutions, corrective actions, and related communications.
* Participate in the customer complaint review process and remain informed of relevant customer complaints.
* Develop procedures to effectively coordinate supply chain activities with sales, marketing, finance, production, quality assurance, and other functional areas.
* Design and implement supply chain strategies that support overall business objectives.
* Adapt supply chain strategies in response to changing market conditions, new business opportunities, and cost-reduction initiatives.
* Identify opportunities to improve supplier performance, operational efficiency, and overall supply chain effectiveness.
* Support company objectives and demonstrate a strong commitment to continuous improvement.
* Model and uphold company values in daily responsibilities and interactions.
* Perform other related duties as assigned.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Engineering, or a related field.
* Minimum of 10 years of progressive experience in purchasing, supply chain management, and logistics.
* Extensive experience with international supply chain management, importing, and global sourcing.
* Strong understanding of lean and continuous improvement principles.
* Demonstrated experience developing and implementing lean business processes within an international supply base.
* Thorough understanding of legal contracting and supplier agreements.
* Excellent interpersonal and negotiation skills.
* Proven ability to develop and maintain positive working relationships with vendors, suppliers, shippers, customers, and internal stakeholders.
* Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Strong financial analysis skills and a goal-oriented approach.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite or related software.
* Valid driver’s license.
* Valid U.S. passport.
* Ability and willingness to travel domestically and internationally approximately 5%–25% of the time.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Demonstrated success improving inventory turns, supplier lead times, reliability, and purchasing efficiency.
* Experience managing supplier corrective actions and supplier quality issues.
* Experience working with environmental and product compliance requirements, including Proposition 65.
* Experience collaborating across sales, marketing, finance, production, and quality assurance functions.

**Work Environment / Schedule**

* Position is based in Richmond or Staunton, VA.
* May require extended periods of sitting at a desk, typing, and standing.
* Must be comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-stress environment.
* May periodically work in construction or warehouse environments.
* Must be able to lift up to 25 pounds.
* Must adhere to the our clients Health & Safety Manual.
* Attendance at company safety meetings and participation in safety drills are required.
* Appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE) must be worn when applicable.
* Domestic and international travel may account for approximately 5%–25% of the role.

**Compensation and Benefits**

* Annual salary range of $75,000–$90,000.
* Multiple Aetna medical plan options, including HSA-eligible plans.
* Dental coverage through Aetna.
* Voluntary vision coverage through Guardian.

description:
R10102617 Purchasing Coordinator (Open)

Location:

Branchburg, NJ (HO) - US Hwy 22 W - Advanced materials

The science of electronics is transforming exponentially through innovation and connectivity around the planet. Every day, breakthroughs are making technologies – from micro-processors, memory chips and flat panels to photovoltaic cells – even smaller and more powerful, opening up countless new possibilities in how the world lives, works and connects. Air Liquide Advanced Materials grows by enabling our customers to innovate. Our ALOHA™ and Voltaix® products are critical to the manufacturer of the newest computer chips required for Big Data and the Internet of Things.

**How will you CONTRIBUTE and GROW?**
-------------------------------------

The Purchasing Coordinator is responsible for managing day-to-day procurement operations, including reviewing requisitions, placing purchase orders, and managing vendor relationships for MRO and raw materials. This role focuses on maintaining accurate PO data within ERP systems (preferably SAP), negotiating contract terms within budgetary guidelines, driving cost-reduction initiatives, and cross-functionally resolving invoice and supply chain discrepancies.

**Air Liquide is Hiring for a Purchasing Coordinator!**

**WE ARE LOOKING FOR YOU!**
===========================

* Pay Range: $57k - $72k annually
* Annual bonus: 5%
* Benefits starting on first day
Work Schedule: Hybrid (3 day in office required)

Responsibilities:

* Review purchase requisitions, place purchase orders, and follow up with vendors for MRO and raw materials orders
* Keep pertinent purchase order information up to date within SAP
* Follow up with vendors regarding delivery dates on POs and scheduling releases from blanket orders. Expedites purchases and purchase orders when required.
* Review supplier bid proposals and negotiate contracts within budgetary limitations and scope of authority
* Maintain certifications for pressure vessels and assist Supply Chain team in providing certifications to vendors
* Develop and implement cost reduction ideas for MRO items
* Assist the Purchasing Department staff in vendor sourcing and other projects as required
* Reconcile any purchase order / invoice discrepancies with AP as needed
* Troubleshoot errors within ERP system
* Create new part numbers and assist with the setup of new vendors within ERP system
* Maintain contractor approval documentation and status
* Interfaces with other departments within the organization to resolve issues with purchase orders and purchased items
* Assist with the sourcing of capital items for Engineering, R&D, Product Development, etc.
* Maintenance of Purchasing documents and procedures

**\\_\\_\\_\\_\\_\\_\\_\\_\\_\\_\\_\\_\\_\\_\\_\\_\\_\\_**
----------------------------------------

**Are you a MATCH?**
--------------------

Required Qualifications:

* High School diploma or equivalent
* Ability to work in a team environment
* Strong attention to detail
* 3+ years of experience in Purchasing, Procurement, or Supply Chain
Bachelor's degree in Business or Supply Chain accepted in lieu of relevant work experience

Preferred Qualifications:

* Strong ERP system experience, especially with SAP
* Chemical or Electronics industry operations experience
* Knowledge of SAP
* Proficiency in Google Suite applications

**Our Differences make our Performance**

At Air Liquide, we are committed to build a diverse and inclusive workplace that embraces the diversity of our employees, our customers, patients, community stakeholders and cultures across the world.

We welcome and consider applications from all qualified applicants, regardless of their background. We strongly believe a diverse organization opens up opportunities for people to express their talent, both individually and collectively and it helps foster our ability to innovate by living our fundamentals, acting for our success and creating an engaging environment in a changing world.

* Obtain pricing, negotiate costs, and maintain favorable vendor relationships.
* Process purchase orders and ensure accurate documentation of all purchases.
* Track orders from placement through delivery and resolve any shipping or delivery issues.
* Maintain accurate inventory records and conduct periodic inventory audits.
* Research alternative suppliers and products to improve quality, availability, and cost savings.
* Review vendor invoices and reconcile discrepancies with purchase orders and receipts.
* Monitor warranty claims and manufacturer credits to ensure reimbursement opportunities are captured.
* Assist with fleet, warehouse, and operational supply purchasing as needed.
* Ensure compliance with company purchasing policies and procedures.
* Generate and maintain purchasing, inventory, and vendor performance reports.
* Ensure warranty claims are submitted and processed within required deadlines to secure all available vendor credits and reimbursements for the company.
* Resolve escalated product order issues promptly.
* Ability to work interdepartmentally to achieve high customer and employee satisfaction.
* Achieve parts/equipment order time KPI of 24 hours or less.
* Identify price increases in parts/equipment and work diligently with vendors to obtain best pricing.

* Verify all accounts payable are accurate and ensure the accounting department receives all payables in a timely manner.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications**

* High school diploma or equivalent required; associate degree or related coursework preferred.
* Minimum of 2 years of purchasing, inventory management, or administrative experience preferred.
* Experience in the HVAC, plumbing, construction, or home services industry preferred.
* Strong organizational and time management skills.
* Excellent communication and vendor relationship management abilities.

* Understanding of HVAC and plumbing materials, equipment, and terminology.
* Ability to analyze inventory trends and purchasing needs.
* Strong negotiation and cost-control skills.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating with multiple departments.
* Excellent recordkeeping and documentation skills.

**Physical Requirements**

* Ability to sit, stand, walk, and use a computer for extended periods.
* Ability to occasionally lift and move items up to 25 pounds.
* Ability to work in a warehouse or office environment as needed.

* Maintain adequate inventory levels to support company operations.
* Minimize material shortages and job delays.
* Process purchase orders accurately and efficiently.

**CordenPharma** is a leading full-service Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) specializing in active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs), excipients, drug products (DPs), and packaging. With around 3,000 employees worldwide, we help pharmaceutical and biotech companies manufacture medicines with the ultimate goal of improving people’s lives.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Our network, spanning Europe and the U.S., provides flexible and specialized solutions across six technology platforms: Peptides, Lipids & Carbohydrates, Injectables, Highly Potent & Oncology, Small Molecules, and Oligonucleotides. We strive for excellence in supporting this network and are committed to delivering the highest quality products for patient well-being.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Our People Vision**
---------------------

We strive for excellence. We share our passion. Together, we make a difference in patients' lives.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**SUMMARY**
-----------

The Procurement Coordinator partners closely with Procurement to execute purchasing needs while maintaining strong visibility into departmental budgets and ensuring compliance with internal policies, MAS requirements, and audit controls. Serves as the primary point of contact for all procurement-related activities within an assigned department. Detail-oriented, highly organized, and capable of collaborating cross-functionally to support efficient and compliant procurement operations.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**
-----------------------------------------

Include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

**Procurement Coordination**

* Serve as the central intake point for departmental purchasing requests
* Work with stakeholders to understand required goods/services, timing, and priorities
* Partner with Procurement to ensure sourcing and purchasing align with established processes

**Cost Center & Budget Support**

* Act as the Procurement Coordinator for the assigned department
* Maintain working knowledge of:
+ Budget structure and approved spending by G/L Account
+ Current commitments and anticipated purchasing needs
* Support alignment between purchasing activity and approved budgets

**SAP Requisitioning**

* Create and manage purchase requisitions in SAP
* Ensure accurate cost center and G/L coding, proper documentation, and MAS adherence

**Receipt & Acceptance**

* Acknowledge receipt and acceptance of goods and services
* Confirm deliveries align with purchase order requirements
* Complete receiving confirmations in SAP to support timely invoice processing
* Coordinate resolution of delivery or receiving discrepancies

**Policy & Compliance**

* Ensure all purchasing and receiving activities comply with procurement policies, MAS requirements, and audit standards
* Escalate exceptions or questions to Procurement as needed

**Marietta's Quilt & Sew / We're In Stitches — Greenville/Simpsonville, SC** **Part-Time to Start | Potential to Grow into Full-Time | On-Site**

About the Role

We are growing and adding a new position to help with our expansion. We're looking for a detail-oriented Inventory & Purchasing Coordinator to help us stay on top of ordering, receiving, and inventory accuracy across our two retail locations and our Shopify store. This role starts part-time, with the opportunity to grow into a full-time position as it proves out.

You'll be responsible for making sure purchase orders get created, tracked, and — most importantly — closed out correctly once product arrives, so our inventory system and Shopify always reflect what we actually have in the store.

What You'll Do

* **Purchasing:** Create and track purchase orders across our vendors (fabric, notions, machines, and accessories), and follow up with vendors when orders are delayed or something doesn't look right.
* **Receiving:** Check in incoming inventory against purchase orders and mark it received in our system promptly — so nothing sits "incoming" once it's actually on the shelf.
* **Inventory accuracy:** Help keep our inventory system and Shopify store in sync, so stock levels are accurate for staff and customers alike.
* **Cleanup:** Work through our current backlog of open purchase orders to confirm what's actually been received and get our records caught up.
* **Ongoing improvement:** Flag patterns — slow vendors, recurring shortages, reorder issues — and help us build simple, repeatable habits around receiving.

What We're Looking For

* Some experience with inventory management, purchasing, or retail operations.
* Comfort working with Shopify, or a similar e-commerce/POS platform (we'll train on specifics).
* Comfortable in spreadsheets (Google Sheets/Excel).
* Organized and detail-oriented — someone who notices when something doesn't add up and follows through until it's resolved.
* Reliable and communicative — comfortable following up with vendors and staying on top of open tasks without a lot of hand-holding.

Nice to Have

* Familiarity with an inventory/purchase order system (e.g., Sumtracker or similar).
* Experience in specialty retail or a small business environment.
* Interest in sewing, quilting, or the craft industry.

Schedule & Growth

This role starts part-time, with flexibility around hours. As our inventory processes improve and the role proves its value, there's a real path to full-time.

*To apply, please submit your resume and a brief note about your experience with inventory management and purchasing.*

Pay: $14.00 - $22.00 per hour

Work Location: In person

With 60 years of experience across industries and a vast network of over 100 sites worldwide, Jabil combines global reach with local expertise to deliver both scalable and customized solutions. Our commitment extends beyond business success as we strive to build sustainable processes that minimize environmental impact and foster vibrant and diverse communities around the globe.

**JOB SUMMARY**
---------------

As a Procurement Coordinator, you will play a key role in supporting procurement operations and cross-functional business activities to ensure materials, services, and resources are available when and where they are needed. This position provides administrative and operational support to the Procurement team while partnering with multiple departments to drive efficient purchasing processes, inventory accuracy, equipment maintenance coordination, facility initiatives, and operational continuity.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**
-----------------------------------------

* Support procurement activities by preparing and issuing Requests for Quotation (RFQs) and organizing supplier quotations for review and analysis.
* Assist procurement team members with purchasing activities to support customer sales, repair, and operational requirements.
* Create, process, and maintain purchase orders for direct materials, indirect materials, tooling, maintenance, repair services, and other business needs.
* Support Bill of Materials (BOM) purchasing activities to ensure timely availability of required components.
* Maintain inventory-related data and assist with inventory management initiatives to support operational objectives.
* Provide administrative and transactional support to Procurement Buyers, including data entry, supplier information maintenance, pricing updates, virtual inventory management, and system record accuracy.
* Coordinate equipment and machine maintenance service requests in partnership with production leadership and service providers.
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders across manufacturing, operations, facilities, shipping and receiving, and other functional teams to support business initiatives and continuous improvement projects.
* Assist in the planning and coordination of company events and facility-related improvement activities.
* Provide backup support for shipping and receiving operations, as required.
* Gather and analyze information to support procurement decisions, recommendations, and special projects.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, procurement procedures, quality standards, and applicable business requirements.
Participate in continuous improvement activities that enhance efficiency, service levels, and operational effectiveness.

**JOB QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------

* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines simultaneously.
* Ability to analyze information, exercise sound judgment, and make recommendations based on available data.
* Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build effective working relationships across all levels of the organization.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Customer-focused mindset with the ability to provide responsive support to internal stakeholders.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
* Ability to work independently while contributing as an engaged team member.
* Solutions-oriented approach with a willingness to learn and continuously improve.
* Ability to prioritize tasks and adapt to changing business needs.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Word, and Outlook.
Experience with ERP systems and account management databases preferred; Epicor experience is a plus.

### **EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE**

* High school diploma or equivalent required.
* Associate degree in Business, Supply Chain, Operations, or a related field preferred.
* Previous experience in purchasing, procurement, inventory management, customer service, or administrative support preferred.
Manufacturing environment experience is a plus.

-----------------------

* Medical, Dental, Prescription Drug, and Vision Insurance with HRA and HSA options

**Job Summary**

We are seeking an experienced Purchasing Manager to oversee the purchasing of materials, equipment, parts, and supplies for our construction projects and day-to-day operations. This position is responsible for obtaining competitive pricing, managing vendor relationships, coordinating deliveries, and ensuring materials are available when needed to keep projects moving.

The ideal candidate is organized, detail-oriented, proactive, and comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced construction environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage the purchasing process from material requests through delivery.
* Review project requirements, material lists, specifications, and purchase requests.
* Obtain and compare vendor quotes for pricing, availability, quality, and delivery.
* Issue and manage purchase orders and track orders through completion.
* Negotiate pricing, terms, lead times, and delivery schedules with vendors.
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with suppliers and vendors.
* Monitor open orders and proactively address backorders, shortages, delays, and other issues that could impact projects.
* Work closely with Project Managers, Estimators, Field Personnel, and other departments to ensure materials are purchased and delivered according to project schedules.
* Verify quantities, pricing, specifications, and delivery information for accuracy.
* Resolve issues involving incorrect, damaged, or short shipments and invoice discrepancies.
* Source alternative products or suppliers when necessary.
* Monitor material and equipment costs and identify opportunities for cost savings.
* Assist with inventory management and maintain appropriate stock levels.
* Maintain accurate purchasing records, vendor information, pricing, and related documentation.
* Continuously look for ways to improve purchasing processes, efficiency, and cost control.

**Qualifications**

* Previous experience in purchasing, procurement, or supply chain management.
* Construction industry experience preferred.
* Strong vendor management and negotiation skills.
* Ability to read and understand material lists, specifications, and project documentation.
* Excellent organizational and time-management skills.
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
* Strong communication, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating with project and field teams.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and general computer applications.
* Experience with purchasing or construction management software is a plus.

Pay: $60,000.00 - $85,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Ability to Commute:

* Massapequa, NY 11758 (Required)

Work Location: In person

description:
Fisher Industries is a vertically integrated family of businesses that provides heavy civil construction and aggregate products across the United States. With over 70 years of experience, the company specializes in highways, bridges, aggregates, and large-scale infrastructure projects, supported by in-house capabilities in drilling, blasting, crushing, asphalt, and concrete production. Fisher is committed to delivering innovative, cost-effective solutions with an emphasis on safety and quality. As a proven industry leader, Fisher Industries continues to grow while maintaining the integrity and values of a family-owned company. For additional information about our company, visit our website at www.fisherind.com

**POSITION SCOPE**

The **Parts & Procurement Coordinator** serves as the central communication and coordination hub between Field Operations, Procurement, Warehouse personnel, vendors, and management. This role is responsible for managing procurement request intake, tracking request status, prioritizing operational needs, maintaining procurement records, and ensuring timely communication throughout the purchasing process. By centralizing request management and status reporting, this position allows Procurement Specialists to focus on sourcing, purchasing, vendor management, and expediting activities that support critical construction, aggregate, and equipment operations.

**PRIMARY DUTIES**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for incoming parts, material, and procurement requests from field personnel, supervisors, project managers, mechanics, and operational teams.
* Manage a high volume of incoming communications and procurement-related requests daily.
* Create, document, and maintain procurement requests and work orders within department tracking systems and dashboards.
* Capture and verify required request details including equipment numbers, project information, quantities, priorities, delivery locations, and required completion dates.
* Review requests for accuracy and completeness and route them to the appropriate Procurement Specialist based on business segment, equipment type, or operational need.
* Prioritize requests based on equipment downtime, project schedules, operational urgency, and management direction.
* Maintain current status information for active procurement requests and provide updates to requesting departments.
* Communicate estimated delivery dates, shipment tracking information, backorders, delays, substitutions, and order status updates.
* Escalate urgent, delayed, or stalled requests to Procurement Specialists or department leadership as necessary.
* Track procurement requests from initial intake through completion and verify accurate closeout documentation.
* Coordinate parts and material pickups, transfers, and deliveries with warehouse personnel, drivers, and field teams.
* Maintain organized records including quotes, purchase orders, invoices, tracking information, vendor communications, and procurement documentation.
* Maintain current vendor and supplier contact information and identify potential duplicate requests or communication gaps.
* Document emergency purchases and after-hours procurement activity.
* Prepare and distribute procurement status reports for department leadership and operational stakeholders.
* Assist Procurement Specialists with administrative and reporting responsibilities during periods of high purchasing volume.
* Maintain effective communication between Field Operations, Procurement, Warehouse personnel, and delivery teams.
* Promote safety, efficiency, and teamwork across all business operations.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**REQUIREMENTS**

* High school diploma or GED required; associate degree in business, supply chain, logistics, or related field preferred.
* Previous experience in procurement coordination, purchasing support, parts administration, inventory control, construction operations, fleet maintenance, or related field preferred.
* Strong organizational, multitasking, and time-management skills.
* Ability to prioritize competing demands in a fast-paced operational environment.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite, including Excel, Outlook, and Teams.
* Experience with purchasing, inventory, ERP, fleet management, or work-order tracking systems preferred.
* Strong attention to detail and problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to work effectively with personnel at all organizational levels, vendors, and external partners.
* Knowledge of heavy equipment, construction, aggregate production, trucking, or fleet operations preferred.

Fisher Industries is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

We are a drug-free work environment requiring pre-employment and random drug testing.

If you require an accommodation with applying, please email hrdept@fisherind.com or call the HR Department at (701) 456-9184 to request accommodations. This email is only to request accommodation for

description:
**Company Overview**
Pulp Studio Inc. is a leading manufacturer of fine architectural glass products, dedicated to delivering high-quality solutions that enhance modern spaces. We pride ourselves on innovation, craftsmanship, and excellence in every project we undertake.

**Job Overview**
We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Procurement Coordinator to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will be responsible for sourcing and purchasing materials essential for our manufacturing processes, ensuring timely delivery and adherence to quality standards. Your expertise will help maintain smooth production workflows and uphold our commitment to superior product quality.

**Duties**

* Creates POS with supporting documents (ex. Packing slips, payment info), issues, tracks, and follows up on purchase orders to ensure materials are ordered and delivered on time.
* Communicates with vendors regarding pricing, availability, lead times, order status, quality issues, and delivery schedules.
* Monitors inventory levels and assists with identifying when materials need to be reordered.
* Tracks material availability and communicates potential shortages or delays to the appropriate teams.
* Coordinates incoming material deliveries and verifies quantities and documentation upon receipt.
* Develops and maintains positive working relationships with suppliers and vendors.
* Requests and compares vendor quotes and assists with identifying cost-effective purchasing options.
* Works closely with Production, Inside Sales, and Project Management to understand current and upcoming material requirements.
* Maintains organized purchasing records, including purchase orders, packing slips, invoices, product information, and Safety Data Sheets (SDS).
* Assists with researching new materials, products, and suppliers when project or production material needs arise.
* Optimizes usage based on incoming orders with an emphasis in reducing obsolescence.
* Develops and maintains a buying/price database in the company’s ERP (PSIOPS) for every product.

**Qualifications**

* Proven experience in procurement, inventory, supply chain, manufacturing, or related field.
* Ability to handle materials safely according to safety standards in production
* Strong negotiation skills and attention to detail in materials handling and inventory management
* Ability to communicate clearly and professionally, both verbal and written.
* Customer service driven.
* Glass or construction related experience preferred.
* Bilingual (English/Spanish) preferred.

*Pulp Studio, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against persons because of age, race, color, creed, religion, disability, gender, ethnic or national origin, or veteran status. Pulp Studio prohibits discrimination against individuals with disabilities and will reasonably accommodate applicants with a disability, upon request, and will also ensure reasonable accommodation to employees with a disability.*

Pay: $20.00 - $26.00 per hour

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Employee assistance program
* Health insurance
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

description:
**Surgical Republic | On-site — Southern California**

**About the role:**

Surgical Republic supplies surgical instruments, disposables and implants to hospitals and surgery centers. We are seeking an organized, reliable Inventory & Purchasing Coordinator to manage supplier orders and move products accurately from receiving through customer delivery.

You will order from approved U.S. and international suppliers, maintain inventory records, pack and ship orders, and follow up on delays. Our customer-service team handles instrument cross-referencing and provides the approved product specifications and part numbers.

**Responsibilities:**

Purchasing and supplier follow-up

* Place purchase orders using approved suppliers, part numbers, quantities and spending limits.
* Confirm pricing, pack sizes, availability and delivery dates before ordering.
* Track open supplier orders and follow up on backorders or delayed shipments.
* Coordinate international shipment documentation with suppliers and freight/customs contacts.
* Flag unexpected freight charges, tariffs, price increases and delivery risks.
* Route substitutions or unclear product details to customer service for approval.
* Send supplier invoices and payment requests to the financial controller.

Inventory and receiving

* Receive deliveries and verify products, quantities and condition against purchase orders.
* Record receipts, stock movements and storage locations accurately.
* Maintain an organized, clearly labeled inventory area.
* Conduct regular cycle counts and investigate discrepancies.
* Monitor approved stock levels and submit replenishment needs.
* Track trial/demo instruments, returns and outstanding loaned inventory.

Order fulfillment

* Pick, check and pack the correct products and quantities.
* Prepare packing slips, shipping labels and required documents.
* Schedule carrier pickups and record tracking information.
* Coordinate partial shipments and backorders with customer service.
* Process approved returns and report damaged or incorrect items.

Order tracking and communication

* Keep the shared order tracker current, including supplier confirmations, delivery dates, blockers and shipment status.
* Notify customer service promptly when an order’s promised date is at risk.
* Maintain purchase orders, invoices and shipping records so each transaction can be traced.
* Log incoming customer checks and hand them to the authorized person for deposit.

**How you will work with the team:**

* Hassan, Customer Service: Provides cross-referenced products and approved part numbers; handles customer communication.
* Angelina, Financial Controller: Handles supplier payments, customer collections and financial reconciliation.
* Sales team: Provides approved trial requests and upcoming customer requirements.
* Sam, Owner: Approves spending exceptions, new suppliers and unusual purchasing commitments.

You will not independently select equivalent instruments, change approved specifications, set customer pricing or authorize supplier payments.

**Qualifications:**

* Experience in inventory coordination, purchasing, warehouse operations or order fulfillment.
* Strong attention to part numbers, quantities, pack sizes and documentation.
* Comfortable using spreadsheets, inventory systems and shipping software.
* Reliable supplier follow-up and clear written communication.
* Ability to manage multiple open orders and flag problems early.
* Ability to perform the physical receiving, packing and shipping duties, with reasonable accommodation.

Medical-device or surgical-instrument distribution experience is preferred. Experience with international purchasing, QuickBooks, Shopify or Fishbowl is helpful.

**What success looks like:**

* Accurate inventory records and organized stock.
* Correct, complete customer shipments.
* Supplier orders placed within approved costs and quantities.
* Delays identified and communicated promptly.
* Clear tracking of every open order and trial return.
* Routine orders completed with minimal management intervention.

Pay: $22.00 - $25.00 per hour

Work Location: In person

* Confirm pricing, pack sizes, availability and delivery dates before ordering.
* Track open supplier orders and follow up on backorders or delayed shipments.
* Coordinate international shipment documentation with suppliers and freight/customs contacts.
* Flag unexpected freight charges, tariffs, price increases and delivery risks.
* Route substitutions or unclear product details to customer service for approval.
* Send supplier invoices and payment requests to the financial controller.

* Maintain purchase orders, invoices and shipping records so each transaction can be traced.
* Log incoming customer checks and hand them to the authorized person for deposit.

* Angelina, Financial Controller: Handles supplier payments, customer collections and financial reconciliation.
* Sales team: Provides approved trial requests and upcoming customer requirements.
* Sam, Owner: Approves spending exceptions, new suppliers and unusual purchasing commitments.

You will not independently select equivalent instruments, change approved specifications, set customer pricing or authorize supplier payments.

**Qualifications:**

* Experience in inventory coordination, purchasing, warehouse operations or order fulfillment.
* Strong attention to part numbers, quantities, pack sizes and documentation.
* Comfortable using spreadsheets, inventory systems and shipping software.
* Reliable supplier follow-up and clear written communication.
* Ability to manage multiple open orders and flag problems early.
* Ability to perform the physical receiving, packing and shipping duties, with reasonable accommodation.

Medical-device or surgical-instrument distribution experience is preferred. Experience with international purchasing, QuickBooks, Shopify or Fishbowl is helpful.

* Accurate inventory records and organized stock.
* Correct, complete customer shipments.
* Supplier orders placed within approved costs and quantities.
* Delays identified and communicated promptly.
* Clear tracking of every open order and trial return.
* Routine orders completed with minimal management intervention.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Procurement & Purchasing**

* Purchase structural steel, plate, tubing, grating, fasteners, welding supplies, paint, hardware, and fabrication consumables.
* Obtain and evaluate vendor quotes to ensure best pricing, quality, and delivery.
* Issue purchase orders and maintain accurate purchasing records.
* Monitor market pricing trends for steel and related materials.
* Develop and maintain relationships with steel mills, service centers, distributors, and suppliers.

**Inventory Management**

* Track inventory levels and coordinate replenishment of stock materials.
* Verify material receipts against purchase orders and packing slips.
* Assist with inventory counts and material audits.
* Minimize excess inventory while ensuring production requirements are met.

**Vendor Management**

* Evaluate supplier performance related to quality, pricing, and delivery.
* Resolve discrepancies involving shipments, invoices, shortages, and damaged materials.
* Negotiate pricing, delivery schedules, and payment terms.

**Project Support**

* Collaborate with Estimating, Engineering, Project Management, and Production departments to ensure required materials are available for fabrication and erection schedules.
* Review project specifications and drawings to identify purchasing requirements.
* Expedite critical materials to prevent production delays.

**Documentation & Compliance**

* Maintain purchasing files, vendor certifications, mill test reports, and material traceability documentation.
* Ensure purchased materials meet company standards, customer requirements, and project specifications.
* Process and reconcile vendor invoices with accounting.

**Qualifications**

**Education**

* Associate's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Construction Management, or related field preferred.
* Equivalent work experience considered.

**Experience**

* 3+ years of purchasing experience, preferably in structural steel fabrication, construction, manufacturing, or industrial environments.
* Experience purchasing carbon steel, stainless steel, aluminum, welding supplies, and industrial materials preferred.

**Skills**

* Strong negotiation and vendor management skills.
* Ability to read and interpret structural steel shop drawings and specifications.
* Knowledge of steel grades, shapes, and fabrication processes.
* Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite and Tekla Power Fab
* Strong organizational and multitasking abilities.
* Excellent communication and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple priorities.

**Physical Requirements**

* Ability to walk through fabrication and warehouse areas.
* Ability to inspect incoming materials and verify quantities.
* Ability to sit, stand, and use a computer for extended periods.

**Performance Expectations**

* Maintain cost-effective purchasing practices.
* Support on-time project completion and fabrication schedules.
* Reduce material shortages and procurement delays.
* Develop strategic supplier partnerships to increase efficiency and profitability.

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Vision insurance

At Sierra Space, we build the missions and systems that keep our world secure in the domain above Earth.

We are mission-driven, and together, we are an extraordinary team.

They will gather and distribute procurement documentation such as drawings, specifications, and statements of work from various data sources. The position involves maintaining procurement databases with high accuracy by entering, extracting, and updating information to support procurement agents and maintain data integrity. The coordinator will communicate effectively with procurement agents, internal stakeholders, and suppliers to resolve procurement cycle issues, identify and help resolve procurement discrepancies related to quotes, billing, contracts, and other documentation. Additionally, they will support Procurement Agents in completing procurement transactions and post-purchase order activities, while coordinating, scheduling, and leading procurement-related meetings with team members and stakeholders.

Our mission is driven by an unyielding commitment to advancing space-based technology in service of our customers and safeguarding national security. * Demonstrated ability to complete low-value procurement transactions under supervision
* Experience with purchase order tracking and supplier follow-up
* Accuracy in database management and data entry
* Strong communication skills with internal and external stakeholders
* Ability to identify and help resolve procurement discrepancies
* Experience in coordinating and scheduling meetings

* Associate degree in business, supply chain management, or related field
* Experience as a Procurement Coordinator/Administrator
* Advanced Excel skills for complex data analysis and reporting
* Experience creating and maintaining supplier performance metrics
* Knowledge of procurement systems and databases

* Demonstrated ability to lead procurement-related meetings

description:
**Overview:**

The Procurement Coordinator plays a critical support role within the Procurement Department, functioning as the logistical and administrative “command center” for the buying process. This position supports Buyers by managing the clerical, operational, and coordination aspects of product procurement from purchase order creation and transportation arrangements to inbound tracking, system entries, and internal communication. This is an excellent entry-point for individuals looking to gain exposure to the produce industry, supply chain operations, and cross-functional logistics. You’ll work closely with shippers, drivers, customers, warehouse teams, and various departments across the organization, learning firsthand how products move from grower to warehouse to customer.

This is a great role for someone who wants to learn how different parts of an operation all work together. In this role, you can expect to interact with different types of people and teams, work on a variety of tasks, and learn a lot about the produce industry, produce supply chain and buying process, while also being exposed to virtually every other touchpoint of the organization.

**Key Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:**

* Purchase Order Management
* Create purchase order folders and enter corresponding load and shipment information into internal systems.
* Review shipping confirmations and update PO details once product is confirmed as loaded at origin.
* Inbound Coordination & Logistics
* Arrange and dispatch inbound FOB (Freight On Board) orders in coordination with shippers and carriers.
* Track scheduled ETAs for all inbound loads and communicate updates proactively to internal teams.
* Customs & Documentation
* Review receiving paperwork for incoming loads; update system entries and escalate any discrepancies or quality issues to Buyers or vendors.
* Organize, document, and report shipment discrepancies to support any claims or vendor reviews.
* Communication & Coordination
* Liaise with warehouse supervisors and operations teams regarding product arrivals, staging, and any special instructions.
* Monitor USDA email alerts and attach inspections to the appropriate inventory lots, notifying the relevant stakeholders.
* Monitor Foodlink/iTrade systems and maintain accurate vendor communication records.
* Returns & Claims
* Arrange customer returns, vendor returns, and street pick-ups when necessary.
* Support the processing of truck claims by gathering and submitting appropriate information in a timely manner.
* Track and follow up on direct-to-customer deliveries; confirm appointments and collect signed delivery receipts.
* Transportation Scheduling
* Secure outbound transportation for customer orders, including arranging third-party carriers when needed.
* Schedule delivery appointments with chain and independent customers, ensuring accurate timing and communication.
* Cross-functional Support
* Serve as a reliable point of contact for both internal departments and external partners.
* Provide backup support to other Procurement staff as needed.
* Monitor and restock supplies in all shared employee spaces, including main kitchen, buyer’s kitchen, and lunchrooms
* Perform other administrative or operational tasks as assigned.

**Qualifications & Requirements**

* Experience: 1–2 years of experience in an administrative, logistics, customer service, or operations support role preferred.
* Experience in produce, food service, wholesale, or import/export industries is a plus.
* Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written
* Comfortable working cross-functionally with various teams and external partners.
* A proactive, service-oriented attitude with a strong sense of urgency.
* Professional demeanor with the ability to interact effectively with all levels of staff.
* Proactive, flexible, and eager to learn.
* Competent with data entry, email, and working within order tracking or ERP systems.
* Expertise with Microsoft Office (Excel, Outlook, Word).

**Work Environment & Schedule**

* Fast-paced, warehouse-adjacent office environment.
* Must be comfortable working around perishable products and in a logistics-heavy setting.
* Availability for weekend or early morning shifts may be required based on seasonal demand.

**Schedule:** Full-Time; M-F

**Pay:** $52,000 - $62,000 per year

**Location:** Burlington, NJ

Equal Opportunity Employer

In business over sixty years, we pride ourselves on our products, our people and our contributions to the medical industry. We are presently looking for a purchasing coordinator to join our team.

We seek a purchasing coordinator who is friendly, hard working and thrives in a fast paced environment. Must be organized, self-motivated, detail oriented, and able to multi-task. Must understand inventory planning. Candidates must possess the ability to work independently or as part of a team. Epicor experience a big plus.

* 401(k) matching

description:
**Join Komatsu and Be Part of Something Big!**

**Job Overview**
----------------

To develop and maintain suppliers for all production parts in accordance to quality, cost and delivery requirements and to ensure continuous improvement of QDC, while reducing purchased – part cost by continually identifying and implementing cost reduction measures with suppliers and controlling inventory to meet current target levels – all the while adhering to the mandated goal to produce machines which meet or exceed the requirements of the design specification.

**Key Job Responsibilities**
----------------------------

* Creates manual orders and/or review MRP generated orders (checking accuracy) promptly and ensure suppliers have acknowledged receipt of orders
* Follow up on orders to ensure that the materials are shipped and delivered as promised to avoid expediting and any production downtime.
* Maintain records of all purchase order and associated documents for all processes and maintain knowledge on all open orders and its status and provide assistance to all purchasing staff and manage all calls for purchasing and delivery schedule.
* Coordinates and decides disposition of rejected parts in a prompt/cost effective manner to prevent production stoppages and workforce downtime
* Assist the Accounting Dept. and Warehouse in resolving unpaid invoices due to pricing and/or receiving discrepancies.
* Notify Purchasing Supervisor / Purchasing Manager immediately upon notice of a potential parts issue that may impact the production line.
* Maintain the accuracy of all databases and spreadsheets
* Attend production and material review meetings when required
* Performs other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications/Requirements**
-------------------------------

* BS degree in Business, Engineering or related field and 1-3 years materials experience, - OR - 2 years college and 5-7 years manufacturing experience working with materials (purchasing, planning, warehouse, - OR 9-11 years manufacturing experience working with materials (purchasing, planning, warehouse).
* Excellent computer skills including Excel, Access, PowerPoint and Word.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills.
* Good organizational skills and attention to detail.

**Additional Information**
--------------------------

**Diversity & Inclusion Commitment**

At Komatsu we come from diverse backgrounds, with unique perspectives, experiences, and contributions. We are committed to creating a workforce that is reflective of the communities we work and live in. We believe that our people are part of our shared purpose. We are authentic, ambitious, and innovative in our pursuit of Diversity & Inclusion. United, we are on a journey towards a sustainable future that creates value together.

**Company Information**

Komatsu is a world leader in manufacturing construction, mining, forestry, and industrial heavy equipment. Founded in 1921, Komatsu has a long history of quality, reliability, innovation, and excellence. Headquartered in Tokyo, Japan, Komatsu facilities, distributors and dealers are in more than 140 countries and employ more than 60,000 people. Komatsu offers a diverse and challenging work environment, where you can grow your skills and career, and contribute to a sustainable, clean-energy future. If you are looking for a company that values your talent and potential, be a part of something big and join a team that is shaping the world!

If you want to learn more about Komatsu, please visit our website at https://www.komatsu.com/ .

*Katzman Distribution is a startup full-service produce distribution company servicing the independent supermarket customer base in the NY/NJ/CT/PA/DE markets. The company prioritizes customer service and retail merchandising guidance as two of the primary pillars for growth and customer satisfaction. As is customary with a startup, we encourage an all-hands-on-deck work ethic and offer unlimited growth potential to the team that builds our business.*

**Overview:**

The Procurement Coordinator plays a critical support role within the Procurement Department, functioning as the logistical and administrative “command center” for the buying process. This position supports Buyers by managing the clerical, operational, and coordination aspects of product procurement from purchase order creation and transportation arrangements to inbound tracking, system entries, and internal communication. This is an excellent entry-point for individuals looking to gain exposure to the produce industry, supply chain operations, and cross-functional logistics. You’ll work closely with shippers, drivers, customers, warehouse teams, and various departments across the organization, learning firsthand how products move from grower to warehouse to customer.

This is a great role for someone who wants to learn how different parts of an operation all work together. In this role, you can expect to interact with different types of people and teams, work on a variety of tasks, and learn a lot about the produce industry, produce supply chain and buying process, while also being exposed to virtually every other touchpoint of the organization.

**Key Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:**

* Purchase Order Management
* Create purchase order folders and enter corresponding load and shipment information into internal systems.
* Review shipping confirmations and update PO details once product is confirmed as loaded at origin.
* Inbound Coordination & Logistics
* Arrange and dispatch inbound FOB (Freight On Board) orders in coordination with shippers and carriers.
* Track scheduled ETAs for all inbound loads and communicate updates proactively to internal teams.
* Customs & Documentation
* Review receiving paperwork for incoming loads; update system entries and escalate any discrepancies or quality issues to Buyers or vendors.
* Organize, document, and report shipment discrepancies to support any claims or vendor reviews.
* Communication & Coordination
* Liaise with warehouse supervisors and operations teams regarding product arrivals, staging, and any special instructions.
* Monitor USDA email alerts and attach inspections to the appropriate inventory lots, notifying the relevant stakeholders.
* Monitor Foodlink/iTrade systems and maintain accurate vendor communication records.
* Returns & Claims
* Arrange customer returns, vendor returns, and street pick-ups when necessary.
* Support the processing of truck claims by gathering and submitting appropriate information in a timely manner.
* Track and follow up on direct-to-customer deliveries; confirm appointments and collect signed delivery receipts.
* Transportation Scheduling
* Secure outbound transportation for customer orders, including arranging third-party carriers when needed.
* Schedule delivery appointments with chain and independent customers, ensuring accurate timing and communication.
* Cross-functional Support
* Serve as a reliable point of contact for both internal departments and external partners.
* Provide backup support to other Procurement staff as needed.
* Monitor and restock supplies in all shared employee spaces, including main kitchen, buyer’s kitchen, and lunchrooms
* Perform other administrative or operational tasks as assigned.

**Qualifications & Requirements**

* Experience: 1–2 years of experience in an administrative, logistics, customer service, or operations support role preferred.
* Experience in produce, food service, wholesale, or import/export industries is a plus.
* Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written
* Comfortable working cross-functionally with various teams and external partners.
* A proactive, service-oriented attitude with a strong sense of urgency.
* Professional demeanor with the ability to interact effectively with all levels of staff.
* Proactive, flexible, and eager to learn.
* Competent with data entry, email, and working within order tracking or ERP systems.
* Expertise with Microsoft Office (Excel, Outlook, Word).

**Work Environment & Schedule**

* Fast-paced, warehouse-adjacent office environment.
* Must be comfortable working around perishable products and in a logistics-heavy setting.
* Availability for weekend or early morning shifts may be required based on seasonal demand.

**Pay:** $52,000 - $62,000 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off

**Job Summary**

Owyhee Tavern is seeking a detail-oriented Purchasing Coordinator to support purchasing, inventory, and vendor-related activities. This position helps ensure the restaurant has the ingredients, beverages, supplies, and operational materials needed for consistent daily service while maintaining accurate records and cost awareness.

**Responsibilities**

* Coordinate routine purchasing and replenishment of food, beverage, and restaurant supplies.
* Communicate with vendors regarding orders, pricing, availability, deliveries, and discrepancies.
* Prepare purchase orders and maintain accurate purchasing documentation.
* Monitor inventory levels and identify items that need to be reordered.
* Compare pricing and product availability to support cost-effective purchasing decisions.
* Verify deliveries against invoices and purchase orders for quantity and accuracy.
* Maintain organized records of vendors, orders, invoices, and product information.
* Coordinate with kitchen and management teams regarding product requirements.
* Track product usage, shortages, substitutions, and delivery issues.
* Assist with inventory counts and periodic cost reviews.
* Follow company purchasing procedures and food-safety requirements.

**Qualifications**

* Previous purchasing, inventory, restaurant operations, or administrative experience preferred.
* Experience in food-service or hospitality purchasing is a plus.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills.
* Excellent attention to detail and record-keeping abilities.
* Comfortable working with spreadsheets, POS/inventory systems, or purchasing software.
* Strong communication and vendor-management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple orders and deadlines accurately.
* Basic understanding of food costs, inventory control, and restaurant supplies preferred.

**Benefits**

* Competitive Boise-area annual salary
* Full-time position
* Employee dining benefits or discounts, where applicable
* Professional development opportunities
* Collaborative restaurant environment
* Opportunities to grow within hospitality operations

**About The Company**

Owyhee Tavern is a Boise dining establishment known for its full-service restaurant and bar environment. The team focuses on quality food, beverages, hospitality, and efficient day-to-day operations supported by strong coordination between management, kitchen, and service teams.

* Regular and consistent engagement, participation and promotion of Herzog’s Culture and its essential behaviors are a requirement for this position.
* Regular and predictable attendance and punctuality are a requirement for this position.
* Other duties as assigned.

* High school diploma or equivalent.
* Bachelor’s degree preferred.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail are a must.
* Time-management skills are essential; must possess a natural sense of urgency and work well with pressure and deadlines.
* Must be a self-starter and able to excel in a fast-paced environment.
* Flexible and adaptive to change.
* Possess a high level of ingenuity.
* Must have strong interpersonal skills, ability to interact with all levels of employees and prospects.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office Products and advanced computer literacy skills.
* Ability to maintain a high level of confidentiality

* Subject to pre-employment physical, medical evaluation, and drug screen.

* Frequently sits for extended periods of time.
* Frequently use a computer keyboard and office related equipment.
* Requires occasional standing, walking, lifting, stooping or bending.

* Herzog is nationally recognized for its excellent corporate safety record which results from all employees at all levels, in all positions adhering to established policies and procedures. **Benefits:**

* Herzog offers a robust benefits package including medical and dental coverage. The plans are specific to projects and locations.

**Why Herzog:**

Founded in 1969, Herzog is headquartered in St. Joseph, Missouri, with a satellite office in Fort Worth, Texas.

We believe our culture is at the heart of our existence. It is that belief which empowers every member of our professional family to act with purpose and passion as they advance their career throughout their personal pursuit of excellence.

Backed by over five decades of experience, Herzog delivers exceptional customer service and elite results.

Our success is the outcome of our relentless pursuit of excellence, our passion for our customers, safety without compromise, and a deep-rooted belief in the power of team.

We invite you to join us on our journey to excellence as we work to be better today than yesterday and better tomorr

description:
**Job Description:**

The Procurement Coordinator supports the day-to-day purchasing and vendor management functions across our construction projects. This is a highly tactical, execution-focused role responsible for keeping materials, equipment, and subcontracted services moving smoothly and arriving on time to support project schedules. The coordinator works closely with suppliers, vendors, and project teams to champion ideas and drive the smooth, on-time operation of procurement activities.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

The essential functions include, but are not limited to the following:

* Plan and execute initiatives to support vendor and supplier processes on a daily basis, with the goal of 100% on-time delivery of construction materials and equipment to job sites.
* Send monthly follow-up lists to vendors and suppliers to request status updates and review outstanding deliveries.

* Expedite shortage items, past-due materials and equipment, and urgent parts requests to help avoid project delays.
* Perform data analysis and reporting on vendor performance, material pricing, and delivery timelines using Microsoft Excel.
* Manage the purchase order (PO) process and vendor acknowledgments for construction materials, equipment, and subcontracted services.
* Coordinate with project managers and site superintendents to confirm material and equipment needs align with project schedules.
* Support procurement operations across active construction project sites and coordinate with the broader purchasing team as needed.
* Maintain accurate procurement records and vendor documentation.
* Perform other duties as assigned

**Minimum Qualifications (Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities)**

* One to two years of experience in supply chain, procurement, or construction purchasing
* Ability to work onsite in Seattle.
* Comfortable working within Excel workbooks; familiarity with construction materials and equipment a plus.
* Self-starter who can work independently and as part of a team.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills, both written and oral.
* Ability to solve problems and recommend solutions.
* Strong organizational, multi-tasking, and time-management skills.
* Familiarity with construction terminology, materials, and project schedules preferred.

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS AND WORK ENVIRONMENT**

The physical demands and work environment characteristics described here represent those an employee may encounter while performing the essential functions of this position. The company complies with all applicable federal, state, and local laws, including the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and the Fair Employment and Housing Act (FEHA), and will provide reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.

Employees in this role must be able to:

* Communicate effectively, both verbally and in writing.
* Frequently sit for extended periods; occasionally stand, walk, reach, handle objects, climb, balance, stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl.
* Frequently lift and/or move up to **30 lbs**, with occasional heavier lifting as needed. If a task requires lifting beyond the recommended weight limit, employees will receive appropriate assistance, equipment, or team lifting support in compliance with Cal/OSHA safety regulations.

This position may involve exposure to moving mechanical parts, airborne particles, chemicals, electrical hazards, and other workplace risks. The company provides all necessary personal protective equipment (PPE) in accordance with OSHA regulations. Noise levels are generally moderate but may require hearing protection in certain situations.

**Salary Range:**

$28-$30/hr

**About The Company:**

**Onni**

For over half a century, Onni has been building communities for people to live, work, and play. Our success reflects our commitment to our employees and partners, and our dedication to quality construction, innovation, sustainability, and customer satisfaction. Our expertise expands across North America, with offices in Vancouver, Toronto, Los Angeles, Seattle, Phoenix, and Chicago.

**AI Use:**

This role may involve the use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support research, analysis, content development, design, reporting, or operational efficiency. Employees are expected to use AI responsibly and in compliance with company policies, data privacy requirements, confidentiality obligations, and applicable laws.

All AI-generated or AI-assisted outputs must be reviewed for accuracy, quality, and appropriateness before use. Employees are also expected to disclose when AI tools have been used in the creation of work and must not present AI-generated content as solely their own original work.

**How To Apply:**

*Please apply through the link on the job posting and attach your resume and any other required documents.*

*We thank all applicants for your interest in the Onni Group. Note that only those applicants under consideration will be contacted.*
