**Role Description**: Entry Level Purchasing Assistant

**Company Background**

Denier Electric is a family-owned business with a rich history that goes back over 8 decades. The business started as a small electrical contractor business in 1942 and has grown into a multi-division business capable of meeting the needs of just about any construction project. We are a regional leader amongst our peers specializing in commercial, mission critical, multi-family housing, healthcare, institutional and specialty electrical projects.

Denier is seeking eager, hardworking individuals to join our team. If you have a dedicated work ethic and enjoy working in a safety-focused, productive team environment this job is for you.

**Opportunity**

Denier is looking to expand our Purchasing team with an entry level Purchasing Agent. Experience in the electrical distribution or contracting business is preferred but not required.

**Job Responsibilities & Requirements**

* Solicit quotes for product/material needed
* Issue and process purchase orders for product/material
* Data entry, monitoring, and tracking of purchase orders, including back orders
* Inspect product/material in the warehouse
* Infrequent light warehouse duties
* Basic computer skills using Microsoft Word and Excel

**Skills**

* Ability to work well with others in a team oriented environment
* Self-motivated with a willingness to learn
* Punctual

**What We Offer**

* Competitive Pay
* Paid Time Off (PTO)
* 401K with a Company match
* A fully paid medical plan.
* Dental and vision insurance available
* Provided Short-Term Disability
* Long-Term Disability available
* Provided Basic Life Insurance
* Supplemental Life Insurance available

Visit our website at www.denier.com to learn more about us and email your resume to our Human Resources Department at HR@denier.com.

Job Type: Full-time

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

* Conduct price comparisons and negotiate with suppliers to secure the best terms.

* Document Standard Operating Procedures
* Research and identify new suppliers to expand the vendor network

* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

WHO WE ARE:
Headquartered in Southern California, Skechers—the Comfort Technology Company®—has spent over 30 years helping men, women, and kids everywhere look and feel good. Comfort innovation is at the core of everything we do, driving the development of stylish, high-quality products at a great value. From our diverse footwear collections to our expanding range of apparel and accessories, Skechers is a complete lifestyle brand.

ABOUT THE ROLE:
The Assistant Buyer, International, supports the International Buying team in executing and managing merchandising strategies across select international markets and brands. Reporting to the Buyer, this role is responsible for analyzing business performance, inventory trends, consumer behavior, and market data to inform assortment, pricing, and product decisions.
The ideal candidate is genuinely curious about all aspects of the merchandising process — from inventory planning and buying to product analysis and assortment development. We are seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented individual with a passion for retail, consumer behavior, and data analysis.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

**Buying & Merchandising Strategy**

* Support the Buyer in developing and executing seasonal assortment strategies and merchandising plans for assigned international markets and brands
* Analyze market trends, consumer behavior, inventory levels, product performance, and Open-to-Buy (OTB) to identify opportunities and risks, and recommend actions to the Buyer
* Evaluate assortment performance and provide recommendations on product selection, depth, market allocation, replenishment, and inventory positioning
* Prepare for and participate in product meetings and assortment reviews (Style Out)
* Maintain assortment planning tools and business processes that support buying and merchandising decisions
* Recommend pricing adjustments, including markdowns, for stores and e-commerce based on market conditions, product performance, and inventory levels
* Work on ad hoc business analyses and special projects aligned with strategic merchandising objectives

**Business Analysis, Reporting & Communication**

* Compile, review, and interpret weekly and seasonal sales and inventory reports to identify trends, opportunities, and key performance indicators
* Prepare clear business analyses and presentations that summarize findings, highlight risks and opportunities, and support decision-making
* Develop and maintain reporting tools and dashboards used by the Buying team
* Prepare materials and provide support for business reviews, key initiatives, collaborations, and internal meetings
* Collaborate cross-functionally with Planning, Allocation, Product, Marketing, Visual Merchandising, and other teams; contribute relevant analysis and recommendations in cross-functional discussion
* Partner with international and franchise partners to gather business information, understand market needs, and support execution of approved merchandising strategies

**Order Management, Systems & Other Responsibilities**

* Assist with the execution of purchase orders based on approved assortment and buying strategies, including style setup, product classification, and maintenance of accurate product data
* Generate, maintain, and monitor purchase orders from creation through delivery, flagging potential delays, discrepancies, or inventory risks
* Maintain organized and accurate records related to purchase orders, assortment decisions, business analyses, and key communications
* Identify opportunities to improve reporting, workflows, and business practices within the Buying function
* Perform other related duties and special projects as assigned
* Stay current on retail industry trends, consumer behavior, competitive activity, and international market dynamics relevant to assigned brands and markets

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

* Ability to analyze information, identify trends and opportunities, and develop actionable recommendations
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; able to work with minimal supervision
* Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
* Strong communication, collaboration, and follow-through skills
* Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams and international business partners

REQUIREMENTS:

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Buying & Merchandising, Retail Management, or a related field preferred
* 2+ years of relevant experience in buying, merchandising, or fashion retail
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; solid understanding of retail math

At Jabil (NYSE: JBL), we are proud to be a trusted partner for the world's top brands, offering comprehensive engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing solutions. With 60 years of experience across industries and a vast network of over 100 sites worldwide, Jabil combines global reach with local expertise to deliver both scalable and customized solutions. Our commitment extends beyond business success as we strive to build sustainable processes that minimize environmental impact and foster vibrant and diverse communities around the globe.

SUMMARY

Support procurement of items such as materials, components, equipment, supplies, and outsourced services that are required for engineering prototype builds and general engineering operations.

Provides analytical and specialized administrative support to relieve executive, director, and/or staff managers of complex details and advanced administrative duties.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Coordinate executives, directors and/or manager’s calendar, meetings, correspondence and presentations as needed.

Coordinate and arrange meetings facilities and records and transcribe minutes of meetings.

Participate or lead special projects and/or events as needed.

Serve as the administrative liaison with others within and outside the company regarding administrative issues relating to purchasing, personnel, facilities and operations.

Plan and prepare for customer visits and corporate events.

Serve as resource to others in the resolution of complex problems and issues.

Issue Purchase Orders to pricing, terms & conditions that are negotiated and agreed to by Jabil Commodity Managers and Buyers. Ensure suppliers’ adherence to established agreements.

Processes purchase requisitions and purchase orders through Coupa.

Optimize order management process to ensure effective communication with suppliers.

Support Accounts Payable in resolving invoice discrepancies.

Handles shipping and receiving packages.

Processes new vendor onboarding using Jabil’s systems.

Perform analysis and reporting of purchase history and supplier performance.

Adheres to all safety and health rules and regulations associated with this position and as directed by supervisor.

Comply and follow all procedures within the company security policy.

May perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

MANAGEMENT & SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

Reports to Sr. Manager of Engineering Operations

Job is NOT directly responsible for managing other employees (e.g., hiring/termination and/or pay decisions, performance management).

JOB QUALIFICATIONS EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS

Typically requires a minimum of 6+ years of related experience.

Or an equivalent combination of education, training or experience.

BE AWARE OF FRAUD: When applying for a job at Jabil you will be contacted via correspondence through our official job portal with a jabil.com e-mail address; direct phone call from a member of the Jabil team; or direct e-mail with a jabil.com e-mail address. Jabil does not request payments for interviews or at any other point during the hiring process. Jabil will not ask for your personal identifying information such as a social security number, birth certificate, financial institution, driver’s license number or passport information over the phone or via e-mail. If you believe you are a victim of identity theft, contact the Federal Bureau of Investigations internet crime hotline (www.ic3.gov), the Federal Trade Commission identity theft hotline (www.identitytheft.gov) and/or your local police department. Any scam job listings should be reported to whatever website it was posted in.

**Accessibility Accommodation**
===============================

* Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills

* Health insurance

* Vision insurance

**Position Description**
------------------------

**Position Overview:**

The Procurement Assistant plays a vital role in supporting the procurement activities of the Elections Division within the County Clerk’s Office. This position is responsible for assisting with the purchasing of goods and services, ensuring compliance with Harris County purchasing policies and procedures, and providing efficient support to all departmental procurement needs.

**Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Create, review, and submit requisitions for approval through Harris County Purchasing, and forward approved purchase orders to vendors.
* Process invoices and payments to vendors for services rendered.
* Maintain inventory levels and a working knowledge of all office assets, both capital and non-capital.
* Obtain quotes from suppliers to support the processing of order requests.
* Process supply orders and service requests submitted by department heads.
* Communicate with new vendors to obtain required documentation for creating a Supplier ID in STARS and forward all materials to Harris County Purchasing.
* Assist Harris County Purchasing with the inspection of capital asset inventory.
* Manage surplus inventory.
* Perform other related duties as assigned.

**Harris County is an Equal Opportunity Employer**

https://hrrm.harriscountytx.gov/Pages/EqualEmploymentOpportunityPlan.aspx

If you need special services or accommodations, please call (713) 274-5445 or email ADACoordinator@bmd.hctx.net

**Requirements**
----------------

**Must meet all eligibility requirements to register to vote in the State of Texas.**

**Education and Experience:**

* High School Diploma or G.E.D. equivalent from an accredited educational institution **with**
* Two (2) years of related experience

**OR**

* An Associate degree in a related field.

**PLUS**

* Two (2) years of experience using any ERP financial system.
* Two (2) years of experience performing clerical, administrative, or fiscal work.
* Advanced Excel skills, including pivot tables, VLOOKUP, and related functions.

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:**

* Ability to prioritize work assignments.
* Ability to process transactions and perform accounting duties such as account maintenance, recording entries, and reconciling accounts.
* Exceptional customer service skills.
* Ability to manage projects from start to finish.
* Ability to meet strict processing deadlines.
* Ability to analyze data to track ordering and spending patterns.
* Strong judgment and decision-making skills.
* Strong leadership and communication skills.
* Detail-oriented.

**NOTE****:** Qualifying education, experience, knowledge, and skills must be documented on your job application. You may attach a resume to the application as supporting documentation but **ONLY information stated on the application will be used for consideration. "See Resume"** **will not be accepted for qualifications.**

**Preferences**
---------------

* Experience in a fast-paced environment.

**General Information**
-----------------------

**Position Type and Typical Hours of Work:**

* Temp Full-time | **Position End Date: 04/30/2027** - This is a temporary position being onboarded through a Harris County-contracted agency.
* Monday – Friday | 8:00 A.M. to 4:30 P.M.

+ Overtime hours as required to include extended hours and weekends during election periods.

**Salary:**

* $25.00 Hourly

**Position** **Location:**

* 15600 Morales Rd, Houston, TX 77032

**Work Environment and Physical Demands:**

* This job operates in a professional office environment.
* This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, photocopiers, and filing cabinets.
* This position requires bending, stooping, and lifting up to 20 lbs., as well as frequent walking, standing, sitting, reaching, and ascending/descending stairs.

Dewberry is seeking a **Procurement Assistant/Buyer** in our corporate headquarters located in Fairfax VA. Reporting to the Procurement Manager, the selected candidate will support the procurement team by managing procurement tasks, tracking inventory, consulting with vendors, and assisting in product selection and pricing strategies. The Buyer shall conduct business in accordance with the standard operating procedures of this organization and/or in accordance with company best practices.

*Dewberry is a leading, market-facing professional services firm with more than 60 locations and 2,500 professionals nationwide. What sets us apart from our competitors are our people. At Dewberry, we seek out exceptional talent and strive to deliver the highest quality of services to our clients. Whether you’re an experienced professional or a new graduate, you’ll have the chance to collaborate with the best and brightest and work on innovative and complex projects at the forefront of the industry. Our commitment to excellence stems from our personal integrity and from other defining attributes, which we call “Dewberry at Work,” that have inspired our employees to be successful for more than a half-century.*

* Receive and review requisitions for completeness, accuracy, and clarity
* Conduct market research for assigned commodities and identify potential suppliers
* Perform initial evaluation and screening of potential suppliers
* Prepare purchase orders in accordance with procurement policies
* Oversee Dewberry supplier’s portals (review and approve orders entered, etc.)
* Monitor and expedite orders to ensure timely delivery and resolve delays
* Manage discrepancies during the receiving process, including 2/3-way matching
* Reconcile invoices and coordinate with Accounts Payable as needed
* Provide ERP user assistance and support for ERP system training
* Oversee and manage special projects assigned
* Supports day-to-day procurement activities

* High School Diploma or equivalent required; bachelor’s degree preferred
* 1+ years of experience in procurement/purchasing or related field preferred
* Strong analytical, organizational, and time management skills
* Strong understanding of procurement principles and practices
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications
* Experience with Deltek Vantagepoint a plus
* Ability to multitask, work under pressure and maintain mindfulness

*Don’t meet every single requirement? At Dewberry we are dedicated to building a diverse and inclusive workplace for our employee’s. So if you’re excited about this role, but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the position description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may just be the right candidate for this or other opportunities.*

* At this time, Dewberry will not sponsor a new applicant for work authorization.
* Dewberry is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, gender identity or sexual orientation.
* All recipients of an offer of employment from Dewberry, will be required to submit to a background screening which may include, but is not limited to, employment verification, educational and other credential verification, driving record check, criminal background check, and an investigative consumer report. These screenings will be conducted by Dewberry’s background vendor of choice and will be conducted in compliance with all applicable federal, state, and local law.

description:
At Ben E. Keith Company, our legacy is strong—and our future is even stronger.

For more than a century, we’ve been leaders in fine food and premium beverage distribution, known for delivering excellence and building lasting partnerships. Today, our Food Division spans multiple states, and our Beverage Division brings top beverage brands to communities across Texas.

But what truly sets us apart is our commitment to people. We invest in our employees, empower growth, and create opportunities to make an impact—because when our people succeed, so do our customers and our business. Since 1906, that’s been our promise.

The Purchasing Assistant will compile information and records to draw up purchase orders for procurement of materials and services. The Purchasing Assistant will select, order and authorize payment for merchandise according to contractual agreements.

* Represent Ben E. Keith Company with professionalism, maintain a positive attitude and follow dress code
* Prepare purchase orders - send copies to suppliers and to departments originating requests.
* Determine if inventory quantities are sufficient for needs, ordering more materials when necessary.
* Respond to customer and supplier inquiries about order status, changes, or cancellations.
* Perform buying duties when necessary.
* Contact suppliers in order to schedule or expedite deliveries and to resolve shortages, missed or late deliveries, and other problems.
* Review requisition orders in order to verify accuracy, terminology and specifications.
* Prepare, maintain and review purchasing files, reports and price lists.
* Compare prices, specifications and delivery dates in order to determine the best bid among potential suppliers.
* Track the status of requisitions, contracts and orders.
* Calculate costs of orders and charge or forward invoices to appropriate accounts.
* Check shipments when they arrive to ensure that orders have been filled correctly and those goods meet specifications.
* Approve bills for payment.
* Locate suppliers using sources such as catalogs and the internet, interview supplier about products for ordering.
* Special projects as assigned.

**Job Qualifications:**

* 2 to 5 years Marketing or Purchasing experience preferred.
* Valid Driver’s license – Required to perform company business
* Knowledge and ability to competently us MS Office, internet and email – willingness to learn new software as needed.
* Associates or related degree /related experience resulting in equivalent level of knowledge and experience is required.

We offer employees the opportunity to make a meaningful impact in collaborative, results-driven environments supported by competitive benefits, including:

* Medical, Dental, Vision & Life Insurance
* 401(k) with Company Match + 100% Company-Paid Profit Sharing
* Paid Time Off & Holidays
* Wellness, EAP & Educational Assistance

At Ben E. Keith, we value a diverse and inclusive workforce where different perspectives drive better decisions and innovation. We are an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer and a VEVRAA Federal Contractor, considering all qualified applicants, including minorities, females, veterans, and individuals with disabilities.

description:
**Take Ownership of Your Career and Shape Your Future!**

Are you ready to become an Employee Owner? At Suburban Enterprises, you not only work for the company you own the company! The ideal candidate is happy where he/she is currently employed but is interested in a more self-directed work environment, increased responsibility, and the opportunity to grow into additional roles. We would like to hire someone interested in a career, not a job, who wants to do the work and be recognized for a job well done!

**The Role – Purchasing Assistant**

The Purchasing Assistant provides administrative and operational support to the Purchasing team by maintaining accurate purchasing records, monitoring orders, coordinating inventory transactions, resolving supplier and invoice issues. This role plays a key part in ensuring timely procurement, accurate inventory management, and effective communication between suppliers, purchasing, accounts payable, and internal stakeholders.

**What You'll Do**

* Enter and maintain accurate order, purchasing, and inventory data in company systems.
* Process order acknowledgements and review to ensure accuracy and completeness.
* Process inventory requests related to field and machine moves.
* Monitor and maintain accurate inventory records.
* Track supplier shipments and follow up on purchase orders to ensure timely delivery.
* Coordinate material returns and ensure timely pickup and credit processing.
* Partner with Accounts Payable to investigate and resolve invoice discrepancies.
* Assist with supplier performance evaluations.
* Maintain accurate records and documentation for all quoting projects.
* Support Purchasing team as needed to ensure efficient operations.

**What You Bring (Required Experience)**

* High school diploma or general education degree (GED) required
* 1-3 years of purchasing experience and/or training
* Familiarity with ERP and/or inventory software
* Experience in the use of a PC and Microsoft Word and Excel software, as well as the Internet

**Bonus Points For (Preferred Experience)**

* Associate or bachelor’s degree in business, supply chain or related field preferred

**What We Offer – Why Choose Suburban Enterprises?**

* **Team Member Ownership**: Work for a company where your contributions directly impact your future

* **Commitment to Safety**: Safety isn’t just a priority; it’s our promise to you and your family

* **Career Growth**: This isn't just a job - it's a career path with opportunities for advancement
* **Continuous Learning**: Investment in your professional development
* **Collaborative Culture**: Work with a team that values respect, integrity, and excellence

* **Comprehensive Benefits**: Competitive pay, ESOP, 401(K) with employer match, and no healthcare premium increases for 4 years

**Ready to Join Us?**

Our high standards of service to our customers and clients require that we select only the top team members based on our culture and core values so please read and understand them or come with clarifying questions because we work, live, hire and promote by them. We will choose new team members with great care because the future of Suburban Enterprises rests with them. You are here because we believe in your character and abilities.

If you're passionate about innovation, committed to excellence, and ready to be part of a company that invests in its people, we want to hear from you. Help us create a better future through innovation and automation.

*We are an equal opportunity employer.*

**Job Description:**

We are seeking a **detail-oriented and organized Purchasing Assistant** to join our team in **Pomona, CA**. This fully in-person role supports the Purchasing Department with **administrative tasks, inventory control, purchasing documentation, and vendor coordination**.

The ideal candidate is dependable, proactive, and able to **prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced team environment**. Responsibilities include maintaining inventory records, processing purchasing documents, following up with vendors, assisting with office supply orders, and coordinating with various departments and locations.

**Job Qualifications**

* **At least 1 year of experience** in an administrative, purchasing, inventory, or related office support role.
* Previous experience in office administration, purchasing, or inventory management is preferred.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel and Outlook.
* Familiarity with ERP systems or other inventory/procurement software is a plus.
* Strong data entry, organizational, and record-keeping skills with a high level of accuracy.
* Excellent communication, follow-up, and coordination skills.
* Ability to multitask, prioritize responsibilities, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accurate information and documentation.
* Previous experience in **HVAC, manufacturing, construction, or a related industry** is helpful but not required.

**Essential Duties & Responsibilities**

* Process receiving documents, purchase orders, and related paperwork.
* Perform accurate data entry and general clerical tasks.
* Create and process work orders and stock transfers.
* Monitor vendor orders, deliveries, returns, and discrepancies.
* Close purchase orders (POs) promptly and accurately.
* Review and manage sales order flags.
* Assist with inventory control and maintaining proper stock levels.
* Purchase and maintain office supplies.
* Maintain accurate and organized purchasing records.
* Provide administrative and liaison support to management and other departments.
* Assist with special projects and other Purchasing Department needs.
* Prioritize tasks, solve problems, and work effectively in a fast-paced team environment.
* Perform other duties as assigned

If you’re organized, detail-oriented, and ready to grow your skills in purchasing and inventory, we’d love to hear from you! **Join our team as a Purchasing Assistant and make an impact at Superior Duct Fabrication. Apply today!**

Pay: $24.00 - $26.00 per hour

* Dental insurance

* Life insurance
* Vision insurance

* **Support and advise colleagues.** Give routine advice and support to end users on the procurement process and documentation. Help with user training and problem resolution as needed.
* **Find better sources.** Seek new sources of supplies and services and secure favorable terms for the Laboratory.
* **Support daily operations.** Perform other duties as required, such as scheduling equipment maintenance and services, adjusting grant encumbrances and rolling them into the next year, maintaining the catalog library, and filing. Assist in the operation of a maintenance stock room and receiving dock.

* **Education:** High school diploma or GED. A combination of education and experience may be considered. Associate or bachelor’s degree preferred.
* **Experience:** 5 + years in the same or a similar role.

* Ability to negotiate the best price and service while working within Laboratory procurement policies and procedures.
* Proven ability to organize time, work under time constraints, meet deadlines, and prioritize work.
* Demonstrated ability to take over special projects and follow through to completion.
* Ability to perform basic information research, gather and compile data, and prepare reports.
* Excellent organizational skills, attention to detail, and accurate data entry.
* Effective interpersonal skills for working with a wide variety of people and personalities, including internal customers and external suppliers.
* Ability to communicate effectively, both verbally and in writing.
* Ability to operate computer hardware and software applications normally found in a business setting.

* Ability to lift a minimum of 50 pounds when assisting in the maintenance stock room or receiving dock.

**Purchasing Assistant**

**About Us**

Perfume Price is a leading fragrance distribution company with over 20 years of industry experience. As we continue to grow, we are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Purchasing Assistant to join our Purchasing team and support the procurement and inventory management functions of the business.

**Position Overview**

The Purchasing Assistant will support daily purchasing operations by coordinating purchase orders, maintaining product and vendor data, monitoring inbound shipments, and assisting with inventory and procurement activities. This role works closely with vendors, warehouse operations, accounting, sales, and customer service teams to ensure products are accurately maintained and inventory is received efficiently.

This position is ideal for someone who enjoys working with data, spreadsheets, solving problems, staying organized, and building a long-term career in purchasing, supply chain, or operations.

**Key Responsibilities**

Purchasing & Inventory Support

* Assist with purchase order creation, maintenance, and follow-up.
* Support inventory replenishment, pricing updates, and purchasing activities.
* Maintain purchasing records, reports, and inventory data.

Vendor & Shipment Coordination

* Communicate with vendors, freight providers, and internal departments regarding orders and deliveries.
* Monitor inbound shipments, provide ETA updates, and coordinate receipt of inventory.
* Follow up on open purchase orders and shipment documentation.

Data & System Management

* Create and maintain product, vendor, and inventory information within company systems.
* Support data uploads, item maintenance, reporting, and research activities.
* Assist with purchase order, sales order, and product data management.

Cross-Functional Support

* Coordinate with warehouse, accounting, sales, and customer service teams to resolve issues and support daily operations.
* Respond to internal and external inquiries through email, WhatsApp, website, and other communication channels.
* Support special projects and process improvement initiatives as assigned.

**Qualifications**

Experience

* Previous experience in purchasing, inventory management, supply chain, customer service, administrative support, or a related field preferred.
* Experience in a distribution, wholesale, or inventory-driven environment is a plus.

Technical Skills

* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Office.
* Experience working with ERP systems and large data sets is preferred.

Core Competencies

* Strong communication, organization, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Detail-oriented, self-motivated, and eager to learn and grow professionally.
* Spanish language skills are a plus.

**Compensation & Benefits**

* Competitive Salary
* Performance-Based Bonus Opportunities
* Comprehensive Health Insurance
* 401(k) with Company Match
* Paid Time Off (PTO)
* Career Growth Opportunities

Job Details

Job Type: Full-Time

* Monday to Friday

Ability to Commute:

* Deerfield Beach, FL (Required)

Work Location:

* In Person

Equal Opportunity Employer

Perfume Price is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Job Type: Full-time

Ability to Commute:

* Deerfield Beach, FL (Required)

description:
**American Equipment Manufacturing** is growing and seeking a motivated, hands-on **Procurement Assistant / Plant Expediter** to join our team.

This position plays an important role in keeping production moving by supporting procurement activities, coordinating material requirements, monitoring production schedules, and communicating with suppliers and internal departments.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, comfortable working in a fast-paced manufacturing environment, and able to take initiative to keep materials, projects, and production schedules on track.

Responsibilities

* Assist with purchasing materials, components, and supplies required for manufacturing.
* Monitor production schedules and coordinate material requirements to support upcoming jobs and deadlines.
* Schedule and track long-lead materials based on manufacturing needs.
* Request and evaluate supplier quotes for materials, freight, and specialty items.
* Maintain ongoing communication with suppliers regarding pricing, availability, lead times, and delivery schedules.
* Identify opportunities to reduce material and purchasing costs while maintaining quality and availability.
* Monitor minimum and maximum inventory levels and assist with maintaining appropriate stock levels.
* Review internal material requirement documents and determine purchasing needs.
* Create material take-offs from drawings and prepare accurate bills of materials.
* Enter and maintain bills of materials and inventory information within company accounting/inventory software.
* Track the progress of materials and production orders across departments.
* Work closely with department supervisors to confirm project status, priorities, and expected completion dates.
* Help prioritize material and production needs based on manufacturing deadlines.
* Follow up on delayed materials, purchase orders, and production items to help prevent scheduling disruptions.
* Identify workflow or material-related issues and communicate them to management.
* Maintain accurate purchasing, inventory, and project documentation.

Qualifications

* Previous experience in **procurement, purchasing, inventory, expediting, or manufacturing** preferred.
* At least 1 year of experience in a manufacturing or industrial environment preferred.
* Strong computer skills, including proficiency with **Microsoft Excel**.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Excellent organization, follow-up, and time-management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Basic math and geometry skills, including the ability to calculate measurements, square footage, and circumference.
* Ability to read and interpret material lists, bills of materials, and basic manufacturing drawings.
* Understanding of minimum/maximum inventory principles.
* Ability to work independently while also coordinating effectively with multiple departments.

Preferred Knowledge

Experience or familiarity with industrial and manufacturing materials such as:

* Plate steel
* Structural shapes
* Pipe
* Valves
* Fittings
* Specialty fabricated or purchased components
* Freight and material transportation

Experience creating **material take-offs, bills of materials, purchase orders, or supplier quote requests** is highly desirable.

What We're Looking For

We are looking for someone who is proactive and dependable and who understands the importance of following through. This position requires someone who can identify what is needed, communicate with the appropriate people, and keep materials and production requirements moving without losing track of deadlines or details.

The right candidate will be comfortable working between the office, purchasing, suppliers, and production departments and will take ownership of assigned tasks from start to completion.

Benefits

* 401(k) matching
* Health insurance
* Dental insurance
* Vision insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off

**Job Type:** Full-time
**Work Location:** In person

**Join American Equipment Manufacturing and become part of a growing team where your work directly contributes to keeping production organized, supplied, and on schedule.**

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Application Question(s):

* Background in purchasing or procurement?
* Familiar with steel, pipe, valves, and fittings?
* Able to read bills of materials?

Work Location: In person

² Purchase materials in a timely manner and at the lowest cost

² Identify and optimize common inventories among facilities

² Judgment and decision-making ability

² Demonstrated integrity and ethical standards

² Manages time effectively and adapts quickly to changing priorities

² Accuracy and attention to detail

² Team player who works productively with wide range of people

² Comfortable in fast-paced environment

² Problem-solving and analytical ability

² Capable of following written instructions and documented procedures

² Ability to stay focused and work without close supervision.

² Able to adjust priorities on short notice, manage interruptions and work well under pressure.

² Ability to timely meet deadlines

² Effective listening, communication (verbal and written), and negotiating skills

² Complies with and maintains company confidentiality practices and policies.

² Interacts professionally with all company employees and outside persons, such as customers and vendors

**About the Job**

Books-A-Million, America’s hometown bookstore since 1917, is headquartered in Birmingham, AL, and is home to a family of brands including Books-A-Million, 2nd & Charles, Joe Muggs, and Yogurt Mountain. We’re seeking an enthusiastic and motivated Assistant Buyer to join our Merchandising team supporting our Gift business. This entry-level, hybrid role is based at our Birmingham, AL corporate office and is ideal for a recent Merchandising graduate or someone with a combination of retail store experience and strong merchandising skills. You’ll start by mastering the fundamentals of the business – purchase orders, item creation, and vendor partnerships – while building toward buying for assigned categories.

* Position: Assistant Buyer – Gifts
* Department: Merchandising
* Location: Birmingham, AL (Hybrid)

**Role Summary**

The Assistant Buyer supports the Gift buying team by managing the operational details that keep our assortment moving – from purchase order creation and tracking to item setup, SKU management, and on-time delivery. Working closely with their assigned Buyer, as well as outside vendors, the distribution center, stores, and internal marketing teams, the Assistant Buyer builds a strong foundation in merchandising and progressively takes on category buying responsibilities. This role thrives in a fast-paced, detail-oriented, and collaborative environment and is ideal for a self-starting, flexible, organized, and results-oriented team member who is eager to learn.

**Role Responsibilities**

*Purchase Order & Item Management*

* Execute merchandising activities including the full life cycle of purchase orders, from PO creation and order entry through tracking and receipt.
* Complete item creation and SKU management, maintaining data accuracy and integrity for the company.
* Ensure timely delivery of merchandise via consistent communication and follow up with vendors and the distribution center.
* Use company merchandising systems and Excel according to procedures to record all transactional activity, perform processes, and complete required analyses.
* Maintain logical and clear working papers, spreadsheets, and checklists/calendars, monitoring the detail and quality of your own work.
* Communicate regularly with stores using appropriate communication channels.

*Category & Vendor Support*

* Learn the vendor base and take initiative to develop collaborative vendor relationships, including cost negotiation, problem resolution, and follow up.
* Produce sales recaps and analysis to identify new and existing business opportunities. Communicate findings and advocate for intended purchases.
* Identify patterns, gaps, or related trends when reviewing data, and provide your Buyer with suggestions drawn from your analysis.
* Develop planograms for in-store merchandise sets that drive sales and fixture productivity.
* As skills develop, progress into buying for assigned Gift categories, including open-to-buy management.

*Buyer & Division Support*

* Monitor the latest trends and share with the Gift team to identify sales and marketing opportunities.
* Execute contracts and incentives, including promotional partnerships.
* Provide organizational support for cross-functional team projects by breaking assignments into tasks and coordinating with internal and external partners.
* Monitor competitor merchandising and share findings with stakeholders.
* Other duties as assigned by the Buyer, Divisional Merchandise Manager, or Vice President.

**Role Qualifications**

*Required Qualifications:*

* Bachelor’s degree in merchandising or a business-related field, or equivalent combination of work experience
* 1–2 years of retail or relevant experience, which may include retail store, customer service, or internship experience
* Basic retail math skills and the ability to analyze data, identify trends, and draw conclusions
* High standards, accountability, and a high degree of accuracy and attention to detail
* Strong prioritization and time management skills, with a sense of urgency and the ability to re-prioritize as needs change
* Clear, effective written and verbal communication; listens attentively and asks questions to confirm understanding
* Intellectual curiosity, personal ownership, and a drive to learn and improve processes
* Collaborative team player who builds strong internal and external partnerships and stays positive and adaptable under pressure

*Preferred Qualifications:*

* Passion for the gift industry; knowledge of and interest in popular culture and online trends, with a keen eye for developing trends
* Degree or coursework in merchandising
* Retail internship or retail store experience
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Outlook, and Word

**Work Environment & Expectations**

* This hybrid position is based at our Birmingham, AL corporate office: 4 days in office and 1 day remote, with Monday in office preferred.
* Up to 25% travel to trade shows

**MINIMUM TRAINING & EXPERIENCE**
---------------------------------

Graduation from an accredited college/university with an Associate degree in accounting, procurement, finance, business, or related field plus five (5) years of work experience in accounting, procurement, finance, or business preferred. In lieu of an Associate degree, a high school diploma plus nine (9) or more years of work experience in accounting, procurement, finance, or business will be accepted. Government work experience is preferred. Knowledge of computerized accounting applications and spreadsheets required. Must possess a valid Florida’s Driver’s License and have and maintain an acceptable driving record.

**EMERGENCY DECLARATION STATUS**
--------------------------------

Code 3: Non-essential employees will not be required to work during a declared emergency but may be required to work during an undeclared emergency or in the aftermath of an event associated with a declared emergency. Employee may be re-assigned to another position or another Department. On an incident-by-incident basis, the employee’s Department Head will make the determination when the employee will be required to work and if they are re-assigned based on the needs of the City.

**GENERAL STATEMENT OF JOB**
----------------------------

Under limited supervision, performs a variety of professional level duties involved in coordinating various accounting and procurement activities; analyzes and reconciles financial transactions; assists in maintaining the accuracy of the Public Works capital projects; prepares and maintains accurate financial records and reports; assists in the preparation of assigned budgets, annual audit, procurement documents and year end closing; and provides highly responsible staff assistance to the assigned management staff. Considerable independent judgment and initiative are required in performing assigned duties. Reports to the designated manager.

**SPECIFIC DUTIES & RESPONSIBLITIES**
-------------------------------------

**ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS**

Assists the Division Managers, Supervisors and the Public Works Accountant.

Assist in data entry and analysis of information in systems to manage, track, maintain and procure vehicle assets and fuel supplies.

Monitoring of capital improvement projects and general expenditures and providing periodic reports for capital projects.

Assists in all aspects of the development and preparation of the Public Works budget process and preparation (included but not limited to: scheduling review meetings, entering data in the City’s financial software (HTE), year-end estimates and projections for all expenditures and revenues, position control revisions, budget adjustment requests, CIP project detail sheets, fee schedules, etc.

Assists in monitoring transactions to ensure they are applied to the appropriate line item and are within budget.

Assists project managers with grants reimbursement requests, reports and monitoring expenditures and revenue.

Assists in the preparation and processing of journal vouchers, budget transfers, and budget amendments as necessary.

Assists with external auditors during performance of the City’s annual audit and during preparation of the annual financial report.

Assists in the procurement process to expedite the purchases of goods and services.

Assists in the accounts payable process for the department. Reviews and verifies invoices for accuracy, processes invoices for payment, and monitors expenses.

Assists in identifying capital equipment during the procurement process. Coordinates disposal of surplus items.

Performs quality assurance/quality control checks of data accuracy, analyzes aggregated and individualized data sets, and prepares written reports.

Performs data research and develops and prepares specialized reports for management.

Assists with special projects as needed.

**ADDITIONAL JOB FUNCTIONS**

Performs other work as required.

This job description is not intended to be and should not be construed as an all-inclusive list of all the responsibilities, skills or working conditions associated with the position. While it is intended to accurately reflect the position activities and requirements, Management reserves the right to modify, add or remove duties and assign other duties as necessary that are a logical assignment to the position.

description:
We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented **Entry-Level Purchasing Assistant** to support the purchasing and material-control functions of our FAA-approved aircraft repair station.

This position is an excellent opportunity for someone interested in beginning a career in the aviation industry. The Purchasing Assistant will help procure aircraft parts, materials, hardware, consumables, tooling, and outside services required to support aircraft component maintenance and repair operations.

Because we operate in a regulated aviation environment, accuracy, organization, documentation, and attention to detail are essential. Training will be provided on our purchasing procedures, aviation documentation, material traceability, and applicable repair station requirements.

Duties and Responsibilities

The Purchasing Assistant will:

* Assist with purchasing aircraft parts, materials, standard hardware, consumables, tooling, supplies, and outside services.
* Obtain and document vendor quotations for requested materials and services.
* Prepare and issue purchase orders in accordance with company procedures.
* Follow up with vendors regarding quotations, order acknowledgments, delivery dates, backorders, and shipment status.
* Expedite critical material requirements to support production schedules.
* Assist in locating alternate sources when materials or parts are unavailable from established suppliers.
* Verify that purchase orders accurately identify required part numbers, descriptions, quantities, specifications, revisions, and applicable certification requirements.
* Ensure applicable traceability and certification requirements are communicated to suppliers at the time of purchase.
* Coordinate with Quality Control when questions arise regarding acceptable documentation, traceability, certification, or supplier approval.
* Purchase materials only from approved or otherwise authorized suppliers in accordance with company procedures.
* Maintain accurate purchasing records, quotations, purchase orders, order confirmations, and vendor correspondence.
* Assist with maintaining and updating supplier information and purchasing records.
* Communicate expected delivery dates and material shortages to Production, Quality, Stockroom, and Management.
* Coordinate with Shipping and Receiving regarding incoming materials and urgent deliveries.
* Assist in resolving discrepancies involving incorrect quantities, damaged materials, incorrect parts, missing certifications, or other receiving discrepancies.
* Coordinate returns, replacements, credits, and warranty claims with suppliers when necessary.
* Assist with inventory replenishment and minimum stock requirements for commonly used materials and hardware.
* Monitor open purchase orders and follow up on overdue items.
* Assist with purchasing-related data entry and administrative duties.
* Maintain organized electronic and/or hard-copy purchasing records.
* Follow company procedures relating to FAA Repair Station requirements, quality control, material traceability, and documentation.
* Maintain professional relationships with suppliers and service providers.
* Perform other purchasing, stockroom, and administrative support duties as assigned.

Minimum Qualifications

* High school diploma or equivalent.
* Basic computer proficiency, including email, Microsoft Excel, and Microsoft Word.
* Strong organizational and communication skills.
* Ability to accurately enter and review part numbers, quantities, specifications, and other technical information.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple purchasing requests and priorities simultaneously.
* Ability to communicate professionally with vendors and internal departments.
* Dependable attendance and ability to work effectively as part of a team.
* Willingness to learn aviation purchasing, material traceability, and FAA Repair Station requirements.

Preferred Qualifications

The following are helpful but **not required**:

* Previous purchasing, inventory, warehouse, stockroom, or administrative experience.
* Experience working in aviation, aerospace, manufacturing, maintenance, or another regulated industry.
* Familiarity with purchase orders, vendor quotations, packing slips, invoices, and certificates of conformance.
* Basic understanding of aircraft parts, hardware, raw materials, or technical specifications.
* Experience with inventory, ERP, or purchasing software.

What We Are Looking For

The ideal candidate is organized, dependable, willing to learn, and comfortable asking questions when information is unclear. Aviation purchasing requires more than simply finding the lowest price. Parts and materials must meet specific technical, documentation, traceability, and quality requirements.

We are looking for someone who can develop into a knowledgeable aviation purchasing professional and understand the importance of ensuring that the **correct material, from the correct source, with the correct documentation

**Introduction**
----------------

When you join the Maryland Department of Human Services (DHS), you join a team of more than 5,000 employees across the state dedicated to positively changing the lives of more than 1 million Marylanders each year. We do this by providing economic support, preventive services, and caring for children and adults.

We aim to deliver services so that we more quickly meet the needs of the people we serve. At DHS, we grapple with hard questions to find new ways to foster a culture of bold innovation. We do this to ensure that in Maryland, we leave no one behind.

**GRADE**
---------

STD0011

**LOCATION OF POSITION**
------------------------

ST. MARY'S COUNTY DEPARTMENT OF SOCIAL SERVICES

PROCUREMENT DIVISION

23110 LEONARD HALL DRIVE

LEONARDTOWN, MD 20650

**Main Purpose of Job**
-----------------------

The main purpose of this position is to provide support for agency operations and to help the agency meet its overall mission. The duties include supply ordering and distribution; maintaining supply room; utilizing Financial Management Information System (FMIS) and eMaryland Marketplace Advantage (eMMA) to procure goods and services; monitoring and maintaining agency vehicles; managing office equipment; facility repair reporting and follow-up; preparing financial reports, etc.

**POSITION DUTIES**
-------------------

* Ensure proper maintenance and repair of fleet.
* Procure the agency's supply, material and equipment.
* Assist with facility issues.

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**
--------------------------

Applicants must meet all minimum (and selective) qualifications to be considered, and to appear on the list of people eligible for hire. Please read all requirements before applying.

Education: Graduation from an accredited high school or possession of a high school equivalency certificate.

Experience: One year of experience performing administrative staff, clerical, clerical technical, or secretarial work.

Notes:

1. Candidates may substitute 30 credit hours from an accredited college or university for the required experience.

2. Candidates may substitute U.S. Armed Forces military service experience as a non-commissioned officer involving staff work requiring regular use of independent judgment and analysis in applying and interpreting rules and regulations in accordance with agency laws and policies on a year-for-year basis for the required experience.

**DESIRED OR PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
---------------------------------------

Preference will be given to applicants who possess the following preferred qualification(s). Include clear and specific information on your application regarding your qualifications.

Six months experience ordering, receiving, moving and lifting office supplies and equipment.

Six months experience troubleshooting facility-related issues and/or equipment difficulties.

Six months experience coordinating and managing maintenance on vehicles or equipment.

Six months experience with computer programs like Google Application and Microsoft Suites.

**SPECIAL REQUIREMENTS**
------------------------

Candidates may be responsible for providing their own transportation as needed to access meetings, remote locations, and job destinations as assigned.

**SELECTION PROCESS**
---------------------

Please make sure that you provide sufficient information on your application to show that you meet the qualifications for this recruitment. All information concerning your qualifications must be submitted by the closing date. We will not consider information submitted after this date. Successful candidates will be ranked as Best Qualified, Better Qualified, or Qualified and placed on the eligible (employment) list for at least one year.

If you are in State service and are a promotional candidate, your salary will be determined in accordance with State of Maryland guidelines.

**EXAMINATION PROCESS**
-----------------------

The examination will consist of a rating of your education, training, and experience as presented on your application and as they relate to the requirements of the position. You may be asked to complete a supplemental questionnaire. The supplemental questionnaire may be used as part of the rating process. Therefore, it is important that you provide complete and accurate information on your application.

For education obtained outside the U.S., a copy of the equivalent American education as determined by a foreign credential evaluation service is required prior to hire.

**BENEFITS**
------------

**STATE OF MARYLAND BENEFITS**

**FURTHER INSTRUCTIONS**
------------------------

The online application process is STRONGLY preferred. If you are unable to apply online, you may mail a paper application and supplemental questionnaire to, Department of Human Services, Examination Services Unit, 25 S. Charles Street, Suite 1100, Baltimore, Maryland 21201.

Or email latoura.jones@maryland.gov: Voice 410-767-8844, toll-free: 1-800-3

**Who We Are**

At **Tillys**, we’re a leading specialty retailer offering casual apparel, footwear, and accessories for young men, women, boys, and girls. Our extensive collection features iconic global brands, emerging labels, and proprietary lines, all rooted in an active and social lifestyle.

Based in sunny Southern California, our **Retail Support Center (RSC**) is the heart of our corporate operations, dedicated to supporting both our retail and online stores. The RSC is where strategy meets execution. From trend forecasting to tech innovation, our teams work together to bring the Tillys experience to life — both in-store and online.

**Position Summary**

An Assistant Buyer will support the Buyer in daily operations, including purchase order management, sample coordination, markdown creation, trend research, reporting and order tracking. Collaborates with internal teams and vendors while maintaining strong communication and relationships to support timely and accurate assortment execution.

**Key Responsibilities**

A typical day may include:

* Support Buyer on all day-to-day functions of the department.
* Generates, maintains, and follows through on all Purchase Orders. Some examples include vendor delivery, tickets, samples, and warehouse issues etc. Ensure that communication (written/verbal) is complete and thorough with vendor and internal partners. Set and agree upon dates for completion of projects with buyer and communicate progress.
* Organization with files, samples, and photos. Work in an efficient manner that maximizes time management. Update files so that they are up to date. Purge files/samples/photos as needed to keep area current. Perform regular maintenance on picture boards so that assortments are represented accurately.
* Creates and re-caps all weekly markdowns.
* Monitors on-order and manages weekly receipt flow into DC.
* Assists in management of OTB.
* Partners with Allocation, Marketing, and Visual teams to ensure correct execution of assortments in store.
* Requests and manages samples for fittings, photo shoots, and meetings.
* Ensures quality control of all orders.
* Creates recaps and reports as needed.
* Maintains positive working relationships with vendors and internal partners.

**Qualifications**

Your experience brings:

* Proficient in the use of Excel, Microsoft Word and Outlook.
* Ability to perform all essential duties and responsibilities listed above.
* Detail oriented and organized.
* Must be able to communicate in a professional manner and respond with timeliness.
* Able to effectively use common office equipment.
* Resourceful and able to research problems and recommend solutions.
* Numerical and analytical ability required.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Trend and fashion awareness with ability to understand current trends, competition and market.
* Ability to reprioritize projects frequently.
* Must have ability to multitask.
* Independent, self-motivated, team player.
* Able to effectively communicate with all levels of staff and management.

**Education & Experience**

* 1-2 years of Assistant Buying experience required.
* High School Diploma required.
* BS/BA degree preferred.

**Work Environment & Physical Demands**

* Professional office setting with low to moderate noise
* Ability to sit or stand for extended periods
* Regularly lift/move up to 20 lbs and navigate stairs
* Frequent walking and movement between floors/departments
* Reasonable accommodation is available to support individuals with disabilities

**Leadership & Team Development**

Non-Management:

While this is not a leadership role, we value team players who embody proactive collaboration, curiosity, accountability, and a growth mindset. Opportunities to grow and develop within the company are strongly supported.

**Compensation**

**Hourly Range:** $24 – $28/hr
Final offer will be based on experience, skills, and qualifications.

**What to Expect**

**Schedule:** Full-time role with weekday office hours; occasional evening or weekend work may be required during peak retail seasons.
**Work Location:** Irvine, CA — minimum of 4 days per week in-office.

At Tillys, we thrive in a creative, collaborative, and high-energy environment where individuality is not just accepted — it’s celebrated. description:
**General Summary**

Claire’s is being remade as a modern playground for girlhood, designed for Gen Alpha girls across the U.S. and Canada. While so many brands are trying to pull her toward what’s next, Claire’s is built around who she is right now—a place where she can explore, make choices, and build confidence. Claire’s has pierced more than 131 million customers, and for many girls, it is the first store where they spend their own money on something they chose for themselves. Our strategy is to build the products, experiences, and stores around those choices, giving her reasons to come back at every stage of girlhood. That work is happening now across piercing and jewelry, beauty, accessories, and toys. The Assistant Buyer is involved from the very beginning. You’ll follow product from first sample to store, sit in the room where the assortment is shaped, and look at the weekly data to understand what she picked up, what she passed on, and why. Your decisions reach 900 stores and you can walk into one and see your work come to life on the sales floor. In your first year, success means becoming the person in the room who knows your product area better than anyone else and turns weekly reads into actions the team can use. From there, your ownership grows—from the size of the business you manage to the decisions you make independently. Every merchant is reviewed twice a year on performance and potential, with development plans tied directly to what’s required for the next level.

**Key Responsibilities**

Analyze and report on your area weekly and provide tactical in season trading actions to drive the business forward.
Build expertise in the customer and the competition for the assigned department, including other retailers' assortments, pricing and promotions against Claire's, and report back findings, white space opportunities and actions.
Track assigned tests cleanly: matched doors, matched weeks, and per-department reads, so scale, extend or exit decisions rest on actuals.
Use retail math to analyze the department weekly, monthly and seasonally, provide accurate investment inputs, and explain item level sales, margin and inventory variances, escalating errors and emerging risks.
Create and maintain style boards and line sheets with the product detail cross-functional partners need.
Manage the sample process: sort styles by category and season, track every sample against requirements, and communicate product changes before shipment.
Develop and maintain cross-functional relationships with Design, Product Development, Sourcing, Planning, Allocation, Marketing and In Store Presentation to learn the seasonal buying process.
Support the Buyer and the merchandising team on day-to-day functions for the assigned departments.
Own administrative deliverables: meeting reports and recaps, purchase orders, submits, sample tracking and seasonal buy recaps, keeping the critical path on time and the information accurate.
Manage email correspondence efficiently, escalate concerns to the merchandising team, and meet deadlines without a reminder.

**Qualifications**

Bachelor's degree in fashion merchandising, business, or a related field, or equivalent experience
Experience in retail or merchandise buying preferred
Curiosity about the customer we serve and what she is choosing right now
Comfort with numbers, including retail math, and the instinct to ask what a number means rather than only report it
Organized enough to hold a critical path on time without being chased
Clear written and verbal communication, including with partners outside merchandising
Proficient in Excel and PowerPoint)

Claire’s is committed to adhering to all applicable company policies and federal, state, and local laws and regulations. All positions will be compensated at or above the legally mandated minimum wage for the location in which work is performed. The final compensation will be determined by various factors such as relevant work experience, education, certifications, skills, and geographic location.

Benefits for full-time employees included medical, dental, and vision insurance, voluntary welfare plans, bonus plan eligibility, 401(k) match, vacation time, sick time\\* and paid leave.

Benefits for part-time employees included voluntary welfare plans, 401(k) match, vacation time, sick time\\* and paid leave in required states.

* Sick Time: For the State of Washington, all employees will accrue paid sick time at the rate of 1 hour for every 30 hours worked.

Claire's is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion and we encourage applications from members of all underrepresented groups, including those with disabilities. We will accommodate applicants' needs, upon request, throughout all stages of the recruitment process. Please inform us of the accommodation(s) that you may require.

Information received relating to accommodation will be addressed confide

We are a fast-growing and dynamic organization seeking a **Purchasing Assistant** to join our Operations team. The Purchasing Assistant supports company purchasing by coordinating vendor information, purchase orders, order status, receipts, invoice discrepancies, and purchasing records. Works with employees, vendors, and Finance to help ensure purchases are documented and processed accurately. This role is in Seattle, WA and will work on-site.

***Good things are happening at Omeros!***

***Who is Omeros?***

Omeros is an innovative biotechnology company that discovers and develops first-in-class protein and small-molecule therapeutics for both large-market and orphan indications, with a focus on the treatment of complement-mediated diseases, cancers, and addictive or compulsive disorders. Omeros’ lead complement inhibitor YARTEMLEA® (narsoplimab-wuug), which targets the lectin pathway’s effector enzyme MASP-2, is FDA-approved and commercially available in the U.S. for the treatment of hematopoietic stem cell transplant-associated thrombotic microangiopathy (TA-TMA) in adult and pediatric patients two years of age and older. OMS1029, Omeros’ long-acting MASP-2 inhibitor, has successfully completed Phase 1 clinical trials.

Under an asset purchase and licensing agreement, Novo Nordisk acquired global rights to zaltenibart (formerly OMS906), an inhibitor of MASP-3, the alternative pathway’s key activator, which is in clinical development for PNH and other alternative pathway indications, along with associated intellectual property and related assets. Omeros’ pipeline also includes OMS527, a phosphodiesterase 7 inhibitor in clinical development for cocaine use disorder, which is fully funded by the National Institute on Drug Abuse, and a growing portfolio of novel recombinant antibodies targeting multidrug-resistant organisms and novel molecular and cellular therapeutic programs for oncology. For more information about Omeros and its programs, visit www.omeros.com.

**What are your job responsibilities?**

* Assists in contacting vendors to obtain prices and schedule delivery dates
* Assists in expediting orders
* Maintains purchase orders, invoices, receiving records, and supporting documentation; assists with matching purchase orders, receipts, and invoices.
* Maintains information on computer systems, creates as on demand reports
* Assists with internal audits of vendors, POs
* May develop and maintain resources for assigned commodity items
* Prepares standard requests for quotation. Assignments may require initiative regarding pricing revisions, order cancellations, discontinued items, acceptable substitutes, delivery date revisions, and invoice discrepancies
* Requests vendor Forms W-9, verifies tax identification information, and records applicable vendor classifications, including Sunshine Act designations, in company systems.
* Reconciles company credit card transactions and obtains receipts and other supporting documentation.
* Receiving of goods
* Interact with company employees at all organizational levels to gather information
* Provide administrative and clerical support for the Purchasing Department

**What education and experience do you need?**

* AA degree and 2-4 years of experience in a related role
* Industry experience is considered a plus
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Word and experience with purchasing or ERP systems; Oracle Cloud experience is preferred.
* A good command of the English language with excellent grammatical and proofreading skills
* Developing analytical and problem solving skills
* Results oriented with a high attention to detail and excellent organizational, planning and time management skills
* Effective communication skills including excellent verbal and written communication with the ability to effectively communicate with a diverse audience
* People skills with an emphasis on communications, planning and personal accountability
* Ability to handle multiple tasks while delivering accuracy and delivering on commitments

**Behavioral Competencies Required:**

* Able to build and maintain positive relationships with management, peers, and employees
* Good interpersonal skills
* Able to present oneself and represent Omeros in a professional manner
* Integrity

**Physical Demands Required:**

* Intermittent physical activity including bending, reaching, pushing, pulling, or lifting up to 30 lbs.
May encounter prolonged periods of sitting or standing

**Compensation and Benefits:**

Omeros is proud to offer a competitive total compensation package designed to support the lives of our employees and their families. The wage scale for Purchasing Assistant position is ($32.00/hr - $37.40/hr). Salaries will be determined based on knowledge, skills, education, and experience relevant to the role. Job Summary

The job of the Assistant Buyer is to support the Buyer or customer in the procurement process through multi-channels including telephone, fax, email and EDI. This includes proper review of the purchase order before placement; updating the purchase order based upon vendor confirmations; resolving discrepancies with the purchase order; communication with the customer on order status; and maintaining appropriate purchasing records. Essential Functions

* Receives purchase requisitions from internal customers and reviews for proper vendor, authorization, accuracy and completeness. Receive purchase orders assigned by the buyer.

* Identify purchase order exceptions such as pricing, availability, back orders and other items details receive through various methods and communicate them to the appropriate party.
* Resolves discrepancies between purchase orders, receipts and invoices and other related activities.
* Maintain purchase order documentation in the ERP system as well as any required paper documentation per system or department policy. May be responsible to add/change/delete information in the system while ensuring the integrity of the data.
* Communicate, collaborate and acts as a liaison between other departments and vendors in order to ensure continuity and coordination of services.

**POSITION SUMMARY:**

This position provides administrative, organizational, and operational support to the Purchasing Department. The role coordinates daily office activities, maintains documentation and contract files, supports contract intake and routing, and ensures clear, timely communication with internal stakeholders and external vendors. As a backup Buyer, the position assists with purchasing tasks, including preparing requisitions and purchase orders, obtaining quotes per policy thresholds, following up with suppliers, and ensuring adherence to County procurement procedures and audit requirements.

**POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES:**

***Essential Functions***

The duties and responsibilities of this position include, but are not necessarily limited to:

* Provide comprehensive administrative support, including scheduling, recordkeeping, mail processing, document preparation, and filing to ensure smooth department operations.
* Maintain organized electronic and physical files, and manage department logs, trackers, and routine reports.
* Assist with contract intake, tracking, routing for review and approval, and maintain complete and accurate contract files.
* Monitor workflow milestones and provide timely status updates to staff and stakeholders.
* Serve as a backup Buyer and prepare and submit requisitions and purchase orders in the County ERP system.
* Coordinate supplier communications for quote requests, confirmations, delivery follow ‑ ups, and assist in routine purchasing decisions in alignment with County procurement procedures.
* Resolve routine procurement issues such as documentation gaps, purchase order modifications or cancellations, receiving updates, and support audit readiness by ensuring complete and compliant records.
* Ensure compliance with County procurement policies, contract administration procedures, records retention standards, and audit requirements.
* Assist with drafting, updating, and organizing department standard operating procedures.
* Support responses to Right to Know Requests.
* Communicate professionally with internal departments and vendors to facilitate timely, accurate information sharing and issue resolution.
* Provide logistics support and assist with special projects as assigned by the Director and/or Deputy Director.

**MINIMUM EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:**

* Associate’s Degree in Business Administration, Public Administration, or closely related subject.
* Four years of experience in advanced administrative office experience.
* Any equivalent combination of experience and training which provides the required knowledge, skills, and abilities.

**MINIMUM KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:**

* Demonstrate strong organizational and follow ‑ through skills, with the ability to plan, prioritize, and complete assignments independently.
* Detail oriented, proactive, and able to manage multiple tasks effectively.
* Working knowledge of ERP systems for requisitions, purchase orders, receiving, and reporting, or a strong willingness and ability to learn.
* Analytical thinking and sound judgment, with the ability to interpret and consistently apply basic procurement procedures.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite applications, including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint, with the ability to produce clear, accurate documents and spreadsheets.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills, along with strong interpersonal abilities to build effective working relationships with staff, County departments, vendors, and the public.
* High ethical standards and a commitment to confidentiality.
* Ability to follow written and verbal instructions with precision and initiative.
* Ability to meet deadlines and manage time effectively.
* Ability to handle stress.
* Physical presence in the office is required.

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS:**

Work involves standing, walking, sitting, lifting, carrying, talking, hearing, and reaching with hands and arms. Vision abilities required by this job include close vision and the ability to adjust focus. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 40 pounds a distance of 15 feet or less.

**WORKING ENVIRONMENT:**

Normal cubicles and individual office environment. Work is primarily performed during regular business hours; however, occasional evening or weekend work may be required based on the department’s needs. Travel within the assigned service area may be required. The position may require working in moderately noisy to loud environments, including cubicles and communal workspaces, and participating in frequent collaborative team meetings. The work environment may include a fast-paced setting with frequent interruptions, changing priorities, and interactions with employees, the public, and other stakeholders.

**JOB TITLE:** Assistant Buyer

**DEPARTMENT:** Purchasing

**FLSA STATUS:** Hourly Non Exempt

**COMPANY OVERVIEW:** LogistiQ is a dynamic and rapidly growing conveyor system integrator dedicated to providing turn-key innovative solutions to the retail, e-commerce & distribution markets. In our 750,000 sq. ft. facility located in Port Clinton, Ohio, you will find a team of innovators dedicated to building solutions that solve our customers’ evolving needs.

At LogistiQ, our core values of integrity, innovation, accountability, and collaboration are the cornerstones of our success. Integrity is at the heart of everything we do, ensuring honesty and transparency in our actions. Innovation drives us to constantly seek creative solutions and push the boundaries of what's possible. Accountability means we take responsibility for our work and uphold the highest standards. Collaboration fuels our collective strength, bringing together diverse perspectives to achieve common goals. By embracing these values, we foster a culture that not only delivers exceptional results but also makes LogistiQ a great place to work.

**JOB SUMMARY:** As an Assistant Buyer at LogistiQ, you will assist with the day-to-day operations of the purchasing department.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES** include the following:

* Collects and prepares purchase orders.

* Generates purchase order to suppliers, executes delivery pull-ins, pushouts, or cancellations per operational need.
* Assists in forecasting and negotiating prices.
* Resolves supplier issues regarding logistics, pricing, quality, and accounting.
* Assists in maintaining the ERP system up to date, ensuring visibility of deliveries.
* Assists with resolving receiving and invoicing errors on purchase orders.
* Reviews acquisitions for accuracy prior products are distributed.
* Monitors prices, specifications, and delivery dates.
