**Description**

**Salaried Non Exempt**
**Position Title:** Purchasing Assistant Warehouse 12 hour Rotating from 6am to 6pm
**Department:** Purchasing Department

**Location:** Plainwell Plant

**Purchasing Assistant**—Serves under Purchasing Supervisor

The primary responsibilities of the Purchasing Assistant are turning purchase orders from released requisitions, confirm pricing and delivery dates on purchase orders with vendors, build relationships with vendors and assisting the Purchasing Supervisor with their duties.
**Responsibilities:**
Responsible for all aspects of the purchase order cycle to include:

* Checking requisitions for accurate information and internal releases.
* Acquiring pricing and delivery date confirmation from vendors.
* Contacting vendors when deliveries are late or incomplete. Will require coordination with Packaging and Stock Room Departments.
* Assisting vendors with any questions or problems they may have in regards to purchase orders
* Working with accounting to ensure that purchase orders have been received and invoices posted.
* Working with Accounts Payable to check payment status/problems for vendor invoices.
* All other duties as assigned by Purchasing Manager or Controller

**KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS**
The Knowledge of overseeing all functions involved in incoming receiving inspection and accurately processing the inventory changes to Maintenance Parts, Operating Supplies, Ingredients, and Packaging supplies. This person will work closely with other departments within the Plainwell Complex to insure materials are received to the correct department and personnel.
**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Finding parts and materials in the computer data base for maintenance and other departments.
* + Checking on hand computer balances.
+ Finding locations and warehouses where parts are stored.
+ Researching Order histories including the following:
+ - On order quantities
- Requisitions and details including for whom the materials were ordered.
- Receiving histories.
- Issue histories.
- Return and repair histories.

* Two to five years purchasing/procurement experience.
* Good verbal and written communication skills
* Good math skills.
* Good organizational skills.
* Computer skills to include Microsoft Office Suite Programs (Outlook, Word, Excel and some knowledge of Access).
* SAP experience preferred
* Minimum one-year experience in procurement, inventory control, asset management, or incoming inspection and receiving.

**EDUCATIONAL REQUIREMENTS**:

High School Diploma/GED; College Degree in business related preferred

**EOE/INCLUDING DISABILITY/VETS**

Signet Jewelers is the world's largest retailer of diamond jewelry, operating more than 2,800 stores worldwide under the iconic brands: Kay Jewelers, Zales, Jared, H.Samuel, Ernest Jones, Peoples, Banter by Piercing Pagoda, Rocksbox, JamesAllen.com and Diamonds Direct. We are a people-first company and this core value is at the heart of everything we do, from empowering our valued team members, to collaborating with our customers, to fostering the communities in which we live and serve. People – and the love their actions inspire – are what drive us. We’re not only proud of the love we inspire outside our walls, we’re especially proud of the diversity, inclusion and equity we’re inspiring inside. There are dynamic career paths awaiting you – rewarding opportunities to impact the lives of others and inspire love. Join us!

The primary responsibility of the Assistant Buyer is to assist their Buyer on all aspects of the job or step in as needed to help with Merchandise Coordinator/Detail Assistant duties. They are responsible for sourcing and developing product, pricing product, determining assortment groups, forecasting order quantities, and participating in competitive shops. Weekly reporting and departmental reports.

**Product Development**

* Develop understanding/knowledge base of the Jewelry Category
* Work with the Buyer to learn the elements of merchandising as it applies to their position.
* Overall understanding and maintenance of their merchandise category, in conjunction with the Buyer
* Identify sales trends, develop new product designs for testing and assortment opportunities
* Attend vendor meetings and actively participate in selection and review of product. Be the point person for meeting notes and follow-up.
* Instrumental in determining various marketing vehicles, SKU selection, new merchandise programs, sales trends, and assortments which lead to sales growth and overall productivity in their area.
* Be jointly accountable for the success of their specific merchandise category with regards to sales, inventory levels & gross margin goals, which are established by Management.
* Participate in on-going Competitive Shopping from an omni-channel lens. Review our assortments as well as competitor to ascertain opportunities and advantages.
* Ability to adjust quickly to changing market trends, conditions, priorities, and corporate strategies.

**Assortment / Inventory Management**

* Setup sku’s, descriptions, retails and packaging attributes.
* Assist Buyer with Assortment Development - Work with Planners and Inventory Analysts to set program parameters (i.e. product attributes, assortment size, targeted inventory and turn levels, open-to-buy requirements)
* Monitor and help develop forecasted sales quantities for marketing items and new programs in conjunction with the Inventory Analyst and Buyer
* Communicate and manage with vendors re: product qualities, costs, terms/ownership, delivery dates, return of merchandise requests.
* Establish retail prices in line with margin requirements
* Responsible for updating departmental category assortment sheets, reporting, and analysis

**Collaboration**

* Proofing of all advertising materials to ensure accuracy including catalogs, emails, web site, customer mailings, and in store signage.
* Merchandise items for all marketing channels, which are innovative and competitive within the marketplace.
* Attend open-to-buy meetings and provide merchandise status updates as needed
* Complete and submit Project Request Forms and develop store communications.
* Work in collaboration with Visual Merchandising team for in-store presentations (planograms).

* Work with the Buyer to learn the elements of merchandising as it applies to their position.
* Overall understanding and maintenance of their merchandise category, in conjunction with the Buyer
* Identify sales trends, develop new product designs for testing and assortment opportunities
* Attend vendor meetings and actively participate in selection and review of product. Be the point person for meeting notes and follow-up.

* Be jointly accountable for the success of their specific merchandise category with regards to sales, inventory levels & gross margin goals, which are established by Management.
* Participate in on-going Competitive Shopping from an omni-channel lens. Review our assortments as well as competitor to ascertain opportunities and advantages.
* Ability to adjust quickly to changing market trends, conditions, priorities, and corporate strategies.

* Assist Buyer with Assortment Development - Work with Planners and Inventory Analysts to set program parameters (i.e. product attributes, assortment size, targeted inventory and turn levels, open-to-buy requirements)
* Monitor and help develop forecasted sales quantities for marketing items and new programs in conjunction with the Inventory Analyst and Buyer
* Communicate and manage with vendors re: product qualities, costs, terms/ownership, delivery dates, return of merchandise requests.
* Establish retail prices in line with margin requirements
* Responsible for updating departmental category assortment sheets, reporting, and analysis

**Collaboration**

* Proofing of all advertising materials to ensure accuracy including catalogs, emails, web site, customer mailings, and in store signage.
* Merchandise items for all marketing channels, which are innovative and competitive within the marketplace.
* Attend open-to-buy meetings and provide merchandise status updates as needed
* Complete and submit Project Request Forms and develop store communications.
* Work in collaboration with Visual Merchandising team for in-store presentations (planograms).

Description:

**Produce Assistant Buyer & Receiver**

**Part-time; benefits eligible**

**Friday - Saturday 6:00am - 2:00pm**

**16 Hours**

**Purpose: Support the Produce Buyer in meeting department goals by assisting with buying and receiving.**

**Status: Reports to Produce Manager**

**Pay Level 3**

**Responsibilities:**

**General:**

* Follow all department policies and procedures in order for Hunger Mountain Co-op to adhere to all applicable regulations.
* Be responsible for safety in the workplace by creating a safe work environment, reporting safety concerns to a manager, and adhering to all safety rules and regulations.
* Be a team player.
* Attend all required meetings, training, seminars and workshops.

**Buying:**

* Fill in and assist buyer and place day-to-day orders with established suppliers within guidelines set by Produce Manager.
* Inventory back stock to determine ordering needs and for periodic financial reporting.
* Communicate daily with Produce buyer regarding market choices and opportunities.
* Enter new products in the Point of Sale (POS) system, as needed.
* Assist in updating, organizing, and maintaining sales data in department spreadsheet.
* Assist in making and maintaining price signs and making price changes in POS system in consultation or at the direction of the Produce Buyer and/or Manager.
* Regularly double check floor pricing to assure consistency with the POS.
* Notify Produce buyer of inconsistencies in pricing and reports.
* Obtain credit from suppliers, as needed.

**Receiving:**

* Receive deliveries following established procedures, checking for quality and accuracy, while maintaining proper product rotation.
* Follow appropriate procedures for handling invoices.
* Maintain a clean and safe work environment, including mopping floors and cleaning cooler shelves.

**Merchandising:**

* Assist with displays following guidelines of Produce Manager. Replenish and rotate displays as needed; assure accuracy of signage; label items with PLU stickers and/or signs; correct pricing discrepancies and report to Produce Manager.
* Inform floor staff of new products when they arrive and facilitate the stocking and labelling of any new items.
* Assist floor staff with replenishing and maintaining displays, culling several times daily, and following stocking priorities set by Produce Manager.
* Assist customers with produce and special orders; offer samples and suggestions for purchases and preparations in friendly, courteous manner.
* Trim, wash, and prepare produce as needed. Pull damaged or spoiled items and dispose with appropriate notification to Produce Manager.
* Assist with general produce maintenance as needed. Remove trash, clean cases and mirrors, and keep prep and storage areas in clean, orderly condition.
* Use equipment safely. Monitor cooler and walk-in temperatures and follow procedures for handling breakdowns. Advise Produce Manager of equipment repair and replacement needs.

**Miscellaneous:**

* Provide produce information and education to Co-op staff members and customers.
* Participate in periodic inventory.
* Attend department and storewide meetings.
* Perform other tasks assigned by Produce Manager.

Requirements:

The responsibilities as listed in this job description are representative only and not exhaustive of the tasks that an employee may be required to perform. To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position.

**Qualifications:**

* Prior retail produce experience required; experience with produce purchasing, merchandising, quality control, organic standards and especially ordering and working with multiple local organic farms is preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to follow through on commitments under tight time pressures.
* Highly organized, detail-oriented with a strong numerical aptitude.
* Ability to perform and prioritize multiple tasks.
* Familiarity with computers and Microsoft Office including use of Excel.
* Experience working in a fast-paced environment involving frequently lifting 50 lbs., standing for long periods, and working in a cold environment.
* Manual dexterity with equipment used in moving, unpacking and preparing produce for display.
* Ability to follow all Safety policies and procedures of Hunger Mountain Co-op.
* Ability to provide excellent service to customers, vendors and co-workers and abide by Hunger Mountain Co-op’s Service Policies.
* Ability to work well with others in a cooperative environment where teamwork and constant communication are essential.

**Desired:**

* Ability to have some scheduling flexibility with when business needs require it.
* Ability to follow attendance and punctuality policies of Hunger Mountain Co-op.
* Ability to be physically present onsite at the Co-op to perform the requirements of this position.

description:
**JOB SUMMARY**

The incumbent will assist the Production Staff Manager in providing professional direction to the management group on purchasing strategies. The position will ensure that Corporate policies and procedures in the purchasing area are effectively implemented. The incumbent will assist in long range planning, value analysis and setting cost-saving goals, including supervises inventory levels. Buyer manages all vendor managed inventory in the warehouse, maintaining correct minimum/maximum levels.

**SCOPE AND IMPACT OF THE POSITION**

The success of the purchasing activity is directly related to the profitability of the Company. Because this position is called upon for advice, individual credibility is of the utmost importance. This position requires interfacing with Company employees’ company-wide, as well as outside vendors, thus necessitating effective communication capabilities both written and oral.

**JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Performs all purchasing functions including evaluation per manager implemented procedures.
* Establishes and maintains effective relationships with Vendors as a primary Company representative.
* Purchases hardware, MRO, safety supplies, miscellaneous shop supplies, Exceedra materials, Costco/janitorial and kitchen needs, along with managing most company credit card purchases.
* Uses appropriate judgment and integrity in all purchasing decisions and establishes a high standard of conduct.
* Receives Purchase Requisitions from Project Managers, Plant Engineers, Foremen and other Company personnel. Obtains pricing and lead time information as necessary to make informed and cost-effective purchasing decisions. Issues Purchase Orders as necessary for securing requisitioned materials, equipment or services and inventory. Responsible for expediting all orders as required for timely delivery.
* Coordinates incoming traffic of major materials and adds big deliveries to delivery calendar.
* Maintains supplier/manufacturer library and updates as required. Maintains computer vendor database.
* Stamps, reviews, and processes all certification documents received from buyers, ensuring records are accurate and properly maintained.
* Tool Watch administrative help (Load Parts, Employee Information, ext.)
* Support the Warehouse by assisting in the write ups for BOL'S for shipping
* Process new SOS sheets for new product purchases.
* Assist in tracking Warehouse repair items.
* Assists Accounting in reconciling vendor invoices as required.

**SPECIAL NOTES AND CONDITIONS**

* (Outside work, travel, exceptional hours, etc.)
* Some work may require presence in the concrete manufacturing plant.
* Location is at CTC’s premises, except for local travel as required in support of customers. CTC does not offer telecommuting.

**COMPANY BENEFITS**

* Competitive salary: $26.78 - $28.50 per hour depending on experience
* Healthcare Coverage - Medical, dental, and vision with family coverage included
* Retirement plan - 401(k) with generous company matching and an employer sponsored money purchase pension plan.
* Paid time off - Holidays, vacation and sick leave

**Education/Experience**

· One to two years of progressive experience in purchasing and inventory management (experience in Construction-related field preferred).

**Skills**

* Knowledge of Microsoft word, Excel, Outlook
* Knowledge of Sage computer software
* Ability to Multitask
* Good attention to detail
* Great Team Member
* Positive attitude & customer service skills
* Strength in Problem Solving
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with ability to bridge communication gap between technical terms and general management knowledge.
* Strong mathematical skills.

**Benefits**

* Medical insurance
* Dental Insurance
* Vision Insurance
* Life insurance
* State parental leave
* Employee assistant program
* Health savings account
* HSA online store with great prices
* 7 paid holidays
* Accrued paid time off
* State accrued sick pay
* 401(k) matching after 1 year of service
* Retirement plan
* Professional development assistance when job-related

Pay: $18.00 per hour

* 401(k)

Insurance benefits start day 1.

On-the-job training with career growth opportunities.

The Doe Run Company is currently seeking an Assistant Buyer to support purchasing and warehouse teams by generating purchase orders for stock material, managing replenishment and placing direct purchase orders as required. This dayshift position is located at Central Office located in Viburnum, MO.

The work location may change as needed to support production and business needs within the Viburnum Trend in Southeast Missouri.

**Education & Experience:**

* High school diploma or equivalent
* Minimum 1 year customer service experience

**Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:**

* Proficient computer skills utilizing Microsoft Office (Word & Excel) and ERP (PeopleSoft).
* Positive customer service and communication skills.
* Basic organization skills to support filing needs.
* Time management skills to complete tasks timely.

**Job Responsibilities:**

* Issue all basic stock orders
* Print and distribute requisitions.
* Manage stock replenishment.
* All required document filing.
* Manage direct requisitions as required for assigned locations, includes quoting material as required.
* Complete tasks in a safe and environmentally compliant manner by following EHS (environmental, health and safety) policies, procedures and best practices; support and assist peers in working in a safe, compliant manner; report unsafe acts or conditions, incidents, and deviations; and provide feedback to support continuous improvement in EHS performance.
* Other duties or projects as assigned.

**Work Environment, Physical & Lifting Requirements:**

* Regular use of a computer and telephone.
* Work is regularly performed in a standard quiet office setting.
* Regularly sitting and repetitive wrist and/or finger movement, frequently hearing, occasionally talking and standing, and rarely reaching with arms and/or hands. Requires clarity of vision at 20 inches or less and concentrated attention.
* Frequently required to lift up to 5 pounds and rarely lift up to 15 pounds.

Based in St. Louis, Missouri, USA, The Doe Run Company is a privately held natural resources company and a global provider of lead, copper, and zinc concentrates. Dedicated to environmentally responsible mineral and metal production, Doe Run operates the Resource Recycling facility, one of the world’s largest, single-site lead recycling centers, located in Boss, Missouri. The company also owns six operating mines in one of the world’s largest lead mining districts, also in Missouri: Brushy Creek, Buick, Casteel, Fletcher/West Fork, Mine 29/Viburnum and Sweetwater. The Doe Run Company and its subsidiaries deliver products and services necessary to provide power, protection, and convenience. Doe Run has operations in Missouri, Washington, and Arizona. For more information, visit www.doerun.com (http://www.doerun.com/).

All job offers are contingent upon the candidate's successful completion and clearance of post-offer drug screen, physical, and background check. Background checks include verification of education, employment history, and criminal record review. The role may also require a motor vehicle record review and ATF explosives possessor clearance.

Doe Run is an Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability and veterans.

#### **Experience**

Required

* 1 year(s): Customer Service Experience

#### **Education**

Required

* High School or better

Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities

description:
Contech Engineered Solutions LLC provides site solutions for engineers, contractors, architects, and owners. The Contech portfolio includes bridges, drainage, erosion control, retaining wall, sanitary sewer, and stormwater management products. Through cost-effective engineered solutions, we help build, support, and sustain land development projects while protecting the environment.

**The Position**

Contech Engineered Solutions seeks a detail-oriented and dependable **Assistant Buyer** to join our team in West Chester, Ohio - **LOCAL CANDIDATES ONLY**. In this role, you’ll provide essential administrative and clerical support to the Purchasing Department, helping keep day-to-day purchasing activities running smoothly. Working closely with Buyers and the Department Manager, you’ll maintain accurate purchasing records and data while supporting our plants and vendors with routine requests, information, and coordination.

**Why Should You Apply?**

At Contech Engineered Solutions, you’ll be part of a team-oriented environment where collaboration, innovation, and shared success are a priority. As an industry leader in world-class design, manufacturing, sourcing, and distribution, we provide opportunities to work alongside talented professionals and contribute to meaningful work. We’re also committed to helping our employees achieve their professional goals while maintaining a healthy balance between work and life.

**About the Role**

* Request written bids and telephone quotes from approved vendors as directed, and record bid information including vendor price, payment terms, and delivery.
* Respond to and process system triggers for material and requests from plants for material or information; escalate issues to a Buyer as needed and communicate order status and delivery expectations to internal customers while coordinating with Contech Logistics.
* Prepare and issue Purchase Orders for raw material within established guidelines and as directed by a Buyer.
* Monitor on-hand inventory of stock at supplier, subcontractor and plant locations and report discrepancies and assist with physical inventory.
* Assist with tracking vendor quality and delivery issues and prepare supporting documentation for claims as directed.
* Support accounting and purchasing functions, including receiving products, virtually transferring inventory, reviewing invoices and obtaining proof of delivery documents from vendors.
* Communicate with vendors to obtain product, pricing and delivery information; refer vendor concerns and emergency purchase needs to a Buyer or the Manager.
* Maintain accurate purchasing files and records using proper record keeping methods and procedures.
* Follow departmental purchasing policies and procedures; refer questions on specifications, including AASHTO and ASTM requirements, and other regulations to a Buyer or the Manager.
* Assist with monitoring data integrity in the ERP system, incoming EDI data and Access databases; identify errors and assist with resolution.
* Assist with entering new items and new item/plant combinations into the ERP system in coordination with Cost Accounting, ensuring accurate descriptions are loaded.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications:**

**Required:**

* Associate’s degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, or a related field.
* Minimum of six months to one year of office, clerical, or purchasing experience.
* Attention to detail in reviewing purchasing documents such as invoices, purchase orders, and requisitions to ensure conformance with policies and procedures.
* Basic knowledge of office procedures and general computer applications used in business, such as spreadsheet, database, and word processing software. Willingness to learn purchasing practices, including ethics, standards, bid preparation and competitive bidding procedures.
* Ability to: collect and enter data accurately; perform arithmetic calculations; use common units of measure; calculate discounts and shipping charges; prepare basic written reports; recognize responsibility and limits of assigned authority; maintain effective working relationships with vendors, management personnel, and co-workers.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Office.

**Preferred:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management or a related field.
* Ability to travel occasionally.
* Familiarity with J.D. Edwards or another ERP system.

**Ready to Apply?**

The process is simple. Click on the “apply” button to get started. Good luck!

description:
Big R is looking to hire an Assistant Buyer to provide support to our Sporting Goods/Automotive departments. An Assistant Buyer is responsible for providing operational support to the Buyer with a focus on business management and problem-solving. They are committed to executing responsibilities and managing functions for a product category. They will develop an understanding of the company’s business and position in the market, evolving into an expert in a business category, and working with vendors, agents, and other suppliers. The Assistant Buyer should have a proven ability to multi-task and operate independently, with strong presentation, communication, and Excel skills.

* + This is not a remote position; all work is done from Big R’s home office in Pueblo, CO.

**Responsibilities:**

* Perform operational functions supporting buyer to achieve sales, margin and inventory plans
* Write purchase orders and manage the purchase order process with suppliers ensuring on time and accurate delivery
* Demonstrate advanced product knowledge by sharing information with buyer through competitive shopping and market trend research
* Independently identify priorities and proactively work to achieve efficiency in purchase order writing, item maintenance and administrative tasks
* Establish and maintain a reputation of responsiveness in the marketplace
* Troubleshoot issues and negotiate with suppliers accordingly
* Utilize various software applications daily

* Professional attitude and appearance
* Excellent interpersonal, communication and negotiation skills
* Ability to maintain focus on goals and objectives that deliver results
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite
* Strong analytical and organizational skills
* Great communicator who works best in a collaborative environment and builds mutual trust and credibility at all levels of an organization
* Ability to apply new practices in a constantly changing environment
* High school diploma

To apply for this position, please click here. Only applicants with resumes attached will be considered.

* Starting wage is based on experience.

Benefits:

* Paid Time Off (PTO)
* Medical, Dental, Vision Insurance Options (Eligibility required)
* 401K Retirement Plan Options (Eligibility required)
* Employee Discount
* Paid Holidays
* On-site Gym
* Advancement opportunities

**Job Description**
-------------------

The Office of the District Attorney, Bronx County (“BXDA”) is charged with the twin goals of ensuring public safety and striving for equal justice for the over 1.4 million members of the Bronx County community. By “Pursuing Justice with Integrity,” the BXDA places a focus on assistance for crime victims while simultaneously ensuring fairness to defendants. Moreover, the BXDA aims to balance the need to seek appropriate punishment for certain crimes while recognizing when punitive measures do not adequately advance justice. By recognizing these significant distinctions and acting accordingly, BXDA has established a standard of excellence in the representation of the Bronx community at large, which continues to grow stronger every day.

In furtherance of this mission, the BXDA seeks experienced and enthusiastic Purchasing Assistant who will be tasked with supporting the day-to-day purchasing, receiving, inventory, stockroom, and office-wide delivery operations. The position ensures that orders are processed accurately, deliveries are received and distributed in a timely manner, and purchasing documentation is properly maintained. The employee will also provide backup support for Copy Center operations when needed.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:

* Assist in ordering office supplies, equipment, furniture, and other materials as requested.
* Process and track purchase orders and purchasing requests.
* Receive deliveries and verify that items received match the purchase order, packing slip, and/or invoice.
* Review packing slips for accuracy and identify shortages, damaged items, incorrect items, or other discrepancies.
* Report and follow up on delivery and order discrepancies with vendors and appropriate staff.
* Maintain organized records of purchase orders, packing slips, invoices, and receiving documentation.
* Coordinate and assist with office-wide deliveries, including distributing supplies, equipment, furniture, and other materials to the appropriate offices, units, or floors.
* Assist with moving, staging, and organizing deliveries as needed.
* Help maintain and organize the stockroom, ensuring supplies and materials are properly stored, labeled, and readily accessible.
* Assist with inventory tracking and monitoring office supply levels.
* Monitor outstanding orders and follow up with vendors regarding delivery schedules, back orders, and delays.
* Communicate with staff regarding the status of orders, deliveries, and requested items.
* Perform other purchasing, receiving, and administrative duties as assigned.

Backup Copy Center Responsibilities

* Provide backup coverage for the Copy Center during staff absences, high-volume periods, or as otherwise needed.
* Assist with printing, copying, scanning, collating, stapling, binding, three-hole punching, and other document-preparation tasks.
* Assist with processing and completing office-wide and large-volume print and copy requests.
* Sort, organize, package, and distribute completed Copy Center jobs.
* Monitor Copy Center supplies and notify the appropriate staff when replenishment is needed.
* Report on equipment issues or service needs.
* Follow established Copy Center procedures and maintain confidentiality when handling sensitive documents.

Physical and Operational Requirements

* Must be able to lift and carry boxes and other materials weighing up to 50 pounds.
* Must be able to safely operate and maneuver a hand truck/dolly with heavy loads.
* Must be able to assist with moving and distributing office supplies, equipment, furniture, and deliveries throughout the facility.
* Must maintain a valid driver’s license and be able to drive as required for work-related duties and deliveries.

PREFERRED SKILLS:

* Strong organizational and time-management skills.
* Excellent attention to detail, particularly when reviewing orders, packing slips, and deliveries.
* Ability to manage multiple requests and priorities simultaneously.
* Good communication and customer service skills.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Basic computer skills and ability to learn purchasing and inventory systems.
* Ability to safely handle, transport, and distribute boxes, office supplies, equipment, and other materials.
* Ability to maintain accurate records and follow established purchasing, receiving, inventory, and safety procedures.
* Valid driver’s license required.

**Position Summary**

The Purchasing Assistant (Inventory/Logistics) is responsible for supporting inventory accuracy and the efficient movement of goods by maintaining inventory records, processing shipment documentation, and coordinating with internal departments and external business partners. This role works closely with Purchasing, Accounts Payable, freight forwarders, customs brokers, warehouse personnel, and overseas vendors to ensure timely receipt of inventory and accurate processing of shipments.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Enter shipment information into the inventory management system and verify inventory receipts against purchase orders and shipping documentation.
* Submit shipping documentation to Accounts Payable for processing and communicate payment status, as needed.
* Maintain and update shipment tracking reports and truck delivery schedules.
* Prepare and submit required documentation to customs brokers to facilitate timely customs clearance.
* Review warehouse receiving reports following container unloads and accurately receiving inventory into the inventory system.
* Investigate and resolve discrepancies involving receiving reports, purchase orders, shipping documents, and inventory records.
* Maintain organized inventory records, shipping files, and related documentation.
* Communicate effectively with internal departments, freight providers, customs brokers, and overseas vendors regarding shipment status, inventory discrepancies, and documentation requirements.
* Assist in maintaining inventory accuracy through timely and accurate data entry.
* Perform other duties and special projects as assigned.

**Qualifications**

**Required Qualifications**

* High school diploma or equivalent; associate degree preferred.
* Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
* Ability to prioritize multiple tasks and work independently in a fast-paced environment.
* Proficient data entry and basic mathematical skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including Microsoft Excel.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Previous experience in purchasing, inventory control, logistics, or supply chain operations.
* Experience working with inventory management.
* Familiarity with international shipping documentation and customs clearance processes.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to work collaboratively across multiple departments while managing competing priorities.

description:
**Why You’ll Love World Market**

You won’t find a store and team like this anywhere else! We're passionate about our mission to delight customers with a unique, ever-changing marketplace of products from around the world. Our assortment is curated with stylish home décor, quality furniture, thoughtful gifts, time-honored handicrafts, and international food and beverage favorites. From handpicked finds to heartfelt teamwork, World Market is where uniqueness isn’t just celebrated—it’s what sets us apart.

Our team means the world to us! We value authenticity, empowerment and respect and we take pride in what we do. If you’re looking for a collaborative, fast-moving environment where your contributions are valued, growth is supported and you can have a little fun—you’ve found it!

**When you join our team, you’ll enjoy:**

* Benefits that support health, financial security, and personal life needs. Learn more about benefits and eligibility for Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance, and more!
* Paid vacation and paid sick time
* 401(k) plan with Roth option and company match
* Employee Assistance Program and wellness resources to be and do your best
* Sample Sales and up to 30% shopping discount on our unique finds for you and your designated shopper
* Work life balance and work from home flexibility
* Working with a team who thinks the world of you

**What You’ll Do:**

You will become part of a dynamic Merchandising team and build relationships with external and internal partners as you learn about our business. As an Assistant Buyer, you will be responsible for supporting the Buyer’s activities to drive our business, including developing unique product assortments for our omni-channel business through analysis, trend research and international sourcing.

In this role, you will:

**Assist in managing the overall department’s business through assortment planning, reporting, and product reviews**

* Assist in strategically building assortments that meet financial metrics and excites our customers through comp shopping, working with vendors, and understanding trends.
* Develop business acumen and demonstrate an understanding of key metrics and levers
* Maintain and speak to key financials through weekly reporting by analyzing and summarizing current business.
* Assist in actively manage the business both in forward planning and in season execution.

**Manage the administrative detail of product development planning**

* Assist in in Product Review preparation by sample tracking, maintaining quote sheets, and assortment planning
* Assist with providing Inventory Management with final assortment plans and any updates to ensure accuracy.
* Create and maintain Vendor and SKU set up information in merchant operational tools.

* Own the sample management process: tracking, organizing, and distributing samples to cross-functional partners
* Manage vendor relationship: request samples, handle quality assurance issues, organize claims preparation, return to vendor (RTV) process, vendor income support, and track and resolve outstanding issues.
* Audit and proof marketing ads, store signage, and product copy
* Attend vendor meetings in Alameda or domestically as appropriate

**Maintain effective communication with cross-functional partners**

* Collaborate with Visual and Inventory Management partners to determine product placement, signage needs, and schematic accuracy.
* Communicate product trends and sales projections with Marketing teams to develop effective and compelling marketing strategies
* Manage Ecommerce product database by utilizing merchant operational tools and providing Ecommerce support
* Partner with the Merch Operations team to execute store strategies, updates, and resolve store issues

**Hybrid Work Location:**

You will spend up to 3 days per week on average at our Alameda, CA Home Office

**Experience & Skills You’ll Bring**

* Passion for the business
* A high level of critical thinking, agility, and curiosity.
* Strong team collaboration skills and ability to present and verbalize new ideas.
* Resourcefulness and creative problem solving.
* Awareness of the marketplace, trends, and a keen eye for taste.
* An enthusiasm for travel and exploring.
* Excellent analytical, planning, and time management skills
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Some experience with a multi-unit retailer in a merchandise capacity preferred.
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience required
* Microsoft Suite skills and experience with Merchandising software systems
* Ability to lift and move boxes of samples

*CA Pay Range is $72,000- $78,000 Annually*

**Job Summary:**

Allway Tools is looking for a highly organized and detail-oriented **Sales & Purchasing Assistant** to join our growing team. This is a varied, hands-on position that supports our Sales, Purchasing, and Marketing teams and provides exposure to customer accounts, product launches, purchasing, research, eCommerce, and project coordination.

This position plays an important role in keeping our sales and purchasing activities organized and moving forward. The role includes data collection, item setup, product launches, account service, customer compliance, eCommerce, meeting preparation, product samples, merchandising, and project coordination.

The ideal candidate is able to multitask, prioritize responsibilities, and communicate effectively and professionally with both team members and customers. Strong attention to detail is essential. Strong computer skills are required, including the ability to write professional emails and proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook, and PowerPoint.

1–3 years of relevant experience preferred. Experience in sales support, purchasing, customer service, operations, or a related field is a plus. Experience in the home improvement industry is preferred, but not required.

Because Allway works with major retail customers and a wide range of products, this position offers the opportunity to learn how products move from development and purchasing through sales, retail, eCommerce, and marketing.

Bachelor's degree preferred; equivalent relevant work experience will also be considered. We offer competitive compensation based on experience and qualifications, and benefits such as 401(k) with company match and health insurance.

**Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:**

* Support the Sales and Purchasing departments with day-to-day activities and special projects
* Provide direct support for specific, high-priority customer accounts
* Assist with item setup, product launches, and project coordination
* Conduct industry and product research
* Check and enter customer orders
* Troubleshoot order and shipping issues
* Assist with order billing and related documentation
* Assist with customer account management
* Maintain and manage spreadsheets and other internal documents
* Act as a liaison between the production and shipping departments
* Support the Purchasing team with record keeping, inventory reviews, and other purchasing activities
* Assist with marketing, social media, and other special projects
* Potential for travel for customer meetings or industry retail shows

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree preferred – Business, Accounting, Finance, Marketing, or a related field is a plus
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Detail-oriented with exceptional organizational skills
* Ability to multitask, prioritize, and manage multiple responsibilities
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team
* Proficiency in the Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Word, Excel and PowerPoint)
* Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 or another ERP system preferred
* Willingness to learn and grow with the company

**Schedule:**

* 8 hour shift
* Day shift
* Monday to Friday

Pay: $50,000.00 - $65,000.00 per year

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Parental leave
* Professional development assistance
* Retirement plan
* Vision insurance

* Bachelor's (Required)

* Sales/Account Support: 1 year (Preferred)

Ability to Commute:

* Bronx, NY 10462 (Required)

Ability to Relocate:

* Bronx, NY 10462: Relocate before starting work (Required)

**Nature of Work**
------------------

**DEP2700053 Purchasing Assistant**
**West Virginia Department of Environmental Protection**
**Division of Land Restoration**
**Procurement Unit**
**Office location will be one of below:**
**601 57th Street, Southeast, Charleston, WV 25304**
**1000 Technology Drive, Suite 3220, Fairmont, WV 26554**
**47 School Street, Suite 301, Philippi, WV 26416**

**This position is classified exempt; therefore, does not fall under the classified service.**

We welcome you to join our team where we value work/life balance and diversity. We offer a great benefits package that includes 12 paid holidays, insurance and flexible benefits, ample annual and sick leave accrual, flexible work schedules, an Employee Assistance Program, Wellness Initiatives, an optional 457 defined contribution retirement savings plan and more.

If you want to be a part of this innovative team, apply today.

Under supervision of the Procurement Supervisor, this position provides procurement support services for the Department of Environmental Protection; Division of Land Restoration (DLR). Provides administrative and procurement services for the Land Closure Assistance Program (LCAP), Office of Environmental Remediation (OER), Office of Special Reclamation (OSR), and the Office of Abandoned Mine Lands (AML).

Duties include:

* Will maintain and update DLR Procurement operational resources such as checklists, coding and funding information, SOPs, account information lists, staff assignment lists, etc.
* Will monitor the DLR Procurement delegated email account and Procurement Management System for incoming invoices, purchase requests, inquiries, etc., and will tag and route work to assigned staff.
* Will maintain DLR Procurement & DLR project records in the electronic filing system and manage archived documents by auditing files for duplications and misfiled documents. Will audit the electronic filing system for discrepancies to ensure the integrity of records. Will redact or destroy confidential and outdated files in accordance with the record retention policy.
* Will assist inventory coordinators by tracking inventory items. Will track and maintain office supply and equipment inventory. Prepare purchase requests for stock items when supplies are needed. Assists DLR staff with preparing purchase requests. Documents & tracks all purchase requests in the Procurement Management System.
* Will review invoices for accuracy and prepare coding sheets for signature. Will obtain approval signatures for various procurement documents such as invoices, purchase requests and receiving reports. Documents & tracks all invoices in the Procurement Management System. Will submit invoices for payment to Accounts Payable.
* Will pay invoices and make DLR purchases on PCard. Will make travel arrangements for staff and schedule conference rooms, hotels and rental vehicles for DLR staff using PCard. Will reconcile all PCard transactions in accordance with all policies and procedures.
* Will be responsible for administrative duties such as answering and screening routine phone calls, maintaining email lists, preparing routine correspondence and form letters, preparing fillable forms and spreadsheets. May be required to compile information and create reports across various systems such as the Procurement Management System, AppXtender, and Oasis.
* Will schedule meetings, trainings and interviews. Will utilize the agency facility reservation system to reserve meeting space. Will prepare agendas, meeting materials, presentation materials and interview packets.
* Will assist with processing, researching, reviewing and responding to FOIA requests for DLR. Will be the backup contact for questions, complaints and emergency calls and distribute them to appropriate DLR offices. Logs and determines priority of calls and notifies proper staff.
* Will publish legal ads for NPDES permit actions. Will track and distribute affidavits for publication. Employee will prepare fee transfers and submit them to accounts payable for payment.
* Will receive, date stamp, distribute and log mail and packages received via mail room, and process outgoing mail, packages and certified letters.

Notes:

* Regular attendance is an essential part of this position.
* Qualifying applicants will be required to complete an internet-based profile assessment to compare the applicant's thinking and reasoning skills, behavioral traits and the occupational interests against the traits determined to be important to the posted position.
* The recommended candidate will be subject to a search of his or her Motor Vehicle Record (MVR) prior to being hired and annually thereafter.
* All new employees that are involved with Specific DEP programs subject to the Surface Mining Control and Reclamation Act (SMRCA) of 1977 must file prior to final appointment and annually thereafter, a Statement of Employment and Financial Interest (OSM 23).

**Boston College Introduction**

Founded in 1863, Boston College is a Jesuit, Catholic university located six miles from downtown Boston with an enrollment of 9,654 full-time undergraduates and 5,072 graduate and professional students. Ranked 37 among national universities, Boston College has 923 full-time and 1,336 FTE faculty, 2,822 non-faculty employees, an operating budget of $1.4 billion, and an endowment in excess of $3.9 billion.

**Job Description**

**Fiscal & Procurement Assistant**

The **Fiscal & Procurement Assistant** serves a key role in the fiscal, procurement, and student organization-related activities of the Student Affairs Business Service Center (SABSC). This position is responsible for the work associated with financial and business operations, including managing and monitoring the accurate and timely processing of all transactions. This role is responsible for responding to incoming requests and inquiries and ensuring follow-up and resolution. The Fiscal and Procurement Assistant provides financial support and services to Student Affairs departments, and to students involved with the Undergraduate Government of Boston College (UGBC), the Student Organization Funding Committee (SOFC), and registered student organizations (RSOs), including transactional support, reporting, and problem-solving across a wide variety of service center operations and services.

Interested candidates must have a strong customer service orientation, the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, team-based environment, and sound judgment to manage complex fiscal and operational processes with accuracy and integrity. The ideal candidate will bring demonstrated experience in financial administration, and problem-solving, along with the flexibility to adapt to evolving needs and contribute to continuous improvement.

Each staff member in the Division of Student Affairs is expected to support division and university-wide initiatives, staff events, and serve on committees as needed.

Hiring Range: $24.78/hr to $30.96/hr. Pay rate commensurate with relevant experience.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree
* Three years relevant experience or equivalent combination of education and experience
* Understanding of or demonstrated aptitude for budgetary and financial concepts essential, especially in higher education
* Previous experience in a customer service environment essential
* Academic experience preferred
* Excellent organizational, prioritization, and project management skills
* Functional use of PeopleSoft HR and Financial systems
* Functional use of Microsoft software including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint
* Strong oral and written communications skills
* Excellent organizational, prioritization, and project management skills
* Ability to recognize and effectively balance the differing needs of students and staff in multiple departments
* Ability to work well in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment
* Ability to work independently and in a team-based environment
* Availability for occasional evening and weekend work to support business cycles, events, and divisional priorities

**Closing Statement**

Boston College offers a broad and competitive range of benefits depending on your job classification eligibility:

* Tuition remission for Employees
* Tuition remission for Spouses and Children who meet eligibility requirements
* Generous Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
* Low-Cost Life Insurance
* Eligibility for both University-Funded 401k and Employer-Sponsored 403b Retirement Plans
* Paid Holidays Annually
* Generous Sick and Vacation Pay
* Additional benefits can be found on https://www.bc.edu/employeehandbook

Boston College conducts pre-employment background checks as part of the hiring process.

Boston College is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected category, including disability and protected veteran status. Boston College's Notice of Nondiscrimination can be viewed at https://www.bc.edu/nondiscrimination.

description:
**Position Summary**
====================

The Sourcing Manager leads strategic and day-to-day sourcing activities for materials, components, equipment, and services needed to support manufacturing operations and customer commitments. This position develops reliable supplier relationships, negotiates favorable commercial terms, improves cost and lead-time performance, reduces supply risk, and ensures purchases meet quality, technical, delivery, and inventory requirements. The Sourcing Manager works closely with Operations, Engineering, Quality, Project Management, Finance, Shipping/Receiving, and other plant departments to keep work moving efficiently and support customer satisfaction.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**
=========================================

**Strategic Sourcing and Cost Management**
------------------------------------------

* Develop and execute sourcing strategies for assigned materials, components, outside services, capital equipment, and indirect purchases based on business priorities, demand, supplier capability, and market conditions.
* Analyze company spending, purchase history, forecasts, lead times, and market trends to identify opportunities for cost reduction, supplier consolidation, standardization, and improved purchasing leverage.
* Obtain competitive quotations - normally at least three when practical and consistent with company requirements - and evaluate suppliers using total cost, quality, delivery, service, technical capability, and risk rather than unit price alone.
* Negotiate pricing, payment terms, freight, lead times, warranties, service levels, stocking arrangements, and other commercial terms; document savings, cost avoidance, and negotiated value.
* Negotiate, implement, and maintain supplier agreements, blanket orders, and quantity-purchase arrangements within assigned authority and in coordination with management, Finance, and legal resources when appropriate.
* Support annual budgets, cost estimates, quoting activities, and margin improvement by providing current material costs, supplier options, and sourcing recommendations.

**Supplier Selection, Development, and Performance**
----------------------------------------------------

* Identify, qualify, and develop suppliers capable of meeting company requirements for quality, delivery, capacity, technical performance, price, and service.
* Build professional, ethical, and productive supplier relationships while representing the company effectively during telephone, electronic, and in-person communications.
* Maintain supplier performance records and scorecards using appropriate measures such as on-time delivery, quality, responsiveness, pricing, and corrective-action performance.
* Lead or support supplier reviews, audits, performance-improvement plans, and corrective actions; escalate recurring issues and recommend changes in source when warranted.
* Monitor supplier capacity, financial or operational concerns, long lead-time items, single-source dependencies, and other supply-chain risks; develop alternate-source and contingency plans where practical.
* Partner with Quality and Engineering to confirm supplier qualifications, specifications, certifications, inspection requirements, and approval of substitutions or process changes.

* Strong negotiator who still protects the relationship.
* Sharp analytical and problem-solving skills.

* Microsoft Office proficiency, especially Excel.

**Position Title:** Location Procurement Manager (New Factory Launch & CapEx)

**Location:** Pendergrass, GA (Hybrid)

**Are you looking for a company that empowers talent?**

Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. Improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation!

From Day 1, you are empowered to create an impact with your full potential and creativity to make a difference for tomorrow.

We truly have an inclusive and diverse team culture where you can be yourself. Our extensive global presence offers a diverse range of career opportunities across various industries, nations, and job domains, empowering our workforce to continuously enhance their skills and stay competitive.

Create a better tomorrow with us!

The Location Procurement Manager will lead site-level procurement to support the launch of a brand-new manufacturing facility. This role is responsible for building the local supply base from the ground up, establishing purchasing processes and controls, and partnering with Engineering, Operations, Finance, and EHS to execute capital projects. The ideal candidate is hands-on, analytical, and experienced in CapEx sourcing, supplier development, and cross-functional project execution in a fast-paced start-up environment.

**You will make an impact with the following responsibilities:**

* **Develop the site supply chain:** Identify, qualify, and onboard local/regional suppliers for direct and indirect categories to support factory ramp-up.
* **CapEx sourcing & execution:** Lead procurement activities for capital equipment, construction-related spend, utilities, and facility services (RFQs, bid analysis, negotiations, award recommendations).
* **Capital expense governance:** Partner with Finance and Project Controls to ensure purchasing aligns to approved budgets/authorizations; track commitments vs. budgets.
* **Contracting & commercial terms:** Draft, negotiate, and manage contracts, statements of work, service level agreements, and change orders in collaboration with Legal and stakeholders.
* **Supplier performance management:** Establish KPIs (quality, delivery, cost, responsiveness), conduct reviews, drive corrective actions, and mitigate supply risk.
* **Cross-functional collaboration:** Serve as the procurement lead for site projects, partnering with Engineering, Maintenance, Operations, Quality, IT, and EHS to define requirements and ensure timely execution.
* **Strategic sourcing:** Develop location strategy to support product development and ramp up, leverage corporate agreements, and execute make/buy and total-cost-of-ownership analyses.
* **Systems & process setup:** Implement/standardize purchasing processes and ensure data accuracy in ERP/eProcurement tools.
* **Compliance & ethics:** Ensure adherence to procurement policies, competitive bidding requirements, delegation of authority, and audit expectations.

**You’ll win us over by having the following qualifications:**

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in supply chain, business, engineering or finance.
* 5 plus years of procurement/sourcing experience in manufacturing, industrial, automotive, food & beverage, chemicals, or related environments.
* Demonstrated experience sourcing and executing **capital projects (CapEx)** such as equipment purchases, construction trades, MRO, and/or facility services.
* Proven negotiation skills with experience leading RFx processes, supplier selection, and contract awards.
* Strong financial acumen (budgeting, commitment tracking, total cost of ownership, cost breakdown/should-cost analysis).
* Experience working cross-functionally with Engineering/Operations and managing multiple concurrent priorities.
* Proficiency with ERP and procurement tools and strong Excel skills.
* Ability to work on-site and travel as needed during the build and ramp phases.
* Must be eligible to work in the US with no sponsorship now or in the future.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience supporting a **greenfield/new facility** launch, major expansion, or plant turnaround.
* Knowledge of construction and project procurement (GC/CM, subcontractors, equipment installs) and common contract types (lump sum, T&M, unit rate).
* Familiarity with supplier qualification processes, quality management systems, and supply risk assessments.
* Professional certification such as CPSM, CPM, CSCP, or PMP.
* Experience with cost estimating, change order management, and CapEx project reporting.

Qualified Applicants must be legally authorized for employment in the United States. Qualified Applicants will not require employer sponsored work authorization now or in the future for employment in the United States.

**Benefits and Perks:**

Siemens offers a variety of health and wellness benefits to our employees. Details regarding our benefits can be found here: https://www.benefit

* Partner with relevant stakeholders to drive meaningful continuous improvement including material performance, operational throughput, and vendor relationships

Operational & Reporting 30% of time

* Reliably complete order administration to ensure accurate and on-time delivery
* Travel to trade shows and origin as needed

* Familiar with compliance/ GMP’s and CFR 111 Dietary Supplement Regulations
* High level of proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel and PowerPoint
* ERP experience and report writing ability strongly preferred

**YOU’LL BE A GREAT FIT:**

* Strong critical thinking ability to navigate and solve complex problems
* Solid work ethic, self-starter, and result-oriented
* Natural ability to develop strong, trusting relationships
* Enjoys collaborating with cross-functional partners
* Responsible and a high degree of ownership
* Thrives in an ever-changing work environment
* Effectively managing a multitude of work responsibilities
* Balances attention to detail and swift execution

**Job Title**

***Sourcing Manager***

**Employment Status:**

Full-Time

**FLSA Status:**

Exempt

**Department:**

Production Control

**Location:**

Manufacturing

Ridgeland, SC

**Job Summary**

The Sourcing Manager will oversee and manage the procurement process for raw materials, components, and services required for TICO’s manufacturing operations. This role is responsible for developing and implementing sourcing strategies, negotiating with suppliers, managing supplier relationships, and ensuring that all procurement activities align with company objectives, quality standards, cost targets, and operational requirements.

The Sourcing Manager will directly supervise two Sourcing Specialists, providing direction, training, mentoring, and ongoing development. This position will establish priorities, delegate assignments, monitor performance, and ensure the sourcing team effectively supports TICO’s manufacturing and business objectives.

**Duties and Responsibilities**

* Develops and executes a comprehensive sourcing and procurement strategy aligned with TICO’s business and manufacturing objectives.
* Directly supervises, trains, mentors, and develops two Sourcing Specialists.
* Provides day-to-day leadership and direction to the sourcing team, including assigning workloads, establishing priorities, monitoring progress, and ensuring timely completion of assignments.
* Coaches team members on supplier negotiations, sourcing practices, purchasing procedures, contract management, and problem resolution.
* Establishes performance expectations and provides ongoing feedback, coaching, and development opportunities for Sourcing Specialists.
* Collaborates with other departments and leadership to identify and develop requirements for equipment, materials, products, and acceptable substitutions.
* Assesses current material availability and reasonably predicts future availability based on market conditions, delivery systems, supplier capacity, and other variables.
* Develops and aggressively drives material cost-reduction initiatives.
* Negotiates supplier terms and conditions to maximize TICO’s overall value, including favorable pricing, payment terms, lead times, warranties, and service agreements.
* Identifies opportunities to transfer and mitigate risk through supplier agreements, warranties, contractual terms, and other sourcing strategies.
* Prepares and presents market conditions, supplier performance, and material cost reports to leadership.
* Manages the preparation and processing of purchase orders and requisitions for materials, supplies, and equipment using the TICO MRP system.
* Develops, implements, and maintains purchasing and contract management policies, procedures, and work instructions.
* Evaluates bids and supplier proposals and approves or recommends conditions for issuing and awarding business.
* Leads supplier negotiations and serves as the company’s primary representative in strategic supplier discussions.
* Develops and maintains strong supplier relationships while holding suppliers accountable for cost, quality, delivery, warranty, and service expectations.
* Resolves disputes, grievances, and performance issues with vendors, contractors, and suppliers.
* Maintains and improves purchasing, sourcing, and recordkeeping systems to ensure accurate and accessible procurement information.
* Coordinates the removal, disposition, or disposal of surplus materials as appropriate.
* Administers the sourcing department budget and monitors expenditures.
* Tracks and monitors company-owned assets, including TICO-owned tooling and fixtures located at supplier production facilities.
* Establishes sourcing metrics and monitors team and supplier performance against established objectives.
* Identifies opportunities to improve sourcing processes, supplier performance, and overall procurement efficiency.
* Ensures sourcing activities comply with company policies, procedures, contractual requirements, and applicable regulations.
* Performs other duties as assigned.

**Required Skills & Abilities**

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with proven negotiation and supplier management skills.
* Excellent interpersonal, relationship-building, and customer service skills.
* Strong supervisory and leadership skills with the ability to effectively train, coach, and mentor team members.
* Ability to establish priorities, delegate responsibilities, and effectively manage the workload of a sourcing team.
* Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Excellent time management skills with a proven ability to meet deadlines.
* Strong analytical, critical-thinking, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to develop and execute sourcing strategies that support cost, quality, delivery, and operational objectives.
* Thorough understanding of materials, components, equipment, and supplies used in a manufacturing environment.
* Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite or related software and MRP

**About Us:**

Afinitas, headquartered in St. Louis, Missouri, is a global leader in equipment, forming systems, and essential accessory products that support transportation, water, and utility precast concrete infrastructure worldwide. We provide industry-leading production equipment; highly engineered formwork; and a broad portfolio of precast concrete, electrical, and construction accessories, along with structural products and systems designed for bridge, highway, and heavy construction applications. Afinitas is part of BW Forsyth Partners, LLC, the investment group of global manufacturing and engineering consulting firm Barry-Wehmiller, a $3 billion organization with nearly 12,000 team members, united by a common belief: to use the power of business to build a better world.

**Job Description:**

Location: Remote (Midwest Preferred)

Employment Type: Contract

Afinitas is seeking a Contract Sourcing Specialist to help build candidate pipelines for frontline production and manufacturing positions across multiple locations.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys finding talent, engaging candidates, and helping organizations fill critical manufacturing positions. You'll partner closely with our Talent Acquisition team to identify and connect with production employees, skilled trades professionals, and other manufacturing talent needed to support our growing operations.

While this is a remote position, we are seeking candidates located in the Midwest who are familiar with regional labor markets and manufacturing talent pools.

What You'll Do

* Source candidates for production, assembly, machining, welding, maintenance, and other manufacturing roles.

* Build active talent pipelines across multiple sites and regions.

* Conduct candidate outreach through phone, email, text, social media, and recruiting platforms.

* Screen candidates and assess qualifications, availability, and interest.

* Schedule qualified candidates for interviews with recruiters and hiring managers.

* Maintain candidate records and sourcing activity within our ATS.

* Support hiring campaigns, workforce initiatives, and recruiting events as needed.

* Develop talent pools for recurring and hard-to-fill manufacturing positions.

What We're Looking For

* Experience sourcing or recruiting for manufacturing, production, warehouse, industrial, or skilled trades positions.

* Strong candidate sourcing and outreach skills.

* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

* Excellent communication and relationship-building abilities.

* Experience using recruiting technology, job boards, and sourcing platforms.

* Familiarity with Midwest labor markets and manufacturing talent communities strongly preferred.

* Experience supporting multi-site manufacturing operations is a plus.

Why Join Us

* Flexible contract opportunity.

* Fully remote work environment.

* Opportunity to partner with multiple manufacturing locations and make an immediate impact.

* Collaborative team focused on solving hiring challenges and building strong workforce pipelines.

* Competitive hourly compensation based on experience.

The approximate pay range for this position is $35 - $50/hour. Please note that the pay range is a good faith estimate at the time of posting and may vary based on factors such as experience, skills, and geographic location.

If you're passionate about finding talent and building pipelines that help manufacturing operations succeed, we'd love to hear from you.

**About Us:**

Afinitas, headquartered in St. Louis, Missouri, is a global leader in equipment, forming systems, and essential accessory products that support transportation, water, and utility precast concrete infrastructure worldwide. We provide industry-leading production equipment; highly engineered formwork; and a broad portfolio of precast concrete, electrical, and construction accessories, along with structural products and systems designed for bridge, highway, and heavy construction applications. Afinitas is part of BW Forsyth Partners, LLC, the investment group of global manufacturing and engineering consulting firm Barry-Wehmiller, a $3 billion organization with nearly 12,000 team members, united by a common belief: to use the power of business to build a better world.  
  
  

**Job Description:**

Location: Remote (Midwest Preferred)

Employment Type: Contract

Afinitas is seeking a Contract Sourcing Specialist to help build candidate pipelines for frontline production and manufacturing positions across multiple locations.

  

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys finding talent, engaging candidates, and helping organizations fill critical manufacturing positions. You'll partner closely with our Talent Acquisition team to identify and connect with production employees, skilled trades professionals, and other manufacturing talent needed to support our growing operations.

While this is a remote position, we are seeking candidates located in the Midwest who are familiar with regional labor markets and manufacturing talent pools.

  

What You'll Do

* Source candidates for production, assembly, machining, welding, maintenance, and other manufacturing roles.

* Build active talent pipelines across multiple sites and regions.

* Conduct candidate outreach through phone, email, text, social media, and recruiting platforms.

* Screen candidates and assess qualifications, availability, and interest.

* Schedule qualified candidates for interviews with recruiters and hiring managers.

* Maintain candidate records and sourcing activity within our ATS.

* Support hiring campaigns, workforce initiatives, and recruiting events as needed.

* Develop talent pools for recurring and hard-to-fill manufacturing positions.

  

What We're Looking For

* Experience sourcing or recruiting for manufacturing, production, warehouse, industrial, or skilled trades positions.

* Strong candidate sourcing and outreach skills.

* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

* Excellent communication and relationship-building abilities.

* Experience using recruiting technology, job boards, and sourcing platforms.

* Familiarity with Midwest labor markets and manufacturing talent communities strongly preferred.

* Experience supporting multi-site manufacturing operations is a plus.

  

Why Join Us

* Flexible contract opportunity.

* Fully remote work environment.

* Opportunity to partner with multiple manufacturing locations and make an immediate impact.

* Collaborative team focused on solving hiring challenges and building strong workforce pipelines.

* Competitive hourly compensation based on experience.

  

The approximate pay range for this position is $35 - $50/hour. Please note that the pay range is a good faith estimate at the time of posting and may vary based on factors such as experience, skills, and geographic location.

If you're passionate about finding talent and building pipelines that help manufacturing operations succeed, we'd love to hear from you.

description:
At Spectrum Control, most departments operate on a 4-day, 10-hour work schedule in exchange for a **3-day weekend**. We offer competitive wages and PTO, plus our benefits begin on **day 1** of employment. Come join a workforce where we put you first!

**JOB SUMMARY:** The Commodity Manager is responsible for developing and executing commodity strategies that support Spectrum Control’s operational, financial, and customer objectives across multiple manufacturing locations. This hands-on, people manager will lead and develop a team of three commodity professionals while remaining actively involved in major supplier negotiations, contracting, cost reduction, risk mitigation, and supplier performance management.

Working closely with Supply Chain, Engineering, Operations, Quality, and Program Management, the Commodity Manager will build a reliable and competitive supply base for highly engineered products serving the aerospace, defense, and other high-reliability markets. The role requires strong commercial judgment, technical sourcing experience, and the ability to balance strategic initiatives with immediate business and production needs.

**Compensation Range:** The expected compensation range for this position is $130,000 - 160,000.00 annually.

**ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:**

Commodity Strategy:

* Spend Analytics
* Develop commodity strategy framework, supplier strategies.
* Implement major commodity strategies aligned with business objectives, customer requirements, and manufacturing needs.
* Manage supplier relationships and performance, improve lead time, mitigate supplier/supply risk.
* Identify and execute cost-reduction, productivity, value-engineering, and working-capital improvement opportunities.
* Identify opportunities for supplier base optimization.

People Management and Development:

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of commodity professionals, establishing clear priorities, performance expectations, and development plans.
* Establish and monitor key performance indicators for cost savings, lead time reduction, risk mitigation.
* Jointed ownership with Material Management team for purchase-price variance, delivery, lead time, and risk reduction.

Maintain hands-on involvements:

* SRM.
* Critical supplier selection, negotiations, contracting, cost analysis, and resolution of critical supply issues.
* Partner with Engineering and Operations to support supplier transitions and make-versus-buy decisions.

Continuous Improvement:

* Collaborate across Spectrum Control locations to standardize commodity practices, leverage enterprise-wide spend, and improve supply-chain performance.
* Automation and AI- actively seek opportunities to introduce new tools and automation.
* Establish and implement KPIs, best practice commodity framework and processes.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, Engineering, Operations, or a related field; advanced degree or professional certification is preferred.
* 7+ years of progressive experience in strategic sourcing, commodity management or supply-chain management, including 2+ years of direct people management experience.
* Demonstrated experience leading and developing sourcing, procurement, or commodity-management professionals.
* Experience sourcing technical components, materials, or manufacturing services within aerospace, defense, electronics, or another highly regulated manufacturing environment.
* Strong background in supplier negotiations, contract development, cost analysis, commodity strategy, and supplier performance management.
* Ability to understand technical requirements, drawings, specifications, bills of material, cost drivers, and manufacturing processes.
* Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and influence stakeholders across Engineering, Operations, Quality, Finance, and Program Management.
* Strong analytical, organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to manage strategic priorities while responding effectively to urgent production and supplier-related challenges.
* Proficiency with ERP/MRP systems, Microsoft Office applications, and data-analysis or business-intelligence tools.
* Ability and willingness to travel approximately 30%.

**WORK ENVIRONMENT:**

* This position will be based at Spectrum Control’s facility in Marlborough, MA.
* The role operates in a professional office environment with regular interaction on the manufacturing floor and at supplier facilities.
* Approximately 30% travel is required to Spectrum Control locations, supplier sites, and other business-related destinations.
* The role requires frequent collaboration across multiple locations and functions.

Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities

The contractor will not discharge or in any other manner discriminate against employees or applicants because they have inquired about, discussed, or disclosed their own pay or the pay of another employ
