**Procurement Manager**
**Austin, TX**
**$95,000 – $120,000 / year base**

**OVERVIEW**

A growing real estate development company is hiring a Procurement Manager to turn design intent into finished, installed spaces across its pipeline of ground-up developments and renovation projects. You’ll own FF&E sourcing and purchasing end to end — from vendor selection through freight, customs, and final on-site installation — for luxury multifamily, student housing, and mixed-use properties.

This is a hands-on role for someone who can run procurement logistics at scale while also building and leading a team to do the same.

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**

* Source, purchase, and manage FF&E (furniture, fixtures & equipment) for ground-up developments and renovation projects

* Own the full procurement cycle — vendor selection, purchase orders, freight, customs clearance, and on-site delivery/installation

* Coordinate directly with design teams to turn design intent into real, installed spaces on schedule and on budget

* Manage, train, and delegate across a procurement team, balancing hands-on execution with team leadership

* Support acquisitions assessments and renovation scope planning with procurement-side input on cost and timeline

* Oversee creative art installation and styling programs for completed properties

* Track purchase orders, lead times, and vendor performance across multiple concurrent projects

* Troubleshoot shipping delays, damaged goods, and vendor issues to keep installation schedules on track

* Build and maintain vendor relationships that support quality, pricing, and reliability across the portfolio

**WHY YOU MATTER**

Every finished unit, amenity space, and lobby depends on the right furniture and fixtures showing up on time, intact, and on budget. You’re the one making sure design plans actually become real spaces — without blown budgets, missed move-in dates, or last-minute scrambles.

**WHAT IT TAKES**

* 4+ years of experience in FF&E procurement, purchasing, or sourcing for interior design, hospitality, multifamily, or commercial projects

* Hands-on experience managing freight, customs clearance, and delivery logistics for large-scale installations

* Experience managing or mentoring a procurement team, not just running your own purchase orders

* Strong vendor management and negotiation skills

* Comfortable juggling multiple active projects and deadlines at once

* Sharp attention to detail — a damaged or late shipment can hold up an entire move-in

* Experience supporting acquisitions assessments or renovation scoping is a plus

* Strong organizational and communication skills across design, construction, and ownership teams

**THE PERKS!**

* Discretionary annual performance/project bonus (~15% target)

* Full corporate medical, dental, and vision coverage

* 401(k) with company matching

* PTO and paid holidays

Overview:

The Senior Purchasing Manager is responsible for overseeing all purchasing process functions for Mastec Renewables. Develops, improves, and maintains processes and systems utilized by the company while coordinating with stakeholders to ensure procurement activities are effective. Understands the life cycle of procurement activities and assists in processes throughout. Provides technical support and assistance to strategic sourcing and purchasing teams. Develop systems and reports that support procurement’s key performance indicator efforts. This position collaborates closely with internal teams, suppliers, and vendors, while maintaining high standards of compliance, efficiency, and continuous improvement.

**Location:** This position can be located at any of our office locations: Phoenix, AZ; Clinton, IN; Indianapolis, IN; Centennial, CO; Irving, TX; or Fargo, ND. Based on the experience and skillset of the individual identified, we are open to a remote-based role with ability to travel to our office and field site locations to support events or department activities.

**Company Overview**

MasTec Renewables, comprised of Wanzek Construction, IEA Constructors, and White Construction, combines over 20 years of experience in renewable energy construction. Depending on your position and project, you may work for one or more of our companies over your career with us. Join one of the largest construction firms in the country (Engineering News-Record [ENR]: #1 in Power, #17 Top 50 Domestic Heavy Contractors, #20 Transportation Contractor).

**General Position Overview**

The Indirect Buyer is responsible for sourcing, negotiating, and purchasing the goods and services required to support the organization's operations and business objectives. Working closely with internal stakeholders and external suppliers, this role ensures that products and services are acquired in a cost-effective, timely, and quality-focused manner.

The Indirect Buyer manages supplier relationships, evaluates sourcing opportunities, negotiates commercial terms, and oversees the procurement process from requisition through purchase order issuance. This position plays a key role in driving purchasing efficiency, supporting cost-reduction initiatives, and ensuring compliance with company policies and procurement procedures. The position requires strong communication, analytical, negotiation, organizational, and problem-solving skills, along with the ability to manage multiple priorities and collaborate effectively across all levels of the organization.

**Essential Job Functions**

* Demonstrates SoundOff Signal’s Core Values in daily interactions with internal and external customers.
* Ensures all purchasing decisions and transactions adhere to the company’s Quality Management System (QMS), internal controls, and contractual requirements while promoting responsible and effective stewardship of company funds and upholding the highest standards of business integrity.
* Assesses purchasing requirements and determines the appropriate use of tactical and strategic sourcing methods to achieve timely delivery and cost-effective results.
* Partners with engineering, facilities, marketing, manufacturing, sales administration and IT departments, to source, negotiate, evaluate, and develop effective procurement strategies across all indirect purchasing categories.
* Manages the supplier onboarding process, including supplier evaluation and qualification, master data collection, negotiation of payment terms and Incoterms, establishment of key performance indicators (KPIs), and collaboration with Finance to ensure supplier records are complete and accurate.
* Recognizes when contractual agreements are required and engages appropriate stakeholders and legal counsel to establish terms and conditions that protect the company and mitigate business risk and liability.
* Processes purchase requisitions into orders accurately and in a timely manner, while collaborating with requestors to ensure materials and services meet their specifications and requirements when ordered and when delivered.
* Identifies and implements hard and soft cost savings through spend data analysis, supplier negotiations, continuous improvement, competitive bidding, and supplier optimization initiatives.
* Leverages industry and market data to develop and implement purchasing strategies that optimize price, quality, delivery and service across each indirect purchased category.
* Cultivates strong supplier relationships while holding suppliers accountable to established performance standards and business expectations.
* Quickly resolves purchasing, invoicing, receiving, delivery and supplier issues.
* Monitors current news, market conditions, supplier input, and business trends relevant to assigned indirect purchasing categories to anticipate potential risks and support informed procurement decisions.
* Prepares and presents results, issues, opportunities, risk and other key data as requested.
* Demonstrates proper document control habits.
* Identifies and contributes to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance supply chain performance and advance the company’s vision, mission, and strategic objectives.
* Other duties as assigned.
* Able to perform job consistently without excessive absenteeism or tardiness.

**Job Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business or related field. An equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered.
* Five plus years’ experience in purchasing
* Professional designation or certification, such as APICS (Certified Supply Chain Professional (CSCP), or Certified Purchasing Manager (CPM) or Certified Professional in Supply Management (CPSM) program preferred.
* Indirect Procurement experience with a global supply base of over 100 suppliers and an annual expenditure over $75M
* Experience procuring multiple indirect categories
* Strong tactical procurement skills, with a demonstrated ability to execute purchasing activities, and other tasks, accurately, and within appropriate timelines
* Strong strategic thinking and analytical skills, with the ability to independently analyze, define, and resolve complex supply chain and procurement challenges using sound judgement
* Ability to work independently, as well as work successfully with others across all departments and levels of the organization
* Excellent negotiation skills
* Experience with ERP Software
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy of tasks
* Excellent written, verbal, and computer communication skills exh

### **Why join Stryker?**

Looking for a place that values your unique talents? Discover Stryker's award-winning culture.
We are proud to offer you our total rewards package which includes bonuses, healthcare, insurance benefits, retirement programs, wellness programs, as well as service and performance awards – not to mention various social and recreational activities, all of which are location specific.

### **Job description**

We are excited to be named one of the World’s Best Workplaces by Fortune Magazine! We are proud to offer you 12 paid holidays annually. For an overview of our benefits and time off, please follow this link to learn more:US Stryker employee benefits.

**What you will do**

The Sourcing Manager- NPI (Hybrid) serves as the strategic sourcing leader for new product development programs, partnering with Marketing, R&D, Operations, Quality, Finance, and suppliers to bring innovative products from concept through commercialization. This role is responsible for driving the strategy on how we partner with our internal stakeholders and external suppliers. In addition, the successful candidate will also execute sourcing strategies that enable successful product launches, mitigate risk, optimize cost, and create long-term business value. This role as a hybrid work style. The desired employee will be located in Flower Mound, TX or the surrounding area, expected to be physically present at a Stryker location on a cadenced basis but has the flexibility to work from home.

* + Lead sourcing strategy for multiple new product development and new product introduction (NPI) initiatives, ensuring alignment with business, operational, and commercialization objectives.
+ Identify, evaluate, and select suppliers for new technologies, components, and manufacturing processes, balancing cost, quality, service, innovation, and risk.
+ Develop and execute supplier strategies that support product launches, margin expansion, supply continuity, and long-term growth.
+ Serve as the primary commercial interface between suppliers and cross-functional teams, influencing decisions and resolving issues to achieve program milestones.
+ Partner closely with Engineering, Operations, Quality, Finance, and Marketing to ensure sourcing strategies support project timelines, business cases, and financial objectives.

**What you need**

**Required Qualifications**

* + Bachelor’s degree in supply chain management, Engineering, Finance, Business, or a related field.
+ 8 years of sourcing, procurement, supply chain, or supplier management experience.
+ Demonstrated experience leading supplier contract negotiations and sourcing strategies for complex products or programs.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* + 3 years of project management experience leading cross-functional initiatives.
+ Experience in medical devices or other highly regulated industries (e.g., aerospace, automotive, life sciences).
+ SAP experience.
+ Project Management certification (PMP or equivalent)
+ Experience supporting new product development and commercialization in a global supply chain environment

**US10**: $112,900 - $188,100 USD Annual

Health benefits include: Medical and prescription drug insurance, dental insurance, vision insurance, critical illness insurance, accident insurance, hospital indemnity insurance, personalized healthcare support, wellbeing program and tobacco cessation program. Financial benefits include: Health Savings Account (HSA), Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs), 401(k) plan, Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP), basic life and AD&D insurance, and short-term disability insurance. Stryker offers innovative products and services in MedSurg, Neurotechnology, Orthopaedics and Spine that help improve patient and healthcare outcomes. Alongside its customers around the world, Stryker impacts more than 150 million patients annually. Depending on customer requirements employees and new hires in sales and field roles that require access to customer accounts as a function of the job may be required to obtain various vaccinations as an essential function of their role.

description:
You’re the strategic architect of our service sourcing ecosystem at our facility, tasked with mastering the intricate operational requirements of a mission-critical environment. By effectively planning and executing a sophisticated, strategic sourcing strategy, you’ll elevate the relationships between Phillips and our key vendors to an unprecedented level of synergy and mutual success. Your mastery of negotiation will ensure that we optimize pricing and delivery schedules to the maximum benefit of our organization while simultaneously delivering a level of customer satisfaction that sets a new industry standard. You’ll operate at the intersection of market trends and organizational needs, ensuring every procurement decision is grounded in a deep understanding of current industrial best practices and regulatory compliance.

Seamless execution defines this role, as you’ll be required to dominate our internal processing systems to manage everything from CRM workflows and purchase orders to the complex logistics of sourcing critical repair parts. You’ll navigate the rigorous demands of the Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) with absolute precision, ensuring every transaction adheres to the strict guidelines governing executive agencies of the federal government. On the ground, you’ll serve as the essential liaison for subcontractors, managing the full lifecycle of onsite assessments, preventative maintenance, and corrective repairs. Your ability to forecast resource allocation days in advance and provide rapid follow-up ensures that the pulse of the shipyard remains steady and uninterrupted.

Beyond the logistics, you’re a master of communication and documentation, providing the technical oversight necessary to ensure all contract data requirement reports are submitted with flawless accuracy and timing. You’ll represent our mission in high-stakes customer meetings, collaborating with internal teams to align corrective maintenance schedules with emergent needs as they arise in real-time. By safeguarding the quality of work and ensuring that every purchase order, statement of work, change order and agreement is maintained at the highest level of excellence, you’ll protect our reputation and our world-class results. If you possess the breakthrough mindset required to transform standard sourcing into a competitive advantage for national defense, we invite you to take command of this pivotal position.

Phillips offers a world-beating collaborative culture and competitive pay and benefits. In our 65 year history, Phillips has grown from a handful of employees to over 900 supplying and supporting manufacturing technology in the United States and around the world. Compensation at Phillips is based on the market and your individual level of contribution. The expected pay range for a qualified person in this role is between $90,000.00 and $125,000.00 annually plus bonus opportunities. If you have a different suggestion, please mention it in your application.

*Phillips Corporation is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. Phillips Corporation is an E-Verify participant.*

**Requirements**

5 or more years of purchasing and sourcing experience, preferably for industrial or manufacturing industries.

Military or government experience is a plus.

Knowledge of US government procurement operations, including contract types (FFP, IDIQ, Cost Plus, etc) and regulations (FAR, GSAR, etc).

Strong Microsoft Office skills (Excell, PowerPoint) as well as D365 and ERP experience

Budgeting, cost accounting and financial analysis skills a plus.

**Benefits**

* Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental & Vision)
* Retirement Plan (401k, IRA)
* Life Insurance (Basic, Voluntary & AD&D)
* Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick & Public Holidays)
* Family Leave (Maternity, Paternity)
* Short Term & Long Term Disability
* Training & Development

description:
**About the role**

SupplyX sources finish materials and FF&E directly from factories across East Asia for multifamily, hospitality, and commercial construction clients. This role owns the supplier side of finish materials packages - supporting precon during bidding, negotiating and awarding to factories, and holding suppliers accountable to spec, budget, and schedule through delivery.

**Purchasing**

* Support preconstruction during bidding with technical product information, value-engineering and alternate-material options, factory recommendations, and budget pricing and lead times
* At award, negotiate pricing with factories and select the most qualified product and vendor for the scope
* Review and approve cutsheets against specification before release to production
* Manage submittal, sample, shop drawing, and approval cycles between factory, design team, and client
* Own the quality control process - pre-production samples, in-line and pre-shipment inspection, and third-party inspection coordination
* Resolve damage, shortage, and non-conformance claims with factories

**Factory vetting & vendor management**

* Qualify new factories: capability and capacity assessment, certifications and test reports, audits, references, sample evaluation, financial and trade-compliance screening
* Maintain a rated vendor base with performance tracking on quality, on-time delivery, and responsiveness
* Negotiate pricing, tooling, MOQs, lead times, payment terms, and warranty/remedy language
* Build long-term relationships that get SupplyX priority in production queues and preferential terms

**What you need**

* 5+ years in procurement, sourcing, or purchasing for construction finish materials - tile, stone, flooring, countertops, millwork, plumbing fittings, lighting, hardware, glazing, or similar
* Direct experience buying from factories in East Asia - factory-direct, not through a domestic distributor or trading company
* Demonstrated track record vetting and onboarding new factories, including on-site or remote audit experience
* Ability to read and interpret construction documents, finish schedules, and specification sections
* Working knowledge of international logistics and Incoterms, and comfort with landed-cost modeling
* Strong Excel skills and the discipline to keep project data clean in a system of record
* Comfortable working across time zones - early or late calls with Asia are part of the job
* Willingness to travel internationally for factory visits and trade fairs

**Strong pluses**

* Multifamily, hospitality, or commercial project experience at scale
* Prior experience in an owner's-rep environment where you represented the buyer, not the manufacturer
* Trade compliance exposure - tariff classification, country-of-origin rules, forced-labor due diligence

**Buyer / Purchaser – Job Description**

**Job Title:** Buyer / Purchaser
**Department:** Parts / Purchasing
**Reports To:** Parts Manager / Operations Manager
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**Position Summary**
The Buyer/Purchaser is responsible for sourcing and purchasing parts, supplies, and materials needed to support daily operations while maintaining appropriate inventory levels and controlling costs. This position works closely with vendors, parts personnel, service departments, and management to ensure the right products are available at the right price and at the right time.

**Essential Duties & Responsibilities**

* Review inventory levels, usage history, open orders, and demand to determine purchasing needs.
* Place purchase orders with approved vendors and suppliers.
* Obtain competitive pricing and negotiate discounts, price breaks, freight costs, and other purchasing terms.
* Compare vendor pricing and availability to determine the best overall value.
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with vendors and suppliers.
* Monitor purchase orders and follow up on backorders, delayed shipments, and shortages.
* Verify pricing, quantities, part numbers, and shipping information before placing orders.
* Work with vendors to resolve pricing discrepancies, incorrect shipments, damaged products, and returns.
* Maintain accurate purchasing and inventory records.
* Monitor inventory levels to minimize stockouts while avoiding unnecessary overstock.
* Analyze purchasing history and usage trends to identify opportunities for cost savings and improved inventory management.
* Consolidate purchases when practical to reduce freight costs, administrative work, and receiving time.
* Identify opportunities for volume purchasing and bulk discounts.
* Assist with establishing appropriate stocking levels and reorder points.
* Review obsolete, slow-moving, and excess inventory and make recommendations for corrective action.
* Coordinate with the parts counter and service department to ensure customer and repair needs are met.
* Research alternative parts and suppliers when necessary.
* Ensure purchases are made in accordance with company policies and approved vendors.
* Maintain organized documentation of purchase orders, pricing, quotes, and vendor communications.
* Assist with annual and periodic physical inventory counts.
* Stay informed about vendor price changes, product availability, and market conditions.
* Perform other purchasing, inventory, and parts-related duties as assigned.

**Qualifications**

* Previous purchasing, parts, inventory, or automotive/heavy-duty experience preferred.
* Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
* Good communication and negotiation skills.
* Ability to compare pricing and make cost-effective purchasing decisions.
* Ability to prioritize multiple orders and deadlines.
* Basic computer skills and experience with inventory or purchasing software.
* Ability to read and understand part numbers, product descriptions, and specifications.
* Strong problem-solving and follow-up skills.
* Ability to work independently while also working effectively with other departments.

**Key Performance Expectations**

The Buyer/Purchaser should focus on:

* **Cost Control:** Obtain competitive pricing and maximize vendor discounts.
* **Availability:** Maintain adequate inventory to support customers and technicians.
* **Inventory Management:** Reduce excess, obsolete, and slow-moving inventory.
* **Vendor Management:** Build productive relationships and hold vendors accountable for pricing and delivery.
* **Purchasing Efficiency:** Consolidate orders when practical and reduce unnecessary purchasing and receiving activity.
* **Accuracy:** Ensure correct parts, quantities, pricing, and delivery information.
* **Customer Support:** Help ensure parts are available when needed to minimize customer and repair delays.

description:
The Heritage Project comprises 16 power generation facilities across Pennsylvania, New Jersey, and Ohio. The portfolio includes a diverse range of generating assets supporting reliable electricity production throughout the region.

**Opportunity Summary**

NAES Corporation has an immediate opening for an Inventory Procurement Specialist to support procurement, purchasing, and inventory management across 16 Heritage Project power generation facilities. This position coordinates purchasing activities, supplier relationships, inventory control, and material availability to support safe, reliable, and cost-effective plant operations.

Working closely with plant personnel, suppliers, and corporate teams, the Inventory Procurement Specialist helps maintain accurate inventory records, resolve purchasing issues, identify cost-saving opportunities, and improve procurement practices across the fleet.

This is a remote position requiring approximately 15% travel, including quarterly site visits for inventory verification and related procurement and inventory activities.

**Your scope of responsibility as Inventory Procurement Specialist includes the following primary functions:**

* Coordinate procurement, purchasing, and inventory activities across 16 Heritage Project facilities to support plant operational needs and material availability.
* Process purchase requisitions, obtain supplier quotations, evaluate pricing and availability, issue purchase orders, and coordinate deliveries in accordance with established procedures.
* Support supplier selection, pricing negotiations, contract administration, and vendor relationships to maintain competitive costs, quality, and reliable service.
* Partner with plant personnel to identify purchasing requirements, verify material specifications, prioritize critical needs, and resolve procurement or inventory issues.
* Monitor inventory levels, material usage, and stock availability to identify shortages, excess or obsolete inventory, and opportunities to improve inventory accuracy.
* Conduct quarterly site visits to verify physical inventory, reconcile discrepancies, review warehouse and storeroom practices, and support corrective actions.
* Analyze purchasing, spending, and inventory data to identify cost-saving opportunities, material standardization, supplier consolidation, and fleet-wide purchasing efficiencies.
* Track supplier performance, purchase orders, deliveries, and purchasing activities while addressing pricing, invoicing, material quality, and fulfillment discrepancies.
* Maintain accurate procurement, supplier, and inventory records in Maximo, including material data, purchasing transactions, stock adjustments, and related reporting.
* Prepare procurement, inventory, and spending reports to identify trends, monitor performance, and recommend operational improvements.
* Follow company Supply Chain policies, purchasing procedures, contractual requirements, and internal controls while supporting Supplier Diversity initiatives.
* Collaborate with plant leadership and corporate teams to improve purchasing processes, inventory management, Maximo utilization, and overall supply chain efficiency.
* Perform other duties and support procurement, inventory, and supply chain initiatives as assigned.

**NAES Safe**

Safety is a core value of NAES and as a condition of employment, all employees are expected to be mentally alert and work safely at all times. Additionally, employees are required to adhere to all safety warnings and posted safety signs whenever on company property. Furthermore, employees must follow all NAES safety rules and procedures. Effectiveness in carrying out this responsibility is part of the evaluation of each employee’s performance.

**Working Relationships**

**Position Summary**

We are seeking a strategic, detail-oriented leader to serve as Procurement Manager . This position leads tactical buying team in the U.S. and Canadian branches. Reporting to the Director of Supply Chain, this role leads the buying team and translates demand and product strategies into practical supply plans that support product availability, customer fulfillment, inventory health, and working-capital goals.

**Duties and Responsibilities**

* Lead, coach, and develop the tactical buying team responsible for branch replenishment; establish clear expectations, performance measures, and development plans.
* Ensure timely, accurate execution of purchase orders, supplier communication, follow-up, and exception management.
* Partner with the Director of Supply Chain to implement and support Echelon’s S&OP process, leading the supply-planning component by translating approved demand plans into actionable supply and inventory plans.
* Work closely with Sales, Operations, Finance, and Strategic Sourcing to align demand and supply planning cycles, identify risks, and ensure effective handoffs to execution.
* Ensure material availability and fulfillment performance while minimizing excess, obsolete, and slow-moving inventory.
* Execute replenishment strategies that support product availability, branch service levels, and working-capital objectives.
* Maintain and improve ERP/MRP planning parameters, including lead times, reorder points, min/max levels, safety stock, order quantities, and material master data.
* Monitor supplier lead times, capacity constraints, fill rates, stockouts, inventory turns, aging inventory, and branch-level inventory health; escalate service-level risks as appropriate.
* Identify and implement process, system, reporting, and data-quality improvements that strengthen planning and procurement workflows.
* Maintain productive supplier relationships that support availability, service, and cost objectives.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, Operations, or a related field; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
* Five or more years of progressive experience in purchasing, supply planning, inventory management, or hose operations.
* Demonstrated experience leading, coaching, or supervising a buying, procurement, planning, or operations team.
* Strong working knowledge of ERP/MRP systems and inventory-planning principles.
* Experience in a multi-branch distribution environment preferred.
* Strong analytical skills and advanced Excel proficiency.
* Excellent communication, organization, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
* Ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.

description:
**Career Area:**

Procurement

**Job Description:**

**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Employees in this position work directly with a specific group of suppliers in the Forgings Supply Chain and cross functional clients daily to help ensure uninterrupted availability of material through the Global Supply Chain to worldwide locations in direct response to our customers’ requirements. The Procurement Specialist have a direct impact on improving and sustaining supplier performance with impact to quality, cost, delivery, and ultimately to customer commitments and satisfaction.

Responsibilities include day-to-day and strategic supplier management including, but not limited to: purchase order placement, follow-up, issue resolution, communication of demand and forecasts, preparing contracts, negotiating contract terms, providing solutions to a wide range of issues, managing supplier relationships and performance metrics, facilitating communications and mitigating risk that could impact Solar’s ability to meet customer commitments or business plan.

This position acts with a sense of urgency and is diligent in providing timely support to internal clients and external customers. This individual operates in compliance with corporate and Supply Chain policies and procedures and continuously practices and demonstrates Safety and acts in adherence to Our Values in Action. A Procurement Specialist will manage relationships of moderately strategic to complex suppliers. This individual has no direct reports but works within a team structure typically including a Sourcing Specialist, Supply Chain Coordinator/Planner, Supplier Technical Engineer and reports directly to a Supply Chain Manager. There is an expectation to both participate and lead projects from conception to maturity that directly support organizational objectives. The work environment is office based with occasional visits to internal production areas as well as external supplier sites, which may involve domestic and/or international travel.

The successful candidate will have demonstrated skills and competencies that include:

**Supply Chain Management –** Ensures procurement processes meets audit, regulatory, and legal standards. Develops and maintain relationships with internal clients and supplier executives. Applies advanced Supply Chain knowledge to manage processes, establish policies, and develop value-adding strategies. Monitors and manages ownership of risk from financial, business continuation, and compliance perspectives.

**Supplier Management** - Manages each relationship of moderately complex suppliers. Drives cost management through identifying and implementing opportunities for cost reduction, utilizes cost modeling techniques, and analyzing TCO to ensure the best overall value to Solar. Manages and maintains the supplier relationship at a day-to-day and strategic level. Day-to-day activities include purchase order issuance and maintenance, grief resolution, and business review meetings.

**Supplier Selection** - Strategic activities include working with the Supply Chain Leadership and/or Sourcing Specialist to define the buyer-supplier relationship and the strategic direction (Hold, Grow, Consolidate, Exit). Supports NPI, global strategic sourcing, and supplier selection to ensure flexible capacity and consistent supply from qualified suppliers to support business objectives.

**Contract Management** – Develops agreements that align with sourcing strategies and utilizes appropriate standard Solar contracts with legal review, as required. Identifies and balances key risks at all stages. Integral in tracking contract execution, leading contract teams, closing contracts, and enforcing any applicable rights beyond contract completion. Works closely with users defining supplier performance measurements and reporting frameworks. Leads commercial negotiations and is accountable for contract execution and maintenance (NDA’s, GP’s, PSAs, JDAs, etc).

**About the Role:**

As a CBRE Procurement Manager, you'll be responsible for managing a team of employees responsible for sourcing, negotiating, and managing service provider for outsourced services. You will also assist a client or department with the development and execution of sourcing and procurement strategies.

This job is part of the Procurement function. They are responsible for sourcing and purchasing goods, services, or raw materials from vendors and suppliers.

**What You’ll Do:**

* Provide formal supervision to employees. Monitor the training and development of staff. Conduct performance evaluations and coaching. Oversee the recruiting and hiring of new employees.
* Coordinate and manage the team's daily activities. Establish work schedules, assign tasks, and cross-train staff. Work with business stakeholders, operational shared services team members, and sponsors to develop, coordinate, and execute strategy at local and regional levels.
* Set and track staff and department deadlines. Mentor and coach as needed.
* Draft, review, negotiate, and maintain contracts and other business documents in support of the purchase of goods and services.
* Review the process of contract terminations, expirations, extensions, and renewals. Inform peers and corporate management staff of changes or results.
* Manage supplier and contractor certification process. Conduct periodic visits to supplier work locations to review vendor performance.
* Mentor and educate on contemporary outsourcing practices and the value of applying them.
* Analyze account-wide facility management services spend, suppliers, operations, and statement of works to identify opportunities for value creation.
* Assist with creating RTFs, selecting solutions, and negotiating. Prepare and maintain contracts with national and regional service providers. Ensure contracts adhere to company standards.
* Lead by example and model behaviors that are consistent with CBRE RISE values. Influence parties of shared interests to reach an agreement. Deal with sensitive issues.
* Apply knowledge of own discipline and how own discipline integrates with others to achieve team and departmental objectives.
* Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve day-to-day and moderately complex issues which may or may not be evident in existing systems and processes.

**What You’ll Need:**

* Bachelor's Degree preferred with 3-5 years of relevant experience. In lieu of a degree, a combination of experience and education will be considered. C.P.M., C.P.S.M. or N.A.C.M. certifications or eligibility preferred.
* Experience in the areas of staffing, selection, training, development, coaching, mentoring, measuring, appraising, and rewarding performance and retention preferred.
* Ability to guide the exchange of sensitive, complicated, and difficult information, convey performance expectations and handle problems.
* Leadership skills to motivate team impact on quality, efficiency, and effectiveness of the job discipline and department.
* In-depth knowledge of Microsoft Office products. Examples include Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.
* Extensive organizational skills with a strong inquisitive mindset.
* Advanced math skills. Ability to calculate difficult figures such as percentages, fractions, and other financial-related calculations.

**Equal Employment Opportunity:** CBRE has a long-standing commitment to providing equal employment opportunity to all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, veteran status, political belief, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

**Candidate Accommodations:** CBRE values the differences of all current and prospective employees and recognizes how every employee contributes to our company’s success. CBRE provides reasonable accommodations in job application procedures for individuals with disabilities. If you require assistance due to a disability in the application or recruitment process, please submit a request via email at recruitingaccommodations@cbre.com or via telephone at +1 866 225 3099 (U.S.) and +1 866 388 4346 (Canada).

**Location:** Vineland, New Jersey
**Work Setting:** On-Site
**Employment Type:** Full-Time
**Pay Range:** $80,000 – $100,000 annually

About DataOne

DataOne designs, develops, and operates sustainable AI Factories, bringing together energy, infrastructure, and artificial intelligence at industrial scale. With operations in the U.S. and internationally, we deliver large-scale, mission-critical infrastructure with a focus on innovation, sustainability, and operational excellence. As we continue to grow, we’re looking for people who want to bring their experience, ideas, and perspective to meaningful projects and help shape what comes next at DataOne.

About the Job

DataOne is hiring a **Procurement Manager** to oversee sourcing, purchasing, and supplier management for our Vineland data center. This position supports construction, critical infrastructure, facility operations, and site services.

You'll work closely with Construction, Engineering, Operations, Finance, and Legal to manage purchasing activities, negotiate supplier agreements, control costs, and support project schedules and ongoing operations.

What You’ll Do

* Manage procurement activities, including sourcing, competitive bidding, supplier selection, negotiations, purchase orders, and delivery tracking.
* Purchase construction materials, critical electrical and mechanical equipment, subcontracted services, and operational supplies.
* Work with Construction, Engineering, and Operations to identify purchasing needs, technical requirements, and equipment lead times.
* Prepare and evaluate RFQs, RFPs, supplier proposals, bid comparisons, and commercial recommendations.
* Negotiate supplier pricing, payment terms, delivery schedules, warranties, and contractual conditions.
* Manage supplier relationships, onboarding, credit accounts, performance, and compliance requirements.
* Monitor purchasing budgets, committed spending, equipment deliveries, and opportunities for cost savings.
* Maintain procurement records, contracts, purchasing trackers, and supplier documentation.
* Coordinate with Finance and Legal on payment issues, contract changes, supplier disputes, and purchasing approvals.
* Identify supply chain risks and resolve procurement issues that could affect construction schedules or facility operations.

**Requirements**

What You’ll Need

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Procurement, Construction Management, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field, or equivalent relevant professional experience.
* Minimum 5 years of experience in procurement, strategic sourcing, construction procurement, or a related field.
* Experience supporting purchasing activities in construction, industrial, infrastructure, or other complex project environments.
* Strong knowledge of competitive bidding, supplier negotiations, purchase orders, and contract administration.
* Ability to review technical specifications, construction drawings, scopes of work, and supplier proposals.
* Experience managing suppliers, purchasing budgets, delivery schedules, and procurement documentation.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and experience with ERP or procurement management systems.
* Strong communication, negotiation, organizational, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities.

**We recognize that experience and skills can come from different paths. Relevant professional, hands-on, educational, military, trade, and industry experience may all provide the skills and knowledge needed to succeed at DataOne.**

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience supporting procurement for data centers, critical infrastructure, or large-scale construction projects.
* Experience purchasing Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing (MEP) equipment and construction packages.
* Knowledge of U.S. construction suppliers, subcontractors, and equipment manufacturers.
* Experience managing long-lead equipment and complex delivery schedules.
* Professional procurement or supply chain certification, such as CPSM, CPM, CIPS, or equivalent.

What to Expect

* Full-time, on-site position at DataOne's Vineland facility.
* Work in an active data center construction and operating environment, including occasional site walkthroughs.
* Occasional domestic or international travel and schedule flexibility based on project needs.
* Adherence to site safety requirements, including applicable Personal Protective Equipment (PPE).

Physical Requirements

Primarily office-based work involving prolonged sitting and computer use, with occasional standing, walking, climbing stairs, and accessing construction or operational areas. Site visits may involve noise, dust, moving equipment, and varying temperatures.

**Benefits**

What We Offer

* Medical, dental, and vision coverage
* 401(k) retirement plan with company match up to 3%
* PTO
* Annual performance-based bonus opportunity
* Company equity opportunity for eligible positio

description:
**Amp Up Your Career**

We are seeking a **Regional Sourcing Manager** who is ready to join an organization that combines passion and performance to shape a better world. As a **Global Top Employer 2026**, Amplifon is a place where your expertise improves lives and accelerates your career.

In this role, you will support and lead regional indirect procurement initiatives across multiple categories, partnering closely with internal stakeholders and external suppliers to drive value, efficiency, and cost savings. You will report to the Global Procurement Director and act as a trusted advisor across the organization.

**Compensation:** Based on qualifications we anticipate the hiring range will be **$125,000-$145,000** in addition toan annual incentive.

**Hybrid Work:** We require team members to be in our downtown Minneapolis office three days per week, offering flexibility while fostering in-person collaboration.

**Benefits Offered:**

* **Health & Financial:** Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k) with company match, family hearing aid benefits, and tuition reimbursement.
* **Work-life Balance:** Generous vacation, safe and sick leave, paid holidays, paid volunteer time off, parental leave and bereavement.
* **Well-being:** Access to our Wellness Hub and Employee Assistance Program (EAP), providing holistic support for you and your family.
* **Career Development:** Access to Ampli-Academy, LinkedIn Learning, Coursera, team training, and additional specialized training.
* **Commuter Support:** Reimbursement for transportation (parking downtown, bus or train).

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Strategic Sourcing & Cost Management**

* Support end-to-end sourcing activities, including supplier selection, sourcing events, negotiations, and contract execution across indirect spend categories
* Partner cross-functionally to identify, negotiate, and execute cost-saving and value-driving initiatives

**Stakeholder & Supplier Partnership**

* Act as a trusted procurement advisor leading projects across multiple functions and, at times, geographies
* Build and maintain strong supplier relationships to maximize partnership value and performance

**Procurement Operations & Continuous Improvement**

* Track and analyze procurement KPIs to recommend and implement process improvements that increase efficiency

**Must-Have Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in business, supply chain, finance, or a related field
* 5+ years of procurement experience, preferably supporting direct or indirect categories (e.g., Marketing, IT, HR, Facilities)
* Working knowledge of procure-to-pay processes, sourcing methodology, and contract fundamentals
* Experience using a source-to-pay system such as Oracle, SAP, or Coupa

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience partnering with Legal to review and redline commercial contract terms
* Strong communication and influencing skills with the ability to work across functions
* Demonstrated sense of ownership with a proactive, results-oriented approach
* Continuous improvement mindset and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment

Amplifon is the global leader in the hearing care retail market, empowering people to rediscover all the emotions of sound. With a presence in 25 countries and 20,300 employees worldwide, we are a team of diverse, innovative talent dedicated to improving lives through customer experience.

**Amplifon Americas**, headquartered in Minneapolis, MN, supports **Amplifon Canada**, **Amplifon Hearing Health Care**, **GAES**, and **Miracle-Ear** bridging retail and insurance industries to provide comprehensive hearing well-being across Canada, LATAM, and the United States.

*Please note that AI tools may be used to assist in resume screening. All hiring decisions are made by our recruitment team.*

*We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. If selected for an interview, please advise our Human Resources team if you require accommodation during the interview and assessment process and we will work with you to meet your accessibility needs.*

*Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis without the need for current or future sponsorship. This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship, including but not limited to OPT, CPT, or H-1B.*

**Overview:**
In this role, the candidate will oversee the procurement process, securing cost-effective goods, equipment, and services while managing vendor relationships and supervising the buying team. CentiMark operates under a hybrid sourcing platform, where corporate contracts and partnerships represent 70% of the company's annual spend, with the remaining balance sourced locally across our 100 field locations. The commercial roofing industry is well structured, with numerous industry resources available, such as the NRCA and Roofing Alliance.

You will manage a team of buyers and utilize our ERP system (SAP) to analyze all aspects of our spend. We maintain an online internal catalog that provides quick access for field associates while allowing corporate purchasing to adjust pricing immediately. This role is a key component for our field associates, and daily communications take place not only with our suppliers, but inter company personnel as well.

The right candidate will have significant opportunities for advancement and a long-term career at CentiMark.

**This role offers a salary of $90k, premier benefits and annual bonus opportunity.**

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Strategy & Sourcing: Create and implement effective procurement plans that cut costs and reduce supply chain risks.
* Vendor Management: Research, select, and evaluate suppliers based on price, quality, and delivery speed.
* Negotiation: Negotiate pricing, bulk discounts, rebates, and contract terms with suppliers.
* Warranty: Ensure the best possible warranties are in place for all sourced goods.
* Inventory Control: Monitor stock levels and forecast future demand to prevent shortages or excess waste.
* Team Leadership: Supervise, mentor, and lead the buying team.

**Required Skills & Qualifications:**

* Education: **Bachelor's degree in business, supply chain management, finance, or a related field.**
* Experience: **5+ years proven work history in purchasing or procurement.**

**Job Title**

***Sourcing Specialist***

**Employment Status:**

Full-Time

**FLSA Status:**

Exempt

**Department:**

Production Control

**Location:**

Manufacturing

Ridgeland, SC

**Job Summary**

The Sourcing Specialist independently manages assigned sourcing projects with an emphasis on identifying competitive suppliers, reducing material costs, and maintaining or improving quality. This position evaluates supplier capabilities, negotiates commercial terms, supports supplier qualification, and works cross-functionally to implement new sourcing opportunities.

**Duties and Responsibilities**

* Independently identifies and evaluates new suppliers capable of meeting or exceeding TICO’s quality, cost, delivery, and technical requirements.
* Leads assigned sourcing projects focused on cost reduction and supplier development.
* Works closely with Purchasing to identify materials and components where alternative sourcing may improve cost, quality, lead time, or supply availability.
* Conducts detailed supplier comparisons, including pricing, quality, capacity, lead times, technical capabilities, and overall value.
* Negotiates pricing and commercial terms with prospective and existing suppliers within established authority.
* Develops supplier recommendations and presents sourcing alternatives to the Sourcing Manager and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Partners with Engineering and Quality to evaluate and qualify alternative materials, components, and suppliers.
* Coordinates supplier samples, first articles, testing, and validation activities as required.
* Supports supplier transitions and implementation of new sources.
* Identifies, documents, and tracks cost-reduction opportunities and savings.
* Conducts market research and monitors supplier and commodity trends.
* Develops and maintains relationships with current and prospective suppliers.
* Assists with supplier performance reviews and corrective action initiatives.
* Provides guidance and knowledge-sharing to Sourcing Specialist 1 employees.
* May lead cross-functional sourcing projects.
* Performs other duties as assigned.

**Required Skills & Abilities**

* Strong sourcing, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Proven ability to research, evaluate, and compare suppliers.
* Strong negotiation and communication skills.
* Strong understanding of supplier pricing, cost structures, and commercial terms.
* Ability to develop and maintain effective supplier relationships.
* Ability to independently manage multiple projects and meet deadlines.
* Strong organizational and project management skills.
* Ability to analyze data and develop sourcing recommendations.
* Ability to effectively communicate with Engineering, Quality, Purchasing, Manufacturing, and other internal departments.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and ERP/MRP systems.
* Ability to understand technical specifications, drawings, and quality requirements.

**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, Procurement, Operations, or a related field preferred.
* 3–5 years of experience in sourcing, procurement, supply chain, manufacturing, or a related field preferred.
* Experience with supplier negotiations and cost-reduction initiatives required.
* Manufacturing or automotive/industrial sourcing experience preferred.

**Working conditions**

* This position primarily operates in an office environment but may also require work in warehouse settings.
* Travel may be required to visit manufacturing facilities, suppliers, or customer sites as necessary to support quality initiatives and resolve issues.
* PPE is required per company procedures and includes safety shoes, safety glasses and safety vest.

**Physical requirements**

Work is primarily performed in an office setting, requiring prolonged sitting, computer use, and occasional lifting of up to 20 pounds.

***This job description is intended as a general guide to the job duties for this position. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as an exhaustive summary of all responsibilities, duties and efforts required of employees assigned to this job position. At the discretion of management, this description may be changed at any time to address the evolving needs of TICO Manufacturing.***

***We offer a comprehensive benefits package to our employees and their families that includes health, dental, vision, disability and life insurance. 401K, vacation and paid holidays. TICO is a Drug-Free Workplace***

**Company Description**

The Audio Business Division of Electro-Voice Dynacord LLC is headquartered in Burnsville, Minnesota. Our product segments include Critical Communications Systems, Pro Sound, and Public Address & Conferencing. With our premium brands: **Dynacord, Electro-Voice, RTS and Telex**, we are committed to delivering innovative solutions that shape the future of sound.

At KEENFINITY, we are a globally leading provider of innovative and professional security and communication solutions. With over 4,200 employees in over 50 countries worldwide, our ambition is clear: we offer more than just technology – we secure, connect, and amplify the moments that matter in life.

Next to our passion for technology we’re very passionate about our work environment. Based on values such as trust, appreciation, and accountability we all work together to shape the future – boldly, customer-focused and with a strong team spirit.

**Job Description**

The Senior Procurement Manager is responsible for managing the procurement buyers and strategic sourcing processes within the group. This includes:

* Responsible for overall within the BU segment for procurement activities including sourcing, supplier performance management, NPI’s, strategic suppliers development.
* Supplier strategy execution including strategic supplier framework, supplier base optimization, business and supplier roadmap alignment.
* Driving NPI and awarding management, ensuring awarding on-time and on cost target and strategic supplier utilization coverage.
* Driving team performance to reach to cost savings and cash flow targets.
* Process and productivity optimization, lead the team to improve working efficiency by process optimization and digital procurement solution towards benchmark level.
* Purchasing representative for the assigned respective Business Segment within Audio.
* Target and functional management of all procurement buyers under responsibility.
* Establish targets, priorities and deadlines for team members.
* Professional development of the team under responsibility.
* Ensures the procurement targets are defined and met for Business Segment under responsibility.
* Cross-project prioritization and coordination of procurement issues under responsibility.
* Approval of business awards for projects developed under the assigned Product Area.
* Alignment with other procurement leaders / supply chain leaders and BU stakeholders on prioritization and coordination of procurement issues.
* Ensures supplier selection is according to procurement supplier strategy.

**Qualifications**

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in a related field is required.
* Minimum of 5 years purchasing, strategic procurement/commodity management and/or materials management experience.
* Minimum of 5 years experience in sourcing in the areas of mechanical components, electronic and electro-mechanical components, contract manufacturing, loud speaker and various acoustic components, packaging and hardware along with some technical knowledge within a given spends category.
* Experience developing global supplier relationships and managing global supplier negotations.

job_title: Aerospace Parts Procurement Specialist (Remote, Hourly, Part-Time to Full-Time)
description:
**About Green Taxi Aerospace**

Green Taxi Aerospace (GTA) is a Plano, Texas aerospace company developing an electric taxi (eTaxi) system for the Embraer E-175 regional jet. The eTaxi system lets aircraft taxi on electric power without running the main engines, reducing fuel burn, emissions, and noise on the ground. We are a small, fast-moving engineering team working with aerospace suppliers across the United States and internationally.

**Job Summary**

Green Taxi Aerospace is hiring a remote Aerospace Parts Procurement Specialist on an hourly basis to own supplier follow-through and component procurement for our eTaxi program. In this role you will source, quote, order, and track electrical and mechanical components, keep every supplier moving, and manage delivery timelines so engineering is never waiting on parts.

This position starts part-time with the potential to become full-time depending on capability. If you prove you can run aerospace procurement end to end and keep a large supplier base in play, the role can grow with you.

**Responsibilities**

* **Supplier follow-through:** Chase quotes, specifications, samples, and open orders with suppliers so nothing sits idle. Escalate, re-engage, and find alternate sources when a supplier goes quiet.
* **Component procurement:** Source and purchase electrical and mechanical parts for the eTaxi system, including motors, power electronics, controllers, cooling system components, power supplies, cables, connectors, harness hardware, fasteners, and machined parts.
* **Delivery timeline management:** Build and maintain a procurement tracker with lead times, order status, and expected delivery dates. Flag schedule risk early and drive recovery plans.
* **RFQ and quote management:** Prepare and send RFQs, compare supplier quotes on price, lead time, and quality, and recommend sourcing decisions.
* **Supplier onboarding and documentation:** Coordinate NDAs, supplier forms, certifications, and quality documentation with suppliers and the GTA team.
* **Tech-demo logistics:** Coordinate parts, shipping, receiving, and delivery timing to support technology demonstrations and test events so hardware arrives where and when it is needed.
* **Status reporting:** Provide clear, regular procurement status updates to the Operations Manager and CEO.

**Qualifications**

* Proven experience in aerospace procurement, purchasing, supply chain, or supplier management.
* Existing aerospace supplier connections and the ability to open doors with aerospace component vendors, machine shops, and distributors.
* Working knowledge of electrical and mechanical components, part numbers, datasheets, drawings, and bills of materials.
* Strong follow-up discipline. You keep many suppliers in play at once and do not let requests sit unanswered.
* Experience managing lead times, delivery schedules, and order tracking.
* Clear written and verbal communication in English.
* Comfortable working remotely and asynchronously with a US Central Time team.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Familiarity with aerospace quality and compliance standards such as AS9100, FAA requirements, and export control (ITAR/EAR).
* Experience supporting prototypes, test programs, or technology demonstrations.

**Job Details**

* **Location:** 100% remote.
* **Employment type:** Hourly, part-time to start, potentially full-time depending on capability and performance.
* **Compensation:** Hourly rate based on experience.
* **Start date:** Immediately.

**How to Apply**

Apply on Indeed with your resume and a short cover note covering: (1) your aerospace procurement experience, (2) supplier relationships you have built and how you keep suppliers accountable to delivery timelines, (3) the types of electrical and mechanical components you have sourced, and (4) your weekly availability and desired hourly rate.

Pay: $10.00 - $15.00 per hour

Expected hours: No less than 10.0 per week

Work Location: Remote

Within FFDG, the Finance Division provides safe, efficient, effective financial operations in support of the Laboratory's high-energy physics program in accordance with all laws, regulations, and DOE requirements. Within the section, the Procurement Department is responsible for acquiring goods and services for the entire Laboratory. It provides helpful, professional support for all procurement requirements from the development of initial plans and requirements to subcontract closeout.

This **Procurement Specialist** role requires a strategic thinker with an acute understanding of the market, suppliers, and products to ensure that goods and services are procured at the best possible terms for Fermi Forward. These responsibilities are accomplished in cooperation with internal customers, FRA project teams, support personnel, subcontractors, and DOE, in accordance with established procurement policies and procedures, contract law, commercial practice, and applicable federal procurement regulations.

This role will execute on known or anticipated opportunities in the acquisition of constructions services while contributing to cost savings, partnerships with suppliers and other value-added activities to support the work of the Laboratory.

**What your day-to-day as a Procurement Specialist IV at Fermilab will look like:**

* Serve as a procurement subject matter expert in area of capital construction, architect and engineering (A/E), and special projects.
* Performs subcontract administration and ensures the completeness, organization, and accuracy of the subcontract file in compliance with subcontract terms and conditions, including timely delivery of goods and services, Buy American Act, Service Contract Act, Davis Bacon Act, workplace safety, insurance, payment, socio-economic provisions, and others as appropriate.
* Solicits request for proposals for highly complex subcontracting requirements, determines responsiveness of subcontractors to solicitation requirements, evaluates proposals, selects qualified potential subcontractors, conducts price and cost analysis, negotiates subcontract terms and conditions, draft contractual instruments, obtains approvals, and awards procurements.
* Plans and develops subcontracting requirements with internal Laboratory customers.
* Support FFDG compliance and self-assessment activities.
* Support audits and assessments, contractor procurement system reviews; collaborate with the DOE Fermi Site Office (FSO); ensure team compliance with the prime contract and applicable acquisition regulations; contribute to and support Procurement metrics gathering and reporting.

**Skills and Attributes for Success:**

* A Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, English, Communications or relevant experience as a sourcing or procurement professional or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* 9 years of procurement experience.
* Understanding and administration of the Buy American Act, Service Contract Act, Davis Bacon Act, workplace safety, insurance, payment, socio-economic provisions.
* Experience with major construction procurement awards, Cost Reimbursable, Time & Material agreements as well as IDIQs/BOAs is preferred.
* Proven ability to plan, develop, negotiate, administer and close large, complex, high dollar value subcontracts.
* Experience with electronic word processing, spreadsheets, document sharing systems, mail and other common office tools.
* Experience working in a matrixed project team environment.

**Applicable Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Required:**

* Experience with federal contracting, particularly with the Department of Energy (DOE) and working knowledge of Federal Acquisition Regulations (FAR).
* Professional Certifications as Certified Procurement Manager (CPM), Certified Federal Contract Manager (CFCM), Certified Professional Contracts Manager (CPCM) or Master’s Degree in Business / MBA preferred.

* Ability to abide by all environment, safety and health regulations.

Overview:

The Senior Purchasing Manager is responsible for overseeing all purchasing process functions for Mastec Renewables. Develops, improves, and maintains processes and systems utilized by the company while coordinating with stakeholders to ensure procurement activities are effective. Understands the life cycle of procurement activities and assists in processes throughout. Provides technical support and assistance to strategic sourcing and purchasing teams. Develop systems and reports that support procurement’s key performance indicator efforts. This position collaborates closely with internal teams, suppliers, and vendors, while maintaining high standards of compliance, efficiency, and continuous improvement.

**Location:** This position can be located at any of our office locations: Phoenix, AZ; Clinton, IN; Indianapolis, IN; Centennial, CO; Irving, TX; or Fargo, ND. Based on the experience and skillset of the individual identified, we are open to a remote-based role with ability to travel to our office and field site locations to support events or department activities.

**Company Overview**

MasTec Renewables, comprised of Wanzek Construction, IEA Constructors, and White Construction, combines over 20 years of experience in renewable energy construction. Depending on your position and project, you may work for one or more of our companies over your career with us. Join one of the largest construction firms in the country (Engineering News-Record [ENR]: #1 in Power, #17 Top 50 Domestic Heavy Contractors, #20 Transportation Contractor).

We embrace diverse perspectives among our employees and across all levels of our business, including our suppliers, community partners, and clients. We have built a multidimensional workforce that brings valuable differences in perspectives, work ethics, and approaches to our organization. By collaborating across departments, we foster innovation and encourage everyone—from interns to executives—to share their ideas and make an impact. Our goal is to create a respectful work environment where all employees feel valued, included, and empowered to become innovative leaders in our industry.

The MasTec Renewables market sector is part of the MasTec Clean Energy & Infrastructure (CE&I) business segment. The CE&I segment generates over $4.5 billion in annual revenue, providing construction services across our renewables, industrial, infrastructure, and general building operating groups. Sustainability and safety are foundational to our culture and influence everything we do.

MasTec, a minority-owned Fortune 500 company, has shaped the construction industry for more than 90 years. With over 35,000 employees and 400 offices nationwide, we provide flexibility and career growth in dynamic work environments. Join one of the largest construction firms in the country (Engineering News-Record [ENR]: #1 in Power, #16 Top 50 Domestic Heavy Contractors, #13 Transportation Contractor).

Responsibilities:

**Essential Job Functions:**

* Lead and mentor the Field Purchasing Manager and Category Buyers, ensuring effective execution of procurement processes
* Conduct regular performance reviews, provide coaching, and foster professional development opportunities within the team
* Ensure the Procurement team is well-supported and equipped to meet organizational objectives
* Develop and implement effective procurement strategies that align with the company’s business objectives and growth goals
* Drive and enforce document control efforts to ensure all purchase orders, approvals, and supporting documents are correctly saved in Procore
* Ensure the repository of company negotiated agreements including master vendor agreements is maintained
* Coordinate with company stakeholders related to updates to master templates standard procedures and agreements and ensure that procurement is informed of these updates
* Ensure all procurement activities comply with company policies, industry regulations, and legal requirements
* Provide contract negotiation guidance to buyers utilizing structured company guidelines
* Provide direction on proper contract formats to utilize for the requested scope of work
* Work closely with Compliance and Legal teams to review and maintain contracts, purchase orders, and other procurement-related documentation
* Identify and mitigate risks related to procurement, ensuring continuity of supply and operational success
* Continuously evaluate and improve procurement processes to increase efficiency and effectiveness across all areas of procurement
* Work with IT teams to implement procurement software and tools that streamline operations and enhance business continuity
* Ensure accurate tracking and reporting of procurement activities, including purchase orders, invoices, and inventory levels
* Collaborate with other departments (e.g., Finance, Operations, Compliance, HR, and IT) to ensure seamless procurement processes
* Provide clear communication and regular updat

Applicant must be a US citizen

**Role and Responsibilities**

· Review reports on the status of open purchase orders, vendor performance and related topics.

· Obtain updates on vendor delivery schedules and follow up on shipping issues.

· Communicate projected delivery time frames to the Production Manager for any items relating to production.

· Alert the Production Manager of any unforeseen delays in receipt of product.

· Update procedures for the department.

The Strategic Purchasing Manager is responsible for developing and executing purchasing and sourcing strategies that support both Speedway Motorsports’ retail merchandise business and race car manufacturing operations. This role manages supplier relationships, purchasing strategy, inventory planning, category performance, and procurement analytics to ensure products and components are available at the right cost, quality, and time.

This position serves as the primary purchasing partner for the retail merchandising and manufacturing teams, working across the organization to improve supplier performance, reduce costs, strengthen inventory planning, and support uninterrupted operations. The Strategic Purchasing Manager will have the opportunity to take ownership of purchasing processes, identify opportunities for improvement, and help build a more strategic and data-driven approach to how the organization buys.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Develop and execute sourcing strategies for souvenir merchandise, licensed products, apparel, race car components, manufacturing materials, and related products.

* Identify opportunities to consolidate suppliers, improve purchasing leverage, reduce total cost, and mitigate supply chain risk.
* Establish and maintain strong relationships with domestic and international suppliers while developing alternate sourcing strategies for critical products.

### **Category & Inventory Management**

* Manage assigned product categories through demand forecasting, inventory planning, lifecycle management, and purchasing execution.
* Analyze sales trends, production schedules, inventory levels, and business forecasts to develop purchasing plans.
* Ensure merchandise availability for Speedway events while maintaining healthy inventory turns and minimizing obsolete inventory.
* Coordinate material purchases to support race car manufacturing schedules and customer demand.

### **Procurement Analytics & Business Improvement**

* Develop reporting and dashboards that measure purchasing performance, supplier effectiveness, inventory health, spending trends, and cost savings.
* Analyze supplier spend, purchase price variance, freight expense, gross margin, inventory turns, and forecast accuracy.
* Recommend process improvements, inventory optimization strategies, sourcing initiatives, and cost-reduction opportunities supported by business data.
* Present recommendations and key performance metrics to leadership.

* Partner with Retail, Manufacturing, Engineering, Finance, Operations, Warehouse, and Sales teams to align purchasing decisions with organizational priorities.

* Strong analytical skills with advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and ERP systems.
