description:
**COMPANY OVERVIEW:**

Founded in 1953 Avtron has a long history of manufacturing market leading power test solutions. Now with a global footprint and sales into some of the largest industrial projects, Avtron will continue to push the envelope of what’s possible in the electrical test environment. Avtron Power Solutions manufacture and distribute market leading load bank solutions for mission critical applications. We have the largest portfolio in the industry and can meet the highest load testing standards with our intelligent SIGMA load bank control system.

**POSITION SUMMARY:**

The Global Sourcing Lead is responsible for leading sourcing efforts to drive cost savings within design, supplier processes, and value engineering (VAVE). This role focuses on identifying and implementing strategies to reduce procurement costs while maintaining quality and supply chain efficiency. The Global Sourcing Lead will lead supplier engineering requests in support of quoting and act as the liaison between engineering, sourcing, and Avtron suppliers to ensure a shared understanding of technical specifications, design, best-cost pricing, lead times, and terms. This role will serve as the primary supply chain point of contact for all New Product Development (NPD) procurement discussions involving design engineering, sourcing, supplier selection, cost negotiation, and product launch. Additionally, this role will lead efforts to identify alternative sourcing options for obsolete, out-of-stock, and single-sourced materials in support of production. The Global Sourcing Lead will work closely with cross-functional teams to optimize material costs, streamline processes, improve supplier relationships, and accelerate customer engagement.

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Essential Functions:**

* Leads design engineering feedback and support on cost savings efforts and acts as the sourcing point of contact for associated supplier bids, competitive negotiations, analysis, and PO coordination with the purchasing team
* Acts as the central POC to identify alternative sourcing options for obsolete, out-of-stock, and single-sourced materials in support of production
* Provides direction regarding print and design review, technical publication interpretation, appropriate source selection in coordination with Global Sourcing, and price/terms negotiation for new products
* Provides thorough sourcing analysis and on-site engineering support for supplier on-boarding, VAVE reviews, quality issues, production launch meetings, etc.
* Manages the supply chain for NPD projects and purchased BOM components from quote through FAI approval
* Involves suppliers early in design stages to optimize design and reduce cost throughout the NPD process
* Determines and communicates expected lead times and schedules to support production launch and/or cost savings targets. Develops schedules with critical milestones to track and broadcast progress within project team updates
* Monitors short and long-term material requirements needs, develops and implements effective plans to assure material availability and capacity at selected supplier for NPD projects
* Maintains product costs within established goals for each component and overall BOM
* Maintains an in-depth working knowledge of computerized manufacturing systems: SAP, MRP, Bill of Material structure, Kanban, JIT and Lean Manufacturing concepts
* Actively works to develop new qualified and cost effect sources of supply when a new service, process or component is identified. This also applies to new strategic low-cost country initiatives gaining support and buy-in from Global Sourcing, Site Supply Chain Leaders, and Engineering
* Ensures all purchased components on NPD BOMs are loaded correctly in SAP
* Takes a proactive role in continuous improvement of SAP and maintaining data integrity and parameters
* Manage approval process for new suppliers through the NPD process and cost savings initiatives

**EDUCATION, SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:**

**Education:**

* BS in Business or Engineering.

**Skills**

* Ability to multi-task, handling quick turnaround
* Ability to identify problem issues and escalate and/or execute acceptable solutions
* Possess strong interpersonal skills and the ability to work with customers, suppliers and employees/managers at all levels within the company
* Excellent organizational skills
* Ability to maintain safe work environment

**Experience**

* Minimum of 5-7 years’ progressive experience in engineering with procurement, sourcing, operations, and/or finance experience within manufacturing operations
* Understanding of Supply Chain Management best practices
* Advanced user of SAP, Excel, power point and databases
* Advanced analytical and presentations skills required
* Experience in ERP systems, SAP desired

.

**COMPUTER SKILLS:**

* Possesses strong computer skills with demonstrated proficiency in standard business software packages (e.g., Microsoft Office)

**LOCAL ATTRACT

The Procurement Manager is responsible for developing and executing sourcing and procurement strategies that ensure the organization obtains high-quality goods and services at competitive prices while maintaining compliance with company policies and AS9100D requirements. This role manages supplier relationships, negotiates contracts, drives cost savings initiatives, and collaborates with internal stakeholders to support operational and business objectives.

The successful candidate will lead and manage the procurement department, including all purchasing, inventory & logistics employees and facilitate communication and collaboration with all other departments within the company. As the main point of contact for all program managers, engineering, and manufacturing teams, the main goal is to maintain optimal inventory levels, support on-time program delivery, and uphold the highest standards of supply chain performance. This position requires strong communication skills, ability to delegate responsibilities to all junior staff. This role requires excellent analytical capabilities and a solid understanding of procurement, inventory control, and logistics processes.

**Strategic Procurement**

* Develop and implement procurement strategies aligned with organizational goals.
* Analyze spending patterns and identify opportunities for cost savings and process improvements.
* Establish sourcing plans to support current and future business requirements.
* Monitor market trends, pricing, and supplier capabilities.

**Supplier Management**

* Identify, evaluate, qualify, and manage suppliers and vendors.
* Build and maintain strong supplier relationships to ensure quality, delivery, and service expectations are met.
* Conduct supplier performance reviews and corrective action initiatives when necessary.
* Mitigate supply chain risks through contingency planning and supplier diversification.

**Contract Negotiation & Administration**

* Lead negotiations for pricing, terms, conditions, and service level agreements.
* Prepare, review, and administer contracts and purchase agreements.
* Ensure contractual compliance and manage contract renewals.
* Assist PMs with manhours and cost for bid & proposal purposes on items related to procurement & logistics.

**Purchasing Operations**

* Oversee purchasing processes from requisition through purchase order issuance and receipt.
* Ensure procurement activities comply with company policies, industry regulations, and ethical standards.
* Monitor inventory levels and coordinate with stakeholders to prevent shortages or excess inventory.

* Manage procurement budgets and spending controls.
* Track and report procurement metrics, savings, and supplier performance indicators.
* Support audits and maintain procurement documentation.
* Ensure compliance with applicable regulations, quality standards, and company policies.

* Lead, mentor, and develop all procurement, inventory, & logistics personnel.
* Establish performance goals and conduct employee evaluations.
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement and accountability.

**Job Location:** Redmond, WA

**Job Schedule:** 9/80: Employees work 9 out of every 14 days – totaling 80 hours worked – and have every other Friday off

**Job Description:**

We are seeking a strategic and execution-oriented Supply Chain Leader to build, optimize, and scale a high-performing supply chain organization across a growing multi-site aerospace manufacturing enterprise. This role will lead end-to-end supply chain operations including sourcing, procurement, planning and supplier development.

The ideal candidate brings deep aerospace or highly regulated manufacturing experience and has successfully stood up or transformed a modern, efficient supply chain organization in a complex operational environment. This leader will drive operational excellence, supplier performance, cost competitiveness, and scalable processes that support rapid growth, delivery performance, and customer satisfaction.

This position requires a hands-on leader who can balance strategic vision with tactical execution across multiple facilities and product lines.

The successful candidate will be a strategic yet hands-on leader with a strong operational mindset, capable of driving change in a fast-paced manufacturing environment. This individual should bring a track record of building efficient organizations, improving execution, and developing high-performing teams.

This is an opportunity to play a critical leadership role in shaping the future operations and scalability of a growing aerospace organization.

**Essential Functions:**

* Strategic Leadership
+ Develop and execute an enterprise-wide supply chain strategy aligned with company growth objectives, customer commitments, and operational priorities.
+ Build and lead a multi-site supply chain organization that is standardized, scalable, and performance-oriented.
+ Assess current-state processes, organizational structure, systems, and capabilities; design and implement a future-state operating model that improves efficiency, visibility, and accountability.
+ Lead procurement, strategic sourcing, planning, and supplier development across multiple sites
+ Serve as a key member of the senior leadership team, partnering closely with Operations, Program Management, Engineering, Quality, Finance, and Business Development.

+ Lead the stand-up, redesign, or transformation of the supply chain organization, including roles, responsibilities, governance, and process ownership.
+ Establish clear functional alignment across sourcing, procurement, planning, master scheduling, inventory control, logistics, and supplier management.
+ Drive standard work, common metrics, and integrated planning processes across all sites.
+ Build organizational capability through talent assessment, coaching, succession planning, and targeted hiring.

+ Lead strategic sourcing and procurement activities to ensure cost competitiveness, supply continuity, and strong supplier performance.
+ Develop supplier segmentation, risk management, and performance management processes to improve quality, delivery, responsiveness, and resilience.
+ Negotiate key supplier agreements and partnerships, including long-term agreements where appropriate.
+ Partner with Quality and Engineering to strengthen supplier qualification, development, and corrective action processes.

+ Improve material availability and on-time delivery while optimizing inventory, working capital, and lead times.
+ Drive cross-functional execution to resolve shortages, constraints, and capacity issues.
* Systems, Process, and Performance Improvement
+ Champion the use of ERP/MRP systems, analytics, and reporting tools to improve planning accuracy, material visibility, and decision-making.
+ Implement KPIs and management operating rhythms focused on on-time delivery, supplier quality, lead time, inventory turns, material availability, and cost performance.
+ Lead continuous improvement initiatives using Lean, Six Sigma, or similar operational excellence methodologies.
+ Ensure compliance with applicable aerospace, regulatory, contractual, and customer requirements.

* 12+ years of progressive supply chain leadership experience in aerospace, defense, or highly regulated manufacturing
* Experience leading end-to-end supply chain functions, including sourcing, procurement, planning, inventory management, logistics, and supplier performance.
* Strong track record of driving measurable improvements in on-time delivery, inventory performance, cost, supplier reliability, and process efficiency.
* Proven success building, transforming, or scaling supply chain organizations
* Demonstrated capability leading supply chain operations across multiple manufacturing sites

Cerro Wire LLC

As a part of the global industrial organization Marmon Holdings—which is backed by Berkshire Hathaway—you’ll be doing things that matter, leading at every level, and winning a better way. We’re committed to making a positive impact on the world, providing you with diverse learning and working opportunities, and fostering a culture where everyone’s empowered to be their best.

Summary Description of Position

The MRO Buyer is responsible for sourcing, purchasing, and managing inventory of maintenance, repair, and operating supplies required to support plant operations. This position ensures timely procurement of materials, equipment, parts, and services while maintaining cost effectiveness, quality standards, and vendor relationships. The MRO Buyer works closely with Maintenance, Operations, Engineering, and Finance teams to support production uptime and continuous improvement initiatives. This position reports directly to the Maintenance Manager.

**Major Responsibility Areas and Duties**
=========================================

* Source and purchase MRO materials, parts, equipment, and services to support facility and production operations.
* Process purchase requisitions and issue purchase orders in accordance with company policies.
* Obtain competitive quotes and negotiate pricing, delivery schedules, and service agreements with suppliers.
* Monitor open purchase orders and proactively follow up on overdue shipments.
* Expedite critical materials to minimize equipment downtime and production interruptions.
* Ensure purchased items meet quality, technical, and operational requirements.
* Maintain appropriate inventory levels of maintenance spare parts and consumable supplies.
* Monitor usage trends and adjust stocking levels to optimize inventory investment.

**Job Title: Purchasing Manager**
**Department: Procurement / Supply Chain**

**Position Summary**

The Purchasing Manager is responsible for managing the company’s purchasing activities, supplier relationships, inventory requirements, and procurement processes. This position ensures that materials, products, equipment, and services are purchased at the best possible quality, cost, and terms while supporting operational needs and maintaining appropriate inventory levels.

The ideal candidate is a strategic and organized professional with strong negotiation skills, sound business judgment, and experience managing vendors and purchasing processes.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Develop and implement purchasing strategies aligned with company goals and operational requirements.
* Identify, evaluate, and select reliable suppliers and vendors.
* Negotiate pricing, contracts, payment terms, delivery schedules, and other purchasing agreements.
* Maintain strong relationships with key suppliers and monitor vendor performance.
* Review purchase requisitions and approve purchase orders in accordance with company policies.
* Monitor inventory levels and coordinate purchasing activities to prevent shortages or excess inventory.
* Analyze purchasing trends, pricing, and market conditions to identify cost-saving opportunities.
* Obtain and evaluate competitive bids and quotes when appropriate.
* Ensure purchased goods and services meet established quality, quantity, and specification requirements.
* Track orders and follow up with suppliers regarding delivery schedules, shortages, damaged goods, or other issues.
* Work closely with Operations, Finance, Warehouse, Sales, and other departments to forecast purchasing needs.
* Maintain accurate purchasing records, vendor information, contracts, and pricing data.
* Monitor and report key purchasing metrics, including spend, savings, supplier performance, and inventory-related costs.
* Develop and maintain purchasing policies, procedures, and internal controls.
* Identify opportunities to improve procurement efficiency and reduce overall costs.
* Ensure purchasing activities comply with company policies, contractual requirements, and applicable regulations.
* Manage and develop purchasing staff, as applicable.
* Resolves grievances with vendors, contractors, and suppliers; assess, manage, and mitigate risks
* Perform other duties and special projects as assigned.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Mechanical Engineering or a related field preferred.
* **5+ years of purchasing, procurement, or supply chain experience**, with management or supervisory experience preferred.
* Strong negotiation, communication, and vendor-management skills.
* Demonstrated ability to analyze pricing, costs, and purchasing data.
* Experience with purchasing or ERP systems.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
* Strong attention to detail and problem-solving abilities.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.
* Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in manufacturing industry.
* Experience managing low and high-volume purchasing and multiple suppliers.
* Knowledge of inventory management and demand forecasting.
* Experience with contract negotiations and strategic sourcing.

**Key Performance Indicators**

Success in this role may be measured by:

* Purchasing cost savings and cost avoidance
* Supplier performance and reliability
* On-time delivery
* Inventory accuracy and availability
* Purchase order accuracy
* Reduction of excess or obsolete inventory
* Supplier quality
* Compliance with purchasing policies
* Procurement process efficiency

**Core Competencies**

Strategic Procurement; Negotiation; Vendor Management; Cost Analysis; Inventory Management; Contract Management; Leadership & Team Development; Communication; Problem Solving; Data Analysis; Organization & Time Management; Business Judgment

**Work Environment and Physical Demands**

The work environment characteristics are primarily an office environment with interaction with employees in light manufacturing. The physical work environment is primarily sitting and working on desktop programs and files, but also includes standing, sitting, walking, bending, twisting, turning, pulling, carrying, fingering, grasping, and lifting up to 50 -60 pounds.

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Referral program
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

**Add Flavor to Your Career and Life – Explore New Opportunities at Lee Kum Kee!**

Ready to bring fresh ingredients to your career? At Lee Kum Kee, we’re committed to your growth, offering a place where creativity and innovation thrive. If you're eager to make an impact and advance your career, apply today and start adding flavor to your professional life!

**BENEFITS**

* Medical, Dental, and Life Insurance coverage
* 401(k) Retirement Plan through Principal
* Two (2) Weeks Vacation
* Ten (10) Paid Holidays
* Five (5) Sick Days
* Annual (1 Day) Birthday Time Off
* …And More!

**POSITION SUMMARY**

We are looking for a Procurement Manager to support the sourcing and commercial management of key food manufacturing inputs, including commodities, ingredients, oils, sweeteners, and proteins. this person will work closely with Operations, R&D, Quality, and Finance to help ensure materials and external manufacturing services meet cost, quality, safety, and delivery requirements.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**

* *Sourcing & Category Support*
+ Execute sourcing strategies for raw materials, including commodities, ingredients, oils, sweeteners, and proteins, in partnership with Procurement Leadership.
+ Support the development of category strategies aligned with cost, quality, service, and risk objectives.
+ Manage day-to-day purchasing activity for assigned categories and co-manufacturing/co-packing partners, escalating key decisions as appropriate.
* *Cost Analysis*

+ Build and maintain should-cost models by breaking down supplier cost drivers (raw materials, yields, labor, energy, freight, overhead, and margin).
+ Apply total cost of ownership (TCO) analysis to supplier selection and co-packer evaluations.
+ Use data-driven analysis to question pricing, identify cost-saving opportunities, and prepare supporting materials for negotiations.
* *Market Monitoring*

+ Track and report on market trends affecting commodities, ingredients, oils, sweeteners, and proteins.
+ Monitor commodity indices, supply/demand trends, inflationary pressures, and geopolitical or weather-related risks.
+ Summarize market insights and recommend sourcing, contract, and pricing approaches for management review.
* *Supplier & Co-Packer Management*

+ Support supplier and co-packer selection, RFQ/RFP processes, contracting, and performance reviews.
+ Participate in commercial negotiations covering price models, index-based pricing, capacity commitments, and SLAs, and lead negotiations on smaller or lower-risk agreements.
+ Assist with supplier development efforts and dual-sourcing initiatives to reduce supply risk.
+ Track supplier scorecards, delivery performance, and quality or service issues, and follow through on corrective actions.
* *Cross-Functional Partnership*

+ Collaborate with Operations, Planning, R&D, Quality, Finance, and Engineering to support production, innovation, and growth.
+ Support new product development and line extensions through early ingredient and co-packer engagement.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential function satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

**REQUIRED EDUCATION, SKILLS and EXPERIENCES**

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, or a related field.
* 3+ years of procurement or sourcing experience, preferably in food manufacturing or CPG.
* Exposure to sourcing commodities, ingredients, oils, sweeteners, or proteins.
* Experience with, or strong interest in, working with co-packers and co-manufacturers.
* Demonstrated ability to support supplier negotiations and cost improvement initiatives.
* Working knowledge of should-cost or cost breakdown analysis.
* Proficient in Excel (pivot tables, lookups, and basic modeling); ERP experience required (SAP preferred).
* Clear communicator, comfortable working cross-functionally.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced, changing environment.

**ABOUT THE COMPANY**

Founded in 1888, Lee Kum Kee, a Hong Kong-based global food company, specializes in creating condiments and sauces that promote Chinese cuisine worldwide. With more than 300 products to choose from, Lee Kum Kee takes the mystery out of cooking authentic and delicious Asian foods in the comfort of your kitchen. Lee Kum Kee is committed to providing authentic and innovative condiments and sauces featuring the highest quality ingredients. Armed with a unique management culture, stringent quality control, superb and innovative products, coupled with the century long brand reputation, Lee Kum Kee has achieved unanimous recognition and won numerous prestigious awards.

It is Lee Kum Kee’s policy to seek and employ the most qualified persons in all jobs in a manner which will ensure equal employment opportunity as

**About Carrier**

Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions, is committed to creating innovations that bring comfort, safety and sustainability to life. Through cutting-edge advancements in climate solutions such as temperature control, air quality and transportation, we improve lives, empower critical industries and ensure safe transport of food, lifesaving medicines and more. Since inventing modern air conditioning in 1902, we lead with purpose: enhancing the lives we live and the world we share. We continue to lead because of our world-class, inclusive workforce that puts the customer at the center of everything we do. For more information, visit corporate.carrier.com or follow on Carrier social media at @Carrier.

The Sourcing Manager, LTL Transportation is responsible for developing and executing sourcing strategies for Less-Than-Truckload transportation services across North America while leading logistics analytics transformation initiatives that improve transportation performance, cost, service, and productivity. This role combines category management responsibilities with advanced analytics leadership, supporting the organization's transition to AI-enabled and data-driven logistics decision making.

**Logistics Analytics & Digital Transformation**

* Lead logistics analytics initiatives that improve transportation visibility, service performance, and cost optimization.
* Develop transportation dashboards, KPI scorecards, predictive analytics models, and executive reporting tools.
* Partner with Digital and Technology teams to implement advanced analytics, automation, AI, and GenAI solutions across logistics operations.
* Translate transportation data into actionable recommendations that improve business performance.
* Develop long-term logistics analytics roadmaps aligned with supply chain objectives.
* Leverage freight spend, carrier, and network data to identify optimization opportunities.

**LTL Strategic Sourcing**

* Develop and execute LTL category strategies.
* Lead carrier RFQs, bid events and negotiations.
* Manage annual LTL sourcing processes.
* Develop routing guide strategies and carrier allocations.
* Continuously benchmark market rates and industry trends.

**Carrier Relationship Management**

* Manage national and regional carrier partnerships.
* Conduct quarterly business reviews.
* Drive carrier accountability through scorecards.
* Resolve service, capacity and performance issues.

**Freight Cost Optimization**

* Improve transportation productivity and savings.
* Analyze modal conversion opportunities.
* Support consolidation and network optimization initiatives.
* Increase freight density and utilization.

**Analytics & Performance Management**

* Monitor transportation KPIs.
* Analyze freight spend trends and lane performance.
* Create data-driven recommendations.
* Measure carrier performance and sourcing effectiveness.

**Risk & Capacity Management**

* Develop contingency plans.
* Monitor market conditions and fuel trends.
* Diversify carrier portfolio.
* Support business continuity planning.

### **Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Business, Engineering, Analytics
* 5+ years of experience in transportation sourcing, logistics, procurement, or supply chain.
* 3+ years experience leveraging analytics to drive business results.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Strong understanding of freight transportation and logistics operations.
* Experience developing dashboards, KPIs, and business intelligence reporting.
* Strong financial and analytical skills.
* Exceptional stakeholder management skills.
* Experience managing transportation spend exceeding 25M-50M.
* Power BI, Tableau, SQL, Python, or advanced analytics experience.
* GenAI or AI-enabled analytics experience.
* Transportation Management System (TMS) experience.
* Lean Six Sigma certification.
* Manufacturing or distribution environment experience.

**Pay Range**

The annual salary for this position is between $96,000.00 - $192,000.00 annually. Factors which may affect pay within this range include, but are not limited to, skills, education, experience, and other unique qualifications of the successful candidate. The pay range will not be below the minimum wage applicable to the jurisdiction in which the applicant is to be employed.

**Other Compensation**

This position is entitled to short-term cash incentives, subject to plan requirements.

**Benefits**

Employees are eligible for benefits, including:

* **Health Care Benefits**: Medical, Dental, Vision; Wellness incentives
* **Retirement Benefits**
* **Time off and Leave**: Paid vacation days, up to 15 days; paid sick days, up to 5 days; paid personal leave, up to 5 days; paid holidays, up to 13 days; birth and adoption leave; parental leave; family and medical leave; bereavement leave; jury duty leave; military leave; purchased vacation
* **Disability**: Short-term and long-term

**Our Company**

Guardian Worldwide, LLC is a leading provider in industrial PVF and Tank Container parts. Having enjoyed profound success in Europe and Asia for over 25 years, Guardian is set to elevate the bench mark for quality and cost-efficiency in the American industrial Stainless Steel markets.

**Job Duties**

* Establish procurement processes and sourcing reliable suppliers globally to meet the company’s needs.
* Negotiate contracts and managing vendor relationships to ensure favorable terms, while overseeing compliance with all contract stipulations.
* Coordinate purchasing activities to support company operations, including inventory management and the flow of goods within the supply chain.
* Maximize the use of NETSUITE systems to streamline procurement functions and enhance work process efficiency, ensuring smooth operations and data-driven decision-making.
* Collaborate with internal teams in the US and Asia to develop cost-effective procurement strategies that align with business objectives and support growth.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, industry regulations, and sustainability goals, including ethical sourcing and minimizing environmental impact.
* Track procurement expenses, identifying cost-saving opportunities through strategic sourcing and negotiations.
* Mitigate supply chain risks, identifying potential disruptions, and develop contingency plans to ensure continuity of supply and minimize costs.
* Utilizing data analytics to track supplier performance, purchasing trends, and operational efficiencies, providing insights to improve procurement strategies.
* Contribute to the company’s growth by optimizing procurement functions, ensuring the right materials are available to support product development, customer demand, and operational needs.

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: $50,000.00 - $80,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

**Company Overview**

RapidAir is a leading designer and manufacturer of branded compressed air solutions—including piping, fittings, filtration, and accessories—serving transportation, manufacturing, industrial, energy, agricultural, and consumer markets.

In 2024, Gryphon Investors acquired a controlling interest in RapidAir through the Heritage Fund, positioning the company for significant growth. Together, we’re expanding into new markets, strengthening customer relationships, and leveraging macro industrial trends to scale RapidAir’s leadership in the compressed air space.

**Position Overview**

RapidAir is seeking a Global Sourcing Manager to lead strategic sourcing initiatives across our growing domestic and international supplier network. Reporting directly to the Vice President of Procurement, this role will spearhead existing sourcing projects, identify new category and cost-saving opportunities, and bring greater structure and visibility to RapidAir’s spend profile. The Global Sourcing Manager will play a key role in strengthening supplier relationships, expanding our supply base, and developing sourcing strategies that support continued growth.

The ideal candidate brings strong experience in strategic sourcing, category management, and global supplier development, with the ability to operate independently in a growing, entrepreneurial environment. Industrial sourcing experience is highly preferred

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and execute global sourcing and category strategies aligned with business objectives.
* Lead existing strategic sourcing projects and identify new sourcing and cost-saving opportunities.
* Identify, evaluate, qualify, and develop domestic and international suppliers.
* Lead supplier negotiations related to pricing, commercial terms, lead times, and service levels.
* Analyze company spend and establish greater structure and visibility across spend categories.
* Evaluate supplier markets, cost drivers, risks, and sourcing alternatives to inform purchasing strategies.
* Build and strengthen strategic supplier relationships while identifying opportunities to diversify the supply base.
* Partner cross-functionally to understand future demand, product needs, and sourcing requirements.
* Develop sourcing strategies that balance cost, quality, availability, lead times, and supply continuity.
* Establish and track measurable results across cost savings, supplier performance, category spend, and other key sourcing metrics.

**Qualifications**

* 7+ years of progressive experience in strategic sourcing, procurement, category management, or global supply management.
* Demonstrated experience developing and executing sourcing and category strategies.
* Experience managing international suppliers and global sourcing relationships.
* Proven ability to identify and deliver measurable cost savings and supplier performance improvements.
* Strong analytical skills with experience evaluating spend, supplier data, and market information.
* Strong negotiation, supplier relationship management, and commercial decision-making skills.
* Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple sourcing initiatives, priorities, and stakeholders simultaneously.
* Proficiency in Excel and experience working with ERP systems; comfortable using data and reporting tools to analyze spend, evaluate opportunities, and support sourcing decisions.
* Ability to work independently, take ownership of strategic initiatives, and bring structure to a growing procurement function.
* Bachelor's degree in supply chain, Business, Operations, Finance, or a related field preferred.
* Industrial sourcing experience strongly preferred.

**What Success Looks Like**

Within the first year, the Global Sourcing Manager will have advanced key sourcing initiatives, identified and executed meaningful cost-saving opportunities, and established greater structure and visibility across RapidAir’s spend categories. This person will have strengthened the company’s domestic and international supplier network, identified new sourcing opportunities, and become a trusted strategic partner to Procurement and the broader leadership team.

RapidAir Products offers the opportunity to join a growing, market-leading platform backed by a premier private equity sponsor. This role provides meaningful ownership, visibility, and the opportunity to directly impact the company’s digital growth strategy.

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. Applicants are considered for all positions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, and sexual orientation, and ancestry, marital or veteran status. Diversity is valued and we will not tolerate discrimination or harassment in any form. Candidates for the position stated above are hired on an "at will" basis. description:
**Parker Hannifin**

At Parker Aerospace, we develop technologies and innovative solutions that enable reliable, efficient and increasingly sustainable flight for the lifecycle of the aircraft, including aftermarket support. Our passionate people with deep engineering expertise, together with our breadth of differentiated technologies, ensure that we make the extraordinary happen and continue to shape the future of aviation in partnership with our customers.

As a member of our team, you are instrumental in fulfilling our mission: 'Enabling Engineering Breakthroughs that Lead to a Better Tomorrow.' Pursuing a career at Parker presents unlimited opportunities for both professional and personal development. Working with some of the most brilliant minds in the industry, your contributions will be pivotal in developing innovative technologies and products, significantly contributing to Parker’s goal of addressing the world’s most pressing engineering challenges. At Parker, our team members belong, matter and make a difference.

**Position Summary**

Manages the direction and daily activities of the Divisions procurement of raw materials, castings, forgings, standard hardware, and machined components for production of the Divisions products. Responsible for embracing and driving lean enterprises systems throughout the procurement process. **This position requires regular on-site attendance.**

**Essential Functions**

* Plans and direct the activities of the Division's purchases of materials, castings, forgings, standard hardware, and machined components. Determines the most cost efficient and reliable sources of supply needed for the manufacturing process.
* Establishes preferred supplier selection criteria based on supplier evaluations of price, quality, delivery, certifications, and compliance with governmental procurement regulations. Promotes and uses strategic suppliers.
* Interviews, selects and negotiates with suppliers in response to material requirements/cost issues. Establishes procedures to leverage the company’s position. Ensures purchasing strategy reflects the consistent utilization of local suppliers vs. Group strategic suppliers.
* Works with suppliers to develop and manage continuous improvement programs, addressing quality, delivery, service as well as price.
* Develops standard/automated re-order procedures. Will develop crisis management and supplier backup contingency programs.
* Develops and benchmarks best practices among the Divisions suppliers and maintain accurate measurements and records for evaluation of suppliers.
* Drives strategies to grow margin expansion through deflation
* Conduct regular review of purchase price indexes to confirm variances.
* Develop and hire top talent to ensure long-term success of the department.

**Qualifications**

* **Minimum of 4-6 years purchasing/managerial experience.**
* Strong negotiation skills with experience in negotiating in a single source environment and long lead times (approx. 52 weeks).
* Understanding of aerospace machining and raw material markets to drive cost reduction.
* Support team members in LTA negotiations to ensure long term continuity of supply for the business.
* **Bachelor’s degree** in business, engineering, or materials management **required** with certification
in supply chain management preferred.
* Possess analytical and technical skills required to understand business practices and recommend proper automation opportunities.
* Must have functional understanding of cost accounting and adopt to practical application.
* Must have advanced computer skills and be able to understand electronic processing.
* Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills for effective interface with all internal and external contacts.
* Must be an innovator and embrace lean enterprises principles and practices.

**We offer a comprehensive and competitive total compensation package.**

Come join the Parker Aerospace Team! We are proud to offer competitive compensation, including participation in annual incentive programs, and benefits designed with health, wealth, and well-being in mind. **Our competitive package includes:**

**Benefit & Retirement Plans**

Parker offers competitive benefit programs, including:

* Comprehensive coverage for medical, prescription drugs, dental, vision, voluntary optional life, accident insurance, hospital indemnity insurance and critical illness insurance with competitive premium cost.
* 401(k) Plan with company matching contributions at 100% of the first 5% of pay
* Company provided defined-contribution retirement plan with annual contribution equal to 3% of pay
* Career development and tuition reimbursement
* Other benefits including paid parental leave, short and long-term disability programs, adoption assistance, a Care.com membership and financial planning assistance are provided at no cost to you.
* Supplemental benefit programs including identity protection, legal protection, and pe

**Parker Hannifin**

At Parker Aerospace, we develop technologies and innovative solutions that enable reliable, efficient and increasingly sustainable flight for the lifecycle of the aircraft, including aftermarket support. Our passionate people with deep engineering expertise, together with our breadth of differentiated technologies, ensure that we make the extraordinary happen and continue to shape the future of aviation in partnership with our customers.

As a member of our team, you are instrumental in fulfilling our mission: 'Enabling Engineering Breakthroughs that Lead to a Better Tomorrow.' Pursuing a career at Parker presents unlimited opportunities for both professional and personal development. Working with some of the most brilliant minds in the industry, your contributions will be pivotal in developing innovative technologies and products, significantly contributing to Parker’s goal of addressing the world’s most pressing engineering challenges. At Parker, our team members belong, matter and make a difference.

**Position Summary**

Manages the direction and daily activities of the Divisions procurement of source controlled components ranging from valves, filter manifolds, heat exchangers, motors, and other electrical components for production of the Divisions products. Responsible for embracing and driving lean enterprises systems throughout the procurement process.

**Essential Functions**

* Plans and direct the activities of the Division's purchases of source-controlled components ranging from valves, filter manifolds, heat exchangers, motors, and other electrical components . Determines the most cost efficient and reliable sources of supply needed for the manufacturing process.
* Establishes preferred supplier selection criteria based on supplier evaluations of price, quality, delivery, certifications, and compliance with governmental procurement regulations. Promotes and uses strategic suppliers.
* Interviews, selects and negotiates with suppliers in response to material requirements/cost issues. Establishes procedures to leverage the company’s position. Ensures purchasing strategy reflects the consistent utilization of local suppliers vs. Group strategic suppliers.
* Works with suppliers to develop and manage continuous improvement programs, addressing quality, delivery, service as well as price.
* Develops standard/automated re-order procedures. Will develop crisis management and supplier backup contingency programs.
* Develops and benchmarks best practices among the Divisions suppliers and maintain accurate measurements and records for evaluation of suppliers.
* Drives strategies to grow margin expansion through deflation and establishing new sources of supply.
* Conduct regular review of purchase price indexes to confirm variances.
* Develop and hire top talent to ensure long-term success of the department.

**Qualifications**

* **Minimum of 4-6 years purchasing/managerial experience.**
* Strong negotiation skills with experience in negotiating in a single source environment and long lead times (approx. 52 weeks).
* Understanding of aerospace source-controlled supplier management with the ability to find win/win solutions.
* Support team members in LTA negotiations to ensure long term continuity of supply for the business.
* **Bachelor’s degree** in business, engineering, or materials management **required** with certification
in supply chain management preferred.
* JD preferred or extensive experience in supplier contract writing/ negotiation.
* Possess analytical and technical skills required to understand business practices and recommend proper automation opportunities.
* Must have functional understanding of cost accounting and adopt to practical application.
* Must have advanced computer skills and be able to understand electronic processing.
* Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills for effective interface with all internal and external contacts.
* Must be an innovator and embrace lean enterprises principles and practices.

**We offer a comprehensive and competitive total compensation package.**

Come join the Parker Aerospace Team! We are proud to offer competitive compensation, including participation in annual incentive programs, and benefits designed with health, wealth, and well-being in mind. **Our competitive package includes:**

**Benefit & Retirement Plans**

Parker offers competitive benefit programs, including:

* Comprehensive coverage for medical, prescription drugs, dental, vision, voluntary optional life, accident insurance, hospital indemnity insurance and critical illness insurance with competitive premium cost.
* 401(k) Plan with company matching contributions at 100% of the first 5% of pay
* Company provided defined-contribution retirement plan with annual contribution equal to 3% of pay
* Career development and tuition reimbursement
* Other benefits including paid parental leave, short and long-term disability programs, adoption

description:
Technical Buyer - Electric Motors

**Department:** Purchasing

**Location:** FEDCO Headquarters, Monroe, Michigan

**Employment Status:** Full-Time, Exempt

**Reports To:** Supply Chain Manager

**Position Summary**
====================

The Technical Buyer - Electric Motors sources and manages electric motors, variable frequency drives (VFDs), and related components for FEDCO products and customer projects. This purchasing role requires the technical knowledge to evaluate requirements, compare proposals, identify specification gaps, and coordinate questions with Engineering, Sales, Quality, and suppliers.

The position owns quotations, purchase orders, pricing, delivery performance, negotiations, and supplier relationships while balancing cost, quality, lead time, compliance, and customer requirements.

**Essential Responsibilities**
==============================

**Purchasing and Order Execution**
----------------------------------

* Request, evaluate, and compare supplier quotations for motors, VFDs, accessories, and related components.
* Create and manage purchase orders; verify pricing, quantities, specifications, documentation, and delivery dates.
* Resolve supplier acknowledgement discrepancies involving configuration, price, lead time, freight, warranty, or terms.
* Monitor open orders and delivery commitments; escalate risks and drive recovery actions.
* Maintain accurate ERP data and coordinate expedites, changes, cancellations, returns, warranty claims, and corrective actions.

**Technical Motor Purchasing**
------------------------------

* Review motor data sheets, drawings, customer specifications, and application requirements to confirm the required configuration.
* Compare ratings, voltage, frequency, speed, frame, enclosure, efficiency, mounting, duty, hazardous-area requirements, and accessories.
* Identify exceptions or missing information and coordinate approvals with Engineering, Sales, Quality, customers, and suppliers.
* Confirm NEMA or IEC construction, regional electrical requirements, and certifications; support motor and VFD sourcing without assuming final design authority.

**Supplier Sourcing and Commercial Management**
-----------------------------------------------

* Develop and maintain qualified domestic and global sources for standard and engineered motor requirements.
* Negotiate pricing, lead times, payment terms, freight, warranties, minimum quantities, stocking arrangements, and supply agreements.
* Evaluate total landed cost, including freight, tariffs, duties, quality risk, lead time, and inventory impact.
* Support supplier qualification and performance reviews; track quality, delivery, responsiveness, cost, technical support, market conditions, and supply risks.

**Cross-Functional Support and Improvement**
--------------------------------------------

* Partner with Planning and Operations on forecasts, inventory, shortages, and project priorities.
* Support product development, engineering changes, value analysis, standardization, and cost reduction.
* Provide motor pricing, lead-time, sourcing, and technical information for quotations and customer orders.
* Maintain supplier records and reports, comply with purchasing, quality, and trade requirements, and perform other duties as assigned.

**Performance Expectations**
============================

Success in this role may be evaluated through:

* Supplier quality, delivery, responsiveness, cost control, and technical support.
* Accuracy of sourcing decisions, purchase orders, documentation, and supplier commitments.
* Cost savings, risk avoidance, timely support, clear communication, organized records, and follow-through.

**Required Qualifications**
===========================

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Business, or a related field preferred; equivalent technical training and relevant experience may be considered.
* Five or more years of purchasing, sourcing, or supplier-management experience involving electric motors, drives, rotating equipment, or industrial electrical components.
* Experience buying three-phase induction motors, working with manufacturers or distributors, developing requests for quotation, comparing proposals, negotiating terms, and managing orders through delivery.
* International sourcing, landed-cost analysis, and engineered-to-order manufacturing experience preferred.
* Working knowledge of ERP/MRP systems, purchasing controls, Microsoft Office, and relevant motor certifications.
* Professional purchasing certification is a plus; ability to travel domestically and internationally as required.

*FEDCO is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.*

With more than 900 e-commerce sites and a global omnichannel presence across digital, in-venue, and retail, Fanatics Commerce reaches fans in over 180 countries and powers official fan experiences for many of the world's most iconic sports properties.

With more than 900 e-commerce sites and a global omnichannel presence across digital, in-venue, and retail, Fanatics Commerce reaches fans in over 180 countries and powers official fan experiences for many of the world's most iconic sports properties.

At Fanatics, we bring our BOLD Leadership Principles to life every day—building championship teams, obsessing over fans, acting with limitless entrepreneurial spirit, and delivering with a determined and relentless mindset.

As we continue to scale our global platform, the Sr. Sourcing Manager will play a critical role in building and optimizing the Fanatics Brands global source base to deliver quality licensed product at competitive cost.

#### **ROLE OVERVIEW**

The Sr. Sourcing Manager is responsible for building, optimizing, and managing the Fanatics Brands global source base to achieve industry-leading quality, on-time delivery, and competitive costs while developing partnerships in a sustainable and compliant business environment. This role provides strategic leadership across all sourcing functions — from annual allocation strategy and cost negotiations to cross-functional collaboration with Merchandising, Design, and Product Development — operating effectively at both the macro/strategic and tactical execution levels. The Sr. Sourcing Manager delivers business and fan impact through BOLD leadership and execution excellence, leveraging data, automation, and AI-enabled insights.

#### **HOW WILL YOU DRIVE IMPACT**

Success is measured by the ability to deliver results through BOLD capabilities and measurable outcomes.

Team & Leadership Impact (Build Championship Teams)

Cross-Functional Leadership:

* Partner closely with Merchandising, Design, and Product Development on seasonal assortments, special programs, and events, integrating sourcing into the product creation process from the earliest stages.
* Collaborate with the Fanatics Brands planning team on seasonal forecasts and long-term capacity planning, and work with the Sourcing Operations Team on Incoterms, payment terms, shipping requirements, and customer compliance needs.
* Communicate regularly with regional Product Creation Centers (PCCs) globally to align on source base strategy, seasonal allocation, cost negotiations, and capacity management.

People Leadership:

* Recruit, coach, develop, and supervise an industry-best sourcing team, building the capabilities required to support Fanatics Brands' growth trajectory.
* Provide ongoing direction and performance management to ensure team members are meeting sourcing milestones, critical dates, and quality standards.

Fan & Customer Impact (Obsessed with Fans)

* Ensure on-time delivery of licensed sporting product by maintaining rigorous calendar adherence to sourcing milestones and actively managing capacity across the global source base.
* Drive vendor performance through scorecard reporting and continual review of quality, price, delivery, and compliance against Fanatics Brands requirements — so fans always receive the product they expect, when they expect it.
* Participate in the vendor onboarding process to ensure new partners meet Fanatics Brands standards, protecting the integrity of the licensed product experience.
* Collaborate with Product Integrity and the Sourcing Operations Team on vendor manuals and manufacturing agreements to uphold quality and compliance standards across all supplier relationships.

Innovation & Problem Solving (Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit)

* Develop and continuously optimize the annual allocation strategy by supplier and hemisphere, ensuring a balanced global source base while driving margin enhancement.
* Introduce and implement new sourcing processes and procedures that improve efficiency, reduce risk, and align with evolving business needs.
* Identify opportunities to diversify and evolve strategic supplier partnerships in response to changes in trade, logistics, and business strategy — including vendors in Asia and

description:
**Your Job**

As an MRO Buyer, you will play a pivotal role in procuring parts, components, and services needed for maintenance, repair, and production to support facility operations. Reporting to a Purchasing Manager, you will manage purchasing activities in a fast-paced, time-sensitive environment, focusing on Maintenance, Repair, and Operating (MRO) supplies and outsourced services.

This is a facility-based role, requiring strong collaboration with operations teams, suppliers, and internal partners to drive value, improve processes, and ensure supply continuity. You will leverage ERP systems and strategic agreements to optimize costs and working capital while adhering to safety and corporate policies.

Location: Onsite at Monticello, MS

Travel: Up to 25% travel required

**Our Team**

Georgia-Pacific's Strategic Sourcing & Procurement (SS&P) organization is responsible for the strategic sourcing and procurement of critical materials and services supporting over 140 facilities nationwide. Our team drives value through category management, supplier partnerships, and innovative process improvements. Join us during an exciting transformation as we build new capabilities, improve efficiency, and capture significant savings.

**What You Will Do**

* Support and execute company-wide sourcing strategies for MRO and production-related categories
* Process purchase orders, track deliveries, and mitigate inventory overages using the company's ERP system
* Issue Requests for Quotations (RFQs), evaluate supplier bids, negotiate terms and pricing, and select suppliers based on total cost of ownership
* Collaborate across operations, engineering, logistics, and finance to understand requirements and deliver solutions
* Manage supplier relationships and foster collaboration with logistics and transportation teams to optimize delivery and costs
* Ensure compliance with all safety, environmental, purchasing, and contractual policies and guidelines
* Analyze root causes of invoice exceptions and implement preventive actions
* Drive continuous process improvements and automation to enhance purchasing effectiveness and efficiency
* Utilize strong communication, negotiation, problem-solving, and organizational skills
* Manage competing priorities and deadlines with a strong customer focus and sense of urgency
* Self-directed with a service-oriented attitude and proven ability to work collaboratively in a team environment
* Provide occasional weekend remote support (typically 3-4 times/year), if applicable for the location

**Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)**

* 3+ years of purchasing, procurement, manufacturing operations or related supply chain function experience
* Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel and Outlook
* Willingness to travel up to 25% depending on location and business needs

**What Will Put You Ahead**

* Purchasing experience in manufacturing or maintenance environments, preferably pulp & paper or similar industries
* Advanced Excel skills, including pivot tables, VLOOKUPS, Tableau, and Cognos reporting
* Experience working with suppliers and using multiple ERP systems (e.g., MP2, M3, Asset Suite, SAP S/4HANA)
* Experience in contract negotiation, supplier management, and category strategy execution
* Exposure to data analytics and process improvement methodologies
* Bachelor's degree

At Koch companies, we are entrepreneurs. This means we openly challenge the status quo, find new ways to create value and get rewarded for our individual contributions. Any compensation range provided for a role is an estimate determined by available market data. The actual amount may be higher or lower than the range provided considering each candidate's knowledge, skills, abilities, and geographic location. If you have questions, please speak to your recruiter about the flexibility and detail of our compensation philosophy.

**Job description:**

Job Summary
We are looking for a Procurement Specialist to source components and materials required to fulfill government defense contracts. You will work directly under the Procurement Manager and alongside the existing procurement team.

Responsibilities:

* Source and procure components and materials to support production work orders
* Create and send requests for quotes (RFQs) to approved vendors
* Collect, compare, and analyze vendor quotes for pricing, lead time, and availability
* Validate supplier qualification and compliance per contract requirements
* Create and issue purchase orders in the company ERP system
* Monitor open purchase order delivery status and follow up with vendors on delays
* Prepare cost analysis documentation and support margin review
* Maintain vendor contact lists and supplier records
* Coordinate with warehouse and production teams on material availability and shortage resolution
* Maintain accurate documentation and filing per company procedures

Requirements

Must Have:

* 2+ years experience in procurement, purchasing, or supply chain
* Experience creating RFQs, comparing vendor quotes, and issuing purchase orders
* Comfortable working with ERP systems
* Strong attention to detail
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines simultaneously
* Proficient in Google Sheets and/or Excel
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* U.S. Citizen or Permanent Resident (required for compliance)

Nice to Have:

* Experience in defense or government procurement
* Experience sourcing electronic or electromechanical components
* Knowledge of government procurement regulations
* Manufacturing environment experience

What We Offer

* Competitive salary based on experience
* Hands-on training on company systems and processes
* Small team environment where your work directly impacts company output
* Stable, long-term work backed by U.S. government contracts
* Opportunity to grow within an expanding company

Work Location: In person

Pay: $17.00 - $25.00 per hour

**Welcome to Backburner Labs**

Backburner Labs is an engineering consultancy in St. Paul that designs and builds products our clients can't build alone: medical devices, industrial systems, robotics, things that often don't exist until we make them. That's the engineering side.

None of it works without the business behind it. We've doubled revenue every year for five years and are preparing to move into a new headquarters to match. Growth like that doesn't happen without finance, operations, logistics, and salespeople who are just as sharp and just as accountable as the engineers down the hall.

We're still small enough that your work is visible, not buried in a process nobody remembers building. You'll help create the systems this company runs on as it scales, not just maintain ones someone else already figured out.

If you'd rather build something than babysit it, you'll fit in here.

Help build the company that's building what's next.

**Quick Facts**

* Founded: 2019
* Company: ~50 people (full-time and contract employees)
* Current location: St. Paul - St. Anthony Park area
* Future location: Minneapolis - Prospect Park area (we have leased a 43,000 sq ft building)
* Revenue: doubled every year for 5 years (more details shared later)
* Client retention: 93%

**Position Overview**

Backburner Labs is an engineering consultancy and contract manufacturer that designs and builds products our clients can’t build alone: medical devices, industrial systems, robotics, and things that often don’t exist until we make them. That work depends on getting the right parts, from the right suppliers, at the right price, on time.

We’re looking for a hands-on Buyer to own purchasing and improve how it works as we grow. You’ll source from domestic distributors, fabrication partners, and overseas manufacturers; place and track purchase orders; and work with engineering, manufacturing, and our CFO to keep projects supplied and costs visible. You’ll also own manufacturing inventory; shipping is a secondary part of the role.

**Details**

* Reports to: Manufacturing Operations Manager
* Works closely with: CFO, engineering, manufacturing, and project owners
* Status: Full-time employee
* Team : ~8
* Salary: $70,000 – $80,000
* Location: In person in St. Paul (St. Anthony Park), with a planned move to Minneapolis (Prospect Park)
* Interview process (about 2.5 weeks):
+ Video call with our Head of Talent
+ Video call with the Manufacturing Operations Manager
+ In-person panel interview and tour
+ Decision

**Key Responsibilities**

Purchasing & Supplier Management

* Source electronic components, mechanical hardware, fabricated parts, and indirect materials from suppliers such as Mouser, DigiKey, McMaster-Carr, SendCutSend, CDW, and Uline.
* Request and compare quotes on price, availability, lead time, and freight; negotiate terms and identify second sources.
* Source parts from China and other international suppliers, accounting for quality requirements, shipping, tariffs, and total delivered cost.
* Own supplier accounts and relationships, including setup, payment terms, supplier records, and tax-exemption documentation.
* Convert BOMs and build plans into purchase plans; flag long-lead, single-source, and end-of-life parts early.

Purchase Tracking & Follow-Through

* Create and manage purchase orders from request through delivery; confirm acknowledgements and expedite as needed.
* Maintain a clear view of open orders, expected arrival dates, costs, and project assignments.
* Resolve delays, backorders, incorrect shipments, and returns (RMAs) before they disrupt a build, balancing fast-turn prototype buys against planned production orders.

Process Improvement & Financial Coordination

* Build a consistent purchasing intake process: required specifications, quantities, need dates, project codes, and approvals.
* Work with our CFO on payment terms, invoice discrepancies, and project cost tracking.
* Improve purchasing workflows and records in our ERP/MRP system (Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central), using Arena PLM for BOM and item information.

Inventory Management

* Own manufacturing inventory accuracy: on-hand balances, stock locations, and ERP transactions.
* Receive material against purchase orders and packing slips, verifying part number, quantity, and condition.
* Run cycle counts, maintain reorder points and lot/serial traceability, and support kitting and material readiness for builds.

Shipping & Logistics (Secondary)

* Coordinate parcel (FedEx, UPS) and LTL shipments, labels, BOLs, supplier returns, and freight claims.

**Qualifications**

Required

* 2+ years of hands-on purchasing supporting engineering, manufacturing, or hardware products, including personally requesting quotes, issuing POs, and following them through delivery.
* Hands-on inventory experience: receiving, cycle counts, and reconciling ERP records to physical stock.
* Comfort with technical part information

Meta's Reality Labs organization is building the future of augmented and virtual reality, developing cutting-edge wearable devices including VR headsets, AR glasses, and mixed reality platforms. The Contract Manufacturing Sourcing team is seeking a principal-level leader to own and drive the end-to-end contract manufacturing strategy for Reality Labs hardware products. * Establish and govern supplier performance frameworks including capacity planning, quality metrics, delivery performance, and continuous improvement programs
* Develop and maintain multi-generational sourcing roadmaps aligned to Reality Labs hardware product roadmaps, ensuring supply base readiness for new product introductions
* Manage supply risk across the contract manufacturing portfolio by identifying single points of failure and driving dual-source or alternative supplier strategies
* Provide strategic guidance and mentorship to other sourcing professionals on the team, elevating the overall capability of the contract manufacturing sourcing function
* Represent the contract manufacturing sourcing function in cross-functional leadership forums, communicating supply strategy, risk posture, and investment recommendations to executive stakeholders

* 12+ years of experience in contract manufacturing sourcing, supply chain management, or operations within the consumer electronics, wearables, or hardware technology industry
* Experience leading complex, multi-generational contract manufacturing negotiations including pricing, capacity, tooling, and long-term supply agreements with global EMS or ODM partners
* Experience developing and executing sourcing strategies for high-complexity consumer hardware products involving precision mechanical, optical, or electronic assembly
* Experience influencing executive-level decisions across internal and external stakeholders in ambiguous, cross-functional environments requiring independent judgment
* Experience with total cost of ownership modeling, should-cost analysis, and competitive benchmarking in a contract manufacturing context

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Familiarity with optical, display, or sensor assembly processes relevant to augmented and virtual reality hardware platforms
* Experience building and scaling a contract manufacturing sourcing function or center of excellence within a high-growth hardware organization
* Experience managing new product introduction processes in partnership with contract manufacturing partners, including ramp readiness, yield improvement, and capacity qualification

For more than 100 years, Twin Disc has been a global leader in power transmission and propulsion technology, delivering innovative solutions that help move industries around the world. Our success is built on a culture of ingenuity, continuous improvement, and a commitment to excellence.

As we continue to grow and expand globally, we are seeking a strategic and results-driven **Commodity Manager** to join our team. This role is ideal for an experienced sourcing professional who thrives on building supplier partnerships, driving cost competitiveness, and influencing business strategy.

**Position Summary**
--------------------

The Commodity Manager is responsible for developing and executing sourcing strategies that deliver annual cost savings, strengthen supplier performance, and support Twin Disc's business objectives. * Lead supplier selection activities and establish sourcing strategies for materials, components, and outside processing services.
* Build and maintain strategic relationships with key suppliers while serving as the primary point of contact for critical vendor partnerships.
* Leverage global sourcing resources, including Twin Disc India, to maximize value and supply chain effectiveness.

### **Cost Management & Negotiation**

* Drive annual sourcing savings initiatives and identify opportunities to improve cost competitiveness.
* Lead negotiations for pricing, contracts, and long-term supply agreements.
* Track and analyze cost savings, price increases, and overall supplier cost performance.
* Develop target cost models ("should-cost" analysis) to support negotiations and supplier accountability.

### **Supply Chain & Process Improvement**

* Create and implement tools and processes that improve sourcing effectiveness, productivity, and supplier management.
* Develop and manage a strategic sourcing pipeline, ensuring a healthy flow of cost reduction and supplier development projects.
* Support manufacturing operations through rapid outsourcing solutions when capacity relief is required.
* Establish supplier performance tracking systems, supplier visit schedules, and supplier database management processes.

* Partner with Engineering, Operations, and Product Development teams to ensure supplier readiness for new product launches.
* Support prototype and production release activities to ensure successful product introduction and supply continuity.

### **Education & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Accounting, Supply Chain, or a related field.

* Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, materials, and machining operations.
* Knowledge of components such as gears, shafts, castings, forgings, and precision-machined parts preferred.
* Experience with ERP systems and supplier performance management tools is a plus.

* Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Ability to influence stakeholders and collaborate effectively across all levels of the organization.

Description:

**Position Summary**

The Commodities Manager is responsible for developing and executing sourcing strategies for assigned

commodity categories, managing supplier relationships, and mitigating cost and supply risk across the

organization. This role combines market analysis, negotiation, and cross-functional collaboration to ensure

reliable, cost-effective, and quality-compliant supply of materials.

Requirements:

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

Develop and implement category strategies for assigned commodities, aligning with production, engineering, and business goals

* Monitor, prepare and present commodity markets analysis, pricing trends, and supply/demand dynamics to anticipate risk and identify cost-saving opportunities
* Lead supplier selection, qualification, and contract negotiations, including pricing, terms, and service-level agreements
* Manage ongoing supplier performance through scorecards covering quality, delivery, cost, and responsiveness
* Build and maintain a diversified, resilient supplier base to reduce single-source and geopolitical risk
* Partner with engineering, operations, and finance teams to forecast demand and align procurement plans
* Drive cost reduction and value engineering initiatives without compromising quality or supply continuity
* Manage hedging or forward-buying strategies where applicable for volatile commodities
* Ensure compliance with company policies, ethical sourcing standards, and relevant trade regulations
* Support new product introduction (NPI) by sourcing materials early in the design cycle
* Resolve supply disruptions, quality issues, and contract disputes in a timely manner

**Qualifications**
------------------

**Required:**

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, Engineering, or related field
* 7+ years of experience in commodity management, strategic sourcing, or procurement
* Strong negotiation and contract management skills
* Strong Data Center Industry Experience
* Experience with ERP/procurement systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle) and spend analytics tools
* Solid understanding of market analysis, cost modeling, and total cost of ownership
* Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills

**Preferred:**

* Master's degree or MBA
* Professional certification (ISM, CPSM, CSCP, or similar)
* Experience in indirect Categories, electronics, metals, energy commodities

Familiarity with international trade, tariffs, and import/export regulations

**Core Competencies & Behaviors**
---------------------------------

**Highlight key values expected of all Forgent Power team members: safety, quality, continuous improvement, collaboration, accountability, and customer focus.**

* Analytical and data-driven decision-making
* Strategic thinking with attention to execution detail
* Risk management and problem-solving under pressure
* Strong relationship management with internal stakeholders and external suppliers
* Adaptable and Resilient in fast-changing market condition
* Ability to work autonomously with strong ownership, discipline and accountability
* Proactively driving outcomes with stakeholder groups to achieve deliverables

The typical work environment is a standard office setting. The employee is frequently required to perform work in a manufacturing environment. Frequently required to sit for extended periods of time at computer.

Up to 50% travel for site based role, 75% for remote team members.

**Performance Metrics Categories**
----------------------------------

Spend Under Management

OTD/OTIF

Savings and Productivity

Quality

Safety

Replenishment and Lead-Time

Supplier Rationalization

Innovation and Continuous Improvement

The statements above are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. They are not an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, or skills required. Forgent Power reserves the right to modify, interpret, or apply this job description as needed.

Forgent Power is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected class.

Resolves shipment quality discrepancies by mediating supplier/manufacturing issues. Facilitates the resolution of issues by arranging and participating in conferences between suppliers and company personnel.

**About Groq**

Inference is the engine that powers AI, and Groq was built from the silicon up to deliver the world's fastest inference at scale. We pioneered the LPU—the first processor designed specifically for AI inference—and are transforming that innovation into a global cloud platform powering production AI workloads.

As an Infrastructure Sourcing Manager, you will own data center sourcing end to end: building the pipeline of site opportunities, leading technical and commercial due diligence, negotiating with landlords and colocation providers, and presenting site recommendations to executive leadership for approval.

This is a single-threaded owner role. You will partner across Engineering, Networking, Operations, Finance, and Legal, but you will be the person accountable for finding sites, proving they fit, and closing them on the best terms available. You will sit in the Finance organization and report to the Head of FinOps at Groq.

**Location:** This role will be based in one of our three hiring hubs: the **Dallas, San Francisco, or New York City** area. The person hired for this role must be based in one of these three areas.
