Kratos Defense & Security Solutions, Inc., is a leading defense technology company focused on unmanned systems, satellite communications, cyber security/warfare, microwave electronics, missile defense, training, and combat systems. Our customers include the U.S. federal government, foreign governments, commercial enterprises, and state and local government agencies. At Kratos, we prioritize affordability as a cornerstone of our technology. We leverage proven, cutting-edge methodologies and technology to minimize costs, streamline schedules, and mitigate risks, ensuring timely delivery of cost-effective solutions to market.

Kratos Unmanned Aerial Systems (KUAS), a division of Kratos Defense, is renowned for its expertise in developing, delivering, integrating, and supporting high-performance, cost-effective, jet-powered Unmanned Aerial Systems (Targets and Tactical). As a mid-tier defense contractor, we've demonstrated agility and innovation in providing aircraft to the US military and global allies and partners. Our track record of delivering top-notch jet-powered subscale targets has established us as a go-to defense contractor capable of delivering capabilities at an affordable price.

At KUAS, we prioritize innovation, collaboration, and growth. Our team collaborates to cultivate a supportive and dynamic workplace, fostering creativity and promoting professional development while honoring personal and family lives. Join our team and help shape the future of unmanned technology within the defense industry today!

**GENERAL JOB SUMMARY:**

The Buyer is responsible for supporting the sourcing, value analysis, bidding, negotiation, selection, approval, purchase, receipt, and quality of all materials for assigned commodities. The Buyer works closely with Material Program Managers, Engineering, Materials Program Manager and Production Planners to ensure supplier quality requirements and customer delivery is achieved through accurate and timely management of purchase orders for assigned commodities.

**ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:**

**The duties and responsibilities listed below apply to all levels of Buyers. Each level of Buyer has additional duties and responsibilities listed.**

* Supports the development and maintenance of effective supplier relationships to achieve company goals to include achieving schedule, reducing material lead times, improving quality, reliable delivery performance and favorable pricing.
* Obtains competitive bids as appropriate.
* Researches sources of supply and requests supplier viability data (i.e. Survey Information, ISO Certifications).
* Updates and maintains supplier records.
* Reviews, reports and updates ERP (CINCOM) data related to supplier records.
* Supports Supplier Performance Reviews by printing reports, organizing data reviews with buyers, obtaining approvals, and issuing report and cover letter to suppliers.
* Supports senior level buyers with transactions for return to vendor, Government owned property and other buyer responsibilities.
* Attends meetings both internal and with suppliers, as needed.
* Follows established QMS procedures.
* Takes initiative in recognizing and proposing process improvement opportunities.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities at one time.
* Demonstrated knowledge of supply chain processes
* Ability to prioritize tasks and organize workload to assure that timelines are met while having frequent interruptions.
* Ability to adjust priorities and manage time wisely in a fast-paced environment.
* Responsible for maintaining a clean and safe work area.
* Other assignments and/or projects as required.

**Buyer I:**

* Primary source for procurement of MRO materials and other non-direct materials.
* Utilizes system reports and other sources to meet production requirements and minimize inventory holding costs.
* Participates in the disposition of surplus, salvage, returned and discrepant materials.
* Notifies appropriate personnel when ordered material may be/or is past scheduled delivery date.
* Reviews material requirements to support production schedules and avoid expediting fees.
* Entry level negotiation skills

**MISSION:**

Jackson’s Food Company is the Snack Super™ brand powered by heroic employees and premium avocado oil. We stand poised to upset the snacking status quo forever. All employees support our mission of delivering a safe and quality product.

**POSITION SUMMARY:**
The Procurement Manager at Jackson's Food Company is responsible for leading the company's procurement function and ensuring the timely, cost-effective, and reliable acquisition of raw materials, packaging, supplies, and other materials required to support production and business operations. This position oversees purchasing activities, supplier relationships, inventory availability, demand planning, pricing, lead-times, and procurement processes.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**: The following statements reflect the general details necessary to describe the major functions of this position and are not intended to be a detailed description of all the work/functions that may be required. Other duties may be assigned. Individuals will work a varied schedule based on client needs.

* Lead and oversee procurement activities for raw materials, packaging, production supplies, PPE, office supplies, and other operational materials.
* Review and validate short-term and long-term production schedules to ensure all required materials are available and delivered in time to support production.
* Partner with the Supply Chain Planner and Operations leadership to develop material purchasing strategies that support production requirements and customer demand.
* Analyze forecasted demand, historical usage, inventory levels, production requirements, and supplier lead-times to establish appropriate purchasing requirements.
* Develop and maintain purchasing plans that balance material availability, inventory investment, shelf-life, minimum order quantities, and production requirements.
* Identify and proactively address potential material shortages, excess inventory, obsolete inventory, and supply risks.
* Develop, maintain, and strengthen strategic relationships with key suppliers to ensure reliable supply, competitive pricing, quality, and service.
* Lead supplier negotiations related to pricing, payment terms, lead-times, minimum order quantities, delivery requirements, and other commercial terms.
* Monitor supplier performance and establish expectations related to on-time delivery, quality, responsiveness, pricing, and service.
* Work with suppliers to anticipate changes in demand and develop solutions to support production requirements.
* Evaluate supplier performance and identify opportunities for supplier consolidation, alternate sourcing, and supply-chain risk reduction.
* Partner with Quality and Operations to address supplier-related material or quality concerns and support corrective actions as needed.
* Oversee short-term oil delivery schedules and coordinate with suppliers and shippers to ensure timely arrivals.
* Oversee the processing and scheduling of potato purchase orders, adjusting as needed based on production requirements and inventory levels.
* Ensure appropriate management of material shelf life and minimize the risk of expired or obsolete inventory.
* Ensure purchasing activities are aligned with approved budgets, pricing agreements, and company policies.
* Develop and execute procurement strategies designed to reduce material costs while maintaining quality, service, and supply reliability.
* Identify and implement cost reduction opportunities through supplier negotiations, sourcing strategies, order optimization, process improvements, and inventory management.
* Monitor commodity pricing and market conditions that may impact the cost and availability of key raw materials.
* Analyze purchasing and material costs and partner with Finance to ensure accurate reporting, forecasting, and budgeting.
* Ensure procurement data is accurate, timely, and maintained according to established company standards.
* Identify opportunities to improve ERP functionality and automate or streamline procurement processes.
* Partner with Operations, Supply Chain, Planning, Warehouse, Finance, Quality, and other departments to align procurement activities with business and production needs.
* Lead, coach, and develop procurement and purchasing team members to ensure effective execution of purchasing responsibilities.

**QUALIFICATIONS:** To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
**Required Experience**

**EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENC**E

* Bachelors degree or equivalent from four-year college
* Seven to ten years related experience and/or training
* Or equivalent combination of education and experience
* Proven aptitude in Microsoft Suite
* Proven aptitude with ERP system

description:
**Position Overview**

We are seeking a Purchasing Manager to be accountable for the full procurement function: ensuring electronic components and materials are sourced, purchased, and delivered on time and on cost to support PCBA production across Avalir's aerospace/defense, space, and medical programs. This role partners closely with Engineering, Planning, Quality, Receiving, Program Management, and executive leadership, and serves as the escalation point for supplier performance, material shortages, and customer commitments. The Purchasing Manager reports to the Director of Supply Chain and regularly contributes purchasing performance data, including purchase price variance for executive-level review.

**About Avalir**

Avalir (formerly Electronic Source Company) is a leading electronic manufacturing services (EMS) provider, delivering quick-response, high-reliability printed circuit board assemblies (PCBAs) built on world-class manufacturing equipment, practices, and technology. The assemblies Avalir builds support mission-critical end products, from missile guidance to satellite systems, for industry-leading customers. Avalir's business is approximately 70% aerospace & defense, 25% space, and 5% medical, reflecting a customer base that demands the highest standards of quality, traceability, and on-time delivery.

**ITAR Notice**

This position supports programs subject to ITAR and EAR export control regulations. Candidates must be U.S. citizens or permanent residents.

**REPORTING STRUCTURE**

**Reports To**

Director of Supply Chain, with regular visibility and reporting to executive leadership on purchasing performance, cost, and purchase price variance (PPV).

**Direct Reports**

* Senior Buyers
* Buyers
* MRO Buyer

The team is based in Chatsworth, CA and includes remote team members on the East Coast. The team is expected to grow as the business scales, and the Purchasing Manager will lead its structure, recruitment, and development.

**Key Working Relationships**

Internal: Supply Chain leadership, Planning, Engineering, Quality, Program Management, Estimating/Quoting, Receiving, Stockroom, Document Control, Finance, and Operations. External: component manufacturers, franchised distributors, brokers (under counterfeit-mitigation controls), contract service providers, and customers.

**THE PERSON WE’RE LOOKING FOR**

This is an opportunity for a hands-on purchasing leader to help develop, shape, and grow Avalir’s purchasing and supply chain function. We are looking for someone who wants to build, not just maintain, and who takes real pride in developing the people around them.

* **Proactive and driven –** Takes ownership, anticipates supply risks and problems before they reach the production floor, and acts without waiting to be asked. Brings energy, urgency, and a strong sense of accountability for results.
* **A builder –** Excited by the chance to develop, shape, and grow the purchasing and supply chain function, putting in place the processes, systems, structure, and talent needed to scale with the business.
* **Collaborative –** Builds strong, trusted relationships across Engineering, Planning, Quality, Program Management, and Operations, as well as with suppliers and customers. Sees supply chain as a team effort and works to find solutions rather than assign blame.
* **A coach, mentor, and developer of people –** Genuinely invested in growing others; able to coach, mentor, and develop buyers into stronger professionals and future leaders as the function expands.
* **Hands-on and grounded –** Comfortable rolling up their sleeves on day-to-day buying, expediting, and supplier issues when needed, while keeping sight of the bigger strategic picture.
* **A continuous improver –** Curious, data-driven, and always looking for a better way to work, whether in process, systems, supplier strategy, or team capability.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Team Leadership & Development**

* Lead, coach, mentor, and develop a team of Senior Buyers, Buyers, and the MRO Buyer, including remote team members on the East Coast; set goals, conduct performance reviews, and manage individual development plans
* Recruit and onboard talent as the team grows; define team structure, roles, account and commodity coverage, backup, and succession planning to scale the function

**Procurement Operations**

* Ensure components are sourced and purchased accurately and on time to customer BOMs, build schedules, and committed ship dates; oversee PO creation, approval, backlog, acknowledgements, and expediting/de-expediting in Epicor Kinetic ERP
* Drive proactive resolution of component shortages through expedites, alternates, and substitutions, and maintain accurate ERP purchasing data (item master, approved manufacturers, pricing, lead times) so MRP output can be relied on
* Support Estimating/Quoting with accurate component pricing, lead times, and availability for customer RFQs

**Cost, Inventory & Financial Performance**

* Own

description:
**Position Summary**

The New Product Introduction (NPI) Buyer is responsible for leading procurement activities supporting the successful development and launch of new products. Acting as the primary procurement interface for Engineering, Program Management, Operations, Quality, and Suppliers, the NPI Buyer ensures supplier readiness, cost competitiveness, component availability, and risk mitigation from concept through production launch.

This role is embedded within cross-functional product development teams and is accountable for sourcing strategy execution, supplier selection, quote management, launch readiness, and commercialization of new products. The NPI Buyer plays a critical role in accelerating time-to-market while achieving quality, cost, delivery, and sustainability objectives.

**Key Responsibilities**

**New Product Program Leadership**

* Participate as the Procurement representative on NPI program teams.
* Support product development from concept through production launch.
* Drive procurement activities through stage-gate milestones.
* Ensure sourcing timelines align with engineering and launch schedules.
* Support Engineering Change Notices (ECNs) and product revisions throughout development.

**Strategic Sourcing**

* Identify, evaluate, and select suppliers for new product components and assemblies
* Lead RFQ/RFP processes for prototype and production requirements.
* Analyze supplier quotations and negotiate commercial terms
* Develop sourcing recommendations based on total cost, quality, risk, capacity, and technology considerations.
* Collaborate with Category Managers to align NPI sourcing decisions with long-term sourcing strategies.

**Supplier Readiness & Launch Management**

* Assess supplier manufacturing readiness and capacity.
* Coordinate supplier APQP and launch activities working closely with Supplier Development Team.
* Track tooling, PPAP approvals, first article inspections, and qualification milestones.
* Conduct supplier readiness reviews and escalate launch risks.
* Ensure suppliers can support prototype, pilot, and production volumes.

**Cost Management**

* Develop should-cost and target-cost analyses.
* Support value engineering (VE) and value analysis (VA) initiatives.
* Identify cost reduction opportunities early in product development.
* Track cost performance versus program targets.
* Support business case development and program financial reviews.

**Risk Management**

* Identify supply chain risks associated with new technologies, capacity constraints, sole-source suppliers, and geopolitical factors.
* Develop mitigation plans for launch-critical components.
* Monitor long lead-time material requirements.
* Drive dual-source strategies where appropriate.
* Escalate supply continuity risks to procurement and business leadership.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

Partner closely with:

* Engineering
* Product Management
* Program Management
* Manufacturing Operations
* Quality
* Supplier Quality Engineering
* Planning & Logistics
* Category Management
* Finance

**Key Deliverables**

The NPI Buyer is accountable for:

* Sourcing plans for all assigned programs
* Supplier nomination recommendations
* RFQ completion and analysis
* Program BOM cost tracking
* Supplier launch readiness reviews
* Capacity and risk assessments
* Tooling and PPAP status tracking
* Procurement stage-gate approvals
* NPI savings and cost optimization initiatives

**Qualifications**

**Education**

Bachelor's Degree in:

* Supply Chain Management
* Business
* Engineering
* Operations Management
* Related discipline

**Experience**

* 5+ years of procurement, sourcing, commodity management, supply chain, or engineering experience.
* Experience supporting product launches or new product development programs.
* Experience working with suppliers in technical or manufacturing environments.
* Automotive, HVAC, industrial equipment, electronics, aerospace, or other complex manufacturing experience preferred.

description:
**Job Summary**
Kensington Electronics, Inc. is seeking a Buyer to support the company’s purchasing function through the timely and accurate procurement of assigned materials, product lines, and vendor requirements. This position helps maintain strong supplier relationships, monitors open orders and delivery commitments, supports inventory and customer demand requirements, and works closely with sales and internal teams to resolve issues, protect service levels, and meet company objectives. The position reports to the Purchasing Manager and, in lieu of that role, to the Vice President.

This position may involve access to supplier, customer, operational, technical, or other information subject to U.S. export control laws and regulations, including ITAR and EAR requirements. Due to the nature of Kensington Electronics’ business and customer requirements, eligibility for this role may be limited to individuals who meet applicable U.S. export control authorization requirements and company compliance standards.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Procure assigned materials, components, and product lines in accordance with customer demand, forecasted requirements, inventory needs, and company purchasing practices
* Create, review, and maintain purchase orders, order acknowledgements, open order reports, and related ERP data with a high degree of accuracy
* Monitor supplier lead times, promise dates, and delivery performance to support vendor on-time delivery and customer service expectations
* Follow up with vendors on open orders, expedites, de-expedites, shortages, and shipment status
* Maintain assigned focus lines, including pricing updates, product changes, discontinued or obsolete items, stock rotation concerns, and product discrepancy resolution
* Communicate with vendors regarding availability, lead time changes, allocations, backorders, documentation requests, and other supply issues impacting orders
* Coordinate with sales, customer service, warehouse, and management to resolve purchasing, delivery, pricing, and product-related issues in a timely manner
* Comply with all applicable company policies and procedures relating to export-controlled information, customer confidentiality, cybersecurity requirements, Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI), and restricted access to regulated systems or technical data.
* Review inventory positions and purchasing activity to help balance customer needs, service levels, and inventory investment
* Research alternate sources, replacement parts, or revised procurement options when lead times, obsolescence, or supply disruptions create risk
* Maintain organized records and support reporting related to vendor performance, open purchase orders, pricing, and assigned product activity
* Meet all responsibilities applicable to this role as outlined in the ISO Quality Assurance and Procedures Manual and other company policies or procedures
* Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned by management

**Skills**

* Proficiency in SAP, Oracle EBS, ERP systems, and MRP (Material Requirements Planning) software for effective procurement management.
* Strong negotiation skills with a proven track record of securing advantageous contracts.
* Extensive knowledge of procurement processes within manufacturing environments and supply chain operations.
* Expertise in supplier management, category management, logistics coordination, and materials management.
* Familiarity with federal acquisition regulations (FAR) when working on government-related contracts or projects.
* Ability to perform root cause analysis to resolve procurement issues swiftly and effectively.
* Excellent communication skills for collaborating across departments and negotiating with suppliers.
* Understanding of production planning principles, quality management standards, and pricing strategies. Join us as a Buyer to play a vital role in driving operational excellence through strategic sourcing, innovative procurement practices, and supplier relationship management! Your expertise will help us maintain a resilient supply chain while supporting our commitment to quality and efficiency across all facets of our business operations.

**Required Qualifications**

* High school diploma or equivalent required
* Two or more years of purchasing, buying, product management, inside sales support, or supply-chain-related experience, preferably in distribution, electronics, or a similar product environment
* Experience working with purchase orders, vendor follow-up, pricing, lead times, and order status management
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Outlook, Excel, and Word
* Strong attention to detail, organization, follow-through, and time management skills
* Ability to communicate professionally with vendors, customers, and internal teams

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in electronic components, interconnects, electromechanical products, or a related technical distribution environment

At Jabil (NYSE: JBL), we are proud to be a trusted partner for the world's top brands, offering comprehensive engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing solutions. With 60 years of experience across industries and a vast network of over 100 sites worldwide, Jabil combines global reach with local expertise to deliver both scalable and customized solutions. Our commitment extends beyond business success as we strive to build sustainable processes that minimize environmental impact and foster vibrant and diverse communities around the globe.

**How will you make an impact?**

Manage Material Requirements Planning (MRP) activities to ensure material supply aligns with customer demand while optimizing inventory, cost, supplier performance, and overall supply chain efficiency. Drive sourcing strategies, supplier relationships, cost reduction initiatives, and procurement activities that support operational and customer success.

**What will you do?**

* Manage MRP activities to ensure adequate material supply while minimizing inventory costs.
* Develop supply base strategies and supply chain solutions tailored to customer and business unit requirements.

* Influence customers' supply chain strategies to align with and leverage Jabil's capabilities and preferred supplier network.
* Communicate Jabil expectations to suppliers regarding delivery, quality, cost, and service requirements.
* Conduct supplier audits, site visits, performance reviews, and certification activities.
* Drive continuous improvement of supplier performance through regular monitoring and feedback.
* Obtain delivery, quality, and service performance feedback from Materials Planners.
* Support and execute Supply Chain Management initiatives and strategic sourcing programs.
* Quote new and existing materials and participate in material cost analysis activities.
* Re-quote and negotiate with suppliers to achieve cost reduction opportunities.
* Make sourcing decisions based on total cost considerations including price, freight, duties, quality, service, flexibility, and supplier performance.
* Negotiate pricing, terms and conditions, stocking agreements, liability terms, and other supplier agreements.
* Ensure execution of Jabil purchasing agreements, pricing structures, and global supplier contracts.
* Work with customers to expand Approved Manufacturer Lists (AML) and increase adoption of preferred and strategic suppliers.
* Analyze and forecast component pricing to support standard costing and inventory valuation processes.
* Support customer quoting activities by providing competitive and accurate material cost information.
* Optimize Material Price Variance (MPV) through effective sourcing and cost management practices.
* Partner with Business Unit Managers to obtain customer approval for premium freight, material premiums, tooling, and other customer-incurred expenses.
* Collaborate with Materials Planners to ensure supplier performance supports production and business requirements.
* Track, monitor, and improve supplier delivery, quality, and service performance.
* Support overall business objectives through effective supplier management and procurement planning.
* Adhere to all safety and health rules and regulations associated with this position.
* Comply with all procedures within the company security policy.
May perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, Operations, Finance, Engineering, or a related field preferred.
Equivalent combination of education, training, and experience may be considered.

**Experience:**

* Experience in Supply Chain, Procurement, Purchasing, Materials Planning, MRP, or related operations functions.
* Experience negotiating pricing, contracts, and supplier agreements preferred.

**PRIMARY FUNCTION:** The Category Purchasing Manager develops and implements all stated goals and objectives related to contract bidding, contract management, vendor sourcing, pricing, data analysis, continuous improvement projects, supply chain management, and sustainability initiatives.

**RESPONSIBILITIES AND TASKS:**

* Research suppliers for new or current commodities, solicit bids/ RFPs, negotiate best pricing for value, evaluate each and select vendor which meets supply needs; communicate selection with details to leadership if needed
* Evaluate opportunities for cost reduction, source appropriate vendors, solicit bid/ RFP, and negotiate pricing to reduce overall commodity costs and develop a pipeline for back-up suppliers
* Create supplier contracts developing language detailing specifics of purchasing agreements (i.e. pricing/ volume, required delivery schedule, etc.) ensuring required supplies area readily available as required
* Gather, compile, and format data into required reports and/or presentations to support vendor selection, pricing, quality of supplies, etc., communicating to management decisions surrounding vendor selection or pricing model
* Build and maintain strong relationships with new and current vendors to secure best pricing for required supplies
* Lead and support field purchasing managers, as well as others, in supply decisions and related daily tasks
* Provide guidance surrounding issues, recommending corrections or resolutions based on independent evaluation and judgement and follow-up to ensure issues have been resolved; communicate high level issues, plan to resolve to leaders
* Perform other related duties as requested

**SUPERVISOR RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* While this role has no direct reports, it is considered a Leader of People role with required competencies: Sizing up People, Delegation, Planning, Customer Focus and Conflict Management as well as: Functional/Technical Skills, Action oriented, Problem solving, Learning on the Fly

**EDUCATION and CERTIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelors degree in Business, Purchasing or other related discipline from an accredited institution
+ Education and experience may be substituted for four-year degree
* Certified Purchasing Manager (CPM) certification preferred

**EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS:**

* Minimum five (5) years’ purchasing commodities in a manufacturing environment; poultry commodities purchasing preferred
* Proficient in computer skills including MS Office (Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.) and specific software (i.e. Optiva, DocuSign, Adage, etc.)
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate statistics and/ or data into an easily understood presentation
* Strong customer focus with exceptional communication skills, both verbal and written, and the ability to fluently communicate effectively both up and down the chain of command and with external customers in a timely and professional manner
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects while maintaining attention to detail
* Must possess a strong customer-centric attitude, high energy level and a strong sense of urgency

**SAFETY REQUIREMENTS:**

* Follow and ensure others follow departmental and company safety policies and programs
* Wear required protective equipment in all areas where mandatory

**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:**

* Ability to travel up to 10%
* Moderate use of hands/fingers to operate computer, keyboard and mouse; may sit for extended periods of time

**Manufacturing Environment**

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly exposed to risk of injury in a manufacturing environment, cold and humid and/ or hot and dusty environment. Loud noise above 89 lbs. possible and the ability to work non-standard shifts to meet business need (holiday, weekend, and extended)

**Job Posting**: Procurement Specialist
**Company:** New Peak Construction Company
**Location**: In Office - Rexburg, Idaho (supporting Eastern Idaho & Southeastern Wyoming projects)
**Employment Type**: Full Time
**Schedule:** Monday–Friday
**Pay:** Competitive, DOE

**About Us**
New Peak Construction Company/New Peak Homes is a rapidly growing homebuilder and developer with offices in Cheyenne, Wyoming and Rexburg, Idaho. We specialize in custom, high-quality single-family and multifamily residential construction, as well as commercial development, throughout Southeastern Wyoming and Eastern Idaho.

We value integrity, precision, and disciplined execution in every project we undertake.

**Position Overview**
We are seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Procurement Specialist to join our team in Rexburg, Idaho. This role supports the sourcing, purchasing, and vendor coordination processes across active single-family, multifamily, residential, and commercial projects.

The Procurement Specialist works closely with the Estimator, Project Managers, and Superintendents to ensure material pricing, scope alignment, and purchasing execution remain consistent from pre-construction through project completion. This position plays an important role in maintaining organized procurement systems and supporting schedule integrity across multiple projects.

The ideal candidate is proactive, dependable, and confident communicating with vendors while managing multiple tasks and deadlines.

**Key Responsibilities**

· Source and request bids from suppliers and material vendors

· Compare pricing and assist Project Managers with vendor selection

· Coordinate with the Estimator to ensure awarded vendor pricing aligns with project budgets and scope

· Assist in confirming material quantities and specifications based on plans and takeoffs

· Issue and manage purchase orders in coordination with Project Managers

· Track material lead times and proactively communicate potential delays

· Coordinate deliveries to align with project schedules

· Maintain vendor files including insurance certificates, W-9s, and required documentation

· Maintain organized procurement tracking logs and documentation

· Ensure purchase orders align with approved budgets and job cost structures

· Collaborate with accounting to support invoice matching and cost tracking

· Support single-family and multifamily residential, and commercial project purchasing needs

**Qualifications**

· 2 to 5 years of purchasing, procurement, project coordination, or construction-related experience preferred

· Associate or bachelor’s degree in construction management, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or related field preferred (Equivalent construction purchasing or project coordination experience will be considered in lieu of degree)

· Experience in single-family and multifamily residential, and/or commercial construction strongly preferred

· Strong organizational and time management skills

· Ability to read and interpret construction plans and specifications preferred

· Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel required)

· Familiarity with JobTread, Monday.com, or similar software

· Professional written and verbal communication skills

· Ability to manage multiple active projects simultaneously

**What Success Looks Like**

· Materials are ordered accurately and delivered on schedule

· Purchase orders are properly documented and aligned with budgets

· Vendor communication is clear and timely

· Coordination between Estimating, Project Management, and Field teams is seamless

· Procurement documentation is organized and easy to track

**Why Join Us?**

· Competitive pay (DOE)

· Paid Time Off available for full-time employees following successful completion of the 90-day review period

· Opportunity to grow with a rapidly expanding construction and development company

· Collaborative, team-oriented environment

· Direct involvement in high-quality single-family and multifamily residential, and commercial projects

If you are a driven professional who takes pride in disciplined purchasing, clear communication with vendors, and supporting well-executed construction projects, we invite you to apply

**Please submit your resume and a brief introduction explaining why you would be a strong fit for the Procurement Specialist role at New Peak Construction Company.**

We are seeking long-term team members who value accountability, organization, and disciplined execution.

Check out our Instagram and YouTube Channels.

http://www.youtube.com/@NewPeakHomes

· Full Time

**Work Location:**

· In Office - Rexburg, ID 83440 (Required)

**Ability to Commute:**

· Rexburg, ID 83440 (Required)

**Work Environment:**

· Primarily office-based with occasional visits to active construction job sit

**Purchasing Manager**

This role is located in Elkhart, Indiana.

Do you strive to achieve high performance and enjoy making an impact on the community where integrity and excellence is valued and where you can take your career to the next level? Do you value a people-first culture within a workplace that makes it a priority to foster collaboration, support individual growth, and ensure the well-being of its employees? Then, we have a place for you!

**Who We Are:**

Our Company has spent over 40 years providing high-quality fasteners for the industrial textile industry. Our products range from tiny fasteners for circus tents to heavy-duty webbing for truckloads and we continue to invest in state-of the-art packaging technology and ongoing team member development to ensure long-term success. We are commit ted to delivering innovative solutions and maintaining the highest level of customer service, which has made us a trusted leader in the industry.

**What We Offer:**

* Exciting innovative, collaborative, and team-oriented work environment
* Challenging and individualized career development opportunities
* Competitive salaries
* Comprehensive HealthWellness programs
* Retirement Program with Employer Match!
* Best practice Paid Time Off policies and paid holidays
* Open communication, recognition programs, and team-building events
* And much more to motivated, results-oriented individuals who want to make a real difference in their community and role

**What You'll Do:**

As the Purchasing Manager, you will plan, manage, and lead the company's purchasing activities, including inventory management, forecast planning, and supply chain risk mitigation, to ensure on-time, complete products.

**Your Accountabilities in the Role:**

* Develops and implements purchasing strategies that align with operational requirements and financial objectives.
* Researches, evaluates, and selects appropriate supply vendors in alignment with company standards, sourcing strategies, and business objectives.
* Analyzes vendor and supply chain risks to develop and implement purchasing and sourcing strategies that minimize disruption across the organization.
* Manages the procurement of raw materials, components, and finished goods for manufacturing and distribution to support manufacturing and distribution operations.
* Negotiates vendor pricing, contracts, and terms to achieve cost, quality, and delivery objectives.
* Maintains and develops supplier relationships to ensure reliable supply and performance.
* Acts as a liaison between Operations, Sales, and vendors on product needs and related material selection/issues to achieve mutual goals.
* Collaborates with Operations to proactively understand purchasing needs on common items or commodities to maximize purchasing leverage and ensure material availability and budget goals are met.

**Position Requirements:**

**Job Title**

Purchasing Agent

**Who are we?**

As an aircraft manufacturer, industrialist, industrial service provider and logistician, Daher currently has approximately 14,500 employees and achieved a revenue of 1.9 billion euros in 2025. With its family ownership, Daher has been focused on innovation since its creation in 1863. With locations in 15 countries across Europe, North America and Asia, Daher designs and develops value-added solutions for its aeronautical and industrial customers and partners

Daher’s Pompano Beach, Florida site is a key U.S. Part 145 aircraft maintenance and service center, providing comprehensive maintenance, repair, inspection, and technical support for Daher’s TBM and Kodiak turboprop aircraft. The facility supports both individual owners and commercial operators, performing hands‑on airframe, powerplant, propeller, and systems maintenance in accordance with FAA regulations and manufacturer data. The site also plays an important role in training and mentoring aviation maintenance professionals, reinforcing Daher’s commitment to safety, technical excellence, and continuous improvement within its global aircraft support network.

We are seeking to add a Purchasing Agent to our Pompano Beach location.

This role will manage purchasing activities, whether in development or in serial life. They will work in close collaboration with the SCL, SPM and all internal customers (Plant, Sales, Quality, and Program). Responsible for the CBS of purchased products but also of non-aircraft products related to the program (including tools on specification).

**Primary Role and Responsibilities:**

* Researching and comparing suppliers, goods, and services.
* Selecting the most suitable suppliers in terms of reliability, product quality, and cost-efficiency.
* Monitoring inventory levels and determining purchase needs.
* Requesting cost proposals and negotiating contracts and prices.
* Preparing and processing purchase orders.
* Maintaining records of all transactions, purchase orders, receipts, and payments.
* Scheduling and verifying purchase deliveries.
* Building and maintaining positive, long-term supplier relations.
* Monitor Safety Stock forecasts (series, new product launches, industrial transfers) to ensure deliveries and product availability to meet customer needs without generating obsolete stock.
* Within the framework of contracts with entrusted supplies, to ensure the good supply of raw materials in the respect of the delivery cycles.
* Control the supply parameters (batch size, kanban sizing, security level, etc.) and the replenishment method (deterministic, kanban, order points, VMI, consignment) to optimize availability and stock levels.
* Analyze the stocks of perishable materials and ensure their proper management to limit destruction and stock shortages.
* Analyze monthly on its portfolio the valuation of the stocks of bought products, of the dormant and obsolete stocks, to seek axes of optimization, to lead the plan of associated actions validated by its hierarchical superior and to report to him.
* To be responsible for the value of the inventory in its perimeter
* Monitor the receipt of Supplier Acknowledgements, analyze them, negotiate, if necessary, then enter the agreement in the SAP / ERP and send the amendment to the supplier.
* Follow up with suppliers in advance to ensure that product delivery dates are respected.
* Ensure that the delivery deadlines are correctly positioned and if necessary, cancel / adjust the resource elements considering the contractual conditions.
* Take charge of the daily collaboration (quantity, deadline) with suppliers to ensure operational efficiency.
* In the event of an emergency request, negotiate with suppliers for lead times outside the production cycle, having prepared the negotiation levers (quantities, dates, prices, revision of the overall delivery schedule) beforehand. In case of need to look for an alternative source, he / she will have to contact the Sourcing Manager. For any special part supply, breakdown service, equivalent product, the supplier will carry out a DA and the order will be validated by the buyer.
* Coordinate the treatment of the disputes Reception/Invoicing (Qty / Delay / Return Quality).

**What you need to have:**

* Proficiency in SAP / MRP / CRM and inventory management software programs
* High school diploma or GED required.
* Degree in business administration, procurement, or a related field preferred.
* Previous experience as a purchasing agent or in Aircraft Industry.
* Excellent communication and negotiation skills.
* Strong organization and documentation skills.
* Strong research and analytical skills.
* Address and resolve QSE alerts raised by personnel
* Ensure that your team has the skills required for their jobs (QSE training, accreditations, etc.)
* Support QSE maturity development in your sector

**Information related to the position:**

* The compensation range is $60,000 to $70,000 base s

**Summary of Essential Functions and Responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end procurement activities, including supplier pre-qualification, tender management, strategic sourcing, supplier evaluation, and negotiations
* Build and maintain strong relationships with SMC stakeholders and strategic supply partners to drive business performance, collaboration, and value
* Identify and implement strategic cost-reduction and value-creation opportunities to support financial objectives and maximize procurement savings
* Evaluate and continuously improve procurement processes, recommending and implementing initiatives that enhance efficiency, effectiveness, compliance, and operational performance
* Ensure compliance with company procurement policies, procedures, and established purchasing standards
* Represent Procurement at a regional level, partnering with key stakeholders to align procurement strategies with business objectives
* Lead strategic sourcing initiatives, including:

* + Partnering with property subject matter experts (SMEs) to gather requirements, analyze data, and develop sourcing strategies
+ Developing and managing RFPs to support strategic sourcing iniatives
+ Coordinating supplier communications, competitive bidding, and sourcing activities
+ Consolidating and analyzing supplier bids, developing savings strategies, and presenting sourcing recommendations to stakeholders
+ Establishing baseline analyses and securing stakeholder alignment on sourcing objectives and recommendations
+ Evaluating supplier responses to identify optimal value, quality, and service
+ Communicating supplier selections and facilitating successful implementation
+ Monitor supplier performance across aligned business units and identifying opportunities for continuous improvement
+ Addressing and escalating supplier issues as appropriate to ensure timely resolution and operational continuity
* Represent SMC interests in HFE combined purchasing initiatives to maximize purchasing leverage, savings, and overall value
* Lead, develop, and motivate non-exempt team members through hiring, training, coaching

**ADDITIONAL RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Periodically prepares reports to include but not limited to PER execution efficiency, bid process adherence, and project budget metric
* Able to periodically audit the SMC project process and provide reports to support HFE and SMC financial policies and procedures

IPEX is one of the North American leading providers of advanced plastic piping systems. Our mission is **to shape a better tomorrow by connecting people with water and energy.**

We currently have an **exciting opportunity** as **a Buyer, Indirect!** This role is based at our Office in Lynchburg, Virginia and reports to the Purchasing Manager.

Do not miss the opportunity to join a diverse group of people-centric professionals, thought leaders and rapid thinkers, entrepreneurs in spirit and status quo-fighters!

**Job Summary**

The **Buyer, Indirect** is responsible for managing the strategic sourcing, procurement, supplier management, and contract administration of indirect goods and services across multiple manufacturing facilities. This role plays a key part in driving operational efficiency and cost optimization by developing sourcing strategies, leading supplier negotiations, managing commercial agreements, and ensuring consistent supplier performance.

As a trusted business partner, the Buyer collaborates closely with stakeholders across operations, maintenance, engineering, finance, human resources, information technology, and plant leadership to deliver high-quality procurement solutions that align with organizational objectives. The successful candidate will help advance a structured and scalable indirect procurement function while promoting governance, compliance, and continuous improvement across the business.

**Principal Responsibilities**

* Develop and execute sourcing strategies for assigned indirect spend categories to achieve cost savings, service improvements, risk mitigation, and supplier performance objectives.
* Manage the full sourcing lifecycle, including supplier identification, RFQ/RFP development, supplier evaluations, commercial negotiations, and supplier selection recommendations.
* Negotiate pricing, contracts, service level agreements, and commercial terms to maximize value and optimize total cost of ownership.
* Support contract lifecycle management activities, including contract development, renewals, compliance monitoring, and supplier performance reviews.
* Analyze spend data and purchasing trends to identify opportunities for supplier consolidation, process improvements, cost savings, and strategic sourcing initiatives.
* Establish supplier performance metrics and conduct regular business reviews to drive accountability, service excellence, and continuous improvement.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business needs and deliver effective procurement solutions.
* Ensure purchasing activities comply with company policies and governance requirements.
* Lead competitive bidding events and supplier benchmarking initiatives.
* Prepare procurement reports, dashboards, and performance metrics to support leadership decision-making and category strategies.
* Identify, assess, and mitigate supplier-related risks that could impact business continuity, service delivery, or financial performance.
* Support the development and implementation of procurement policies, procedures, supplier management programs, and category management best practices.
Identify and mitigate supplier-related risks while supporting continuous improvement initiatives.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* 3-5 years of experience in procurement, strategic sourcing, purchasing, supply chain, or category management.
* Experience sourcing indirect goods and services within a manufacturing environment highly preferred.
* Proven experience managing RFQs, RFPs, supplier evaluations, negotiations, contract management, and competitive bidding.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, negotiation, and supplier relationship management skills.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including data analysis and reporting. Experience with data visualization tools including PowerBI or Tableau is an asset.
* Experience with ERP, purchasing, or spend analysis systems is an asset.
* Strong business acumen, attention to detail, and organizational skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.
Self-motivated with a continuous improvement mindset and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.

IPEX is committed to providing accommodations for people with disabilities throughout the recruitment process and, upon request, will work with qualified job applicants to provide suitable accommodation in a manner that takes into account the applicant’s accessibility needs due to disability. Accommodation requests are available to candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process for IPEX jobs. To request an accommodation, please contact HR at HR@ipexna.com

description:
At Jabil (NYSE: JBL), we are proud to be a trusted partner for the world's top brands, offering comprehensive engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing solutions. With 60 years of experience across industries and a vast network of over 100 sites worldwide, Jabil combines global reach with local expertise to deliver both scalable and customized solutions. Our commitment extends beyond business success as we strive to build sustainable processes that minimize environmental impact and foster vibrant and diverse communities around the globe.

**How will you make an impact?**
--------------------------------

Lead the Materials and Purchasing function to ensure material supply meets demand, optimize overall purchasing costs, support business growth initiatives, and develop strategic sourcing and supply chain solutions. Drive operational excellence through supplier management, inventory optimization, cost reduction initiatives, and team development while supporting customer satisfaction and business objectives.

**What will you do?**
---------------------

### **Leadership & Team Development**

* Recruit, interview, and hire Purchasing Supervisors and Planner/Buyers.
* Partner with recruiters to identify qualified candidates for Materials and Purchasing roles.
* Coach team members through the hiring and onboarding process.
* Monitor turnover trends and implement retention initiatives.
* Identify individual and team development needs and create training plans.
* Develop and maintain training curricula for the Materials organization.
* Coach and mentor Materials staff to deliver exceptional service to internal and external customers.
* Develop and manage succession planning activities for the Materials function.
* Establish clear goals, objectives, and performance expectations for team members.
* Provide ongoing coaching, feedback, and performance management.
* Conduct performance evaluations professionally and on schedule.
* Drive accountability and continuous improvement against operational metrics and business objectives.
* Coordinate and lead teams through changing priorities and critical business situations.
Ensure recognition and reward programs are applied fairly and consistently.

### **Communication**

* Facilitate regular team meetings and communication forums.
* Promote the exchange of ideas, information, and best practices within the department.
* Communicate effectively through clear verbal and written messaging.
* Encourage employee engagement and feedback.
Adapt communication styles to effectively interact with employees at all levels.

### **Business & Functional Management**

* Understand and support campus and organizational strategic objectives.
* Develop and implement Materials strategies aligned with business goals.
* Support Workcell business strategies through effective materials management.
* Provide regular updates to Business Unit Managers, Workcell Managers, and Operations leadership.
* Identify opportunities to streamline processes, eliminate waste, and reduce costs.
* Utilize cost management tools to monitor departmental expenses and identify trends.
* Provide cost analysis and improvement recommendations to stakeholders.
* Develop accurate departmental forecasts and planning assumptions.
Analyze forecast accuracy and historical trends to improve planning effectiveness.

### **Materials & Supply Chain Management**

* Ensure operational execution aligns with Jabil Supply Chain strategies.
* Support the development and implementation of Supply Chain initiatives and systems.
* Ensure material supply is aligned with customer demand and production requirements.
* Partner with Materials Planners to establish realistic Master Production Schedule (MPS) commitments.
* Maintain disciplined planning processes to ensure material availability while minimizing liability and excess inventory.
* Monitor and resolve material shortages, non-conforming inventory, excess stock, and obsolete materials.
* Drive reductions in overall material costs, including component pricing, freight, inventory carrying costs, and administrative expenses.
* Optimize Material Price Variance (MPV) through strategic sourcing and cost management initiatives.
* Support standard costing activities through accurate component cost projections.
* Ensure customer quotations are competitive while maximizing favorable MPV opportunities.
* Ensure purchase orders are executed according to negotiated pricing, terms, and conditions.
* Partner with Commodity Managers and Buyers to support strategic sourcing objectives.
* Ensure suppliers are selected based on cost, quality, delivery, and overall business value.
* Monitor supplier performance and drive continuous improvement initiatives with suppliers.
* Adhere to all safety and health rules and regulations associated with this position.
* Comply with all procedures within the company security policy.
May perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

description:
If you’re looking for a special place to build or grow your career, you’ve found it. Whether you’re an experienced professional, a recent college graduate or somewhere in between, IDEX is a place where you can apply your existing skills and learn new ones in an environment where you can make an impact.

With interesting opportunities in engineering, marketing, sales, supply chain, operations, HR, finance, and more across more than 40 diverse businesses around the globe, chances are, we have something special for you.

**POSITION SUMMARY**

We are seeking a motivated and detailed oriented Sourcing Specialist that will work with commodity managers to run sourcing activities for a multitude of commodities. The ideal candidate will develop and execute short and long-term sourcing initiatives that reduce supply chain complexity and achieve a minimum of 3% YOY material productivity. They will help identify, evaluate, suppliers to ensure the best value, quality, and service for our organization. Responsible for onboarding new suppliers and/or transitioning parts to more strategic suppliers

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

*Project Management:*

* Plan, execute and manage multiple sourcing projects at one time, determined by various commodity strategies driving quality, delivery and material cost savings’
* Track and report project progress, risk and performance metrics.
* Manage New Product Development projects from quote to production.

*Strategic Sourcing:*

* Research potential suppliers, analyze market trends and spend data to identify sourcing project opportunities.
* Provide recommendations for supplier selection, develop negotiations strategies , stocking agreements and contract finalization.
* Manage RFQ/RFP process and supplier/part transition process
* Lead the end-to-end supplier qualification process for new vendors, from request for quote to first purchase order which includes the supplier onboarding process.
* Utilize 80/20 mindset to establish and execute VA/VE projects to reduce part complexity
* Manage 20’s suppliers and develop strategies for supply base reduction
* Manage and develop strategic sourcing strategies for Indirect (non-production) suppliers

*Cost and Risk Management:*

* Work collaboratively with supplier to address and resolve performance issues to mitigate project risk
* Develop and execute contingency plans for supplier disruptions
* Act as liaison between supplier and internal teams, ensuring effective communication and issue resolution.
* Maintain and monitor “key” performance metrics
* Perform other functions as necessary to support the global sourcing department.

**QUALIFICATIONS:** *To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills and or abilities required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions*

* Excellent project management skills and Project Management tools and MS Office Suite.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, with a demonstrated ability to work well with spreadsheets
* Excellent reasoning and analytical skills, ability to anticipate and define complex problems, collect data, establish facts, distinguish trends, and draw valid conclusions
* Ability to multi-task and manage several projects in different stages.
* Strong ability to interface effectively with suppliers and internal cross-functional counterparts while maintaining a customer satisfaction orientation.
* Excellent organizational and time management skills with strong attention to detail.
* Ability to work both independently and as part of a larger team.

**Education and Experience Requirements or Equivalencies:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Supply Chain Management or related field.
* Experience: 3+ years relevant supply chain/operations experience,
* Relevant certifications (e.g., CPSM, CSM, or equivalent) are an advantage.
* Proficient with strategic sourcing methodologies, supplier negotiation, and contract management
* Experience managing multiple sourcing projects to completion
* Experience in manufacturing purchasing is preferred.

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS:** *The physical demands described here are represented of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.*

* While performing duties of the job, employee is required to move around and be still; use hands to handle objects, tools, or controls; reach with hands and arms; talk and hear.
* Employee will occasionally lift average of 30 lbs.
* Employee may occasionally be required to drive a forklift.
* Specific vision abilities required by the job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.

**BUYER II/III**
================

**Company:** Yulista Solutions, LLC

**Department:** Supply Chain / Procurement

**Reports To:** Purchasing Manager or Designee

**FLSA Status:** Exempt

**Position Type:** Full-Time

**Job Level:** Buyer II/III – Intermediate/Senior Buyer

**POSITION SUMMARY**
--------------------

The Buyer II/III is an intermediate-to-senior procurement professional responsible for performing and administering a broad range of purchasing activities in support of company programs and customer requirements.

The position manages procurement actions across the full purchasing spectrum, ranging from **micro-purchases, purchase card transactions, routine commercial purchases, and low-dollar requirements to large-dollar, technically complex, critical, and/or higher-risk acquisitions** .

The Buyer II/III performs the procurement lifecycle, including requisition review, acquisition planning, market research, supplier sourcing, solicitation, proposal evaluation, price analysis, negotiation, purchase order placement, supplier management, administration, delivery coordination, invoice resolution, and closeout.

The position exercises judgment commensurate with the complexity, dollar value, risk, and contractual requirements of each procurement. More complex, sensitive, or higher-risk procurement actions may require additional review or approval by the Purchasing Manager or other authorized management.

The Buyer II/III may procure aircraft parts and components, maintenance and repair services, engineering and technical services, calibration and testing, tooling and equipment, logistics and transportation services, training, commercial products and services, and other materials and services required to support company and customer operations.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**
-----------------------

### **Purchasing and Procurement**

Manage assigned procurement actions from receipt of an approved purchase requisition through award, administration, delivery, invoice resolution, and closeout.

Process procurement requirements ranging from micro-purchases and routine purchases to large-dollar and complex acquisitions.

Utilize appropriate purchasing methods based upon dollar value, complexity, urgency, competition, availability, contractual requirements, and company procurement procedures.

Review purchase requisitions, Statements of Work (SOWs), specifications, drawings, bills of material, and other technical documentation for completeness and procurement readiness.

Conduct market research and identify qualified suppliers using approved vendor sources, OEMs, authorized distributors, manufacturers, repair facilities, historical procurement information, industry resources, and other appropriate sources.

Develop and issue Requests for Quote (RFQs), Requests for Proposal (RFPs), Requests for Information (RFIs), and other solicitation documents as appropriate.

Obtain and evaluate supplier quotations and proposals for price, delivery, technical compliance, quality requirements, commercial terms, and overall responsiveness.

Prepare, issue, administer, modify, and close purchase orders and other authorized procurement instruments within assigned purchasing authority.

Perform purchase card and micro-purchase transactions when appropriate and in accordance with company policies and established purchasing controls.

Support urgent, mission-critical, and Aircraft on Ground (AOG) requirements while maintaining required procurement documentation and approvals.

### **Competition and Source Selection**

Promote competition to the maximum practical extent consistent with company procedures, contractual requirements, schedule, and market conditions.

Solicit qualified suppliers and document competition obtained.

Evaluate quotations and proposals based on applicable procurement criteria, including price, technical compliance, delivery, quality, past performance, supplier capability, risk, and other solicitation requirements.

Support Lowest Price Technically Acceptable (LPTA), Best Value, and other source-selection methodologies when applicable.

Prepare procurement summaries, bid evaluations, award recommendations, sole-source documentation, and other records necessary to establish the basis for supplier selection.

Identify and resolve supplier exceptions, assumptions, qualifications, and deviations prior to award.

### **Price Analysis and Price Reasonableness**

Evaluate proposed pricing and document price reasonableness at a level appropriate to the dollar value, complexity, and risk of the procurement.

Price-analysis techniques may include:

* Competition among qualified suppliers;
* Historical prices paid;
* Published catalog or market pricing;
* Commercial price lists;
* Government contract or schedule pricing;
* Independent Government Cost Estimates (IGCEs);
* Market research;
* Parametric or price-trend analysis;
* Comparison with similar products or services; and

1

Edinburg, Texas

**Department**

Procurement Office

**FTE**

1

**FLSA**

Exempt

**Scope of Job**

To provide advanced professional advisory and technical skills necessary in the procurement process to acquire supplies, equipment, and services required by the institution in compliance with all applicable laws, rules, regulation, policies and procedures. Primarily responsible for performing various tasks related to the Procurement Cycle from procurement planning through order fulfillment for complex procurements including institutional master supply/service agreements and licensing and leasing agreements. Assist in the operational planning and administration of an assigned service area(s).

**Description of Duties**

* Administers and directs strategic procurements and discretionary and nondiscretionary competitive bids, including conducting pre-proposal and/or pre-bid conferences, conducting evaluations and determining best value, analyzing supplier responses, creating tabulations and related procurement documentation, and making recommendations for award.
* Prepares, reviews, and analyzes procurement reports to assist with development of procurement management strategies.
* Directly coordinates with appropriate staff, various University departments, UT System (as applicable) and pertinent contractors at all stages of the procurement process to ensure best value is secured in accordance with all applicable State, System, and University procurement regulations, polices, and procedures.
* Provides guidance and support to staff, program managers, principal investigators and faculty in the area of procurement including, but not limited to, reviewing the financial terms and conditions of agreements; ensures appropriateness documents for solicitation, contract renewals, extensions and modifications in accordance with Customer requests and purchasing management.
* Interprets and ensures departmental compliance with federal, state, and local policies including internal UTRGV policies and procedures.
* Prepares statements, reports, projects, estimates, and/or projects as requested.
* Resolves issues/problems that arise with the campus community and/or vendors.
* Functions as an effective liaison between University departments and related contracting entities, and provides direction to University representatives in purchase order negotiations.
* Reviews University spend reports for assigned commodities and identifies potential strategic sourcing initiatives or spend trends and patterns.
* May leads or supports internal teams and task forces, providing functional expertise and guidance on the procurement systems and business processes that may include training purchasing staff as required.
* Maintains supplier and/or supply e-catalogs; creation of and maintenance of item master database records.
* Maximizes usage of contractual item(s) or supplier opportunities; identify possibilities for process improvement, service enhancement and/or cost reductions.
* Reviews and analyzes a range of contracting scopes of work and/or specifications, and researches, redrafts, and develops scope documents as necessary to establish clarity and to secure the best interests of the University; provide direction and leadership to University departments in developing scopes of work/specifications
* Ensures opportunities in university contracts to HUB firms when expected value is of at least $100,000 including commodities, professional services, and construction.
* Coordinates with the Contracts Office and applicable departments on procurement solicitations that will result in formal agreements to ensure appropriate terms are included in the solicitation, and the scope of work will effectively transfer to the agreement; develop resulting agreements.
* Coordinates and oversees purchase order execution and provides University departments with guidance on purchase order administration as necessary
* Promotes and develops end-user understanding of procurement procedures and processes through training and direct interaction; assists with, and conducts if necessary, University procurement training.
* Provides leadership, direction, and training to the different level of financial stakeholders within the university.
* Participates in testing and process validation, and serves on teams responsible for upgrades and enhancements to the ERP system.
* Modifies custom queries utilizing PeopleSoft Query or other reporting tools in collaboration with departmental staff. Prepare queries in response to open records requests and University of Texas (UT) System requests.
* Based on specialized area of assignment, may also perform the following duties:

o Meets with salespeople to review products or service offerings and also serves as a liaison between vendor community and end user departments on product updates.

o Assists in the preparation of statutorily required HUB reports.

description:
Take advantage of this rare opportunity to partner with one of the leading contract manufacturers in the world! Leverage your skills in a role where you will be part of process of life-saving medical devices and enjoy the support and stability of an organization that has been in business for over 100 years.

Why join us?

As a valued team member with Trelleborg Medical Solutions, you will enjoy:

* Competitive compensation:

* Generous benefits package: Includes health, dental, vision, STD, LTD, life, 401k, paid time off, tuition reimbursement, and more!

* Greater opportunity for impact:

* Growth and advancement: Join a global company that loves to promote from within and allows for advancement.

* Paid holidays

* Paid time off

* Bonus potential

* And much more

Trelleborg Medical Solutions is currently accepting applications for a Strategic Sourcing Manager for our Plymouth, Minnesota location. The Strategic Sourcing Manager will be a key part of our global TMS support team and will provide leadership to a team of Buyers supporting manufacturing sites across TMS on purchasing-related matters. In addition to managing and developing the Buyer team, this role will serve as a strategic counterpart for key suppliers and oversee related key raw material categories.

The focus of the Strategic Sourcing Manager is to improve, develop, and implement processes and tools within Purchasing on a global level. Working closely with colleagues from the global support team, site Purchasing professionals, and the Buyer team, the Strategic Sourcing Manager will ensure that purchasing strategies, processes, and best practices are consistently executed across the organization. The role is responsible for identifying and capturing synergy opportunities, supporting the development and performance of the Buyer team, and driving Purchasing Excellence (PE) on both a strategic and operational level.

Tasks and Responsibilities:

* Spend mapping and analysis – Collection and maintenance of global spend data for nominated commodities
* Develop, maintain and execute a global strategy for nominated commodities
* Development and negotiation of contracts with key suppliers to nominated commodities
* Sourcing projects – support local sites in the identification of opportunities and applying a systematic approach
* Supplier Market development – Attend seminars, network with peers, work with other group purchasing teams to identify new suppliers.
* Identify areas of risk, i.e. monopoly, proprietary materials, customer approvals etc. that limit our choice of supplier.
* Ownership of Business-to-Business meetings with several key suppliers.
* Support TMS Manufacturing sites on PE related supply- and sourcing activities, to ensure stable supply
* Project Management driven approach with clear KPI mindset and time plan focus
* Work with Group Purchasing to drive next steps in Trelleborg digital sourcing journey
* Identify opportunities for, and implement Sourcing initiatives, on Direct- and Indirect Material & Services

Education and Experience:

* 4-year degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Procurement or related field.
* 3 years of increasing leadership experience managing purchasing or supply chain professionals.
* 5-7+ years of progressive purchasing, sourcing, supply chain, or procurement experience within a manufacturing environment.
* Completed or working towards professional certifications such as CPSM, CSCP, CPM or equivalent are preferred.
* Proven track record of supplier negotiation, contract management, and supplier relationship management with domestic and international suppliers.
* Experience managing strategic supplier relationships.
* Medical device manufacturing or other highly regulated industry experience preferred but not required.

Competencies:

* Strong communication skills and strength in initiating and leading conversation
* Business and commercial awareness
* Strong negotiation and influencing skills
* Recognizes and manages conflict effectively
* Problem solving skills
* Flexible and able to cope with ambiguity
* Planning and organizational skills

Salary: $90,000-$110,000

Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities
This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

description:
*First Solar reserves the right to offer you a role most applicable to your experience and skillset.*

**Basic Job Functions:**

Lead procurement cross-functional teams for Tier 2 categories resulting in procurement decisions delivering the highest quality, reliability, and value to meet First Solar requirements. Develop strong business relationships and strategic alliances supporting First Solar’s growth plan.

**Education/Experience:**

* BS/BA degree plus 5 or more years of experience in a related technical or business field or 8 years of experience in a related technical or business field
* Strong knowledge of operational purchasing processes & concepts
* Experience in the glass industry, glass manufacturing, or sourcing of glass and related materials is preferred, but not required.
* ISM and APICS Certification preferred.

**Required Skills/Competencies:**

* Decision Making:
+ Participates with executives to establish strategic plans and objectives.
+ Select, evaluate, and develop category plan objectives in areas of technology, quality, cost, flexibility, and service.
+ Execute projects consistent with achieving overall supply management organizational goals.
+ Implement sourcing decisions based on team consensus to weighted scorecard.
* Problem Solving:

+ Assess, define, and resolve complex supply chain and procurement issues without supervision.
+ Apply root cause analysis and derive corrective actions and assess adequacy of the analyses and plans proposed by suppliers managed.
+ Apply appropriate competitive cost benchmarks, financial analysis, and risk management techniques to solve issues.
+ Able to influence internal customers and executives to achieve mutually beneficial solutions.
* Project Management:

+ Understands and demonstrates advanced project management skills.
+ Demonstrated ability to successfully manage multiple projects at the same time, and to close projects on time.
+ Effectively manages relationships and peer deliverables to successful project completion.
* Interaction:

+ Highly effective communicator, including oral, written and presentation preparation
+ Interacts primarily with peers, senior managers, and executives within First Solar.
+ Interaction requires the ability to influence others, frequently associates with higher position, to achieve organizational goals.
+ Often acts as team leader of cross-functional group for ad-hoc or standing projects.
+ Routine interaction with directors, VPs or “C” level executives of suppliers managed.
+ Builds deep industry relationships and category subject matter expertise.
* Negotiation:

+ Performs market and cost analysis.
+ Issues RFIs/RFQs/RFPs.
+ Develops and executes negotiation plan.
+ Conducts negotiation within approved negotiation parameters and authority.
+ Documents commercial terms and drafts contract agreements and amendments.

**Essential Responsibilities:**

* Lead global commodity management activities for glass, including development of sourcing strategies that support competitive cost, supply assurance, capacity requirements, supplier development, and risk mitigation.
* Develop and implement a global sourcing with specific negotiation strategies to achieve cost, supply assurance and risk mitigation objectives.
* Lead commercial negotiations with managed supply partners.
* Coordinate aggregation of all sites demand for supplier forecasting and leveraging for cost reduction.
* Proactively manage supplier base ensuring supply with no adverse impact on factory ramp plans.
* Utilize formal benchmarking methods to determine best in class processes and drive improvement.
* Develop and implement cost-reduction programs using Cost- of-Ownership (COO) analysis, cost build-up analysis and supplier competition.
* Measure and track supply performance within spend category.
* Implement inventory optimization programs to optimize inventory turns, inventory investment and service level performance.
* Effectively communicate with appropriate management levels both internally and externally.
* Lead cross functional team and manage supply chain to goals for quality, technology, cost, flexibility and service.
* Demonstrate project management skills in leading cross functional teams.
* Conduct business dealings with the highest level of integrity and regard for legal and environmental issues.
* Other duties as assigned.
* Job description subject to change at any time

**Reporting Relationships:**

* Reports to Commodity Leader or Director, Global Supply Chain.

**Travel:**

* Up to 20%

**Estimated Salary Range:**

* $84,200 - $120,000 annually

**US Physical Requirements:**

Office Physical Requirements:
