**Job Details:**
================

**Job Description:**
--------------------

**The Role and Impact**
As a Sr. Commodity Manager within the GMO Litho Materials Organization, you will drive Intel's supply chain excellence for Litho materials by optimizing cost, ensuring supply continuity, and enabling technology roadmap execution. You will shape sourcing strategies, build strategic supplier partnerships, and influence both commercial and technical decisions to strengthen Intel's competitive position.

**ROLE OVERVIEW**

The Procurement Manager ensures HealthVerity acquires goods and services efficiently, cost-effectively, and compliantly - getting directly involved in day-to-day sourcing, negotiating, and vendor management. This is a hands-on role for someone who wants to be in the details, not just overseeing from a distance.

We're looking for a Procurement Manager who thrives on execution. You won't just set strategy and hand it off - you'll be running RFPs yourself, sitting across the table in vendor negotiations, digging into spend data, and fixing broken processes with your own hands. This role suits someone who's energized by solving problems directly, wearing multiple hats, and getting things done in a fast-paced, lean environment rather than managing through layers of process.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Personally manage the end-to-end procurement process for key categories - from sourcing and RFPs through negotiation and contract execution
* Directly negotiate pricing, terms, and service levels with vendors, rather than delegating high-value or high-complexity negotiations
* Own and maintain vendor relationships day-to-day, including troubleshooting issues as they arise
* Process and manage purchase orders and requisitions directly when needed, especially during high-volume periods or when the team needs support
* Partner closely and directly with Finance, Legal, IT, and department stakeholders to resolve procurement questions and unblock purchases quickly
* Monitor vendor performance and compliance, personally following up on issues rather than waiting for problems to escalate
* Jump into ad hoc projects and problem-solving as priorities shift - this role requires flexibility and a bias toward action

**QUALIFICATIONS**

**Required**

* 5+ years of procurement experience, with a demonstrated preference for hands-on, execution-focused work over purely strategic/oversight roles
* Strong negotiation skills with a track record of personally closing favorable vendor deals
* Comfort with ambiguity and a willingness to do whatever it takes - from high-level strategy to manual PO entry - depending on what the business needs
* Experience with procurement/ERP systems (e.g., Olive, Tropic, NetSuite)
* Strong analytical skills - comfortable building your own spend analyses rather than relying solely on others
* Excellent communication skills and ability to build trust with stakeholders across departments

Base salary for the role is commensurate with experience and can range between $105,000 - 130,000 + annual bonus opportunity.

### **Hiring Locations**

Our main office is located in Center City, Philadelphia, where we operate on a hybrid model with in-office work required three days a week for local employees. We believe collaboration is most effective when teams come together, which is why we prioritize hiring in the Philadelphia area.

For certain roles, we also hire from **hub locations**—regions where we have an established presence with multiple team members working remotely. While these employees primarily work from home, we bring them together in person at least once a year for team-building, collaboration, and strategic planning.

Due to tax and labor regulations, we can only hire from specific states. Remote work is supported in the following key hub locations and approved states:

**Hub Locations:**

* Philadelphia, Pennsylvania
* Boston, Massachusetts
* New York City, New York
* Baltimore, Maryland
* Washington, D.C.
* Charlotte, North Carolina
* Raleigh-Durham, North Carolina
* Atlanta, Georgia
* Chicago, Illinois

**Approved States for Remote Work:**
CT, DE, FL, GA, IL, IN, MA, MD, MI, NC, NJ, NY, OH, PA, TN, and VA.

**About HealthVerity**

HealthVerity is the leader in privacy-protected real-world data exchange, transforming how healthcare and life sciences organizations connect and analyze disparate patient data. By enabling access to the industry’s largest RWD ecosystem, HealthVerity supports critical applications in clinical development, commercial strategy, regulatory decision-making, and public health. To learn more about HealthVerity, visit healthverity.com.

**Why you'll love working here**

**We are making a difference** – Our technology is at the forefront of some of the biggest healthcare challenges in the world.

**We are one team** – Our people define our culture and always will. We take time out to celebrate each other, and acknowledge the value that each of us adds towards our greater mission. Come share all you have to offer.

**We are learners** – Every team member is continually learning, no matter if we've been in a role for one year or much longer. We are committed to learning and implementing what is best for our clients, partners, and each other.

**Benefits & Perks**

Our benefits package is thoughtfully designed to support and enrich the experience of our full-time employees, with eligibility limited to those in permanent positions.

The Specialist I Procurement will provide essential support to Project teams by managing administrative tasks, maintaining accurate records, and facilitating seamless operations for procurement activities. This role is critical in ensuring timely strategic sourcing, vendor setup, negotiations, bid analysis, purchase orders, subcontract management, and compliance with company policies and project requirements.

Expertise in supply chain management, vendor relationships, and negotiation will be key in maintaining project schedules, controlling costs, and ensuring quality standards are met. This position requires strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced industrial construction environment.

**Company Overview:**

Primoris Pipeline is committed to being the value and customer solutions leader in midstream, transmission, and upstream construction by delivering safe, high quality, environmentally-compliant, timely and cost-effective projects for our clients, regardless of size or challenges.

**Benefits:**

* Competitive compensation, paid weekly.
* Best-in-class medical, dental, vision, and LTD/STD coverage.
* 401(k) with company match, vested on day one.
* Employee Stock Purchase Plan [ESPP].
* Pet coverage for your furry friends.
* Legal assistance coverage.
* Award-winning safety programs.

**EEO Statement**

We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

**Agency Statement**

We are not accepting resumes from Third Party Recruiting Firms for this position. If you are an Agency or Search firm representative, contact the Primoris Talent Acquisition Manager directly for consideration. Primoris or its subsidiaries will not be responsible for any fees arising from the use of resumes and online response forms through this source. In addition, Primoris or its subsidiaries will not be responsible for any fees on unsolicited resumes that are submitted to any member of the Staffing or Operations team. Primoris has established an approved vendor program for this service and will only consider accepting submissions from those approved firms. For consideration in becoming an approved vendor, contact HR.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights notice from the Department of Labor.

description:
SA Recycling, a leader in the metals recycling and processing industry, is actively looking for an experienced Commercial Buyer to join our growing Commercial Sales team. As a Buyer you will be accountable for growing and managing a book of business consisting of Commercial, Industrial and Dealer accounts for both Ferrous (FE) and Non-Ferrous (NF) materials. As the face of SA Recycling, you will use your exceptional communications and relationship building skills to build, deepen, and support, long-lasting relationships with all assigned accounts; and your superior negotiation skills come into play as you identify new business partners and negotiate pricing and service agreements to increase volume and profitability.

**SA Recycling offers:**

* Competitive Pay
* Choice of 2 Medical plans, with Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance
* 401k with a Company Match
* Weekly Pay
* Referral Incentives
* Company provided uniforms and PPE
* Eligible for Safety and Profitability Bonuses
* Advancement Opportunities

**Responsibilities of a Commercial Buyer**

* Responsible for the purchase of ferrous and non-ferrous scrap metals and materials to grow margins, volume, and market share.
* Deepens market share by actively identifying and securing new commercial, industrial, and dealer accounts.
* Purchase scrap metals and material following current market conditions and within pricing standard and models as set by the General Manager and National Sales Team.
* Conduct regularly scheduled suppler visits and sales activities to strengthen relationships and keep abreast of business and market conditions.
* Maintain knowledge of various federal, state, and local environmental regulations to ensure compliance with the purchase and processing of various materials.
* Demonstrate exceptional and ethical customer service and sales skills to ensure repeat business.
* Participate in the development of regional and individual purchasing, marketing, and profitability goals.
* Maintain accurate records for all purchasing, sourcing, prospecting, and follow up activities.
* Partner with facility General Manager’s in the inspection of scrap metals and material to ensure specification, volume, and pricing targets.

**Qualifications for a Commercial Buyer**

* Associate’s degree, Bachelors preferred, related to Sales, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or related field; or 4 years Buyer (Account Management) experience in the scrap metals recycling industry.
* Strong contract negotiation and interpersonal skills required.
* Demonstrated buying/selling skills and product knowledge.
* Ability to generate and qualify leads and close deals.
* Strong oral and written communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and to prioritize effectively.
* Proficient in MS Office programs. SAI or similar software experience a plus.

**PLEASE NOTE: The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work to be performed by individuals assigned to this job. This job posting is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills expected.**

An offer of employment by SA Recycling is contingent on the satisfactory completion of a post-offer drug screen, physical exam, and background check with a credit check (if position specified).

All US applicants must be 18 years of age or older.

Equal Opportunity Employer
This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

description:
**Position Purpose:**

The Strategic Sourcing Manager is responsible for developing, executing, and managing strategic initiatives across International, Domestic, and Final Mile Transportation categories. This role leads the creation of market-driven sourcing strategies, leads and executes RFP events, drives cost optimization projects, and identifies opportunities to deliver sustainable cost savings and operational value.
**Key Responsibilities:**

* 25% Negotiate for products and services within the assigned product category ensuring the lowest possible price.
* 25% Develop and execute strategic sourcing plans to assigned categories. Work cross functionally to improve and streamline processes.
* Initiate quality vendor relationships to support new and ongoing product and services sourcing needs.
* 5% Evaluate vendor relationships and terminate if necessary.
* 20% Work with stores and functional areas to best determine products and services to be sourced. Manage the vendor and resolve issues regarding product quality, delivery, etc.
* 5% Work with purchasing operations to ensure orderly transition from initial deal to ongoing purchasing of products and services. Ensure accuracy and delivery of orders so that clients for the product group are able to complete projects and meet the Company's needs.
* 10% Source qualified vendors to Sourcing who can meet purchase needs in terms of product quality, quantity, and delivery date.
* 10% Identify and qualify vendors to provide product and services to Home Depot. Conduct research to assess vendor capabilities and product information as they relate to company needs.

**Direct Manager/Direct Reports:**

* Typically reports to a sr manager position
* Typically requires working collaboratively across multiple functions
* Typically requires highly developed interpersonal skills for dealing with sensitive or controversial situations.
* Typically faces situations that are unstructured and require original approaches.
* Typically considers new approaches within general policies and short-term goals when solving problems.
* Typically expected to provide infrequent status reports to management only as appropriate.

**Travel Requirements:**

* Typically requires overnight travel less than 10% of the time.

**Physical Requirements:**

* Most of the time is spent sitting or standing in the same location or there may be a need to stoop regularly or move/lift light material or equipment (typically less than 8 pounds).

**Working Conditions:**

Located in a comfortable indoor area. Any unpleasant conditions would be infrequent and not objectionable.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Must be eighteen years of age or older.
* Must be legally permitted to work in the United States.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Strong problem-solving and critical thinking skills
* Experience in process implementation and required internal controls
* Ability to translate complex data into actionable insights
* Strong understanding of strategic sourcing process
* Experience with financial analysis
* Experience working with large datasets and sourcing tools
* Experience sourcing Transportation and Supply Chain categories

**Minimum Education:**

* The knowledge, skills and abilities typically acquired through the completion of a high school diploma and/or GED.

**Preferred Education:**

* No additional education

**Minimum Years of Work Experience:**

* 5

**Preferred Years of Work Experience:**

* No additional years of experience

**Minimum Leadership Experience:**

* None

**Preferred Leadership Experience:**

* None

**Certifications:**

* None

**Competencies:**

* Negotiation Skills - able to negotiate in adversarial situations to arrive at the best deal in terms of cost and quality to meet sourcing needs.
* Product Knowledge - a thorough understanding of the product category to which he/she is assigned.
* Strong presentation and communication skills.

The Strategic Sourcing Specialist role will be responsible for the strategic management of supplier relationships in support of Trew’s Product Development team. This role will assist in optimizing the value and performance in the acquisition of goods and services for the organization. The Strategic Sourcing Specialist will create innovative sourcing strategies to mitigate risks to business operations contacts and to develop relationships with suppliers that provide the best value to Trew.

The ideal candidate will possess good self-management skills, well rounded thinking, confidence, a collaborative approach to working with others within various departments, and the ability to work under pressure and timelines associated with the daily life in the Strategic Sourcing department of a fast-moving industry.

**Duties/ Responsibilities:**

* Assist in leadership of New Product Development (NPD) initiatives, including identifying and onboarding suppliers and managing supplier relationships
* Support the Product Development engineering team, including by acting as the technical and commercial interface between suppliers and the Product Development engineering team
* Initiate and coordinate design review discussions between the Product Development engineering team and suppliers to identify areas for improvement in the manufacturability of components
* Create and manage RFQ packages with current and prospective suppliers and analyze for best value to the project and the Company
* Negotiate contracts, improved prices and terms of business with suppliers and review opportunities to add value to the Company
* Manage prototype and production costs to align with NPD project budgets and product targets and communicate results to internal stakeholders
* Manage prototype part delivery and related order documentation, including expediting to support NPD project schedules
* Support development of process to transition prototype parts to production parts
* Interface with Strategic Sourcing team responsible for production commodities to understand current strategies, trends, and norms within each commodity
* Research and evaluate areas of opportunity and reduce costs where possible
* Explore alternate supplier sources for goods and materials
* Aid in the development of creative and innovative procurement processes and strategies for both NPD and production to improve operational efficiency, add value, aid business performance and work towards a strategy of continuous improvement
* Coordinate First Article and/or Production Part Approval Process (PPAP) packages according to the requirements of the Product Development and Quality teams
* Maintain a willingness to learn about the Company and its operations and business functions so that maximum value can be added to the project teams
* Become a teammate who is sought to support the activities of internal and external stakeholders related to NPD
* Research potential vendors’ abilities and products via supplier visits and assessments
* Deliver briefs, updates and reports as and when required, in particular when there is a risk which could prevent the organization meeting customer demands or where there are over capacity concerns
* Assist where able in training less experienced team members
* Maintain a high level of performance in carrying out the goals of the department and the Company
* Support product change requests and manufacturing process improvement objectives relative to sourced components and communicate the impact on supplier capacity and cost
* Ensure good communications, and update records with new and existing suppliers
* Ensure that a professional and consistent approach is taken in relation to all supplier relationships
* Ensure compliance with company guidelines, purchasing policies and procedures guidance
* Perform other special projects or duties as assigned by manager

* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and contribute performance-based solutions is required
* Ability to add value by reducing cost, cost avoidance, and making business improvements
* Understanding of vendor relations and specific function capabilities as they relate to NPD and production processes desired
* Ability to add value by identifying ways to reduce cost and make business improvements and by negotiating favorable terms with suppliers

* Strong analytical, problem solving, and troubleshooting skills

#### **General Summary**

The Global Indirect Procurement Manager is responsible for executing the global indirect category management strategy across the organization. This role ensures that indirect procurement activity flows through approved procurement channels and is aligned with defined category strategies for both strategic and non-strategic spend.

The role is accountable for procurement daily operation, supplier selection, commercial terms, cost and value optimization, and supplier performance across the indirect category portfolio.

This role operates as a player-coach, directly leading sourcing, negotiation, and supplier management activities for key categories and suppliers, while supporting and guiding others involved in indirect procurement execution.

#### **Key Responsibilities**

***Procurement Strategy Deployment and Execution***

* Personally lead sourcing events, supplier negotiations, and contract development for key indirect categories and high-impact spend areas.
* Execute the global indirect category management strategy across the organization, translating executive-defined procurement strategy into category plans, sourcing actions, and supplier decisions within the indirect category portfolio.
* Develop and execute category-level sourcing plans, including leading sourcing events, supplier selection, and contract negotiations within the indirect category portfolio.
* Ensure indirect procurement activity flows through approved procurement channels, including catalogs, PunchOut, P-Card, and governed business-led procurement pathways, consistent with defined policies and decision rights.
* Monitor supply market conditions, pricing trends, and supplier developments within indirect categories, identifying opportunities to improve cost, value, service, and supply continuity.

***Drive Success***

* Act as the primary procurement lead on key initiatives and projects involving indirect spend, directly supporting sourcing, supplier selection, and commercial decision-making.
* Partner with stakeholders across functions to understand business requirements, upcoming demand, and operational needs within indirect categories, ensuring sourcing activities are aligned to timing, service expectations, and business priorities.
* Lead and execute sourcing and negotiation activities for assigned indirect categories, directly engaging suppliers and driving commercial outcomes.
* Support cross-functional initiatives, including product development, plant operations, and business services, by ensuring indirect suppliers and commercial arrangements are aligned to project and operational requirements.

* Responsible for all New Product Development (NPD) activities across NAM, covering all product categories.
* Accountable for supplier selection aligned with the strategic supplier list provided by Global Category Managers (GCMs).
* Actively participate in discussions with Marketing and Engineering teams, ensuring procurement strategy is clearly represented and defended.
* Support and drive escalations when required in coordination with Supply Chain.
* Identify, analyze, and execute Sourcing opportunities for assigned commodities.
* Continuously evaluate prices, quality, and reliability of assigned suppliers.
* Negotiate contracts and agreements with suppliers to secure favorable terms.
* Monitor KPIs for assigned suppliers and develop and execute improvement plans as needed.
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders to ensure alignment on sourcing strategies and objectives.
* Seek opportunities to optimize the supply chain and reduce costs of assigned commodities.
* Monitor market trends, industry developments, and regulatory changes that impact assigned commodities.
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with key suppliers and internal stakeholders to foster collaboration and drive mutual success.
* Lead cross-functional teams on sourcing projects and initiatives.
* Provide regular reports and updates to senior management on sourcing activities, performance metrics, and cost savings.
* Lead sourcing activities for assigned new products.
* Own the Packaging and Labor commodities, including:
* + Delivering cost savings
+ Leading development initiatives
+ Driving continuous evolution of the category.

**WHAT WE SEEK**

* 6+ years overall in Supply Chain with a minimum of 5 years of experience in a Sourcing role.
* Proven experience as a sourcing manager or in a similar procurement role, preferably in the manufacturing or retail industry.
* Strong negotiation skills and the ability to build and maintain relationships with suppliers.
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Proficiency in procurement tools, such as ERP systems and supplier management platforms.
* Knowledge of sourcing best practices, supply chain principles, and contract management.
* Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Willingness to travel as needed to visit suppliers and attend meetings or events.
* Experience with ERP and business analytics systems, such as OBI preferred
* Advanced degree or ISM Certified preferred
* Experience working with international teams, particularly with China, Spain, Mexico, Australia preferred

**EDUCATION**

* Bachelor's degree in business administration, supply chain management, or related field.

##### **WHAT WE OFFER**

An exciting opportunity to dive in and begin your career with a company that offers a competitive total rewards package that includes:

* Paid vacation
* Work from home FRIDAYS!
* 11 paid Holidays
* Full range of health benefits including medical, dental & vision, short & long-term disability
* 401(K) matching (100% of first 3% contributed, 50% of the next 2%)
* Health and wellness programs / gym reimbursement
* Educational assistance up to $7,000 per year
* On-site self-service café / free gourmet coffee stations
* Company sponsored FUN events!
* Generous product discounts

Fluidra is a publicly listed company focused on developing innovative products, services and IoT solutions for the residential, commercial and wellness pool markets, globally. The company operates in over 45 countries, has over 7,000 employees and owns a portfolio of some of the industry’s most recognized and trusted brands : Polaris®, Jandy®, CMP, S.R. Smith, and Zodiac®. We also sell products under the Cover ‐ Pools®, iAquaLink®, Grand Effects®, Dell® and Nature2® names. With these combined resources we’re able accelerate innovation in critical areas like energy-efficiency, robotics and the Internet of Things.

Our focus is on creating the perfect pool and wellness experience responsibly. We take our mission to heart, and our employees embody these guiding principles in everything we do: *passion for success, honesty & trust, customer collaboration, teamwork and inclusion, learn and adapt,* excellence and innovation.

description:
The Purchasing Manager is responsible for leading and managing all direct and indirect procurement activities to support business objectives, manufacturing operations, and customer requirements. This role develops sourcing strategies, manages supplier relationships, negotiates contracts, and drives cost reduction initiatives while ensuring the uninterrupted supply of materials, components, equipment, and services.

The Purchasing Manager will work closely with Operations, Engineering, Quality, Program Management, Finance, and suppliers to optimize procurement performance. The ideal candidate will possess strong automotive Tier 1 supplier experience and proven success managing commercial relationships and negotiations with OEM customers and suppliers.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Lead all direct and indirect purchasing activities for manufacturing operations.
* Develop and execute purchasing strategies aligned with regional and global business objectives.
* Manage sourcing, supplier selection, RFQs, negotiations, and contract administration.
* Establish and maintain strategic relationships with suppliers and service providers.
* Support customer programs, product launches, engineering changes, and production requirements.
* Negotiate pricing, commercial terms, tooling agreements, and long-term supply contracts.
* Analyze market trends, commodity fluctuations, and supply chain risks to develop mitigation strategies.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to achieve operational, quality, delivery, and financial objectives.
* Drive annual cost reduction initiatives and support budget planning activities.
* Monitor supplier performance, including quality, delivery, responsiveness, and cost competitiveness.
* Lead supplier business reviews and corrective action activities when performance issues arise.
* Manage inventory levels to support production while minimizing working capital investment.
* Ensure compliance with company purchasing policies, customer requirements, and applicable regulations.
* Develop procurement metrics and reports to support management decision-making.
* Support regional purchasing initiatives led by the Head of Purchasing Americas.
* Lead, mentor, and develop purchasing team members.

**Qualifications**

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Engineering, Operations Management, or a related field.
* CPSM, CPM, APICS/ASCM, or other purchasing certifications preferred.

**Experience**

* Minimum of 7 years of progressive purchasing and procurement experience within an automotive manufacturing environment.
* Minimum of 3 years of leadership or management experience.
* Experience working for an Automotive Tier 1 supplier is required.
* Demonstrated experience managing both direct and indirect purchasing processes.
* Proven experience negotiating commercial agreements, pricing, and supplier contracts.
* Experience supporting automotive OEM customer programs and launch activities.
* Strong understanding of automotive supply chain requirements, customer expectations, and production planning processes.
* Experience with global sourcing and supplier development preferred.

**Leadership Expectations**

* Demonstrates integrity, accountability, and sound business judgment.
* Serves as a strategic business partner to leadership and operational teams.
* Builds strong supplier partnerships that support organizational objectives.
* Drives continuous improvement, cost competitiveness, and supply chain excellence.
* Promotes a culture of collaboration, innovation, and employee development.

**Carcoustics Tech Center North America is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace.**

description:
Fisher Industries is a vertically integrated family of businesses that provides heavy civil construction and aggregate products across the United States. With over 70 years of experience, the company specializes in highways, bridges, aggregates, and large-scale infrastructure projects, supported by in-house capabilities in drilling, blasting, crushing, asphalt, and concrete production. Fisher is committed to delivering innovative, cost-effective solutions with an emphasis on safety and quality. As a proven industry leader, Fisher Industries continues to grow while maintaining the integrity and values of a family-owned company. For additional information about our company, visit our website at www.fisherind.com

**POSITION SCOPE**

The **Parts & Procurement Coordinator** serves as the central communication and coordination hub between Field Operations, Procurement, Warehouse personnel, vendors, and management. This role is responsible for managing procurement request intake, tracking request status, prioritizing operational needs, maintaining procurement records, and ensuring timely communication throughout the purchasing process. By centralizing request management and status reporting, this position allows Procurement Specialists to focus on sourcing, purchasing, vendor management, and expediting activities that support critical construction, aggregate, and equipment operations.

**PRIMARY DUTIES**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for incoming parts, material, and procurement requests from field personnel, supervisors, project managers, mechanics, and operational teams.
* Manage a high volume of incoming communications and procurement-related requests daily.
* Create, document, and maintain procurement requests and work orders within department tracking systems and dashboards.
* Capture and verify required request details including equipment numbers, project information, quantities, priorities, delivery locations, and required completion dates.
* Review requests for accuracy and completeness and route them to the appropriate Procurement Specialist based on business segment, equipment type, or operational need.
* Prioritize requests based on equipment downtime, project schedules, operational urgency, and management direction.
* Maintain current status information for active procurement requests and provide updates to requesting departments.
* Communicate estimated delivery dates, shipment tracking information, backorders, delays, substitutions, and order status updates.
* Escalate urgent, delayed, or stalled requests to Procurement Specialists or department leadership as necessary.
* Track procurement requests from initial intake through completion and verify accurate closeout documentation.
* Coordinate parts and material pickups, transfers, and deliveries with warehouse personnel, drivers, and field teams.
* Maintain organized records including quotes, purchase orders, invoices, tracking information, vendor communications, and procurement documentation.
* Maintain current vendor and supplier contact information and identify potential duplicate requests or communication gaps.
* Document emergency purchases and after-hours procurement activity.
* Prepare and distribute procurement status reports for department leadership and operational stakeholders.
* Assist Procurement Specialists with administrative and reporting responsibilities during periods of high purchasing volume.
* Maintain effective communication between Field Operations, Procurement, Warehouse personnel, and delivery teams.
* Promote safety, efficiency, and teamwork across all business operations.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**REQUIREMENTS**

* High school diploma or GED required; associate degree in business, supply chain, logistics, or related field preferred.
* Previous experience in procurement coordination, purchasing support, parts administration, inventory control, construction operations, fleet maintenance, or related field preferred.
* Strong organizational, multitasking, and time-management skills.
* Ability to prioritize competing demands in a fast-paced operational environment.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite, including Excel, Outlook, and Teams.
* Experience with purchasing, inventory, ERP, fleet management, or work-order tracking systems preferred.
* Strong attention to detail and problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to work effectively with personnel at all organizational levels, vendors, and external partners.
* Knowledge of heavy equipment, construction, aggregate production, trucking, or fleet operations preferred.

Fisher Industries is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

We are a drug-free work environment requiring pre-employment and random drug testing.

If you require an accommodation with applying, please email hrdept@fisherind.com or call the HR Department at (701) 456-9184 to request accommodations. This email is only to request accommodation for

**About The Role**

CV Engineering is seeking an experienced Procurement Specialist to join our project management team and lead procurement activities for major industrial capital projects. This is a hands-on role for someone who knows how to take a procurement package from bidder development through negotiation, award, expediting, and delivery. You will have direct ownership of assigned packages and play an important role in keeping project costs, schedules, and construction activities on track.

Our projects involve a wide range of equipment, materials, fabricated components, installation services, and international suppliers. You'll work directly with project engineering, construction, vendors, and client representatives, with commercial judgment and problem-solving that direct impact on project cost, schedule, and execution.

This is not a purchasing administration role. We're looking for someone who has independently run procurement packages on industrial capital projects and is comfortable owning the commercial process from beginning to end.

**What You'll Do**

* Lead assigned procurement packages from initial sourcing through award, delivery, and closeout.
* Develop bidder lists and issue requests for quotation in accordance with established project procedures.
* Coordinate technical bid evaluations with project engineers and prepare commercial evaluations and bid comparisons.
* Negotiate pricing, lead times, delivery requirements, and commercial terms with vendors.
* Prepare clear award recommendations for client review and approval.
* Assemble purchase order and award packages for client approval and issuance.
* Manage procurement-related changes and commercial adjustments throughout the project.
* Maintain accurate procurement and controls information, including budgets, awarded values, vendors, contract information, schedule status, delivery status, and required dates.
* Prepare weekly procurement reporting and proactively communicate cost, schedule, and delivery risks.
* Expedite awarded packages and work directly with vendors to keep documents, milestones, manufacturing, and deliveries on schedule.
* Track international shipments through freight forwarding, ports, customs, and delivery to the project site.
* Coordinate freight approaches for overseas packages.
* Manage smaller procurement requirements that can otherwise become schedule constraints, including components, materials, instruments, valves, refractory, fabricated items, and other site needs.
* Coordinate installation contractors and local fabricators when required.
* Maintain complete and organized procurement documentation in the project SharePoint environment.
* Serve as the primary commercial point of contact for assigned vendors while coordinating technical questions through the appropriate project personnel.
* Visit project sites and vendor facilities as needed for expediting, inspections, and procurement coordination.

**What We're Looking For**

**Required Qualifications:**

* 5+ years of procurement experience supporting industrial capital projects, such as steel, metals, mining, process plants, or other heavy industrial facilities.
* Experience independently managing packages from bidder development and RFQ through bid evaluation, negotiation, award, and delivery.
* Experience with equipment, construction materials, fabricated components, installation services, and other project-related procurement.
* Experience expediting vendors and managing international shipments, including freight forwarding and customs.
* Strong Microsoft Excel skills and the ability to maintain accurate procurement registers and project data.
* Strong commercial, analytical, and organizational skills.
* Ability to prepare clear, concise recommendations that allow a client or project decision-maker to understand the options, costs, risks, and recommended path forward.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with engineers, project managers, construction personnel, vendors, and client representatives.
* Ability to manage multiple procurement packages simultaneously and proactively address issues before they affect project cost or schedule.
* Ability to work on an active industrial construction site when required.
* Authorized to work in the United States.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with Aconex or a similar project document or bid management platform.
* Experience with furnace, refractory, metals processing, or other industrial process equipment.
* Ability to read Primavera P6 or Microsoft Project schedules and understand how procurement dates affect the overall project schedule.
* Experience working for an owner, EPC, EPCM, or owner's representative organization.
* Experience with an ERP purchasing or procurement module.
* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Construction Management, Business, or a related field.

**Job Summary**

The Procurement Manager, Major Projects, serves as the primary Procurement partner for assigned major transmission capital projects or programs. Embedded within the project team, this senior individual contributor leads procurement integration across materials, equipment, services, construction, supplier capacity, and contracting activities to support successful project delivery.

Working through influence across Procurement, Supply Chain, Engineering, Construction, and Project Controls, the role develops and oversees the integrated procurement plan, anticipates and mitigates risks, aligns procurement activities with project milestones, and provides executive-level visibility into procurement readiness and performance. While not responsible for category strategy, supplier relationship ownership, material tracking, or overall project execution, this position coordinates these capabilities into a unified procurement strategy that supports project success.

**Job Description**

Where Putting the Customer First Powers Everything We Do!

**What You'll Do:**

* Serve as the primary procurement liaison and single point of coordination for assigned major projects, partnering closely with Project Managers, Project Directors, and project leadership.
* Develop, maintain, and drive the integrated project procurement plan, ensuring alignment with engineering, construction, commissioning, and project milestones.
* Translate project schedules and business objectives into coordinated procurement, sourcing, contracting, supplier, and material execution plans.
* Represent project material and capacity requirements within the Transmission COE portfolio planning process and incorporate prioritization decisions into project execution plans.
* Maintain procurement dashboards and risk registers that provide visibility into milestones, supplier capacity, material status, commercial issues, actions, decisions, and executive reporting.
* Coordinate cross-functional execution across Transmission COE, Category Management, PPO, Sourcing, Contracts, Engineering, Project Controls, Construction, Logistics, and other stakeholders.
* Establish clear accountability, decision paths, and escalation processes to resolve procurement issues and risks.
* Partner with Procurement teams to address supplier performance, capacity constraints, category strategies, and commercial considerations.
* Communicate procurement readiness, key risks, mitigation plans, and critical decisions to project leadership.
* Leverage analytics, systems, and continuous improvement practices to enhance sourcing effectiveness, contract visibility, supplier performance, and project outcomes.

**What We're Looking For:**

**Education/Experience:**

* Bachelor's degree in a related field and 8 years of relevant experience.
* Associate's degree in a related field and 10 years of relevant experience; or
* High School Diploma/GED and 12 years of relevant experience.
* Demonstrated success leading complex cross-functional initiatives without direct authority.
* Strong knowledge of procurement processes, contracting, supplier management, supply markets, manufacturing lead times, and delivery assurance.
* Experience supporting large capital, utility, energy, transmission, infrastructure, industrial, or engineering projects.
* Strong stakeholder management, collaboration, and executive communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting transmission, utility, energy, EPC, or infrastructure capital projects.
* Knowledge of project controls, critical path scheduling, commissioning, and construction sequencing.
* Experience managing procurement risks on projects exceeding $100M in capital investment.
* PMP, CPSM, CPSD, SCM, or similar professional certification.
* Experience operating in matrixed and portfolio-based organizations.

**Expected Salary Range:** $120,000.00-$130,000.00 (USD)

Who we are

For more than 40 years, Reworld has been a leader in sustainable waste solutions, providing our customers with innovative solutions that help them achieve carbon-negative outcomes.

Our Vision

Reworld is leading the charge to a carbon-negative future through revolutionary sustainable materials management solutions that reduce, reuse, recycle and reimagine waste for the benefit of society and the environment.

Our Business

Reworld partners with businesses by offering cutting-edge engineering and innovative solutions, to help customers reduce, reuse, recycle and recover value from waste streams and meet or exceed their sustainability goals.

Our Value

Reworld's differentiator comes from our ecosystem of technology, facilities and partnerships, trusted by the world’s largest organizations to reimagine waste management for a smarter, more sustainable world.

All that we’re missing is you. Apply today!

**About the role**

The Procurement Specialist role will be based out of Indianapolis, IN and support multiple Reworld sites within the Indianapolis area. The Procurement role in our facilities contributes to Reworld’s success by effectively leading, developing and executing product and services sourcing strategies for the assigned facilities. The position implements the facility procurement process such that all applicable policies, procedures and regulations are maintained. The position is responsible for the coordination of all procurement activities, ensuring that programs, initiatives, cost reduction, FPP goals, corporate social responsibility and plant/regional/corporate synergies are achieved. The position manages suppliers and internal networks to deliver best in class performance for all spend categories while consistently delivering measurable results to achieve a competitive advantage for top line and bottom-line facility growth. The position collaborates effectively internally and with suppliers, develops effective negotiation strategies in conjunction with Corporate Procurement, and communicates with other Reworld procurement professionals, interfacing closely with Corporate and Regional Procurement Management. The position reports to the Regional Procurement Manager with a strong dotted line to the Facilities Management Team.

***WHAT YOU’LL DO:***

The Procurement Specialist is primarily responsible for managing the local/regional Procurement process in accordance with established Reworld procedures and policies. This role owns all facility Procurement activities from Supplier qualification through performance management and will be responsible for all related supplier onboarding activities as well as assuring compliance with all governmental regulations, company policies and acceptable business practices. The Specialist develops effective working relationships with Facility Operations, Engineering and Maintenance teams and acts as advisor for all contractual rights and obligations.

Specific accountabilities Include (but are not limited to):

* Supplier qualification and relationship management
* Request for Proposal (RFP), Bid receipt, market comparisons, evaluation and analysis and clarifications.
* Identify Global sourcing opportunities based on the maintenance plan and make sure the project timeline is in line with the facility installation schedule.
* Coordinating and participating in bid conferences/walk downs.
* Finalization activities (negotiations, awarding of contracts, follow-up, management, and dispute resolutions)
* Purchase orders, Approval, placement and expediting for all the sites.
* Administration of cost reduction and supplier quality assurance programs
* Performance Analysis and compliance oversight of suppliers/vendors to determine necessity for amendments or extensions of contracts.
* Compiling data for preparing cost reporting in support of the annual budgeting process.
* Providing site training and instruction of all personnel for Procurement systems
* Management of supplier interface, strengthening the supplier data base through the use of supplier visits and technical conferences
* Attending Corporate and regional Procurement meetings and conferences as required
* Directing and coordinating the activities of facility personnel who are engaged in formulating requests for proposals for the facility.
* Sourcing maintenance spare parts from other Reworld facilities to maintain the corporate inventory pool to an optimum level between facilities who share common spare parts.
* Collaborate with storekeepers and Procurement associates to identify savings opportunities.
* Ensure the company policies and procedures are implemented and followed by the buyers, storekeepers, and procurement associates.
* Manage the P-card spend and reconcile weekly.
* Schedule Weekly meetings with the staff, Monthly Open PO review with the site, and Match exemption reports with AP.

***WHAT YOU’LL BRING:***

*Education:*

A bachelor’s degree is required; preferably Supply Chain, Finance

**About Mayesh**
================

Mayesh Wholesale Florist is a family-owned wholesale flower distributor with a long-standing history in the floral industry dating back to 1938. With approximately 400 team members and locations across multiple states, Mayesh provides fresh flowers, floral supplies, and hardgoods to professional florists and floral businesses throughout the country.

As Mayesh continues to grow, we are looking for talented professionals who can help strengthen our operations, build scalable processes, and support the company’s continued success. This role offers an opportunity to make a meaningful impact on how Mayesh manages its floral supplies and hardgoods category across the organization.

**Position Purpose**
--------------------

* The Category Manager – Floral Supplies is responsible for the overall strategy, performance, and standardization of Mayesh Wholesale Florist's hardgoods and floral supplies category across multiple branch locations.
* Reporting directly to the Chief Operating Officer, this position provides leadership for category strategy, inventory optimization, purchasing practices, vendor relationships, pricing strategy, assortment governance, SKU management, and product lifecycle management. Working collaboratively with Branch Managers and Hardgoods Leads, the Category Manager establishes company-wide standards and best practices that improve inventory performance, profitability, consistency, and customer satisfaction.
* This position serves as the company's primary business owner for the floral supplies category and is responsible for driving continuous improvement, supporting branch operations, and developing scalable processes that support future growth, acquisitions, and new branch openings.

**Category Management & Product Strategy**
------------------------------------------

* Manage the overall performance of the floral supplies and hardgoods category across multiple branch locations.
* Develop category strategies supporting sales growth, margin improvement, inventory efficiency, pricing strategy, and product assortment.
* Research new products, suppliers, and category opportunities.
* Analyze product profitability and recommend pricing adjustments.
* Evaluate promotional pricing and effectiveness.

**Inventory Management & Purchasing**
-------------------------------------

* Monitor inventory investment, turns, stock levels, and replenishment practices.
* Identify slow-moving, obsolete, duplicate, and excess inventory.
* Partner with branches to improve purchasing decisions and forecasting.

**SKU & Assortment Governance**
-------------------------------

* Own company-wide SKU and assortment governance.
* Standardize product setup, naming conventions, units of measure, and purchasing practices.
* Approve new SKUs, substitutions, and assortment exceptions.
* Serve as business owner for floral supplies master data.
* Partner with Operations and IT & Business Systems to maintain data quality.

**Vendor & Supplier Management**
--------------------------------

* Develop supplier relationships.
* Negotiate pricing, rebates, freight, and promotional programs.
* Evaluate vendor performance and identify sourcing opportunities.

**Branch Support & Training**
-----------------------------

* Partner with Branch Managers and Hardgoods Leads.
* Travel to branches to review inventory, merchandising, and purchasing practices.
* Provide training and support acquisitions and new branch openings.

**Reporting & Analysis**
------------------------

* Develop KPIs for sales, margin, inventory turns, fill rates, vendor performance, and inventory investment.
* Present recommendations and performance metrics to leadership.

**Preferred Experience**
------------------------

* 5+ years in category management, merchandising, purchasing, inventory management, or wholesale distribution.
* Experience with ERP systems and inventory management software; NetSuite experience is a plus.
* Experience negotiating with vendors and managing large SKU portfolios.
* Multi-location wholesale, floral, agricultural, retail, or supply chain experience preferred.

**Skills & Attributes**
-----------------------

* Strong analytical and communication skills.
* Ability to influence without direct authority.
* Strong organizational and project management abilities.
* Willingness to travel periodically.

**Success in This Role**
------------------------

* Improve inventory turns, margins, vendor partnerships, pricing discipline, SKU and assortment governance, and standardization across all branch locations.

1. By opting in, you agree to receive text messages from Mayesh Wholesale Florist regarding your candidacy, including appointment reminders, notifications about pending items or required actions, interview scheduling updates, and general communications related to your application and hiring process.

2. You can cancel the SMS service at any time. Just text "STO

description:
8901 - Corp Office West Crk - 12800 Tuckahoe Creek Parkway, Richmond, Virginia, 23238

CarMax, the way your career should be!

The Senior Buyer coordinates, manages, and negotiates supplier and stakeholder relationships, projects, contracts, and purchasing activities related to the procurement of CarMax branded materials in support of the Store Marketing Team and CarMax Marketing Operations.

**What You Will Do**
====================

**Procurement Project Management and Implementation**
-----------------------------------------------------

Manage and implement procurement projects:

* Proactively work with the Store Marketing team and other business partners to identify needs and research new products and suppliers to support new or ongoing business requirements and/or projects
* Support on-time delivery and installation of all marketing materials for grand openings and remodels
* Coordinate and lead cross-functional project teams, with an eye toward continuous improvement
* Implement new programs, products, or services for a particular store location and campaigns on a nationwide/company-wide basis

**Supplier Management and Coordination**
----------------------------------------

Manage supplier relationships across the print and promotions category with CarMax's strategic partners:

* Monitor supplier performance for adherence to contracts and service level agreements
* Independently resolve supplier performance issues
* Create and review supplier scorecards
* Conduct regularly scheduled meetings and reviews with suppliers and stakeholders to ensure open communication and collaboration
* Analyze purchases with suppliers and regularly identify savings opportunities and efficiencies
* Review industry/commodity data to stay informed of industry changes and trends
* Lead cross-functional RFI and RFP sourcing events
* Identify and develop diverse sources to support CarMax in branded material (primarily print) production engagements

**Customer Relationship Management**
------------------------------------

Coordinate and assist in managing the business relationship with the Store Marketing team:

* Participate in and lead continuous improvement initiatives
* Participate in weekly standups and project planning meetings
* Ensure customer and stakeholder expectations and requirements are met
* Update project trackers on a weekly basis to ensure accurate, timely visibility into project status for stakeholders, including SS&P management

**Supplier Contract Coordination and Negotiation**
--------------------------------------------------

Coordinate, monitor, and assist in the negotiation of contracts and agreements to ensure they are amended or executed in support of the ongoing partnership:

* Negotiate standard procurement terms and conditions
* Make recommendations and assist in negotiating contract terms such as pricing, length of agreement, inventory stocking, delivery, and service levels
* Monitor and regularly review existing contracts

**Marketing Sourcing Team Coverage and Support**
------------------------------------------------

* Other duties as assigned

**Qualifications and Requirements**
===================================

* Previous procurement/buying and supplier management experience required (5+ years)
* Experience in the marketing and/or printing industry (5+ years)
* Four-year degree preferred, but not required
* Project management experience required (3+ years)
* Proven success in building relationships
* CarMax-specific experience preferred
* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Strong internal and external customer service and organization skills
* Strong teamwork behaviors in line with CarMax values
* Ability to work independently with limited supervision
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple tasks, prioritize, and stay results-focused
* Ability to establish working relationships with associates at all levels of the company

**Work Location and Arrangement:** **This role will be based out of the CarMax Home Office in Richmond, VA** **and Associates will work onsite 4 days per week.**
=================================================================================================================================================================

**Work Authorization:** Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. Sponsorship will not be considered for this specific role.

CarMax disrupted the auto industry by delivering the honest, transparent and high-integrity experience customers want and deserve. This innovative thinking around the way cars are bought and sold has helped us become the nation’s largest retailer of used cars, with over 250 locations nationwide.

About Us

Join a talented team of engineering professionals at Vogt Power International Inc. Vogt is based in Louisville, KY and specializes in the design, manufacture and supply of equipment and solutions to the power generation industry. We are an industry leader in heat recovery steam generators (HRSGs) with both domestic and international customers.

Position Summary

The Vogt Power Global Sourcing Manager reports to the Senior Director of Supply Management and leads strategic sourcing, supplier development, and competitive bid analysis for assigned commodities and products. The position expands and strengthens the global supply base to improve competitiveness, capacity, quality, and supply continuity. The Global Sourcing Manager identifies, evaluates, and develops qualified, competitive global suppliers and fabricators for materials and components used in Heat Recovery Steam Generators (HRSGs) and other boiler applications.

Essential Functions/Responsibilities

* Monitor global market conditions, pricing trends, supply risks, capacity constraints, and regional developments affecting assigned commodities and products, and translate findings into sourcing recommendations.
* Assess supplier capacity against forecasted demand and proactively qualify alternative sources for constrained or high risk commodity categories.
* Maintain the Approved Vendor List (AVL), document supplier qualification status, and ensure newly approved suppliers are included in applicable bid packages.
* Identify commodities, products, and regions with limited or high risk sourcing coverage, prioritize the gaps, and develop action plans to qualify competitive alternative suppliers.
* Develop and manage long term relationships with strategic suppliers to improve competitiveness, capacity alignment, quality, delivery performance, and responsiveness across projects.
* Work closely with key suppliers to align capacity and product qualifications with forecasted requirements.
* Serve as the global sourcing subject matter expert for Buyers and Project Procurement Managers by recommending qualified sources, addressing supplier capacity constraints, and supporting sourcing strategies for assigned commodities and products.
* Provide quarterly updates to business unit leadership on supplier qualifications, sourcing gaps, capacity risks, market developments, and progress against strategic sourcing initiatives.
* Develop and support the negotiation of strategic capacity agreements and long term agreements for assigned commodities and products, as directed by the Director of Supply Management.
* Support the Estimating and Proposals teams by developing supplier pricing, validating sourcing assumptions, and maintaining current and historical pricing data for assigned commodities and products.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Reasonable Accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or Chemical Engineering from an accredited institution preferred. Candidates with a business-related degree and relevant industry experience may also be considered.
* Five (5) to ten (10) years of Global Sourcing Experience with a focus on Power Generation Boiler Products including Pressure Vessel, Pipe/Valve/Fittings and/or Steel Fabrication. A strong understanding of ASME materials and manufacturing operations is required. The successful candidate will possess a deep understanding of procurement governance, contracting, policy compliance, and Global Sourcing practices.
* Requires above average computer skills including MS Office products, specifically Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint applications. Database, MRP and ERP Software knowledge is a plus.
* No certificates required. CPM Certification or equivalent is a plus.
* Strong analytical and negotiation skills are required. Solid foundational math skills and advanced problem-solving abilities are required. Excellent verbal and written communication skills are essential. Must have a valid passport and be able to travel frequently and for extended periods. Strong working knowledge of business law principles and general accounting practices. Must possess exceptional time management and organizational skills.

To provide greater transparency to candidates, we include base pay ranges for all US-based job postings that encompass all potential locations and levels for the open position. Our base pay ranges are set based on the function, discipline, level and regional location and are benchmarked against companies in the same or similar industry. Final offers may vary based on multiple factors, including education, depth and relevance of work experience, relevant licenses and certifications, and may vary from the amounts listed in the job posting.

=================================

Location:
Eden Prairie, US

Job ID: 55544

**Stratasys is a world leader in 3D printing!**

**Stratasys** is leading the global shift to additive manufacturing with innovative 3D printing solutions for industries such as aerospace, automotive, consumer products, and healthcare. Through smart and connected 3D printers, polymer materials, a software ecosystem, and parts on demand, Stratasys solutions deliver competitive advantages at every stage in the product value chain. The world’s leading organizations turn to Stratasys to transform product design, bring agility to manufacturing and supply chains, and improve patient care.

Location

Eden Prairie, MN

Position description

The Commodity Manager – Mechanical develops and executes global sourcing strategies for mechanical commodities, including precision-machined components, sheet metal and fabricated assemblies, castings, extrusions, injection-molded parts, standard hardware, and related mechanical assemblies. This role owns supplier relationships, cost, quality, tooling, capacity, and supply continuity across the mechanical commodity portfolio. Working closely with Engineering, Operations, and Quality, you will support new product development and ongoing production by securing competitive, capable, and reliable sources of supply.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities include the following:

* Develop and execute multi-year sourcing strategies for assigned mechanical commodities to optimize total cost of ownership, supply assurance, quality, manufacturability, and innovation.
* Lead RFI, RFQ, and RFP events; conduct should-cost and benchmarking analyses; and drive competitive bidding for machined parts, sheet metal and fabrications, castings, extrusions, injection-molded components, standard hardware, and related assemblies.
* Analyze raw-material indices, manufacturing processes, tooling, labor, capacity, and regional market dynamics to identify risks and opportunities and deliver annual cost-reduction targets.
* Own end-to-end supplier relationships, including performance scorecards, business reviews, capability assessments, and continuous-improvement initiatives.
* Negotiate pricing, contracts, payment and delivery terms, tooling provisions, and long-term agreements that deliver measurable value.
* Manage supplier risk, including financial health, geographic concentration, single-source exposure, manufacturing capacity, and critical tooling; partner with Quality on corrective actions, first article inspection, process qualification, and defect reduction.
* Partner with Engineering during new product introduction to influence design for cost, manufacturability, quality, and supply availability, including material and process selection, drawing and specification reviews, supplier qualification, tooling strategy, and alternate sourcing.
* Apply design-for-manufacturability and value-engineering principles to improve component cost and scalability.
* Monitor and mitigate constrained capacity, tooling failures, raw-material volatility, long lead times, and single-source dependencies to help ensure uninterrupted production.

Basic Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Business, or a related field.
* At least five years of progressive experience in procurement, strategic sourcing, or commodity management, including direct ownership of mechanical commodities such as precision-machined parts, sheet metal and fabricated assemblies, castings, extrusions, injection-molded components, standard hardware, or related mechanical assemblies.
* Demonstrated success negotiating supplier contracts and long-term agreements and delivering year-over-year cost reductions.
* Strong should-cost modeling and data-analysis skills, with working knowledge of mechanical manufacturing processes, technical drawings and specifications, and tooling economics.
* Proficiency with ERP/MRP systems such as SAP or Oracle and Microsoft Excel.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience in a manufacturing, industrial equipment, or hardware-driven industry with complex mechanical components and assemblies.
* Familiarity with new product introduction, design for manufacturability, value engineering, and design-for-cost or design-for-supply principles.
* Professional certification such as CPSM, C.P.M., APICS, or CPIM.
* Experience managing global suppliers across multiple regions.

**COMMODITY MANAGER – STEEL**

**Supply Chain | St. Joseph, Missouri**

**ABOUT ALTEC**

Altec is a leading provider of products and services for the electric utility, telecommunications, tree care, lights and signs, and contractor markets. For nearly a century, Altec has been committed to helping customers safely and reliably build and maintain critical infrastructure.

At Altec, our values guide everything we do:

**Customer First • Enjoyment of Work • Family • Financial Stability • Integrity • People Are Our Greatest Strength • Quality • Spiritual Development • Teamwork**

We offer a collaborative environment where associates are empowered to innovate, solve complex challenges, and make meaningful contributions to our customers and communities.

**ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY**

Altec is seeking an experienced professional to join our Strategic Sourcing team, located in St. Joseph, Missouri, as a **Commodity Manager – Steel**.

This role is responsible for developing and executing sourcing strategies, managing supplier relationships, negotiating agreements, identifying cost reduction opportunities, and ensuring continuity of supply for steel commodities supporting manufacturing operations.

While steel is the primary focus of this position, the Commodity Manager may also support other commodity categories. Category assignments and areas of responsibility may be adjusted over time based on business needs, organizational structure, workload, and staffing.

The successful candidate will partner closely with Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations, Materials, and Quality teams across the organization to support both current production and future business growth.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

**As the Commodity Manager for Steel, you will:**

* Develop and execute sourcing strategies for steel commodities supporting manufacturing operations.
* Create, negotiate, implement, and manage short- and long-term commodity supply agreements.
* Develop, identify, and implement cost reduction strategies that deliver measurable results.
* Research and evaluate suppliers, market conditions, pricing trends, availability, and supply chain risks.
* Develop and maintain a robust supplier network that supports quality, delivery, and cost objectives.
* Lead supplier qualification, development, and performance improvement initiatives.
* Partner closely with Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations, Quality, and Supply Chain teams to support current production and future business needs.
* Monitor industry trends and maintain awareness of developments affecting steel supply, pricing, and availability.
* Drive year-over-year material cost improvements within assigned commodity areas.
* Serve as the primary escalation point for supplier-related quality, delivery, and service concerns.
* Support new product development activities through supplier engagement and sourcing expertise.
Coach and support purchasing and materials team members on commodity trends, supplier capabilities, and cost management opportunities.

**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree.
* Six years of applicable experience in procurement, supply chain, manufacturing, engineering, materials management, operations, or a related field.
* Strong supplier-management and negotiation experience.
* Excellent analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to develop sourcing strategies and evaluate supplier performance.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office.

*Should the selected candidate meet the qualifications of a more experienced level within the career path, the job level may be adjusted.*

**Preferred Experience**

**We are particularly interested in candidates who bring technical expertise and operational knowledge to the role, including:**

* Experience sourcing steel, fabricated steel components, tube, plate, sheet, structural steel, or related materials.
* Knowledge of steelmaking and fabrication processes, metallurgy, material specifications, or industrial manufacturing applications.
* Experience in materials management, engineering, production management, or an engineered-products manufacturing environment.
* Experience evaluating supplier capabilities, quality systems, and production processes.
* MBA, APICS certification, or equivalent professional certification.

**What Success Looks Like**

**Successful candidates will demonstrate:**

* A strong record of developing and implementing sourcing strategies.
* Proven success achieving cost reduction and continuous improvement objectives.
* The ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders and drive strategic decisions.
* Strong analytical skills combined with sound business judgment.
* A proactive approach to supplier development, risk mitigation, and total cost management.
* A commitment to quality, safety, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.

Our mission at Oura is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles.

Empowering the world starts with living our values and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office.

We are looking for a Senior Sourcing Manager to lead end to end category strategy and supplier execution for silicon and electrical components supporting our current and next generation hardware roadmap. This role will partner closely with Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Hardware and Electrical Engineering, Science, Product, Finance, Legal, suppliers, and contract manufacturers to develop resilient, cost optimized sourcing strategies, align technical and commercial requirements, lead RFQs and negotiations, and drive supplier performance across capacity, clear to build readiness, delivery, quality, and cost.

**This is a hybrid role requiring someone to be able to work 2-3 days a week out of our San Francisco office.**

### **What You Will Do:**

* Collaborate with EE engineering teams to influence and align supplier product roadmaps with the company's long-term hardware strategy and product lineup.
* Secure reliable component supply and locked-in commercial terms to support both production demand and engineering builds for NPI programs across the full EE component portfolio.
* Apply deep understanding of pricing structures and cost drivers for EE components to lead cost analysis activities at the module and component level, and negotiate with suppliers to meet or beat target cost objectives.
* Own forecast alignment and supplier capacity planning to safeguard supply continuity for development, pilot, and mass production needs
* Proactively monitor global silicon market dynamics, technology trends, and capacity/geopolitical risks, translating insights into category strategies and mitigation plans

### **What you'll bring**

* 5+ years of work experience in PCB, PCBA, FPC, or SiP sourcing or procurement
* Bachelor of Science degree in Electrical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Supply Chain, or related field, Master's Degree a plus
* Proven experience in negotiating commercials and a deep understanding of should cost
* Excellent negotiation and communication skills (written and verbal)
* History in working supply escalations and managing forecasts and commitments with vendors
* Ability to thrive in ambiguity, can manage multiple complex projects in a fast-paced, rapidly evolving environment
* Ability to travel 25% of the time, both domestically and internationally

### **Nice to have:**

* Experience working with Tier‑1 FPC and PCB foundry suppliers and Surface Mount Technology partners across Asia, North America, and/or Europe
* Background in high‑volume consumer electronics and CM/ODM/JDM manufacturing models is strongly preferred
* Strong understanding of PCB, FPC supply chain and processes needed to produce finished goods

### **Benefits**

At Ōura, we care about you and your well-being. Everyone here at Ōura has a ring of their own and we are continually looking to improve employee health.

What we offer:

* Competitive salary and equity packages
* Health, dental, vision insurance, and mental health resources
* An Ōura Ring of your own plus employee discounts for friends & family
* 20 days of paid time off plus 13 paid holidays plus 8 days of flexible wellness time off
* Paid sick leave and parental leave

Ōura takes a market-based approach to pay, which may vary depending on your location. US locations are categorized into tiers based on a cost of labor index for that geographic area. While most offers will be closer to the starting range, successful candidates' pay will be determined based on job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, internal peer equity, and market conditions. These ranges may be modified in the future.

San Francisco Salary Range: $172,550 - $203,000

A recruiter can determine your Region based on your US location.

We are not considering candidates residing in the following states: Alaska (AK), Delaware (DE), Iowa (IA), Mississippi (MS), Nebraska (NE), South Dakota (SD), West Virginia (WV), and Wisconsin (WI).

Oura is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Individuals seeking employment at Oura are considered without regard to age, ancestry, color, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), gender identity or expression, genetic information, mar
