Our work is guided by our purpose: creating an energy-resilient world for a better future. This purpose embodies the legacy we bring, with more than 100 years as the global leader in energy resilience, delivering solutions critical to sustain and improve life.

Our teams have the opportunity to provide a critical resource – energy – that ensures safety, security, and independence for people around the world. Our team members are focused on pushing boundaries, continuing to innovate in an ever-changing landscape, and keeping up with the pace required to create solutions for today’s world demands.

Our product range includes engines, generators, power conversion, UPS systems, EV components and electrification solutions, microgrid controls and management, and clean energy solutions that serve a broad spectrum of OEM, residential, industrial, and commercial customers. At Rehlko, you have the freedom to identify, create, and deliver solutions – large and small – that help people and communities thrive in the moments that matter.

At Rehlko, our team members are the essential energy that powers our organization’s success. We are committed to fostering a safe and sustainable work environment where safety is everyone’s responsibility. We empower every team member to actively participate in our Zero Is Possible safety culture by encouraging open communication, proactively reporting hazards, following protocols, and suggesting improvements. Join us in creating an energy resilient world for a better future!

**What We Offer**

At Rehlko, our Total Rewards programs are designed to accelerate growth, energize performance, and support a culture of inclusion at every stage of life and work. We offer total rewards that are easily understood, recognize results, enable career mobility, and reflect our commitment to valuing diverse needs in a fast-moving world. We provide:

* Competitive compensation and benefits
* Work-life flexibility
* Recognition and rewards
* Development and career opportunities
* A safe and inclusive workplace

**Why You Will Love this Job**

Create and maintain supplier source and price records in SAP, and resolve invoice discrepancies, if they arise. Provide supplier performance feedback. Provide assistance to the material planners, when needed, by following up on orders to ensure proper handling and on-time delivery.

* Lead global sourcing initiatives from concept to completion. * Coordinate cross functionally with internal teams and suppliers to source new and resource existing products under the guidelines of the global procurement policy manual.

description:
Every day, MTI Motion associates around the world set the future in motion by solving our customers' most vexing motion-control challenges. Serving various industries including commercial aerospace, defense, oil and gas, and transportation, MTI Motion designs and manufactures an innovative portfolio of custom, precision motion-control products and solutions, including high-performance motors, drives and controllers, as well as windings, gears and ball screws.

We're committed to promoting a collaborative team environment that focuses on accountability, respect, integrity, and teamwork to ensure customer satisfaction. We take pride in the work we perform and are committed to continuous improvement. In addition to offering a competitive benefits package, we strive to offer our employees opportunities to achieve career advancement.

MTI Motion is a wholly owned operating company within the Steel Partners family of companies and is headquartered in Pleasant Prairie, WI, with facilities worldwide.

**POSITION OVERVIEW**

The Commodity Manager will manage the sourcing of assigned category portfolio and associated activities. This includes, but is not limited to, maximizing supplier performance, cost, quality, and speed of execution, leading cost-savings and avoidance projects, and other sourcing-related activities. This role leads negotiations of long-term supply agreements and other contracts, which include pricing, terms and conditions, risk mitigations, working-capital strategies, and warranties.

The Commodity Manager will develop, implement, and manage global strategies to provide value in supply assurance, pricing, flexibility, quality, and delivery performance. This position benchmarks new processes, approaches, and technology. The Commodity Manager researches, identifies, and analyzes current and emerging procurement trends, develops a deep understanding of market conditions, and develops proposed global supply chain solutions focusing on total cost of ownership.

**ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS**

**Category Management**

* Responsible for all areas of category management, including category business plans, global market and pricing analysis, and procurement support.
* Contribute to development of the company's strategic category objectives and goals.
* Develop global category strategies with defined plans for cost savings, risk assessment and mitigation, and service-level agreements.
* Develop and execute category negotiation strategies with suppliers, including specific targets for purchasing, pricing, service, quality, intellectual property, tool ownership, exclusivity, and inventory to ensure continuity of supply and minimize risk.
* Monitor current category market conditions and technology roadmaps, identifying supply/demand challenges and opportunities to mitigate supply and demand challenges.
* Become a subject matter expert in assigned commodities through external research, benchmarking, and analyzing cost drivers and life-cycle costs. Provide market intelligence and category price trends. Develop deep understanding where our competition sources their components and materials, as well as determining the respective costs of same.
* Assist in the development and maintenance of should-cost models that are relevant to the global marketplace.

**Sourcing Management**

* Use strategic sourcing process to manage assigned categories and finished products. Identify all stakeholders for each major category and form cross-functional teams to define and implement a strategy that reduces cost, improves quality and delivery performance, and improves MTI Motion's competitive position. Build a case for significant change and develop consensus among key stakeholders.
* Conduct comprehensive supplier analysis, including strategic direction, capacity, market and industry position, and risk assessment.
* Provide rigorous analysis of spend data and market trends and dynamics to prioritize and launch sourcing initiatives within designated spend/category categories.

**Overview of Job Description:**

The Senior Purchasing Manager is responsible for leading and executing the organization’s purchasing function to achieve service, inventory, and cost objectives. This role combines **strategic oversight with hands-on execution**, serving as a player-coach who actively supports the purchasing team when needed.

This individual applies a **comprehensive knowledge of purchasing principles and supply chain practices** to manage vendor relationships, ensure quality standards, and control costs, while leading a team and administering established policies and procedures.

**Specific Duties and Responsibilities:**

***Leadership & Team Management***

* Lead, direct, and develop a team of buyers, with full authority for personnel decisions
* Foster a high-performance, accountable culture focused on execution, responsiveness, and continuous improvement
* Provide day-to-day coaching, training, and hands-on support to team members
* Step in to directly manage purchasing activities during high-volume periods, team absences, or complex issues

***Hands-On Purchasing & Execution***

* Perform and oversee complex purchasing tasks following established processes and policies
* Actively participate in purchasing activities such as **placing orders, expediting shipments, resolving shortages, and addressing vendor issues**
* Ensure timely and accurate procurement aligned with forecast and inventory plans
* Support buyers in troubleshooting supply chain challenges and escalations

***Vendor Management & Negotiation***

* Identify, evaluate, select, and negotiate with vendors to **maximize quality while controlling costs**
* Develop and maintain strong vendor relationships to ensure reliability and service performance
* Address and resolve vendor issues related to **quality, delivery, shipping, and invoicing**
* Continuously assess supplier performance and identify opportunities for improvement or cost savings

***Procurement Processes & Compliance***

* Develop and manage purchasing procedures, including **RFP, RFQ, bid processes, purchase orders, and requisitions**
* Ensure procurement activities meet quality standards while minimizing total cost
* Administer established purchasing policies and ensure compliance with company guidelines
* Partner with Compliance and Quality Assurance teams in vendor approval and qualification processes

***Cross-Functional Collaboration***

* Work closely with Design, Product Development, Sales, Inventory Planning, and Warehouse teams
* Support internal stakeholders in identifying sourcing solutions aligned with business needs
* Collaborate with Inventory Management to ensure accurate forecasting and inventory planning
* Ensure alignment between purchasing execution and broader operational goals

***Process Improvement & Operational Oversight***

* Evaluate and improve purchasing processes to increase efficiency, accuracy, and scalability
* Analyze purchasing data, vendor performance, and inventory trends to drive improvements
* Primarily administer established policies and procedures while contributing to **process enhancements and procedural changes**
* Support departmental budgeting and provide input into strategic planning initiatives

**Knowledge/Skills/Education/Experience:**

***Skills & Competencies***

* Comprehensive knowledge of purchasing, sourcing, and supply chain principles
* Proven ability to **lead while remaining hands-on in execution**
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and negotiation skills
* Detail-oriented with the ability to manage complex tasks and priorities
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
* Advanced proficiency in **MS Excel and Microsoft Office tools**

***Education & Experience***

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, Operations, or related field preferred
* **7+ years of purchasing experience**, preferably in manufacturing, consumer goods, or gift industries
* Demonstrated experience managing people while actively handling purchasing responsibilities
* Global sourcing experience a plus
* Food industry experience a plus

***Key Role Expectations***

* Functions as a **working manager**, not solely a delegator
* Balances **tactical execution with leadership responsibilities**
* Provides **direct, hands-on support** to ensure team success and continuity of operations
* Drives both **operational excellence and continuous improvement**

Pay: $125,000.00 - $140,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Employee discount
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Experience:

* Purchasing: 7 years (Required)
* Food industry: 5 years (Preferred)
* Manufacturing: 5 years (Preferred)
* Sourcing: 5 years (Preferred)
* Microsoft Excel: 5 years (Preferred)

Ability to Commute:

* Fullerton, CA 92835 (Required)

Work Location: In person

**Job Title:** Purchasing Specialist (Buyer)
**Job Location:** San Francisco-USA-94128
**Work Location Type:** On-Site
**Salary Range:** $25.00 - 32.00 per hour

**About us**
------------

Since 1942, SkyChefs has taken culinary excellence to new heights. As a trusted partner to the nation’s leading airlines and retailers, we proudly deliver millions of meals and exceptional service experiences every year across 43 sites throughout the United States. Built on a legacy of operational excellence, culinary expertise, and continuous innovation, we are committed to setting the industry standard in aviation culinary, airline services, last-mile logistics, and retail commerce. From the kitchen to the runway, our teams work together to deliver quality, reliability, and service at every altitude. Our people are the heart of everything we do. At SkyChefs, a career is more than a job – it’s an opportunity to grow, lead, and make an impact in a fast-paced, team-driven environment. Join America’s first, foremost, and finest and take your career to new heights.

**Role Purpose Statement**
--------------------------

The plays a vital role in supporting an efficient and reliable supply chain by sourcing, purchasing, and managing assigned categories of goods and services. This position is responsible for developing and maintaining strong supplier relationships while ensuring the timely availability of products needed to support daily operations.

Key responsibilities include procuring produce, frozen foods, and other food-related commodities, monitoring inventory levels, and managing expired or obsolete inventory to minimize waste, control costs, and maximize operational efficiency.

Working closely with internal stakeholders, vendors, and Customer Service Center teams, the Buyer helps drive supply chain performance by ensuring product availability, maintaining cost-effective purchasing practices, and supporting the delivery of exceptional service to both internal and external customers. Success in this role requires strong organizational skills, attention to detail, sound decision-making, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.

**Main Accountabilities**
-------------------------

* Conduct market research on products, suppliers, and pricing to identify sources that meet customer specifications, quality standards, and business requirements.
* Monitor product costs and market trends, proactively recommending solutions to mitigate the impact of price fluctuations.
* Strategically source food ingredients and products to achieve the optimal balance of cost, quality, and availability while meeting customer and Retail Sales requirements.
* Coordinate purchasing activities with vendors, including pricing updates, order cancellations, discontinued items, approved substitutions, backorders, delivery schedule changes, and invoice discrepancy resolution.
* Prepare, analyze, and maintain ingredient costing throughout the menu development process, incorporating supplier cost revisions as needed.
* Leverage knowledge of product availability, supplier capabilities, and industry innovations to recommend standardized products and value-driven solutions to customers.
* Support customer projects by ensuring purchases align with negotiated pricing agreements and established sourcing strategies.
* Assist with menu presentation preparation, including ordering product samples, confirming receipt, and collaborating with Category Managers to validate ingredient and packaging costs.
* Partner with Program Management and Pricing teams to ensure sourced products meet customer specifications and program requirements.
* Establish and maintain new product records within distribution and internal LSG systems.
* Collaborate with Customer Service Centers (CSC) to minimize dead stock inventory through resale opportunities, inventory transfers, or salvage solutions.
* Negotiate supplier agreements, evaluate vendor quotations, and ensure competitive pricing and product specifications through strategic sourcing and supplier benchmarking.
* Support Quality Assurance initiatives by collecting and maintaining product specifications, nutritional information, and related documentation.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Customer satisfaction and responsiveness
* On-time and within-budget completion of sourcing and customer projects
* Product cost optimization and savings achievement
* Supplier performance and service levels
* Inventory management and reduction of excess/dead stock
* Process efficiency and continuous improvement initiatives
* Compliance with customer specifications, quality standards, and purchasing policies

**Knowledge, Skills and Experience**
------------------------------------

1 to 3 years of purchasing, procurement, supply chain, or related experience required
Working knowledge of SAP preferred
Demonstrated ability to build and maintain effective relationships with internal stakeholders and business partners

description:
We are looking for a **Procurement Manager** to ensure **efficient, reliable, and standardized procurement execution across all sites** , supporting production continuity and customer commitments.

The role plays a key part in **driving supplier performance and operational excellence** , while ensuring strict alignment with sourcing strategies, contracts, and global procurement processes.

Acting as a **key interface between suppliers and operations** , you will manage end-to-end execution from purchase order to delivery, with a strong focus on:

* MRP execution
* inventory control
* on-time delivery
* shortage mitigation

You will also contribute actively to **S&OP** , ensuring procurement execution is fully aligned with demand and supply plans.

\\_\\_

**Key responsibilities**

**Procurement Operations**

* Manage and standardize procurement execution across sites (POs, confirmations, expediting)
* Ensure alignment with MRP signals and planning priorities
* Act as a coordination point across sites

**MRP Execution & Inventory Control**

* Ensure effective execution of MRP signals (requisitions, rescheduling, cancellations)
* Control inventory levels (safety stock, excess & obsolete, turns)
* Work closely with Planning to balance service level and constraints
* Contribute to parameter optimization (lead time, MOQ, stock)

**Supplier Order Management & Delivery Performance**

* Drive supplier **on-time delivery (OTD)** performance
* Manage confirmations, backlog, and late orders
* Escalate critical topics with sourcing teams

**Material Availability & Prioritization**

* Secure material availability for operations
* Manage shortages and prioritization across sites
* Anticipate risks via Planning and S&OP interactions

**ERP Governance & Data Consistency**

* Ensure consistency of procurement master data
* Maintain strict ERP discipline in execution and transactions

**Supplier Performance (Operational)**

* Track supplier KPIs globally (OTD, backlog, responsiveness)
* Participate in operational reviews for key suppliers
* Escalate structural issues to sourcing

**Team Management**

* Lead and develop procurement teams across sites
* Ensure clear prioritization aligned with business needs

**Process & Continuous Improvement**

* Deploy best practices in procurement and MRP execution
* Improve lead times, inventory turns, and shortage reduction
* Define and track KPIs at network level

**S&OP Contribution**

* Represent Procurement in S&OP governance
* Provide visibility on supplier constraints and risks
* Ensure alignment with supply and inventory plans

\\_\\_

**Profile**

* Bachelor’s degree (Supply Chain, Business, Engineering or related)
* 10+ years of experience in **operational procurement (not sourcing)**
* Experience in **industrial or electrical assembly environments**
* Strong ERP knowledge (BAAN, M2M, SAP, Dynamics…)

\\_\\_

**Key skills**

* Procurement & supply chain operations
* MRP & inventory management
* S&OP processes
* ERP systems
* Supplier performance management
Cross-site coordination

\\_\\_

We're an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

We offer a comprehensive benefits package including:

* 401(k) & 401(k) matching
* Health Insurance
* Dental & Vision Insurance
* Life Insurance and AD&D
* Legal and identity theft protection
* AFLAC
* Paid Time Off & Holiday Pay
* HSA, FSA
* Paid Parental Leave
* Employee Assistance Program

**COMMODITY MANAGER – MRO (MAINTENANCE, REPAIR & OPERATIONS)**

**Supply Chain | St. Joseph, Missouri**

**ABOUT ALTEC**

Altec is a leading provider of products and services for the electric utility, telecommunications, tree care, lights and signs, and contractor markets. For nearly a century, Altec has been committed to helping customers safely and reliably build and maintain critical infrastructure.

At Altec, our values guide everything we do:

**Customer First • Enjoyment of Work • Family • Financial Stability • Integrity • People Are Our Greatest Strength • Quality • Spiritual Development • Teamwork**

We offer a collaborative environment where associates are empowered to innovate, solve complex challenges, and make meaningful contributions to our customers and communities.

**ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY**

Altec is seeking a Commodity Manager to support sourcing activities related to maintenance, repair, and operations supplies; tooling; facility-support materials; safety products; and indirect manufacturing spend.

This role is responsible for developing and executing sourcing strategies, managing supplier relationships, negotiating agreements, identifying cost reduction opportunities, and ensuring continuity of supply for MRO commodities supporting manufacturing operations.

While MRO is the primary focus of this position, the Commodity Manager may also support other commodity categories. Category assignments and areas of responsibility may be adjusted over time based on business needs, organizational structure, workload, and staffing.

The successful candidate will partner closely with Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations, Materials, and Quality teams across the organization to support both current production and future business growth.

**As the Commodity Manager for MRO, you will:**

* Develop and execute sourcing strategies for MRO categories, industrial supplies, tooling, safety products, and facility-support materials.
* Partner with Maintenance, Operations, Facilities, Safety, and Supply Chain leaders to understand operational requirements.
* Create, negotiate, implement, and manage supplier agreements and service contracts.
* Identify cost savings, demand-management, standardization, and process-improvement opportunities.
* Research and evaluate suppliers, market conditions, pricing trends, availability, and supply chain risks.
* Improve supplier performance, service levels, and continuity of supply.
* Support inventory optimization, storeroom efficiency, and supplier-managed inventory programs.
* Develop and maintain a supplier network that supports quality, delivery, service, and total-cost objectives.
* Serve as the primary escalation point for supplier-related quality, delivery, and service concerns.
Coach and support purchasing, maintenance, and materials team members on category trends, supplier capabilities, and cost-management opportunities.

**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree.
* Six years of applicable experience in procurement, supply chain, manufacturing, engineering, materials management, operations, or a related field.
* Strong supplier-management and negotiation experience.
* Excellent analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to develop sourcing strategies and evaluate supplier performance.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office.

*Should the selected candidate meet the qualifications of a more experienced level within the career path, the job level may be adjusted.*

**Preferred Experience**

**We are particularly interested in candidates who bring technical expertise and operational knowledge to the role, including:**

* Experience sourcing plant-maintenance supplies, tooling, industrial supplies, safety products, facility-support materials, or related indirect categories.
* Knowledge of inventory-management practices, storeroom operations, and supplier-managed inventory programs.
* Experience supporting manufacturing, maintenance, facilities, or operations teams.
* Experience in materials management, production management, or an engineered-products manufacturing environment.
* Experience evaluating supplier capabilities, service levels, and operational performance.
* MBA, APICS certification, or equivalent professional certification.

**Successful candidates will demonstrate:**

* A strong record of developing and implementing sourcing strategies.
* Proven success achieving cost reduction and continuous improvement objectives.
* The ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders and drive strategic decisions.

* A proactive approach to supplier development, risk mitigation, and total cost management.
* A commitment to quality, safety, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.

**Field Project Procurement Manager**

**This is in the field on an active industrial construction site.**

Play an integral role in delivering sustainable infrastructure and industrial construction projects that support the world's evolving energy, chemicals, and resources needs. As a Field Project Procurement Manager, you will provide leadership and oversight for project procurement activities at the construction site, ensuring critical materials, equipment, supplies, and services are delivered safely, efficiently, and in alignment with project schedules, budgets, and business objectives.

description:
**Overview**

Microsoft’s Cloud business is expanding, and the Cloud Supply Chain (CSCP) organization is responsible for enabling the hardware infrastructure underlying this growth including AI! CSCP’s vision is to empower customers to achieve more by delivering Cloud and AI capabilities at scale. Our mission is to deliver the world's computers with an industry-leading supply chain. The CSCP organization is responsible for traditional supply chain functions such as plan, source, make, deliver, but also manages supportability (spares), sustainability, and decommissioning of datacenter assets worldwide. We deliver the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's over 200 online businesses including Bing, MSN, Office 365, Xbox Live, OneDrive and the Microsoft Azure platform for external customers. Our infrastructure is supported by more than 300 datacenters around the world that enable services for more than 1 billion customers in over 90 countries.

The Cloud Sourcing, Security and Sustainability (CS3) organization within CSCP manages sourcing, strategy, and suppliers to provide cost, flexibility, and supply advantages that enable our org to become a world-class supply chain. Well-defined and executed sourcing and supply chain management ensures reliable, on-time performance and optimized cost, prevents urgent and unplanned investments, and provides accurate and timely information across the supply base and internally across the infrastructure organization. Our focus is on smart growth, high efficiency, and deliver trusted experience to customers and partners worldwide.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

The role of the **Senior Network Sourcing Manager** will focus on the following key areas:

* Define and establish Microsoft’s Network Sourcing strategy for datacenter switching technologies to drive competitive advantages for Microsoft cloud offerings.

* Early engagement with our suppliers, network architecture and engineering teams to identify optimization opportunities and drive product solutions around design for availability and TCO.

* Establish appropriate sourcing strategy with relevant partners to drive long-term goals of Technology Adoption, COS (Continuity of Supply), Cost, Quality, Business Health, and Sustainability.

* Provide thought leadership and manage strategic initiatives with internal stakeholders and suppliers to support cloud supply chain objectives and strategies.

#CSCP #CSCPJobs **#CSCPHiringNow**

**Responsibilities**

**Sourcing management**

* Engage with cross- functional leadership including Network architecture, engineering, quality, and business teams to determine best design solution and supply base to deliver that solution at optimal Supply chain, Continuity of supply, and cost.
* Own the switch sourcing process, partnering with product engineering teams on high visibility technology developments and delivery of innovative solutions.

* Provide sourcing engineering expertise on datacenter switching platforms, evaluating switch architectures, merchant silicon ecosystems, optics technologies, supplier capabilities, and technology roadmaps.

* Lead industry initiatives and innovate on business models to deliver best in cloud solutions.

* Define RFQ / RFP activities and conduct negotiations with suppliers.

* Manage contracting activities with Legal and ensure contracts reflect appropriate business terms, IP protection, etc.

**Cost and operations management**

* Build multi-sourcing strategies to mitigate risk and drive appropriate competition.

* Identify cost reduction opportunities and drive supplier competition with cost modelling and other sourcing tools.

* Manage NPI (New Product Introduction) development builds until mature enough to transition to sustaining sourcing team.

* Support programs through the development phases to ensure continued optimization, parts availability, and contract readiness.

* Run weekly, monthly, quarter review with team on cost and operations KPIs.

**Manage supplier performance and compliance**

* Create and deliver supplier relationship management strategy.

* Drive RFQs and supplier selection process through a cross-functional analysis around supplier capabilities.

* Develop and enable the introduction of new suppliers.

* Oversee compliance with MSFT requirements for security, social responsibility, and payment terms.

* Ensure suppliers deliver timely corrective actions from business review / audits.

* Support and meet business cost metrics through the development process.

**Qualifications**

**Minimum Qualifications**:

* Master's degree in Business, Supply Chain

description:
**Company Description**

Arista Networks is an industry leader in data-driven, client-to-cloud networking for large data center, campus and routing environments. What sets us apart is our relentless pursuit of innovation. We leverage the latest advancements in cloud computing, artificial intelligence, and software-defined networking to provide our clients with a competitive edge in an increasingly interconnected world. Our solutions are designed to not only meet the current demands of the digital landscape but to also anticipate and adapt to future challenges.

At Arista we value the diversity of thought and perspectives that each employee brings to the table. We believe that fostering an inclusive environment, where individuals from various backgrounds and experiences feel welcome, is essential for driving creativity and innovation.

Our commitment to excellence has earned us several prestigious awards, such as Best Engineering Team, Best Company for Diversity, Compensation, and Work-Life Balance. At Arista, we take pride in our track record of success and strive to maintain the highest standards of quality and performance in everything we do.

**Job Description**

**Who You’ll Work With**

The Commodity Manager is responsible to develop Arista’s commodity strategies for **Thermal / Heat Sinks** (experience with Front end Power Supplies is a plus) in order to drive time to market, continuity of supply and meet cost reduction initiatives. You'll work across the supply chain to support operations and will be collaborating closely with Engineering on sourcing strategies.

The role will require the individual to be familiar with the complete range of strategic sourcing activities. This includes the analysis of spend, the formulation of and implementation of commodity strategies, the negotiation of contracts and the ongoing management of strategic supplier relationships.

**What You’ll Do**

* Creates, implements, and maintains sourcing strategies for assigned commodities to support company requirements.
* Undertakes spend analysis, supplier assessment and supplier selection to agreed processes.
* Develops and implements commodity strategies in line with company and manufacturing initiatives to improve supply chain efficiencies and reduce the total cost of supply chain management.
* Builds cost models (TAC/should cost) to validate commodity strategies and to understand cost drivers.
* Coordinates all activities with Engineering, NPI, and suppliers to ensure the selection of parts with long lifetimes and solid supply availability.
* Working with the site supply chain leads, this individual will manage relationships with suppliers on behalf of Arista.
* Develops a robust commodity supply base which creates and sustains a competitive advantage for Arista, utilizing global markets, leveraging spend, and best in class technologies.
* Monitors/reports on priority projects and savings.
* Ensures that agreed strategic sourcing targets for cost reduction are met in the commodity portfolio. This includes responsibility for meeting improvement plan targets and year on year cost reductions.
* Provides support to NPI teams as required to meet target costs and establish program cost models.
* Negotiations and management of cost models for suppliers to include "hard" money (such as price, volume discounts, etc.) and "soft" money (such as expertise, technical backup, etc.) in the context of Total Acquisition Cost (TAC) and Total Opportunity Cost (TOC).
* Identification and delivery of opportunities for cost reduction.
* Provides input for annual and long-term savings targets.
* Trains/Mentors junior supply chain personnel on strategic sourcing process.
* Ensures appropriate performance measure (Technology, Quality, Cost and Delivery) of supply base and feedback of results.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain Management, Operations or Engineering required; Master’s degree preferred.
* Minimum 10 years’ experience in a networking environment (preferred), electronics or electrical, purchasing, commodity management and materials management positions. CPIM, CIRM, and/or C.P.M. desired.
* Excellent Program and Project Management Skills.
* Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing and Process Variation Reduction (Six Sigma) concepts and tool sets as they relate to materials management.
* Utilize strong team building abilities to lead cross-functional process improvement teams and lead change within the organization. Ability to coordinate cross-site, multi-functional objectives.
* Ability to interface and positively influence at all levels through excellent communication skills.
* Understanding of assigned commodities, materials, and manufacturing processes.
* Strong PC application skills. Including complement of Microsoft Office Software, with strong capabilities in Project and Access.

**Compensation Information:**

The new hire base pay for this role has a salary range of $142,000 to $188,000.

Arista

We've been changing the game since 2013, and we're not taking our foot off the gas now.

Creating an extraordinary customer experience is at the heart of Carvana. Our goal is to place the customer in control of the car buying experience and infuse honesty and transparency back into the car buying process. The **Senior Buyer, Procurement** is a key sourcing position that will handle a variety of tactical and strategic tasks, including request for quotation (RFQ) and purchase order (PO) entry/submission and order tracking. This role will support procurement activity across the business. Additional duties of this position include data collection and analysis, assembling and publishing reports and providing support to Category Managers, Specialists and to Management.

* Ownership and accountability for the entire PO procurement process to include sending purchase orders, confirming order acknowledgement, expediting (as needed), and confirming Suppliers are paid.
* Communicate the status of current purchase orders with requesters and others as needed.
* Receive and execute ad-hoc requests that are external to the procurement system for any areas of the business the procurement platform has not yet been implemented.
* Maintain and adhere to procurement budgets, ensuring fiscal responsibility and cost efficiency.
* Follow up on invoice discrepancies as required.
* Other duties as assigned.

**What you should have**

* Bachelor's Degree in Business, Supply Chain, or relevant field and 5+ years experience OR
* 8+ years of experience in Procurement or Accounting.
* CPSM certification is a plus.
* Experience with Coupa or other leading Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems and/or dedicated e-procurement platforms (preferred).
* Demonstrated accuracy, responsiveness, and follow-through; strong multitasking ability, close attention to detail, quantitative aptitude, and genuine curiosity about how things work.
* Ability to work collaboratively on a team as well as independently; actively engaged across the full procurement lifecycle and aligned with Carvana's core values.
* Ability to organize workload efficiently, meet tight deadlines, problem solve effectively, and perform duties of the job accurately and with input and follow-up from management.
* Proficient in the use of SQL, SnowFlake, MS Excel, and ERP systems.

* Competitive full-time salary.
* Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits.
* 401K with company match.
* A multitude of perks including student loan payments, discounts on vehicles, benefits for your pets, and much more.
* A great wellness program to keep you healthy and happy both physically and mentally.
* Access to opportunities to expand your skill set and share your knowledge with others across the organization.
* A company culture of promotions from within, with a start-up atmosphere allowing for varied and rapid career development.
* A seat in one of the fastest-growing companies in the country.

**Other requirements**

In order to perform the essential functions of this role, candidates must meet the following baseline requirements:

* Must be able to read, write, speak, and understand English.

Carvana will make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of their role.

Hiring is contingent on passing a complete background check. This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship.

Overview:

**ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.**

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.

Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.

Responsibilities:

**Foundry Advanced Packaging Sourcing Manager**

**THE ROLE:**

* Coordinate the management and spend of AMD’s strategic foundry suppliers with specific focus on post fab / advanced packaging services reporting to the Director Foundry Procurement.
* Develop the global procurement strategy for foundry with specific focus on post fab and advanced packaging; implementing a supplier development program that has a coordinated long-term approach on cost, quality, and service.
* Build and maintain supplier relationships.
* Provide analytical support and recommendations regarding sourcing strategies, requirements planning, and cost improvement.

**THE PERSON:**

* Problem Solving Specialist
* Drives sophisticated solutions and recommendations for complex issues through the analysis of the situation and available data.
* Exercises judgment in selecting the methods, techniques, and evaluation criteria for acquiring results.
* Networks with key contacts outside area of expertise.
* Excellent communication & people skills.
* Capable of initiating and leading new projects to enable procurement scalability in support of AMD growth.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Collaborate with partners and foundry team members to understand and develop negotiation strategies to drive cost targets.
* Develop, implement, and lead critical foundry procurement management processes based on feedback from team members and partners. This may include (but not limited to): NPI/NRE procurement program management / order execution, Spend/Savings reporting, support emergency ordering process, tracking payables/receivables initiatives, ongoing critical action tracking/reporting and accountability.
* Own the overall driven bidding process including analysis, price negotiation, and driving business awards.
* Implement contracts to minimize AMD risk and enable supplier accountability for non-performance
* Lead Supplier Performance Management (SPM) and be responsible for the quarterly scorecard process to review service levels on cost, technology, quality, service, and flexibility.
* Develop and optimally communicate a foundry post fab / advanced packaging commodity strategy which fully reflects key partner inputs to AMD Senior Management Team. Provide updates on a regular basis to supervise progress against plan.
* Collaborate and formalize foundry post fab / advanced packaging market research and benchmarking processes.
* Collaborates with suppliers to communicate AMD requirements.
* Ownership of spend, savings and forecasting for Foundry post fab / advanced packaging supplier.

**PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:**

* Extensive Founry or Semiconductor experience (specific to post fab and advanced packaging service offerings is ideal)
* Strong Engineering background is a plus
* Stong Negotiation and Sourcing skills
* Supply Chain Management (SCM) familiarity
* Experience working in an engineering or semiconductor company
* Understanding of regional and global markets and cultures

**ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS:**

BS/BA degree

MBA

**Location:**

Austin, TX

**This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship.**

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.

Northrop Grumman Defense Systems is seeking a **Procurement Manager 2**. This position will be located in **Roy, UT** and will support the **Sentinel (GBSD) Ground Base Strategic Deterrent** program.

**What You’ll Get To Do:**

* Direct Supervision of staff, assigning work priorities and daily assignments necessary to support the sector objectives
* Provide direction to the team to ensure compliance with established policies and procedures
* Manage purchasing team responsible for purchasing activities including preparing Request for Quotes (RFQs), conducting bid analysis, negotiating purchase orders, documenting purchase order requirements while meeting compliance requirements and managing supplier performance and relationships
* Terms and Conditions negotiations
* Metrics reporting and data analytics
* Engage in supplier sourcing strategy development
* Manage supply chain risks and opportunities
* Cross-functional coordination in and out of the organization
* Engage suppliers that possess products that support multiple programs and/or significant quantity to achieve mutual desired outcomes and formalizes the relationship in the form of a long-term agreement
* Support Procurement teams in areas of policies and procedures, sourcing, training, and development
* Plan, organize, and assign procurement resources, ensuring they are well matched (knowledge/skills/experience) to their assigned duties
* Provide an independent review of procurement products and procurement compliance packages prior to delivery or review and presentation to Audit, program, and GSC Leadership

As a full-time employee of Northrop Grumman, you are eligible for our robust benefits package including:

* Medical, Dental & Vision coverage
* 401k
* Educational Assistance
* Life Insurance
* Employee Assistance Programs & Work/Life Solutions
* Paid Time Off
* Health & Wellness Resources
* Employee Discounts

This position’s standard work schedule is a 9/80. The 9/80 schedule allows employees who work a nine-hour day Monday through Thursday to take every other Friday off.

**You’ll Bring These Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree with 8+ years or Master’s and 6+ years of relevant experience in Global Supply Chain, U.S. Government contract, or Procurement/Subcontracts; Four additional years of experience may be substituted in lieu of a degree.
* Must be a U.S. Citizen and have the ability to obtain and maintain a DoD Secret Security Clearance
* Minimum of 2 years’ experience leading processes, and/or projects
* Experience in the Aerospace and Defense industry and working knowledge of FAR/DFARs
* 5 years of experience with the procurement of goods to include the Request for Quotes (RFQs), conducting bid analysis, negotiating purchase orders, documenting purchase order requirements and or similar activities
* Experience managing supplier performance and relationships

**These Qualifications Would be Nice to Have:**

* Minimum of 2 years experience leading a team,
* Knowledge and experience with services governed by statement of work (SOW) and supporting authors through the SOW creation process.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills and extremely organized
* Ability to deal effectively with change and challenges and helps others to do the same.
* Ability to deal effectively with competing priorities and deadlines, and able to manage multiple tasks in a fast paced environment while demonstrating a professional attitude.
* Working knowledge of FAR/DFARs (FAR Part 12 and FAR Part 15)
* Working Knowledge of SAP

Primary Level Salary Range: $115,000.00 - $172,400.00The above salary range represents a general guideline; however, Northrop Grumman considers a number of factors when determining base salary offers such as the scope and responsibilities of the position and the candidate's experience, education, skills and current market conditions.Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay. **About Veeco**
You probably don’t realize it, but what we do at Veeco touches the lives of every person, every day. It’s a bold statement, but it’s true. From the smartphones in our pockets that access the world’s collective knowledge, to the cloud-based services where all that information lives, to high-speed wireless communication and computing power needed to drive artificial intelligence, augmented and virtual reality, gaming and so much more, our technology is all around us.

We design, develop, manufacture, and service highly complex, cutting-edge machines used by our customers to create the essential devices that drive the digital age, connect the world, and improve the human experience. Along with the world’s leading technology companies, many of which are household names, we help solve their most difficult material science challenges, enabling technologies for a more connected, sustainable, and convenient world.

We’re looking for material difference-makers to join our growing team. Interested? Learn more at www.veeco.com/careers.

**OVERVIEW**

Veeco is seeking a strategic Category Manager to transform how we source the technologies, components, and manufacturing capabilities behind our advanced equipment. Depending on the candidate’s expertise and business needs, this high-impact role may support either OEM commercial off-the-shelf products or build-to-print custom manufacturing suppliers. We are looking for a candidate with deep strength in either supplier category who can shape global sourcing strategies, strengthen supply resilience, and deliver measurable business value.

The Category Manager will convert business and technical requirements into actionable category roadmaps, resilient supplier strategies, and commercial agreements that deliver measurable improvements in cost, quality, delivery, capacity, innovation, and supply continuity. This role serves as a strategic partner to Engineering, Operations, Quality, Planning, Finance, and Supply Chain leadership, using market intelligence and sound judgment to influence decisions and strengthen Veeco's global supply network.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Category Strategy and Market Intelligence**

* Own and drive global category strategies, multi-year roadmaps, sourcing plans, and supplier segmentation for assigned direct-material or equipment categories, with accountability for business results.
* Analyze global markets, technologies, cost drivers, capacity, lead times, geopolitical exposure, and supplier trends to guide sourcing decisions.
* Build category plans that align product roadmaps and production requirements with cost objectives and long-term supply resilience.

**Supplier Model and Supply Base Management**

* Lead supplier strategies for an assigned category aligned with the candidate’s expertise and business needs, supporting either OEM commercial off-the-shelf products or build-to-print custom manufacturing.
* **OEM commercial off-the-shelf:** Manage OEM and authorized-channel relationships; evaluate technology and product roadmaps, pricing, availability, lead times, allocation, warranty, service, and total cost of ownership; and lead lifecycle, end-of-life, obsolescence, and supply-continuity planning.
* **Build-to-print custom manufacturing:** Translate drawings, specifications, bills of materials, and quality requirements into sourcing and supplier-execution plans; assess manufacturability, process capability, tooling, capacity, cost drivers, and production readiness; and coordinate qualification, first-article approval, revision control, and engineering changes.
* Develop, qualify, rationalize, and strengthen the applicable global supplier network through performance data, business reviews, corrective actions, improvement plans, and supplier development.

**Strategic Sourcing and Commercial Leadership**

* Lead RFIs, RFQs, competitive bids, supplier selections, and sourcing transitions from requirements definition through implementation.
* Negotiate pricing, lead times, capacity commitments, payment terms, intellectual property protections, warranties, service levels, and other complex commercial terms.
* Apply should-cost, cost-modeling, market, and financial analysis to deliver savings, cost avoidance, and value-improvement opportunities.

**Cross-Functional Execution and Supplier Performance**

* Partner with Engineering, Operations, Quality, Planning, and Finance to optimize technical requirements, manufacturability, cost, quality, delivery, and risk.
* Establish clear supplier expectations and drive measurable improvements in cost, quality, delivery, responsiveness, and capacity, including corrective action and executive escalation when required.
* Coordinate sourcing decisions, supplier readiness, and continuity plans for production changes, engineering revisions, demand shifts, and product lifecycle events.

description:
**At Lhoist North America, our core values of Respect, Courage, and Integrity are more than words.** We respect people, encourage courageous innovation, and uphold integrity in everything we do. If these principles resonate with you, you may find your next great opportunity with us.

We believe our people make the difference. That’s why we invest in talent by offering meaningful opportunities to grow your skills, expand your knowledge, and pursue your interests. Our work environment prioritizes safety, fosters collaboration across teams, and embraces inclusion. Here, you’ll be challenged to grow, and you’ll be supported throughout your career journey. **Join us and help shape the future of Lhoist North America.**

**POSITION SUMMARY:**

This role will perform and follow up on mid-value spot buys within the geography by clarifying requester requirements, formal bidding, supplier selection, negotiations, and supplier management.

Additional duties include determination of PO terms and conditions for mid-value spot buys, sourcing support to Sourcing/Category Managers within the geography, supporting spot buy reduction through regular analysis of spot buy activities and monitoring and enforcement of purchase order requirements for mid-to-high value orders.

This role will also be expected to become a subject matter expert on the Lhoist procure-to-pay process overseeing requisitioning, purchase order creation and supplier invoice management, as well as work with Operational Procurement Manager to identify and implement continuous improvement opportunities within the procure-to-pay process.

**RESPONSIBILITIES & EXPECTATIONS:**

**Execution of spot buy process:**

* Analyzes mid-value spot buys; requests high-value spot buy execution from the responsible Sourcing Manager
* Searches for potential suppliers, either existing or new
* Conducts RFQ and supports participating suppliers in case of commercial or system-related issues.
* Facilitates clarification of technical questions between internal stakeholders and suppliers
* For selected spot buys, follows-up on technical evaluations with internal stakeholders to ensure timeliness of tendering process.
* Executes negotiation, supplier selection and determines PO terms and conditions
* Track / Measure performance according to Group Procurement guidelines
* Completes Free Text or Generic Purchase Requests and creates related PO
* Based on local requirements, follows up on PO approval and distribution to the supplier

**Closes/changes/modifies** **Purchase Orders related to spot buys:**

* Manages change requests or closes PO if no longer needed
* Upon supplier/user request to amend POs, follows up with user/supplier to determine feasibility; changes/modify POs if needed. If no resolution can be achieved escalates to the team lead and other responsible persons using standard procedures

**Follows up Purchase Orders:**

* Proactively follow up POs to get supplier confirmations

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

The Project Procurement Manager, Construction will oversee all aspects of procurement for the project including for all capital equipment, building materials, construction related services and raw materials. This position will manage supplier relationships, strategic sourcing and procurement processes and ensure the timely and cost-effective acquisition of materials and services essential for the project. The Procurement Manager must utilize a proactive approach to optimizing procurement strategies and place a strong focus on cost reduction, quality assurance and supply chain efficiency.

**WHAT YOU’LL ACCOMPLISH**

* Develop and implement procurement strategies that align with the Project’s business goals and operational requirements.
* Lead cross-functional teams to manage procurement projects from initiation through to completion, ensuring projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to the required quality standards.
* Negotiate contracts and terms with suppliers, vendors, and service providers to secure advantageous terms.
* Conduct market research and supplier evaluations to identify and onboard reliable suppliers and subcontractors.
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders, including engineering, production, logistics, quality assurance, and finance departments, to forecast demand and ensure an uninterrupted supply of materials.
* Monitor and manage supplier performance to ensure compliance with contractual obligations and performance metrics.
* Implement continuous improvement initiatives to enhance procurement processes, reduce costs, and improve supplier performance.
* Ensure compliance with procurement activities' legal, regulatory, and environmental policies and standards.
* Demonstrate a commitment to communicating, improving and adhering to health, safety and environmental policies in all work environments and areas. Promote a culture of safety and exhibit these behaviors.

**WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR**

* Education: Bachelor’s Degree
* Field of Study Preferred: Supply Chain Management, business administration, engineering or related field

**Required Work Experience:**

* Minimum 7+ years experience in Procurement or Supply Chain Management, preferably within a construction manufacturing environment and/or a greenfield plant environment.
* Certification in supply chain management or procurement is a plus.
* 7+ years of managing suppier relationships, strategic soucing and handling negotiations

**Required Computer and Software Skills:**

* Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite
* Experience working with Procore or similar project management software Proficient in procurement software and systems

**Travel Requirements:**

* Occasional, but regular overnight travel to the project site and to suppliers for meetings and presentations

**Additional Requirements:**

* Demonstrate detailed and efficient organization skills
* Demonstrate excellent oral and written communication skills
* Work well under pressure to meet project deadlines
* Show high levels of commitment to detail
* Strong knowledge of procurement processes, supply chain management, and strategic sourcing principles.
* Strong knowledge and project procurement experience with greenfield and brownfield expansions.
* Excellent negotiation, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Must have strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to analyze data, identify trends, and make data-driven decisions.
* Solid understanding of manufacturing processes and materials.
* Project management skills, including planning, scheduling, and managing budgets.
* Familiarity with capital projects including engineering and construction

description:
**Used Truck Purchasing Manager Job Posting | RWC Group | Heavy-Duty Commercial Truck & Bus Dealership**

**RWC Group** is looking for an experienced Used Truck Purchasing Manager who knows the commercial truck market and has the relationships, judgment, and sales ability to turn used equipment into profitable opportunities. This is not a traditional purchasing position. You’ll be responsible for sourcing and purchasing used trucks and equipment, wholesaling inventory, and directly selling used equipment to retail customers. If you know how to spot a good truck, understand what it’s worth, negotiate a great deal, and find the right buyer, this is an opportunity to make a significant impact on RWC’s used truck business.

Every used truck starts with the right buying decision. This role directly impacts inventory turn, gross profit, and sales by putting the right equipment into RWC’s inventory at the right cost—and getting it into the hands of the right customer. At RWC Group, you’ll have the opportunity to build relationships, make deals, and directly influence the profitability of our used truck operation. You won’t simply manage inventory that someone else buys. You’ll help determine what we buy, what we pay, how we position it, and how we sell it.

**What You’ll Do**

* Source and purchase used commercial trucks and equipment through fleets, auctions, trades, dealers, lease returns, and other channels.
* Evaluate equipment condition, specifications, market demand, and resale potential.
* Appraise equipment and negotiate purchases that support RWC’s margin and inventory objectives.
* Develop and maintain a strong network of fleets, dealers, wholesalers, auction contacts, and other industry partners.
* Monitor used truck market conditions, pricing trends, and equipment demand.
* Identify wholesale opportunities and actively market equipment to dealers and wholesale buyers.
* Negotiate and complete wholesale transactions while protecting profitability.
* Directly sell used trucks and equipment to retail customers.
* Develop new customer relationships and maintain an active network of prospective buyers.
* Work with RWC Sales teams to evaluate trade-ins and identify resale opportunities.
* Monitor inventory aging and take action to keep equipment moving.
* Coordinate with Service, Parts, and other departments regarding inspections, repairs, and reconditioning.
* Maintain accurate purchasing, inventory, sales, and customer information in company systems.

**We’re Looking for Someone Who...** *Is part buyer, part salesperson, and part entrepreneur. You’ll be a great fit if you:*

* Have strong experience in used commercial trucks, heavy equipment, fleet sales, or a closely related industry.
* Understand commercial truck values, specifications, market conditions, and resale potential.
* Have demonstrated experience buying, selling, appraising, or wholesaling used equipment.
* Are an exceptional negotiator who knows how to structure a profitable deal.
* Have strong industry relationships—or know how to build them quickly.
* Are comfortable prospecting and developing new sources for both inventory and customers.
* Understand inventory aging and the importance of turning equipment.
* Are self-directed, competitive, and motivated by results.
* Communicate professionally with customers, fleets, dealers, vendors, and internal teams.
* Are comfortable using CRM, inventory, and other business systems.

**Why Join RWC Group?**

With more than 20 locations across the western United States, RWC Group is one of the largest International® Truck dealerships in the country. We offer a collaborative culture, exceptional training, and the resources you need to build a successful long-term sales career.

* Competitive base salary plus performance incentives
* Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
* 401(k) with Company Match
* Paid Time Off and Holidays

**Find the Right Trucks. Make the Right Deals. Drive the Profit. Apply at** **careers@rwcgroup.com**

*RWC Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer M/F/V/H. This posting is intended to provide a general overview of the position. A complete job description, including essential duties, and qualifications is available and will be provided to candidates during the selection process.*

**WHO WE ARE**

KNAPP brings new technology to warehouse automation.

The KNAPP Group is a global provider of intelligent automation solutions for intralogistics and manufacturing, specializing in the sectors healthcare, fashion/apparel, general retail, food retail, industry and service. We live and breathe automation. We, more than 8,000 employees of the KNAPP Group across over 60 locations worldwide, shaping the future-oriented intralogistics industry, are dedicated to making complexity simple.

One of KNAPP’s primary goals is to use continuous innovation to drive warehouse automation forward, always with the specific needs of the customers in mind. KNAPP Group’s unrelenting development activity is evident in everything from automated order picking systems and continuing refinement of container handling technology to its state-of-the-art, industry leading software solutions.

**WHAT YOU GET TO DO**

**Job Summary:**

* Responsible for the purchase of materials, supplies, equipment and services needed for the completion of various projects.
* Support the sales process by working closely with Sales & Project Engineering and by managing the vendors.

**Essential Functions and Responsibilities:**

* Acts as a point of contact between Knapp Inc. and its strategic suppliers
* Using analytical skills, identifies, screens and onboards potential suppliers
* Negotiates price, payment terms, quality levels, and delivery terms for MHE products and services within budget and schedule requirements
* Perform all necessary duties to support corporate goals as they relate to established supplier quality, total landed cost, and inventory objectives
* Take proactive role in identifying and resolving material availability, quality problems and service issues to deliver
* Execute purchases and manage orders to support project activity.
* Performs sourcing administrative functions such as requesting appropriate signatures for Non-Disclosure Agreements, contracts etc.
* Performs purchasing related clerical tasks as assigned
* Interface with Project Managers on purchasing items during project roll out
* Development and implementation of future instruments, methods, processes, systems and/or tools in procurement
* Development of improvement ideas and innovation followed by coordination and implementation of corresponding measures
* Ensures the Senior Project Buyer is well informed, at all times of changes and news-worthy events within the area of responsibility
* Effectively communicates relevant related information within the organization

**WHAT YOU HAVE**

**Working Conditions and Environment:**

* Occasional Overtime, if required by work
* Occasional domestic and international travel
* Professional office etiquette is required at all times
* Physical requirements: sitting for long periods of time, standing, walking, speaking, visual acuity, finger dexterity, listening, reaching at arm’s length, and lifting up to 50-100 pounds

**WHAT YOU WILL GET**

* 2 remote days per week
* Half day Fridays
* A beautiful new, state-of-the-art, office complex in Kennesaw, GA
* Industry competitive compensation
* Great benefits with better than average employer contributions, including health, dental, vision, life insurance, Flexible Spending Accounts, Short & Long Term Disability and more!
* 401k with a very generous employer match and no vesting!
* Paid Vacation & Holidays
* Profit Sharing
* Paid Parental Leave
* Subsidized Daycare
* Tuition Reimbursement
* Pet Insurance
* Subsidized food delivery
* Monthly celebrations
* Quarterly employee events
* Corporate Social Responsibility including recycling, sustainability and volunteering

*KNAPP is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals without discrimination on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, veteran, disability status or any other basis protected by law.*

*Due to the safety-sensitive nature of this position, strict adherence to KNAPP’s drug-free workplace policy is required. All candidates will be subject to drug-screening in accordance with the policy and will be expected to remain drug-free during their employment. There will be no exception if recreational or medical use of marijuana is permitted in the location of employment and/or residence or if use of marijuana is only during “off-hours.”*

description:
**Why Join Altec?**

**COMMODITY MANAGER – MARKET PRICING & COMMODITY INTELLIGENCE**

**Supply Chain | St. Joseph, Missouri**

**ABOUT ALTEC**

Altec is a leading provider of products and services for the electric utility, telecommunications, tree care, lights and signs, and contractor markets. For nearly a century, Altec has been committed to helping customers safely and reliably build and maintain critical infrastructure.

At Altec, our values guide everything we do:

**Customer First • Enjoyment of Work • Family • Financial Stability • Integrity • People Are Our Greatest Strength • Quality • Spiritual Development • Teamwork**

We offer a collaborative environment where associates are empowered to innovate, solve complex challenges, and make meaningful contributions to our customers and communities.

**ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY**

Altec is seeking a Commodity Manager focused on market pricing, commodity intelligence, and strategic analysis. This role serves as a key resource for understanding commodity trends, forecasting cost impacts, and supporting sourcing decisions across multiple categories.

While market pricing and commodity intelligence are the primary focus of this position, the Commodity Manager may also support specific commodity categories or other sourcing priorities. Category assignments and areas of responsibility may be adjusted over time based on business needs, organizational structure, workload, and staffing.

The successful candidate will partner closely with Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations, Materials, and Quality teams across the organization to support both current production and future business growth.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

**As the Commodity Manager for Market Pricing & Commodity Intelligence, you will:**

* Monitor commodity markets, pricing indices, economic indicators, capacity, lead times, and supply-demand trends across multiple categories.
* Develop cost models, forecasts, dashboards, and scenario analyses to support sourcing and business decisions.
* Translate market data into actionable recommendations for Procurement, Finance, Manufacturing, Engineering, and leadership teams.
* Analyze commodity exposure, inflationary and deflationary drivers, and supply chain risks; identify mitigation opportunities.
* Establish consistent data sources, methodologies, and reporting standards for commodity intelligence.
* Track supplier and market cost drivers and evaluate the reasonableness of pricing changes.
* Support commodity managers with negotiation preparation, sourcing strategies, timing decisions, and long-range planning.
* Deliver recurring and ad hoc reports that clearly communicate trends, risks, opportunities, and expected financial impact.
* Maintain awareness of regulatory, geopolitical, logistics, energy, and technology developments that may affect commodity markets.
Coach and support purchasing and materials team members in the use of market intelligence, cost modeling, and forecasting tools.

**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree.
* Six years of applicable experience in procurement, supply chain, finance, economics, business analytics, manufacturing, engineering, or a related field.
* Demonstrated experience analyzing market, pricing, cost, or supply chain data.
* Excellent analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable business recommendations.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including advanced Excel capabilities.

*Should the selected candidate meet the qualifications of a more experienced level within the career path, the job level may be adjusted.*

**Preferred Experience**

**We are particularly interested in candidates who bring technical expertise and operational knowledge to the role, including:**

* Experience with commodity pricing, market analytics, cost modeling, or forecasting.
* Knowledge of economics, finance, procurement analytics, strategic sourcing, and manufacturing cost structures.
* Experience using market indices, economic indicators, dashboards, or business-intelligence tools.
* Experience identifying cost drivers, quantifying risk, and evaluating supplier pricing changes.
* Experience in a manufacturing or engineered-products environment.
* Experience translating complex market and financial data into clear recommendations for cross-functional and leadership audiences.
* MBA, APICS certification, or equivalent professional certification.

**What Success Looks Like**

**Successful candidates will demonstrate:**

* A strong record of producing reliable market analysis, forecasts, and cost insights.
* The ability to identify emerging risks and opportunities and recommend practical actions.
* Skill in influencing cross-functional stakeholders through clear, evidence-based recommendations.
* Strong analytical judgment, attention to detail, and disciplined use of data.
* The ability to communicate complex information clearly to tech

description:
**Who We Are**

Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology.

**What We Offer**

Salary:

$101,000.00 - $139,000.00

Location:

Santa Clara,CA

You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more.

At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits .

Applied Materials’ Global Supply Chain, has a career growing opportunity for an experienced Project Manager to lead design and commercialization of Supply Chains for New Products. The Strategic Supply Chain Project Manager will be working on products for one of Applied’s largest Business Units – Etch. They will collaborate with cross functional teams and lead initiatives to enable diverse aspects of designing supply chains for New Products from rapid prototyping to commercialization. The individual will be responsible to achieve material cost targets, eliminate supply chain single points of failure, and dual source for supply continuity reasons, while staying within the guidelines of Applied’s commodity strategies and protecting Applied’s IP.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Supply Chain Design & Commercialization**

* Develops and implements effective supply chain strategy from NPI to High Volume that meets performance requirements.
* Collaborates and negotiates with key suppliers to ensure a reliable and cost-effective supply of materials and components.
* Coordinates product development process deliverables through a matrix organization of engineers, supplier account managers, buyers, planners, and production control.
* Creates process maps for critical/complex long lead components; collaborates to implement mitigation strategies
* Develops and executes dual sourcing strategies to mitigate supply risk of new products prior to commercialization
* Identifies single points of failure in new product supply chain design, establishes and implements strategies to mitigate them
* Designs supply chain to minimize total landed cost, improve material availability, while meeting quality KPIs
* Drives alignment between engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, finance & quality on key insource/outsource decisions
* Presents new product sourcing strategies to management

**Product Material Cost Management**

* Creates and maintains material cost reduction roadmaps
* Leads supplier price negotiations to achieve material cost targets and product’s Gross Margin targets; facilitates and maintains Cost Apportionment Models
* Collaborates with engineering and suppliers to identify and implement DFM, DFC opportunities
* Facilitates and maintains Cost Apportionment Models

**Program Management**

* Oversees and manages end-to-end semiconductor equipment NPI development programs from Supply Chain perspective.
* Coordinate with internal teams and external partners to ensure timely delivery, budget adherence, and quality control throughout the NPI project lifecycle.
* Identifies and resolves potential complications/ risks jeopardizing the program’s targets. Provide fact-based containment options and/ or sustainable solution scenarios to executive stakeholders.

**Leadership/ Problem Solving**

* Support R&D initiatives with engineering in exploration of emerging technologies and materials for potential integration into semiconductor equipment
* Acts as a resource for colleagues with less experience; uses structured approach and analytics to exercise judgment and identify innovative solutions
* Serves as a cross-functional link and maintains open communication among matrixed stakeholders

**Functional Knowledge**

* Proven experience in program management, supply chain management, and business acumen
* Knowledge of various fabrication commodities and processes
* Excellent communication and leadership skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.

**Business Expertise**

* Applies broad industry and commercial awareness to drive financial and operational performance across business unit, department or sub-functions
* Interprets internal/external business challenges

We at Freudenberg-NOK Sealing Technologies run the business operations of Freudenberg Sealing Technologies (FST) in the Americas. Being part of the global Freudenberg Group, our company is a leading producer of advanced sealing technologies for automotive and general industries. Freudenberg-NOK Sealing Technologies is a joint venture between Freudenberg and NOK Corp. in Japan, is headquartered in Plymouth, MI, operates more than 20 facilities and employs about 4,700 people across the Americas.

#### **401K Match**

**401K Match:** Save for retirement with the company's help.

**Health Insurance:** Rely on comprehensive services whenever you need it.

**Vacation:** We offer time off to refresh and recharge.

**Paid Holidays:** With paid-time off, local holidays are all the way more relaxing.

Plymouth, MI
