SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

**SOURCING SPECIALIST, ELECTRONICS (STARLINK)**

At SpaceX we're leveraging our experience in building rockets and spacecraft to deploy Starlink, the world's most advanced broadband internet system. Starlink is the world's largest satellite constellation and is providing fast, reliable internet to 10M+ users worldwide. We design, build, test, and operate all parts of the system – thousands of satellites, consumer receivers that allow users to connect within minutes of unboxing, and the software that brings it all together. We've only begun to scratch the surface of Starlink's potential global impact and are looking for best-in-class individuals to join our supply chain team and help maximize Starlink's utility for communities and businesses around the globe.

This is a high-profile, cross functional position that plays an integral role in enabling development and production flow of satellites. Working in close coordination with engineering and manufacturing departments, sourcing specialists execute effective creative and smart supply chain strategies to achieve production goals. The functions within the supply chain management include material requirements planning, delivery management, dock-to-stock coordination, and inventory management. With integration taking place in-house, sourcing specialists are able to see their assemblies come to life every day!

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Place purchase orders and resolve blocked invoices related to assigned category
* Forecast demand, evaluate capacity, and manage supply signals to adjust incoming material
* Track high risk components and supplier delivery performance
* Communicate clearly and rapidly to influence decisions of vendors and senior leadership
* Interpret engineering drawings and Bill of Materials (BOMs)
* Create sourcing strategies for all mechanical custom and Commercial off the Shelf (COTS) hardware
* Develop a preferred supplier network and leverage it to minimize cost and lead time for the fabrication and delivery of parts
* Solve complex, open-ended problems with an emphasis on speed and efficiency
* Manage outsource fabrication projects including planning, coordinating with stakeholders, estimating completion, and manage vendor performance
* Perform onsite reviews of vendor capabilities
* Responsible for authoring of contract documents with the legal department
* Management of contracts ensuring performance of the supplier to contract obligations
* Understand interrelationships between contracts and terms while applying creativity and sound business reasoning to interpret application of contract to business needs
* Utilize negotiations to maximize value and cost savings benefit while lowering risk

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor's degree and 3+ years of experience working in purchasing, procurement, material planning, production planning, supply chain management, or engineering; or 5+ years of experience working in purchasing, procurement, material planning, production planning, supply chain management in lieu of a degree

**PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:**

* Experience with Material Resource Planning (MRP) or Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems, and with managing bill of materials, work orders, and purchase orders
* Experience with forecasting, demand planning, and lead time analysis
* Ability to learn quickly and prioritize appropriately to meet customer and company needs
* Strong track record for achieving results; must be able to reference wins and quantify impact
* Strong skills in data analysis using Excel, SQL and PowerBI
* Solid understanding of PCBA, SMT process, Clear to build
* American Production and Inventory Control Society (APICS) certification, Six Sigma certification, or similar certifications
* Effective written and verbal communications skills, with strong ability to communicate to all levels of internal personnel
* Demonstrated ability to work in ambiguous situations and across organizational boundaries. History of self-learning & application of newly learned tools & techniques
* Ability to learn quickly and prioritize appropriately to meet customer and company needs

**ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:**

* Position may require extended hours and/or weekend work when needed
* Position may require travel up to 30%
* This position is based in Redmond, WA and is 100% onsite

**COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:**

Pay Range:
Level 1: $85,000.00 - $115,000.00
Level 2: $100,000.00 - $140,000.00

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at

**Strategic Sourcing Specialist**

Composed of Chromalox, Durex Industries, Vulcanic, and Thermocoax businesses, Electrical Thermal Solutions (ETS), part of Spirax Group, creates electrical process heating and temperature management solutions, including industrial heaters and systems, heat tracing, and a range of component technologies.

At Chromalox, we build advanced thermal technologies for the world’s most challenging industrial heating applications.

Headquartered in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, we got our start with an innovative solution 100 years ago when a self-taught engineer invented the first metal-sheathed resistance heating element. It was this then-advanced thermal technology that launched an entire industry.

We excel in industries that have high expectations. We are acknowledged as experts at delivering solutions that exceed specifications, limit risk, and reduce operating costs.

Join us as we continue to provide solutions to our customers and the world!

**The Role:**

As the Strategic Sourcing Specialist, you will lead category strategy, supplier sourcing, and contracting activities across key product and service categories. This role will collaborate with engineering, quality, production and finance teams to deliver sustainable cost savings, ensure supply continuity, and drive procurement process improvements. The successful candidate will analyze market trends, conduct competitive sourcing events, negotiate contracts, and manage supplier performance to support business growth and operational excellence.

**Your Responsibilities:**

* Intelligence studies to identify supplier trends, cost drivers, and risk factors
* Maintain supplier qualification and ongoing performance management (e.g., scorecards, audits)
* Collaborate with internal team-engineering, legal, quality assurance, and operations—to ensure alignment with sourcing decisions
* Identify supply chain risks; develop and execute mitigation and continuity plans to manage supply disruptions and escalation issues
* Drive continuous cost-optimization, process improvement, and performance metrics tracking
* Identify, evaluate and qualify new suppliers. Help find second sources for any single sourced items
* Issue and maintain blanket purchase orders for commodities
* Other duties as assigned

**Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, or related field; advanced degrees preferred
* Proven experience (5–7 years) in sourcing or procurement, preferably in strategic sourcing and category management
* Industry-specific expertise (manufacturing)
* 2-3 years proven ETO or MTO manufacturing environment experience
* Strong negotiation skills; ability to secure favorable commercial terms and supply agreements
* Proficiency in ERP/MRP systems and advanced Excel for spend and data analysis and reporting
* Analytical mindset for data-driven decision-making
* Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities for stakeholder management
* Organizational and time management skills to handle multiple sourcing projects
* Strong ethical judgment and strategic orientation
* Procurement/Supply Chain credentials: CPSM, CIPS, CPIM, ISM CSP or equivalent preferred

**Payrate:** $75,000 - $85,000

At Chromalox, we are not just an employer but a champion of equal opportunities and inclusivity. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace that adheres to the highest hiring standards and is free from discrimination and harassment.

Chromalox is an equal opportunity employer; our commitment extends to all aspects of employment, ensuring that no individual is mistreated or discriminated against based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristic as defined by federal, state, or local laws.

**Job Description**

Thermo Fisher Scientific offers the scale, reach, and mission-driven work to make a meaningful impact.

**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

How you will make an impact:

The Procurement/Sourcing Specialist III manages direct material procurement while driving sourcing, supplier performance, cost productivity, and supply assurance initiatives within a fast-paced manufacturing environment. The role combines strategic sourcing with strong operational execution and requires close collaboration with a global supply base and cross-functional teams. The ideal candidate is proactive, commercially minded, comfortable working independently, and has a strong willingness to learn, succeed, grow, and take on increasing responsibility.

Key Responsibilities:

* Proactively identify and drive cost-saving, productivity, and supply assurance opportunities from ideation through implementation, delivering measurable year-over-year results.
* Develop and execute sourcing and supplier strategies that improve cost, supply continuity, lead times, and supplier performance.
* Apply strong negotiation and commercial skills to secure competitive pricing, terms, lead times, and overall value.
* Proactively identify supply-chain risks and develop mitigation and contingency plans with suppliers and internal stakeholders.
* Build strong relationships with a global supply base while holding suppliers accountable for delivery, quality, cost, and responsiveness.
* Partner with Category Management, Material Planning, Finance, Engineering, Quality, R&D, Operations/Value Streams, and other functions to execute projects and achieve business objectives.
* Drive continuous improvement by identifying better and more efficient procurement processes, sourcing approaches, and ways of working.
* Understand manufacturing workflows, Bills of Materials (BOMs), technical drawings, and specifications and apply this knowledge to sourcing and procurement decisions.
* Manage day-to-day direct material procurement, including demand analysis, purchase order placement, price updates, order confirmations, supplier follow-up, expedites, escalations, and invoice discrepancy resolution.
* Use SAP to execute purchasing activities, maintain procurement data, manage purchase orders, and support material availability.
* Work closely with Material Planning and suppliers to proactively resolve shortages, late deliveries, capacity constraints, and other supply issues.
* Independently manage competing priorities with limited supervision and proactively escalate issues when appropriate.

**REQUIREMENTS**
----------------

Minimum Qualifications:

* Bachelor's Degree plus 8+ years of procurement/supply chain experience within a manufacturing environment.
* Experience managing direct materials, suppliers, and purchasing activities.
* Experience with ERP systems; SAP experience strongly preferred.
* Understanding of manufacturing operations, BOMs, technical specifications, inventory, and material planning.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with excellent attention to detail.
* Ability to work independently and effectively manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills across functions, cultures, and geographical locations.
* Proactive sense of urgency – anticipates issues, acts before they become critical, and drives problems through resolution.
* Strong willingness to learn, succeed, grow, and take on new challenges and responsibilities.

Preferred Qualifications:

* Experience sourcing plastics, resins, injection-molded components, packaging, or other direct materials.
* Strong negotiation experience involving pricing, commercial terms, lead times, and supplier agreements.
* Experience leading cost-reduction, productivity, sourcing, or supply-assurance projects.
* Familiarity with Power BI, data analysis, dashboards, and visualization.
* Familiarity with AI-enabled procurement, automation, or process optimization.
* Experience working with international suppliers and global teams.

Key Competencies:

* Ownership & Accountability – Takes responsibility and drives issues through resolution.
* Commercial Mindset – Consistently seeks opportunities to improve cost, terms, and overall value.
* Assertive Communication – Comfortable leading difficult discussions and constructively challenging suppliers and internal stakeholders.
* Proactive Sense of Urgency – Anticipates problems and takes action before they impact the business.
* Results Orientation – Focuses on measurable results and sustainable year-over-year improvement.
* Continuous Improvement – Challenges existing processes and actively looks for better solutions.
* Independence & Collaboration – Operates effectively with limited supervision while building strong cross-functional relationships.
* Drive to Learn & Grow – Demonstrates curiosity, initiative, resilienc

**Job Summary**
We are seeking a dynamic and detail-oriented **Buyer & Procurement Specialist** to join our team and drive excellence in our purchasing and supply operations. In this role, you will be responsible for optimizing procurement, inventory management, and vendor relations to ensure seamless production. Your expertise in market analysis, **ERP systems (specifically Odoo)**, and negotiation will be essential to enhance efficiency, reduce costs, and support continuous improvement initiatives across the organization. This position offers an exciting opportunity to impact our operational success through innovative problem-solving and strategic planning.

**Duties**

* **Strategic Purchasing:** Act as the primary purchaser by identifying supply needs, sourcing materials, and negotiating pricing and terms to ensure Highline receives the best value and quality.
* **Decision Making & Accountability:** Exercise independent judgment to resolve pricing disputes or logistics hurdles, taking full professional accountability for the success of your assigned categories.
* **Odoo Order Lifecycle:** Manage the full procurement cycle within **Odoo**, including creating Purchase Orders (POs), tracking shipments, and ensuring all product data and pricing are current.
* **Vendor Management:** Lead vendor registration and maintain strong relationships; resolve issues related to contracts, quality discrepancies, and service levels.
* **Logistics & Coordination:** Oversee the movement of goods from the vendor to our facility, managing all logistics documentation and troubleshooting delays to ensure zero downtime for our operations.
* **Administrative & Clerical Support:** Perform essential clerical work to support the department, including maintaining precise digital records and providing lifecycle support for every order.
* **Collaborate with manufacturing** teams on demand planning, production scheduling, and inventory control to meet customer requirements efficiently.
* **Optimize logistics operations** by coordinating transportation, warehousing, and distribution activities to improve delivery times and reduce costs.

**Experience**

* Proven experience in supply chain management or logistics roles within a manufacturing or distribution environment.
* High school diploma or equivalent required. College or commercial school courses in business functions (Purchasing, Logistics, or Supply Chain) are preferred.
* Minimum **three years** of experience in a Supply Chain or Purchasing role, with a demonstrated knowledge of procurement functions and order lifecycle management.
* Proficiency in **Odoo** (Purchase and Inventory modules) is highly preferred.
* Must have a proven ability to work independently, make critical decisions under pressure, and maintain a high level of professional accountability.
* Familiarity with inventory management systems and demand planning processes.
* Excellent problem-solving skills with a focus on root cause analysis and process optimization. Join us as a Supply Chain Specialist to play a pivotal role in refining our supply chain operations! Bring your passion for process improvement, analytical prowess, and strategic thinking to help us achieve operational excellence while advancing your career in a fast-paced environment dedicated to innovation and continuous growth.

Pay: $23.00 - $29.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Vision insurance

Application Question(s):

* Experience in the construction industry?
* Experience with windows & doors?

Experience:

* Purchasing: 1 year (Preferred)
* Supply chain: 1 year (Preferred)

Language:

* Spanish (Preferred)

Ability to Commute:

* Garland, TX 75041 (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

Description:

**Signia Aerospace** is built on decades of proven performance and partnership in the aircraft systems industry. The proven brands that operate under the Signia Aerospace ecosystem lead the field in thermal management and mission-specific equipment. They are the brands of choice for pilots, maintenance directors, ground crews, and supply chain professionals worldwide, in commercial, private, and military applications. Our depth of expertise and unique pool of resources allows us to act as an integrated, nimble partner in the design, manufacture, delivery, and service of highly specialized aircraft systems and components.

**Precise Flight** is a leading designer and manufacturer of aviation safety and performance products for commercial, business, and general aviation aircraft worldwide. For more than 40 years, the company has developed innovative solutions including aircraft lighting systems, oxygen systems, and other aerospace components that help make flying safer and more efficient. Headquartered in Bend, Oregon, Precise Flight serves aircraft manufacturers, airlines, fleet operators, and aircraft owners around the globe.

**Our Culture**

We are a team that prides ourselves on a culture that supports shared values of empowerment, accountability, drive, integrity, and respect. Our team shares a deep commitment to safety and collaboration. We offer a comprehensive benefits package to support your well-being and professional growth including medical, dental, vision, paid time off, life insurance, 401(K) plans with employer match, company provided Growth Participation Units (GPU) and so much more.

Our GPU benefit is unique to the industry and encourages all employees to think like owners and receive future financial reward for contributions to business growth. Join our team to be part of a culture that encourages growth and development and celebrates our success.

**Key Responsibilities:**

Executes procurement strategies and sourcing activities for assigned commodities, suppliers, or operational categories. Manages supplier selection, contract negotiations, procurement compliance, and supplier performance activities while supporting operational continuity, cost management, and supply chain efficiency. Collaborates closely with internal stakeholders and suppliers to ensure timely procurement execution and operational support.

All roles at Signia are expected to support the company’s operating model (SOAR) and contribute to the organization’s business value drivers, Profitable New Business, Productivity, Precision M&A, and Value-Based Pricing, through operational excellence, continuous improvement, collaboration, and customer focus.

**Key Deliverables of the Position**

1) Effective execution of procurement strategies and sourcing activities

2) Successful supplier selection, contract negotiation, and procurement coordination

3) Reliable supplier delivery, quality, and performance management

4) Compliance with procurement policies, contracts, and regulatory requirements

5) Improved procurement efficiency, supplier responsiveness, and cost management

6) Accurate procurement reporting and supplier performance tracking

7) Strong supplier and cross-functional stakeholder relationships

Requirements:

**Education and Experience**

* Solid working knowledge of procurement and supply chain practices
* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Business, Operations, or related discipline preferred
* Typically requires 2–4 years of procurement, sourcing, or supply chain experience
* Works under general supervision and may mentor junior staff

**Technical Competencies**

1) Procurement strategy execution

2) Supplier selection and contract negotiation

3) RFQ/RFP management and sourcing processes

4) Supplier relationship and performance management

5) Procurement compliance and policy adherence

There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. $51,800-$106,200

**Procurement Specialist**
==========================

**Job Description**
-------------------

### **Summary**

The Procurement Specialist supports the purchasing of materials, equipment, products, and services needed to support company operations and projects. This position works with internal teams and suppliers to obtain quality products and services at competitive prices while ensuring purchases are made in accordance with company policies and procedures. The Procurement Specialist will also assist with purchase orders, supplier communications, pricing research, and resolving purchasing-related issues.

### **Responsibilities**

* Prepare and process purchase requisitions and purchase orders for materials, equipment, products, and services.
* Research suppliers and obtain quotations based on project and business requirements.
* Assist with evaluating suppliers based on price, quality, availability, delivery, and overall value.
* Communicate with suppliers regarding pricing, availability, delivery schedules, and other purchasing requirements.
* Monitor purchase orders to ensure materials and services are delivered accurately and on schedule.
* Maintain accurate purchasing records, including purchase orders, supplier information, pricing, and delivery information.
* Research market conditions, pricing trends, and material availability to support purchasing decisions.
* Assist with negotiating pricing, delivery schedules, and other commercial terms with suppliers.
* Review purchase orders and supplier documentation for compliance with company policies and procedures.
* Assist with resolving vendor issues, including delivery delays, quality concerns, pricing discrepancies, and invoice questions.
* Support the identification and qualification of new suppliers and maintain effective supplier relationships.
* Assist with sourcing alternative materials, products, and suppliers when needed.
* Participate in the development and review of specifications for equipment, products, materials, and services.
* Assist with bid evaluations, bid awards, and other procurement documentation as required.
* Support the disposition or disposal of surplus materials and equipment in accordance with company procedures.
* Prepare purchasing reports and other procurement-related documentation.
* Work collaboratively with project teams, accounting, operations, and other internal departments to support purchasing needs.
* Ensure purchasing activities are completed in accordance with company policies, procedures, and applicable requirements.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

### **Education and Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, Procurement, Finance, or a related field preferred.
* Previous internship, co-op, or work experience in procurement, purchasing, supply chain, materials management, or a related field is preferred but not required.
* Entry-level candidates with a strong interest in procurement and supply chain are encouraged to apply.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accurate records.
* Good analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to develop and maintain positive working relationships with suppliers and internal stakeholders.
* Ability to learn and apply company policies, procedures, and purchasing processes.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and Outlook.
* Ability to work independently while also contributing effectively as part of a team.

### **Physical Requirements**

* Ability to reach, stand, walk, finger, grasp, feel, talk, hear, see, and perform repetitive motions.
* Sedentary work: Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally and/or a negligible amount of force frequently or constantly to lift, carry, push, pull, or otherwise move objects, including the human body

*We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.*

Sparcz Engineering is a growing custom electronics design and manufacturing company specializing in automated test equipment, circuit boards, cables and wire harnesses, custom chassis, box builds, and rack systems.

We are seeking an experienced **Electronics Buyer** to source and purchase electronic components, electrical hardware, fabricated parts, and other materials used in our customer projects.

Responsibilities

* Purchase electronic components, electrical hardware, fabricated parts, and production materials.
* Source materials from BOMs, drawings, and manufacturer part numbers.
* Request and evaluate supplier quotes for price, lead time, availability, and delivery.
* Create and manage purchase orders in our ERP system.
* Monitor open orders and expedite materials as needed.
* Source hard-to-find, obsolete, and long-lead-time components.
* Work with Engineering to identify alternate components when necessary.
* Negotiate supplier pricing and delivery.
* Develop and maintain supplier relationships.
* Resolve pricing, delivery, quality, and documentation issues.
* Help identify cost-saving and inventory-reduction opportunities.

Qualifications

* 3+ years of purchasing experience in electronics or manufacturing preferred.
* Experience purchasing **electronic components** strongly preferred.

**Job Overview**

Dosal Tobacco Corporation, an ISO 9001 certified company, is seeking a Procurement Officer. With half a century of experience in the United States, our brands have become respected and well known for providing premium-quality tobacco products.

This position is responsible for the procurement of a wide range of commodities, products and services; preparing, soliciting and analyzing quotations, delivery terms and availability; negotiating costs; and conducting sourcing and support activities.

Pay: Up to $70k / year + bonus

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

· Plans, organizes, directs, and controls activities related to the procurement function

· Maintains inventory of listed items, tracks their availability and prepares reports as needed

· Prepares delivery schedule and monitors against production plan to guarantee availability; reports any issues.

· Utilizes appropriate negotiation and purchasing techniques to maximize savings and benefit to the company.

· Recruits, evaluates and maintains suppliers while maintaining the highest code of ethics and conduct; maintains the approved supplier list (ASL).

· Makes all necessary inquiries to obtain the best quote for all of the products and/or services, as needed.

· Prepares contracts, bids, proposals, and vendor agreements for legal review, price, and acceptability of items to specifications, as requested.

· Prepares and issues purchase orders and change notices for raw materials, equipment parts and general office supplies.

· Oversees all activities related to procurement of a commodity from intent to purchase through delivery of commodity; monitors processing of the PO in the system until it’s fully closed.

· Tracks on time deliveries with vendors.

· Investigates and resolves pricing discrepancies between supplier invoices and purchase orders.

· Enters records of all received materials in the system on a daily basis.

· Maintains and keeps procurement records.

· Participates in inventory of materials and equipment parts on a monthly basis, as assigned.

· Additional duties and responsibilities as assigned

REQUIREMENTS

· Associate of Art or Science degree (A.A. or A.S.) from two-year College or school; or three to five years related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

· Certified Purchasing Professional (CPP) a plus

· Excellent analytical and communicational skills

· Bilingual English/Spanish

Dosal Tobacco pays 100% of health insurance for all employees, with the employees having the option to provide additional coverage for their families. Dosal also provides a 401(k) pension plan and profit sharing plan to its employees.

As part of the pre-employment screening process, all potential employees are subject to a drug screen and background investigation.

EOE

Pay: $65,000.00 - $70,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

description:
Join Elliott Aviation as a **Procurement Specialist** and play a critical role in supporting aircraft maintenance, repair, and overhaul (MRO) operations. In business aviation, where precision, reliability, and responsiveness drive every flight, our Procurement Specialists ensure the right parts and materials are available at the right time to keep aircraft operating safely and efficiently.

If you excel at sourcing materials, building supplier relationships, negotiating favorable terms, and managing competing priorities, this role offers the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on customer satisfaction, operational performance, and work order profitability.

**Let us introduce ourselves:**

Elliott Aviation began on a modest grass airstrip in DeWitt, Iowa. Over the past 90 years, we have grown into a diversified aviation services company while maintaining the personal touch that has defined us from the beginning. At Elliott Aviation, our team is at the heart of what we do. Since 1936, we've built our reputation as one of the most respected MRO providers in the country by combining cutting-edge facilities, highly skilled teams, and a culture of excellence.

**What would you do as a Procurement Specialist?**

As a Procurement Specialist, you will be responsible for the timely and cost-effective sourcing of aircraft parts, materials, and supplies that support maintenance operations. Your ability to procure the right parts, manage supplier relationships, and maintain inventory visibility directly impacts aircraft downtime, operational efficiency, and customer satisfaction. Working closely with maintenance, materials distribution, shipping/receiving, and finance teams, you will help ensure materials are available when needed while supporting profitability and quality objectives.

**Responsibilities of this position include:**

* Source and procure aircraft parts and materials from approved vendors to support MRO operations.
* Place purchase orders promptly based on parts order sheet submissions.
* Ensure timely follow-up on order confirmations, delivery schedules, and backorder resolutions.
* Negotiate with vendors to secure competitive pricing, favorable terms, and timely delivery.
* Escalate pricing discrepancies, shortages, and delays in accordance with established procedures.
* Coordinate warranty claims and core return activity with vendors and internal stakeholders.
* Maintain accurate purchasing and supplier records within ERP and MRO systems.
* Support inventory management efforts through min/max evaluations and inventory replenishment.
* Communicate expected delivery dates and potential shortages to internal customers.
* Track supplier performance and support continuous improvement initiatives.
* Help achieve and maintain parts margin objectives on assigned work orders.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**Top candidates will possess:**

* Strong procurement, purchasing, or supply chain experience.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Solid math and analytical skills, including margin and markup calculations.
* Ability to work under pressure and meet critical deadlines.
* Experience working with ERP systems and the ability to learn new software platforms quickly.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Excel.
* Positive attitude and team-oriented approach to problem solving.
* Ability to effectively collaborate with cross-functional teams.

**Education and Experience:**

**Required**

* High school diploma or equivalent.
* 1-2 years of purchasing, procurement, or supply chain experience.
* Experience using ERP systems in a business environment.
* Ability to work onsite in Moline, IL.

**Preferred**

* Aviation procurement experience.
* Experience supporting aircraft maintenance, repair, and overhaul (MRO) operations.
* Pentagon2000 experience.
* Familiarity with FAA Part 135 and Part 145 operations.
* Experience sourcing aircraft parts and managing supplier relationships.
* Experience supporting procurement functions across multiple industries.

**Schedule**

* Typical schedule is Monday through Friday, 7:00 a.m. to 3:30 p.m.
* Occasional schedule adjustments may be required based on business needs.
* No travel required.

**Physical Requirements**

This position is primarily office-based. Occasional support may be requested within materials distribution or warehouse operations. Must be able to perform the physical requirements of the position, including occasional walking, standing, lifting, carrying, and moving materials consistent with business needs.

**Why join Elliott?**

At Elliott Aviation, you're not just joining a company, you are becoming part of a legacy built on service, craftsmanship, and trust. For 90 years, we've set the standard in aircraft services, delivering world-class craftsmanship and personalized solutions that keep our customers soaring. Here, your ideas matter, your expertise

Bothell, WA

Full Time

Finance and Operations

Mid Level

SystImmune is a leading and well-funded clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company located in Bothell, WA and Princeton, NJ. It specializes in developing innovative cancer treatments using its established drug development platforms, focusing on bi-specific, multi-specific antibodies, and antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs). SystImmune has multiple assets in various stages of clinical trials for solid tumor and hematologic indications. Alongside ongoing clinical trials. SystImmune has a robust preclinical pipeline of potential cancer therapeutics in the discover and IND-enabling stages, representing cutting-edge biologics development. We offer an opportunity for you to learn and grow while making significant contributions to the company's success.

The Procurement Specialist will be responsible for sourcing and purchasing goods and services that meet the company’s operational requirements. This role involves vendor management, contract negotiation, cost control, and ensuring timely delivery while maintaining quality standards. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of procurement processes, excellent communication skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively across multiple departments.

This is a full-time onsite position in Bothell, WA.

**Responsibilities**

* Identify and evaluate potential suppliers and develop strong relationships with existing vendors.
* Assess supplier capabilities, negotiate terms, and secure competitive pricing.
* Create and manage purchase orders, ensuring compliance with company policies.
* Negotiate contracts, terms, and conditions to ensure optimal terms for the company.
* Ensure all contracts adhere to legal, safety, and environmental guidelines.
* Implement cost-saving initiatives without compromising quality or timelines.
* Track procurement spending and identify areas for process improvements or cost reductions.
* Coordinate with inventory and supply chain teams to ensure timely delivery of materials and services.
* Monitor stock levels and anticipate purchasing needs to avoid shortages or excess inventory.
* Evaluate supplier performance regularly to ensure adherence to quality, delivery, and cost standards.
* Address any performance issues and develop improvement plans where necessary.
* Ensure all procurement activities comply with the company’s policies and relevant regulations.
* Maintain accurate records of purchases, suppliers, and pricing data for audit and reporting purposes.
* Work closely with other departments (e.g., finance, operations, and legal) to understand procurement needs and ensure smooth execution of the procurement process.
* Provide support and guidance to internal stakeholders on procurement best practices.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Accounting/Finance, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Previous experience or coursework in supply chain management or consulting.
* Strong negotiation and communication skills.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite.
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
* Knowledge of supplier management and contract law is a plus.

**Preferred**

* Experience in managing international suppliers or handling imports/exports.
* Familiarity with sustainable procurement practices.

**Compensation and Benefits:**

The expected base salary range for this position is $65,000 - $85,000 annually. Actual compensation will be based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to a candidate’s level qualifications, experience, and skills.

While most offers typically fall within the **low to mid-point** of the range, we may extend an offer toward the higher end for exceptional candidates whose background and expertise exceeds the requirements of the role.

**SystImmune is a leading and well-funded biotech company with a bright future. We offer an opportunity for you to learn and grow while making significant contributions to the company’s success. SystImmune offers a comprehensive benefits package including: 100% paid employee premiums for medical/dental/vision, also STD, LTD, a 401(k) plan with a 50% company match of up to 3% and a vesting schedule of only 5 years, 15 PTO days per year, sick leave, plus 11 paid holidays and MORE.**

**We offer an opportunity for you to learn and grow while making significant contributions to the company’s success.**

**SystImmune is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome diverse talent and encourage all qualified applicants to apply.**

Finding the right supplier—with the technical capabilities, capacity, quality, cost structure, and reliability to support advanced manufacturing—is something different. Elmet Technologies is looking for a Technical Procurement Specialist to strengthen critical supply lines, develop supplier capabilities, and support the acquisition of equipment and services across our manufacturing operations.

This position can be based in **Euclid, Ohio, Lewiston, Maine, or Coldwater, Michigan.**

Reporting to the Director of Strategic Sourcing, you’ll work at the intersection of Procurement, Engineering, Operations, Quality, and Production Planning. You’ll evaluate suppliers and manufacturing capabilities, analyze total cost, manage capital equipment purchases, and lead sourcing activities supporting new and existing customer programs. This is an opportunity for someone who understands both procurement and manufacturing—and wants to use that expertise to build a stronger, more resilient supply chain.

**What’s In It for You**

* $90,000–$110,000 annual salary
* Benefits starting Day One, including medical, dental, and vision insurance
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid time off and paid holidays
* Tuition assistance
* Professional development and internal growth opportunities
* A highly visible role supporting strategic manufacturing and customer programs
* Opportunity to influence supplier strategy, capital equipment decisions, and supply-chain resilience
* Cross-functional work with Engineering, Operations, Quality, Production Planning, and Strategic Sourcing
* Exposure to technically complex manufacturing processes, equipment, materials, and suppliers
* Opportunity to support projects from supplier identification through production readiness

**What You’ll Do**

As a Technical Procurement Specialist, you’ll help ensure Elmet has the suppliers, equipment, materials, and technical capabilities needed to support current operations and future growth. Your responsibilities will include:

* Source, evaluate, qualify, and onboard new suppliers to strengthen critical supply lines
* Assess supplier technical capabilities across machining, coating applications, materials, and other manufacturing processes
* Evaluate suppliers for technical capability and production readiness
* Solicit and evaluate supplier proposals
* Analyze proposals using a total-cost-of-ownership approach
* Lead supplier cost analysis and support commercial negotiations
* Manage procurement of capital equipment from requirements development through installation and commissioning
* Partner with technical stakeholders to identify equipment requirements and evaluate technical specifications
* Conduct vendor assessments and oversee purchasing activities for equipment acquisitions
* Lead project-based procurement activities supporting new and existing customer programs
* Support customer launch readiness and sourcing risk-mitigation strategies
* Partner with Engineering, Production Planning, Operations, and Quality on supplier qualification and equipment acquisition
* Develop and maintain documentation supporting supplier onboarding, equipment purchasing, and project procurement
* Identify opportunities to improve supply-chain resilience and reduce sourcing risk
* Participate in continuous-improvement initiatives supporting long-term strategic customer and business requirements

Requirements:

**What We’re Looking For**

You’ll be a strong fit if you bring:

* 5+ years of procurement experience
* Supplier cost analysis and negotiation experience
* Experience purchasing capital equipment
* Experience with supplier development or technical sourcing of components, processes, or specialized materials
* Working knowledge of manufacturing processes, equipment commissioning, and production workflow integration
* Project management experience, particularly involving launch readiness, risk mitigation, or customer-driven timelines
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret technical drawings, specifications, and process requirements
* Familiarity with ERP/MRP systems and procurement workflow tools
* Ability to collaborate effectively across Engineering, Quality, Operations, Production Planning, and other functions
* Experience in a manufacturing environment supporting continuous improvement or Lean initiatives

A bachelor’s or associate degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Operations, or a related technical field is preferred.

**How You’ll Make an Impact**

Success in this role means creating more than purchase orders. You’ll help build the supplier and equipment capabilities Elmet needs to deliver for its customers. You’ll make an impact by:

* Developing capable and reliable suppliers for critical materials,

SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

**SOURCING SPECIALIST, OPEX (STARLINK)**

One of the most ambitious missions that SpaceX has undertaken to date, the Starlink constellation is our solution to providing reliable internet to the entire world. To capitalize on our technical and market success, our team will execute large-scale projects that will define the bottom-line for the Starlink program. The functions within the department include procurement, planning and fulfillment, supplier development and quality, logistics, inventory management, negotiation of supplier contracts and pricing, and developing the commodity strategy.

This is a high-profile, cross functional position that plays an integral role in enabling development and production flow for Starlink production. You will work in close coordination with engineering and manufacturing departments, executing effective, creative and smart supply chain strategies to achieve production goals. With integration taking place in-house, sourcing specialists are able to see their assemblies come to life every day!

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Place purchase orders and resolve blocked invoices related to assigned category
* Forecast demand, evaluate capacity, and manage supply signals to adjust incoming material
* Track high risk components and supplier delivery performance
* Communicate clearly and rapidly to influence decisions of vendors and senior leadership
* Interpret engineering drawings and BOMs
* Create sourcing strategies for all custom items, COTS hardware, and other Indirect Categories
* Develop a preferred supplier network and leverage it to minimize cost and lead time for the fabrication and delivery of parts
* Supported commodities include but are not limited to machined parts, electromechanical equipment, large machining, finish processes, mechanical assemblies, etc
* Solve complex, open-ended problems with an emphasis on speed and efficiency
* Manage outsource fabrication projects including planning, coordinating with stakeholders, estimating completion, and manage vendor performance
* Perform onsite reviews of vendor capabilities
* Responsible for authoring of contract documents with the legal department
* Management of contracts ensuring performance of the supplier to contract obligations
* Understand interrelationships between contracts and terms while applying creativity and sound business reasoning to interpret application of contract to business needs
* Utilize negotiations to maximize value and cost savings benefit while lowering risk

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor's degree or 2+ years of experience working in purchasing, procurement, material planning, production planning, supply chain management, or engineering in lieu of a degree

**PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:**

* Experience with MRP or enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems, and with managing bill of materials, work orders, and purchase orders
* Experience with forecasting, demand planning, and lead time analysis
* Detail-oriented, self-motivated and able to respond quickly to a fast-moving and ever-changing environment. Capability to prioritize multiple on-going projects
* Strong track record for achieving results; must be able to reference wins and quantify impact
* Strong skills in data analysis using Excel, SQL and PowerBI
* Solid understanding of common manufacturing processes and machines including mills, lathes, waterjet, laser cutters, sheet metal fabrication, etc
* Familiar with common material finishes and coatings, including paint, powder coat, anodize, heat treatment, etc
* American Production and Inventory Control Society (APICS) certification, Six Sigma certification, or similar certifications
* Effective written and verbal communications skills, with strong ability to communicate to all levels of internal personnel
* Demonstrated ability to work in ambiguous situations and across organizational boundaries. History of self-learning & application of newly learned tools & techniques
* Ability to learn quickly and prioritize appropriately to meet customer and company needs

**ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:**

* Willingness to work extended hours and weekends when needed to meet critical deadlines
* Ability to travel and communicate outside of work hours
* Ability to travel: up to 20% - 50% of work week
* Must be able to work onsite, remote work not considered

**ITAR REQUIREMENTS:**

* To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. **Who We Are:**

For over 35 years, ISC has provided safe, high quality electrical, instrumentation and controls solutions to global leading industrial manufacturers. With offices in Baton Rouge, Beaumont, Houston, and Corpus Christi, Texas, as well as job sites around the country, ISC has grown our team as high as 3,000+ associates and offers full-service engineering, construction, and maintenance solutions throughout the United States.

**The Position:**

Supports the regional logistics and procurement daily activities of sourcing suppliers and purchasing products, equipment, and services to support work in the Columbus Regional Office.

This role will spend a significant amount of time supporting material management, warehouse operations, equipment coordination, and logistics functions in addition to procurement.

**Responsibilities:**

* Responsible for strategic resourcing, negotiating and long-term supplier relationships
* Coordinate material flow from suppliers to warehouse locations and final jobsites
* Monitor and expedite critical-path materials, long-lead equipment, and procurement risks
* Direct continuous improvement of purchasing processes in line with changing organizational needs and market conditions
* Evaluate suppliers based upon price, quality, and customer service leveraging purchases to maximize price discount
* Oversee the operations and daily activities of the purchasing department
* Assist with planning and execution of material staging, laydown areas, and site logistics
* Maintain procurement logs, material status reports, inventory records, and equipment tracking procurement, rentals, repairs, calibrations, and asset tracking databases
* Maintain procurement logs, material status reports, inventory records, and equipment tracking databases
* Support warehouse operations through inventory tracking, material transfers, jobsite releases, and receiving coordination
* Coordinate with project management, superintendents, warehouse personnel, vendors, and accounting teams to support uninterrupted field operations
* Assist project estimators with material quotes for bids
* Support project closeout activities including surplus material disposition, warranty tracking, equipment reconciliation, and vendor account resolution

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management or related field preferred
* Purchasing professional certifications a plus
* 5+ years of experience in a purchasing environment
* Experience working in a purchasing group required
* Industrial construction material procurement experience required
* Procurement of electrical construction materials a plus
* Onsite industrial and/or data center experience a plus
* Experience with an ERP system required - Vista experience a plus
* Proficient in Microsoft Office Products – Intermediate level required

### **Competencies:**

* Professional written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to maintain positive business relationships with suppliers and internal customers
* Strong analytical skills
* Motivated to recognize and resolve problems independently
* Ability to comprehend, analyze, and interpret complex documents
* Capacity to manage multiple priorities
* Willingness to work as part of a team

**Other Information:**

* Excellent wages and complete benefits package.
* We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.
* ISC evaluates and hires applicants for employment based exclusively upon the applicant’s merit. No applicant will ever be required to pay money (or any other form of compensation) to an ISC employee in order to be hired by or considered for employment with the Company.
* This announcement is not intended to be a complete listing of all similar, miscellaneous, or incidental, duties, which may be required from day-to-day. ISC utilizes the multi-skill concept and expects all associates to perform other job requirements.

**Accessibility: If you need an accommodation as part of the employment process please contact Human Resources at**
**Phone: 225.756.7501**
**Email: hr@iscgrp.com**

**Equal Opportunity Employer, including disabled and veterans.**

**JOB TITLE: Buyer/Analyst**

**DEPARTMENT: Procurement**

**REPORTS TO: Director of Procurement**

**FLSA STATUS: Exempt**

**POSITION SUMMARY**

The Buyer/Analyst is primarily responsible for sourcing, purchasing, and managing parts, tooling, repairs, services, and supplies required to support the company’s fleet and maintenance operations. This position manages the procurement process from requisition through delivery, ensuring materials are available when required, purchased at competitive cost, and meet quality, traceability, and regulatory requirements.

The position also provides support for inventory and stockroom control by assisting with the receipt, issuance, storage, shipment, documentation, and reconciliation of materials. The Buyer/Analyst uses inventory, consumption, and demand information to make purchasing and stocking decisions and works closely with Maintenance, Planning, Supply Chain, Finance, and vendors to maintain adequate material support.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

Procurement & Inventory Planning — Primary

* Provide adequate and timely material support to maintenance stations and company operations.
* Create, issue, coordinate, and manage purchase and repair orders with approved vendors.
* Coordinate with Maintenance Planning to ensure materials are purchased and staged in advance of scheduled maintenance.
* Review material requisitions, inventory levels, station allocations, usage, and consumption data to determine appropriate stock coverage and reorder points.
* Analyze demand, consumption, manufacturer data, and forecasts to establish appropriate inventory positions and purchasing requirements.
* Source aircraft parts, tooling, MRO services, repairs, and other materials while identifying alternate sources and cost-saving opportunities.
* Assist with RFPs, bids, supplier contracts, and annual/bulk purchasing agreements.
* Conduct price and cost analysis and negotiate pricing, terms, conditions, specifications, and scopes of work with suppliers and contractors.
* Manage removed cores and repair orders, including determining appropriate repair conditions, BER status, exchange options, and beneficial repair sources.
* Monitor rotable and expendable spares and establish appropriate reorder points and inventory allocations.
* Develop and maintain an Approved Supplier List and monitor supplier quality, delivery, pricing, and overall performance.
* Process supplier warranty claims for failed, damaged, or lost components and coordinate resolution with vendors and internal departments.
* Review and resolve purchasing and invoicing discrepancies in coordination with Finance.
* Develop short- and long-term sourcing and inventory planning strategies.
* Monitor industry changes, supplier capabilities, material availability, and alternate sources.
* Identify and document cost savings and cost-avoidance opportunities.
* Support surplus inventory sales and disposition activities. Inventory & Stockroom Support — Secondary
* Support the stockroom in issuing parts and tooling and ensuring proper control and security of company inventory and assets.
* Assist with receiving, inspecting, counting, identifying, locating, storing, staging, packing, and shipping parts and materials as required.
* Review packing slips, certifications, traceability documents, and vendor documentation associated with received materials.
* Verify incoming and outgoing materials and documentation and ensure transactions are properly recorded in the company’s systems.
* Assist with cycle counts, physical inventory, inventory reconciliation, and investigation of discrepancies.
* Identify damaged, defective, expired, excess, or obsolete materials and coordinate appropriate disposition.
* Maintain awareness of aircraft parts certification, traceability requirements, material shelf life, and tool calibration requirements.
* Assist in maintaining proper housekeeping, organization, security, and inventory control within assigned areas.
* Ensure materials are handled, stored, and shipped in accordance with company procedures and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Perform other duties as assigned by the Supply Chain Supervisor or Director of Procurement.

**POSITION REQUIREMENTS**

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

* Strong purchasing, procurement, analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
* Knowledge of aviation MRO, aircraft

The Procurement Specialist supports the day-to-day execution of procurement activities for the Rockville manufacturing site across direct materials, indirect materials, services, capital expenditures (CapEx), and operating expenditures (OpEx). This role partners closely with the Associate Director, Procurement and cross-functional stakeholders to ensure business requirements are competitively sourced, contractually supported, and fulfilled in accordance with Samsung Biologics procurement policies and applicable GMP requirements.

The Procurement Specialist contributes to site performance by improving procurement execution, maintaining spend and supplier visibility, supporting cost-reduction initiatives, monitoring supplier performance, and proactively identifying supply and commercial risks. This role serves as a key procurement partner to Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Quality, Engineering, Finance, and other business functions while supporting the requisition-to-purchase order (PO) process, supplier onboarding, procurement compliance, and audit readiness.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Execute and support RFQ/RFP activities for assigned categories, including supplier identification, quotation collection, bid analysis, commercial evaluation, negotiation support, and supplier recommendations.
* Support implementation of global procurement strategies, policies, systems, and processes at the Rockville site.
* Ensure procurement activities meet business requirements while remaining aligned with global procurement standards and local operational needs.
* Manage the requisition-to-PO process, ensuring timely and accurate procurement transactions.
Support supplier onboarding activities and maintain procurement compliance documentation.

Contract Management

* Support the development, review, negotiation, execution, renewal, and administration of procurement-related agreements, including Master Service Agreements (MSAs), Statements of Work (SOWs), Quality Agreements, Purchase Order Terms & Conditions, Amendments, and other contractual documents.
* Coordinate with Procurement leadership, Legal, Finance, Quality, and business stakeholders throughout the contract lifecycle.
* Maintain organized procurement records and ensure compliance with applicable procedures, policies, and approval requirements.
* Monitor contract expiration dates, renewal schedules, commercial obligations, and required procurement actions to minimize business and compliance risks.
Ensure adherence to Samsung Biologics procurement policies, delegation-of-authority requirements, GMP expectations, and applicable regulatory standards.

Data Analysis & Reporting

* Maintain accuracy of supplier master and item master data within procurement systems.
* Track and report procurement savings, cost avoidance, and productivity initiatives.
* Support category management strategies and continuous cost-improvement efforts.
* Analyze procurement and spend data to identify trends, cost-saving opportunities, supply risks, and areas requiring management attention.
Develop and maintain reporting dashboards and metrics related to spend visibility, sourcing pipeline, supplier performance, PO compliance, savings, and other procurement KPIs.

Supplier Management

* Monitor supplier performance, including delivery, quality, responsiveness, pricing, and contractual compliance.
* Coordinate with Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Quality, and suppliers to resolve material shortages, delivery issues, quality concerns, invoice discrepancies, and other supply-related challenges.
* Support supplier performance reviews and follow-up on corrective action plans.
* Identify and mitigate potential supply risks, including long lead times, single-source dependencies, capacity constraints, and supplier performance issues.
* Escalate significant supplier, continuity, commercial, or compliance risks to Procurement leadership and appropriate stakeholders.

Education

Bachelor's degree in supply chain management, Business Administration, Procurement, Finance, Engineering, Life Sciences, or a related field required.

Experience

* 3 years or more of procurement, purchasing, strategic sourcing, or supply chain experience in a manufacturing environment.
* Experience supporting GMP-regulated pharmaceutical, biotechnology, life sciences, medical device, or related industries preferred.
* Experience working with ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics, or similar enterprise platforms.
Experience supporting supplier management, contract administration, sourcing activities, and procurement operations preferred.

Preferred Qualifications

* Professional procurement certification (e.g., CPSM, CPM, CSCP, APICS, or equivalent) preferred.
* Experience supporting procurement activities within a GMP-regulated biopharmaceutical manufacturing environment.

**Procurement Specialist**
==========================

**Location:** Odessa

**Position overview**
---------------------

Plum Gas Solutions is seeking a highly organized, relationship-oriented Procurement Specialist to support the company’s Operations organization in Odessa. This position will play an important role in ensuring that teams have timely access to the parts, equipment, materials, and services required to operate safely, efficiently, and cost-effectively.

The Procurement Specialist will manage purchasing activities from initial sourcing through vendor coordination, delivery, inventory support, and issue resolution. The role will work primarily with Operations while partnering closely with Engineering and Manufacturing to understand technical requirements, anticipate business needs, and help keep work moving without unnecessary delays or expense.

This is an ideal opportunity for someone who combines strong customer service instincts with purchasing discipline and practical business judgment. The successful candidate will be comfortable researching suppliers, comparing options, negotiating commercial terms, monitoring inventory, and maintaining productive vendor relationships. Just as importantly, this person will understand that every purchase represents company resources and will consistently look for ways to make responsible, cost-conscious decisions without compromising quality, service, safety, or operational continuity.

The Procurement Specialist will interact with vendors, internal stakeholders, and business partners on a regular basis and will represent Plum Gas Solutions’s brand and standards in every interaction. Success in this role requires professionalism, follow-through, attention to detail, clear communication, and the ability to collaborate across teams in a fast-paced operating environment.

**Essential responsibilities**
------------------------------

### **Sourcing and purchasing**

* Source parts, equipment, materials, and related services to support operational requirements.
* Identify qualified suppliers and evaluate options based on quality, availability, lead time, service, and total cost.
* Obtain and compare quotations, pricing, delivery commitments, payment terms, and other commercial conditions.
* Negotiate pricing, terms, delivery schedules, and service expectations with vendors.
* Process and track purchase requests and orders accurately and in a timely manner.
* Follow up on open orders, backorders, delayed shipments, substitutions, and other exceptions.
* Help ensure purchased items meet applicable specifications and the needs of the requesting team.

### **Inventory and operational support**

* Monitor inventory levels and support timely replenishment of critical parts and materials.
* Coordinate with Operations, Engineering, and Manufacturing to understand current and anticipated requirements.
* Help identify critical, high-use, obsolete, or slow-moving inventory and support appropriate action.
* Resolve purchasing, availability, quality, and delivery issues quickly and professionally.
* Maintain accurate records of purchases, vendor information, pricing, order status, and delivery commitments.
* Contribute to a dependable procurement process that supports operational continuity and minimizes avoidable downtime.

### **Vendor and internal relationship management**

* Build and maintain professional, productive relationships with suppliers and service providers.
* Serve as a responsive point of contact for internal customers and provide clear updates on purchasing activity.
* Communicate requirements, changes, delivery expectations, and issues clearly to vendors and internal stakeholders.
* Partner with cross-functional teams to understand needs, clarify priorities, and identify practical solutions.
* Represent Plum Gas Solutions positively and professionally in person, by phone, and in written communication.

### **Cost control and process improvement**

* Practice sound cost control and responsible spending in all purchasing decisions.
* Look for opportunities to reduce costs, improve terms, consolidate purchases, and increase purchasing efficiency.
* Apply practical judgment when balancing price, quality, availability, lead time, and business urgency.
* Follow established purchasing processes and contribute ideas that improve accuracy, visibility, and efficiency.
* Support appropriate documentation and accountability for purchasing activity.

**Required qualifications**
---------------------------

* Experience in purchasing, procurement, parts, inventory, customer service, or a related field.
* Strong oral and written communication skills.
* Demonstrated ability to provide responsive, professional customer service.
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy in managing orders, records, pricing, and follow-up.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with Operations, Engineering, Manufacturing, vendors, and other business partners.

**Overview**

We are seeking a dynamic and detail-oriented Procurement Specialist to join our team and drive strategic sourcing, vendor management, and procurement operations. In this role, you will be instrumental in optimizing supply chain processes, managing procurement experience 8-30 yrscontracts, and ensuring compliance with procurement regulations. Your expertise will support the organization’s goals by fostering strong supplier relationships and delivering cost-effective procurement solutions. This position offers an exciting opportunity to contribute to a fast-paced environment where proactive sourcing and negotiation skills are highly valued.

**Responsibilities**

* Manage end-to-end procurement processes, including sourcing, purchasing, and contract negotiations across various categories.
* Utilize ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle EBS, and E-procurement platforms to streamline procurement workflows and maintain accurate records.
* Conduct market research and supplier assessments to identify optimal sourcing options aligned with organizational needs.
* Negotiate contracts with vendors to secure favorable pricing, terms, and service levels while ensuring compliance with procurement regulations such as Federal Acquisition Regulations.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with project teams, supply chain management, and finance to align procurement strategies with organizational goals.
* Perform root cause analysis to resolve supply chain issues, improve procurement efficiency, and enhance quality management practices.
* Maintain comprehensive vendor contract management records, monitor supplier performance, and manage supplier relationships effectively.

**Qualifications**

* Proven experience in procurement management within public sector or federal environments is preferred.
* Strong familiarity with ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle EBS, and other e-procurement tools.
* GED HIGH SCHOOL DIPLOMA
* Certifications
* Referrals
* Demonstrated expertise in contract negotiation, strategic sourcing, category management, and procurement contract management.
* Knowledge of procurement regulatory frameworks including Federal Acquisition Regulations (FAR) is highly desirable.
* Excellent negotiation skills combined with the ability to conduct direct negotiations for procurement contracts.
* Experience in supply chain management, materials management, and pricing strategies.
* Strong project management skills with the ability to handle multiple priorities efficiently.
* Effective communication skills for cross-functional collaboration and vendor engagement.
* Background Check must pass

Join us to be part of a forward-thinking team committed to excellence in procurement operations! We value proactive problem-solving, strategic thinking, and a passion for optimizing supply chain performance in a vibrant work environment.

CSI – a custom hardware/software engineering company headquartered in Richardson, TX, is seeking a talented Procurement Specialist. The Procurement Specialist will support all procurement aspects for CSI and will be responsible for, and perform as necessary, the daily activities associated with procuring materials & services, receiving material, invoicing, qualifying vendors, tracking purchases, and various other aspects related to supply chain management. The ideal candidate will have a background in procurement. It is important that the Crescent Systems Procurement Specialist views their role as an important team member in the production of hardware and software products.

**The selected candidate will be subject to government security investigations and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information.**

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Must be a U.S. Citizen and have the ability to obtain a U.S. Government Security Clearance
* Bachelor’s degree in supply chain, Business, Management or equivalent combination of education and experience
* Must have 7 years of procurement experience, preferably in a manufacturing environment.
* Direct experience ensuring contractual requirements are met in all issued purchase orders
* Primary user of the software tools associated with procurement and manufacturing operations
* Proficiency using MS Office suite of programs to include MS Word, MS Excel and MS PowerPoint
* Keep records, prepare reports, and follow specific instructions
* 5+ years with DoD experience
* Trusted agent and responsible for procurement activities and actions to ensure company success
* Experience working directly with Engineering and drawing packages
* Current Secret or Top-Secret Security Clearance

**CANDIDATE MUST POSSESS THE ABILITY TO:**

* Multi-task
* Train and instruct employees in proper use of computers/network system functions and resources
* Effectively carry out difficult and complex tasks while exercising independent judgment and initiative
* Manage multiple concurrent priorities and meet critical deadlines
* Work independently as well as part of a team; self-motivated
* Be adaptive and proactive
* Show initiative by seeking ways to improve processes
* Performs other duties as required

If you are passionate about Supply Chain and eager to contribute to innovative aerospace projects, we encourage you to apply for the position of Procurement Specialist at Crescent Systems, Inc. Join our dynamic team and be part of our mission to deliver exceptional solutions in the aerospace industry!

**Join the Lippert Team!**

Lippert is a leading, global manufacturer and supplier of highly engineered products and customized solutions, dedicated to shaping, growing and bettering the RV, marine, automotive, commercial vehicle and building products industries. We combine our strategic manufacturing capabilities with the power of our winning team culture to deliver unrivaled customer service, award-winning innovation and premium products to all of our customers.

**Strategic Sourcing Specialist**

The Lippert Corporate Aftermarket team is hiring a Strategic Sourcing Specialist to support the sourcing, development, and management of trailer running gear and towing products, including axles, brakes, hubs, drums, bearings, suspension, and related components. This position will work closely with Product Development, Engineering, Quality, and Supply Chain teams to identify and develop global supplier partnerships while supporting the growth of Lippert’s Aftermarket business. This position is based in the Elkhart, Indiana area.

**Responsibilities**

* Serve as a subject matter expert for assigned product categories and provide technical guidance to support business objectives.
* Serve as the category expert for trailer running gear products including axles, brake assemblies, hubs, drums, bearings, suspension, and towing components.
* Identify, evaluate, and qualify domestic and international suppliers for running gear product categories.
* Identify, evaluate, and manage supplier relationships to ensure quality, cost, delivery, and performance expectations are met.
* Partner with cross-functional teams, including Engineering, Quality, Product Development, and Purchasing, to define product requirements and execute sourcing strategies.
* Assess supplier capabilities, manufacturing processes, quality systems, and operational capacity to support organizational growth.
* Lead cost analysis, supplier negotiations, and continuous improvement initiatives to optimize value and performance.
* Support product development and sourcing activities throughout the product lifecycle, from concept through commercialization.
* Monitor product performance, customer feedback, and quality trends to identify opportunities for improvement and corrective action.
* Collaborate across departments to introduce new products, enhance existing offerings, and expand product portfolios.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s Degree preferred.
* 5+ years of experience working with trailer axles, brakes, hubs, suspension systems, bearings, towing products, or related running gear categories.
* Strong understanding of trailer component applications, fitment requirements, and industry standards.
* Experience in sourcing, product management, engineering, category management, purchasing, or supplier development preferred.
* Ability to review product drawings, specifications, and quality requirements.

**Preferred Education and Experience**:

* College Degree (Associates or Bachelors)
* Buying or sales experience
* International Private Label Product Development experience is preferred

**Travel:**

Travel independently, domestically as well as globally up to 10% of time.

**Work Authorization/Security Clearance**

Must be legally authorized to work in the United States.

**Why We are Different:**

At Lippert, Everyone Matters. This is not just a tagline or empty promise; it is who we are. We have intentionally created a culture that values and celebrates our team members’ unique and varied backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. We strive to give our team members a deeper sense of purpose at work, and we continue to build a better work environment by aligning our cultural and business strategies with the needs of our team members.

**What You will Get:**

* A unique, inclusive and supportive company culture.
* Comprehensive benefit offerings including medical, dental, vision, 401k with employer match, vacation, and more!
* Fair and competitive compensation.
* Career development and mentoring and opportunities to grow.
* Holiday, personal and vacation days.

**Apply at careers.lippert.com!**
