About Us:

Quanta Power Solutions brings together the industry-leading capabilities and resources of Quanta's operating companies to deliver complete EPC solutions. Our integrated approach spans power generation, battery energy storage, renewables, transmission, substation, and underground infrastructure — from concept to commissioning, we execute complex power infrastructure projects with the speed, certainty, and operational excellence our customers depend on.

At Quanta Power Solutions, we are driven by a culture of safety, integrity, and disciplined execution — and we're building a team that shares that commitment.

About this Role:

Quanta Power Solutions is seeking an experienced Procurement Specialist III to lead procurement activities for complex Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) projects supporting power generation, renewable energy, battery energy storage systems (BESS), data centers, substations, transmission, and industrial infrastructure. This senior-level procurement professional is responsible for strategic sourcing, supplier management, commercial negotiations, contract administration, procurement planning, and project execution support.

What You'll Do:

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Lead procurement activities from project award through closeout.
* Develop sourcing strategies for major equipment, materials, and subcontracted services.
* Manage RFIs, RFQs, RFPs, bid evaluations, purchase orders, contracts, and change orders.
* Negotiate pricing, delivery schedules, commercial terms, and supplier agreements.
* Coordinate with Engineering, Construction, and Project Management teams to support project execution.
* Manage supplier relationships, performance evaluations, and strategic sourcing initiatives.
* Track procurement schedules, long-lead equipment, and material deliveries to support project timelines.
* Support cost control efforts through strategic sourcing, budgeting, forecasting, and spend analysis.
* Resolve commercial and contractual issues while ensuring compliance with company policies and project requirements.
* Drive continuous improvement, supplier quality, and procurement best practices.

What You'll Bring:

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Construction Management, Engineering, Logistics, or a related field required.
* Equivalent combination of education and relevant procurement experience may be considered.

**Experience**

* Minimum 5–8 years of procurement, strategic sourcing, supply chain, contract administration, or purchasing experience.
* Minimum 3 years of experience supporting industrial construction, energy, utility, manufacturing, or EPC projects.
* Experience procuring engineered equipment, fabricated materials, and subcontracted services preferred.
* Experience supporting power generation, renewable energy, BESS, data center, transmission, substation, or industrial infrastructure projects strongly preferred.

**Travel Requirements**

* Ability to travel up to 15% as required for supplier meetings, fabrication facility visits, project site support, supplier audits, and industry events.

What You'll Get:

* Competitive Compensation
* Weekly Pay
* 401(k) Retirement Plan
* Holiday Pay
* Paid Time Off (PTO)
* Comprehensive Health Coverage
* Pet Insurance
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Professional Development Opportunities
* Tuition Assistance
* Employee Discount Program

Equal Opportunity Employer:

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin or ancestry, sex (including gender, pregnancy, sexual orientation, and/or gender identity), age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, and/or any other basis protected by applicable federal, state or local law.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability and protected veteran status.

We prohibit all types of discrimination and are committed to providing access and equal opportunity for individuals with disabilities. For additional information or if reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application, interview, or hiring processes or to perform the essential functions of a position, please contact us the Company’s Human Resources department.

SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

**SR. SOURCING SPECIALIST (STARSHIP)**

SpaceX is seeking a Sr. Sourcing Specialist with a demonstrated track record of extreme ownership and a high sense of agency to own end-to-end procurement and fulfillment of critical mechanical hardware in support of the Starship program. Supply chain functions at SpaceX include procurement, planning and fulfillment, supplier development and quality, logistics, and inventory.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Own sourcing activities across a range of commodities, including precision-machined components, outside processes (e.g., heat treat, coatings), forgings, castings, and other complex manufactured parts.
* Quote, negotiate, and place purchase orders for precision-machined components while ensuring alignment with technical specifications, cost targets, and delivery schedules.
* Forecast demand, evaluate supplier capacity, and proactively manage purchase orders to ensure uninterrupted supply of piece parts in support of aggressive development and production schedules.
* Track and drive supplier performance across quality, delivery, responsiveness, and cost in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
* Interpret engineering drawings and technical specifications to select and align with suppliers that deliver optimal manufacturability, quality, and cost efficiency.
* Manage frequent design changes by clearly communicating updates to the supply base, minimizing downtime, and reducing lead times through proactive coordination.
* Take initiative to solve complex, open-ended supply chain problems in an ambiguous, fast-evolving environment to ensure continuity of supply.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with key internal and external stakeholders to drive alignment, foster collaboration, and enable effective change management throughout the product lifecycle.
* Consistently deliver results with a high level of efficiency and effectiveness, balancing speed and accuracy to meet critical program deadlines.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Advanced degree; or bachelor's degree and 2+ years of experience working in one or more of the following; or 6+ years of experience working in one or more of the following:
+ Engineering
+ Supply Chain
+ Purchasing
+ Contract negotiation
+ Material or production planning
+ Operations management
+ Material cost control
+ Master production scheduling

**PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:**

* Experience leveraging AI tools and large language models to accelerate sourcing activities, including supplier research, cost analysis, demand forecasting, risk assessment, and contract review.
* Demonstrated ability to operate in ambiguous situations, work across organizational boundaries, and rapidly self-learn and apply new tools and techniques.
* Experience leading supplier development, qualification, and onboarding activities to expand and diversify the supply base for high-rate production.
* Strong data analysis skills using Excel, SQL, and Power BI.
* Experience with MRP/ERP systems and managing bills of materials, work orders, and purchase orders.
* Detail-oriented, self-motivated, and able to thrive and prioritize in a fast-moving, ever-changing environment with multiple concurrent projects.
* Experience with forecasting, demand planning, and lead time analysis
* Proven track record of achieving results with the ability to quantify impact.
* Solid understanding of common manufacturing processes and equipment, including mills, lathes, forgings, castings, heat treatment, and coatings.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to interface effectively at all levels of the organization.

**ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:**

* Ability to travel domestically and internationally up to 15%.
* Ability to work extended hours and/or weekends as needed.
* This position is based in Hawthorne, CA and requires being onsite - remote work not considered

As the largest private-sector power producer in the world and the nation's largest producer of clean and reliable energy, Constellation is focused on our purpose: lighting the way to a brilliant tomorrow for all. We have been the leader in clean energy production for more than a decade, and we are cultivating a workplace where our employees can grow, thrive, and contribute. Now integrated with Calpine, our portfolio includes 55 gigawatts of capacity from nuclear, natural gas, geothermal, hydro, wind and solar facilities, with the generating capacity to power the equivalent of 27 million homes.

Our culture and employee experience make it clear: We are powered by passion and purpose. Together, we're creating healthier communities and a cleaner planet, and our people are the driving force behind our success. At Constellation, you can build a fulfilling career with opportunities to learn, grow and make an impact. By doing our best work and meeting new challenges, we can accomplish great things. Join us in meeting the country's energy needs today and tomorrow.

Constellation offers an extensive selection of benefits and rewards to help our employees thrive professionally and personally. We provide competitive compensation and a wide-range of benefits that support both employees and their families, helping them prepare for the future. In addition to highly competitive salaries, eligible employees are offered a bonus program, 401(k) with company match, employee stock purchase program; comprehensive medical, dental and vision benefits, including robust wellbeing programs; disability and life insurance benefits; paid time off for vacation, holidays, and sick days; and much more.

**Strategic Sourcing Specialist**

Composed of Chromalox, Durex Industries, Vulcanic, and Thermocoax businesses, Electrical Thermal Solutions (ETS), part of Spirax Group, creates electrical process heating and temperature management solutions, including industrial heaters and systems, heat tracing, and a range of component technologies.

At Chromalox, we build advanced thermal technologies for the world’s most challenging industrial heating applications.

Headquartered in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, we got our start with an innovative solution 100 years ago when a self-taught engineer invented the first metal-sheathed resistance heating element. It was this then-advanced thermal technology that launched an entire industry.

We excel in industries that have high expectations. We are acknowledged as experts at delivering solutions that exceed specifications, limit risk, and reduce operating costs.

Join us as we continue to provide solutions to our customers and the world!

**The Role:**

As the Strategic Sourcing Specialist, you will lead category strategy, supplier sourcing, and contracting activities across key product and service categories. This role will collaborate with engineering, quality, production and finance teams to deliver sustainable cost savings, ensure supply continuity, and drive procurement process improvements. The successful candidate will analyze market trends, conduct competitive sourcing events, negotiate contracts, and manage supplier performance to support business growth and operational excellence.

**Your Responsibilities:**

* Intelligence studies to identify supplier trends, cost drivers, and risk factors
* Maintain supplier qualification and ongoing performance management (e.g., scorecards, audits)
* Collaborate with internal team-engineering, legal, quality assurance, and operations—to ensure alignment with sourcing decisions
* Identify supply chain risks; develop and execute mitigation and continuity plans to manage supply disruptions and escalation issues
* Drive continuous cost-optimization, process improvement, and performance metrics tracking
* Identify, evaluate and qualify new suppliers. Help find second sources for any single sourced items
* Issue and maintain blanket purchase orders for commodities
* Other duties as assigned

**Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, or related field; advanced degrees preferred
* Proven experience (5–7 years) in sourcing or procurement, preferably in strategic sourcing and category management
* Industry-specific expertise (manufacturing)
* 2-3 years proven ETO or MTO manufacturing environment experience
* Strong negotiation skills; ability to secure favorable commercial terms and supply agreements
* Proficiency in ERP/MRP systems and advanced Excel for spend and data analysis and reporting
* Analytical mindset for data-driven decision-making
* Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities for stakeholder management
* Organizational and time management skills to handle multiple sourcing projects
* Strong ethical judgment and strategic orientation
* Procurement/Supply Chain credentials: CPSM, CIPS, CPIM, ISM CSP or equivalent preferred

**Payrate:** $75,000 - $85,000

At Chromalox, we are not just an employer but a champion of equal opportunities and inclusivity. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace that adheres to the highest hiring standards and is free from discrimination and harassment.

Chromalox is an equal opportunity employer; our commitment extends to all aspects of employment, ensuring that no individual is mistreated or discriminated against based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristic as defined by federal, state, or local laws.

+ Ability to communicate effectively with all levels of applicants

description:
The Enviva team is driven by our shared vision for a renewable energy future. We are a fast-growing, purpose-driven, global energy company specializing in delivering sustainable wood bioenergy solutions. We are the world's largest producer of sustainable wood pellets, which provide a low-carbon alternative to fossil fuels.

The Procurement Specialist has an important role in the Procurement Organization with the responsibility for the sourcing of equipment, goods, and services while reducing cost and ensuring on time delivery to meet organizations goals and objectives. This person will be responsible for managing and communicating the requirements of the organization to the supply base. This position will also facilitate the operations and implement procedures for effective stockroom management.

**Responsibilities**

* Evaluate approved requisitions for accuracy and potential cost savings.

* Execute approved purchase orders and distribute to approved vendors.

* Maintain vendor database utilizing current vendors and only adding vendors with added value to the organization.

* Manage relationships with key suppliers to maintain quality of goods, timely delivery and compliance with the organizations terms and conditions.

* Focus on consolidating vendors by developing synergies with other sites within the organization to achieve optimum cost savings.

* Support and implement Procurement leadership cost saving initiatives.

* Measure and hold suppliers accountable for performance as measured in supplier scorecards.

* Manage on-site vendors to ensure all procedures are followed.

* Coordinate with accounting to ensure pricing/invoicing accuracy.

* Assists receiving with delivery discrepancies.

* Support continuous improvement throughout the organization.

* Establish and implement procedures to ensure organization and effectiveness of the stockroom.

* Evaluate and determine proper inventory levels for the stockroom.

* Effectively communicate potential supply disruptions throughout the organization.

* Promote safety initiatives and enforce the organization's safety policies.

* Execute Enviva's OEMS System, Gembas, Coaching, Visual Administration, 5's, Material Strategy, Root Cause Analysis, Material and information flow, 7 wastes, VA and NVA activities, Continuous Improvement, TPM, Communication.

**Qualifications**

* Professional career on engineering, business or related - Desirable

* Strong Background on Commercial Negotiations.

* Stockroom management experience required.

* Professional Level of experience in the manufacturing industry is required.

* Basic knowledge on MRP.
* 3 to 5 years of experience in Purchasing/Materials Management areas.

**Physical Requirements**

* Primarily office-based with periodic visits to manufacturing facilities and warehouses.
* Ability to travel occasionally to supplier locations and company facilities.
* Ability to safely enter industrial environments while wearing required personal protective equipment (PPE).

This position is not eligible for visa support.

**EEO Statement**

Enviva is dedicated to the principles of equal employment opportunity (EEO) in any term, condition or privilege of employment. Enviva does not discriminate against applicants or employees on the basis of race, color, creed, religion, sex, national origin, age, physical or mental disability, ancestry, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, uniform service member, genetic information or any other status protected by law. Enviva complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location in which we operate.

Job Summary

Dragon Woodland is seeking a motivated and detail-oriented **Lumber Buyer / Procurement Specialist** to join our team in Houston, Texas.

This position will be responsible for sourcing, negotiating, and purchasing logs, lumber, and related raw materials from domestic and international suppliers. The ideal candidate is bilingual in English and Mandarin, has strong negotiation and supplier-management skills, and has previous experience in purchasing, procurement, or material sourcing.

The role requires regular travel to supplier locations, lumber mills, and industry events.

Key Responsibilities

* Source, negotiate, and purchase logs, lumber, and related raw materials from domestic and international suppliers
* Develop and maintain strong supplier relationships to ensure stable supply and competitive pricing
* Evaluate supplier capacity, product quality, pricing, and delivery performance
* Monitor market conditions, pricing trends, and supply availability within the forestry and agricultural sectors
* Work closely with operations and logistics teams to coordinate deliveries, scheduling, and inventory planning
* Conduct supplier visits, site inspections, and supplier audits
* Prepare purchasing reports, forecasts, and cost analyses for management review
* Ensure procurement activities comply with applicable environmental, legal, and company requirements

Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Procurement, Forestry, Agriculture, Business Administration, or a related field preferred; equivalent experience will also be considered
* 1–3+ years of experience in purchasing, procurement, sourcing, or material buying
* Experience in lumber, forestry products, agriculture, commodities, or raw-material sourcing is preferred
* **Bilingual proficiency in English and Mandarin is required**
* Strong negotiation, communication, and supplier-management skills
* Ability to analyze market trends and adjust purchasing strategies accordingly
* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Word, Outlook, and ERP or purchasing systems
* Ability to travel approximately **40%**, including visits to suppliers, lumber mills, and industry event

Pay: $78,000.00 - $94,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) 4% Match
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Retirement plan
* Vision insurance

**Job Description**

**Position Summary**

The Level I Procurement Specialist is an entry-level contributor, supporting the efficient acquisition of goods and services through routine purchasing and contract-related tasks. This role assists in processing procurement requests, conducting basic sourcing activities, and ensuring compliance with established procurement policies and procedures. The role collaborates with internal stakeholders, vendors, and multiple state agencies to provide timely, service-oriented support that upholds procurement standards and contributes to the overall effectiveness of the shared services initiative.

**Position Responsibilities**

* Utilizes and manages the state purchase card in accordance with State Purchase Card Rules and internal ABS Procurement guidelines.
* Prepares requisitions, purchase orders, change orders, and other required procurement forms.
* Handles daily procurement needs, prepares purchasing documents, assists with solicitations, and coordinates with Accounts Payable to support procure-to-pay processes.
* Administers annual contract renewals, ensuring compliance with purchasing rules and timely completion of fiscal year updates.
* Maintains organized records, documentation, and agency files.
* Supports team activities to ensure consistent service delivery across Finance teams.
Maintains required certifications, stays updated on policy changes, and completes mandatory training.

**Education and Experience**

Requirements include:

* A bachelor’s degree in business, or a closely related field; or
* Four (4) years of clerical, contracting, or procurement experience; or
* A combination of education and experience, substituting one year of experience for each year of the required degree.
Certification as State of Oklahoma Certified Procurement Officer (CPO) Level I or must attain certification within 90 Days

**Knowledge/Skills/Abilities**

Knowledge/Skills/Abilities include:

* Basic knowledge of procurement principles, purchasing processes, and state procurement guidelines, or the ability to learn them quickly.
* Strong attention to detail with the ability to accurately process routine procurement and change order requests.
* Effective communication and customer service skills when working with internal staff, state agencies, and vendors.
* Ability to follow established procurement procedures and work under direct supervision in a structured environment.
* Solid organizational skills with the ability to manage routine tasks, maintain accurate procurement documentation, and support renewal activities.
* Basic problem-solving skills with the ability to assist in resolving straightforward procurement or data-entry issues.
Ability to obtain CPO Level I certification and P-Card credentials within required timeframes.

**Physical Demands and Work Environment**

This position works in a comfortable office setting with a computer for a large percentage of the work day. The noise level in the work environment is usually mild. Occasional travel may be required.

**Schedule**

This is a full-time, 40-hour per week position.

This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

The State of Oklahoma is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of genetic information, race, religion, color, sex, age, national origin, or disability.

Current active State of Oklahoma employees must apply for open positions internally through the Workday Jobs Hub .

**Job Summary**

The Stocking Specialist / Buyer supports nursery operations by monitoring stock levels, sourcing plant material, and ordering replenishments for assigned departments. This role works closely with vendors, receiving staff, and internal teams to ensure plant material and related inventory are available to meet operational and sales needs while avoiding shortages, overstocks, or inactive inventory.

The Stocking Specialist / Buyer manages purchase orders, coordinates deliveries, resolves vendor issues, and maintains accurate vendor and inventory records. This role balances daily operational needs with efficient purchasing practices to support consistent product availability across the nursery.

**Essential Functions**

* Research and source plant material for special orders requested by the Sales Team.
* Maintain positive and effective relationships with plant vendors and suppliers.
* Maintain and update vendor information in company systems.
* Create and process purchase orders for plant material and related items.
* Verify receipt of purchased materials and work with vendors to resolve shipment discrepancies, shortages, or damages.
* Negotiate with vendors to obtain competitive pricing while maintaining quality standards.
* Ensure purchase documentation and approvals are completed so vendor payments can be processed in a timely manner.
* Serve as a liaison between internal departments and vendors to coordinate purchasing and delivery needs.
* Work with vendors to schedule or expedite deliveries and resolve delivery issues such as shortages, late deliveries, or missed shipments.
* Coordinate logistics to ensure plant material arrives at the appropriate nursery location in a timely manner.
* Monitor changes in plant availability, vendor pricing, and purchasing terms.
* Participate in pricing updates, inventory projects, and other operational initiatives as needed.
* Support administrative tasks related to purchasing, inventory, and vendor coordination.

**Additional Responsibilities**

* Assist with inventory-related projects and operational initiatives as needed.
* Support cross-departmental coordination related to purchasing and stocking activities.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**Experience & Other Requirements**

**Required**

* Minimum of 2 years of experience working in a nursery, horticulture, or related industry.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Word and Excel.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to coordinate multiple purchasing and inventory activities simultaneously.

**Preferred**

* Associate degree (AA) or higher.
* Experience creating purchase orders within inventory or ERP systems.
* Familiarity with plant sourcing and vendor coordination within nursery operations.

**Work Environment & Physical Requirements**

This is an in-office position located at the nursery site. Remote work is not available except for short-term situations approved in advance by upper management.

The role requires regular movement between office and nursery yard environments.

Physical requirements include:

* Remaining in a stationary position (sitting or standing) for extended periods.
* Frequent typing and use of computer systems including data entry and 10-key functions.
* Use of hands and fingers for typing, filing, and operating office equipment.
* Gross grasping and manual handling of documents or office materials.
* Occasional walking through outdoor nursery areas which may involve uneven ground surfaces and exposure to varying weather conditions.
* Lifting up to 20 lbs. approximately 20% of the time.

Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position.

The Procurement Specialist supports the Agency’s procurement and inventory operations by maintaining accurate vendor

and inventory records, processing inventory submissions, assisting Staff with quotes and purchasing needs, monitoring

stock and pricing fluctuations, and ensuring timely, organized, and compliant procurement activities.

* Minimum: High School Diploma or Equivalency
* Valid Florida Driver's License
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook)
* Basic knowledge of general office equipment

* Maintain vendor records, insurance certificates, catalogs, and supplier performance data.
* Source and evaluate vendors, obtain quotes, and support purchasing decisions.
* Enter and process requisitions, procurement forms, and inventory submissions.
* Monitor stock levels, pricing, and reorder points; research pricing and bulk purchase options.
* Review purchase orders, confirm vendor receipt, and support PO processing as needed.
* Manage issued property records and coordinate returns or transfers for Staff members.
* Update inventory‑related spreadsheets and run reports as requested.
* Maintain accurate files in agency systems and support annual inventory activities.
* Handle multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and apply procurement best practices while adhering to Agency

policies and confidentiality requirements.

* Other duties as assigned.

* Adhere to laws/agency policy/rules/ regulations/SOP/ procedures.

with lawful requirements.

* Maintain continuity and operational efficiency by accurate and timely dissemination of information to Staff and

co-workers.

notification to supervisor regarding absence from work due to illness or untimely incidents, etc.)

Overview

Sourcing Specialist

The Sourcing Senior Specialist will manage the placement and confirmation of all direct import buys and perform research into the development of new resources and assist in the resolution of quality and delivery issues.

Key Responsibilities:

* Manage and execute brand or product category and report directly to the Director
* Work to build effective strategic relationships with cross-functional partners, internal stakeholders, external suppliers and teams to drive results and influence change.
* Manage internal and external teams and Time and Action to deliver on IMU, quality and delivery goals.
* Conduct pre-and post-season analysis and present findings and actions to executive management
* Maintain detailed product cost information (CIP, Fabric)
* Responsible for negotiating program pricing and delivery
* Monitor quality and delivery performance metrics and implement improvement initiatives
* Manage move outs, cancellations, and liabilities
* Special Projects, as assigned Core Competencies & Accomplishments:
* Builds relationships with all internal and external partners
* Manages execution and drives performance of sourcing strategies in all functions

Qualifications:

* 1-3 years of related experience in retail, apparel manufacturing, quality and trade agreements preferred
* Strong communication skills and negotiation skills; ability to build relationships cross-functionally
* Excellent organizational skills; attention to detail
* Ability to multi-task successfully and prioritize while meeting critical deadlines
* Proficient in Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Word)

What you get:
If eligible, we offer a competitive benefits package including medical/dental/vision, term life insurance, paid vacation/holidays\\*, and 401(k) with Company match. All associates are eligible for an associate discount on all Catalyst Brands merchandise. For paid holidays, associates who are eligible for paid vacation (MTO) are also eligible for eight paid holidays during the calendar year. All store hourly associates scheduled to work on a designated holiday will receive additional compensation. \\*For paid vacation days, as well as eligibility requirements for other benefits, please visit www.catalystbrandsbenefits.com

About JCPenney:
JCPenney is the shopping destination for diverse, working American families. With inclusivity at its core, the Company’s product assortment meets customers’ everyday needs and helps them commemorate every special occasion with style, quality, and value. JCPenney offers a broad portfolio of fashion, apparel, home, beauty, and jewelry from national and private brands and provides personal services including salon, portrait and optical. The Company and its 50,000 associates worldwide serve customers where, when, and how they want to shop – from jcp.com to more than 650 stores in the U.S. and Puerto Rico. In 2024, JCPenney celebrates 122 years as an iconic American brand by continuing its legacy of connecting with customers through shopping and community engagement.

Pay Range

USD $48,000.00 - USD $63,000.00 /Yr.

Location Cleveland, Ohio, 44115 Category Business Functions JR103424 Applied Industrial Technologies, Inc 1100 Applied Industrial Technologies, Inc. Regular Job Type Full time

Embrace the opportunity to become an Indirect Procurement Specialist for Applied Industrial Technologies.

***SCOPE OF RESPONSIBILITY***

* Assist in the strategic sourcing and management of indirect spend categories such as office supplies, uniforms, and travel to optimize cost and service.
* Serve as point of contact for indirect goods/service providers and internal customers while ensuring appropriate levels of management engagement and approval.
* Develop Requests for Proposal, purchase contracts and professional services agreements.
* Create and maintain indirect purchasing policies, procedures, and process controls.
* Gather market intelligence and track industry trends for assigned purchasing categories.
* Execute Environmental, Social, and Governance initiatives within assigned spend categories.
* Build and maintain beneficial relationships with internal customers and suppliers.
* Develop and execute cost reduction strategies for assigned spend categories.
* Lead facilities management projects, at both local and field facilities, as needs arise.
* Other projects and duties as assigned.

**Job Duties**

* Oversee category administration, ensuring accurate financial coding, payment, supplier vetting and compliance with company standards.
* Deploy supplier performance and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Investigate, propose, and execute strategies and activities to reduce the company’s costs and increase service to customers.
* Create and maintain productive relationships between suppliers and internal customers.
* Lead contract development activity in conjunction with the Legal department.
* Facilitate the payment for indirect goods and services and troubleshoot issues as they arise.
* Act as Office Coordinator for Applied’s Corporate Headquarters location, including janitorial liaison and inventory management, furniture and workspace configuration and maintenance.
* Vet vendors, conduct purchase negotiation and execute the purchase of office and warehouse equipment and services for local HQ and field locations.
* Develop an annual budget; track and manage expenses within budget.

**Education and Experience**

* High School Diploma or equivalent is required; Bachelor's degree preferred.
* Strong organization and communications skills, especially e-mail.
* Experience with spreadsheet software and data analysis tools.
* 3+ years of experience in procurement or supply chain management preferred.

#LI-LG1 #LI-ONSITE

Founded in 1923, Applied Industrial Technologies (NYSE: AIT) is a leading value-added distributor and technical solutions provider of industrial motion, fluid power, flow control, automation technologies, and related maintenance supplies. Our leading brands, specialized services, and comprehensive knowledge serve MRO and OEM end users in virtually all industrial markets through our multi-channel capabilities that provide choice, convenience, and expertise.

**Applied Industrial Technologies is built on a philosophy that puts people first. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we are committed to a workforce in which we enforce fair treatment and provide growth opportunities for everyone. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of age, race, color, national origin, genetics, religion, gender, marital status, physical or mental disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.**

Working at Freudenberg: "We will wow your world!" This is our promise. As a global technology group, we not only make the world cleaner, healthier and more comfortable, but also offer our 52,000 employees a networked and diverse environment where everyone can thrive individually. Be surprised and experience your own wow moments.

We at Freudenberg-NOK Sealing Technologies run the business operations of Freudenberg Sealing Technologies (FST) in the Americas. Being part of the global Freudenberg Group, our company is a leading producer of advanced sealing technologies for automotive and general industries. Freudenberg-NOK Sealing Technologies is a joint venture between Freudenberg and NOK Corp. in Japan, is headquartered in Plymouth, MI, operates more than 20 facilities and employs about 4,700 people across the Americas.

### **Some of your Benefits**

#### **401K Match**

**401K Match:** Save for retirement with the company's help.

#### **Health Insurance**

**Health Insurance:** Rely on comprehensive services whenever you need it.

#### **Vacation**

**Vacation:** We offer time off to refresh and recharge.

#### **Paid Holidays**

**Paid Holidays:** With paid-time off, local holidays are all the way more relaxing.

#### **Personal Development**

**Personal Development:** We offer a variety of trainings to ensure you can develop in your career.

Plymouth, MI

On-Site

Freudenberg-NOK General Partnership

You support our team as

**Commodity Specialist**
========================

### **Responsibilities**

* Own commercial strategy and supplier management for assigned direct material commodities, with a focus on metals.
* Build and execute market analysis and commodity strategies, including supply base development and optimization.
* Develop raw material forecasts using complex datasets and feedstock market intelligence.
* Lead total cost management across the supply chain while aligning to divisional business objectives.
* Drive material risk mitigation strategies to address supply continuity, pricing volatility, and supplier performance.
* Negotiate and execute supplier agreements, including contracts and NDAs, ensuring compliance with company standards.
* Partner cross-functionally and globally with R&D, material technology, and operations to align sourcing with innovation and business needs.

### **Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Business, or a related field.
* 5+ years of experience in Purchasing or Supply Chain Management.
* Proven experience in commodity purchasing, preferably within automotive and metals.
* Strong negotiation skills with the ability to influence commercial outcomes.
* Analytical mindset with strong problem-solving capability and ability to interpret market and cost drivers.
* Experience with ERP/MRP systems such as SAP, QAD, or similar, and familiarity with supplier portals.
* Strong communication skills, executive presence, and a collaborative, high-energy, team-oriented approach.

description:
Are you the detail-obsessed problem solver who catches the pricing error before it costs a dime and keeps every order on track from PO to warehouse? Do you believe a great bid starts with accurate takeoffs and clean data? ACS is looking for an organized, analytical Procurement Specialist to own material purchasing, bid estimating, and pricing accuracy for our Commercial division: protecting margin and keeping our projects moving.

Welcome to ACS: Commercial & Residential Flooring Specialists, where innovation meets a values-driven culture.

At ACS, we’re more than a flooring company. We’re a growing, collaborative community grounded in four core values: Say Yes, Own It, Do What You Say, and We Care. These principles shape how we work, solve problems, and support each other every day.

As the Procurement Specialist, you will own material ordering and tracking for ACS Commercial, working alongside the Project Coordinator to get material where it needs to be, when it needs to be there. You will build large and complex bid quotes, source product and vendor pricing for the sales team, audit cost and freight, and serve as the owner of our product library, turnkey pricing, catalog, and quote templates.

Your work will directly impact margin, quote accuracy, and on-time material delivery; turning vendor pricing and project plans into bids that win and orders that arrive right the first time.

**Your objectives may be similar to:**

* Owning material ordering and tracking for sold jobs, ensuring every PO is accurate and every order is confirmed at the warehouse.
* Building accurate, competitive bid quotes and sourcing product and vendor pricing for commercial, multifamily, and property management projects.
* Protecting margin through disciplined cost, invoice, and freight auditing.
* Owning the product library, turnkey pricing, catalog, and quote templates so the sales team can quote quickly and accurately.

**Essential Functions**

(Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.)

**Ordering & Material Tracking**

* Place material orders for sold jobs and confirm PO accuracy against the quote.
* Track every open order until material is confirmed at the servicing warehouse, working alongside the Project Coordinator.
* Flag delays, backorders, shortages, and substitutions to sales and the Project Coordinator the same day.

**Bid Estimating & Product Sourcing**

* Build large and complex bid quotes for property management, multifamily, and commercial projects.
* Source products and obtain vendor pricing for the sales team’s bid work, including special-order and non-catalog items.
* Read plans and measures to produce accurate takeoffs, scope, and material quantities.
* Review quotes built by sales and field teams for accuracy and margin before they go out.

**Cost & Freight Audit**

* Audit vendor invoices, material cost, and freight against quotes and POs.
* Identify overcharges, billing errors, and margin leaks, and work with vendors to resolve them.
* Report monthly on cost, freight, and margin trends to the VP of Sales and National Accounts.

**Product Library, Pricing & Templates**

* Lead the initial cleanup of the product library to align with the turnkey catalog, and finalize turnkey pricing in partnership with Finance and the VP.
* Build quote templates that enable sales reps and Field Support Managers to quote quickly and accurately.
* Build and maintain property key guides outlining approved products, specs, and pricing by property for managed accounts.
* Maintain pricing on an ongoing basis, updating for changes in vendor cost, SKUs, or freight, and retiring discontinued SKUs.

**To excel in this role, you should possess the following qualifications:**

* 3+ years of experience in flooring, construction, or building-materials estimating, pricing, or purchasing.
* Ability to read plans and measures and produce accurate takeoffs.
* Advanced Excel skills, including lookups, pivot tables, and maintaining clean price files.
* Experience with CRM or database systems such as QuickBase, vendor portals, and Outlook, with the ability to learn new systems quickly.
* Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage many open orders, bids, and price changes at once and catch errors in quantities, SKUs, pricing, and freight before they cost money.
* Demonstrated ability to build and follow processes, including checklists, trackers, file structures, and standard steps that make work repeatable.
* Clear communicator with vendors, sales, and finance.
* Flooring product knowledge (LVP, hardwood, carpet, underlayment, transitions, prep) preferred.
* Experience with multifamily, property management, or commercial bids preferred.
* Experience with Home Depot Pro or a retail-installed program preferred.

**Benefits:**

* Medical, Dental, Vision
* Vacation (Planned Time Off)
* Sick/Personal (Unplanned Time Off)
* Flexible Spending Accounts
* Health

**Job Schedule:** 9/80: Employees work 9 out of every 14 days – totaling 80 hours worked – and have every other Friday off

**Job Description:**

Rocketdyne is currently seeking a Procurement Specialist to contribute to the success and growth of our Space business located in Mason, OH, supporting the procurement and management of machined and electronics components. The Procurement Specialist determines how to achieve objectives by applying a deep understanding of procurement principles, concepts, and practices in a DoD environment. This position requires a minimum of 6 years’ experience in defense procurement and manufacturing.

**Essential Functions:**

* Procure components and subassemblies to support various programs, including commodities such as electronic, mechanical, optical components or assemblies, capital equipment, and electronic/optical systems. The primary focus of this role will be on electronics.
* Manage Purchase Orders (POs) and other agreements for direct and indirect procurements; Includes preparation of Requests for Quotes (RFQs) and Requests for Proposals (RFPs), proposal evaluation and analysis, and issuance and maintenance of POs.
* Select and recommend suppliers, negotiate pricing, delivery, quality, terms and conditions, and execute non-disclosure agreements and service agreements.
* Contribute to material cost reduction strategy. Create and issue various types of POs, including Firm-Fixed Price and Time & Material.
* Lead source selection teams; conduct formal cost/price analysis to determine price fair and reasonableness. Negotiate the lowest possible total cost for the product (balance price with optimum quality and schedule needs).
* Identify opportunities to mitigate supply chain risk.
* Administer post-award of issued POs.
* Create purchase orders files in compliance with all command media and necessary process disciplines for audits.
* Support Integrated Product Teams (IPT) through supply chain representative or as an active team member.
* Monitor and provide feedback to IPT on critical supplier performance to ensure timely delivery to manufacturing schedules; Inter and Intra departmental coordination is essential.
* Active participation in company and department initiatives such as strategic sourcing and various L3Harris improvement efforts.
* Provide training and mentorship to peers to further Inter departmental growth.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s Degree and minimum 2 years of prior relevant experience or in lieu of a degree a minimum of 6 years of supply chain experience in aerospace, defense, or highly regulated manufacturing
* Strong background in strategic sourcing, planning, supplier management, and inventory optimization
* Knowledge of aerospace quality and regulatory environments including AS9100, FAA, DoD, or ITAR requirements preferred

**Preferred Additional Skills:**

* Experience using advanced Excel skills including use of pivot tables, lookup tables, etc.
* Knowledge within Deltek, Costpoint, and SAP.
* Knowledge in the procurement processes of military grade products.
* Demonstrated experience working within proposal teams, generating material estimates for bids and proposals, and providing substantiating evidence as needed is a plus.
* Willingness to learn DoD 5000.02 framework and Earned Value Management principles.
* Proven ability to direct and manage multiple projects with effective prioritization and resource allocation.
* Strong team player with excellent collaboration and interpersonal skills.
* Superior verbal and written communication abilities, along with strong organizational, negotiation, and management skills.
* Advanced computer skills, including proficiency to quicky learn ERP systems and MS Office applications, particularly Excel.
* Capability in reading and interpreting specifications, statements of work, and technical drawings.
* Extensive knowledge of FARS, DFARS, and ITAR regulations as they pertain to purchasing requirements.
* Extensive understanding of company policies and processes.
* Extensive understanding of small business government requirements.
* A strong commitment to learn continuous improvement methodologies, including Lean Six Sigma tools.

As a **Used Car Buyer/Trade In Specialist**, you are responsible for following up with leads and creating valuable guest experience for customers wanting to sell or trade in their vehicles.

**What you’ll be working on:**

* Reaching out to customers who have expressed interest in selling or trading in their vehicle
* Following up on inbound leads through phone, email, or text to gather vehicle info and set appointments
* Communicating regularly with customers to understand their needs and offer a competitive, fair-value deal
* Logging outreach and customer status updates in the CRM system
* Partnering with General Managers and Used Car Managers to understand inventory needs and source accordingly
* Occasionally attending car auctions to scout vehicle opportunities and support store-level buying goals

**What you need to bring to the table:**

* 1-3 years of customer service, retail, or sales experience
* Strong communication skills—both in person and over the phone
* Confidence in negotiating and guiding customers through the vehicle trade-in or selling process is a plus
* Ability to stay organized, follow up consistently, and work independently
* Valid driver’s license and clean driving record

**Salary:** $36,000-$150,000/annually

* Pay is based on applicable experience and skills. This job is eligible for commissions based on individual sales metrics.

**Industry Leading Benefits:**

* Values-driven culture and team built on integrity, caring, performance and efficiency
* Continuous career development and advancement opportunities
* Comprehensive benefits package (Medical, Dental, Vision)
* 401k with company match
* Employee Assistance Program with free telemedicine and mental health resources

Our enthusiastic and courteous team, award-winning culture, combined with our cutting-edge technology, provide guests with a one-of-a-kind, “best-in-class\\" dealership experience.

DGDG's 4 core values of Integrity, Caring, Performance, and Efficiency have stood at the cornerstone of our success. Our shared passion for training, teaching, recognition, reward, and promotion produce results that set us apart.

“Be happy” is much more than a slogan. It’s a way of doing business. We pride ourselves on making our guests and our team members exceedingly happy. And we’d be happy if you joined us!

DGDG takes your privacy seriously. You can learn more here: DGDG Privacy Policy\\*.

If you are looking for an exciting career with one of the top workplaces in the Bay Area - apply today! DGDG’s vision for success is driven by our unique culture and cutting-edge technology. To make our vision real, we look for sales professionals who think differently and strive to provide 100% guest satisfaction. We provide top-notch training to ensure your success and are proud to offer all our Sales team members one weekend off a month.

As a **Used Car Buyer/Trade In Specialist**, you are responsible for following up with leads and creating valuable guest experience for customers wanting to sell or trade in their vehicles.

**What you’ll be working on:**

* Reaching out to customers who have expressed interest in selling or trading in their vehicle
* Following up on inbound leads through phone, email, or text to gather vehicle info and set appointments
* Communicating regularly with customers to understand their needs and offer a competitive, fair-value deal
* Logging outreach and customer status updates in the CRM system
* Partnering with General Managers and Used Car Managers to understand inventory needs and source accordingly
* Occasionally attending car auctions to scout vehicle opportunities and support store-level buying goals

**What you need to bring to the table:**

* 1-3 years of customer service, retail, or sales experience
* Strong communication skills—both in person and over the phone
* Confidence in negotiating and guiding customers through the vehicle trade-in or selling process is a plus
* Ability to stay organized, follow up consistently, and work independently
* Valid driver’s license and clean driving record

**Salary:** $36,000-$150,000/annually

* Pay is based on applicable experience and skills. This job is eligible for commissions based on individual sales metrics.

**Industry Leading Benefits:**

* Values-driven culture and team built on integrity, caring, performance and efficiency
* Continuous career development and advancement opportunities
* Comprehensive benefits package (Medical, Dental, Vision)
* 401k with company match
* Employee Assistance Program with free telemedicine and mental health resources
* Exclusive Employee Vehicle Purchase Program with a 3-Year Service Maintenance Package

**More about DGDG:**

The Del Grande Dealer Group (DGDG) is the largest family-owned automotive group in the Bay Area. Our team is over 1,000 strong and growing. We’ve been named a Bay Area News Group Top Workplace for 16 consecutive years (not to mention being named a Top Workplace USA in 2020). Our enthusiastic and courteous team, award-winning culture, combined with our cutting-edge technology, provide guests with a one-of-a-kind, “best-in-class\\" dealership experience.

DGDG's 4 core values of Integrity, Caring, Performance, and Efficiency have stood at the cornerstone of our success. Our shared passion for training, teaching, recognition, reward, and promotion produce results that set us apart.

“Be happy” is much more than a slogan. It’s a way of doing business. We pride ourselves on making our guests and our team members exceedingly happy. And we’d be happy if you joined us!

DGDG takes your privacy seriously. You can learn more here: DGDG Privacy Policy\\*.

We are an equal opportunity employer and prohibit discrimination/harassment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

**About Us**
------------

Quanta Power Solutions brings together the industry-leading capabilities and resources of Quanta's operating companies to deliver complete EPC solutions. Our integrated approach spans power generation, battery energy storage, renewables, transmission, substation, and underground infrastructure — from concept to commissioning, we execute complex power infrastructure projects with the speed, certainty, and operational excellence our customers depend on.

At Quanta Power Solutions, we are driven by a culture of safety, integrity, and disciplined execution — and we're building a team that shares that commitment.

**About this Role**
-------------------

Quanta Power Solutions is seeking an experienced Procurement Specialist III to lead procurement activities for complex Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) projects supporting power generation, renewable energy, battery energy storage systems (BESS), data centers, substations, transmission, and industrial infrastructure. This senior-level procurement professional is responsible for strategic sourcing, supplier management, commercial negotiations, contract administration, procurement planning, and project execution support.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Lead procurement activities from project award through closeout.
* Develop sourcing strategies for major equipment, materials, and subcontracted services.
* Manage RFIs, RFQs, RFPs, bid evaluations, purchase orders, contracts, and change orders.
* Negotiate pricing, delivery schedules, commercial terms, and supplier agreements.
* Coordinate with Engineering, Construction, and Project Management teams to support project execution.
* Manage supplier relationships, performance evaluations, and strategic sourcing initiatives.
* Track procurement schedules, long-lead equipment, and material deliveries to support project timelines.
* Support cost control efforts through strategic sourcing, budgeting, forecasting, and spend analysis.
* Resolve commercial and contractual issues while ensuring compliance with company policies and project requirements.
* Drive continuous improvement, supplier quality, and procurement best practices.

**What You'll Bring**
---------------------

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Construction Management, Engineering, Logistics, or a related field required.

* Equivalent combination of education and relevant procurement experience may be considered.

**Experience**

* Minimum 5–8 years of procurement, strategic sourcing, supply chain, contract administration, or purchasing experience.

* Minimum 3 years of experience supporting industrial construction, energy, utility, manufacturing, or EPC projects.

* Experience procuring engineered equipment, fabricated materials, and subcontracted services preferred.

* Experience supporting power generation, renewable energy, BESS, data center, transmission, substation, or industrial infrastructure projects strongly preferred.

**Travel Requirements**

* Ability to travel up to 15% as required for supplier meetings, fabrication facility visits, project site support, supplier audits, and industry events.

**What You'll Get**
-------------------

* Competitive Compensation

* Weekly Pay

* 401(k) Retirement Plan

* Holiday Pay

* Paid Time Off (PTO)

* Comprehensive Health Coverage

* Pet Insurance

* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

* Professional Development Opportunities

* Tuition Assistance

* Employee Discount Program

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
------------------------------

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin or ancestry, sex (including gender, pregnancy, sexual orientation, and/or gender identity), age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, and/or any other basis protected by applicable federal, state or local law.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability and protected veteran status.

We prohibit all types of discrimination and are committed to providing access and equal opportunity for individuals with disabilities. For additional information or if reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application, interview, or hiring processes or to perform the essential functions of a position, please contact us the Company’s Human Resources department.

Headquartered in Houston, Texas, BWC Terminals is a premier provider of bulk liquid storage and logistics services to refiners, manufacturers, and distributors of bulk liquids in North America. The Company consists of 22 sites with over twenty million barrels of storage capacity. The BWC Terminals facilities are equipped to store a wide range of petroleum, chemical, renewables, and agricultural products. Additional information about BWC Terminals is available at www.bwcterminals.com.

**PURPOSE**

Responsible for the purchase of materials, equipment and services needed for BWC Terminals (The Company). Procurement Specialist analyze costs, negotiate contract details, and offer strategies and solutions to help companies better manage costs on supplies and vendor services. Additional duties may include: Tracking orders and resolving issues concerning price disputes. Acts as the main contact for suppliers. Communicate and negotiates on behalf of The Company to obtain the best price and quality for all material and services.

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

Below is a list of essential duties of this position. **NOTE**: Other duties may be assigned as needed.

* Delivers high quality purchasing services on a day-to-day basis according to defined procedures, respecting quantity, quality, and timing.
* Manage entire procurement life cycle from start to finish for assigned spend categories, by evaluating suppliers, handling sourcing, negotiations, issuing of purchase orders, and contract administration.
* Evaluates proposals and communicates proposals with potential suppliers and requestors.
* Ensure suppliers comply with PO or Master Service Agreement terms and conditions.
* Supports user in purchase request scope definition when needed.
* Perform rate analysis/negotiation and compliance oversight.
* Coordinate with Finance Department to ensure suppliers are paid on time.
* Maintains good working relations, acts professionally and positively represents The Company.
* Participates in relevant and mandatory training as assigned, conducts formal and informal user training on company P2P process.
* Takes the initiative to identify problems, uses judgment to find appropriate solutions and follows through on resolving issues in a timely manner.
* Supports team efforts, actively works to generate respect and enthusiasm, cooperates with others, and actively learns from other team members.
* Interacts and communicates in a professional and appropriate manner and responds to and gives feedback in a respectful and positive manner.
* Reports to work on time prepared to perform the duties of the position and willing to perform the duties as workload necessitates.
* Employee shall comply with applicable regulatory and The Company health, safety, environmental, and security requirements.Employee is expected to complete required training in a timely manner; perform duties in a safe and environmentally sound manner; and immediately report injuries/illnesses, environmental spills/releases, and any unsafe acts or conditions to supervision in support of continual improvement of The Company's health, safety, environmental, and security performance.

**EDUCATION, TRAINING, LICENSES, MINIMUM EXPERIENCE, SKILLS, LICENSES, AND QUALIFICATIONS**

To perform the duties of this position successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential function satisfactorily. The requirements listed below outline the knowledge, skills, abilities, and competencies that are required in this position. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

* Bachelor’s degree is required in Management, Supply Chain Management, or Business Administration.
* Minimum of 5-10 years of purchasing experience preferably in industrial environment.
* Proficient in Oracle Financials Procurement Module is preferred, but similar ERP experience will be considered.
* Knowledge of accounting principles and ability to accurately apply and use financial and accounting concepts.
* Ability to read, analyze and interpret general business and professional journals, technical procedures, governmental regulations, financial reports and legal documents.
* Ability to effectively present information, communicate with, and respond to questions and complaints from co-workers and management.
* Internal customer service focused.
* Attention to detail.
* Ability to interact with others in a professional and appropriate manner and to establish and maintain effective working relationships with others.
* Proficient with computers and applicable software (Excel, Word, Oracle, Outlook, SharePoint, and Oracle Financials).
* Ability to solve problems and ability to interpret a variety of instructions, policies, and data.
* Good organizational skills; ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines.

**Your Role:**
The **Senior Procurement Specialist** drives the organization's sourcing lifecycle to optimize costs, mitigate market risks, and guarantee supply continuity. This role balances strategic category leadership with execution, managing a diverse portfolio across both direct procurement (production-critical raw materials and inventory) and indirect procurement (operational goods, software, and corporate services). The ideal candidate acts as a strategic advisor to stakeholders and builds resilient, high-performing supplier networks.

Key Responsibilities:

* Process purchase orders, track deliveries, and ensure timely receipt of goods
* Responsible for negotiating preferred/discount pricing or contract pricing with vendors.
* Maintain strong relationships with suppliers, monitor performance, and resolve disputes or claims.
* Partners with AP to resolve vendor invoice issues.
* Partners with MSAT to drive second sourcing activities for raw materials.
* Helps with obtaining vendor documentation for RMS updates for materials.
* Drive sourcing strategies for raw materials and core engineering components to ensure milestones are being met.
* Complex Contracting: Draft and negotiating complex, multi-year Master Service Agreements (MSAs), Statements of Work (SOWs), and Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
* Help drive Key Performance Metrics (KPI’s) such as cost savings/avoidance, supplier performance and reduction in procurement cycle times.
* Managing high-value corporate spend categories (e.g., Enterprise Software, Global Facilities, Professional Services) and aligning procurement with executive business goals.
* Responsible for executing and managing enterprise-wide sourcing strategies for non-production goods and services. This role focuses on optimizing corporate spend, driving structural cost reduction initiatives, and building resilient supplier frameworks across high value spend categories.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Finance, or a related technical field.
* 5 to 8+ years of indirect/direct corporate procurement or category management experience.
* Experience with ERP / inventory control systems required, Dynamics D365 experience preferred.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication and influencing skills.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Professional certification (e.g., CPSM, MCIPS, or APICS/CSCP) is highly preferred.
* cGMP experience and writing SOP’s and contracts highly preferred.
* Elite negotiation skills with a proven track record of securing multi-million-dollar annual savings.

**Position Type/Expected Hours of Work:**

This role is a full-time onsite position in Tustin, CA. Days and hours of work are Monday through Friday 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. unless otherwise stated by Supervisor. The employee must also have the ability to work overtime and/or weekends when necessary.

**Compensation:**

We offer competitive compensation packages for this role, including a base salary, performance-based bonuses, and comprehensive benefits such as health, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) matching, and paid time off.

The compensation range for this role is $24.23 - $30.28 hourly depending on experience and qualifications. Additionally, we offer opportunities for career growth and development as well as a supportive and inclusive work environment.

**Who you are:**

* You have a "bring it on!" team player approach and an unshakable positive attitude, always ready to tackle anything that comes your way.
* Your written and verbal skills are out of this world, and you communicate with clarity and confidence.
* You have exceptional multitasking skills and an unparalleled attention to detail that ensure the smooth running of everything.
* You are a master at building relationships, capable of establishing connections with anyone, be it team members, clients, vendors, or suppliers.

**Physical Demands & Work Environment:**

In this dynamic role, expect a blend of regular activities like sitting, standing, and walking, with occasional physically engaging tasks such as lifting objects up to 25 pounds. The work environment might expose you to electrical shocks, toxic chemicals, vibrations, or loud noise levels occasionally. However, reasonable accommodations are available to enable individuals with different abilities to perform effectively, ensuring a supportive and adaptable work setting. Your visual acuity, including close, distance, and color vision, will be essential in navigating through the diverse day-to-day demands of this position.

---------------------------------

#### **\\*\\*REQUIRED: BILINGUAL ENGLISH/SPANISH\\*\\***

***This is not a traditional recruiting role. The primary focus is building long-term talent pipelines through community partnerships, outreach, and workforce development initiatives.***

*We're looking for someone who has experience building relationships in the community, developing workforce partnerships, & creating talent pipelines through outreach & engagement efforts rather than filling jobs through conventional recruiting methods. This role is an FTE position directly with Employbridge.*

**Job Summary**

The **Community Sourcing Specialist** drives proactive talent attraction and workforce development strategies within the local market. This role builds strong community partnerships, develops sustainable candidate pipelines, and leverages labor market insights to connect qualified talent with client opportunities. Working closely with operations, sales, marketing, and community organizations, the Manager strengthens Employbridge's presence in the market while supporting workforce planning, client success, and business growth. The ideal candidate is relationship-driven, knowledgeable of local labor trends, and passionate about creating innovative talent solutions.

**Role & Responsibilities**

**Market Talent Strategy & Pipeline Development**

* Develop and execute local recruiting strategies that drive candidate attraction and create a consistent talent pipeline for branches and onsite operations.
* Build market-specific talent pipelines based on labor availability, client demand, skill needs, and workforce trends.
* Identify and engage untapped talent pools while proactively building pipelines for high-volume, hard-to-fill, and critical roles.
* Establish sustainable sourcing channels that reduce reliance on reactive recruiting methods.
* Create and maintain referral networks through associates, community partners, alumni, redeployment opportunities, and grassroots recruiting.

**Community Partnerships & Workforce Development**

* Build and maintain partnerships with workforce boards, educational institutions, community organizations, and economic development groups.
* Develop relationships with diverse community networks, including immigrant, refugee, nonprofit, civic, and cultural organizations, to expand access to talent.
* Lead community outreach initiatives, hiring events, and recruitment campaigns that connect talent to employment opportunities.
* Maintain a visible community presence that strengthens Employbridge's reputation as a trusted workforce partner.
* Partners with organizations experiencing workforce reductions to connect displaced workers with employment opportunities.

**Labor-Market Intelligence**

* Monitor labor market conditions, including employment trends, wages, competitor activity, workforce availability, and market changes.
* Translate market intelligence into recruiting, workforce planning, and business development strategies.
* Identify emerging workforce trends and talent risks and share insights with operational and sales leaders to support proactive decision-making.

**Recruitment Marketing & Community Engagement**

* Partner with Marketing to develop localized recruitment campaigns and employment branding initiatives.
* Support digital, social, grassroots, and community-based recruiting efforts.
* Evaluate recruitment channel performance and adjust strategies to improve candidate engagement and conversion.

**Commercial & Operational Alignment**

* Partner with branch, onsite, and sales leaders to align talent supply with client needs and growth opportunities.
* Provide insights into talent availability, skill concentrations, wage expectations, and workforce trends to support workforce planning and sales efforts.
* Collaborate with operational teams to ensure talent strategies meet client requirements and service expectations.
* Help position Employbridge as a workforce partner that delivers both talent and market intelligence.

**Preferred Education and Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree or 2-4 years related experience in a business related field
* Previous experience in talent sourcing, sales/marketing, and/or labor market analysis is required
* Must have a valid driver’s license and satisfactory driving record
* Must provide proof of vehicle liability insurance

**Competencies (Skills and Knowledge)**

* Experience in recruiting, staffing, workforce development, talent acquisition, business development, or community engagement.
* Knowledge of local labor markets, workforce trends, and talent attraction strategies.
* Ability to build and maintain partnerships with community organizations, educational institutions, and business leaders.
* Strong relationship-building, communication, presentation, and networking skills.
* Ability to develop proactive talent pipeline and workforce solutions strategies.

We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented **Vehicle Buyer,** also known as **Vehicle Acquisition Specialist,** to support our inventory growth through the purchase, appraisal, and sourcing of vehicles. This role plays a critical part in maintaining the right mix of inventory to support dealership sales goals while ensuring compliance with all California and federal regulations.

The ideal candidate is market-savvy, analytical, and comfortable negotiating with customers.

* Source and acquire vehicles through customer purchases, trade-ins, and direct acquisitions
* Conduct vehicle appraisals using market data, vehicle condition, and dealership guidelines
* Monitor market trends, pricing tools, and inventory performance to make informed purchasing decisions
* Negotiate vehicle purchases professionally and ethically
* Ensure all acquisition documentation is completed accurately and in compliance with CA DMV and dealership policies
* Coordinate vehicle titles, payoff information, and required disclosures
* Collaborate with Sales, Finance, and Recon teams to align inventory with sales strategy
* Maintain accurate records within dealership management systems
* Represent the dealership in a professional manner at all times

Requirements

* High school diploma or equivalent preferred
* Prior automotive purchasing, appraisal, or sales experience preferred
* Strong negotiation, communication, and analytical skills
* Ability to work in a fast-paced, goal-driven environment
* Proficiency with inventory management systems and valuation tools (e.g., vAuto, KBB, Manheim) preferred
* Valid California driver’s license with acceptable driving record
* Ability to stand, walk, and inspect vehicles for extended periods
* Ability to operate a motor vehicle safely
* Weekends Mandatory

Salary Description

Expected Earnings: $50,000-$120,000 per year

**GET TO KNOW US**

Welcome to the City of Baltimore! Experience the reward of a fulfilling career and enjoy the added element of excitement in a vibrant, diverse atmosphere. The City of Baltimore offers limitless opportunities to help drive social impact, both on the job and in the community, while serving its citizens. Join us in making Baltimore a great place to live and work. In the City of Baltimore, we hire great people and provide them with the skills and opportunities to grow toward their career aspirations. If you are looking for a career change or interested in learning more, explore our opportunities and benefits programs. We are excited to have you as a part of the City of Baltimore Team! The city offers medical, prescription drug, dental, vision, optional life, AD&D, and FSA plans. This office also supplies wellness programs, support groups, and workshops. You can learn about our benefits here: https://humanresources.baltimorecity.gov/hr-divisions/benefits

**CLASS DEFINITION**

A Procurement Specialist II reviews, analyzes and develops highly complex procurement contracts for the procurement of specialized services and technology for City agencies. Work of this class may involve leading professional and paraprofessional procurement employees but does not involve full supervisory duties or responsibilities.

Employees receive minimum to moderate supervision from a Procurement Manager. Employees in this class work a conventional workweek. Work is performed in an office setting where there is no exposure to environmental hazards. Work requires minimal physical exertion.

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

***On or before the date of filing the application, each candidate must:***

**Education:** Have a bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university

**AND**

**Experience:** Have three (3) years of procurement experience **including** procurement planning and solicitation preparation, contract development, negotiation, and contract administration, with emphasis in utilizing complex Request for Proposal (RFP), Invitation for Bid (IFB), Request for Information (RFI), and Request for Quote (RFQs).

**OR**

**Equivalency Notes:** Have a master’s degree from an accredited college or university; and two (2) years of procurement experience including procurement planning and solicitation preparation, contract development, negotiation, and contract administration, with an emphasis in utilizing complex RFP’s IFB’s, RFI’s, and RFQs.

OR

Juris Doctor from an accredited school of law; and one (1) year of procurement experience to include but not limited to procurement planning and solicitation preparation, contract development, negotiation, and contract administration, with emphasis in utilizing complex RFPs, IFBs, RFIs, and RFQs.

OR

CPPB designation and 5 years of experience within the previous 10 years. A minimum of 50% of the required years of experience must be in government or public sector.

**LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS AND CERTIFICATES:**

Employees in this classification must take and pass the Universal Public Purchasing Certification Council (UPPCC) test for certification as a Certified Professional Public Buyer (CPPB) within three (3) years of hiring; failure to pass the test for certification is grounds for dismissal.

**\\*\\*APPLICATION DEADLINE:** *Please submit your application no later than* ***12:00 AM*** *on the closing date to be eligible for consideration.*

**KNOWLEDGES, SKILLS AND ABILITIES**

* Knowledge of theories, principles and practices of public procurement.
* Knowledge of procurement laws, regulations and policies.
* Knowledge of English usage, grammar and writing techniques.
* Skill in negotiating commodity, technology and service specifications and contracts.
* Skill in writing specialized and complex commodity, technology and service specifications and contracts.
* Skill in investigating and resolving complex disputes between City agencies and vendors concerning the provision of specialized technology and services.
* Ability to assign, review and correct the work of others.
* Ability to analyze complex and highly technical technology, equipment, service and supply requests.
* Ability to effectively communicate both orally and in writing.
* Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with vendors and contractors, City agency personnel, associates, and the general public.
* Ability to locate sources of supply and to obtain competitive bids.
Ability to maintain records and write reports.

**ADDITIONAL INFORMATION**

**Background Check**

Eligible candidates under final consideration for appointment to positions identified as positions of trust will be required to complete authorization for a Criminal Background Check and/or Fingerprint must be successfully completed.
