description:
**About Varda**
---------------

Low Earth orbit is open for business. Varda is accelerating the development of commercial space infrastructure, from in-orbit pharmaceutical processing to reliable and economical reentry capsules. **Varda's W-Series vehicles are built, designed, and operated by Varda in-house, including the pharmaceutical processing payloads, the capsules, the C-PICA heat shields, and the satellite buses.**

From life-saving pharmaceuticals to more powerful fiber optics, there is a world of products used on Earth today that can only be manufactured in space. Varda is accelerating innovation in the orbital economy by creating both the products and infrastructure needed so space can directly benefit life on Earth. Our mission is to expand the economic bounds of humankind.

Our team is uniquely suited to accomplishing this goal, with leadership and staff comprised of veterans from SpaceX, Blue Origin, major pharmaceutical companies and Silicon Valley. Varda was founded in January 2021 by Will Bruey and Delian Asparouhov with significant backing from world class investors including Khosla Ventures, Lux Capital, Founders Fund, Caffeinated Capital, General Catalyst, and Also Capital.

Varda is headquartered in El Segundo, California, where we have offices and a production facility where our vehicles, equipment, and materials are built, integrated, and tested. Varda also has offices in Washington, DC and Huntsville, AL.

Join Varda, and work to create a bustling in-space ecosystem.

**About this Role**
-------------------

As a Sourcing Manager, you will play a critical role in ensuring the seamless procurement of high-quality, precision-machined components for our cutting-edge space systems. In this fast-paced, dynamic environment, you'll work closely with engineering, production, and quality teams to source, evaluate, and manage suppliers of machined parts used in spacecraft assembly, propulsion systems, and other space hardware.

You will be responsible for managing the end-to-end procurement process—from identifying potential suppliers and negotiating contracts to monitoring delivery timelines and ensuring parts meet rigorous quality standards. As Varda continues to innovate and expand, your ability to source parts that adhere to strict performance and reliability criteria will directly contribute to the success of our mission to bring space-based manufacturing into the next era.

This is a full-time, exempt position located in our El Segundo headquarters.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Own purchasing for machined components and similar commodities from quote stage to delivery
* Send RFQs, place POs, run open order report meetings with key suppliers.
* Develop understanding of supplier capacity, lead times, and cost trends
* Work closely with supply chain engineering to develop a preferred supplier network to minimize cost and lead time
* Work closely with design engineering teams to understand upcoming design releases and part changes
* Build strong relationships with suppliers and negotiate pricing and lead times to meet mission milestones
* Identify part supply constraints that may impact production schedule and create mitigation plans
* Maintain part and planning master data to accurately reflect lead-times and stock levels
* Support purchasing of various commodities and inventory operations as needed

**Basic Qualifications**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in the field of Supply Chain, Engineering, Business, or Finance
* Minimum 4 years of relevant experience, ideally within space, aerospace, precision medical devices, pharmaceutical manufacturing, biotech/life sciences or similar
* Willingness and ability to travel up to 50% of the time
* Strategic sourcing of machined components or propulsion components
* Experience translating engineering designs into demand and supply plans
* Extensive experience using MES/ERP software
* Highly adept relationship building and influencing skills, and the ability to interact and work effectively with many levels of personnel and suppliers
* Detail-oriented and able to respond quickly to a fast-moving and ever-changing environment

**Preferred Skills and Experience**
-----------------------------------

* Technical knowledge and skills in coding and computer applications, (e.g. MS Office Suite, VBA, Smartsheet, SQL, Confluence, JIRA, Power BI, ION etc.)
* Proactive, quick learner, and ability to prioritize efforts to meet customer and company goals
* Ability to develop and maintain strong internal and external supplier relationships in a fast-moving and ever-changing environment
* Exceptional analytical and organizational skills
* Excellent customer service skills, highly self-motivated
* Effective written, verbal and presentation communication skills
* Previous work as a machinist (nice to have), plus understanding of manufacturing and the material flow process

**Pay Range**
-------------

* Salary range: $125,306 - $169,53

description:
Logitech is the Sweet Spot for people who want their actions to have a positive global impact while having the flexibility to do it in their own way.

The Role:

As a Sr Sourcing Deputy, you will play a crucial role in executing procurement processes, managing supplier relationships, and driving cost efficiencies. The focus will be on strategic sourcing and supplier management, including negotiations, contracting, and supplier performance. You will need to collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment with company goals and market trends.

Your Contribution:

* Develop and implement sourcing strategies that align with the company’s overall goals and objective

* Gathering and analyzing information about the market, including competitors, customers, trends and products

* Manage sourcing and procurement for electronic components.
* Oversee supplier management and negotiate pricing and contracts.
* Lead new supplier selection and vendor management.
* Responsible for cost negotiations, drive cost reduction strategies and identify sourcing opportunities.
* Collaborate with internal teams to provide market trend analysis; provide supplier roadmap and market trend & analysis to internal customers on regular basis
* Develop and maintain positive relationships with suppliers and partners.
* Ensure business continuity and risk mitigation strategies are in place, work on long term component capacity planning and identifying sourcing bottlenecks

Your Qualifications and Skills:

* At least 6-8 years of sourcing experience, especially in electronic components.
* High proficiency in English, both spoken and written.
* Strong analytical, communication, and negotiation skills.
* Ability to work globally across regions (US, EMEA, AP).
* Experience in strategic sourcing and international procurement.
* Ability to understand market drivers and cost structures.
* Strong interpersonal skills for effective collaboration.
* Proven track record in supplier and cost management.
* Knowledge of financial analysis related to sourcing.

Work Location and Model:

At Logitech, we empower global collaboration by providing a flexible hybrid work model. Depending on the role and team needs, this may include working remotely, on-premises, or a blend of both.

This is a hybrid position. The successful candidate is expected to work onsite at our San Jose, CA office 2–3 days per week, with the remaining days remote. Specific onsite days will be coordinated with your manager and team.

Compensation:

This position offers an annual base salary typically between $ 116,000 and $ 152,000 . In certain circumstances, higher compensation will be considered based on the business need, candidate experience, and skills.

Benefits:

Logitech offers benefits such as Medical Coverage, Dental Coverage, Vision Coverage, Traditional and Roth 401(k) Plans, Flexible Spending Accounts, Employee Share Purchase Plan (ESPP), Basic and Additional Life Insurance, Disability Coverage, Adoption and Surrogacy Assistance, Tuition Reimbursement Plans, Commuter Benefits, Paid Time Off, Paid Holidays, Bereavement Leave, and Paid Parental Leave.

Logitech also offers Wellness Programs, Health Savings Account Plans, access to Expert Medical Opinions, Identity Theft Protection, Breast Milk Delivery to Nursing Mothers on Business Travel, access to a Group Legal Plan, Donations Matching Programs, Employee Product Discounts, and access to Auto, Home, and Pet Insurance.

#LI-SN1

Across Logitech we empower collaboration and foster play. We help teams collaborate/learn from anywhere, without compromising on productivity or continuity so it should be no surprise that most of our jobs are open to work from home from most locations. Our hybrid work model allows some employees to work remotely while others work on-premises. Within this structure, you may have teams or departments split between working remotely and working in-house.

Logitech is an amazing place to work because it is full of authentic people who are inclusive by nature as well as by design. Being a global company, we value our diversity and celebrate all our differences. Don’t meet every single requirement? Not a problem. If you feel you are the right candidate for the opportunity, we strongly recommend that you apply. We want to meet you!

We offer comprehensive and competitive benefits packages and working environments that are designed to be flexible and help you to care for yourself and your loved ones, now and in the future. We believe that good health means more than getting medical care when you need it. Logitech supports a culture that encourages individuals to achieve good physical, financial, emotional, intellectual and social wellbeing so we all can create, achieve and enjoy more and support our families. We can’t wait to tell you more about them being that there are too many to list here and they vary based on location.

All qualified applicants

* Gathering and analyzing information about the market, including competitors, customers, trends and products

description:
Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life. Our portfolio of life-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines. Our 122,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries.

**About Abbott**

Abbott is a global healthcare leader, creating breakthrough science to improve people’s health. We’re always looking towards the future, anticipating changes in medical science and technology.

Our diagnostic solutions are used in hospitals, laboratories, and clinics around the globe. The crucial information derived from our tests, instruments and informatics systems are often the first step in patient care decision making for hundreds of health conditions from heart attacks to blood disorders to infectious diseases and cancers.

**Working at Abbott**

At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and family, be your true self and live a full life. You’ll also have access to:

* Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of.
+ Employees can qualify for free medical coverage in our Health Investment Plan (HIP) PPO medical plan in the next calendar year.
* An excellent retirement savings plan with high employer contribution
* Tuition reimbursement, the Freedom 2 Save student debt program and FreeU education benefit - an affordable and convenient path to getting a bachelor’s degree.
* A company recognized as a great place to work in dozens of countries around the world and named one of the most admired companies in the world by Fortune.
* A company that is recognized as one of the best big companies to work for as well as a best place to work for diversity, working mothers, female executives, and scientists.

**The Opportunity**

* This is not a remote opportunity
* Qualified candidates **must** currently live in the **Dallas TX area.**
* Traveling up to 15 %

Join Abbott's **Core Lab** business as a **Sr. Procurement Manager**, where you'll lead procurement strategy and supplier management across three manufacturing sites. In this high-impact role, you'll drive sourcing initiatives, optimize supplier performance, and ensure a reliable, cost-effective supply of materials, goods, and services that support manufacturing and business objectives.

You will partner with cross-functional stakeholders to identify cost savings opportunities, mitigate supply risks, improve operational efficiency, and support business growth. You will play a key role in shaping procurement strategy, strengthening supplier partnerships, and delivering value through innovation, quality, and continuous improvement.

This is an excellent opportunity for a strategic procurement leader who enjoys influencing business decisions, driving results, and making a direct impact on operational and financial performance.

**What You’ll Work On**

* Execute procurement and sourcing strategies aligned with enterprise and business unit objectives to ensure the reliable, compliant, and cost-effective supply of materials and services needed to support operational, manufacturing, and commercial requirements.
* Lead and develop a team of procurement professionals responsible for procurement operations, including supplier relationship management, purchase order management, supplier performance monitoring, issue resolution, and compliance with procurement policies, procedures, and purchasing controls.
* Identify, assess, and mitigate supplier, supply chain, and market risks to ensure continuity of supply, support inventory objectives, and achieve zero manufacturing disruptions.
* Drive financial performance through cost reduction initiatives, productivity improvements, inventory optimization, working capital management, and reduction of excess, obsolete, and distressed inventory while maintaining required service levels.
* Establish and maintain effective supplier relationships and performance management processes to improve quality, delivery, service, responsiveness, and overall supplier reliability.
* Partner with Operations, Planning, Quality, Engineering, Finance, and other cross-functional stakeholders to support business initiatives, product launches, process improvements, and continuous improvement activities.
* Manage performance of staff towards department and Company goals, including feedback on performance, appraisals, recommendations for merit increases or necessary disciplinary actions, communication to employees on performance, etc..
* Understands and is aware of the quality consequences which may occur from the improper performance of their specific job; has awareness of device defects that may occur in their area of responsibility, including product design, verification and validation, manufacturing, and testing activities.
* Carries out duties in compliance with established business policies.
* Demons

**Why Join Altec?**

**COMMODITY MANAGER – COMPOSITES**

**Supply Chain | St. Joseph, Missouri**

**ABOUT ALTEC**

Altec is a leading provider of products and services for the electric utility, telecommunications, tree care, lights and signs, and contractor markets. For nearly a century, Altec has been committed to helping customers safely and reliably build and maintain critical infrastructure.

At Altec, our values guide everything we do:

**Customer First • Enjoyment of Work • Family • Financial Stability • Integrity • People Are Our Greatest Strength • Quality • Spiritual Development • Teamwork**

We offer a collaborative environment where associates are empowered to innovate, solve complex challenges, and make meaningful contributions to our customers and communities.

**ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY**

Altec is seeking a Commodity Manager to lead sourcing and supplier-management activities for composite materials, fiberglass products, resin systems, structural composites, and other related commodities.

This role is responsible for developing and executing sourcing strategies, managing supplier relationships, negotiating agreements, identifying cost reduction opportunities, and ensuring continuity of supply for composite commodities supporting manufacturing operations.

While composites are the primary focus of this position, the Commodity Manager may also support other commodity categories. Category assignments and areas of responsibility may be adjusted over time based on business needs, organizational structure, workload, and staffing.

The successful candidate will partner closely with Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations, Materials, and Quality teams across the organization to support both current production and future business growth.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

**As the Commodity Manager for Composites, you will:**

* Develop sourcing strategies for composite materials.
* Create, negotiate, implement, and manage short- and long-term commodity supply agreements.
* Develop, identify, and implement cost reduction strategies that deliver measurable results.
* Research and evaluate suppliers, market conditions, pricing trends, availability, and supply chain risks.
* Develop and maintain a robust supplier network that supports quality, delivery, and cost objectives.
* Lead supplier qualification, development, and performance improvement initiatives.
* Partner closely with Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations, Quality, and Supply Chain teams to support current production and future business needs.
* Monitor industry trends and maintain awareness of developments affecting composite-material supply, resin and fiber pricing, capacity, and availability.
* Drive year-over-year material cost improvements within assigned commodity areas.
* Serve as the primary escalation point for supplier-related quality, delivery, and service concerns.
* Support new product development activities through supplier engagement and sourcing expertise.
Coach and support purchasing and materials team members on commodity trends, supplier capabilities, and cost management opportunities.

**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree.
* Six years of applicable experience in procurement, supply chain, manufacturing, engineering, materials management, operations, or a related field.
* Strong supplier-management and negotiation experience.
* Excellent analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to develop sourcing strategies and evaluate supplier performance.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office.

*Should the selected candidate meet the qualifications of a more experienced level within the career path, the job level may be adjusted.*

**Preferred Experience**

**We are particularly interested in candidates who bring technical expertise and operational knowledge to the role, including:**

* Experience sourcing composite materials, fiberglass products, resin systems, structural composites, or other advanced materials.
* Knowledge of composite manufacturing processes, material specifications, and quality requirements.
* Experience supporting product development and collaborating with Engineering.
* Experience in materials management, engineering, production management, or an engineered-products manufacturing environment.
* Experience evaluating supplier capabilities, quality systems, and production processes.
* MBA, APICS certification, or equivalent professional certification.

**What Success Looks Like**

**Successful candidates will demonstrate:**

* A strong record of developing and implementing sourcing strategies.
* Proven success achieving cost reduction and continuous improvement objectives.
* The ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders and drive strategic decisions.
* Strong analytical skills combined with sound business judgment.
* A proactive approach to supplier development, risk mitigation, and total cost management.
* A commitment to quality, safety, operational

**Working Title:** Strategic Buyer

**Business Function:** Supply Chain

**Reports To:** Senior Manager, Supply Chain

**Job Summary**

The Strategic Buyer owns the commercial relationship and long-term performance of assigned suppliers supporting Hologic's production and indirect requirements, including suppliers that manufacture components unique to Hologic. The role supports sourcing, negotiations, cost reduction, supply risk mitigation, and item master data, and owns supplier on-time delivery (OTD).

This position owns strategic procurement activities and supports tactical execution, bridging the Commodity Manager, who sets category strategy, and the Tactical Buyer, who executes purchase orders. The Strategic Buyer uses independent judgment to resolve material issues.

**Essential Duties**

The candidate may be asked to perform other function-related activities in addition to the responsibilities below, as reasonably required by business needs.

* Lead site sourcing in support of the global sourcing and commodity teams, including spend analysis, business award scenarios, cost models, and RFQs.
* Partner with cross-functional teams across the supplier lifecycle, from evaluation, selection, and onboarding through risk mitigation and offboarding, including dual-sourcing strategies with the global sourcing team.
* Support global sourcing on supply agreement negotiations and monitor contract compliance.
* Drive cost reduction through the VIP pipeline and value engineering. Support the annual standard cost update and own purchase price variance review and material quotes.
* Own supplier OTD and long-term performance through scorecards, supplier reviews, and QBRs, and drive actions that reduce delivery risk and business impact.
* Resolve supplier delivery and quality issues with cross-functional partners, including root cause and corrective action.
* Partner with data governance and cross-functional teams to maintain accurate item master data and strategic ERP parameters, including pricing, lead times, MOQ, safety stock, and sourcing rules. Support new supplier and part number setup, as well as engineering and supplier changes.
* Review demand, MRP signals, inventory, and open POs with Planning and Manufacturing. Share forecasts with suppliers and escalate supply risks.
* Guide Tactical Buyers on PO requirements, transactional exceptions, escalated issues, and end-of-life materials. Process POs as needed.
* Improve inventory turns through programs such as supplier Kanban, and lead continuous improvement and site cross-functional projects.
* Represent Supply Chain on New Product teams and define supply chain strategy for new products.

**Physical Demands**

The physical requirements described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.

* Sit; use hands to finger, handle, or feel objects, tools, or controls.
* Stand, walk, and reach with hands and arms.

**Qualifications**

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, or a related field preferred, and/or equivalent experience.

**Experience**

* 5+ years of procurement experience; medical device or pharmaceutical industry experience preferred but not required.
* Experience with an ERP system, MRP logic, and item master data; Oracle experience is a plus.

**Skills**

* CPIM, CPSM, CPM, or PMP certification preferred; APICS involvement is a plus.
* Negotiation, cost modeling, and total cost analysis.
* Supplier relationship management, performance management, and risk management, including dual-sourcing strategy with the global sourcing team.
* Working knowledge of a PLM system such as Agile, change control, and quality processes.
* Strong communication, interpersonal, and organizational skills, with the ability to build collaborative relationships internally and externally.
* Accurate, dependable, and audit-ready, with experience supporting internal and external audits. Ability to work to tight requirements with minimal supervision and sound escalation judgment.
* Strong Microsoft Office skills, including advanced Excel and data analysis.

**Compensation**

The annualized base salary range for this role is $77,800 to $121,700, and the position is eligible for an annual bonus. Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, skills, education, location, business needs, and market conditions.

**Agency and Third-Party Recruiter Notice**

Agencies that submit resumes to Hologic must have a current, fully executed Hologic Agency Agreement approved by the Human Resources Department. Agencies may only submit candidates for positions when specifically authorized to do so by a Hologic Recruiter. Resumes submitted outside of these terms will not be considered.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

Hologic is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer inclusive of disability and veterans.

description:
We are a team of strategic advisors, architects, and implementers who drive business transformations. Our diverse talent energizes clients' business functions and technology to maximize value in Supply Chain enhancing their ability to fulfill their growth and efficiency ambitions. Imagine working with world-class supply network capabilities like Smart Factory, Strategy & Innovation, Supply Chain Responsiveness, Sourcing & Procurement, or Product Development & Operations!

Are you ready to take your career to new heights? Join our US Supply Chain & Network Operations Offering, where you'll deliver transformational solutions using operational expertise, digital technologies, advanced analytics, and industry-specific hybrid solutions. Don't miss the chance to be part of a team that provides exceptional client value while advancing your professional journey. Apply now and become a vital part of our innovative and dynamic workforce!

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/31/2026

**The team**

Our team helps clients transform their value chains into competitive advantages. We drive efficiency, improve flexibility, and increase responsiveness through proactive insights and decision-making. We advise, implement, and operate transformational solutions that bring world-class supply network and operational capabilities to our clients. We provide operational know-how, digital technologies, advanced analytics, and industry-specific hybrid solutions to deliver unprecedented client value. Additionally, we improve operations, product, and material flow across the breadth of the value chain and create greater supply network synergy and value.

**Roles and Responsibilities**

This role utilizes your deep understanding of end-to-end network transformation, with a specific emphasis on strategic sourcing and procurement impacts to broader supply chain design. While below is a sample of the role, each unique project will provide you the opportunity to develop and grow your supply chain transformation capabilities.

* Conduct discussions with senior leaders on functional solutions within sourcing and procurement and network visibility/resiliency
* Lead discussions with business to understand needs and requirements, translating requirements into technical platform functionality, and collaborate with technical architects ensuring technically feasible and scalable technology application solutions
* Perform high-level functional and technical architecture, analysis, research, and design for sourcing and procurement, `network visibility and resiliency/decision intelligence solutions
* Lead project delivery across process design, data analytics, solution configuration, deployment, testing, knowledge management, and performance metric development
* Advise clients on supply chain and operations strategy and translating findings into network design / sourcing strategies, total cost of ownership models, and recommendations for client executives

description:
Cabot Corporation (NYSE: CBT) is a leading global specialty chemicals and performance materials company headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts, USA.

Our businesses deliver a broad range of products and solutions to customers in every corner of the globe, serving the transportation, infrastructure, environment and consumer industry sectors. We bring the power of innovative chemistry to solve customers' challenges today while preparing them to meet tomorrow’s needs. Our commitment to innovation is driven by a passion to advance our customers' businesses through our deep understanding of their applications and the global trends that impact their operations.

If you do not meet every requirement, or your experience is slightly different that what we have listed, we still encourage you to apply!

**Your Role at Cabot:**

Cabot Corporation is seeking a Category Sr Buyer to join the North America Procurement team at the Alpharetta, GA location. This role is responsible for regional support for the chemicals category among the US and Canada manufacturing sites.

In this role you would handle the execution of end-to-end procurement activities within onsite services, ensuring policy compliance and cost–effective, value-driven solutions. This role involves managing strategic sourcing events, negotiating contracts, and leveraging Coupa for purchase requisitions, approvals, procurement data, and supplier management. The Category Sr Buyer acts as a key liaison between internal stakeholders and suppliers to ensure operational efficiency, supply continuity, and continuous performance improvement. The primary focus of the role is Site leadership, tactical sourcing, category support and execution

This role requires a highly intelligent, self-motivated person with a positive attitude, positive energy, strong organization skills, and urgency to make things happen.

**This role is based at the Alpharetta, GA location, but is eligible to participate in the current Hybrid Working Arrangement program (Monday/Friday remote and Tuesday-Thursday in office).**

**How You’ll Make an Impact:**

**Operational Procurement**

* Manage end-to-end purchasing process using Coupa, including requisition review, PO creation, purchasing form and template management, contracting, and approvals.
* Ensure compliance with procurement policies, governance frameworks, and GBS standards.
* Monitor and resolve issues related to invoices, deliveries, and supplier performance.
Contribute to procurement cost improvement and savings target delivery.

**Sourcing & Negotiation**

* Conduct RFQs/RFPs for mid-value purchases and negotiate pricing and terms.
* Support category managers in implementing sourcing strategies and supplier consolidation.
* Help develop category roadmaps aligned with business objectives and long-term sourcing strategies.
Create and maintain pricing catalogs, order forms, and RFx templates.

**Supplier Management**

* Maintain accurate supplier data in Coupa and ensure onboarding compliance.
Monitor supplier performance and escalate issues as needed.

**Stakeholder Collaboration**

* Partner with internal teams to understand requirements and provide guidance on procurement best practices.
Act as a point of contact for queries related to Coupa processes and procurement policies.

**Process Improvement**

* Identify opportunities to streamline workflows and improve efficiency within Coupa.
Support GBS initiatives for automation and digital procurement transformation.

**People Leadership & Development**

* May mentor Buyers and support onboarding of new team members
Promote a culture of continuous improvement and collaboration

**What You’ll Bring to Cabot:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Business, or related field.
* 3+ years’ experience in procurement or buying roles.
* Experience in manufacturing, specialty chemicals, carbon materials, or industrial products highly preferred.
* Chemical Market highly preferred.
* Experience managing multimillion-dollar spend categories across multiple facilities.
* Experience negotiating chemical supply agreements and commercial terms.

* Hands-on experience with Coupa or similar e-procurement platforms.
* In-depth knowledge of tactical sourcing and category execution.
* Proficiency in site-level procurement leadership and alignment with category strategy.
* Understanding of category traits (market conditions, suppliers, news & trends, & performance metrics and escalation protocols).
* Strong negotiation and communication skills.
* Knowledge of procurement governance and compliance requirements.
* Detail-oriented and process-driven.
* Strong stakeholder engagement and problem-solving skills.
* Familiarity with digital procurement tools and analytics (and escalation protocols).
* Knowledge of global procurement policies and audit requirements.
* Skills in mentoring and supporting team development.

description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. At AWS Cloud Logistics, we support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for warehousing safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

This position is located in Austin, TX.

AWS Infrastructure is looking for a talented, driven, and highly analytical, Contract Logistics Procurement Mgr with a hunger for driving change and impact at a global scale to join AWS Infrastructure Supply Chain (AIS) team. The successful candidate will have strong analytical and communication skills, and a passion for using data to drive business decisions. You are analytical and creative, and you don’t quit until you solve the problem. You thrive by providing data-driven decision support and business intelligence that is timely, accurate, and actionable.

Key job responsibilities

* Lead sourcing, procurement, and contract operations for global contract logistics and warehousing services.
* Establish annual financial plans and create operating rhythms to measure execution vs established targets.
* Build and manage operating rhythms to simplify and automate business processes to ensure compliance with agreed terms and reduce procurement lead times.
* Draft contractual requirements in cooperation with business partners which encourage continued customer focus deliver reduced service costs.
* Manage supplier relationships including contractual negotiations, service performance, capability development.
* Dive deep to uncover areas of opportunity, present written business recommendations, and lead global projects which deliver reduced service costs.

A day in the life

* Recommend, develop, and implement policies that guide the organization in accurately estimating service cost and delivering annual profit and loss (P&L).
* Develop new business relationships and competencies.
* Partner with supply and operations teams to develop capacity models, guide network strategy, and inform capital investment decisions.
* Own Controllership activities including invoice auditing to identify discrepancies.
* Partner with business partners to draft, maintain, and standardize contractual requirements.
* Design exception-based reporting highlighting and analyzing outliers.
* Lead weekly discussions reporting on financial performance to plan and areas of improvement.
* Manage and support finance and accounting activities globally with multiple currencies.

About the team
\\*Why AWS\\*
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

\\*Diverse Experiences\\*
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

\\*Work/Life Balance\\*
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

\\*Inclusive Team Culture\\*
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

\\*Mentorship and Career Growth\\*
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

description:
**SENIOR BUYER – CONTRACT MANUFACTURING**

Location: Willowbrook, IL – Hybrid

$80,000 - $100,000

Midtronics has an exciting and challenging opportunity for a Senior Buyer to lead procurement strategy for our Contract Manufacturing (CM) supplier base. This is a highly visible role, reporting to the Supply Chain Manager, with regular interaction across Suppliers, Project Managers, Quality, and Leadership. The Senior Buyer owns the end-to-end health of our assemblies — ensuring parts availability, managing component lifecycle risk, and driving supplier performance — while partnering closely with Production, Quality, and Engineering to keep production running without disruption.

Key metrics managed by the Senior Buyer include Vendor Scorecards (Quality, On-Time Delivery, Pricing, Responsiveness), assembly parts availability, and component lifecycle/obsolescence risk. Additional participation in strategic cost savings and supplier risk mitigation activities would also be expected.

**A DAY IN THE LIFE:**

Typical responsibilities include but are not limited to:

* Own the relationship and performance of Contract Manufacturing (CM) suppliers, including pricing, capacity, lead times, and delivery commitments
* Monitor and maintain the health of assemblies by tracking parts availability and resolving shortages before they impact production
* Perform component lifecycle analysis, proactively flag end-of-life (EOL)/obsolescence risk, and lead efforts to qualify alternates or last-time-buys
* Validate multi-level bills of materials (BOMs) for accuracy and work with Engineering on ECOs to assess supply impact of design changes
* Partner with Production on build schedules and material readiness
* Partner with Quality on supplier NCRs, corrective actions, and audits
* Partner with Engineering on component selection, alternates, and new product introduction (NPI) supply readiness
* Report on supply health, risks, and key decisions to Project Managers and Leadership
* Prepare requests for quote (RFQ’s) and purchase orders (PO’s); negotiate cost, terms, and delivery with CM/PCBA and component suppliers
* Track supplier on-time delivery, quality, and responsiveness; drive continuous improvement and cost-down initiatives
* Identify long-lead-time items and single-source risk; build mitigation plans (safety stock, dual-sourcing, buffer strategies)

**WHAT YOU’LL NEED:**

* Bachelor of Science (Engineering, Business, Supply Chain) or equivalent work experience in supply chain / operations required
* 5+ years of buying/procurement experience in electronics manufacturing, with direct experience managing Contract Manufacturing and/or PCB Assembly suppliers
* Strong understanding of electronic component lifecycle management and obsolescence/EOL mitigation
* Experience reading and managing multi-level bills of materials (BOMs)
* Proven track record partnering cross-functionally with Production, Quality, Engineering, Project Managers, and Leadership
* Skilled in RFQ processes, supplier negotiation, and contract terms
* Working knowledge of MRP/ERP software (e.g., Epicor, SAP, Oracle) and supplier scorecards
* Ability to travel domestically and internationally to vendor/supplier sites as needed
* Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with comfort presenting supply status and risk to Leadership
* APICS / CPSM / CPM certification a plus

**WHAT WE OFFER:**

Comprehensive Medical, Dental, & Vision Benefits; Life & Disability Insurance at no Additional Cost; 401(K) Savings Plan with Company Match; Annual Bonus & Profit-Sharing Opportunities; Generous Vacation & Holiday Schedules; Reimbursement for Continuing Education & 50% of Textbook costs; Onsite Wellness Screening & Flu Shots; Subsidized Health Club Memberships; Auto Supplier Discounts; Free Charging Stations for Plug-In Hybrids & EVs in Parking Lot; Monthly Employee Meeting/Lunch; Annual Picnic, Holiday and other events.

**ABOUT US:**

Midtronics manufacturers advanced cutting-edge battery testing and charging equipment incorporating wireless communication and data analytics for traditional 12V, 24V, and high-voltage EV batteries for emerging Electric Vehicle platforms. Midtronics is a fast-growing company with an energetic, passionate, and innovative leadership team. As the world is determined to reduce carbon emissions and improve vehicle safety, the rapid evolution of the transportation industry – from electrification and connectivity to autonomous vehicles — Midtronics, is a committed partner in developing superior battery management solutions to meet those exciting challenges in the years ahead.

**PROCUREMENT MANAGER**

***You Make Sure We're Buying Smart, Not Just Buying***

**Full-Time** **|** **Monday–Friday**

**ABOUT ASAHI BEER USA / OCTOPI BREWING**

Founded in 2014 as a Wisconsin contract brewery, Octopi Brewing has spent over a decade brewing and packaging beer, seltzers, RTDs, and sodas for clients nationwide. In 2024, Asahi — brewers of Asahi Super Dry — acquired Octopi, making us the U.S. production home of Super Dry. Today, our 250+ person team of beverage industry pros keeps that same local, quality-first spirit alive at a state-of-the-art facility, backed by the global scale and category expertise of Asahi's procurement network.

**THE OPPORTUNITY**

We're looking for a Procurement Manager to own sourcing and supplier strategy for assigned categories here in the U.S., while collaborating closely with Asahi's global category teams. You'll negotiate contracts, manage supplier relationships, and drive total cost of ownership — balancing local business needs with global best practices.

**WHAT MAKES THIS ROLE GREAT**

? Real ownership of category strategy, with direct influence on cost, risk, and supplier relationships

? A global network behind you — connect with Asahi's category teams and procurement best practices worldwide

? Visible impact — your negotiations and supplier decisions show up directly in the bottom line

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

? Act as the local category expert, implementing category strategy and representing local business needs to Asahi's global category teams

? Manage CapEx and OpEx categories, negotiating contracts and supporting the broader team in negotiations and implementation

? Define and maintain sourcing strategies for locally managed categories, aligned to business needs and priorities

? Analyze market trends, competitors, and supplier data to inform sourcing decisions

? Build and manage supplier relationships, including evaluation, accreditation, and performance/quality controls

? Partner with Legal, Tax, and other functions to ensure supplier contracts are properly in place

? Manage category and supplier risk — price volatility, supplier stability, and volume assurance

? Track performance against procurement KPIs and lead continuous improvement projects to drive further cost and value gains

**WHAT YOU BRING**

**Must-haves:**

? University degree, preferably in a business-related field

? 5+ years of professional experience, including 2+ years in procurement

? Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office

? Experience with procurement platforms and ERP systems

? Strong negotiation, analytical, and stakeholder management skills

**Nice-to-haves:**

? Experience managing CapEx/OpEx categories in a manufacturing or CPG environment

? Prior people-management experience

**BENEFITS & PERKS**

? Medical, dental, and vision coverage — effective the 1st of the month after 30 days

? Company-paid life, short-term, and long-term disability insurance

? 401(k) eligible after 3 months, with company match — 100% up to 3%, 50% on the next 2%

? 120 hours of PTO annually, with accrual that grows the longer you're here

? 9 paid holidays (if they fall on your scheduled workday)

? A free beer after shift, because you earned it

**PAY & SCHEDULE**

? Salary: $102,000–$115,000/year

? Schedule: Monday–Friday

*Full-time, exempt*

**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**TITLE:** Procurement Manager
**REPORTS TO:** General Manager

**POSITION SUMMARY**

Procurement Manager is a skilled manufacturing professional who oversees an organization's acquisition of goods and services, aligning purchasing strategies with financial goals to secure the best value, quality, and supply continuity. Is responsible for overseeing Supplier relations and transportation details for a company. Their duties include evaluating their employers’ brand and target audience to determine what products to order, monitoring delivery times from warehouses or manufacturing plants to retail locations and hiring and training purchasing staff members to carry out purchasing tasks.

**RESPONSIBILITIES / AUTHORITIES**

* Research market conditions, identify business needs across departments, and develop plans to source raw materials, equipment, or services.
* Evaluate vendors using criteria like production capacity, financial stability, quality certifications, and pricing
* Secure favorable pricing, volume discounts, payment terms, and protective legal clauses to reduce total cost of ownership
* Maintain ongoing communication, track performance metrics (KPIs), and resolve delivery or quality disputes
* Mitigate supply chain disruptions by diversifying vendor bases, auditing supplier health, and creating backup plans.
* Review purchasing data to track spending patterns, eliminate maverick (unsanctioned) spend, and forecast future financial needs.
* Partner with finance, legal, operations, and production teams to ensure purchasing compliance and operational alignment

* Manage procurement staff, assign workflows, set departmental targets, and ensure adherence to company and regulatory policies.
* Developing sound, cost-effective strategies for the purchasing of materials used in the business

* Maintaining relationships with suppliers while continually scouting for additional vendors
* Evaluating spending operations while seeking ways to improve and enhance the quality of products purchased and the timeliness of deliveries
* Communicating with management regularly regarding the efficient flow of goods and services affecting production

Overview:

GCG Custom Engineered Solutions is currently seeking a Buyer to join the Custom Engineered Solutions procurement team!

As a Buyer with our procurement team, you will be responsible for planning and purchasing the raw materials needed to support our cable assembly operations. You’ll play a key role in ensuring materials are available to meet production demand while maintaining appropriate inventory levels, cost control, and supplier performance.

This role requires close coordination with internal teams and suppliers to manage demand signals, execute purchase orders, and maintain a steady flow of materials through the operation. Your work will directly support on-time delivery and overall operational efficiency.

Schedule: Monday-Friday, 7:00am to 4:00pm EST

### **What You’ll Do**

**Procurement Execution & Order Management**

* Manage purchase orders from requisition through receipt, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and alignment with production requirements
* Procure raw materials, MRO, and services at optimal cost, quality, and lead time
* Monitor open orders and proactively manage delivery schedules to prevent shortages or disruptions

**Material Planning & Inventory Management**

* Review MRP outputs in Oracle to plan and maintain appropriate inventory levels for assigned commodities
* Establish and adjust safety stock levels in alignment with production needs and business objectives
* Balance inventory investment with service level expectations to support efficient operations

**Supplier Management & Sourcing**

* Source and evaluate suppliers, obtain quotations, and negotiate pricing and lead times
* Build and maintain strong supplier relationships to support reliability and continuous improvement
* Participate in supplier performance reviews and support corrective actions as needed

**Operational & Cross-Functional Support**

* Partner with production, engineering, and supply chain teams to align material availability with manufacturing schedules
* Resolve material issues including shortages, quality concerns, and supplier discrepancies
* Support cost reduction initiatives and process improvements across the procurement function
* Maintain accurate data and transaction integrity within ERP and procurement systems

### **What You’ll Bring**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, or related field preferred
* 3–5 years of experience in a purchasing, buyer, or materials planning role within a manufacturing environment
* Experience working with MRP/ERP systems (Oracle strongly preferred)
* Strong understanding of material planning, inventory control, and procurement processes
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, production-driven environment
* Effective communication and negotiation skills with both internal teams and external suppliers
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and standard business applications
* Detail-oriented with a focus on accuracy, follow-through, and problem-solving

### **What We Offer**

* Competitive base salary ranging from $60,000 to $65,000, dependent on relevant experience
* Comprehensive health coverage with multiple plan options (CDHP and PPO)
* Company-paid life and disability insurance, 401(k) with company match, supplemental insurance options
* Generous time off including PTO, paid holidays, parental leave, and compassionate care leave
* Wellness and support programs (EAP, wellness incentives, telehealth)
* Extras including dental/vision, FSAs/HSAs with company contributions, pet insurance, legal services, and ID theft protection
* An employee-centric culture that values and truly appreciates our most important asset: You!

### **Our Use of AI in Recruiting**

At GCG, we use AI technology to assist with our interviews by automating note-taking, allowing our hiring teams to focus fully on the conversation. This technology supports efficiency and accuracy in capturing candidate insights during interviews but is not used to evaluate resumes. All resume reviews and candidate assessments are conducted directly by our corporate recruiting team and hiring managers to ensure a thoughtful, human-centered approach.

### **About Custom Engineered Solutions (CES)**

GCG Custom Engineered Solutions delivers innovative wire and cable solutions, serving industries including renewable energy, data communications, industrial applications, irrigation, and more. We are committed to engineering excellence, customer-driven innovation, and high-quality products that help businesses solve complex challenges with tailored solutions. Built on a foundation of expertise, flexibility, and humility, we are dedicated to solving customer challenges, adapting to their needs, and continuously improving.

**SSW Advanced Technologies, LLC** is a growing multinational supplier to the global appliance OEMs. With more than 70 years of expertise and innovation, we design and sell components and systems to the residential appliance industry (refrigeration, cooking, laundry), commercial refrigeration, HVAC, retail display and home/office organizational markets. **More information is available on our website** **https://www.sswtechnologies.com/**

**Job Summary:**

The **Onsite Lead Buyer** will analyze past buying trends, price, and quality of merchandise to determine value and yield. Select, order, and authorize payment for merchandise according to contractual agreements. May conduct meetings with sales personnel and introduce new products. May negotiate contracts.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* This role is key in identifying, developing, and maintaining quality suppliers of materials, components, and services at the best price, quality, availability, on-time delivery, and service.
* Communicate & ensure adherence to Gemtron Purchasing practices, guidelines and initiatives both internally to Operations and other internal customers and externally to Suppliers
* Assist in creating standard procedures, processes, and systems for standardization within the plant purchasing department
* Support Purchasing Manager or Director on Plant level and Regional Sourcing Strategies.
* Identify and implement plant-level cost savings and risk-mitigation initiatives
* Mentor and lead other member of the local Purchasing team in a professional, constructive and efficient manner
* Identify, Develop and maintain relationships with key suppliers through proper communication and visits
* Champion Plant-level cost savings initiatives / cost-outs
* Contributor for site-level annual planning and savings Purchasing reporting
* Conduct RFQ and negotiations for Capital Expenditure projects, New Project launches as well as support for Innovations Department
* Plant champion for Purchasing for cross-functional projects (Sales, IT, Supply-Chain, etc.)
* Participate in Cross-Functional teams for Process improvements / LEAN activities
* Work with Purchasing Manager or Director in refining & implementing systems for Supplier identification, qualification as well as a smooth transition of program launch to the Supply Chain Planners

**Position Supervised or Directed:**

Supply Stores Buyer.

**Qualifications, Experience requirements:**

* Bachelor’s Degree (Engineering or Business Management or equivalent)
* Minimum of 3-5 years practical knowledge and experience in Purchasing in a Manufacturing environment
* APICS or ISM Certification helpful
* Previous experience in MRP / ERP systems (SAP preferred)
* Knowledge of Microsoft Office Products PowerPoint, Word, Excel, and Access
* Ability to multi-task and prioritize while working in a deadline driven environment
* Ability to persuade and lead with facts and data with ability to adapt to, and promote change

**General Requirements:**

* Detailed and hands-on oriented.
* Ability to travel, up to 10%

**Working Conditions:**

* Office and manufacturing plant environment
* Frequently indoors

**Equipment Use:**

* Computer
* Telephone
* Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) when necessary

**Commitment to Core Values:**

* Honesty
* Integrity
* Caring for People
* Customer Focus
* Teamwork
* Communication
* Improvement

------------------------

**\\*Updated - Change in work location options. The successful candidate may work in either Columbia, Charleston, Florence, Greenville, Rock Hill or Spartanburg.\\***

This position is on the Agency Sourcing Team for Higher Ed/Law Enforcement within the Division of Procurement Services (DPS).

**Duties:**

Develop solicitations prior to posting to ensure compliance with standard operating procedures and the guidelines of the Consolidated Procurement Code, regulations. Develops and reviews solicitation documents including scope, instructions to offer technical, and functional specifications/statement of work, qualifications, award criteria, terms and conditions, bidding schedules and all necessary attachments. Works with the end user and other procurement managers, applying knowledge of procurement practices, and conducting market analysis. Performs delegation reviews of agency solicitation as assigned.

Evaluates responses to procurements to ensure that offers are responsive and responsible. Awards contracts appropriately based on source selection method, ensuring that awards are in compliance with SC Procurement Code and MMO policy. When using a panel to evaluate offers, instructs and guides the panel through the procurement process by managing discussion and providing appropriate tools and information to facilitate the process. Consolidates individual panel member evaluations and provides proper documentation for award determination. Negotiates terms and drafts final contract documents. Assists other procurement managers with complex procurements as directed by management.

Provide on-going contract administration by working with customers and/or end users, and other procurement staff to ensure that contractor fully performs their contractual obligations. Resolves issues by working with all parties (contractors and end-users) to clarify requirements and resolve misunderstandings. Determine need to escalate issues and keeps management informed on sensitive issues or issues that may result in termination.

Serve as a consultant to using governmental entities and procurement staff by assisting and providing guidance with purchasing methods, sources of supply, policies and procedures, negotiation, and compliance with SC Consolidated Procurement Code. Works with contractors and other vendors to maintain current information on products and services, business standard and practices, and market conditions.

**Minimum and Additional Requirements**
---------------------------------------

A bachelor's degree and experience in procurement, contract management, or an approved acceptable equivalence (to include experience in Project Management or Paralegal skills) in accordance with State Human Resources regulations. A valid driver's license for statewide and other travel as required.

Must serve as a lead ESF7 representative whenever Emergency Operations Center is activated. Overnight travel may be required on occasion. This position is considered essential (critical) for the continuation of key agency and/or state government operations and services during an emergency. As determined by management, this position may be required to report to work when the office is closed.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

CPPB or CPPO preferred. Two (2) years of experience in government procurement or other purchasing experience. Experience with the South Carolina Enterprise Information System (SCEIS) and Microsoft Office Suite program.

**Additional Comments**
-----------------------

The State Fiscal Accountability Authority offers an exceptional benefits package for FTE positions that includes Health, Dental, Vision, Long Term Disability, and Life Insurance for Employee, Spouse and Children.

15 days annual (vacation) leave per year

15 days sick leave per year

13 paid holidays

**State Retirement Plan and Deferred Compensation Programs**

The Electrical Procurement Manager (U.S.) owns the full electrical procurement scope for Ormat's U.S. battery energy storage (BESS) and utility-scale solar projects. The role covers commercial strategy, sourcing, contracting, supplier delivery and escalation for BESS containers and enclosures, PV modules, inverters (PCS), trackers, transformers, switchgear, MV/HV electrical balance of plant, e-houses and control cabinets.

Based in Philadelphia, the position is the single commercial owner of the U.S. electrical category. It works alongside the Israel-based electrical category team and reports to the Head of Global Procurement, partnering closely with Engineering, Project Management, Construction, Legal, Trade Compliance, Logistics and Finance.

Beyond execution, the role is expected to move U.S. electrical buying from project-by-project purchasing to portfolio-based strategic sourcing — establishing master agreements, securing supplier capacity ahead of the project pipeline, and protecting projects against tariff, domestic content and lead-time exposure.

**Essential Functions**

**Category ownership – BESS and Solar**

* Own the U.S. electrical category strategy for BESS and solar: negotiation strategy, pricing and lead-time approvals, and final commercial escalation with suppliers.

* Lead sourcing of major equipment: BESS containers/enclosures and integrated systems, PV modules, inverters and PCS, trackers, MV/HV transformers, switchgear, cabling, e-houses and control cabinets.

* Build and maintain a qualified supplier base across the U.S., Asia and Europe, including new supplier identification, qualification and onboarding.

* Consolidate demand across the U.S. project pipeline and secure supplier capacity and pricing in advance of project award.

**Contracts and commercial**

* Lead negotiation and execution of MSAs, framework agreements, supply agreements and equipment POs for BESS and PV packages, including correct PO split and signature flow.

* Work with Legal and Contract Management on terms and conditions, SOWs, liquidated damages, warranty and performance guarantees, indemnity, lien waivers and dispute mechanisms; flag high-risk commercial terms early.

* Benchmark supplier pricing against market and project budgets; deliver measurable cost savings and report against procurement KPIs.

**Trade compliance and domestic content**

* Direct and develop U.S. electrical buyers; balance workload, ensure back-to-back coverage and that no open item is left unowned during absences.
* Serve as the final escalation point for the electrical category before the Head of Global Procurement.
* Ensure compliance with Ormat procurement procedures, approval matrices, segregation of duties and audit requirements; SAP is the single source of truth for supplier evaluation, approval and control.

description:
**Job Summary:**

As a Senior Buyer, you will play a crucial role in the procurement process of goods and services necessary for our organization's operations. You will be responsible for sourcing suppliers, negotiating contracts, and ensuring timely delivery of quality products at competitive prices. Your meticulous attention to detail and strong communication skills will contribute to the efficiency and effectiveness of our procurement operations. In addition, the Purchasing Agent will serve as a working team member and individual contributor to the overall team’s success.

**Typical Duties and Responsibilities:**

*Supplier Sourcing and Management:*

* + Identify potential suppliers through market research, networking, and industry contacts.
+ Evaluate suppliers based on factors such as price, quality, reliability, and delivery speed.
+ Build and maintain strong relationships with suppliers to ensure favorable terms and conditions.

*Contract Negotiation:*

* + Negotiate contracts with suppliers to secure advantageous terms regarding pricing, payment terms, delivery schedules, and quality standards.
+ Review and analyze contract terms to ensure compliance with company policies and legal requirements.
+ Collaborate with legal and finance departments to finalize contract agreements.

*Purchase Order Processing:*

* + Generate purchase orders accurately and in a timely manner based on approved requisitions.
+ Coordinate with internal stakeholders to confirm specifications, quantities, and delivery requirements.
+ Monitor purchase orders to track delivery schedules and resolve any discrepancies or issues that may arise.

*Cost Optimization:*

* + Continuously seek opportunities to reduce procurement costs through negotiations, supplier consolidation, and process improvements.
+ Implement cost-saving initiatives without compromising product quality or service levels.

*Compliance and Documentation:*

* + Ensure compliance with company policies, industry regulations, and ethical standards throughout the procurement process.
+ Maintain accurate procurement records and documentation, including contracts, purchase orders, and supplier agreements.

*Supplier Performance Evaluation:*

* + Evaluate supplier performance based on criteria such as delivery reliability, product quality, and customer service.
+ Provide feedback to suppliers and work collaboratively to address any performance issues or concerns.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in business administration, supply chain management, or a related field.
* Proven experience as a purchasing agent, supply chain specialist, or similar procurement role.
* Strong negotiation skills and ability to build and maintain effective relationships with suppliers.
* Proficiency in procurement software and Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint).
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Attention to detail and accuracy in data entry and record-keeping.
* Effective communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment

**Disclaimer:** The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this classification. They are not to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required of personnel so classified. All personnel may be required to perform duties outside of their normal responsibilities from time to time, as needed.

description:
Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. Improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrive is if our people are thriving. That’s why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you?

**Transform the everyday with us!**

As a Senior Buyer within Siemens Smart Infrastructure’s Electrical Products (EP) business, you will drive material availability and purchasing execution for our Fort Worth, Texas manufacturing operation. Based on-site at our manufacturing facility, you will interpret Material Requirements Planning (MRP) signals, manage purchase orders and supplier commitments, resolve complex material risks, and provide purchasing direction that protects production continuity. You will also guide the Buyer while partnering with planning, production, receiving, suppliers, and cross-functional teams to strengthen supply performance.

**You will make an impact by:**

* Interpreting Material Requirements Planning (MRP) signals, demand changes, lead times, inventory requirements, and exception messages to make timely purchasing decisions.
* Managing purchase orders and supplier commitments for production materials while protecting manufacturing schedules and customer delivery requirements.
* Leading supplier follow-up and material-expediting activities, including pull-ins, push-outs, cancellations, backorders, and recovery plans for at-risk materials.
* Analyzing purchasing and material master data, including minimum order quantities, safety stocks, lead times, and purchasing information records, to improve planning accuracy and supply continuity.
* Escalating supplier performance issues and coordinating corrective actions that improve material availability, delivery reliability, and inventory performance.
* Providing direction to the Buyer by reviewing purchasing priorities, interpreting MRP requirements, and supporting resolution of complex material issues.
* Coordinating with production, planning, procurement, receiving, accounts payable, and suppliers to resolve shortages, Goods Receipt/Invoice Receipt (GR/IR) discrepancies, and purchase order issues.

**You’ll win us over by having the following qualifications:**

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Five+ years of direct purchasing or buying experience, depending on the depth, complexity, and relevance of the experience.
* Demonstrated manufacturing or production purchasing experience supporting the flow of materials into a manufacturing facility.
* Strong knowledge of Material Requirements Planning (MRP), including the ability to interpret MRP signals, exception messages, demand changes, lead times, and inventory requirements.
* Experience placing and managing purchase orders, following up with suppliers, expediting materials, and managing pull-ins, push-outs, cancellations, and revised delivery commitments.
* Experience resolving material shortages, supplier delivery risks, backorders, purchase order issues, or other exceptions affecting production.
* Proficiency with SAP or another enterprise resource planning, purchasing, inventory, or Material Requirements Planning (MRP) system.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, particularly Microsoft Excel, for purchasing analysis, reporting, and data management.
* Demonstrated ability to analyze information, prioritize material risks, and provide clear direction and recovery recommendations.
* Ability and willingness to work on-site at the Siemens Smart Infrastructure manufacturing facility in Fort Worth, Texas.
* Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company sponsorship.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Advanced hands-on knowledge of SAP purchasing, MRP, supplier scheduling, inventory management, or material master data functionality.
* Experience providing direction, coaching, or day-to-day guidance to buyers, purchasing specialists, or other materials team members.
* Experience purchasing electrical, mechanical, electronic, or other production components in a high-mix manufacturing environment.

**NPI/Indirect Buyer**

The **NPI/Indirect Buyer** is responsible for leading sourcing, procurement, and supplier engagement activities that support successful New Product Introduction (NPI) initiatives and indirect procurement programs across CONMED's global operations. This role serves as the primary sourcing liaison between Global Sourcing, R&D, Engineering, Operations, Planning, Supplier Quality, Product Management, and key business stakeholders to ensure supplier capability, material readiness, cost competitiveness, and supply continuity throughout the product development and launch lifecycle.

The NPI/Indirect Buyer supports supplier selection, qualification, commercial negotiations, and procurement execution for both product launch activities and indirect spend categories, including capital equipment, tooling, facilities, MRO, professional services, logistics, and IT. This role balances strategic sourcing principles with operational execution to support speed-to-market objectives, operational efficiency, risk mitigation, and cost optimization.

**\\*\\*\\*This is a remote position\\*\\*\\***

**Key Responsibilities**

**New Product Introduction (NPI)**

* Lead sourcing and procurement activities for assigned NPI projects from concept through commercial launch.
* Participate as the purchasing representative on cross-functional product development teams.
* Develop sourcing strategies for new components, assemblies, tooling, equipment, and services required for product launches.
* Identify, evaluate, onboard, and manage suppliers capable of supporting new technologies and product requirements.
* Ensure supplier capacity, tooling, lead times, and manufacturing readiness align with launch schedules.
* Drive supplier participation in design reviews, development activities, and technical discussions.

**Indirect Procurement & Strategic Sourcing**

* Support sourcing initiatives across assigned indirect spend categories.
* Conduct spend analysis and identify opportunities for cost reduction, supplier consolidation, and process improvement.
* Manage RFIs, RFQs, and RFPs and lead supplier negotiations for pricing, contracts, and service agreements.
* Support stakeholder requirements across Operations, Engineering, Facilities, IT, Finance, HR, Marketing, and other business functions.
* Develop and execute sourcing strategies that align with business objectives and financial targets.

**Supplier Management**

* Partner with Supplier Quality and Engineering to support supplier qualification, validation, and approval activities.
* Coordinate supplier selection, quotation analysis, and commercial negotiations.
* Monitor supplier performance related to quality, delivery, responsiveness, and launch readiness.
* Drive corrective actions and mitigation plans when supplier risks are identified.
* Support onboarding and governance of suppliers across direct and indirect procurement categories.

**Project & Cost Management**

* Maintain sourcing timelines, milestones, deliverables, and project readiness metrics.
* Communicate risks, dependencies, and mitigation plans to project stakeholders and leadership.
* Support should-cost analysis, cost modeling, and total cost of ownership evaluations.
* Identify and implement cost savings, cost avoidance, and value improvement opportunities.
* Utilize data-driven analysis to support sourcing decisions and supplier selection.

**Systems & Reporting**

* Maintain supplier, sourcing, contract, and procurement data within Oracle and related systems.
* Track procurement KPIs, sourcing milestones, supplier performance, and project readiness metrics.
* Develop spend analytics and reporting to support category management and sourcing decisions.
* Provide regular updates to sourcing leadership and project teams.

**Education & Experience Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Engineering, Operations Management, Finance, or a related field.
* 3-5+ years of experience in Purchasing, Procurement, Strategic Sourcing, Supply Chain, or Materials Management within a manufacturing environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 5+ years of procurement or sourcing experience within a regulated manufacturing environment such as medical device, pharmaceutical, aerospace, or automotive.
* Experience supporting NPI, product launches, supplier onboarding, or engineering change management processes.
* Experience supporting medical device product development and commercialization activities.
* Knowledge of supplier qualification, validation, quality systems, and FDA-regulated manufacturing environments.
* Experience leading strategic sourcing initiatives and category management programs.
* Experience with supplier cost modeling, should-cost analysis, and total cost of ownership methodologies.
* Professional certifications such as CPSM, CPM, CSCP, or CPIM.

* Familiarity with Lean Manufacturing, Value Engineering, and Continuous Improvement methodologies. Exper

The successful candidate will work closely with Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, Planning, Finance, Program Management, and global procurement teams to ensure suppliers meet Eugenus requirements for **quality, cost, delivery, technology, and responsiveness**.

* Evaluate total cost of ownership when making sourcing and supplier-selection decisions.

* Analyze purchase requisitions for accuracy, completeness, specifications, required dates, and appropriate approvals.

* Maintain accurate supplier pricing, lead-time, delivery, and purchasing information within SAP/ERP systems.
* Update product BOMs and purchasing information records with current lead times and pricing.
* Monitor open purchase orders, past-due orders, shortages, and critical material requirements and proactively resolve delivery issues.
* Execute material and trace transactions within the ERP system.
* Maintain accurate delivery schedules in ERP, Material Status reports, and applicable Program Management planning tools.

* Work with suppliers to improve delivery performance, reduce lead times, improve quality, and increase overall supply-chain effectiveness.
* Escalate significant supplier performance, capacity, quality, or commercial issues in a timely manner.

* Identify, negotiate, implement, and track cost-reduction and cost-avoidance opportunities.
