Join our team as an Entry-Level Buyer and play a key role in supporting purchasing operations that keep our production schedules on track. This position is ideal for someone who is detail-oriented, organized, and eager to grow within supply chain or purchasing. You will work closely with vendors and internal teams to ensure accurate purchase order processing, timely deliveries, and uninterrupted material flow to production.

Inline Filling Systems designs and manufactures world-class, application-specific systems for customers across major industries. Our focus on purposeful innovation and operational excellence depends on strong internal processes — including a dependable and detail-oriented purchasing function.

**Responsibilities:**

* Review and process purchase order confirmations to ensure accurate system data.
* Update vendors’ purchase order due dates and follow up on missing confirmations.
* Contact vendors to resolve past-due orders and coordinate delivery timelines.
* Monitor and update price information, notifying the Purchasing Manager of significant changes.
* Assist in purchasing supply and maintenance items for operations.
* Identify and resolve discrepancies between receipts and invoices.
* Communicate with operations regarding delays or supply issues that could impact production schedules.

**What You'll Bring:**

**Required Skills & Abilities:**

* Strong attention to detail and data accuracy.
* Excellent communication and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work effectively with vendors and internal teams.
* Work independently under limited supervision

**Education & Experience:**

* Coursework or foundational knowledge in purchasing, supply chain, or business, preferably within a manufacturing setting.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word, and Outlook, preferred.
* Minimum **3+ years** with broader ERP systems knowledge, preferably Genius ERP

**Physical Requirements:**

* Ability to sit for prolonged periods at a desk and work on a computer.
* Ability to lift up to 25 pounds occasionally.

***The above job description is general, and management may assign other duties.***

**Why Join Us?**

We offer a dynamic and supportive work environment where your contributions are highly valued. At Inline Filling Systems, you'll have the opportunity to work on exciting projects and make a tangible impact on our success.

**Benefits:**

* 401(k) with company matching
* Dental Insurance
* Flexible Schedule
* Health Insurance
* Life Insurance
* Paid Time Off
* Vision Insurance

**Employment Information**

Inline Filling Systems is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We believe in providing a fair and equitable employment environment for all individuals. All employees are responsible for upholding our commitment to equal opportunity and diversity. We prohibit discrimination based on race, color, creed, religion, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, sex, sexual orientation, and any other status protected by applicable federal or Florida state law.

Inline Filling Systems is a division of the Middleby Food Processing Group.

description:
About International Filter Products

International Filter Products provides filtration products, components, and support to customers in pharmaceutical, sterile compounding, laboratory, research, and other specialized industries. We value accuracy, reliability, teamwork, and strong supplier partnerships.

The Role

We’re looking for an organized, analytical Buyer/Planner to keep materials flowing and orders shipping on time. You’ll plan and purchase the products and components we need, manage supplier relationships, and balance inventory so we have what customers need without carrying excess stock. You’ll work closely with our sales, accounting, receiving, and warehouse teams. Our customers work in regulated settings, so accuracy and follow-through matter in every order. Training is provided, including on our systems and procedures.

What You’ll Do

* Plan and purchase products, components, and supplies based on sales orders, forecasts, and inventory levels.
* Create purchase orders in QuickBooks and track, confirm, and expedite them to ensure on-time delivery.
* Maintain inventory levels that balance customer availability against carrying costs, including reorder points and safety stock.
* Build strong vendor relationships, negotiate pricing and lead times, and monitor supplier performance.
* Keep item and vendor data accurate, and work with accounting to resolve receiving and invoice discrepancies.
* Communicate product availability, shortages, and expected arrival dates to internal teams.

Qualifications – Required

* 2–5 years of experience in purchasing, materials planning, inventory control, or supply chain.
* Experience creating and managing purchase orders in QuickBooks Enterprise.
* Strong Excel skills, including pivot tables and lookups.
* Strong organization, attention to detail, and follow-through on multiple priorities.
* Clear, professional communication and comfort negotiating with suppliers.

Qualifications – Preferred

* Experience in a manufacturing or distribution environment.
* Experience purchasing for pharmaceutical, laboratory, medical, or other regulated industries.

**To apply:** submit your résumé with a brief description of your relevant purchasing, planning, or inventory experience.

*International Filter Products is an equal-opportunity employer.*

Pay: $72,000.00 - $85,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Health insurance

Work Location: In person

Materials Buyer

**Salary:** $65,000.00-$84,000.00 per year

**Job description:**

Job Summary
This job requires an individual who is self-motivated and comfortable working in an entrepreneurial, efficiency-focused environment. The role involves working closely with production to ensure proper materials are on hand, while at the same time, working with suppliers to source quality materials at a competitive price. This position will report directly to the Director of Procurement.

Responsibilities

* Working with approved vendors to source materials for production, including, but not limited to, pallets, tape, and packaging materials
* Ensuring that the production plant has all necessary materials on hand to produce orders efficiently
* Developing near-term (4 to 6 weeks) forecasts for consumption of products
* Understanding supplier lead time and adjusting purchasing accordingly
* Actively working to promote improvements in efficiency throughout the plant
* Actively working to reduce total material expenses
* Working with vendors to track orders through delivery
* Check vendor order acknowledgements to locate and prevent discrepancies
* Locating potential vendors
* Periodically reviewing pricing with multiple vendors with the goal of reducing material costs
* Reporting all purchases to the Purchasing Department
* Coordinate die repairs and transportation of dies
* Working with the technology department to improve reporting and forecasting
* Communicating with customer service to keep them informed of updated Vendor delivery schedules
* Constantly work to promote an environment of continuous improvement

Scope and Impact on Others
Maintain flexible, positive and willing attitude along with open, professional communication with Manufacturing, Sales, Accounting, Customers, Suppliers, etc. to facilitate both the reduction in material costs and improvement in plant efficiency.

Qualifications and Skill Set

* Familiarity with Microsoft Office, with a particular emphasis on Microsoft Excel
* A valid driver’s license
* Previous work experience in the fields of Supply Chain Logistics or Procurement is preferred, but not required

description:
The Buyer reports directly to the General Manger and is responsible for the material functions relating to the planning, procurement, storage, control and distribution of materials and products to meet company objectives and customer requirements. This involves the responsibility of shipping/receiving, direct purchasing, awareness of production, scheduling and inventory control.

· Excellent communication skills with the ability to provide concise documentation.

· Accurate, organized, detail-oriented, able to work well without close supervision and achieve goals beyond minimum levels of performance.

· Good computer skills including word-processing, spread sheets, ability to review reports and access information from Sage50.

· Due to the nature of our environment, strict confidentiality in all phases of employment is expected and must be maintained.

· Procurement of parts needed based on bill of materials including maintenance of machine drawings, if required. Utilize purchase order system (Sage50).

· Obtains material, equipment, components or supplies at lowest cost consistent with required quality, quantity and availability.

· Makes certain all purchasing documents are properly executed and the terms and conditions of purchases are appropriate.

· Investigates and solves problems resulting from material shortages.

· Assures departmental records are maintained and that purchases are expedited when required. Department records include price histories to provide information on price variances.

· Interacts effectively with coworkers to communicate purchasing status or problems that may develop as machines are built.

· Monitors and maintains adequate levels for items used frequently or items with long delivery schedules to avoid disruption to assembly processes.

· Receive in parts and materials from vendors and subcontractors.

· Stores incoming parts, components or other purchases in customer job cart staging area, upon receipt.

· Assists with monthly reconciliation of inventory and purchases. Monitors that parts are coded to the specific job for which they were ordered. This includes the taking and valuing of the physical inventories. Maintenance of computerized inventory records.

Pay: From $28.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Retirement plan

Work Location: In person

description:
**Project Buyer – Data Centre Construction**

**Location:** Kentucky
**Project:** Data Centre Construction

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced Project Buyer to support the delivery of a major data centre construction project.

The Project Buyer will be responsible for managing procurement activities across key construction packages, equipment and materials, ensuring packages are competitively tendered, commercially evaluated and placed in line with the project programme and budget.

The successful candidate will work closely with Project Managers, Cost Managers, Engineering teams, contractors and suppliers, providing procurement support throughout the project lifecycle.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Manage procurement activities for construction packages, equipment and materials associated with the data centre project.
* Develop and maintain procurement schedules aligned with the overall construction programme.
* Prepare and issue RFQs, RFPs and tender packages to contractors and suppliers.
* Manage tender processes, including bidder engagement, clarifications and commercial evaluations.
* Analyse quotations and prepare bid comparisons and procurement recommendations.
* Support commercial negotiations covering pricing, contractual terms, lead times and delivery conditions.
* Coordinate with engineering and project teams to ensure technical and commercial requirements are aligned before orders are placed.
* Identify long-lead equipment and procurement risks that could impact the project schedule.
* Monitor supplier and contractor performance throughout the procurement and delivery process.
* Track purchase orders, manufacturing schedules and delivery dates.
* Support procurement of key data centre packages such as electrical equipment, mechanical equipment, generators, UPS systems, switchgear, transformers, cooling equipment and associated construction packages.
* Maintain procurement trackers, tender documentation and commercial records.
* Work closely with cost management teams to ensure procurement activities remain aligned with project budgets.
* Provide regular procurement updates and identify potential cost, programme or supply-chain risks.

**Experience Required**

* Previous experience as a Project Buyer, Construction Buyer, Procurement Specialist or Procurement Manager within major construction or engineering projects.

Anduril is fielding the next generation of Autonomous Underwater Vehicles (AUVs) to tackle the extremely challenging industry demands of seabed exploration. * Manage day-to-day ordering and inventory for assigned product lines
* Identify and resolve supply issues, collaborating with cross-functional teams
* Generate and analyze data to identify trends and support decision-making
* Develop and maintain processes within MRP and associated master data
* Support strategic sourcing initiatives and make/buy decisions
* Issue purchase orders for production and R&D initiatives and manage supplier relationships
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives for cost savings and quality
* Participate in S&OP processes and support related strategic initiatives
* Develop data reporting structures and tools to monitor Demand Planning KPIs and identify key levers for improvement by product or program
* Understand the product BOM to a level that enables quick decision-making as well as effective questioning and discussion of potential sales opportunities
* Support continuous improvement initiatives for cost savings, quality improvement, and on-time delivery

* 2+ years of significant technical procurement experience in a manufacturing environment

* Prior knowledge of Oracle or a similar Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) system
* Ability to travel up to 25%

When a machine is down, a crew is waiting, or a critical part is sitting on backorder somewhere across the country, we need someone who doesn’t simply send an email and wait.

We need someone who **owns it.**

Alpha Inc. is looking for a **Purchasing Agent** who is organized, relentless about follow-through, sharp on the details, and wired with a genuine sense of urgency. You’ll source and purchase the parts, equipment, tools, materials, supplies, and specialty items that keep our equipment, maintenance, construction, and field operations running.

This is not a transactional purchasing role.

You’ll own purchasing requests **from initial request through successful delivery**—finding the right part, verifying the details, tracking the shipment, chasing the backorder, communicating the delay, finding Plan B when Plan A falls apart, and making sure the person who needs it actually gets it.

If your definition of follow-up is *“I sent them an email,”* this probably isn’t your role.

If you naturally think *“What needs to happen next, who do I need to call, and how do I get this across the finish line?”* — **keep reading.**

**About Alpha Inc.**

Founded and grown in Hawai?i, Alpha Inc. is a locally owned company supporting construction, drilling, energy, equipment, and infrastructure operations across the islands.

We take on demanding work, and that requires people who take ownership of their piece of the operation.

Our three core values shape how we work:

**Leading with Heart** – Support and foster a safe, productive, and respectful work environment for all team members.

**Strength in Unity** – Work together across equipment, maintenance, field leadership, project teams, vendors, and internal departments because operations win when the entire team wins.

**Alpha Mentality** – Take ownership. Act with urgency. Solve problems proactively. Communicate effectively. Follow through and execute.

For the Purchasing Agent, those aren’t words on a wall. **They’re the job.**

**What You’ll Own**

**Own the Purchase — Start to Finish**

* A request hitting your desk is the **beginning** of your responsibility, not the end.
* You’ll own purchasing requests through final delivery, making sure orders are accurate, complete, documented, actively tracked, and successfully received.
* That means verifying part numbers, serial numbers, equipment information, specifications, quantities, compatibility, pricing, and shipping information **before** an order goes out.
* And when a repair requires more than one component, you’ll work with mechanics, maintenance personnel, vendors, and manufacturers to make sure the team has the seals, fittings, hardware, fluids, kits, and related components necessary to actually finish the job.

**Attack Downtime With Urgency**

A backordered part isn't just a line on a spreadsheet.

It can mean **equipment sitting instead of working.**

You’ll work closely with the Equipment Superintendent, foremen, mechanics, and operations personnel to understand what’s critical, what’s coming next, and where delays could hurt maintenance schedules, safety, field productivity, or project operations.

Critical order stuck?

**Call the vendor.**

Still stuck?

**Call again. Find another distributor. Check the manufacturer. Explore another shipping method. Find another solution.**

You’re expected to aggressively follow up on critical parts, emergency orders, backorders, and delayed shipments—and immediately escalate significant issues that could extend equipment downtime.

**Communicate Before Someone Has to Ask**

Great purchasing professionals don't make the operation hunt them down for answers.

You’ll maintain current information on open orders, estimated delivery dates, tracking numbers, partial shipments, backorders, substitutions, cancellations, and outstanding items.

When something changes, **you communicate it.**

Not tomorrow.

Not when someone asks.

When it matters.

Sometimes the obvious vendor won't have it.

That's where resourcefulness matters.

You’ll source heavy-equipment and heavy-duty truck parts, components, tools, materials, supplies, consumables, equipment, and specialty products from vendors throughout the United States and internationally.

When traditional channels don't work, you'll identify alternate manufacturers, dealers, distributors, vendors, shipping methods, and sourcing options.

**Overview**Gulf Coast Supply and Manufacturing is currently seeking a Buyer/Purchaser responsible for assuring the continuous supply of assigned components in order to maintain the required production levels at optimum cost consistent with quality and quantity specifications. Maintaining an inventory level for all SKU’s while developing the internal and external supply chain. The end-to-end sourcing process for this company will be determined and driven through this position.

**Duties and Responsibilities**

· Interpret and validate MRP messages daily by tracing and validating the source.

· Investigate and resolve sources of false demand and initiate corrective measures

· Maintain correct planning parameters for all assigned parts/suppliers

· Carefully monitor past due shipments with suppliers, carriers and or Receiving material.

· Responsible for Purchasing stocked and non-stocked items through over 35 suppliers.

· Maintain proper inventory levels to support forecast and work with Production to ensure inventory on hand is continually reviewed against Material Resource Planning (MRP) required from Operations to meet customer demand

· Communicate price increases to direct supervisor.

· Communicate product requirements to our vendors and required compliance.

· Make sourcing decisions from a list of suppliers as well as look for new ones that can be qualified.

· Keep purchasing and item information accurate and up-to-date in SYSPRO.

· Expedite and respond to shortages in an immediate fashion to ensure stock-outs are as little as possible.

· Able to independently troubleshoot issues/concerns and determine course of action

· Work with suppliers and internal customers to resolve returns to vendor and quality issues

· Other duties as assigned

· 2 year degree in business or related field

· Minimum of 2-3 years’ experience as a buyer

· Proficient use of Excel

· Knowledge of import/export compliance a plus

· Capable of multi-tasking to meet expected due dates

description:
Milacron is looking for a Buyer to join our team in Batavia, OH. In this position, you will be responsible for procuring materials for APPT Machinery, managing inventory planning, supporting production schedules, and coordinating supply chain activities to ensure product availability and on-time delivery.

**Work You’ll Do:**

* Support management initiatives focused on cost reduction, quality improvement, and delivery performance.
* Execute material procurement activities and manage purchase orders based on MRP requirements.
* Monitor inventory levels and maintain appropriate safety stock, reorder points, and min/max settings.
* Develop and communicate forecast plans with sales, supply chain, and manufacturing teams.
* Coordinate with sales and product management to validate demand forecasts and inventory requirements.
* Maintain item master data, branch plant records, and ABC classifications by SKU.
* Administer interplant warehouse transfers and identify potential product shortages.
* Review and respond to MRP messages to ensure a consistent flow of materials.
* Expedite late, missing, or incorrect orders and resolve delivery, pricing, and quality concerns with supplier support.
* Process drop shipments, support engineering change releases, and create work orders to balance supply and demand.

**Qualifications:**

* High school diploma or GED required.
* Bachelor’s degree in a supply chain-related field and at least 2 years of buying/planning experience, or a minimum of 3 years of related experience required.
* Working knowledge of supply chain metrics.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to communicate and collaborate effectively with all levels of the organization.
* Ability to work successfully in a cross-functional environment.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.
* Ability to analyze inventory, forecasting, and procurement data to support business objectives.
* Ability to occasionally lift up to 25 pounds and perform physical requirements associated with a manufacturing environment.

**Who we are:**
Milacron is a global industrial leader in the manufacturing and distribution of highly engineered and customized injection molding and extrusion solutions, and aftermarket parts and service for the plastics processing industry. The company’s 1,900+ associates worldwide collaborate to serve a diverse range of end-markets, such as automotive, construction, medical, telecommunications, material handling, packaging, and much more. With expertise in plastics spanning nearly 60 years, Milacron holds longstanding relationships with more than 27,000 customers around the world. The original equipment provider of plastics manufacturing solutions is the largest US-owned and globally served of its kind. Headquartered in Batavia, OH, Milacron’s global footprint is also serviced through regional facilities in Asia, Europe, and South America.

**EEO:**
The policy of Milacron is to extend opportunities to qualified applicants and employees on an equal basis regardless of an individual's age, race, color, sex, religion, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression or veteran status. We are committed to being an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Employer and offer opportunities to all job seekers including individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to assist with your job search or application for employment, email us at recruitingaccommodations@milacron.com. In your email, please include a description of the specific accommodation you are requesting as well as the job title and requisition number of the position for which you are applying.

**ABOUT OTTINE MINERAL SPRINGS:**

Ottine Mineral Springs, nestled beside Palmetto State Park, is a historic treasure renowned for its rich legacy and commitment to health and wellness. Our extraordinary waters are rich in natural minerals and have long been known to promote relaxation, reduce stress and support overall well-being. Today, we carry on this tradition by offering a peaceful retreat where guests can experience the rejuvenating power of these waters in a calming setting that only nature can provide.

**POSITION:**

We are looking for an experienced **Purchasing & Procurement Specialist** to manage operational procurement across our growing hospitality and resort operations, as well as support ongoing development needs. This person will work within established processes while playing a key role in the implementation of a new accounting system — including material requisitions and purchase orders — and helping to strengthen our procurement function going forward.

*Operational + implementation experience required. Construction experience a plus.*

**Compensation:**

$40,000 - $80,000 yearly

**Responsibilities:**

* Lead day-to-day purchasing across resort and hospitality operations, ensuring timely fulfillment of goods, services, and operational supplies while maintaining quality standards.
* Support the rollout and configuration of a new accounting system; establish standard operating procedures for material requisitions (MR) and purchase order (PO) workflows.
* Source, evaluate, and negotiate competitive pricing and terms with suppliers and service providers; build and maintain strong long-term vendor partnerships.
* Work closely with the accounting team to ensure proper GL coding, three-way matching, invoice approval routing, and accurate documentation.
* Continuously evaluate purchasing patterns, identify cost-saving opportunities, streamline inventory tracking, and mitigate supply chain delays.
* Partner with department managers, hospitality operations, and project teams to anticipate material/supply needs and support ad-hoc construction or maintenance projects as needed.
* Participate in relevant meetings.

*Due to changing operational demands and the need to exceed customer expectations, it may be necessary to undertake various functions that are not specifically related to this position. This individual may be required to carry out additional tasks and duties as needed or as directed. Additionally, employee responsibilities and job descriptions are subject to review and modification.*

**Qualifications:**

* Based locally in Broussard, LA, with the ability to travel monthly to Central Texas for site visits, inventory audits, and team alignment.
* 3+ years of progressive experience in purchasing or procurement, with a strong emphasis on operational procurement.
* Demonstrated comfort with system implementations and new software adoption; hands-on experience using ERP, accounting, or procurement management software.
* Hospitality, resort, or property management experience is strongly preferred; construction purchasing experience is a plus.
* Practical accounting experience or a solid understanding of cost accounting, PO/invoice reconciliation, and budgeting is a strong plus.

*Ottine Mineral Springs is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity, equity, and inclusion. All employment is decided based on qualifications, merit, and business need. We are committed to fostering the professional growth of our employees by providing opportunities for continuous learning and development. With dedication and demonstrated performance, there is potential for career advancement with our company.*

**About Company**

**Discover Your Next Chapter at Ottine Mineral Springs**

Nestled on 60 serene acres in Gonzales, Texas, Ottine Mineral Springs is a historic resort dedicated to healing and holistic well-being. Centered around our century-old thermal artesian waters, our expanding wellness village features mineral pools, a full-service spa, and movement spaces.

We are looking for passionate, hospitality-driven professionals to grow with us. Working here means immersing yourself in a culture that prioritizes mindfulness, exceptional service, and connection to nature. Whether you are experienced or have the right attitude and a drive to learn, we invite you to build a meaningful career in the thriving wellness industry.

We are Doe Run – 160 years strong, delivering minerals and metals to power the world.

The Doe Run Company is seeking a Buyer to support operations by timely sourcing and ordering material, equipment, and services while supporting financial, quality and expedited needs. This position is located at our Central Office in Viburnum, MO.

The work location may change as needed to support production and business needs within the Viburnum Trend in Southeast Missouri.

Based in St. Louis, Missouri, The Doe Run Company is a privately held natural resources company and one of the largest lead producers in the Western Hemisphere. Dedicated to environmentally responsible mineral and metal production, Doe Run has facilities in Missouri, Washington, and Arizona and operates one of the world's largest, single-site lead recycling facilities, located in Boss, MO. Using innovative mining techniques, Doe Run skillfully taps one of the largest lead deposits in the world. As stewards of the mineral resources in our care, we strive to provide premium services and products to people who share our belief in enhancing the quality of life. You may view our sustainability report located at http://sustainability.doerun.com/.

We Offer:

Competitive base pay plus bonus eligible.
Benefits start day 1, including insurance, paid time off, and discount programs.

Career growth opportunity, plus training and education assistance.

**Job Responsibilities:**

* Purchasing: Source material, equipment and services for the organization as needed. Negotiate with vendors for price, availability, quality and delivery time. Manage backorder report and invoice exceptions regularly to ensure material is received and invoices are paid in a timely manner.
* Customer relations: Work with internal customers to ensure the correct material, equipment and services are quoted, ordered and received in a timely manner.
* Vendor relations: Work with vendors to ensure material, equipment and services are rendered at the best overall cost and received in a timely manner.
* Commodity analysis: Perform analysis on commodities purchased including sourcing and engaging with vendor base.
* Complete tasks in a safe and environmentally compliant manner by following EHS (environmental, health and safety) policies, procedures and best practices; support and assist peers in working in a safe, compliant manner; report unsafe acts or conditions, incidents, and deviations; and provide feedback to support continuous improvement in EHS performance.
* Other duties or projects as assigned.

**Education & Experience:**

* High school diploma or equivalent.
* Minimum 3 years customer relations/service experience.
* 1 year of buying experience preferred.
* Associate degree preferred

**Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities:**

* Proficient computer skills in Microsoft Office Suite, ERP enterprise resource planning (PeopleSoft) and accounts payable (DataServ).
* Proficient decision-making regarding prioritization and negotiation.
* Advanced customer relations and communication skills (including verbal, written, and listening).
* Attention to detail must be detail-oriented and maintain the ability to manage multiple tasks.

**Environmental Conditions, Physical & Lifting Requirements:**

* Regular use of a computer and telephone,
* Work is regularly performed in a quiet office setting.
* Regularly sitting, talking, hearing, reach with hands/arms, and repetitive wrist and/or finger movements. Requires clarity of vision at 20 inches or less.
* Occasionally required to lift up to 5 pounds.

All job offers are contingent upon the candidate's successful completion and clearance of post-offer drug screen, physical, and background check. Background checks include verification of education, employment history, and criminal record review. The role may also require a motor vehicle record review and ATF explosives possessor clearance.

Doe Run is an Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability and veterans.

#### **Experience**

Required

* 3 year(s): Customer relations/service experience.

Preferred

* 1 year(s): Buying experience.

#### **Education**

Required

* High School or better

Preferred

* Associates or better

Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities
This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

Description:

**Company:** Ulm Automotive

**Department:** Purchasing

**Reports to:** General Manager / Chief Financial Officer

**Location:** Bogart, GA (on-site)

**Employment type:** Full-time, salaried, exempt; paid weekly

**Direct reports:** Inventory Specialist and Warehouse Associate

**Position Summary**

The Purchasing Manager makes sure every part for every vehicle is on the shelf, at the right price, before the build needs it. Ulm upfits new Mercedes-Benz Sprinter vans into luxury passenger vehicles and sells them wholesale to dealerships. Every vehicle is built from a released bill of material covering seating and climate systems, electrical components, trim and finishes, hardware, and outsourced services such as paint. Production is ramping now, and material has to arrive ahead of it.

This role owns the supplier base and the buy: it selects and qualifies suppliers, negotiates price and terms, turns the production schedule and the bill of material into purchase orders, and chases every late delivery until it lands. It

leads the Inventory Specialist and works daily with Production, Engineering, Quality, and Accounting. It suits a hands-on purchasing leader who knows the difference between a box price and a piece price and would rather prevent a shortage than expedite one.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Supplier Selection and Performance**

* Select and qualify suppliers on capability, quality history, delivery, price, and certifications, and keep the approved supplier list current for the Quality Manager's approval. Production parts are bought only from suppliers on the list.
* Negotiate pricing, volume breaks, lead times, payment and freight terms, and warranty support; put key suppliers on written agreements or blanket orders tied to planned volume.
* Qualify second sources for single-source and long-lead parts so no one supplier can stop the line.
* Collect compliance documentation and current installation instructions from suppliers of safety-related components (seating systems, seat belt assemblies, glazing, and fuel-fired heaters) for Engineering before the first receipt.
* Define outsourced work such as paint and fabrication in writing, with acceptance criteria, and confirm it is verified on return.
* Score suppliers on on-time delivery and incoming quality, review them quarterly with the Quality Manager, and replace any that keep missing after corrective action.

**Purchase Orders and Material Planning**

* Turn the production schedule, base vehicle arrival dates, and the released bill of material into a rolling purchasing forecast, and buy in release blocks so material lands ahead of each block without tying up cash in excess stock.
* Issue a purchase order under the company's standard terms and conditions for every purchase before the supplier ships: part number, quantity, unit of measure, price, revision level, and required date. No verbal orders.
* Check every price against the agreed basis before release: a box, roll, or pack price is never entered as a unit price, and order quantities match the supplier's pack.
* Buy production material only against the released bill of material; no part is added or substituted without an approved Engineering Change Order.
* Keep shop supplies and consumables (adhesives, abrasives, tape, cutting tools, and PPE) on par levels so the floor never waits.
* Expedite late orders before they become shortages, and report open orders, expected receipts, and shortages against the production schedule every morning.

**Cost Control and Systems**

* Keep item data accurate in Katana, the company's inventory and production management system, and in QuickBooks: part numbers, suppliers, units of measure, prices, lead times, and reorder points.
* Track material cost per vehicle against the bill of material standard monthly, explain every variance, and bring cost-reduction ideas to Engineering as change orders.
* Plan large commitments (blanket orders, deposits, and prepayments) with the Controller against the cash forecast, within the CFO's approval limits.
* Work with Accounting on new supplier setup (credit applications, W-9s, and payment terms) and on the three-way match of purchase order, receipt, and invoice; settle price and quantity differences before payment.
* Apply the company's sales tax position: materials that go into the vehicle are bought for resale under the supplier's copy of the resale certificate, which only the CFO signs; shop supplies, tools, and equipment are taxable unless the CFO directs otherwise.

**Receiving and Inventory**

* Lead the Inventory Specialist, and run receiving with Material Control so every delivery is checked against its purchase order and booked into inventory the same day.
* Quarantine damaged or nonconforming material under the nonconforming product procedure, and settle returns and credits with the supplier.
* Set reorder points and safety stock by part class, with the tightest control on high-value and safety-related

**Buyer**

The Buyer is responsible for procuring products within assigned planner codes in a timely and cost-effective manner. This role will lead initiatives and projects to resolve quality and delivery concerns to take proactive steps to eliminate or reduce risk to the company.

**Who are we?**

Founded in 1849, Ducommun is the oldest company in California. Starting as a hardware supply store during the California Gold Rush and eventually assisted in the birth of the aerospace industry in Southern California by providing aircraft aluminum to early aerospace pioneers like Lindbergh, Douglas and Lockheed.

Today Ducommun is a global provider of innovative manufacturing solutions for customers in the aerospace, defense and industrial markets. We specialize in electronic and structural systems, producing complex products and components for commercial aircraft platforms, mission-critical military and space programs, and sophisticated industrial applications.

Our Facility in Appleton, WI manufactures state-of-the-art circuit boards for Aerospace and Defense as well as Industrial and Medical Industries.

**Job Summary**

* Negotiate best value with suppliers
* Perform materials quotation for prices and delivery
* Procure products within assigned commodity areas in a timely and cost effective manner
* Identify and reduce long lead times in the system by utilizing material strategies with suppliers
* Review daily MRP exception message, purchase order status, and order action reports and take appropriate action
* Must know when/where to buy goods and services
* Resolve material price variances
* Identify alternate solutions for obsolete components and work with engineering for approval
* Ensure timely delivery of products to support manufacturing
* Develop new/better/alternate sources of supply to reduce the supplier base
* Maintain purchasing data in computer system so that it is always current
* Resolve problems that occur periodically with suppliers
* Maintain appropriate lead times, minimums and multiples; vendor information for all assigned parts in the system
* Performs other assignments as required

**Required Skills and Qualifications**

* Understanding of engineering drawings and flow charts
* MRP exposure required
* Intermediate level of computer skills in e-mail, internet, Word, and Excel
* Strong communications and interpersonal skills needed
* Experience dealing with suppliers including quoting, order processing and tracking delivery and quality performance

**Preferred Experience and Education**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience preferred
* 1-5 years relevant purchasing experience required in a manufacturing environment preferred

Business mileage reimbursement scheme.

Position Title: Purchasing Manager
Department: Procurement / Purchasing
Location: Longview, WA (On-site)
Reports to: Director of Compliance

Classification: Salary, fulltime
Salary Range: $108,680.00 - $130,312.00 per year DOE

\\*\\*\\*If you are an American Indian/Alaska Native and/or a Veteran and would like this to be considered a preference in hiring, please upload documentation with your resume and cover letter. Acceptable documentation includes Tribal Enrollment card, a letter from your Tribe stating your enrollment, or BIA 4432 and/or DD214.\\*\\*\\*

**Position summary**

Oversees the Cowlitz Indian Tribe’s (CIT) Purchasing department and manages procurement activities to ensure the timely, cost-effective acquisition of goods and services. Develops purchasing strategies, policies, and procedures; coordinates supplier contract negotiations and required approvals; and maintains vendor relationships that support quality, value, and reliable service. Monitors market trends, evaluates supplier performance, and ensures compliance with applicable Tribal laws, funding requirements, and federal, state, and local regulations. Maintains professionalism in all interactions and honors and represents CIT’s mission, vision, and values.

The Purchasing Manager serves as the central procurement. The role partners with all Tribal Departments and Administration leadership to connect purchasing, contracts, inventory, and financial systems while protecting Tribal sovereignty.

*This list of duties and responsibilities is illustrative only of the tasks performed by this position and is not all-inclusive.*

**Essential Duties & Responsibilities:**

* Oversees the Purchasing department within the Cowlitz Indian Tribe (CIT).
* Administers the procurement process to ensure the timely and cost-effective acquisition of goods and services needed to support CIT.
* Develops and implements purchasing strategies, negotiates contracts with suppliers, develops policies and procedures, and maintains strong vendor relationships to secure favorable terms and high-quality products.
* Works with the Legal department and Administration department on reviewing contract packets for required documents.
* Monitors market trends and evaluates supplier performance.
* Analyzes inventory needs, optimizes supply chain efficiency, and collaborates with internal teams to align procurement activities with organizational goals and budgets.
* Manages the purchasing department staff.
* Improves staff effectiveness by recruiting, selecting, orienting, training, coaching, counseling, and disciplining team members; communicating values, strategies, and objectives; assigning accountabilities; planning, monitoring, and appraising job results; developing a climate for offering information and opinions; integrating functional objectives; and providing and participating in educational opportunities.
* Hosts regular staff meetings and trainings to ensure communication among team and about purchasing matters.
* Develops or utilizes existing software to track all purchases and expenditures.
* Performs assignments related to purchasing assigned by Tribal Administration.
* Assists in preparing monthly reports for CIT leadership, Tribal Council, and other stakeholders.
* Achieves financial objectives by assisting in preparing annual budgets and budget modifications, and by exercising control and implementation over the departmental budgetary processes.
* Processes receipts and expenditures for all departments.
* Maintains compliance with applicable local/state/federal/tribal laws, regulations, policies, and best practices.
* Enhances professional growth and development through participation in seminars, educational workshops, classes, and conferences.
* Maintains strict confidentiality.
* Contributes to a team effort and accomplishes related results as required.
* Performs other duties as assigned.

**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities**

NaturVet has been an industry leader in the development and manufacturing of natural pet supplements and other essential solutions for over 30 years. Our competitive advantage lies with our people, and we are committed to providing a safe and inclusive workplace, opportunities for advancement, and a healthy work-life balance.

Located in Temecula, California, NaturVet is one of the largest pet supplement manufacturers in the United States. Our operations span four facilities within a two-mile radius, including two manufacturing facilities where we produce Soft Chews, Powders, Tablets, and Liquids for our trusted NaturVet brand and as private-label products for several high-profile companies.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

We are seeking a detail-oriented, proactive Strategic Buyer to support our manufacturing operations through effective sourcing, purchasing, and supplier relationship management. In this role, you will manage assigned purchasing categories from supplier selection and negotiations through purchase order execution, delivery coordination, and issue resolution to ensure materials are available when needed, meet quality requirements, and support business objectives.

The Strategic Buyer balances strategic sourcing and supplier development with day-to-day purchasing execution. You will partner closely with Production, Operations, Planning, Quality, R&D, Finance, and other internal teams to maintain supply continuity, manage costs, improve purchasing efficiency, and address changing business needs.

Depending on assigned categories and business priorities, responsibilities may include packaging, labels, ingredients, raw materials, maintenance, repair, and operations (MRO) supplies, and other production-related materials. This role also supports supplier qualification, onboarding, quality documentation, and continuous improvement initiatives that strengthen supplier performance and purchasing processes.

* **Purchasing & Supply Management:** Manage the end-to-end purchasing process for assigned categories, including sourcing, purchase order creation and maintenance, order tracking, delivery coordination, and resolution of purchasing issues.
* **Strategic Sourcing & Negotiations:** Identify and evaluate suppliers, obtain competitive quotes, negotiate pricing and purchasing terms, research market trends, and identify cost-saving and sourcing opportunities.
* **Supplier Relationship Management:** Develop and maintain strong supplier relationships, monitor supplier performance, address service or delivery concerns, and support ongoing supplier evaluations and improvements.
* **Material Availability & Inventory Support:** Partner with internal teams to anticipate material requirements, monitor inventory and purchasing needs, and proactively address potential shortages, delays, or excess inventory.
* **Supplier Qualification & Onboarding:** Source and qualify new suppliers and coordinate onboarding documentation and internal approvals to ensure accurate and complete setup within the ERP system.
* **Sample & Approval Coordination:** Manage sample and First Article Inspection (FAI) processes, including sample requests, supplier follow-up, testing, evaluation, status tracking, and approval documentation.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Work closely with Production, Operations, Planning, Quality, R&D, Finance, and other departments to align purchasing activities with production schedules, specifications, cost objectives, and business needs.
* **Pricing & Invoice Resolution:** Investigate pricing discrepancies and coordinate with suppliers, Finance, and internal stakeholders to support accurate invoicing and timely invoice approvals.
* **Systems, Documentation & Compliance:** Maintain accurate supplier, pricing, purchase order, and product information; support audits and supplier documentation requirements; and follow company policies, quality standards, applicable regulatory requirements, and food safety and GMP requirements.
* **Team Support & Flexibility:** Provide backup purchasing coverage across categories as needed, support assigned MRO purchasing activities, maintain standard operating procedures, and participate in cross-training and knowledge sharing.

Requirements:

**KEY QUALIFICATIONS**

**Education & Experience**

* High school diploma or GED required; bachelor's degree in business, supply chain management, or a related field preferred.
* At least 3 years of experience in purchasing, procurement, sourcing, or materials management.
* Experience in manufacturing, food and beverage, consumer packaged goods (CPG), supplements, cosmetics, or a similar industry preferred.
* Experience managing multiple purchasing categories, such as packaging, labels, ingredients, raw materials, MRO, or other manufacturing-related supplies, preferred.

**Skills & Competencies**

* Strong supplier relationship management, sourcing, and negotiation skills, incl

**JOB SUMMARY:**

The buyer is responsible for purchasing goods and services for use within Polar Semiconductor. This position requires comparative research and the ability to negotiate pricing with suppliers, evaluate inventory and stick within a budget. The buyer must understand the unique needs of Polar Semiconductor. Role requires in-person training with hybrid schedule after training period.

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

Ensure company’s purchasing requirements are met by possessing knowledge of the Polar Semiconductor purchasing policy and its intent. Source quality items at competitive prices, locating dependable manufacturers. Ensure deliveries by managing purchase orders through full purchase cycle. Key point of contact for internal and external customers. Responsible to maintain contact with internal teams regarding purchase order status and changes. Maintain purchase orders through department tracking system, pursuing any delinquent purchase orders. Support company initiatives, such as quality, safety and environmental management, CQI, 5S, yield management, and cost containment. Perform other duties, as required.

**SKILLS AND KNOWLEDGE:**

* Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience
* Excellent interpersonal, communication skills
* Demonstrated abilities in negotiating and purchasing procedures
* Strong analytical and organizational skills, with high attention to detail
* Knowledge of semiconductor manufacturing, and technical applications to semiconductor manufacturing, preferred
* Ability to multi-task, prioritize, and perform under pressure
* Experience in Microsoft Office
* Experience with ERP software systems is a plus, but not required

Please note that this position may require U.S. Citizenship or Permanent Residency status in the future depending on federal requirements

**What We Offer**

**Salary**: The estimated base salary range for the position is $72,500-$90,000. The pay offered is based on many factors including, but not limited to, relevant education, job-related experience, skills and level of the position.

**Benefits & Other Eligible Compensation**: Includes health, dental, vision, disability and life insurance, 401(k) plan with company match, paid time off, annual bonus, and tuition reimbursement.

**About Us**

At Polar Semiconductor, we’re on a mission to fulfill our future as the U.S. based manufacturing partner of choice for differentiated power and sensor technologies. With a $525M investment from the CHIPs Act, the state of Minnesota, and private equity, we are looking for the best in the industry to help Polar transform from a captive fab to a pure-play foundry. We are doubling our manufacturing capacity and investing in advanced BCD and Wide Bandgap technology such as GaN. Polar has a long history in manufacturing automotive grade semiconductors and we are expanding in strategic markets such as national defense and AI data centers. We pride ourselves on state-of-the-art semiconductor manufacturing, a collaborative culture, and a commitment to helping our customers succeed.

**About Minneapolis/St. Paul Area**

Our offices and manufacturing facility are located in Bloomington, Minnesota, a suburb of Minneapolis. Living in the Minneapolis / Saint Paul area offers a strong sense of community, a vibrant arts and music scene, and abundant outdoor activities year-round. The city boasts a lower cost of living than many major metros, excellent parks and lakes, and a well-educated workforce with diverse job opportunities. Its distinct seasons bring variety, from colorful autumns to lively summers filled with festivals and waterfront activities.

**EEO Statement**

*Polar Semiconductor LLC provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, creed, ancestry, sexual or affectional orientation, marital or veteran status, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, status with regard to public assistance or any characteristic protected under federal, state or local law.*

Motion Control Systems Inc., a manufacturer of high end electronic motor drive systems, is seeking a skilled Purchasing Agent to buy goods and services necessary for our business. The successful individual will have the means and opportunity to raise our profits by making the most high-quality and cost-effective purchases.

The ideal candidate will have a keen eye for detail and a commercial mindset. You should know how to evaluate market conditions and different suppliers. Communication skills will help you negotiate effectively and maintain profitable relationships.

The goal is to acquire supplies that are critical for the success of our business operations.

**Responsibilities**

Include:

* Supplier development thru analysis and supplier visits
* Assessing sources thru communication with Engineering
* Developing profitable purchasing strategies
* Assessing supplier profiles and analyzing offers
* Preparing and implementing effective negotiation tactics

**Requirements**

* US Citizenship is Required
* Proven experience as a purchasing agent or relevant role
* BS/BA in business or relevant field
* Demonstrable experience in negotiating prices and terms and conditions
* Knowledge of market research, data analysis and purchasing best practices
* Working knowledge of MS Office and Excel
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
* A strong analytical mindset
* Outstanding organizational skills
* Manage relationships with key suppliers to maintain quality of goods, timely delivery and compliance to terms of contracts
* Occasionally requires overnight on-site visits of a supplier’s facility
* Review supplies to ensure quality
* Monitor stock levels
* Prepare and submit detailed reports (revenues, buying expenditures etc.)
* Keep updated records
* Attend events, fairs and exhibitions to keep abreast of the market’s trends

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: $65,000.00 - $75,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Retirement plan
* Tuition reimbursement
* Vision insurance

Application Question(s):

* Are you a US Citizen?

Education:

* Bachelor's (Preferred)

Experience:

* Purchasing: 2 years (Preferred)

Willingness to travel:

* 25% (Preferred)

description:
Overview:

We are seeking a full-time **Buyer 1** at Garmin's U.S. headquarters in the Greater Kansas City area. In this role, you will be responsible for managing the acquisition of assigned commodities and products.

Responsibilities:

**Essential Functions**

* Drive performance to meet world-class levels in supplier Quality, Cost, Delivery and Service (QCDS)
* Responsible for supplier development in the areas of supplier partnering agreements and QCDS
* Manage the planning, ordering and delivery of all components, products and services to ensure on-time delivery across all levels of the organization
* Closely monitor inventory levels of assigned commodities and products to maximize inventory turns and minimize exposure to obsolescence
* Review, analyze, develop and negotiate multiple procurement contracts in support of Garmin’s Master Production Schedule (MPS)
* Prepare cost price analysis for various supplier partnering agreements and projects
* Review and compile inventory costing records, such as Purchase Price Variance (PPV), scrap and rework costs
* Work closely with Engineering, Quality, and Marketing to develop new sources of supply in support of new product development
* Knowledge of department processes and procedures, work instructions and training requirements for the Purchasing Department in support of ISO9000/QS9000
* Continued improvement to ensure departmental goals and metrics are met

Qualifications:

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s Degree in a related field **OR** an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience
* Demonstrated strong and effective verbal, written, negotiating, analytical, and interpersonal communication skills to work across functional and organizational lines with uncompromising ethics
* Must be a motivated self-starter with a demonstrated proven track record in the ability to prioritize, organize and multi-task in a flexible, fast paced and challenging environment to effectively meet deadlines
* Must possess demonstrated knowledgeable of Manufacturing Resource Planning (MRPII)/Master Production Schedule (MPS) process
* Demonstrated knowledge of manufacturing requirements and ability to asses supplier capabilities
* Demonstrated proficient computer skills using Microsoft Office Word, Excel and PowerPoint

**Desired Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Business Administration, Management, Operations or Material or equivalent experience
* Certified in Production & Inventory Management (CPIM) or Certified Purchasing Manager (CPM)
* Previous experience in a electronics manufacturing or repair purchasing

*Garmin International is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, citizenship, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran’s status, age or disability.*

*This position is eligible for Garmin's benefit program. Details can be found here:* *Garmin Benefits*

**Job Title**: Buyer

**Location:** North Platte, NE

**Position Type**: Full Time

**Job Summary**

We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive individual to join our team as a Buyer. In this role, you will play a key part in supporting Sustainable Beef's operations by guiding purchasing and warehouse functions. Duties include reviewing data, transaction entry, and reporting.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Purchase materials, supplies, services and equipment as directed, consistent with company policy
* Record purchase orders in ERP
* Maintain control of purchase orders from creation to close
* Maintain control of inventory item list
* Evaluate and create new vendors within company policy
* Process returns and credits
* Maintain appropriate inventory levels
* Understand purchase contracts and purchase accordingly
* Investigate invoice discrepancies as needed
* Manage reorder reporting, vendor price lists, and usage reporting in ERP
* Maintain control of Receipts and Invoices and monitor uninvoiced receipts
* Support Purchasing Manager and Purchasing Supervisor in maintaining warehouse operations
* Follow all company policies and procedures
* Participate in all required training programs
* Other duties as assigned

**Qualifications:**

* Inventory/warehousing experience in the cattle industry is strongly preferred
* Proficiency in computer applications, especially Excel, Word and ERP systems (Business Central experience is a plus)
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with strict attention to detail
* Ability to work well within a team and across multiple departments
* Ability to work an 8:00 AM to 5:00 schedule daily, with extended hours as needed to ensure timely cattle payment
* Fluent in English, with strong written and verbal communication skills
* Strong organizational skills, with the ability to handle stressful situations effectively
* Demonstrated problem-solving abilities and follow-up skills to ensure task completion
* Strong desire to set goals, meet deadlines, and efficiently manage tasks with attention to detail
* Excellent customer service skills with a professional demeanor

**Benefits:**

* Competitive wage based on a pay scale
* Health insurance
* Paid time off and holidays
* 401K with matching
* Opportunities for advancement within the company

**Compensation Transparency**

Compensation for this position is based on experience, skills, and qualifications and will be discussed during the hiring process.

**Equal Employment Opportunity & Affirmative Action Statement**

**Sustainable Beef is an Equal Opportunity Employer and federal contractor. We are committed to affirmative action and equal employment opportunity for all qualified applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.**

**Applicants have rights under Federal Employment Laws. For more information, please review the “EEO is the Law” poster and the Pay Transparency Nondiscrimination Provision.**

**Reasonable Accommodation Statement**

If you are an individual with a disability and require a reasonable accommodation to complete the application or hiring process, please contact Human Resources.

**Additional Compliance Statement**

Sustainable Beef reserves the right to modify, interpret, or apply this job description as business needs require. This job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or qualifications associated with the position. Compensation for this position is based on experience, skills, and qualifications and will be discussed during the hiring process.

description:
**Position Summary:** Coordinates inventory replenishment activities with suppliers, sales, logistics and operations for assigned categories.

**What you’ll do:**

* Place purchase orders with vendors utilizing an awareness of seasonal fluctuations, market effects and other information that require a high attention to detail to avoid spoilage, overstocks, and shortages.
* Manage and maintain the entire Purchase-to-Pay process, covering:

+ PO Creation.
+ Vendor Confirmation.
+ Accurate expected delivery date updates.
+ Collaboration with Accounts Payable to ensure payment.
* Maintain Purchasing system data to effectively generate suggested POs.
* Maintain necessary required vendor documents (electronic and physical), such as W-9’s, Indemnities, etc.
* Work closely with:

+ Vendors to ensure POs are filled and delivered in a timely fashion.
+ Vendors to manage FDA issues.
+ Logistics to minimize freight expenses.
+ Sales Managers to manage out-of-stock or over-stock risks.
+ Customer Service teams to enable sales order growth.
+ Buyers to build upon best-practices.
* Build and maintain vendor relationships to not only support PO fulfillment, but also negotiate volume discounts and price breaks wherever possible.
* Manage Fusion system issues that impact Purchasing and Receiving.
* Maintain BFC dating system to minimize close dated issues and Expired product impact.

**About you:**

* 5+ years buying experience with a focus on Specialty Food Products for a multi-unit Distribution Organization.
* Bachelor’s degree from accredited four-year college or university preferred.
* Previous food service distribution and/or food importing experience strongly preferred.
* Commodity product awareness including blanket commitments, contractual processes, and appropriate market tracking.
* Advanced Excel Skill and additional Computer skills (JDE, Microsoft Suite – Word and PowerPoint, etc.)
* Must have a sense of urgency and be able to work under pressure, be comfortable in a fast-paced, metrics-driven environment.
* Flexible with the ability to work well with all departments and levels of staff both internally & externally.
* Professional demeanor during all interactions with vendors, customers and fellow employees via phone or in-person.
* Have a drive to advance within the organization.
* Must be a team player with a positive attitude.
* Excellent verbal/written communication skills and a high level of analytical capabilities within Excel
* Self-starter, professional, goal oriented and able to handle multiple tasks.

**Full-time | On-site in Mid-Michigan | Operations | Reports to VP of Operations**

Compensation: $48,000–$60,000 annually, depending on experience and qualifications.

**About the opportunity**

Tumbl Trak, a manufacturer and distributor of gymnastics, cheer, and movement training equipment, is seeking an organized, analytical and collaborative Logistics & Purchasing Coordinator. This role connects freight coordination, administrative purchasing, supplier follow-up and ERP data accuracy. You will work closely with Operations, Warehouse, Sales and Customer Experience to keep shipments and purchasing information moving accurately and on time.

**What you will do**

* Coordinate inbound freight, outbound LTL quotes, ground shipments, brokers and carrier follow-up.
* Manage shipping claims, track recoveries, resolve discrepancies and audit freight invoices against quotes or agreed rates.
* Prepare and track supplier purchase orders; maintain vendor records, delivery dates and purchasing data in E-21.
* Track inbound containers, coordinate documentation and arrival updates, and enter container details in the ERP system.
* Keep Sales and Customer Experience informed when freight delays or exceptions affect customer orders.
* Support the VP of Operations with carrier/vendor relationships, cost monitoring and contract-related analysis.
* Help test, document and maintain E-21 MRP purchasing workflows; assist with data cleanup and process improvements.
* Maintain accurate problem logs, basic performance reports, custom SKU records as assigned and operating procedures.

What we are looking for

* Strong experience using ERP or comparable business systems, with the ability to learn new workflows and troubleshoot data discrepancies.
* Excellent analytical skills, attention to detail and comfort using Excel or Google Sheets to organize and interpret information.
* Clear, proactive written and verbal communication with coworkers, suppliers and carriers.
* Outstanding organization, prioritization and follow-through across multiple open issues.
* Experience in logistics, freight, purchasing administration, manufacturing or distribution is preferred.
* Familiarity with LTL freight, claims, container shipments or MRP is helpful, but not required.

**Why this role matters**

This role has a direct impact on freight costs, order reliability and process efficiency. We value someone who notices problems early, follows issues through resolution, and enjoys making systems work better.

Pay: $48,000.00 - $60,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Paid time off
* Professional development assistance
* Retirement plan

Education:

* Bachelor's (Required)

Experience:

* Logistics: 3 years (Required)

Work Location: In person

**Position****Description**
---------------------------

The Sourcing Buyer is responsible for the day-to-day execution of purchasing activities to ensure materials and services are ordered accurately and on time to support SPS production and project requirements. This position partners closely with Sourcing Analysts to execute purchasing strategies, maintain accurate purchase orders, obtain supplier acknowledgements, and resolve transactional issues throughout the purchasing process.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**
-----------------------------------------

Purchasing Order Execution

* Process RFQs, purchase orders, and supplier acknowledgements.
* Maintain accurate pricing, quantities, and delivery dates within the ERP system.
* Process purchasing changes related to ECNs, NCRs, and changing material requirements.
* Purchase indirect materials, MRO, logistics, and other business needs.
* Expedite orders as needed to support production schedules.

Supplier Transactional Support

* Communicate with suppliers regarding orders, deliveries, and purchasing issues.
* Resolve invoice, receiving, quality, and pricing discrepancies.
* Escalate material, delivery, or supplier concerns to the Sourcing Analyst.
* Partner with Sourcing Analysts to execute material and sourcing strategies.
* Follow established purchasing policies and processes.

Performs additional duties as assigned.

**Knowledge, Skills Abilities**
-------------------------------

**Required**

* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple purchasing priorities.
* High level of accuracy and attention to detail.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work effectively with suppliers and cross-functional internal teams.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and Outlook.
* Basic mathematical and analytical skills.
* Ability to learn and effectively utilize ERP/MRP systems.

**Preferred**

* Experience working in purchasing, supply chain, or a manufacturing environment.
* Ability to read and understand engineering documents and bills of material.
* Understanding of basic mechanical and electrical components.
* Experience working within an ERP/MRP system, preferably GSS.
* Experience resolving purchasing, invoice, or supplier discrepancies.

**Qualifications Experience**
-----------------------------

Associate or Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Operations Management, or a related field preferred. Previous purchasing, procurement, supply chain, or manufacturing experience preferred. Equivalent relevant work experience will be considered.

**Travel**
----------

Rare

**Physical Demands and Work Environment**
-----------------------------------------

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to stand; use hands to handle, or feel objects, tools, or controls; talk and hear. The employee regularly is required to walk and reach with hands. The employee is frequently required to sit and rarely required to climb or balance; and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. Employee uses computer keyboards often. The employee must regularly lift and/or move up to 10 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus. Employee views computer monitor often.
The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally exposed to moving mechanical parts. The employee is rarely exposed to airborne particles or chemical agents. The noise level in the work environment is usually low to moderate.

Switchgear Power Systems is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or national origin.

SPS is an equal opportunity employer.

**Buyer**
=========

**MSHS Pacific Power Group**
**Location:** Fort Lauderdale, FL
**Job Type:** Full-Time
**Salary:** $75,000 - $83,000 per year, based on experience
**Travel:** Up to 25%

**Build Smarter Supply Chains That Drive Real Business Impact**

This is not a transactional buying role. This is about owning sourcing strategy, improving supplier performance, and making decisions that directly impact cost, delivery, and revenue execution.

If you’re someone who thrives in fast-moving environments, enjoys negotiating and solving supply challenges, and wants to play a key role in scaling procurement operations, this is your seat at the table.

**About the Role**

The Buyer is responsible for managing sourcing activities across key categories, supporting RFQs, supplier negotiations, and vendor performance. You’ll work closely with Sales, Operations, and Finance to ensure materials and services are sourced efficiently, competitively, and reliably.

This role requires strong commercial judgment, urgency, and the ability to balance cost, lead time, and operational impact. You’ll help move the team from reactive purchasing to proactive, strategic sourcing.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage end-to-end sourcing activities including RFQs, supplier selection, and negotiations
* Evaluate suppliers across cost, quality, delivery, and performance metrics
* Develop and maintain relationships with OEM, OE, aftermarket, and remanufactured part suppliers
* Identify and qualify alternative suppliers to reduce risk and improve supply continuity
* Negotiate pricing, terms, and agreements to improve margin and supplier performance
* Partner cross-functionally with Sales, Operations, and Finance to align sourcing priorities
* Monitor supplier performance and drive accountability for on-time delivery and quality
* Support category management and sourcing strategies for key spend areas
* Analyze sourcing data and provide insights to support decision-making
* Proactively identify risks related to lead times, single-source dependencies, and supply constraints

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Business, or related field preferred; equivalent experience accepted
* 3+ years of experience in sourcing, procurement, or supply chain roles
* Strong commercial acumen with the ability to balance cost, lead time, and business impact
* Experience managing RFQs and supplier negotiations
* Proven ability to identify and develop alternative sourcing strategies
* Strong negotiation skills with measurable impact on pricing and supplier performance
* Experience managing supplier relationships and performance metrics
* Strong problem-solving skills in fast-paced, non-standard environments
* Proficiency in Excel; experience with ERP systems (Infor SyteLine or similar is a plus)
* Ability to work cross-functionally and influence stakeholders

**Desired Skills**

* Experience in marine, power generation, or industrial MRO environments
* Experience sourcing OEM, OE/OES, aftermarket, or remanufactured components
* Experience managing complex RFQs for engineered or technical components
* Exposure to supplier performance management frameworks (KPIs, scorecards)
* Experience conducting supplier business reviews and driving corrective actions
* Familiarity with Power BI or advanced data analysis tools

**Why Join MSHS Pacific Power Group?**

MSHS Pacific Power Group is scaling rapidly across marine, energy, and industrial markets. This role directly impacts how we source, negotiate, and deliver critical components that keep operations running.

You’ll be part of a team that values accountability, speed, and smart decision-making. If you want to move beyond transactional purchasing and into true strategic sourcing, this is where you make that jump.

**Benefits Include**

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid time off and holidays
* Company-paid life and disability insurance
* Tuition reimbursement and professional development
* Growth opportunities within a scaling organization

**Take Ownership of Strategic Sourcing**

Apply now to help drive smarter procurement decisions, strengthen supplier partnerships, and support operational performance across the business.

description:
**TOWN OF NEW CANAAN**

**Purchasing Agent**

The Town of New Canaan is seeking applicants for the position of Purchasing Agent. Under the direction of the Chief Financial Officer, the Purchasing Agent is responsible for administering the Town of New Canaan’s purchasing and procurement functions in accordance with Town.

The Purchasing Agent serves as the primary resource for Town departments on purchasing and procurement matters and works closely with department heads, Finance staff, Town officials, vendors, and contractors to ensure that purchases are conducted in a fair, competitive, transparent, efficient, and fiscally responsible manner. Essential job functions include administering the Town’s centralized purchasing and procurement process and providing guidance to departments regarding purchasing policies and procedures, reviewing requisitions and purchase requests for appropriate approvals, funding, documentation, and compliance with Town requirements, coordinating competitive purchasing, including informal quotations, formal bids, requests for proposals (RFPs), requests for qualifications (RFQs), and other procurement methods, assisting departments in developing specifications, scopes of work, bid documents, and procurement schedules, and coordinating bid advertisements, bid openings, evaluations, tabulations, and award documentation as well as other associated responsibilities.

This position works with the Chief Financial Officer, Town Attorney, department heads, and appropriate Town officials on procurement awards and contracts.

Minimum required qualifications include Bachelor’s degree in business administration, public administration, finance, accounting, supply chain management, or a related field and three years of progressively responsible purchasing or procurement experience. Municipal or public-sector procurement experience is preferred. CPPB or CPPO is desired.

An equivalent combination of education, training, and experience may be considered.

Salary range $107,924 - $116,223 dependent on qualifications and years of experience. Background investigation and pre-employment physical required. Equal opportunity employer M/F/D/V. Position will be filled as soon as a qualified candidate is selected. Complete the online application which can be found at www.newcanaan.info under Job Opportunities. Click on Purchasing Agent and attach a cover letter and resume with at least three references. The position will be filled as soon as a qualified candidate is selected.
