Description:

Join the Malarkey team, innovators in roofing technology with pioneering rubberized asphalt shingles designed for superior durability and sustainability. At Malarkey, we take pride in our most important asset - our employees.

We’re seeking a Plant Buyer who's ready to be part of our mission to manufacture and deliver innovative, performance-driven building products with unmatched service and integrity. Our focus is creating longer-lasting, environmentally responsible roofing solutions that can withstand all weather conditions.

**Job Title:** Plant Buyer| **Req ID:** 18284 | **HR Contact:** Elizabeth Bertapelle| **Location:** Building Envelope - South Gate, CA

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

The Plant Buyer is responsible for supporting the day-to-day purchasing needs of the manufacturing facility, with primary responsibility for indirect spending, Maintenance, Repair and Operations (MRO) materials, and plant services. This position ensures the plant has the materials, parts, supplies, equipment, and services needed to operate safely, reliably, and efficiently while maintaining appropriate cost, quality, service, and inventory controls.

**WHAT YOU'LL ACCOMPLISH**

* Manage purchasing activities for plant indirect spend, including MRO parts and supplies, tools, safety supplies, operating consumables, equipment, and contracted services.
* Partner with Maintenance, Operations, and storeroom personnel to understand routine, planned, emergency, and shutdown requirements and ensure necessary materials and services are available to support plant operations, including inventory and critical spare parts.
* Process purchase requisitions and purchase orders accurately and timely in accordance with company procurement policies, approval requirements, delegated authority, and established financial controls.
* Source and evaluate suppliers based on cost, quality, availability, lead time, service, and overall value; obtain competitive quotes and negotiate pricing, terms, delivery expectations, and service requirements within established authority levels.
* Procure and coordinate plant services, including maintenance and repair services, equipment servicing, facilities support, contractors, rentals, and other operational services.
* Develop and maintain effective supplier relationships, monitor supplier performance, and address issues related to delivery, pricing, quality, availability, and service.
* Monitor open purchase orders, backorders, lead times, and critical deliveries; proactively identify and communicate potential supply disruptions and coordinate resolution with suppliers and plant stakeholders.
* Analyze purchasing and spending data to identify cost savings, supplier consolidation, preferred-supplier utilization, process improvements, and unmanaged or noncompliant spend.
* Partner with Accounts Payable, Finance, and internal stakeholders to resolve invoice, pricing, receiving, and other procure-to-pay discrepancies.
* Demonstrate a commitment to communicating, improving, and adhering to health, safety, and environmental policies in all work environments and areas. Promote a culture of safety and exhibit these behaviors.

**WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR**

**Education:** Bachelor’s degree

**Field of Study Preferred:** Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Operations, Finance, or a related field

**Required Work Experience:** Two to five years of purchasing, procurement, supply chain, MRO, maintenance planning, inventory, or related manufacturing experience

**Travel Requirements:** NA

**Additional Requirements:**

* Experience in purchasing indirect materials and services within a manufacturing or industrial environment
* Successful candidates must adhere to all safety protocols and proper use of Amrize-approved Personal Protection Equipment (PPE), including but not limited to respirators. Employees who are required to wear respirators must be clean-shaven where the respirator seal meets

**What we do here changes the world.** UTHealth Houston is Texas’ resource for healthcare education, innovation, scientific discovery, and excellence in patient care. That’s where you come in.

**The Buyer I s****upports procurement operations by processing requisitions for goods and services, sourcing and evaluating vendors, and managing purchase orders. Ensures compliance with purchasing policies and procedures, administers departmental Procurement Card activities, handles receiving and delivery functions, maintains audit documentation, prepares purchasing reports, and provides customer support throughout the procurement process.**

**Once you join us you won't want to leave.** It’s because we reward our team for the excellent service they provide. Our total rewards package includes the benefits you’d expect from a top healthcare organization (benefits, insurance, etc.), plus:

* 100% paid medical premiums for our full-time employees
* Generous time off (holidays, preventative leave day, both vacation and sick time – all of which equates to around 37-38 days per year)
* The longer you stay, the more vacation you’ll accrue!
* Longevity Pay (Monthly payments after two years of service)
* Build your future with our awesome retirement/pension plan!

**We take care of our employees!** As a world-renowned institution, our employees’ wellbeing is important to us. We offer work/life services such as...

* Free financial and legal counseling
* Free mental health counseling services
* Gym membership discounts and access to wellness programs
* Other employee discounts including entertainment, car rentals, cell phones, etc.
* Resources for child and elder care
* Plus many more!

**Position Summary:**

Prepares and executes requisitions for various, commodities and services under guidelines established by federal, state, and local requirements.

**Position Key Accountabilities:**

* Executes requisitions of goods and services from suppliers.
* Researches and evaluates vendor quotes to qualify commodity suppliers. Identifies qualified suppliers of commodities pursuant to agency needs.
* Monitors and reports purchase order status through the use of various automated systems.
* Interacts regularly with customers to ensure all purchasing policies and procedures are followed.
* Administers University Procurement Card within the assigned department(s) to include; placing orders, reconciliation of orders and adherence to Procurement Card policy and procedures.
* Performs receiving function for desk top delivery within assigned department(s).
* Maintains appropriate documentation for audit purposes.
* Prepares reports on a routine and ad-hoc basis to provide information regarding purchase order activities.
* Performs other duties as assigned.

**Certification/Skills:**

* Excellent communication skills both verbal and written.
* Microsoft Office literate.
* Manages Human Resources activities of department in regards to: recruiting and selection, hiring and termination, training, professional development, mentoring, counseling, performance evaluations, and salary planning.
* Basic Texas Purchaser by Texas Comptroller of Public Accounts preferred

**Minimum Education:**

High School Diploma or equivalent required

**Minimum Experience:**

1 year of buying experience preferred in Higher Education or State of Texas Institution preferred May substitute required experience with equivalent years of education beyond the minimum education requirement.

**Physical Requirements:**

Exerts up to 20 pounds of force occasionally and/or up to 10 pounds frequently and/or a negligible amount constantly to move objects.

**Security Sensitive:**

This position is a security-sensitive position pursuant to Texas Education Code §51.215 and Texas Government Code §411.094. To the extent that a position requires the holder to research, work on, or have access to critical infrastructure as defined in Texas Business and Commerce Code §117.001(2), the ability to maintain the security or integrity of the infrastructure is a minimum qualification to be hired for and to continue to be employed in that position. Personnel in such positions, and similarly situated state contractors, will be routinely reviewed to determine whether things such as criminal history or continuous connections to the government or political apparatus of a foreign adversary might prevent the applicant, employee, or contractor from being able to maintain the security or integrity of the infrastructure. A foreign adversary is a nation listed in 15 C.F.R. §791.4.

**Residency Requirement:**

Employees must permanently reside and work in the State of Texas.

Description:

The Buyer is responsible for the purchase of raw materials and services in support of the manufacturing operation. Employees in this position should be adaptable, enthusiastic for change, and data oriented. Communication skills and self-direction are required, as is a high commitment to cost and inventory management.

**Main Responsibilities**

* Procure materials, parts, and supplies in a cost-effective and timely manner while ensuring compliance with quality standards and specifications.
* Prepare and issue purchase orders in alignment with negotiated contracts and company policies.
* Evaluate supplier quotations to ensure the best overall cost while maintaining quality and delivery standards.
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with key suppliers to drive continuous improvement and cost savings.
* Collaborate with internal departments to improve quality, reduce costs, and optimize inventory levels.
* Work closely with the finance department to ensure accurate and timely invoice payments.
* Utilize procurement tools and strategies to minimize total purchasing costs while maintaining operational efficiency.
* Resolve defective material issues by collaborating with users, vendors, and customers, including handling DMRs (Defective Material Reports).
* Work with suppliers to process RMA (Return Material Authorization) requests related to incoming quality issues.

Requirements:

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in business, supply chain management, engineering or equivalent degree.
* 3-5 years of experience in purchasing, inventory control, or supply chain management may be considered in lieu of a degree.
* Strong knowledge of purchasing procedures for raw materials and an understanding of total product cost concepts.
* Experience managing inventory levels and implementing cost-control strategies.
* Familiarity with Lean Manufacturing principles and Kanban systems.
* Proven contract negotiation skills with an ability to secure favorable terms.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook).
* Experience with SAP or other ERP/MRP systems.
* Knowledge of UL and ISO-9000 quality standards.

description:
Meyer Utility Structures is currently looking to hire a results-driven individual to join our team as a Buyer for our plant operation located in Clinton, IL. Reporting to the Materials Manager, the Buyer will support the facility and play a critical part in managing supply chain and logistics activities to include procurement, inventory management, production planning, vendor coordination, and material movement. We’re looking for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment and can drive improvement through data, communication, and operational excellence.

Meyer Utility Structures is a proud subsidiary of the infrastructure company, Arcosa, Inc. We commit to and pride ourselves on providing reliable structures, superior service, and product solutions. Meyer Utility Structures is an industry leader in the engineering design and fabrication of concrete and tubular steel structures for transmission, distribution, and substation applications.

**What You’ll Do:**

* Manage procurement, production planning, inventory control, outsourcing, vendor selection, and distribution functions

* Monitor and maintain the Estimated Checkbook daily as a purchasing guide

* Ensure timely delivery of MRO (Maintenance, Repair & Operations) and core spend items to support equipment and facility needs

* Use Material Requirement Planning reports and historical purchasing data to estimate future requirements

* Negotiate favorable terms, volume discounts, and long-term contracts with vendors

* Prepare and process purchase orders for external customers and internal use

* Investigate and resolve billing discrepancies related to Accounts Payable

* Plan and monitor inbound material movement from suppliers

* Align purchase requisitions with maintenance requirements

* Ensure proper PO and receipt recordkeeping is consistent with Arcosa policy

* Collaborate closely with internal teams and external partners

* Manage Purchase Credit Card transactions and submit monthly reports

* Respond quickly to urgent purchasing needs under high-pressure situations

* Other duties as assigned

**What You’ll Need:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience and at least 3 years prior relevant experience

* MRO procurement experience required

* 3 years of experience in heavy industrial manufacturing preferred

* APICS certification preferred

* Intermediate to advanced proficiency in computer applications – Excel, Word and ERP systems

* Strong organizational and multitasking abilities

* Clear and effective written and verbal communication skills

* Ability to interact across all levels of the organization

**Compensation and Benefits:**

Arcosa is proud to offer competitive benefits and programs to help you and your family meet your healthcare and retirement planning needs. The various benefits offered to employees based on eligibility may include:

* Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance

* Paid vacation and sick time

* 401k with Employer Match

* 11 paid Company holidays

* Life Insurance

* Short-Term and Long-Term Disability Insurance

* Tuition reimbursement

* Health & Wellness Programs

* Flexible Spending Accounts

* Employee Discount Programs

* Professional Training and Development Programs

* Career Advancement Opportunities – We like to promote from within!

* Salary commensurate with experience – $50,000 to $68,000

**Overview**: The Buyer is responsible for the procurement of either raw goods or components for Operations through qualified vendors. Participates in forecasting efforts, manage and measure performance of current vendors, assist in new vendor qualifications, and facilitate new product introductions into Operations. **This position will be located in person, onsite at our Alexandria, MN location**. FORCE America, Inc. provides competitive wages and excellent benefits in our 100% employee-owned company. Come join a Company you can call your own..

**Essential Responsibilities**:

* Review and analyze current product demands for Operations.
* Issue purchase and transfer orders to meet customer needs, including expediting product.
* Confer with vendors to obtain product information such as pricing, availability and delivery schedules.
* Create and maintain item master records with accurate information for MRP processing.
* Facilitate material cost reduction initiatives.
* Maintain vendor relationships and track vendor metrics including quality and delivery.
* Analyze surplus inventory and identify inventory reduction opportunities.
* Participate in cross functional teams including Engineering, Accounting, Sales, Operations and Marketing.
* Other responsibilities, as assigned.

**Minimum Qualifications**:

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration or Supply Chain or other related business disciplines or equivalent combination of years of experience and education.
* Strong experience in Microsoft office including Outlook, Excel, Word.
* Experience in Microsoft Dynamics preferred.
* Attention to detail oriented.
* Strong analytical ability.
* Strong communication skills.
* Strong organizational skills, timely, and the ability to prioritize.
* Demonstrated problem solving and decision making skills.
* Good understanding of the S&OP process.
* Enthusiastic attitude with good listening skills.

* Work is primarily sedentary in nature. Some physical requirements include sitting, walking, standing, bending, squatting, twisting, lifting, grasping, etc.

* 100% Employee Owned - ESOP
* Health Insurance (3 plan options)
* 401(k) plan plus Employer 401(k) Matching

* Paid time off
* Paid Holidays
* Education Reimbursement Program

* Life Insurance
* And more!

description:
The Purchasing Agent is responsible for procuring the raw materials, components, supplies, equipment, and services required to support ETI Precision's manufacturing operations and calibration laboratories.

This position manages purchasing activities from supplier sourcing and quotation through purchase order issuance, order follow-up, delivery, and resolution of purchasing-related issues. The Purchasing Agent works with internal departments and suppliers to ensure materials and services are available when needed and meet established requirements for quality, cost, delivery, and documentation.

The position also supports purchasing requirements for ETI Precision's calibration laboratory operations in Frederick, Maryland; Roanoke, Texas; and the Huntersville, North Carolina area.

### **Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

Procure raw materials, components, finished goods, equipment, supplies, consumables, and services required to support ETI Precision's manufacturing and calibration laboratory operations.

Review inventory levels, production requirements, forecasts, open orders, lead times, and operational priorities to determine purchasing needs and timing.

Prepare, issue, and maintain accurate purchase orders, including specifications, quantities, pricing, delivery requirements, shipping instructions, and applicable quality or documentation requirements.

Obtain and evaluate supplier quotations and negotiate pricing, lead times, payment terms, and other commercial conditions.

Monitor open purchase orders and proactively follow up, expedite, reschedule, or resolve issues that may affect production, laboratory operations, or customer commitments.

Source and evaluate new or alternate suppliers and materials, monitor supplier performance, and address quality, delivery, responsiveness, lead-time, and cost issues to ensure continuity of supply and reduce supply-chain risk.

Ensure purchased materials and services meet applicable technical, quality, traceability, certification, and documentation requirements.

Maintain accurate procurement records, including supplier, item, pricing, lead-time, purchase order, and supporting documentation, within the company's ERP or purchasing system to meet company, customer, quality, and accreditation requirements.

Resolve purchasing-related issues involving shortages, receiving discrepancies, rejected or damaged materials, invoice variances, returns, credits, and supplier performance.

Maintain professional and ethical relationships with suppliers and protect confidential company, customer, supplier, pricing, and technical information.

Perform other related duties and special projects as assigned.

### **Required Qualifications:**

Associate degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, Operations, Engineering Technology, or a related field; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.

Minimum of three years of experience in purchasing, procurement, materials management, supply chain, or a related field, preferably in a manufacturing, technical-service, calibration, or quality-regulated environment.

Demonstrated experience preparing and managing purchase orders and working directly with suppliers.

Ability to read and understand product specifications, bills of material, technical requirements, and supplier quotations.

Strong organizational, analytical, negotiation, and problem-solving skills.

Ability to manage multiple priorities and respond effectively to changing operational requirements and material shortages.

Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Proficiency with ERP or MRP systems and Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, Outlook, and Word.

High level of accuracy and attention to detail.

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, Operations, Engineering, or a related field.

Purchasing experience involving metals, electronic or electromechanical components, machined parts, chemicals, packaging, or other technical materials.

Experience supporting calibration laboratories, testing laboratories, or technical-service operations.

Familiarity with ISO 9001, ISO/IEC 17025, or similar quality-management and laboratory accreditation requirements.

Experience with supplier qualification, supplier performance management, corrective actions, or audit support.

Professional certification such as CPSM, CPIM, CSCP, or equivalent.

Experience supporting purchasing activities across multiple locations.

### **Physical and Work Requirements:**

Ability to work at a computer and communicate by telephone, email, and virtual meeting for extended periods.

Ability to work in and around warehouse, production, and laboratory environments as needed to review materials, packaging, labels, documentation, and receiving issues.

Ability to occasionally lift or move items weighing up to 50 pounds, with or without reasonable accommodation.

Occasional travel to ETI Precision facilities, suppliers, or other

description:
Thuma is seeking a commercially minded Buyer with exceptional taste and strong analytical instincts to help shape our expanding assortment. You will own assortment strategy and business performance for your assigned product areas, translating customer insights, market opportunities, and Thuma’s design point of view into compelling products and profitable growth.

Working closely with Merchandising leadership, Design, Product Development, Sourcing, and Inventory Planning, you will bring a clear merchant perspective from initial concept through launch and ongoing performance. The right person balances creative judgment with financial discipline and moves comfortably between strategy and hands on execution.

Thuma’s Headquarters is based in the historic Presidio neighborhood of San Francisco. This is a hybrid role that will be in office 3 - 5 days a week.

### **You Will**

**Assortment Strategy and Product Direction**

* Develop assortment plans for assigned product areas, identifying opportunities for newness, expansion, refinement, and discontinuation.
* Use customer feedback, competitive research, and business performance to recommend clear product priorities that support Thuma’s roadmap and create Oasis.
* Define commercial product briefs, including customer needs, assortment positioning, target retail prices, and margin goals; partner with Design, Product Development, and Sourcing to bring them to life.

**Business Performance and Inventory Partnership**

* Own the commercial performance of assigned product areas against agreed sales and margin goals; review results regularly and recommend specific actions.
* Partner with Inventory Planning on forecasts, open to buy, initial buys, replenishment, and product exits, balancing availability with inventory productivity.
* Recommend pricing and lifecycle decisions using product costs, competitive positioning, customer value, and financial performance.

**Product Development and Launch Execution**

* Represent the merchant perspective in product and sample reviews, balancing design, quality, customer needs, and unit economics.
* Maintain clear assortment priorities and commercial decisions in partnership with Product Development and Sourcing; surface risks and tradeoffs early.
* Own merchandising readiness for launches, including assortment details, pricing, product information, and selling stories; align timing with inventory availability and channel readiness.

**Product Storytelling and Presentation**

* Partner with Brand, Creative, Digital, Retail, and Visual Merchandising to translate product intent into clear, compelling customer experiences.
* Ensure product information, imagery, copy, and presentation accurately communicate design, materials, function, quality, and value.
* Use feedback from stores and Customer Experience to improve assortments, product information, and future development.

### **This Might Describe You**

* 5 or more years of buying or merchandising experience, preferably within home or a design led consumer business, with a record of growing sales and profitability.
* An excellent eye for design, materials, quality, and proportion, with the judgment to distinguish lasting opportunities from short term trends.
* Strong command of assortment planning, pricing, margin, forecasting, open to buy, and inventory productivity.
* Experience partnering with Design, Product Development, and Sourcing to take products from concept to launch.
* Strong analytical skills and proficiency with spreadsheets and business reporting tools; ability to turn data into clear recommendations.
* Clear communication, disciplined organization, and the ability to build alignment across teams.
* An accountable, collaborative approach, with the confidence to bring a point of view and the flexibility to adjust as new information emerges.

### **What Success Looks Like**

* Assigned product areas deliver agreed sales and margin goals.
* Assortment decisions strengthen Thuma’s design point of view and respond to meaningful customer needs.
* Forecasts and buying decisions improve availability and inventory productivity in partnership with Planning.
* Product launches are commercially prepared and executed with accurate information and clear storytelling.
* Performance insights translate into timely, measurable improvements.

### **Why Join Us**

* **401(k)**: Participation in our 401(k) program with company matching up to 6% of your contributions.
* **Benefits\\***: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage with generous employer contributions, 100% paid parental leave, and company-sponsored One Medical and WellHub memberships.
* **Equity**: Participation in employee stock option plan.
* **Flexible by Design**: We operate with a high-performance mindset, paired with thoughtful flexibility—flexible hours, flexible PTO, and a hybrid approach that supports both focus and balance.
* **Time to Recharge**: Enjoy 13 company holidays each year to rest, reset, and celebr

description:
This is an excellent opportunity for a purchasing professional who enjoys working in a fast-paced manufacturing environment and wants direct involvement in projects from initial sourcing and supplier selection through **SOP and production ramp-up**.

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**

As Project Buyer, you will manage purchasing activities for assigned projects while ensuring **Quality, Cost and Delivery (QCD)** objectives are achieved.

**You will:**

* Serve as the primary **Purchasing representative within assigned Project Teams**.
* Take responsibility for the **Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) of the BOM** while achieving established QCD objectives.
* Launch and manage **RFQ processes** with approved suppliers based on purchasing and commodity strategies.
* Source and negotiate requirements related to **production components, prototypes, tooling and equipment**.
* Evaluate supplier proposals and support supplier selection through established **Sourcing Committee processes**.
* Negotiate commercial terms, pricing, contracts and supplier agreements within established corporate guidelines.
* Partner with the **Commodity Lead Buyer** to execute commodity purchasing strategies aligned with broader Group Purchasing objectives.
* Manage supplier relationships and support ongoing **supply-base management** activities.
* Work closely with Project Management, Engineering, Quality, Industrialization and other cross-functional stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.
* Collaborate with **mass-production buyers** to ensure successful transition through SOP and production ramp-up.
* Partner with Product Quality Engineering (PQE) and Industrialization Engineering to ensure purchasing activities comply with established processes and requirements.
* Monitor purchasing performance against project objectives and provide regular reporting to leadership.
* Identify deviations from **Quality, Cost and Delivery targets**, escalate concerns appropriately, and implement corrective action plans.
* Support purchasing methodologies including **design-to-manufacturing, cost-to-design, sourcing, negotiation and ongoing commercial management**.
* Ensure purchasing activities comply with established Group policies, procedures and authorization requirements.

**WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR**

We are looking for a commercially minded purchasing professional who understands how Purchasing contributes to the successful execution of manufacturing projects.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree with a minimum of **3 years of Purchasing experience**, or significant relevant experience within a manufacturing environment.
* Experience supporting **project purchasing, sourcing, procurement or supplier management** within manufacturing.
* Knowledge of purchasing processes including **RFQs, supplier sourcing, negotiation, contract management and commercial follow-up**.
* Experience with **supply-base management** and supplier selection.
* Understanding of **Total Cost of Ownership, BOM costing and QCD/QCDP principles**.
* Knowledge of project management principles and experience working within cross-functional project teams.
* Financial and cash-management knowledge.
* Proficiency with **SAP and Microsoft Office**.
* Fluent English required; additional languages relevant to the geographic scope of the position are considered an asset.
* Ability and willingness to **travel internationally** as required.

**THE IDEAL CANDIDATE**

The ideal candidate is a **hands-on Project Buyer who understands both the commercial and operational sides of manufacturing purchasing**.

You are comfortable launching an RFQ, analyzing supplier proposals, negotiating commercial terms, managing supplier relationships and working alongside Engineering, Quality, Industrialization and Project Management to keep a program on track.

You are organized, autonomous and capable of managing multiple priorities while maintaining a strong **QCDP – Quality, Cost, Delivery and Performance mindset**. You communicate effectively, build strong internal and external relationships, and have the perseverance to resolve supplier and project challenges when they arise.

* Relocation assistance

Overview:

**Job Title: Buyer**

**Job Location: Torrance, CA**

**Salary: $70,000-$85,000/yr DOE**

Stellant Systems, a premier manufacturer of critical power amplification products where our technologies and products are unparalleled in the industry. We specialize in the manufacture of microwave devices for ground-based, airborne and satellite communications, industrial and medical equipment, and radar; we are the only U.S. supplier of space-qualified Traveling Wave Tube and Traveling Wave Tube Amplifiers. We combine cutting-edge technology with world-class engineering teams to deliver innovative solutions. Together, we form an invincible company.

As an employer of choice, our goal is to deliver an exceptional employee experience - we recruit diverse, high-performing talent to help our customers exceed their mission needs, which drives our employees to achieve their full potential.

Fundamental to our culture is our focus on core values, inclusivity in the work environment, and a unified dedication to continuous innovation and improvement. In order to serve our vast customer base ranging from the defense industry leaders, to the U.S. and allied militaries, and medical communities, we need the world’s most dedicated and talented people. If these types of projects excite you, we’d love for you to join our team and help us detect, protect, and connect.

Responsibilities:

* Compiles and analyzes statistical data to determine feasibility of buying products and to establish price objectives.
* Approves and qualifies vendors, obtains quotes, examines bids and makes awards
* Follows up on all awards through completion of order
* Negotiates with suppliers and analyzes suppliers’ operations to determine factors that affect prices and to determine lowest cost consistent with quality, reliability, and ability to meet required schedules
* Reviews proposals, negotiates prices, selects, or recommends suppliers, analyzes trends, and maintains necessary records
* Prepares request for proposals (RFP) and bid packages
* Negotiates and settles with suppliers regarding damage claims, rejections, losses, return of materials, over-shipments, cancellations, and engineering changes, within their signature authority
* Obtains quotes, negotiate, and procure materials and services for the best value
* Prepares required paperwork for Purchase Order package, shippers, RFPs/RFQs, supplier and interdepartmental correspondence, etc.
* Verifies accuracy of all documentation such as supplier proposals to purchase orders, file documentation, invoices and receipts, and sign purchase orders
* Interfaces with current and potential suppliers to determine best price and delivery for current requirements and remains abreast of economic and business situations relating to procurement activity
* Maintains total ownership of supplier’s deliveries. Actions taken could include obtaining prints, samples, delivery dates, corrective action, and resolution to discrepant materials. Will likely involve negotiating with supplier when supplier caused rework occurs
* Processes rejected materials back to supplier in a timely manner after receipt of dispositioned NMR.
* Develops new vendors and participates with Engineering in the evaluation and selection of alternate source of supply in accordance with internal policies and procedures
* Responsible for reporting accurate and up to date information both in MRP and in production team meetings. Due to working in a lean production environment, the buyer shall strive to meet a performance metric of 100% current data in both MRP and in shortage reporting in accordance with company procedures
* Interfaces with Engineering and Planning regarding drawing discrepancies, B.O.M., and EO’s. Works with Program Managers on problems which affect meeting contract requirements
* Makes periodic visits to manufacturers and suppliers to ensure that procurement standards are being maintained
* Conducts desk audits on a weekly basis to determine if their desk “queue” is meeting company standards of placing requisitions, updating purchase orders, processing RTVs, invoice resolution, and tracking to completion to avoid delivery impact, and ensure suppliers are meeting current quality acceptance and on time delivery goals
* Other assignments as identified by the Procurement Manager

Qualifications:

**For** **Associate, Procurement (Level 1)**

* Bachelor's degree and 0-2 years of related experience, Master's degree, OR 3 years of experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
* Strong communication skills
* Demonstrated teamwork orientation
* Strong organizational skills
* Excel and other technical skills that help identify areas for supplier performance improvement
* Ability to work in a very fast paced environment

**For** **Sr. Associate, Procurement (Level 2)**

* Bachelor's degree and at least 2 years of related experience, a Master's degree OR 6 years of experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.

description:
#### **Summary**

Responsible for the purchase of multiple commodities including raw materials, machined components, outside processing, and support services. Responsible for negotiating with manufacturers or service providers on prices and deliver dates to make sure they are in line with company goals and needs.

#### **Job Duties and Responsibilities**

Other tasks and duties may be required as directed.

* Create purchase orders (POs) for Raw material, Machined parts, Purchased parts and OSP Processes.
* Create Request for Quote (RFQ) for Raw material, Machined parts, Purchased parts and OSP Processes.
* Use discretion and independent judgment to procure components, materials and equipment that meet demand while making decisions on economic order quantities factoring in considerations such as price, delivery costs, demand levels, timing, market trends and potential for design changes/obsolescence.
* Align product deliveries to minimize inventory while ensuring that production and service needs are being met.
* Assess financial and schedule risks in order to recommend volume buys, etc.
* Review key purchasing drivers (lead time, safety stock, lot size) and identify areas where drivers need to be adjusted to ensure it meets the current needs of the business.
* Using quantitative skills/methods to analyze components/raw materials costs.
* Perform variance analyses for price changes.
* Monitor delinquent PO reports and Reschedule reports to ensure delivery needs are met.
* Follow up with suppliers on delivery of orders and manage change issues as they occur.
* Assist reconciling open PO report for accuracy, past due items, and work with accounting regarding invoicing discrepancies.
* Maintain suppliers’ manufacturing schedules to support in-house production.

#### **Qualification Requirements**

* **Education/Experience**
+ Bachelor’s Degree (B.A. or B.S.) from four-year college or university; or two to four years’ experience and/or training in a related field; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* **Language Skills**
+ Good command of the English language, both written and spoken.
+ Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals.
+ Ability to read, analyze, and interpret general business periodicals, professional journals, technical procedures, or governmental regulations.
+ Ability to write routine reports and correspondence.
+ Ability to speak effectively before small groups of customers or employees.
* **Math Skills**
+ Must have the ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals. Must be capable to compute rate, ratio, and percent and to draw and interpret bar graphs.
+ Must be capable to calculate figures and amounts, such as, discounts, interest, commissions, proportions, percentages, area, circumference, and volume.
+ Must have the ability to apply concepts of basic algebra and geometry.
* **Reasoning Skills**
+ Must have the ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions. Must be capable to interpret an extensive variety of technical instructions, such as, mathematical, and/or diagram form, and deal with several abstract and concrete variables.
* **Computer/ Office Skills**
+ Basic windows/internet browser
+ ERP/Inventory
+ Microsoft Office – Excel, Word, Power Point
+ Typing
+ 10-key
+ Blueprint Reading
+ Strong knowledge of raw materials
+ Mil standards, processing specifications

#### **Physical Demands and Work Environment**

* **Physical Demands**
+ Frequent Activities: Sitting, typing, handling objects, reaching, talking/hearing, lifting/pushing/pulling up to 10 lbs.
+ Occasional activities: Standing, walking, , lifting/pushing/pulling up to 25 lbs
+ Rare activities: Climbing/balancing, stooping, kneeling, crouching, lifting/pushing/pulling heavy weights (50–100+ lbs)
* **Vision Requirements**
+ Frequent: Close vision and computer work
+ Occasional: Ability to adjust focus and color vision
+ Rare: Distance vision, depth perception, peripheral vision
* **Work Environment**
+ Frequent exposure: Quiet noise conditions
+ Occasional exposure: Mechanical parts, fumes, airborne particles, toxic chemicals, and moderate-to-loud noise.
+ Rare exposure: High places, outdoor weather, electrical shock, and vibrations, and very quiet or very loud noise levels.

#### **About Crissair, Inc.**

Since 1954, Crissair has manufactured high-quality precision components for nearly every airframe manufacturer and major subcontractor in the industry for both military and commercial aircraft. Crissair’s primary objective is designing, developing and manufacturing superior quality hydraulic, fuel and pneumatic system components of all complexity levels. Strict design specifications and rigorous quality criteria are the essential factors in Criss

description:
**Job Summary**
Spence Hardware is seeking a Full-Time dynamic and motivated Buyer for our Apparel, Boot, and Toy Department at our Farm and Ranch Hardware Store. As our Apparel Buyer and Department Lead, you'll be in charge of selecting and ordering clothing, outerwear, shoes/boots, and toys to fit our store's style. You'll need to be a bit of a detective, always on the lookout for the hottest new trends and the best deals from our suppliers. The ideal candidate has a knack for style and knows how to put together an outfit that makes our customers feel like a million bucks. But, it's not just about the clothes. You'll also be leading a small team of folks who keep the apparel department looking sharp and help customers find exactly what they are looking for. This is a lead management position with performance bonuses.

**Responsibilities**

* Lead and supervise the department team, providing guidance and support to enhance performance and productivity.
* Negotiate effectively with vendors and partners to optimize product offerings and pricing strategies.
* Stay abreast of the latest trends through industry reports, social media, and trade shows
* Seek out new suppliers and build relationships
* Review and evaluate the current offerings available from suppliers
* Determine which goods to purchase and in what quantities to ensure products remain in stock at all times
* Create purchase orders and work with our Freight and Receiving Department Lead
* Coordinate and place special order purchases when applicable
* Negotiate purchase terms with suppliers
* Analyze inventory data to identify strong and weak sellers
* Generate reports and forecasts
* Manage inventory, including backstock areas
* Assist with marketing and merchandising of the department to display and promote items

**Qualifications**

* Proven experience in retail management or a similar leadership role is required.
* Excellent negotiation skills with the ability to influence outcomes positively.
* Proficient in supervising teams, with a track record of achieving sales targets.
* Experience in cash handling processes and familiarity with cash register operations.
* Great communicator and natural leader.

Join us as we strive for excellence in retail management while creating an engaging environment for both employees and customers alike!

Pay: $19.00 - $23.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Benefits:

* 401(k) matching
* Employee discount
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Application Question(s):

* Have you worked in a retail environment previously?
* Do you have buying experience?
* What experience do you have with western and work clothing as well as footwear?
* Are you able to work Monday-Friday 9-5:30?

Work Location: In person

description:
**American Equipment Holdings**, is one of the leading overhead crane solutions providers in the United States. Over the years, our ability to grow and set ourselves apart from the competition is the result of a tried and true philosophy – take care of our customers and take care of our people.

We also believe that our people matter, which is why we are committed to providing our team members with competitive wages, attractive benefit offerings, and abundant training offerings. As one of the fastest growing companies in our industry, new opportunities are regularly available that enable our team members to develop, grow, and pursue their career passions.

We are looking for a **Buyer**. The Buyer will coordinate the procurement and flow of materials, parts, and assemblies toward meeting materials requirements and production schedules by directing suppliers and shipping companies to ensure that materials arrive on delivery dates. Has the responsibility for purchasing approved inventory items, project components and raw materials, to meet project scheduling needs. Follow up with vendors to ensure schedules are met.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Create Purchase Orders, obtain required signatures following Company Delegation of Authority and ISO purchase procedures and send through appropriate means to supplier.
* Obtain and verify vendor acknowledgements for accuracy; sign and date each acknowledgement and place in electronic job folder.
* Follow up on, expedite and track components to ensure production schedules are met.
* Inform Purchase Order Requestor and Project Scheduler of expected delivery dates.
* File all documents pertaining to procurement both in electronic and hard copy in correct locations.
* Attend Production meetings as required.
* Maintain effective communications with internal team members and vendors.
* Ensure all PO Receivers are issued to the Shipping and Receiving Department within 48 hours.
* Replenishes material, establishes delivery dates, and helps expedite materials to meet production schedules.
* Communicates any supply problems to key internal stakeholders.
* Works to meet customer requirements; 100% on time delivery.
* Manages inventory levels of materials required in our manufacture of crane systems, to meet company goals.
* Acts as a primary contact with direct materials suppliers.
* Aids procurement team in monitoring supplier performance, pricing, and their CI efforts toward increased efficiencies and cost reduction in accordance with our customer performance demands.
* Aids in Analyzing need for new suppliers and makes recommendations to Senior Buyer and Director.
* Aids the procurement team during the supplier selection and quoting process for new parts to ensure suppliers can meet program production and design requirements.
* Work with Senior Buyer for new vendor accounts and Terms.
* Actively participate in the continual improvement of the company, safety compliance and following the Company’s Core Values, Vision, Quality Policy, Goals and Objectives.
* Foster a positive work environment and promote good company morale.
* Works in a safe manner, following all safety policies and procedures while keeping in mind other’s safety as well.
* Reports any accidents and potentially unsafe conditions or unsafe acts immediately to appropriate supervisor.
* Other tasks or responsibilities that may be assigned by manager.

**Required Skills/Abilities**

* Action oriented, time management, Customer focus, Integrity & trust while setting priorities, problem solving, verbal and written communication skills, critical thinking skills.
* Ability to remain calm and focused with stressful situations.

**Education and Experience**

* Bachelor's degree (B.S.) or equivalent in Purchasing, Engineering or Business-related field; or related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Proficient in the use of office equipment including computers, scanners, Internet, email, and copiers.
* Proficient with MS 365 software, Teams, SharePoint.
* Knowledge of overhead cranes, preferred.

**Language Skills:**

Can read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals; write routine reports and correspondence; speak effectively before groups of customers or employees of organization.

**Mathematical Skills:**

Can add, subtract, multiply, and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals; compute rate, ratio, and percent and to draw and interpret bar graphs.

**Computer Skills:**

To perform this job successfully, an individual should have knowledge of Microsoft Office Internet software; Microsoft Excel Spreadsheet, Word Processing software, and experience with ERP systems.

**Other Skills and Abilities:**

Can handle multiple assignments at once and communicate effectively within all levels of the organization. Highly organized.

**Work Environment**

**Procurement Specialist**

**Summary:**
Independently performs market research and assists Government personnel by suggesting or reviewing acquisition strategy recommendations for a variety of government acquisitions. Prepares associated documentation including acquisition plans, source selection plans, requests for proposal, and other transaction proposals and associated determinations and justifications required by statute or policy. Supports source selection process by coordinating and collecting documentation and tracking action items for the Government evaluators' contractor performance assessment research and reviews. Supports the price and proposal costs analysis and coordinates with appropriate agencies on technical evaluations, rate agreements and Cost Accounting Standards issues or material management system approvals. Takes lead role in coordinating contract administration, supports the Government's assessment of contractor cost, schedule and technical performance or program budget analysis and control. Responsible for supporting and developing large, major, or complex government procurements.

**This role requires but is not limited to:**

* Applies knowledge of the various acquisition approaches to include full and open competition, cost plus and fixed price contracts, Government Wide Agency Contracts and blanket purchase agreements, and can formulate the appropriate documentation for the various approaches.
* Applies federal purchasing regulations, policies and procedures while assisting in the procurement of goods and services
* Strong hands-on partnership with program office to develop their pre-award procurement artifacts such as acquisition plans, SOW, market research reports and cost estimates
* Post-Award Contract Administration Support-This may include making sure invoices are paid on time, assisting with performance concerns, making sure deliverables are received on time, and assisting with any contract modifications such as administrative changes, option years, CLIN realignments, etc.
* Acquisition planning and solicitation development to include participating in the structuring of RFPs for complex and technology procurements and develops RFP and contract documentation
* Source selection coordination, responsibility determinations, vendor communications
* Cost/price analysis support
* For major procurements, develops contract line-item structures, synthesizes technical requirements into logical frameworks and unambiguous specifications and statements of work, leads development of evaluation criteria and evaluation schemes, and crafts project-unique contract clauses
* Develops requisite planning and justification documentation and, as required, briefings for approval of major procurements by approval authorities
* Prepares point papers and business case analyses and participates in and supports meetings and program reviews
* Experience with Grants/Cooperative Agreements and Un-definitized Contracting Actions/Letter Contracts highly desirable
* Assists Procurement /Acquisition Manager with implementation, training and maintaining procurement program and other change initiatives; may coordinate, assist/conduct procurement training.
* Maintains purchasing database integrity, associated documentation, and training materials.
* Prepares contractor consent packages and functions as the procurement liaison with the Contracting Officer. Supports purchase orders, change orders, letters, memoranda, narratives and statistical reports and procedures.
* Monitors procurement status and expedites orders according to customer requirements and/or schedules
* Maintains and ensures procurement file documentation compliance with FAR and Agency policies.
* May assist in special projects, as assigned
* Proactively initiates cost reduction/savings initiatives

**Requirements:**

* BA/BS degree plus 6 years of experience
* Prior FAC-C certification or industry equivalent highly desirable
* Experience that demonstrates knowledge of the Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR), agency specific regulations, and acquisition streamlining initiatives and reforms.
* Experience to include conducting comprehensive acquisition/procurement/contract management support activities including developing task lines in PWS/SOW.
* Prior experience using the PRISM contract writing system, and the Federal Financial Management System (FFMS)
* Prior experience using APFS and G-Invoicing desirable
* Ability to elicit requirements from program office subject matter experts to draft high-quality, procurement documentation independently
* Advanced Excel skills to draft independent government cost estimates with detailed bases of estimate
* High aptitude with Microsoft Office Suite to include Teams, Word and Excel
* Experience with file collaboration and management in SharePoint highly desired
* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills and experience working with varied groups of stakeholders
* Ability to work in

Haddad is a privately held family business with over 100 years of experience in the children’s apparel & accessories industry. A leader in the industry, Haddad Brands is the exclusive global licensee for the most iconic brands in the world, including Nike, Jordan, Converse, Hurley, Levi’s, Polo, Abercrombie and Fitch, Lacoste, and Huggies. Supported by a team of professionals skilled in design, sourcing, production, sales, marketing & distribution of premium quality children’s wear, Haddad distributes globally to 100+ countries and maintains sales and sourcing offices in 22 cities globally, including New York, Paris, Hilversum, Shanghai, Egypt, Vietnam, Sri Lanka, and Montreal.

Overview:

The Nike Direct Littles Apparel Buyer will drive the NA Nike Direct Little business through building consumer right assortments by using consumer insights, historical data, analytics, and real-time market feedback to advise future seasons while optimizing current performance.

* Deliver seasonal assortment strategies and determining unit investment and buy depth
* Recap business on a weekly cadence, analyze the business against forecast, manage inventories, and provide actionable insights
* Execute seasonal readiness in partnership with allocation and site merchandising partners
* Drive strong cross-functional partnerships with key partners across Nike and Haddad teams
* Develop long-term strategy for Nike Littles Apparel business, drive classification excellence and portfolio management, and leverage business insights to inform future opportunities
* Special projects as assigned

* 3-5+ years of experience in retail buying, planning and/or product management with a strong understanding of key retail metrics and ability to drive business results
* Proven balance of art and science in decision-making
* Strategic mindset and ability to develop and drive strategy to take business to new places
* Ability to create and drive process with high attention to detail and follow-through
* Ability to foster and drive strong cross-functional partnerships and influence others into action
* Provide mentorship and coaching to teammates
* Strong affinity for current market trends and how Nike apparel can continue to be a style leader in the marketplace

Lornamead is seeking an Oral Care Buyer to join its Supply Chain team.

**Position Summary**

The Oral Care Buyer manages procurement activities that support Planning, Operations, Sales, Finance, Regulatory, R&D, Quality, and other supply chain functions. Working directly with approved suppliers, this role sources raw materials, packaging components, and freight while coordinating purchasing, inventory, and logistics activities. The position requires knowledge of the chemical or packaging industry, strong commercial judgment, and a focus on cost, quality, service, and supply continuity.

**Key Responsibilities**

Strategic Sourcing and Cost Management

* Assist with sourcing strategies for oral care raw materials, packaging components, freight, and related services.
* Use supplier changes, material alternatives, minimum-order quantities, volume commitments, contracts, and other commercial levers to control costs and mitigate price increases.
* Negotiate purchases and establish contracts for critical materials from approved sources.
* Continuously reduce the total cost of procured goods and services without compromising quality, service, or supply continuity.

Supplier and Contract Management

* Build and maintain supplier relationships that support quality, contracted pricing, delivery performance, and lead-time requirements.
* Monitor supplier performance and address cost, quality, service, or delivery issues with internal stakeholders.
* Support category resourcing, supplier risk mitigation, contract execution, and sourcing strategy implementation.

Planning, Inventory, and Supply Continuity

* Evaluate inventory levels against the production schedule and coordinate adjustments as needed.
* Work with Planning and Operations to support material availability and production requirements.
* Identify supply risks and help develop contingency plans to protect continuity of supply.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

* Collaborate with Sales, R&D, Quality, Regulatory, Finance, Planning, and Operations to understand requirements and support business objectives.
* Communicate supplier, cost, inventory, and delivery risks clearly to stakeholders.
* Support departmental and company key performance indicators.

**Qualifications**

Required

* Bachelor’s degree in business, supply chain management, operations, or a related field.
* Three to five years of relevant procurement, purchasing, or supply chain experience.
* Working knowledge of purchasing policies, processes, and procedures.
* Experience using MRP or ERP systems and Microsoft Office applications.
* Strong analytical, organizational, communication, and negotiation skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities with accuracy and attention to detail.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with employees and leaders across the organization.

Preferred

* Procurement experience in the chemical, packaging, consumer products, personal care, or oral care industry.
* Experience sourcing raw materials, packaging components, freight, or related services.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and experience using data to support sourcing and inventory decisions.

.

**About Lornamead Products**

Lornamead is a diversified manufacturer and marketer of specialty oral care and personal care products with a portfolio of several iconic heritage brands, including *Yardley London*, *Finesse*, *Aqua Net*, and *Lypsyl*. The Company is the leading supplier of private label oral care products to retailers across North America. Lornamead is headquartered in Tonawanda (Buffalo), New York. For more information, please visit www.lornameadproducts.com.

description:
**WHO WE ARE**

Biofire Technologies is on a mission to give gun owners better tools for reducing preventable gun injuries and deaths, especially among children. We believe our technology, combined with a best-in-class customer experience, will define the future of firearms safety for the next generation. Our mission-driven approach has earned support from the firearm community, the tech world, and the media.

Biofire employees encompass a diverse range of talents, including world-class engineers who have designed and tested firearms, medical devices, robots, cars, satellites, rockets, and supersonic jets; expert technicians from aerospace, defense tech, special forces, and gunsmithing; and elite operators from high-tech, advanced manufacturing, and regulated industries. Whether building the product or powering the company behind it, every Biofire team member is united by an obsession with safety, reliability, and operational excellence.

**OUR CULTURE**

Reducing accidental firearm injuries and deaths requires original thinking and authentic collaboration, so we’re deeply invested in building a team and culture that can achieve our mission together. Team members enjoy autonomy and flexibility from day one, so expect to be immediately tasked with solving challenging problems and building new systems that work. We’ll hold you accountable for executing audacious goals, giving and receiving honest feedback, and helping your teammates succeed. You’ll receive respect, kindness, and support from every direction while you figure out how to get it all done.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

As a Senior Buyer at Biofire, you’ll own material readiness for an assigned portfolio of production parts as we scale manufacturing. Success means identifying supply constraints early enough to act within standard supplier lead times, maintaining healthy inventory levels, and keeping production supplied through supplier challenges and part transitions.

You will own day-to-day supply planning and purchasing for your portfolio, maintaining accurate visibility into orders, supplier performance, and emerging risks. You’ll partner closely with Production Control, Engineering, Commodity Managers, Quality Engineers, and Finance to support Clear-to-Build (CTB) reviews and turn supply risks into clear, actionable plans.

This role requires strong attention to detail, sound judgment under competing priorities, and the ability to anticipate how today’s supplier performance will affect tomorrow’s production volumes. You’ll also help strengthen shared planning tools and documented processes so the team can scale and provide reliable backup coverage.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Own supply planning and purchasing for your assigned portfolio, maintaining material availability and inventory within established MIN/MAX levels.
* Maintain accurate purchase orders, lead times, and supplier commitments, clearly distinguishing firm orders from forecast quantities.
* Lead category-level Clear-to-Build (CTB) tracking and support weekly executive reviews with early visibility into constraints, mitigation plans, and financial exposure.
* Monitor supplier delivery, quality, and capacity trends; execute supply containment actions and coordinate corrective-action handoffs with Commodity Managers and supplier engineering/quality teams.
* Anticipate supplier risks as production scales and prioritize competing issues based on their impact on production continuity.
* Coordinate part transitions and last-time buys with Engineering and Production Control, balancing remaining inventory, yield, cycle time, and excess and obsolescence risks.
* Request volume pricing ahead of production ramps, obtain competitive quotes, and track purchase price variance and expedite spending in partnership with Commodity Managers and Finance.
* Strengthen shared planning tools and documented processes, including verified lead times, replenishment timing, and cross-coverage with your peer buyer.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

We understand that not all applicants will possess skills that perfectly align with our job qualifications. At Biofire, we appreciate diverse experiences from various industries, and we encourage all individuals who meet the necessary qualifications to submit their applications. While having the "desired" qualifications may strengthen a candidate's profile, we also welcome applicants with alternative experiences to apply.

* A Bachelor’s degree in a technical or operational field (e.g. Engineering, Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering). An MBA, Master’s in Supply Chain or APICS CPIM Certification is a plus.
* 3–5 years of relevant experience in production purchasing, buying, supply planning, or supply chain management within a manufacturing environment. Practical experience in functions such as military, consulting, or finance operations will also be considered.
* An understanding of product lifecycles, BOM development, and how upstream planning impacts downstream execution.
* Strong

* Assist with expediting orders both internally and externally.
* May assist in production planning related functions as required.
* In accordance and adherence with company policy, promotes safety by always working in a safe manner
* Support outside services and other functional areas as assigned.
* Performs other duties as assigned.

* Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college/university or equivalent experience
* Experience in a manufacturing setting with an understanding of business flow and operations.
* Comfortable with technology and utilization of personal computers.

+ Strong Excel skills are mandatory. Comfortable with data extraction, generating custom reports, etc.
* Strong written and oral communication skills with proven ability to interact effectively and positively with other employees, management, and external professionals.

* Self-motivated and deadline oriented
* Well organize and flexible to changes in schedules
* Competency in Microsoft Word and Excel

Join **Century A/C Supply** , proudly part of **Rheem** , a global leader in Heating, Ventilation and Air Conditioning (HVAC) innovation!

With over 70 years of trusted service, **Century A/C Supply** has built a strong network across the Houston TX area, delivering top-quality HVAC products, exceptional service, and industry-leading training to residential contractors and the multifamily industry.

At **Century A/C Supply** , we continue to operate with a **small-company feel** but with the **resources and benefits of a large company -** creating opportunities for growth and success for both our team and our customers. As part of the Rheem family, we’re stronger than ever and committed to:

* **Listening to Understand**
* **Contributing Respectfully**
* **Thinking Creatively**
* **Acting with Responsibility**

Step into an environment where innovation meets opportunity, and where you can grow with a company that values both its employees and its customers!

The **Professional Buyer III** plays a crucial role in delivering our mission and achieving our goals. In this role, you will ensure proper stocking levels of products at all locations while working to maintain relationships with vendors and provide quality products for our customers. You will prepare purchasing requisitions and correspondence, verify purchasing orders, resolve discrepancies with vendors and other internal departments. You will run and analyze purchasing reports and monitor sales records and inventory levels. You will ensure materials, equipment, and supplies are ordered and delivered in a timely manner.

This position will serve **Century A/C Supply Division** customers from our Houston office and at a home-based office located in the area. Our ideal candidate is based in **Houston, TX.**

* RESPONSIBILITIES

* Maintain exceptional service level and fill rate to all branches including regular review of all assigned suppliers.
* Ensure accuracy of all cost and sell prices in our ERP including timely resale price revisions when costs increase to protect margins.
* Maximize margins through inventory management by regular reviewing branch inventory levels, negotiation costs and all purchasing terms with supplier base, category management, maximizing preseason buys including BlueHawk promotions, and establishing initial pricing with acceptable margin levels for all assigned items.
* Work closely with all suppliers to maximize service and minimize cost on assigned products.
* Monitor inventory levels at all branches and prepare purchase orders when necessary.
* Maximize free inbound freight from suppliers while balancing inventory at all branches.
* Establish and maintain positive and productive supplier relationships including participating in business reviews with strategic suppliers.
* Maintain awareness of new products, research new suppliers, and regularly communicate new products to all branches for possible product additions to our offering.
* Stay abreast of product knowledge and industry trends by regular communication with suppliers, territory managers and branch managers.
* Establish and maintain collaborative and productive working relationship with all team members.
* Both lead and support in an environment of continual improvement including process and ERP improvements and efficiencies.
* Complete other assigned projects and tasks as assigned by leadership and management.

QUALIFICATIONS

* Bachelor’s degree, or equivalent work experience.
* 5+ years of experience in procurement and/or purchasing
* Ability to effectively present information in one-on-one and small group situations to suppliers and other employees within the organization.
* Strong organizational skills and ability to prioritize and meet deadlines.
* Ability to read, analyze, and interpret common reports and documents.
* Must be self-motivated, organized and possess strong problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication skills, written and verbal, with attention to detail and accuracy.
* Proficient computer skills and in-depth knowledge of relevant software such as MS Office Suite and ERP

As a leader at Rheem, how you achieve results is as important as the results you achieve. While LEADING SELF, you will be expected to demonstrate the following competencies and behaviors:

* Adapting
* Business Understanding
* Collaborating
* Communicating Effectively
* Continuously Improving
* Customer-Orientation
* Developing Self
* Focusing on Results
* Influencing
* Managing Relationships
* Managing Work
* Problem Solving & Decision Making

Equivalent combination of education, experience, and skills may supplement above minimum job requirements.

**SUMMARY**

The Buyer I role is an entry-level buyer position. The position handles day-to-day purchases and exercises independent discretion and judgment. This position is also responsible for developing, expanding, and improving the profitability of selected organic commodities.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

· Procure the highest quality commodities at a price that meets the needs of both our customers and vendors

· Work closely with the Logistics Coordinator on Inbound shipment logistics as needed

· Manage inventory effectively and perform a daily inventory to evaluate the quality and condition of items purchased

· Research and identify the highest quality sources of organic commodities

· Closely monitor market conditions and emerging purchasing opportunities to evaluate buying opportunities for the company

· Negotiate competitive and mutually satisfactory prices with vendor stakeholders

· Manage multiple purchase orders throughout each workday

· Ensure sufficient inventory levels are maintained to satisfy customer orders, quality expectations, and promotional products

· Collaborate with the Inbound team (QA-IC, Receiving) to ensure the quality and quantity of incoming products. Effectively communicate with these teams regarding all produce's quality, condition, and seasonality

· Manage in-house quality and inventories

· Resolve any invoicing, quality, and arrival issues that may come up in collaboration with the Quality Assurance Team and Accounts Payable promptly

· Manage shipment logistical arrangements as needed

· Communicate pertinent supply, quality, and promotional information to the internal team, including the Purchasing and Sales departments, in a timely and detailed manner, both verbally and in written forms

· Establish and expand relationships with new and existing vendors

· Research and identify new items and supply channels

· Partner with Sales on large-volume deals

· Contribute to process improvement efforts

· Participate in team projects and activities

· Punctuality, regular and reliable attendance

· Perform other duties as directed, developed, or assigned

**SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITY**

Non-applicable.

**QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENTS**

· **Education and/or Experience:** B.A./B.S., or equivalent work experience. A minimum of five years of hands-on fresh produce experience, preferably in quality control or retail merchandising. A minimum of three years of purchasing experience is strongly preferred.

· **Language Skills:** Excellent communication skills, including reading, writing, and verbally communicating effectively and professionally with other business departments, customers, and vendors. Ability to diplomatically deal with difficult situations and people while exhibiting a consistent level of professionalism

· **Technical Skills:** Proficiency with inventory database programs and basic desktop application software. Strong computer skills, including Microsoft Office Suite and Database software

· **Reasoning Ability:** In-depth understanding of quality requirements of discerning retail and institutional customers. Ability to think independently, solve practical problems, and handle a variety of situations without set guidelines. Ability to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, report, or schedule form

· **Other Skills & Abilities:** Appreciation of fresh produce aesthetics and varietal range, with a focus on fruit. Excellent organizational and communication skills, a positive approach to alternative viewpoints, and the ability to build consensus. Positive and Professional attitude. Strong networking ability. Attention to detail. Interest in the history and development of the organic produce industry. Ability to work well in an entrepreneurial environment and a culture of experimentation where creativity can help achieve company goals

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS**

· Stand and walk alternatively depending on the specific needs of the day. Estimate 30% of the time is spent on feet and 70% sitting at a desk

· Have an occasional need to perform the following physical activities: bending/stooping/squatting, climbing stairs, pushing, pulling, twisting, lifting, and reaching above shoulders

· There is a frequent need to perform standing and walking activities

· Consistent need to perform the following physical activities: writing/typing, grasping/turning, finger dexterity

· Lifting/carrying up to 25 lbs frequently and 50 lbs occasionally

· Vision requirements: consistent need to complete forms and view computer screen. Frequent need to see small details. Frequent need to see things clearly beyond arm’s reach

· Hearing requirements: consistent need to communicate over the telephone and in person

**WORK ENVIRONMENT**

The noise level in the work environment is generally moderate. This position occasionally involves temperatures ranging from 34 to over 70 degrees and humidity from 80 to 95%.

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: $80,000.00 - $8

* Place purchase orders for all inventory replenishment items
* Obtain quotes for inventory items and maintain current system item pricing
* Obtain quotes and place orders for all non-stock maintenance requests
* Issue-out and receive-in parts
* Assist on onsite audits, follow up on discrepancies and corrections, as well as any other investigations
* Complete client online training as assigned
* Prepare reports for management review of key statistics such as vendor performance based on findings
* Perform other functions as assigned by management based on department needs
* Solve problems and work collaboratively in a team environment

1. Communication Proficiency (oral and written)

8. Time Management Skills

IMPORTANT EXPERIENCE
