description:
Astronics-PECO, located in Clackamas, Oregon, designs and manufactures highly engineered commercial aerospace interior components and systems for the aerospace industry. We specialize in Passenger Service Units (PSUs) which incorporate air handling, emergency oxygen, electrical power management and cabin lighting systems. We also manufacture a wide range of fuel tank access doors that meet stringent strength, fuel sealing and anti-corrosion requirements.

We are adding a **Buyer II** to our great team. To be successful in this role you will need to be an experienced buyer able to perform production purchasing duties across the entire portfolio of Astronics-PECO products to support production while ensuring that inventory levels are managed according to company objectives and industry best practices.

**Primary Duties and Responsibilities**

* Prepares and monitors purchase orders and procures materials to support production plans; interacts with Planners, Production/Assembly, Engineering, Suppliers and subcontractors to ensure procurement of materials within approved schedules and quality specifications.
* Takes charge in managing supplier relationship for purchased materials and subcontracted processes.
* Provides input to and execution of supplier contracts including Long Term Agreements, Tooling Agreements, and capital equipment purchases.
* Creates and implements special purchasing programs with company suppliers including Kanban, JIT delivery, bread man systems, outsourcing, etc.
* Monitors material levels and status of materials; reviews for excess inventory and coordinates scrap and / or resell back to suppliers.
* Advises Planning of delays and works to resolve material shortage issues. Finds long-term solutions to reduce expedites and premium freight.
* May perform cost analysis on manufactured and purchased parts.
* Provides input on supplier performance evaluation.
* May travel to current and prospective suppliers; travel can include domestic and international destinations up to 1 week per quarter.
* Attends Quality Manual Standards Training and applies Quality Standards accordingly. Ensures that all inventory items are purchased from Approved Sources.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Desired Knowledge, Skills, Abilities, and Experiences:**

* Bachelor's degree in business or related field preferred.
* Three years production purchasing experience as a Buyer, preferably in a manufacturing environment.
* Knowledge of lean / throughput techniques and MRP theory and concepts.
* ASCM and/or ISM certification preferred.
* Excellent oral and written skills.
* Experience working in a fast-paced environment with multiple priorities
* Ability to work in team environment.
* Proven experience in using MRP to manage inventory and minimize production down-time.
* Skill with Microsoft Office software including advanced Excel, Word, and presentation graphics.

**Employment Eligibility Requirements:**

This position may involve access to items subject to U.S. export-control laws. Employment is contingent upon the employee's authorization to access such items under applicable law. The company does not guarantee and is under no obligation to seek such authorization if it would be necessary.

An offer of employment is contingent on successfully passing a pre-employment background and drug screening (including cannabis). Applicants who do not successfully pass both the drug and background screenings will not be considered for employment.

**Accommodation Requests:**

Astronics PECO is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodation to individuals with physical and mental disabilities. If you need special assistance or an accommodation while seeking employment, please e-mail Peco.humanresources@astronics.com or call: 503-387-6045. We will make a determination on your request for reasonable accommodation on a case-by-case basis.

Astronics Corporation (Nasdaq: ATRO) serves the world's aerospace, defense, and other mission critical industries with proven, innovative technology solutions. Astronics works side-by-side with customers, integrating its array of power, connectivity, lighting, structures, interiors, and test technologies to solve complex challenges. For over 50 years, Astronics has delivered creative, customer-focused solutions with exceptional responsiveness. Today, global airframe manufacturers, airlines, militaries, completion centers and Fortune 500 companies rely on the collaborative spirit and innovation of Astronics. The Company's strategy is to increase its value by developing technologies and capabilities that provide innovative solutions to its targeted markets.

For more information on Astronics and its solutions, visit www.Astronics.com.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, national origin, disability, veteran status, or other legally protected status.

* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance procurement efficiency, inventory accuracy, reporting, and customer satisfaction.
* Remote support process for PO’s to be created and placed over the weekend on an emergency basis
* Staffed for normal weekly/monthly cyclicality (daily orders from DC90 and Apple into inventory)
* Expedite PO placement within 1 hour

* Minimum of 3 years buying and procurement related experience
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, reporting, and data analysis.

* Ability to collaborate effectively with Procurement, Operations, Customer Service, Accounts Payable, Order Management, Logistics, and external suppliers.
* Experience investigating and resolving transactional discrepancies within ERP systems.
* Ability to support critical business operations that may require urgent response and expedited procurement activities.

* Ability to positively adjust to changing daily demands and work volumes required.
* Effective verbal and written skills with mid to upper-level management required.
* Above-average telephone and interpersonal skills required.

description:
Nachi America, Inc. thrives on developing long-term relationships. We are a customer-centric, solution-driven, and ambitious team that is passionate about solving our customer challenges.

If you have a desire to utilize your purchasing experience with a world leader in robotics and system automation, you are hungry for an opportunity and motivated to grow, then we want to talk to you about an exciting opportunity for you to join our team as a Buyer in our Novi, MI location.

**About the role:**

The Buyer’s main role is to procure materials, supplies and services at most favorable price consistent with quality.

**Role Responsibilities:**

1. Negotiates with vendors and suppliers to obtain the best prices for products that meet or exceed specified expectations for quality. Must be able to demonstrate proof of competitive bidding

2. Research and select appropriate vendor manufactures and distributors

3. Utilizes the job costing system (CMS) by job order, BOM. Consolidates job orders purchasing to attain volume discounts with vendors. Coordinates non-job purchases in the same way. All purchase orders done in the system should link to corresponding invoices and receivers

4. Implements and monitors a follow-up system for open purchase orders and deliveries

5. Verify order acknowledgements for accuracy

6. Request, process and maintain Return Material Authorizations (RMA)

7. Notifies accounting and operations of any changes to the original purchase order. Develops a communication system that will improve internal customer satisfaction and efficiency of the purchasing function.

8. Customs Robot delivery tracking, controls and tracks all robots stock and parts

9. Monitors all material orders and deliveries to meet production schedule. Expedites orders as needed

10. Submit request for quotes (RFQ)

11. Monthly robot inventory

12. Knowledge of warehouse parts

13. Maintain facility contracts (janitorial, snow removal, landscaping)

**Role** **Requirements:**

1. Bachelor’s degree and knowledge of purchasing/buying principles.

2. Three years of experience in a buyer capacity where negotiating skills were utilized. Two years of leadership/managerial responsibility preferred.

3. Strong communication skills with a teamwork attitude.

4. Computer literate and ability to learn CMS or other ERP systems.

Nachi America, Inc. provides a generous benefit package offered the first of the month following your hire date.

Nachi America, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, national origin, disability, marital or veteran status, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected status.

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: $60,000.00 - $72,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Flexible schedule
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Tuition reimbursement
* Vision insurance

description:
**Company:** West Coast Sports Cards
**Location:** Federal Way, Washington
**Job Type:** Full-time
**Pay:** $19.00 - $22.00 per hour, depending on experience

Join one of Washington State's largest sports card, gaming, and comic book stores! West Coast Sports Cards is a locally owned business with over 30 years of history, and we're looking for a passionate and knowledgeable Sports Cards Specialist to join our team.

We are looking for someone who has a strong knowledge of sports cards and the sports card market and enjoys working with collectors. This position involves both customer service and the buying and selling of sports cards, so the ability to accurately evaluate cards, research current market values, and communicate with customers is important.

**Responsibilities:**

* **Sales & Customer Service:** Engage with customers, provide knowledgeable assistance, and help customers find, buy, and sell sports cards and related collectibles.
* **Buying & Evaluations:** Evaluate sports cards and collections for condition, authenticity, desirability, and current market value.
* **Market Research:** Research recent sales and market trends to help establish accurate buying and selling prices.
* **Sports Knowledge:** Stay current on player performances, trades, injuries, prospects, team news, and other developments that can affect the sports card market.
* **Inventory Management:** Maintain accurate inventory, price cards and products, restock shelves, and help keep the store organized.
* **Administrative Duties:** Answer phone calls, handle cash transactions, and assist with general day-to-day store and office tasks.
* **Product Knowledge:** Stay informed about new releases, grading trends, major sets, manufacturers, and developments within the sports card industry.
* **Online Marketplaces:** Assist with researching and selling products through online marketplaces and auction platforms.

**Requirements:**

* In-depth knowledge of various sports, including player statistics, teams, and historical trends.
* Strong understanding of sports cards market dynamics, grading standards, and pricing factors.
* Proven experience in buying and selling sports cards, memorabilia, or collectibles.
* Familiarity with online marketplaces, auction platforms, and sports card grading companies.
* Excellent research and analytical skills to identify market trends and assess card values.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work independently, make informed decisions, and meet sales targets.
* Detail-oriented with a focus on accuracy in appraisals, inventory management, and financial records.
* Passion for sports and an eagerness to stay updated with industry developments.

**Qualifications:**

* **Sports Knowledge:** Strong knowledge of professional and/or collegiate sports, including players, teams, statistics, prospects, and historical trends.
* **Sports Card Knowledge:** Strong understanding of sports cards, including sets, players, manufacturers, grading, condition, scarcity, and factors that influence card values.
* **Experience:** Previous experience buying and selling sports cards, collectibles, or related products is strongly preferred.
* **Customer Service Skills:** Strong communication and interpersonal skills. Must be comfortable talking with collectors and explaining products, values, and options to customers.
* **Research Skills:** Ability to research recent sales and use available market information to make informed pricing and buying decisions.
* **Organizational Skills:** Ability to manage multiple tasks, maintain organized workspaces, and handle inventory accurately.
* **Technical Skills:** Basic Microsoft Office and Point-of-Sale experience. Familiarity with online marketplaces, auction platforms, and spreadsheets is a plus.
* **Grading Knowledge:** Familiarity with professional grading companies such as PSA, Beckett, SGC, and CGC is a plus.
* **Physical Requirements:** Ability to stand and walk throughout the shift and lift 10–30 pounds periodically.

Why Join Us?

* **Stable Employment:** Our team has an average tenure of 5+ years, and we strive to provide a reliable and friendly work environment.
* **Growth Opportunities:** We are expanding and offer opportunities to grow with the company.
* **Flexible Scheduling:** We offer at least one fixed day off each week and work with employees to provide a manageable schedule.

Our store is a busy hub for collectors, with a large selection of sports cards, Pokémon, Magic: The Gathering, comic books, and other collectibles. We take pride in our product knowledge and customer service and are looking for someone who shares that passion.

If you have a strong knowledge of sports cards, enjoy working with collectors, and want to be part of a growing local business, we'd love to hear from you.

**Benefits:**

* 401(k) with matching

**Expected hours:** 35–40 per week

**Shift:**

* 8 hour shift

**Work Location:** In person

**You may not know our name, but you know our products. What we make is part the places where we live, work and play – all day, everyday.**

Zekelman is a family of companies — 100% domestic manufacturers — with a legacy dating back to 1877. We’re proud to be the largest independent steel pipe and tube manufacturer in North America and the leading innovator in multi-family housing development.

**We believe in what we build and what we build, builds the world around us. Hospitals, hotels, schools, bridges, airports and more.**

**Come build a career you believe in.**

As a **Buyer** at Zekelman Industries, you will play a key role in ensuring the timely procurement of materials, equipment, and services that support business operations and project execution. This position is responsible for managing purchase orders, negotiating supplier pricing and contracts, monitoring delivery schedules, and maintaining strong vendor relationships to drive cost-effective purchasing strategies.

The Buyer partners closely with Operations, Engineering, Finance, Accounts Payable, and external suppliers to ensure material availability, resolve procurement challenges, and support overall supply chain efficiency. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys building supplier partnerships, and brings strong attention to detail, organization, and problem-solving skills.

This is an onsite role supporting operations in Arizona and Texas, with occasional travel to job sites as needed.

**What You'll Do**

* Convert purchase requisitions into purchase orders and issue them to suppliers in a timely and accurate manner.
* Monitor open purchase orders and track supplier delivery schedules to ensure material availability.
* Review engineering drawings and technical specifications and solicit supplier quotations and pricing.
* Manage daily purchasing activities while identifying opportunities for cost savings and process improvements.
* Investigate discrepancies between drawings, schedules, specifications, and material requests and coordinate resolutions.
* Negotiate supplier pricing, contracts, and terms for both short-term and long-term agreements.
* Evaluate supplier performance based on cost, quality, delivery, and service metrics.
* Conduct supplier audits and maintain relationships with preferred vendors.
* Partner with Accounts Payable to resolve invoice discrepancies and payment-related issues.
* Participate in weekly cross-functional meetings and provide procurement updates.
* Travel to project sites in Arizona and Texas as needed to support supplier assessments and project requirements.
* Lead and promote healthy and safe work practices as required by regulatory agencies and company policy.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**Who You Are**

* Associate degree in Business, Supply Chain Management, Purchasing, or a related field.
* 1-3+ years of purchasing, procurement, or supply chain experience within a manufacturing, industrial, or construction environment.
* Experience using ERP/MRP systems, preferably Microsoft Dynamics 365 or similar platforms.
* Experience negotiating supplier pricing, contracts, and purchasing agreements.
* Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and technical specifications.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with internal stakeholders and external suppliers.
* Strong negotiation, organization, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* CPSM, CPP, or other purchasing certifications preferred.
* Eligible to work in the United States.
* Any combination of education, training, and experience that demonstrates success in the role will be considered.

**What You'll Get**

Zekelman Industries offers competitive compensation and excellent benefits, including low-cost, high-quality medical and dental benefits. In addition, we have an amazing tuition assistance program, a bonus plan, a 401(k) plan with a generous company match, loyalty awards, and much more:

* Competitive Compensation
* Bonus Plan & Profit-Sharing Opportunities
* 401(k) with Company Match
* Comprehensive Health, Dental & Vision Insurance
* Tuition Assistance Program
* Paid Vacation & Holidays
* Employee Loyalty Awards

We are Zekelman Industries.

We manufacture superior quality tubular and related products, and provide outstanding service for our valued customers.

The Building People delivers integrated solutions that connect technology, buildings, and people to optimize real estate performance, facility operations, and workforce outcomes. With over 450 contracts delivered across 187 project locations, we manage more than 1,700 facilities and support $38.5B in federal and commercial assets. Leveraging AI-driven automation, data analytics, and platform-agnostic systems, we create high-performing, future-ready environments that reduce cost, improve efficiency, and enable mission success. Founded in 2012, we now have over 450 employees supporting 23 federal agencies—making us a trusted leader in delivering technology-infused building solutions across the public sector.

The Building People is committed to fostering a workplace where every employee can thrive. Using tools like the Predictive Index, we thoughtfully align individual strengths with team needs -ensuring the right fit, the right role, and long-term success.

Our culture is rooted in integrity, innovation, and service. Through our growing philanthropy program, we support communities by focusing on gratitude, giving back, partnerships, and mentorship.

**Our Market Offerings Include:**

* Real Estate & Workplace
* Facilities Management
* Facilities Operations & Maintenance
* Project Management & Engineering
* Workforce Transformation & Organizational Design
* Mission Support
* Smart Buildings & Energy Efficiency
* Technology Solutions

Join our rapidly growing team and help shape the future of real estate, facilities, and community impact.

The Building People, LLC, has a position open for a full-time **Purchasing Agent**. This position would have to report to one of the following locations: Atlanta, GA, Birmingham, AL, Charlotte NC, Tampa, FL, or Nashville, TN. The Purchasing Agent serves customer needs through the placement of Government orders against established contracts (i.e. purchase orders and/or calls against BPAs or other FSS schedules, PBS regional/national IDIQs or other Government sources of supply. Contractor will perform Pre-award and Post-award contracting actions. All procurement actions are at or under the Simplified Acquisition Threshold (SAT). The contractor will be expected to use a variety of purchasing procedures to acquire supplies, services and construction. All work is governed by the FAR and supplemented by additional regulations, legal precedents and agency policy and procedures

**Required Experience & Skills**

* Knowledge of solicitation or purchasing methods such as oral solicitations, calls against BPAs, delivery orders or priced purchase orders to make noncompetitive open market purchases, purchases under established contracts or competitive open market purchases when specifications or statements of work are standardized, price and product characteristics are stable and repeat vendors are used.
* Knowledge of frequently used and easily understood regulations such as those related to required sources, use of mandatory schedules or ordering and documentation procedures for routine purchases to ensure regulatory compliance throughout the purchasing process.
* Knowledge of basic price evaluation techniques to assess price reasonableness using well established references such as price lists, Govt estimates and previous history.
* Knowledge of basic arithmetic used in business to make comparisons of price
* Knowledge of current software and media applications to facilitate the efficient exchange of information via email, spreadsheets, Webex, Federal Procurement Data System - Next Generation (FPDS-NG), Electronic Contract File Viewer (ECF), Federal Business Opportunities (FBO), E-buy, Electronic Subcontracting Reporting System (eSRS) Procurement Processing System (EASi) and other software programs.

* ***Salary offered will be commensurate with the candidate's experience, qualifications, and certifications.***

* ***Our positions may require a background screening and clearance directly from the Government.***

* ***Please note that telework arrangements are subject to change based on customer requirements.***

**ADDITIONAL INFORMATION**

Competitive benefits for eligible employees include:

* Medical & Rx
* Dental
* Vision
* Flexible Spending Accounts
* 401(k) Retirement Plan
* Life Insurance/AD&D
* Long Term Disability and Short-Term Disability
* Paid Time Off
* Holiday Pay

All positions require a background check after acceptance of our offer. The selected candidate will be eligible to begin employment before the background check has been finalized. However, continued employment will be contingent upon the results of your reference/background check from The Building People, LLC. Your position may require special credentialing, clearance, and access as a condition of employment. In the event the government or client does not sponsor or approve your clearance, it may result in termination of your employment.

Job Posting Title: Procurement Specialist, Material Planner

Time Type: Full Time

**Position Description Summary**:

Responsible for being a liason between the direct fullfilment program manager, demand planners and the DSV fullfilment site.

Principal Accountabilities (The following is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not an exhaustive list of all expectations.):

* Ensure that all commitments from the various demand planning groups are within the agreed upon product lead times

* Resolve delays in providing the needed material within the agreed upon timeline

* Manage the lead times of all POs placed on behalf of the customer and report on agreed upon lead times

* Expedite PO’s as needed

* Ensure the recommit process is followed as needed

* Review the back log report and coordinate any exculations with the supplier and review these recommits and any rejected expedited requests

* Review the suppliers build/ship plans ensuring the plan will meet the commitments based on the PO commit dates.

* Review potential on time shipment, OTS, issues to eliminate any orders shipping after the scheduled date or OTS, and document the issues and report on these issues weekly.

* Manually scheduling of orders falling outside of the product's scheduled lead time with the supplier and identify reasons why product is not schedule within lead time

* Monitor lead time of all POs ensuring the POs are shipped within lead time and reporting on the lead time commitment obtainment and manage the process why the lead time was not obtained to correct any issues.

The individual in this position must be capable of performing all of the essential functions with or without a reasonable accommodation.

**Working Environment:**

Assignment Complexity - Work on complex problems where analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of various factors. Exercise judgment within broadly defined practices and policies in selecting methods, techniques, and evaluation criteria for obtaining results.

Accountability – Use professional concepts in accordance with company objectives to solve complex problems in creative and effective ways.

Impact of Decisions – Notable impact on corporate operations and fiscal health.

Working Relationships – Regularly interact with peers, management, and senior management concerning matters of complex scope and discretion.

Scope – Work on problems complex in scope. May determine methods and procedures on new assignments and may provide guidance to other lower level personnel.

**Essential Functions:**

Must be able to pass any federal/state/local government, airport, or company-required background checks, clearances, and/or drug and alcohol tests.

(The following minimum requirements are normal guidelines and should not constrain the advancement of otherwise qualified personnel): This is an intermediate level position. Generally prefer 2-4 years of related experience.

For this position, the expected base pay range is $62,000.00 – $72,000.00 Annual. Actual compensation will be determined based on job-related factors such as relevant experience, skills, education, certifications, and geographic location, in accordance with applicable laws and company policy.

description:
**Overview**
------------

At Ford, you’ll work on ideas that matter, alongside passionate people who want to make a global impact. Together, we’re shaping the next era of transportation—grounded in purpose, driven by progress. Make your move.

* Job Type: Full time
* Work Type: Hybrid

In this position...

You'll be responsible for developing and executing sourcing strategies for assigned commodities and programs. This role manages Total Value Management throughout the program lifecycle, balancing cost, quality, capacity, timing, and supply-chain requirements. The buyer works cross-functionally with Engineering, Product Development, Category Management, Finance, Manufacturing, Quality, and suppliers to deliver competitive sourcing solutions and measurable commercial value.

**What you'll do...**

* Manage cost, quality, and material efficiency through TVM and establish annual cost-saving targets across commercial, design, manufacturing, and supply-chain opportunities.
* Execute the buying and sourcing strategy for assigned commodities, including supplier selection, negotiations, RFx events, tactical sourcing, spot buys, and contract administration.
* Develop material cost roadmaps and sourcing strategies that balance cost, capacity, quality, timing, and business requirements.
* Analyze market conditions, supply/demand, supplier capacity, financial health, and industry trends to identify risks, opportunities, and sourcing actions.
* Own program-specific sourcing Point of View (POV) and provide data-driven recommendations to support business decisions.
* Partner with Engineering and Product Development to identify cost reduction, design efficiency, manufacturability, and commercial opportunities.
* Build and maintain strong supplier relationships while developing negotiation strategies that create leverage and deliver measurable value.
* Challenge existing processes and sourcing assumptions to drive continuous improvement, supplier performance, and end-to-end supply-chain efficiencies

**You'll have...**

* 3+ years of strategic purchasing/buying experience, preferably in automotive or a manufacturing environment.
* 1+ years of experience purchasing production components, including exposure to suspension parts such as bushings or ball joints.
* Experience with sourcing, supplier negotiations, commercial analysis, or commodity management.
* Proficiency in purchasing systems, processes, and procedures with strong analytical and data-driven decision-making skills.
* Strong negotiation and influencing skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders and drive business decisions.
* Strategic, big-picture mindset with strong problem-solving skills and the ability to evaluate multiple scenarios and business plans.
* Self-starter with strong communication skills, high energy, and a demonstrated commitment to continuous learning and developing commodity expertise.

**Even better, you may have...**
* 5+ years of strategic purchasing/buying experience, preferably in automotive or a manufacturing environment.
* 3+ years of experience purchasing production components, including exposure to suspension parts such as bushings or ball joints.
* Familiarity with manufacturing processes, supplier operations, cost structures, and value engineering.

You may not check every box, or your experience may look a little different from what we've outlined, but if you think you can bring value to Ford Motor Company, we encourage you to apply!

As an established global company, we offer the benefit of choice. You can choose what your Ford future will look like: will your story span the globe, or keep you close to home? Will your career be a deep dive into what you love, or a series of new teams and new skills? Will you be a leader, a changemaker, a technical expert, a culture builder…or all of the above? No matter what you choose, we offer a work life that works for you, including:

* Ability to **identify risk and proactively mitigate contractual, financial, and schedule exposure**.

**Central Purchasing Agent**

Do you thrive in a **fast-paced, multitasking environment** with frequent interruptions?
Are you comfortable with **data entry and problem-solving** to ensure smooth purchasing operations?
Do others trust you to resolve issues when things are out of their control?

If so, we want you on our team!

**Why Join CAP Carpet, Inc.?**

CAP Carpet, Inc. is the **22nd largest flooring retailer in the nation** and has been a trusted, family-owned business since **1967**. We are on a continuous **growth trajectory** and are looking for a **detail-oriented Central Purchasing Agent** to support our purchasing operations.

**What We Offer:**

✔ **Competitive Pay**: $18 - $20 per hour, with potential for growth based on experience
✔ **Career Growth**: Opportunities to advance within purchasing, inventory management, and supply chain operations
✔ **Work-Life Balance**: Monday – Friday, **8 AM to 5 PM** schedule
✔ **Comprehensive Benefits**: Health, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k), HSA/FSA options, and **employee discounts on all products**
✔ **A Supportive Team**: Work in a positive environment where collaboration and efficiency drive success

**What You’ll Do:**

As a **Central Purchasing Agent**, you will be responsible for ensuring the **accurate and timely** purchase of specialty and stocking inventory for internal clients. Your key tasks include:
✔ **Creating and processing purchase orders** for specialty and stocking inventory using our computer systems
✔ **Tracking orders and ensuring timely delivery** based on placement and promise dates
✔ **Following up on order confirmations, deadlines, and discrepancies** to resolve any issues
✔ **Handling inventory transfers** and ensuring seamless purchasing operations
✔ **Communicating with vendors and internal teams** to ensure accurate order fulfillment

**What We’re Looking For:**

We need someone who is **detail-oriented, organized, and tech-savvy**, with the ability to work efficiently under deadlines.

✅ **Preferred Qualifications:**
✔ **Two years of experience** in data entry, purchasing, or supply chain management
✔ **Proficiency in Windows-based computer systems**
✔ **Ability to prioritize tasks, work independently, and meet deadlines**
✔ **Experience using RFMS, Excel, Outlook, and other Microsoft Office programs** (a plus!)

**Join Our Growing Team!**

At CAP Carpet, Inc., we know that **our employees drive our success**. Whether you're looking to **hone your purchasing skills** or **advance your career in supply chain operations**, we provide the tools, training, and opportunities you need to succeed.

**Apply today and start your next career move with us!**

* Tuition reimbursement
* Vision insurance

Ability to Commute:

* Wichita, KS 67209 (Required)

We are currently seeking a Platform Procurement Program Manager to be based out of our Secaucus, NJ office. The Platform Procurement Program Manager is an individual contributor who will be responsible for end-to-end supply-demand optimization.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage procurement of **server PCBAs, electronic components, and related materials** from qualified suppliers.
* Issue and manage purchase orders, including pricing, quantities, delivery dates, and commercial terms.
* Monitor supplier commitments and proactively address shortages, delays, and supply constraints.
* Work closely with **Material Planning, Engineering, Manufacturing, and Quality** teams to align purchasing with production requirements.
* Review MRP/ERP requirements and convert demand into timely purchase orders.
* Maintain appropriate inventory levels while minimizing excess and obsolete materials.
* Support supplier selection, qualification, cost negotiations, and performance management.
* Negotiate lead times, MOQ, payment terms, and other commercial conditions.
* Track PCBA component availability and identify potential **long-lead-time and allocation risks** .
* Coordinate engineering changes, BOM updates, and part substitutions with suppliers and internal teams.
* Ensure purchased materials meet specifications, quality requirements, and approved vendor lists.
* Support resolution of supplier quality issues, material discrepancies, and delivery problems.
* Develop and maintain supplier relationships and participate in supplier performance reviews.
* Analyze purchasing data, including cost, lead time, supplier performance, and delivery metrics.
* Maintain accurate purchasing records and ensure compliance with company procurement policies.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in **Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, Operations, or a related field** preferred.
* 3+ years of purchasing/procurement experience in electronics, PCBA, servers, networking equipment, or a related manufacturing environment.
* Understanding of **PCBAs, electronic components, BOMs, and electronics manufacturing processes** .
* Experience working with ERP/MRP systems and purchasing workflows.
* Ability to manage multiple suppliers, priorities, and production requirements simultaneously.
* Strong communication skills and ability to work cross-functionally.

ZT Systems assesses market data to ensure a competitive compensation package is created for all our employees. description:
**Company Overview**

RapidAir is a leading designer and manufacturer of branded compressed air solutions—including piping, fittings, filtration, and accessories—serving transportation, manufacturing, industrial, energy, agricultural, and consumer markets. In 2024, Gryphon Investors acquired a controlling interest in RapidAir through the Heritage Fund, positioning the company for significant growth. Together, we’re expanding into new markets, strengthening customer relationships, and leveraging macro industrial trends to scale RapidAir’s leadership in the compressed air space.

**Job Summary**

We are seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented, and dependable Buyer to join our growing Procurement team. The Buyer will be responsible for day-to-day purchasing activities, including purchase order creation and management, supplier communication, order tracking, expediting, and maintaining accurate purchasing information within the ERP system.

The ideal candidate has 2–4 years of purchasing, procurement, materials, or supply chain experience and is comfortable working in a fast-paced manufacturing environment. This position will work closely with Operations, Warehouse, Logistics, Finance, and suppliers to ensure materials are purchased and delivered on time and at the appropriate cost and quantity.

This role provides an opportunity to develop within the Procurement organization and take on additional responsibilities in supplier management, inventory planning, sourcing, cost reduction, and procurement process improvement as experience and performance develop.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Create and manage purchase orders based on system requirements, inventory needs, and established purchasing parameters.
* Send purchase orders to suppliers, obtain confirmations, and monitor open orders to ensure on-time delivery.
* Expedite materials when necessary and communicate potential delays or shortages to the appropriate internal teams.
* Maintain accurate item, supplier, pricing, lead-time, minimum order quantity, and purchasing information within the ERP system.
* Communicate with suppliers regarding product availability, pricing, lead times, order changes, delivery dates, and other purchasing requirements.
* Resolve purchase order, receiving, shipment, invoice, and other vendor-related discrepancies in a timely manner.
* Assist with obtaining freight quotes and coordinating shipments when required.
* Maintain strong working relationships with suppliers and cross-functional partners, including Operations, Warehouse, Logistics, and Finance.
* Assist with purchasing reports, inventory analysis, and other procurement reporting as requested.
* Identify opportunities to improve purchasing accuracy, supplier responsiveness, delivery performance, and overall procurement efficiency.
* Perform other purchasing and procurement-related duties as assigned.

**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Business, or related field preferred.
* Minimum of 2-4 years of relevant purchasing/procurement experience required.
* Experience using Business Central or similar ERP systems.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Outlook, Word, PowerPoint, OneNote)
* Professional proficiency in Mandarin or Cantonese nice to have.

**Skills & Abilities**

* Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
* Ability to manage multiple purchase orders, suppliers, priorities, and deadlines.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong follow-up skills and a sense of urgency.
* Ability to develop effective working relationships with suppliers and internal teams.
* Basic to intermediate Excel skills and the ability to work with purchasing and inventory data.
* Ability to identify purchasing or supply issues and escalate problems when appropriate.
* Self-motivated, dependable, and willing to take ownership of assigned responsibilities.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
* Willingness to learn and take on additional procurement responsibilities as experience develops.

**Physical Requirements**

* Primarily office-based, requiring the ability to sit or stand for extended periods while using a computer and phone.
* Ability to communicate clearly and receive direction in a fast-paced environment.
* Occasional light physical activity, such as moving product samples or reference materials.

**Travel Requirements**: up to 10%

Travel is required to support operational, supplier, and cross-functional business activities. This includes onsite visits to the Auburndale, WI facility, as well as occasional supplier visits as business needs require.

RapidAir Products offers the opportunity to join a growing, market-leading platform backed by a premier private equity sponsor. This role provides meaningful ownership, visibility, and the opportunity to directly impact the company’s success.

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. Applicants are considered for all

**MMR Purchasing Agent- On-site based in Odessa, TX**
**Pay: $24-$26/hour based on experience**
**Schedule: Monday-Friday 8:00am-5:00pm**

**Company Culture****:**
At MMR, our most valuable assets are not our buildings or equipment, it is our family of employees with diverse backgrounds and experiences. Our investment in training programs and resources allows our employees to reach both their personal and professional goals. This is evident with MMR receiving numerous awards including “Best Place to Work” and consistently being recognized as one of the top Engineering News Record’s “Annual Specialty Contractors.” All of which can be further explained on our website (https://mmrgrp.com/resources) by watching the provided videos.

**Organization Description****:**
MMR has served as the industry leader in instrumentation and electrical construction, maintenance, and technical services for over 30 years. Our diverse list of clients allows us the unique ability to work across industry lines in the oil and gas upstream and midstream as well as chemical and petrochemical downstream, industrial manufacturing, power generation, renewable energy, mission critical, heavy commercial, and energy storage sectors. MMR holds the proud distinction of being the largest privately owned “Open Shop” contractor in the United States with over 30 branch offices including global locations in Canada, and Mexico. For more information, please visit our website: www.mmrgrp.com.

**Job Description****:**
MMR is seeking Purchasing Agent candidates. The responsibilities would include, but not limited to, the following:

* Evaluating suppliers by considering price, quality, availability, and other criteria
* Interviewing vendors and visiting suppliers’ facilities to learn about products, services, and pricing
* Negotiating contracts with vendors and suppliers to obtain the best deals on behalf of the company
* Verifying purchases by comparing them to a master list and recommending alternatives for expensive or irrelevant products
* Interacting with suppliers to schedule delivery times and resolve shipping errors
* Authorizing payments and maintain receipts, records, and inventories
* Manage relationships with key suppliers to maintain quality of goods, timely delivery, and compliance to terms of contracts
* Keeps information accessible by sorting and filing documents
* Provides purchasing planning and control information by collecting, analyzing, and summarizing data and trends
* Follows and provides feedback on processes set forth by department for organization and data management
* The above is not an exhaustive list of duties and you will be expected to perform different tasks as needed to align with the overall business objectives of the organization

**Required Skills and Qualifications****:**

* BS degree in related field preferred
* 3-5 years relevant work experience required
* Experience in procurement within a construction setting preferred
* Ability to work independently, prioritize, organize, problem solve, and exercise good judgement with minimal supervision
* Ability to coordinate a variety of project simultaneously
* Ability to demonstrate flexibility and creativity
* Working knowledge of MS Office software
* Strong organizational and interpersonal skills are required
* Able to work effectively under time pressure and/or deadline
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Willingness to work flexible, varying hours, including evenings and weekends as needed
* Regular and reliable attendance at work

*MMR Group, Inc. and its affiliated companies ("MMR") is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, national origin, religion, sex, age, veteran status, genetic information or any other legally protected class.*

Headquartered in Dublin, Ohio (USA) with Engineering Centers in Pune, India and Yokohama, Japan, Goken is a global Engineering Services and Product Development company founded in 2004. We partner with OEMs and suppliers across the mobility space, as well as clients in non-mobility industries, to deliver innovative solutions and accelerate product development.

At Goken, we embrace our motto of "Time to Innovate" by pushing boundaries, cultivating entrepreneurial thinking, and empowering individuals who thrive on tackling challenges, embrace fresh ideas, and are driven to create solutions that shape the future. This mindset fuels our mission and empowers our teams to solve complex problems, deliver measurable value, and move our clients and industries forward.

Our Vision is to empower associates to drive innovation and lead meaningful change wherever it's needed, ensuring we stay ahead of the challenges and opportunities of tomorrow. Our Mission is to build trust that fosters greatness in our people, excellence in our clients, and positive impact in the communities we serve.

Goken offers a competitive compensation structure and benefits that support professional growth and personal well-being. We also foster a culture built on high performance, collaboration, continuous improvement, and ongoing professional development.

**Summary:**

Support the entire purchasing lifecycle by buying, at the most favorable price: raw materials, equipment, machinery, components, tooling, services and/or supplies for the development of business operations. This activity should be performed so that all items are delivered in accordance with company's quality, quantity and delivery standards. This role requires the candidate to work in a small team while operating independently and routinely self-checking their results.

**Responsibilities:**

* Purchase Order management including: PO creation, PO delivery to the correct vendor, confirming vendor PO receipt and answering vendor questions.
* Order receipt activities including: obtaining vendor's anticipated delivery date, troubleshooting late-delivery or quality issues, supporting Receiving team and managing invoice activities required for PO.
* Issue resolution and compliance.
* Build and manage relationships with both new and existing suppliers.
* Build and maintain internal relationships to facilitate the continuity of services required.
* Manage, confirm and communicate any additional information relating to an order; update both internal and external parties as required.
* Transfer data in accordance with output activity.
* Ensuring systems are updated with the most current information.
* Assist with the development and execution of contracts.
* Facilitate competitive bid analysis and negotiations for goods and services.
* Supplier travel required when requested.

**Qualifications:**

* 5 years of Procurement experience & BS Degree in Business administration or combined relevant experience.
* Experience with CAD drawings; including knowledge of prototype parts.
* Demonstrated understanding of specific manufacturing processes.
* Experience independently leading meetings with external partners including negotiation, delivery and overall assessment discussions.
* Experience leading ongoing Quality, Cost, Delivery and Development discussions with suppliers.
* Experience using SAP.
* Expert PC skills (including Excel, PPT, Word ).
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work in a multinational team environment.
* Strong organizational, analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Coordination experience (preferred).

Goken is committed to fostering a respectful, inclusive, and engaging workplace across all global locations. We value diversity and provide equal opportunities for career growth and professional development, regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

**Buyer, Project Pricing - Remote Position**

**Description:**

Our mission is to help customers save time and money when purchasing commercial kitchen equipment and supplies by providing a customer-centric shopping experience and by leveraging our industry buying power.

We are seeking a Buyer to support our Deal Desk by working directly with manufacturers and their representatives to secure competitive pricing for active sales opportunities. The ideal candidate is a proactive communicator with purchasing experience, strong negotiation skills, and consistent follow-through.

**Skills and Requirements:**

* 2+ years of buying, purchasing, or project-pricing experience at a commercial foodservice equipment and supplies dealer or distributor
* Required hands-on experience negotiating manufacturer discounts, requesting special project pricing, and securing specification credits in a previous role
* Demonstrated results obtaining manufacturer support beyond standard dealer pricing, with the ability to discuss specific examples of prior negotiations and outcomes
* Working knowledge of commercial kitchen equipment categories, major manufacturers, and manufacturer representative networks
* Practical understanding of specification-credit eligibility, project-registration requirements, approval processes, and supporting documentation
* Strong communication and negotiation skills, with confidence contacting manufacturers and their representatives by phone and email
* Ability to present project details, competitive circumstances, and purchasing timelines clearly to support pricing requests
* Understanding of dealer costs, gross margins, and how discounts and credits affect profitability
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets, with experience using purchasing, quoting, ERP, or CRM systems
* Exceptional organization and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple opportunities and follow-up deadlines
* Ability to work independently in a remote environment while maintaining responsive communication and accountability for results

**Responsibilities and Duties:**

* Review assigned sales opportunities with the Deal Desk Manager and sales representatives to identify opportunities for additional manufacturer pricing support
* Gather equipment specifications, quantities, project details, purchasing timelines, and other information needed to prepare complete pricing requests
* Proactively contact manufacturers and their representatives to present opportunities and negotiate project-specific discounts, special pricing, and eligible specification credits
* Identify applicable manufacturer programs and complete required project registrations and credit requests within established deadlines
* Negotiate pricing within company guidelines and escalate complex negotiations or exceptions to the Deal Desk Manager
* Build and maintain productive manufacturer relationships through accurate information, professional communication, and consistent follow-through
* Track open requests and follow up promptly to meet customer quotation deadlines
* Document approved pricing, credit amounts, eligibility requirements, expiration dates, and supporting correspondence
* Communicate manufacturer approvals and conditions to sales and purchasing so they are accurately reflected in quotes and orders
* Coordinate with purchasing and accounting to verify that negotiated discounts are applied and approved credits are submitted and received
* Maintain accurate opportunity records and report on pricing improvements, credits realized, outstanding requests, and turnaround times
* Stay informed about manufacturer pricing programs and recommend improvements to the pricing-request and credit-tracking process

**Why work with us?**

We truly believe that what you do and where you work matters. The opportunity to grow and to build new relationships in a friendly environment makes it fulfilling and exciting to come to work each day.

**Perks:**

* Virtual position with Flexible Schedule and freedom.
* Special pricing on all our commercial kitchen equipment and supplies.
* Expert trainings and company paid continual education offerings.

**Benefits:**

* Competitive salary
* Competitive bonus structure
* Medical, vision, and dental coverages

**Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action Employer:**

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, disability, sex, age, ethic or national origin, martial status, sexual orientation, gender identity or presentation, pregnancy, genetics, veteran status or other status protected by state or federal law.

**Company Overview**

Baker Engineering, LLC’s (Baker) core business centers around the design and development of high-tech, high-performance technologies for a variety of applications, from custom military and commercial engines, to engine components, to the production of parts and mechanical assemblies for other industries. Baker is a division of Waséyabek Development Company, LLC that is wholly owned by the Nottawaseppi Huron Band of the Potawatomi, a Federally recognized Indian Tribe.

**Position Overview**

The Production Control Buyer/Planner is the operational link between customer demand, purchasing, production, outside processing, inventory, and final shipment. This position owns the flow of material and information through the manufacturing process to support on-time delivery while minimizing inventory, shortages, schedule disruptions, and expediting. The ideal candidate is proactive, organized, and comfortable coordinating daily priorities across multiple departments and suppliers.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Customer Schedule Management:** Manage customer releases, delivery schedules, promise dates, past-due orders, forecasts, and schedule changes, including pull-ins and push-outs—to keep production plans aligned with customer requirements.
* **Production Planning & Scheduling:** Develop and maintain production schedules that balance customer priorities, material availability, machine capacity, labor, and outside processing requirements.
* **Daily Production Control:** Participate in daily production meetings prepared to identify machine downtime, missing material, outside-process delays, expedites, customer emergencies, capacity constraints, and recovery plans.
* **Material Planning & Purchasing:** Plan and purchase raw materials and components based on forecasts, customer demand, safety stock levels, and production schedules while balancing inventory investment and machine utilization.
* **Outside Processing Coordination:** Coordinate outside processing—including anodize, chem film, heat treat, black oxide, hydrogen bake, plating, and grinding—through purchase order creation, supplier scheduling, shipment timing, and return-date follow-up.
* **Shortage & Bottleneck Resolution:** Identify and resolve material shortages, routing issues, capacity constraints, supplier delays, and administrative bottlenecks before they disrupt production or customer delivery.
* **ERP/MRP Data Ownership:** Maintain accurate planning data, including routers, lead times, inventory parameters, work orders, purchase orders, and production schedules, so departments are working from reliable information.
* **Supplier Performance:** Monitor supplier quality, delivery, responsiveness, and lead times; work directly with suppliers to resolve shortages and improve performance.
* **Estimating & Quoting Support:** Obtain supplier quotations, material pricing, outside-processing costs, and lead-time information to support estimating and quoting activities.
* **Cross-Functional Communication:** Partner closely with Production, Quality, Logistics, Sales, Engineering, and Customer Service/Fulfillment to communicate priorities, schedule risks, material status, and recovery actions.
* **Performance Improvement:** Track schedule attainment, on-time delivery, shortages, inventory, and other key measures; recommend practical improvements that strengthen production flow and customer service.

**Qualifications**

* **Experience:** 2–5 years of experience in production planning, buying, scheduling, manufacturing operations, or supply chain management.
* **Manufacturing Knowledge:** Working knowledge of manufacturing flow, production schedules, inventory control, purchasing, and outside processing. Experience in machining or a job-shop environment is preferred.
* **Systems Skills:** Experience working with ERP/MRP or production-planning systems and proficiency with Microsoft Excel.
* **Organization:** Ability to manage changing priorities, follow up on details, and keep multiple jobs, suppliers, and deadlines moving at the same time.
* **Problem-Solving:** Ability to recognize schedule risks and bottlenecks, determine practical next steps, and coordinate recovery plans.
* **Communication:** Clear and professional communication skills for working with suppliers, customers, and cross-functional teams.
* **Education:** Associate or bachelor’s degree in supply chain, business, operations, or a related field is preferred; equivalent manufacturing experience will be considered.

It is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities required of an incumbent. An incumbent may be asked to perform other duties as required.

Job Summary

Fazio Mechanical Services is seeking a proactive, detail-oriented, and highly organized Purchasing Agent to support our refrigeration service operations. This position plays a critical role in ensuring our technicians have the materials, equipment, and supplies needed to safely and efficiently complete work across our operating regions.

**Job Description:**

We are seeking a **Senior Specialist, Procuremen**t to join our procurement team at our **Jupiter, FL** facility. Will also consider candidates to work **Remotely**.

**Essential Functions:**

* Procure critical path, components and services, in support of numerous organizational and manufacturing needs. Manage subcontracts for assigned suppliers and or commodities. “On it” focus and attention to detail as a liaison and focal point of contact to various internal customers (Quality, Manufacturing, Engineering and Program).
* Create and issue various types of contracts (FFP, T&M etc.) Lead supplier selection process, perform cost/price analysis, fact finding and formal negotiations.
* Ensure compliance to delivery schedules. Follow up with suppliers in advance to ensure that delivery dates are adhered to.
* Review and negotiate terms and conditions modifications, and review of agreements such as End User License Agreements. Understand component specifications and requirements.
* Maintain documentation control in compliance with FAR regulations and company procedures and policies. Perform audit of PO files and documentation of buyer peers.
* Active participation in company and departmental and enterprise improvement initiatives.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s Degree and minimum 6 years of prior relevant experience. Graduate Degree and a minimum of 4 years of prior related experience. In lieu of a degree, minimum of 10 years of prior related experience.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* 4+ years of professional experience in purchasing within an MRP (ERP) driven manufacturing environment.
* Proven professional history and experience involving procurement negotiations.
* Experience in government / FAR buying environment is preferred but not necessary.
* Contract experience, including knowledge of terms and conditions, and other procurement agreement related experience.
* Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite.
* Understanding and working knowledge of engineering documentation, product configuration

9/80

Incumbents working in this job title perform duties in an office setting.

This job has an initial and promotional probationary period of 6 months, except as provided in KRS 18A.111.

description:
**MANUFACTURING IS IN CHAPIN’S DNA.** We’ve been doing it for over a century, designing and producing industry-leading home and industrial sprayers, spreaders, irrigation and accessories. Our tradition of quality started as a family-owned business in Oakfield, New York and grew into a global corporation with subsidiaries in the United States and manufacturing plants around the world. We’re proud to state most Chapin products are made in the USA with global materials. We understand that dedication to our employees and to our customers is the formula for our success. You’ll contribute to a team that wins and accomplish great things through shared ingenuity, self-discipline and by always going that extra mile. This team is not for the faint of heart. Dedication, accountability, unwavering commitment and always working full throttle are the principles that drive us, and where we go is always worth the trip.

**JOB SUMMARY:** To manage the activities of the purchasing department and purchase supplies and materials at the optimal price and delivery cycle while meeting all inventory levels as per the budget.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

* Procurement of materials and components required for production and manufacturing support including identifying & evaluating new vendors.
* Negotiates for best cost, delivery and quality on assigned commodities.
* Create, submit, communicate and expedite purchase orders.
* Site visits to suppliers’ facilities.
* Assist Director of Operations in the development of annual purchasing budget and departmental goals.
* Working within our production planning department, plan material needs to support the demands of manufacturing and provide daily feedback on any items of concern that would impact production schedules.
* Monitoring of inventory received and other related jobs.
* Sub level production planning to support production process both internally and with out of state divisions.
* Partner with Accounting Department to lead the monthly inventory count.
* Provide reports and other information to management team.
* Provide purchasing support for new product development, line extensions, and process optimization.
* Compile purchasing information including price history, product quality and service to be used to evaluate new and existing suppliers.
* Maintain monthly purchase information and track spend to budget while documenting deviations.
* Actively participate on cross-functional teams on projects that drive continued company success and profitability.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:

* BS in materials management, business management or related discipline (Associate’s Degree may be considered based on experience).
* 5 years purchasing experience.
* Experience in manufacturing environment.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:

* Effective, professional communication.
* Highly organized.
* Efficient in Word, Excel & Power Point
* Self-motivated.
* Energetic.

**WE BELIEVE DIVERSITY DRIVES INNOVATION**

We are committed to building a culture where differences are valued. We believe in constant growth of our people, programs and tools. Chapin International is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to supporting and respecting all individuals and in which personnel processes are merit-based and applied without discrimination on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, age, disability, national or ethnic origin, military service status, citizenship, or other protected characteristic.

description:
**Be part of an amazing story**

Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. We’ve been part of memorable moments and milestones for countless customers and colleagues. Those stories are part of what makes this such a special place to work.

**Job Overview**

The Associate Buyer will elevate Macy’s competitive position by buying merchandise to drive sales and profitability across stores and online for your family of business. You will work closely with existing vendors to curate a distinguished Macy’s assortment, as well as seek out new and differentiating vendors to satisfy our customer demand. The Associate, Buyer will focus on achieving sales, gross margin, turn over and pricing execution in your assigned area of the business. You will develop and implement strategies by vendor, collaborating with planning to analyze and respond to sales trends.

An Associate Buyer is known as a trusted, collaborative, and results-oriented leader, serving as a key business partner and change agent with the ability to lead through influence. Demonstrating professional maturity and industry credibility, the ideal candidate must navigate and lead effectively through significant complexity. A crucial aspect is the candidate's comfort and effectiveness in promptly evaluating and phasing out legacy approaches that no longer align with the current strategy. Equally valued is the candidate's reputation for visionary thinking and a strong commitment to swift decision-making.

**What You Will Do**

* Make all purchasing decisions independently of Buying Director that satisfies the customer demand to achieves sales, turn and margin plan.
* Understand competitive marketplace and pursues white space opportunities that align with company strategy.
* Competitive shop and determine the action necessary to address competitive challenges. Identify any product opportunities and provide suggestions and input in product development to vendors.
* Support Buying Director to drive in-season business effectively by influencing promotional strategies based on current business needs.
* Attend Market appointments prepared with strategic assortment plans and an understanding of product to support customer preferences.
* Set the vision and determine call to action for assortment-building opportunities in partnership with Planning, Pricing and Cross Functional partners.
* Collaborate with planning partner to develop and execute assortment strategy.
* Develop pre-season assortment vision that ties to company key priorities and insights from Digital and Planning Director counterparts.
* Partner with Financial Planning to ensure department-level financial targets support assortment strategy.
* Decide on in-season changes for the department and vendors based on sales, margin, and turn forecast from Financial Planning.
* Support the Financial Planning and Buying Director in building seasonal strategy components based on targets.
* Provide Buying Director with category, class, and item performance analysis to assist in determining in-season item-level changes to make.
* Maintain an industry presence that allows for connections, new business opportunities, and ideas at Macy’s. Represent and support the Macy’s brand while maintaining this presence.
* Communicate with vendors to ensure timely collection of MDAs/markdowns/RTVs and partner with Financial Planning to ensure alignment with in-season VMT input.
* Rely on data analytics (PE and dynamic pricing) to develop POS and Perm pricing strategy and ensure execution is as intended, hitting financial metrics and driving sales and profitability.
* Review discount rate and sales performance in promo planner, making adjustments as needed to hit financial sales and margin goals.
* Execute both POS pricing in promo planner, using dynamic recommends, and work with the associate buyer on permanent markdown execution in UPM.
* Foster an environment of acceptance and respect that strengthens relationships, and ensures authentic connections with colleagues, customers, and communities.
* In addition to the essential duties mentioned above, other duties may be assigned.

**Skills You Will Need**

**Financial Business Acumen:** Ability to understand and analyze financial aspects to make informed strategic decisions.

**Retail Strategy and Tactics:** In-depth knowledge of market trends, customer behaviors, and competitive landscapes..

**Change Management:** Comfort and effectiveness in leading teams through change ensuring successful adaptation.

**Visionary Thinking:** Ability to be a forward thinking and innovative leader with a vision to drive transformative strategies propelling family of business to new heights.

**Communication Skills:** Effectiv

description:
**Description**

Are you a good negotiator?

Do you love working in a fast-paced environment?

Do you want to be part of a team that supports work with a national impact?

**If so, we're looking for someone like you to join our team at APL.**

We are seeking a **Procurement Representative (Buyer)** to help solicit proposals, perform market research, negotiate pricing and terms, and award and administer commercial purchase orders for goods and services in support of APL programs. This role requires close collaboration with suppliers, program offices, and procurement leadership to ensure procurements are completed efficiently and in compliance with laboratory policies and procedures. Expediting deliveries, resolving order issues, and maintaining clear communication with stakeholders are essential aspects of this position.

Our team operates in a highly dynamic environment, and we are always looking for individuals with strong analytical skills, sound judgment, and creative problem-solving abilities.

**As a Procurement Representative (Buyer)...**

* You will independently manage procurement actions from requirements development through award and administration, developing appropriate sourcing and acquisition strategies, soliciting and evaluating proposals, performing price analysis, negotiating pricing and terms, and issuing commercial purchase orders and agreements.
* You will serve as a trusted procurement partner to technical staff and program teams, providing guidance on sourcing strategies, supplier selection, competition, agreement structure, and procurement approaches that balance program objectives, schedule, cost, risk, and compliance requirements.
* You will help develop and execute strategic sourcing and supplier management approaches for APL's build-to-print and custom manufacturing supplier base, including fabrication and machining, printed circuit boards and assemblies, cables and harnesses, and other specialized manufactured products.
* You will work closely with engineering, technical, quality, and other internal teams to understand current and future manufacturing requirements, identify supplier capability needs, evaluate potential supply-chain risks, and develop sourcing strategies that position APL to meet program needs.
* You will develop and lead competitive solicitations, evaluate supplier proposals, conduct price and cost analysis as appropriate, and lead negotiations involving pricing, delivery, terms and conditions, and other commercial considerations.
* You will prepare and maintain procurement documentation and electronic procurement files in accordance with applicable FAR requirements, APL policies and procedures, and established procurement practices.

**Qualifications**

**You meet our minimum qualifications for the job if you ...**

* Have a Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain Management, Finance, or a related discipline, or equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience.
* Have five or more years of progressively responsible professional experience in procurement or contracting, including responsibilities such as sourcing strategy, solicitation development, negotiation, contract formation, and supplier management.
* Have demonstrated knowledge of procurement principles, including sourcing, negotiation, supplier management, and purchase order/contract administration.
* Have strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Have excellent interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively with internal stakeholders and suppliers.
* Have an ability to work both independently and as part of a team while exercising sound judgment and attention to detail.
* Have a demonstrated ability to analyze information, solve problems, and make informed procurement recommendations.
* Hold US Citizenship or permanent resident status, as required to access APL’s facilities and networks, subject to applicable laws.

**You'll go above and beyond our minimum requirements if you...**

* Have experience with SharePoint (for document routing and storage), ServiceNow (as an intake and communication system), Adobe Portfolio, and/or Oracle-based business systems (EBSS)
* Have experience procuring commercial goods and services under the Federal Acquisition Regulations
* Have experience procuring custom-fabricated and build-to-print components, including custom machined parts, printed circuit boards, and other specialized manufactured products

About Us:

Indelco Plastics is the leading supplier of corrosion-resistant thermoplastic products for fluid control and storage. With 13 locations across the Midwest and representing over 70 industry-leading manufacturers, Indelco offers an inclusive environment, continuous professional development, and a commitment to work-life balance for every team member.

Visit our Website: indelco.com

Job Description:

The Senior Buyer is a strategic sourcing professional responsible for managing supplier relationships, negotiating contracts, and driving cost optimization initiatives. This position plays a key role in aligning procurement strategies with organizational goals, ensuring supply continuity, and supporting cross-functional business operations within a manufacturing or industrial environment.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Lead strategic sourcing initiatives to identify, evaluate, and select suppliers that align with company objectives for cost, quality, and sustainability.
* Negotiate long-term agreements, pricing, and supply terms with key suppliers to achieve optimal total cost of ownership.
* Monitor supplier performance using KPIs (e.g., on-time delivery, quality, cost savings) and implement supplier development plans as needed.
* Collaborate with engineering, quality, and operations teams to introduce new materials, components, or suppliers.
* Analyze market trends, commodity pricing, and risks to proactively mitigate supply disruptions.
* Serve as a subject matter expert for ERP purchasing workflows, supplier management, and procurement analytics.
* Develop and report procurement metrics, dashboards, and improvement projects using Power BI or Excel.
* Ensure sufficient supply of all materials and timing of deliveries across multiple sites through robust processes for purchase orders, blanket orders, transfer orders, and manufacturing orders.
* Proactively communicate cross-functionally expected delays, root cause of supplier issues, and countermeasures implemented to prevent occurrences.
* Continually look for opportunities to increase efficiency within the purchasing organization
* Create and maintain documentation around current and best practices for all steps within procurement.
* Mentor junior buyers and provide training on purchasing procedures and supplier engagement best practices.

**Education and Experience**
----------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or a related field required.
* 5–7 years of progressive procurement experience in manufacturing, industrial, or regulated industries (medical device, aerospace, or plastics preferred).
* Demonstrated success in contract negotiation, supplier performance management, and strategic sourcing.
* Proficiency with ERP/MRP systems (e.g., Business Central, SAP, Oracle) and advanced Excel or Power BI skills.

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**
------------------------------------

* Strong analytical, negotiation, and vendor management capabilities.
* Ability to lead cross-functional sourcing projects with minimal supervision.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to present to senior leadership.
* Familiarity with sustainability initiatives and supplier ESG data collection preferred.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and work in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
