**MRO Buyer – Avocet Aviation Services**

**Position Summary**

**Avocet Aviation Services** is seeking an experienced **MRO Buyer** to support our Maintenance, Repair, and Overhaul (MRO) operations. This role is responsible for sourcing, purchasing, and expediting aircraft parts, components, tooling, repairs, and services while ensuring compliance with FAA regulations, quality standards, and approved vendor requirements.

The MRO Buyer plays a critical role in minimizing aircraft downtime, supporting AOG events, maintaining material availability, and controlling procurement costs in a highly regulated aviation environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Procurement & Sourcing**

* Procure aircraft parts including rotables, expendables, consumables, tooling, chemicals, and repair services.
* Source materials from approved aviation vendors in accordance with company procurement and quality policies.
* Obtain competitive quotes and negotiate pricing, lead times, exchanges, and repair terms.
* Issue and manage accurate purchase orders, ensuring correct part numbers, quantities, pricing, and certification requirements.

**AOG & Expediting**

* Expedite AOG (Aircraft on Ground**)** and critical material requirements to minimize operational disruption.
* Track open orders and proactively resolve delivery delays, shortages, or discrepancies.
* Support emergency and after-hours procurement activities as required.

**Supplier & Vendor Management**

* Maintain effective working relationships with OEMs, distributors, and repair vendors.
* Monitor supplier performance related to quality, delivery, turnaround times, and pricing.
* Support supplier qualification, corrective actions, and maintenance of the Approved Vendor List (AVL).

**Inventory & Material Planning Support**

* Monitor inventory levels to prevent stockouts and minimize excess inventory.
* Support material forecasting and demand planning aligned with maintenance schedules.
* Assist with inventory optimization initiatives, including slow-moving material disposition and consignment programs.

**Quality, Compliance & Documentation**

* Ensure all purchased materials meet FAA and regulatory requirements, including proper airworthiness documentation (FAA Form 8130-3, Certificate of Conformance, traceability).
* Maintain accurate purchasing and supplier records in the CMMS/ERP system.
* Support internal, customer, and regulatory audits by providing procurement documentation.

**Cost Control & Continuous Improvement**

* Support cost-reduction initiatives through strategic sourcing and approved alternate or PMA sourcing.
* Identify opportunities to improve purchasing processes, lead times, and supplier performance.
* Track procurement-related KPIs such as cost savings, on-time delivery, and AOG response.

**Collaboration**

* Work cross-functionally with Maintenance, Engineering, Planning, Quality, and Finance teams to resolve material issues and support operational objectives.

**Required Qualifications**

* High school diploma or equivalent required; Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Business, or Aviation preferred.
* 5–8 years of purchasing or buyer experience, preferably in aviation MRO or a regulated environment.
* Strong understanding of aircraft parts, rotables components, repairs, and aviation documentation.
* Preferred experience in systems like AeroXchange, ILS and Part Base
* Experience using CMMS/ERP systems (e.g., SAP, RAMCO, AMOS, BAAN).
* Strong negotiation, organizational, and communication skills.
* Ability to work under pressure in time-sensitive operational environments.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in an FAA Part 145 Repair Station environment.
* Prior AOG support experience.
* Familiarity with aviation OEMs, distributors, and repair vendors.
* Exposure to PMA parts evaluation and alternate sourcing.
* APICS/CPIM or other supply chain certification.

**Position Summary**
--------------------

**DEFINITION**

The incumbent works under supervision of the appropriate administrator in Business Services, to perform technical duties associated with purchasing commodities and services for the college. Provides comprehensive training and daily assistance to District personnel concerning related activities and promotes and values the mission and vision of the college.

**CLASS CHARACTERISTICS**

The incumbent in this position will work under limited direction and will be assigned technical purchasing duties that require great attention to detail, good working knowledge of subject matter and accounting functions for the assigned office as well as of public educational institutions. Incumbents may serve as a lead worker over entry level incumbents or student workers in the performance of these functions. Incumbents may assist the purchasing supervisor and perform the functions of providing technical support to the purchasing process with specific responsibility for processing purchasing documents, materials responding to related inquiries and maintain vendor/source information and inventories.

**Essential Functions and Qualifications**
------------------------------------------

* Examines and analyzes departmental purchase requisitions for completeness and accuracy of information in accordance with district purchasing policies and procedures; contacts department or initiator to clarify or complete information; determines method to process requisition based on dollar amount and timeliness required.

* Communicates with staff regarding purchasing procedures and requirements; assists departments in initiating requisitions

* Prepares purchase requisitions, and processes all purchase requisitions into purchase orders.

* Distributes purchase order documents and places orders according to established procedures; communicates with personnel, vendors, and various outside agencies to exchange information and resolve any questions, issues or concerns associated with purchase orders.

* Audits all requisitions for accuracy, account codes, backup documentation, appropriate tax rate, fixed asset and bid thresholds, and California Uniform Public Construction Cost Accounting Act (CUPCCAA) requirements in accordance with the college’s purchasing policies and procedures.

* Reviews independent contract agreements and professional service agreements for accuracy, completeness, and full signature execution; confirms the required tax forms are completed correctly; faxes the Notice of Independent Contractor to the California Employment Development Department (EDD).

* Generates annual open purchase orders for Business Services.

* Processes Purchase Order Change Requests for revisions and/or corrections to purchase orders; runs purchasing reports for history of receipts and payments; disencumber and reopen purchase orders.

* Disencumber and reopen purchase orders as needed throughout the year; works closely with accounts payable staff at fiscal year-end to determine which purchase orders can be closed or rolled to the next Fiscal Year (FY).

* Trains all users of financial software system in the requisition and receiving modules; updates and maintains training documents.

* Receipts all incoming district checks and cash received in the business services department; reconciles receipt log with accounts receivable deposit reports to ensure that all checks and cash have been deposited.

* Assists in the maintenance of fixed asset records; confers with department representatives to determine purchasing needs and specifications; communicates with Facilities for generation of a fixed asset tag.

* Assists with the purchasing and tracking of Furniture, Fixtures & Equipment (FF&E) for construction/bond projects.

* Assists in maintaining college credit card program, process related transactions and maintains credit card records.

* Assists in the ongoing maintenance and testing of the current software systems and/or implementation of new software systems and applications.

* Assists with competitive bid process and the preparation of and development of bid documents; coordinates bid schedule with Facilities staff and associate superintendent/vice president of finance and administration (VPFA) office personnel. Submits required public notifications related to formal and informal bids; assists with bid openings and preparation of documents for action by Board of Trustees.

* Processes vendor requests which includes; reviewing W-9 forms, determining vendor type, entering 1099 information if required, maintaining vendor information including creation and updating in the financial software system.

* Processes shipping and receiving requests to add funds to the postage machine.

* Assists purchasing supervisor with a variety of complex and technical duties.

* Assists in assuring compliance with Public Contract Code and established laws.

* Assists with Annual CUPCCAA contractor regis

description:
Life changing therapies. Global impact. Bridge to thousands of biopharma companies and their patients.

**We are PCI.**

Our investment is in People who make an impact, drive progress and create a better tomorrow. Our strategy includes building teams across our global network to pioneer and shape the future of PCI.

**SUMMARY:**

The Buyer II (Direct/GMP or Indirect) is responsible for providing tactical support to the Supply Chain Management operations across all business locations or other Indirect business functions such as Engineering, Facilities, IT, Marketing etc. This position supports the development and execution of manufacturing inventory plans or business plans that achieve optimal customer delivery performance while minimizing total inventory investment and logistics cost or other business costs. This position partners cross functionally to support business growth, improve customer service, and reduce costs.

**ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS-OTHER DUTIES MAY BE ASSIGNED:**

* Provides tactical support to Supply Chain Management operations.
* Negotiates pricing and contract terms with suppliers to reduce business risk and provide favorable commercial outcomes.
* For GMP, evaluates current inventory and material lead times, including analysis of delivery conditions, to ensure that the materials will be available for corresponding activities.
* Monitors purchasing systems and procedures and ensures compliance to company authorizations, policies, and procedures with respect to the purchasing function.
* Researches suppliers, pricing, cost effectiveness, and availability of material and commodities.
* Establishes and maintains vendor relationships and monitors suppliers OTIF.
* Identifies and resolves purchasing related issues for materials and manages suppliers associated with respective commodities.
* Utilizes and assists with implementation of systems (ERP, etc.) to help drive automation/continuous improvement programs.
* Prepares and issues purchase orders and change notices.
* Regular and reliable attendance on a full time basis [or in accordance with posted schedule].
* Responsible for exhibiting professional behavior with both internal and external business associates that reflects positively on the company and is consistent with the company’s policies and practices.
* Embodies Aji Bio-Pharma’s cultural values and aligns daily actions with department goals and company culture.

**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:**

* Bachelor’s degree in a business related discipline or equivalent experience required. Working towards membership of professional body such as ISM, APICs or CIPS.
* Three to four (3-4) years of related experience, including a minimum of 1-2 years in a GMP environment.
* Strategic thinker, able to articulate a clear vision and align the Procurement & Planning strategy to business objectives.
* Proven ability to effectively negotiate with suppliers to achieve desired commercial outcomes for the organization.
* Able to work in an orderly and methodical fashion to solve problems.
* Working knowledge of planning (MRP) and or E-Procurement systems and Source to Pay Process.

The hiring rate for this position is $76,000 - $85,500 plus eligibility for an annual performance bonus. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors, including but not limited to specific and relevant experience, education, credentials, geography, and subject matter expertise. PCI offers full-time employees a competitive benefits package that includes paid time off, health insurance coverage (including dental and vision), a flexible spending account, and a 401(k) plan.

**Join Our Team!**

Join WAVE and play a key role in supporting the procurement activities that keep our manufacturing and business operations running efficiently. As a Procurement Specialist / Buyer I, you will work across multiple functions and locations, partnering with internal teams and suppliers to source materials and services, manage purchasing activities, analyze spending trends, and support strategic procurement initiatives.

This position offers the opportunity to build relationships across Operations, Supply Chain, Finance, Engineering, Maintenance, and supplier partners while gaining exposure to sourcing, supplier management, procurement analytics, compliance, and business operations. Your work will directly contribute to ensuring the right goods and services are available at the right time, cost, and quality to support WAVE's continued success.

We are looking for a proactive, analytical, and customer-focused professional who enjoys solving problems, managing priorities, and collaborating with others to deliver results in a dynamic manufacturing environment.

**Responsibilities**

* Source and procure indirect materials, equipment, services, and maintenance-related purchases that support WAVE operations across multiple locations.
* Manage the purchasing process from supplier quotation through purchase order creation, order tracking, and delivery coordination.
* Evaluate suppliers and sourcing alternatives to support cost savings, quality, service, business continuity, and operational requirements.
* Build and maintain supplier relationships, serving as a primary point of contact for purchasing inquiries, delivery issues, and performance-related concerns.
* Support supplier onboarding, contract administration, and compliance activities, ensuring required documentation and records are maintained.
* Monitor supplier performance and open orders, expediting critical purchases and resolving supply, delivery, or service issues as needed.
* Partner with Operations, Engineering, Maintenance, Finance, and Supply Chain teams to understand business requirements and support purchasing needs.
* Prepare and analyze procurement data, including spend reports, supplier metrics, savings opportunities, and key performance indicators.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance procurement processes, reporting capabilities, supplier engagement, and overall efficiency.
* Ensure procurement activities comply with company policies, sourcing standards, audit requirements, and regulatory obligations.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Desired Experience**

* 2-4 years of experience in procurement, purchasing, sourcing, supplier management, supply chain, vendor management, finance, accounts payable, or related business functions.
* Experience working in a manufacturing, industrial, or multi-site environment preferred.
* Experience utilizing ERP systems, purchasing platforms, supplier portals, or financial systems.
* Experience managing purchase orders, supplier communications, contract administration, spend analysis, or procurement reporting.
* Working knowledge of sourcing methodologies, supplier management, and purchasing processes.
* Experience using SAP, Power BI, Power Apps, or similar business systems preferred.
* Professional certifications or coursework in procurement, supply chain, operations, or business disciplines are a plus.

**Knowledge, Skills & Abilities**

* Understanding of procurement, purchasing, supplier management, and business operations processes.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.
* Effective verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong customer service and relationship management capabilities.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, reporting tools, and ERP systems.
* Ability to analyze purchasing and supplier data to identify trends and opportunities.
* Ability to work collaboratively across functions and organizational levels.
* Continuous improvement mindset with a focus on process efficiency and operational effectiveness.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive business information appropriately.

**Compensation and Benefits**

Hiring Range: $61,583 - $75,383 annually

Individual compensation will be determined based on qualifications, relevant experience, skills, certifications, internal equity, and business considerations.

* Medical, dental, and vision coverage
* Health savings and flexible spending accounts
* 401(k) savings plan with company contributions
* Paid time off and company holidays
* Life and disability insurance
* Employee assistance programs
* Professional development and training opportunities

description:
**About Us:**

**How many companies can say they’ve been in business for over 179 years?!**

Here at ZEISS, we certainly can! As the pioneers of science, ZEISS handles the everchanging environments in a fast-paced world, meeting it with cutting edge of technologies and continuous advancements. ZEISS believes that innovation and technology are the key to a sustainable future and solutions for global change. We have a diverse range of portfolios throughout the ZEISS family in segments like, Industrial Quality & Research, Medical Technology, Consumer Markets and Semiconductor Manufacturing Technology. We are a global company with over 42,000 employees and have over 4,000 in the US and Canada alone! Make a difference, come join the team!

**Location/Region:** Dublin, CA

**What’s the role?**

Working within the Hiring Manager’s team, we are looking for a Strategic Buyer / Category Manager to take responsibility for the strategic management of a dedicated category, such as Electronics, Mechanics, IT Software & Hardware, Third-Party Products, Emitters, or Detectors.

**Sound Interesting?**

**Here’s what you’ll do:**

* Develop and implement cross-site category strategies across the USA, Germany, UK, Italy, China, and India.
* Conduct global market analyses and manage supplier selection, qualification, and performance to meet requirements for quality, service, delivery, cost, risk, innovation, and capability.
* Ensure supply continuity by monitoring industry trends, assessing supplier and market risks, and initiating mitigation measures that strengthen supply-chain resilience.
* Identify and develop new suppliers and propose alternative materials, technologies, or manufacturing processes to support series production and NPI projects.
* Lead national and international commercial and contractual negotiations, and resolve supplier discrepancies relating to quality, delivery, price, or service.
* Develop and apply product cost-driver and total-cost models to benchmark, evaluate, and negotiate prices and deliver agreed savings targets.
* Ensure purchased-product costs, source data, and outline agreements are accurately established and maintained in SAP.
* Lead continuous-improvement initiatives and contribute to standardized procurement policies, procedures, KPIs, materials-management systems, and digital tools.
* Collaborate closely with operational procurement, NPI project buying, manufacturing, quality, project management, and other business partners to implement category strategies and supporting programs.
* Build strong supplier and internal stakeholder relationships and communicate effectively with ZEISS leaders at all organizational levels.

**Do you qualify?**

* At least three years of relevant purchasing experience in one or more technical categories, such as formed or extruded metals, plastics, machined parts, mechanical components, or electrical components.
* Strong technical understanding of the assigned category, high-technology systems, and complex parts.
* Analytical and financial capability to assess suppliers against quality, cost, reliability, innovation, capability, and financial-stability criteria and to evaluate total cost of ownership.
* Strong negotiation skills and sound knowledge of commercial law, contracts, and agency principles.
* Proven project-management capability and solid command of strategic procurement methods and continuous-improvement practices.
* At least one year of SAP experience, preferably in Materials Management, and proficient use of Microsoft Office.
* A structured, data-driven approach, with the ability to manage large data sets and synthesize and present decision-relevant information.
* Excellent interpersonal, collaboration, and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to build effective supplier relationships and work across technical, sales, manufacturing, management, and business-process teams.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, a customer-focused mindset, and the confidence to engage effectively across all leadership levels.
* Initiative, creativity, and persistence in developing and implementing new ideas and solutions.
* Willingness to travel domestically and internationally.
* Fluency in English; additional languages, such as German, Chinese or Hindi are an advantage.
Occasional travel to our headquarters in southern Germany or to suppliers internationally will be necessary—up to 20%.

The annual pay range for this position is $77,000 – $96,000

The pay offered for this role may be influenced by factors such as job location, scope of role, qualifications, education, experience, & complexity/specialization/scarcity of talent.

This position is also eligible for a performance bonus or sales commissions. ZEISS also offers robust benefits, including medical plans, retirement savings plan and paid time off.

**We have amazing benefits to support you as an employee at ZEISS!**

* Medical

* Vision

* Dental

* 401k Matching

* Employ

description:
**Position Summary**

The Supply Chain Planner/Buyer is responsible for the purchased machinery, equipment, tools, parts, supplies, or services necessary for the operation of an establishment. The Planner/Buyer is also responsible for planning the production of and the flow of materials and the purchasing actions for a defined value stream segment. The Planner/Buyer ensures that accurate and appropriate inventory levels are maintained.

**Position Responsibilities- Essential**

* Improves value stream material flow to meet customer demand requirements
* Maintains MRP planning data to ensure system performance
* Monitors inventories, customer demand, and production levels
* Production scheduling activities by monitoring material inventories, tracking progress and production and reviewing factors that affect schedules
* Responsible for the timely execution of product and services sourcing activities
* Responds to NCPs for vendor supplied goods and coordinates corrective actions
* Evaluates, monitors, and reports supplier scorecard performance
* Maintains relationship and communication with supplier base
* Adheres to established company policies, procedures, terms, conditions and legal matters

**Position Responsibilities- Non-Essential/Other**

* Bachelor’s degree in supply chain management/Logistics or another related discipline.
* Working knowledge and understanding of ERP/MRP systems and their use in a manufacturing environment (SAP, Microsoft D365)
* Minimum 2 years of experience as a supply planner-buyer or similar role.
* System/data analysis and critical thinking skills.
* Experience in Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, or other similar Continuous Improvement concepts
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint
* APICS Certification preferred.

**Essential Skills and Experience**

* Experience with databases and query language to manipulate Microsoft D365, Excel.
* Highly Detail Oriented.
* Demonstrate acceptable written and verbal communication skills.
* Work independently and productively.

**Beneficial Skills and Experience**

**Position Summary**

The Supply Chain Planner/Buyer is responsible for the purchased machinery, equipment, tools, parts, supplies, or services necessary for the operation of an establishment. The Planner/Buyer is also responsible for planning the production of and the flow of materials and the purchasing actions for a defined value stream segment. The Planner/Buyer ensures that accurate and appropriate inventory levels are maintained.

**Position Responsibilities- Essential**

* Improves value stream material flow to meet customer demand requirements
* Maintains MRP planning data to ensure system performance
* Monitors inventories, customer demand, and production levels
* Production scheduling activities by monitoring material inventories, tracking progress and production and reviewing factors that affect schedules
* Responsible for the timely execution of product and services sourcing activities
* Responds to NCPs for vendor supplied goods and coordinates corrective actions
* Evaluates, monitors, and reports supplier scorecard performance
* Maintains relationship and communication with supplier base
* Adheres to established company policies, procedures, terms, conditions and legal matters

**Position Responsibilities- Non-Essential/Other**

* Bachelor’s degree in supply chain management/Logistics or another related discipline.
* Working knowledge and understanding of ERP/MRP systems and their use in a manufacturing environment (SAP, Microsoft D365)
* Minimum 2 years of experience as a supply planner-buyer or similar role.
* System/data analysis and critical thinking skills.
* Experience in Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, or other similar Continuous Improvement concepts
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint
* APICS Certification preferred.

**Essential Skills and Experience**

* Experience with databases and query language to manipulate Microsoft D365, Excel.
* Highly Detail Oriented.
* Demonstrate acceptable written and verbal communication skills.
* Work independently and productively.

**Beneficial Skills and Experience**

* Ability to lead projects involving team members that do not report to this role.

FASHIONPHILE is more than just fashion — we’re revolutionizing the ultra-luxury fashion experience in order to create a sustainable alternative that extends the life cycle of products and makes them more accessible to a diverse customer base. As we strive to become the world's most sought-after brand in luxury re-commerce, we know it's our team members who make it all happen! We value diversity in our people, perspectives, and products. For us, it's the only way to cultivate the creativity and innovation essential to achieving our mission and supporting our customers. We do this both in-person and through our digital omni-channel experiences. If you're someone who embraces change, is authentic, and wants to make an impact, this is the place for you.

**About the Opportunity**

We are looking for a resourceful and detailed Luxury Procurement Specialist to join our procurement team at our beautiful facility here in Carlsbad, CA. In this role you will be trained to evaluate and appraise luxury pre-owned handbags and accessories (Hermes, Louis Vuitton, Chanel, Gucci, etc.) from clients online. Working schedule would be Sunday - Thursday. Hours: Monday-Thursday 8-4:30pm and Sunday 9-5:30pm, Responsibilities include:

* Research brand, style, and resale value of pre-owned luxury handbags and accessories
* Assess demand and analyze internal and external sales data to provide accurate and timely quotes to online customers
* Review items in person, including the condition and brand-specific information
* Develop personal strategies for research methods, focusing on efficiency and accuracy

**What We’re Looking For**

* Strong research abilities and extreme attention to detail
* Outstanding written, detail-oriented and verbal communication
* Proficient typing skills (30 wpm+)
* Proactive spirit and wiliness to learn, grow and cross-train departments
* Comfortable working in a corporate office setting, sitting for long periods of time at a computer (8 hours per day)
* Ability to work well both independently and in a collaborative environment
* Previous experience in retail, luxury fashion a PLUS
* Trend Focused mindset with emphasis on pricing judgement

**What We Offer**

* Medical, Dental and Vision Coverage
* FSA options for Medical, Dependent Care & Commuter Benefits
* Paid Time off, Paid Sick Time, and Paid Holidays
* 401(k) with generous match program
* Free Life Insurance and AD&D
* Long-Term Disability Insurance
* Employee Discount

**Pay Rate:** This position begins at $22.00/HR for all new hires into FASHIONPHILE's Carlsbad, CA location. Every Employee will have the opportunity for continued promotional opportunities via our Benchmarking Program which offers Title and Pay changes as you grow with the company.

**Mesa, AZ 85212**
**Job Type:** Full-time
**Schedule:** four day, 10-hour shifts

Phoenix Manufacturing LLC is looking for an experienced **Material Buyer** to support our **CNC machining and aerospace manufacturing operations** while also supporting the **textile side of the business**. This role partners closely with cross-functional teams to ensure customer requirements and deadlines are met.

The ideal candidate is a strong negotiator, skilled in supplier management, material planning, procurement strategy, and team leadership, with experience in a manufacturing environment.

Responsibilities

* Lead procurement and supply chain activities to ensure on-time delivery of raw materials and outside services
* Build strong relationships with internal stakeholders and suppliers to resolve supply issues quickly and effectively
* Develop and execute sourcing strategies across product lines and commodities
* Lead supplier negotiations, strategic purchasing contracts, and supplier agreements
* Drive spend management strategies to improve cost, quality, lead times, risk, and overall supply chain efficiency
* Manage supplier performance through formal assessments, scorecards, and review routines
* Proactively manage material inventory to minimize write-offs and meet customer lead-time commitments
* Maintain standard costs, usage data, bills of material, and costing systems accurately
* Oversee purchasing of production and non-production items
* Create purchase orders for raw materials and outside processing in accordance with production schedules
* Track material status and communicate delivery timelines to internal teams
* Communicate with vendors regarding schedule changes, delivery performance, and material availability
* Lead purchasing KPIs and variance analysis routines
* Recommend and improve procurement policies and procedures
* Ensure procurement records are maintained from origination through completion
* Manage and lead procurement team members
* Provide guidance and direction by presenting procurement options and recommendations
* Develop a working knowledge of Falcon’s products and processes to support schedule stability, lead-time accuracy, and load-leveling
* Learn and support the textile side of the business as needed

Qualifications

* Minimum **10 years of progressive procurement or supply chain experience in aerospace**, OR **Bachelor’s Degree** in Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Logistics, Business Administration, or related field preferred, plus **5 years of relevant experience**
* Strong Excel skills
* Strong negotiation skills
* Ability to read specifications and aerospace drawings
* Understanding of material requirements, outside processing requirements, and quality standards
* Strong analytical and decision-making skills
* Experience collecting and analyzing data
* Experience managing a team of at least 5
* Experience with ERP systems
* Experience in **Aerospace CNC Manufacturing** or **Aerospace Hardware**
* Familiarity with lean manufacturing concepts, such as **5S, Lean, and Six Sigma**
* Experience with **DoD, DLA, and aerospace prime purchasing/contracts**
* Knowledge of **FAR and DFAR**
* Familiarity with databases such as **Partsbase, Govgistics, DIBBS, and Qualified Products Database**
* Prior experience working with local Phoenix outside process vendors and material suppliers preferred

Work Environment

This position is primarily office-based but requires regular time on the manufacturing floor. The shop is heated and air-conditioned, and noise levels are typically high due to industrial machines.

Physical Demands

* Frequent walking, standing, typing, and computer use
* Regular reaching, moving, talking, seeing, and hearing
* Must be able to lift and/or move up to **40 pounds**
* Close vision, distance vision, and color vision required

Benefits

* Health insurance
* Dental insurance
* Vision insurance
* Health savings account
* 401(k) with Matching
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Relocation assistance

* 401(k)

* Vision insurance

* Do you have experience with FAR, DFARS, DoD, DLA, or aerospace prime purchasing requirements?
* What ERP systems have you used?
* Are you able to work on-site in Mesa, AZ?
* What is the salary range you are interested in?

The Buyer II performs purchases of commercial and non-commercial products and services for purchases up to the simplified acquisition procedures (SAP) with a current dollar threshold of $250K.

* Generates/reviews purchase order modifications when applicable.

Under minimal supervision, while planning and conducting assignments.
* Plans and conducts wide range of assignments. Assignments are broad in nature, requiring originality and ingenuity. The methods applied and regulatory and requisition compliance of the completed work are not normally reviewed or checked. Only new work is reviewed for regulatory and requisition compliance. The Procurement Specialist will receive requirements from program representatives and will source for approved manufacturers, suppliers, and distributors for the requested products and services, issue Request for Quotes (RFQ) and respond with pricing and availability for all material or pricing and turn-around times for repair services. For captured contracts, the Buyer will receive purchase requisitions, validate requirements from corresponding source, and issue POs in accordance with program contractual requirements, within the signature authority and established process, and utilize the company’s Enterprise Resource and Planning (ERP) System. Oversee the RFQ and Purchase Order requirements from issue through material delivery or completion of services, and coordinate, track, and expedite all open items. Research and identify alternate Sources of Supply (SOS) or sources of repair (SOR) to improve performance and value to the program and customer. Interface with SOS/SOR representatives, Quality Manager, Maintenance Manager, and Accountable Manager to coordinate logistical requirements for a total supply chain and repair delivery solutions. Document all actions into database systems supporting the repair facility; furnish data and reports as required; initiate follow-up action to ensure timely delivery of requested products.

A sample of duties include, but are not limited to:

* Receive and evaluate departmental or program requisitions, identify potential suppliers and analyze and select appropriate procurement methods based on established procurement requirements and best value criterion.
* Administer and direct procurement and competitive bids, conduct evaluations and determine best value, analyze supplier responses and make recommendations for award.
* Execute purchase orders in accordance with applicable company procurement regulations, policies and procedures.
* Confer with and provide direction to departmental and program personnel regarding specifications, complaints and special issues related to procurement; and monitor, investigate and perform problem resolution
* Research and recommend new supply sources to support the efficient delivery of services and equipment.
* Provide training of new procurement staff, through entire procurement processes, such as bid development, pre-bids and the evaluation/award process.
* Assist with researching and developing necessary procurement data and the submission of required procurement reports.
* Proactively identify process improvement opportunities and support continuous improvement initiatives, including identifying and recommending procurement opportunities to further procurement strategies.
* Maintaining constant communication with Program Management to ensure customer requirements are met.
* Perform other duties as assigned at the discretion of management.
* Represent S&K with professional demeanor at scheduled events and during virtual WebEx meetings with customers. Travel in support of conferences, meetings, reviews, and other related activities.
* Working knowledge of FAR/DFAR and other applicable regulations in government contractor administrative support to include operations, accounts payable, purchasing, and CDLR tracking is preferred.
* Must be able to communicate professionally and concisely to customers and employees of the organization.
* Must demonstrate ethics, responsibility, confidentiality, professionalism, punctuality, consistent dependability, and ability to multi-task.

**Education**

* Associates Degree in Business, Logistics, or Supply Chain Management from an accredited university/college required. Related work experience may be substituted for education requirements (2 years of related experience is equivalent to 1 year of college).

**Experience**

* 2 - 3 years’ experience in private or public sector contract administration, purchasing, vendor management, procurement card, accounting, finance, or a closely related field.

**License, Cert or Registration**

* Current drivers’ license, proof of U.S. citizenship or proof of authorization to work in the U.S. and the ability to satisfy a background investigation to obtain a security clearance.
* Within 12 months of hire, must possess one of the following certifications:
* **1-****Institute for Supply Management (ISM)**
Accredited Purchasing Practitioner (A.P.P.)
Certified Purchasing Manager (C.P.M.)
Certified Professional in Supply Management (CPSM)
* **2- Council of Supply Chain Management Professionals (CSCMP)**
SCPro Level One
SCPro Level Two
SCPro Level Three
**Other Equivalent Certification**

### **Description**

The role of the Buyer is to price, quote, and purchase any required materials for the installation of fire protection systems that are currently not produced by the Company. The position analyzes cost, quality, and delivery to ensure competitive performance that is consistent with the organization’s policies and standards.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Receives quote requests from Customer Service Representatives in an assigned territory for required materials
* Analyzes quotes and negotiates prices and terms with suppliers to obtain competitive sources with respect to cost, quality, delivery and service
* Updates weekly meetings with order and quote totals from the previous week
* Follows up on orders placed with vendors
* Analyzes and reviews stock orders for proper quantities prior to placement
* Procures tracking on all stock orders and drop shipments placed
* Assists in maintaining inventory accuracy by removing C-items and obtaining RMA’s
* Maintains weekly quote logs on all inquiries and reports the breakdown
* Analyzes and reviews the SAC102 report before placing all stock orders with vendors
* Reports all discrepancies and/or issues to the vendors in a timely manner and follows up as needed
* Reviews weekly backorder reports from vendors and expedites shipping to the warehouse
* Promote a safe workplace by performing all tasks in a safe and thoughtful manner in compliance with all rules, procedures, instructions, devices, equipment and use of appropriate personal protective equipment. Maintain vigilance for any hazardous conditions or practices in the workplace and immediately report any unsafe condition or practice to your supervisor.
* Performs other duties as directed

### **Skills, Knowledge & Expertise**

* Creates an atmosphere in which timely and high quality communication flows smoothly
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills
* Outstanding customer service and negotiation skills
* Excellent time management and organization ability
* Outstanding attention to detail and accuracy
* Works systematically and logically to resolve problems
* Solid understanding of common business practices relating to purchasing, pricing, terms, shipment, taxes and payment for products and services
* Working knowledge of the terminology of the fire protection industry
* Familiar with markets and commodities/component types related to fire protection systems
* Strong technical knowledge of company products
* Proficient in Microsoft Office, DRP, Elite, Dynamics 365
* High School Diploma
* 2 + years in Purchasing, Supply Chain, Logistics, and/or Related Field

### **Job Benefits**

* Medical, Dental, Vision and FSA are available after 30 days of employment
* 401k with company match is available after 90 days of employment
* Company-provided Life Insurance is provided for you after 90 days of employment
* 3 PTO days after 60 days of employment (hourly and non-exempt positions only)
* 2 weeks of vacation after 6 months of employment
* 10 paid holidays - including your birthday!
* Paid weekly

A house of brands, Anvil, Gruvlok, Sharpe, SCI, and ABZ, unified as ASC in 2019, and the portfolio has grown in the years since.

Sprinklers, valves, and accessories, made in the United States. More than a century later, the discipline has not changed. A century of American-made fire protection products, with multi-generational customer relationships and multi-decade specifications. A century of protecting what matters the most.

**Two legacies. One Future.**

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.\\*

**Job Description:**

**Buyer**
---------

**Reports To:** Supply Chain Manager

**Job Summary**
---------------

The Buyer is responsible for procuring the materials, components, supplies, and equipment required to support business operations. This role focuses on executing the procurement process, including supplier selection, purchase order management, vendor communication, price negotiations, inventory support, and ERP system maintenance. The Buyer works closely with internal teams and suppliers to ensure the timely availability of materials while maintaining quality, cost, and delivery expectations.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**
-----------------------------------------

* Identify and evaluate vendors for materials, components, supplies, and equipment required by the business.
* Obtain quotations, analyze pricing and lead times, and negotiate favorable terms to achieve the best overall value.
* Review material requirements from internal departments and create purchase orders within the ERP system.
* Communicate with suppliers to confirm receipt of purchase orders and ensure adherence to required delivery dates.
* Calculate and maintain appropriate purchase quantities for stocked inventory items.
* Monitor open purchase orders and proactively follow up with suppliers to meet delivery commitments and expedite orders when necessary.
* Resolve purchasing and supplier-related issues, including damaged goods, incorrect shipments, shortages, and invoicing discrepancies.
* Track and evaluate supplier performance, including quality, responsiveness, on-time delivery, and lead-time adherence.
* Establish and maintain standard costs within the ERP system.
* Collaborate closely with Sales, Engineering, Production, and other departments to align purchasing activities with current production requirements and future demand forecasts.
* Support inventory management initiatives by balancing material availability with inventory investment objectives.
* Perform other duties and special projects as assigned.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Logistics, or a related field preferred; or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
* Minimum of 2-4 years of experience in purchasing, procurement, supply chain, inventory management, or a closely related field.
* Experience working within an ERP system and managing purchase orders, supplier communications, and inventory transactions.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

**Competencies**
----------------

* Proficiency with ERP and supply chain management software.
* Strong decision-making skills to effectively manage purchasing activities and inventory levels.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively with internal teams, suppliers, and external partners.
* Strong negotiation skills with the ability to secure favorable pricing, lead times, and supplier agreements.
* Ability to analyze and reconcile inventory transactions while identifying opportunities for process improvements.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
* Technical aptitude with the ability to understand product function, specifications, and applications.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and competing priorities.
* Ability to build and maintain effective working relationships with suppliers and cross-functional business partners.
* English language proficiency required; additional language skills are a plus.

**Compensation Information:**

The pay range for this position is $60,000 - $90,000 per year. Compensation within this range will be based on factors such as experience, skills, education, training, and internal equity. In addition to base pay, eligible employees may participate in company sponsored benefits and other applicable incentive opportunities.

*ITW is an equal opportunity employer. We value our colleagues’ unique perspectives, experiences and ideas and create workplaces where everyone can develop their careers and perform to their full potential.*

*As an equal employment opportunity employer, ITW is committed to equal employment opportunity and fair treatment for employees, beginning with the hiring process and continuing through all aspects of the employment relationship.*

*All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, national origin, age, disability, protected Veteran status or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws.*

We’re seeking a positive and motivated individual who embodies our Core Values of Consistency, Adaptability, Reliability, and Teamwork (CART) to join our team as a Purchasing & Procurement Specialist.

The Procurement Specialist will assist in coordinating the movement of rental products, purchasing, sub-renting, and transferring equipment as needed. They will support the sales team by providing product availability and pricing while also working closely with vendors. The Procurement Specialist reports to the Strategic Procurement Manager.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Create and maintain inventory line items in Sage.
* Coordinate, follow up on, and confirm physical inventory counts as needed.
* Make inventory adjustments and update counts accordingly.
* Write and manage purchase orders (POs) and sub-rentals.
* Monitor and respond to purchasing emails daily.
* Execute warehouse transfers of rental products.
* Monitor and manage our Transfer Dashboard
* Work with vendors to obtain product and service information, including pricing, availability, and delivery schedules.
* Monitor miscellaneous items as needed.
* Manage and track graphic or decal requests.
* Assist production teams with damaged product management, including adjustments and transfers.
* Assist with the distribution of new or missing items to design centers.
* Participate in project work, including Big Sale and TNT counts management.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**Work Conditions:**

* Primarily office-based, with some warehouse exposure (some areas may not be heated or air-conditioned).
* Reasonable accommodations will be provided to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.

**Schedule, Compensation, and Benefits:**

* 9:30am – 6:00pm Monday - Friday
* Full-time
* Pay: $50,000 / year
* Health, dental, vision, and 401(k) eligibility after 60 days.
* 96 hours PTO annually (prorated based on hire date).
* Employee rental discounts and referral program.

**Qualifications and Requirements:**

* Completed a bachelor's degree in business, supply chain, or a related field (preferred).
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Word.
* Strong math skills (fractions, percentages, and ratios).
* Excellent customer service and communication skills.
* Detail-oriented with strong organizational and record-keeping abilities.
* Ability to multi-task, prioritize, and thrive in a fast-paced environment.
* Proficiency in English (written and verbal) is required.
* Must complete a 5-minute Behavioral Assessment through the Predictive Index.
* Must pass a company background check and limited drug screen (excludes marijuana).

description:
KDC is a network of best-in-class custom formulators and manufacturers of color cosmetics, skincare, haircare, bath & body, fragrance, deodorant, home, health, industrial, and auto care products. KDC delivers high-touch innovation, operational excellence, and speed to market to well-known and emerging beauty, personal, and specialty companies from coast to coast. KDC has its head office in Longueuil, Québec. In addition, KDC has 10 operating facilities located throughout North America. Altogether, the company employs nearly 4,800 talented and dedicated employees in North America.

Purchasing Buyer-Supply Chain

kdc/one | Groveport, OH | Onsite

kdc/one is a global leader in custom formulation, package design, and manufacturing solutions for beauty, personal care, and home care brands. The company focuses on high-touch innovation, operational excellence, and rapid speed to market for many of the world’s most recognized brands. Supported by approximately 15,000 employees, kdc/one develops and launches thousands of products each year. The organization co-develops products for more than 1,000 brands, offering exposure to diverse projects and markets for team members.

Are you a purchasing professional who enjoys negotiating, solving problems, and making sure the right materials are available when they’re needed? kdc/one is looking for an experienced Buyer to join our Supply Chain team in Groveport, Ohio.

This is an onsite opportunity where you’ll play an important role in supporting production, managing supplier relationships, controlling costs, and keeping materials flowing efficiently.

Why Join kdc/one?

We believe great people deserve more than just a job. We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support you both at work and beyond, including:

* Competitive compensation based on experience
* 5% annual bonus opportunity
* Medical, dental and vision benefits
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid Time Off (PTO)
* Company-paid holidays
* Career growth and development opportunities
* And more!

What You'll Do

* Purchase raw materials, equipment, tools, parts, supplies and services to support production needs
* Review material requirements and utilize MRP to plan purchasing activities
* Negotiate and manage vendor costs while meeting site requirements
* Build and maintain strong supplier relationships while monitoring cost, quality and service
* Place purchase orders and coordinate delivery schedules
* Monitor inventory levels, lead times and supplier capacity
* Expedite or delay deliveries as customer and production needs change
* Maintain accurate material information and purchasing data in SAP
* Partner with Quality, Production, Finance, Inventory Control and suppliers to resolve material and purchasing issues
* Review and approve purchasing documentation and invoices
* Help manage slow-moving and obsolete inventory
* Support continuous improvement of purchasing processes and workflows

What We're Looking For

* 3+ years of experience in a Buyer/Purchasing role
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering or a related field preferred; equivalent manufacturing experience will be considered
* Manufacturing experience strongly preferred
* Experience with SAP/ERP systems and MRP
* Strong negotiation, problem-solving and organizational skills
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across departments
* APICS or C.P.I.M. certification is a plus

The Environment

This is an onsite role based at our Groveport manufacturing facility. While you'll spend time in an office environment, you'll also regularly interact with our production floor and warehouse operations.

**Location:** Groveport, OH

If you're ready to take the next step in your purchasing career and make a direct impact on operations, we'd like to hear from you.

Seniority Level

Mid-Senior level

Industry

Industrial Machinery Manufacturing

Employment Type

Full-time

KDC-ONE is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, age, sex, gender, disability or any other characteristic protected by law. I understand that employment with KDC-ONE Company is at-will, meaning that I or KDC-ONE Company may terminate my employment at any time, or for any reason consistent with applicable state or federal law. I understand that KDC-One requires the successful completion of a drug and/or alcohol test as a condition of employment.

Aid RMS purchasing team and site project managers to ensure parts are available to support shop schedules. Attend weekly shop production meetings and coordinate purchasing actions. Develop and implement shop consumable programs with suppliers. Negotiate and Implement VIM hardware, machine tool automated vending for cutters, and safety supplies as well as driving cost saving opportunities. This position will also monitor open orders across Engineered to order commodities including shipments, deliveries and schedules to ensure dates are achieved.

ORGANIZATIONAL

* Exceptional attention to detail.
* Display ownership and accountability for tasks and responsibilities.
* Exceptional ability to manage competing priorities.

INTERPERSONAL

* Excellent interpersonal and customer service skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to work independently.
* Ability to work and interact professionally and respectfully with coworkers.

EFFECIENCY

* Ability to manage other projects and responsibilities that may be added at the company’s discretion.
* Exceptional ability to multitask, prioritize, and manage time and resources effectively.
* Excellent time management skills with a proven ability to meet deadlines.

* Quoting, negotiating and order placement of MRO and emergency job commodities.
* Implementation of VIM system for standard hardware and shop support items.
* Purchase indirect shop tooling, cutters, and consumables.
* Implementation of cost saving strategies / volume discounts etc. for MRO buy.
* Create and Process emergency purchase orders to support shop turnaround schedules on weekends.
* Establish supplier promise dates per quoted lead-times.
* Track shipments as needed.
* Monitor and expedite open orders and delivery requirements in Job Boss to support PLW Houston.
* Maintain current delivery dates for production in Job Boss system.
* Manage yearly shop calibration orders.
* Coordinate and resolve nonconforming / deviation request with quality control and engineering.
* Supplier development of local supply chain to reduce lead time for support items.
* Work with engineered to order commodity leaders to maintain schedules and coordinate supplier best practices.
* Attend and hold open-order meetings with lead buyers for assigned commodities.
* Develop and add new suppliers to RMS ASL per purchasing evaluation process.
* Create and submit shipping and requests to RMS shipping receiving department to have material sent to outside services for processing.
* Support Inventory validation / cycle counting and maintenance yearly (Houston)
* Travel to supplier locations for order surveillance when as required by purchasing.
* Other purchasing related tasks as required.

* Department processes
* Negotiation methods

Overview:

***Purchasing Agents*** at Schuff Steel master the art of buying misc. steel materials by navigating competitive markets, high material costs, managing volatility, and ensuring uninterrupted production through strategic sourcing using the ERP/MRP system and other internal tools. Purchasing agents are also responsible for the outsourcing of all rolled, bent, cut and/or drilled plate as well as other produced material to fulfill production requirements. #LI-KF1

1

Responsibilities:

* **Procurement and Supplier Management**
+ Sourcing materials
+ Negotiating contracts
+ Managing supplier relationships
+ Monitoring performance
+ Budget cost controls
+ Obtain and compare quotes from mills, service centers and distributors
+ Evaluate suppliers based on price, availability lead time and quality
+ Purchase all materials to schedule, special requirements, location, and budget
+ Review material and determine best nested requirement and buy materials
+ Accurately process purchase orders in a timely manner
+ Stays knowledgeable on all current market conditions and adjusts buying patterns accordingly.
* **Inventory Control**
+ Monitor stock
+ Forecast demand
+ Minimize costs
+ Coordinate with production to prevent shortages/overstocking
+ Implement Just-in-Time (JIT) strategies as appropriate
+ Track material usage and waste
* **Logistics and Delivery Coordination**
+ Schedule deliveries to align with fabrication timelines
+ Arrange freight and transportation as/if needed
+ Track shipments and resolve delays
* **Coordination with Project Management, Production Planning, Production, and Field**
+ Review advanced bill of materials
+ Clarify material grades and certifications meet ASTM standards
+ Communicate lead times to all internal departments
+ Support change orders and material revisions
+ Provide purchasing schedule for each project to internal departments
+ Offers technical assistance on specific product(s)
* **Risk Management**
+ Anticipate supply chain disruptions
+ Develop backup suppliers for critical materials
+ Manage contract risks and terms
* **Quality and compliance**
+ Ensure materials meet required specifications
+ Obtain mill test reports (MTRs)
+ Resolve material discrepancies or defects with suppliers
* **Process Improvement**
+ Analyze supply chain data, identify bottlenecks, and develop strategies to enhance efficiency and reduce costs
+ Develop and implement new strategies and workflows for procurement, inventory, and logistics
+ Optimize the entire flow of goods and services from sourcing to delivery

*(This job description is not an exclusive or exhaustive list of all job responsibilities and functions that an employee in this position may be asked to perform. Above statements describe the general nature and level of work being performed. Duties and responsibilities can be changed, expanded, reduced or delegated by management to meet the business needs of the company)*

Qualifications:

**Education & Experience:**

* High school diploma or equivalent
* Three to five (3-5) YOE in a Purchasing Agent/Buyer role within the steel fabrication or structural steel construction industry

**Software & Technology:**

Description:

**Build a Stronger Supply Chain With Us**

Custom Profile is looking for an experienced Senior Buyer who can turn supply challenges into smart, practical solutions. As an employee-owned manufacturer of specialty thermoplastic profile extrusions and sub-assemblies, we serve a blue-chip customer base from locations in Grand Rapids, Michigan; Camden, South Carolina; and Juarez, Mexico. Our in-house tooling capabilities give us greater control over quality and lead times—and our collaborative culture gives employees the opportunity to make a visible impact.

**What You’ll Do**

* Plan and execute raw-material procurement using MRP, Kanban and other demand signals.
* Build strong partnerships with scheduling, manufacturing, sales, engineering and key suppliers.
* Lead MRO sourcing, purchasing and analysis in coordination with Production and Maintenance.
* Manage inventory accuracy through cycle counts, root-cause analysis and corrective action.
* Optimize MRP, source-list and material-master parameters, and proactively communicate availability risks.
* Partner with Program Management to secure materials for launches and engineering changes.
* Drive inventory, service and cost performance with production, scheduling and suppliers.
* Maintain accurate ERP data, including pricing, lead times, order quantities, safety stock and purchase-order details.
* Keep Safety Data Sheets and Technical Data Sheets current.
* Monitor purchase orders in IQMS and follow through to support on-time delivery.
* Lead or support RFQs, negotiations, cost-savings initiatives and supplier evaluations.
* Collaborate with Quality and suppliers to resolve nonconforming raw-material issues.
* Take on special projects and assignments as business needs evolve.
* Champion continuous improvement and help make Custom Profile safer, more efficient and more enjoyable.

Requirements:

**What You Bring**

* At least five years of materials management and resin procurement experience.
* Personnel management experience.
* Hands-on ERP/MRP experience.
* A bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, Operations or a related field is preferred, but not required.
* APICS certification is preferred, but not required.

**How You’ll Thrive**

* You understand supply-chain principles and know how to apply them in a manufacturing environment.
* You bring strong analytical, planning, organizational and negotiation skills.
* You communicate clearly and build productive working relationships.
* You are a self-starter who stays effective under pressure and adapts quickly to changing priorities.
* You are proficient with Microsoft Office.

**Work Environment & Physical Requirements**

* Ability to lift and/or move up to 50 pounds.
* Use of safety glasses, hearing protection and closed-toe shoes on the production floor.
* Occasional travel, primarily local.

**Ready to Make an Impact?**

If you are energized by solving supply challenges, developing supplier partnerships and improving how work gets done, we invite you to apply for the Senior Buyer opportunity at Custom Profile.

Description:

Pilatus is hiring a Procurement Manager to join our team in Sarasota, FL. In this role, you will be responsible for maintaining supplier performance in accordance with agreed contractual terms and real-time business needs. Pilatus is a global company based in Switzerland with a worldwide supplier base and this position is focused on the suppliers located in North America. The primary focus is resolution of issues that require face-to-face onsite presence, on short notice and over an extended period of time. The position is expected to be forward-thinking and to recommend and implement strategies for improving supplier performance and meeting production and customer support requirements. Take your career to the next level with Pilatus Aircraft USA Ltd.

* Assists with proactive and successful management of assigned suppliers within the North American supplier portfolio
* Hold suppliers accountable to contractual obligations, commitments, and Key Performance Indicators
* Solves crisis and secures execution of recovery plans.
* Perform supplier risk analysis, develop and execute mitigation actions that protects Pilatus’s production plan
* Communicate proactively with all Pilatus supply chain stakeholders
* Escalate issues when needed according to roles and responsibilities
* Travel on short notice for in-person supplier visits as required
* Support ongoing supplier management tasks
* Build and maintain strong relationships with suppliers and the procurement team in Switzerland
* Collaborate with internal departments and stakeholders, including leading projects and meetings
* Support tracking of supply chain KPIs
* Participate actively in the improvement of procurement processes and management of cross-divisional projects
* Participate in special projects as required
* Act as liaison for procurement activities in European and North American Pilatus offices

Requirements:

**Skills/Qualifications**

* Minimum B.S. in Supply Chain Management or equivalent; graduate degree is an advantage
* Minimum 5 years of experience in a supply chain and/or procurement role in the aircraft industry
* Experience with business intelligence tools and supply chain analytics
* Willingness and ability to travel both domestically and internationally, sometimes on short notice
* Ability to develop relationships and interact effectively with both internal and external stakeholders across varied business areas
* Good knowledge in lean principles and tools
* Experience with ERP/MRP software
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools (Word, Excel, Outlook)
* This position involves access to technology that is subject to U.S. export controls. Any job offer made will be contingent upon the applicant’s capacity to serve in compliance with U.S. export controls.

This is an individual contributor role with no direct people-management responsibilities.

The hiring range is $68,000 - $94,000 per year. This range represents Pilatus Aircraft USA Ltd.’s estimate of the compensation reasonably expected for this position at the time of posting. Actual compensation will be determined based on factors including relevant skills and experience, education, job location, internal equity, market data, and business considerations. The hiring range may be modified in the future based on business or market conditions. Any bonus, incentive compensation, benefits, or other forms of compensation are subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable plans, programs, and policies and may be modified in accordance with applicable law.

Interested and qualified candidates should submit their application as soon as possible. Please note that this announcement may close at any time; early applications are encouraged.

With over 3,000 employees and about 200 apprentices at its headquarters in Stans, Switzerland, completion center in Broomfield, Colorado, and multiple service centers across Westminster, MD, Rock Hill, SC, Chamblee, GA and Sarasota, FL, the Pilatus family unites people from over 40 countries. We offer a secure, innovative, international, and sustainable work environment. Courage, vision, and outstanding performance have made us a strong company. Our culture is shaped by a high level of quality awareness, close customer relationships, and a high degree of employee commitment.

**We Deliver the Goods:**

* Competitive pay and benefits, including Day 1 Health & Wellness Benefits, Employee Stock Purchase Plan, 401K Employer Matching, Education Assistance, Paid Time Off, and much more
* Growth opportunities performing essential work to support America’s food distribution system
* Safe and inclusive working environment, including culture of rewards, recognition, and respect

**Job Summary:**

Coordinate and identify suppliers of product, negotiate price and quantity terms and establish long-term contracts to ensure adequate supply of high quality products for Foodservice Distribution at competitive prices. Maintain established service levels for product in-stock. Assist with special order requests. Functions as a team member within the department and organization, as required, and performs any duty assigned to best serve the company.

**Job Responsibilities:**

* Maintain multi-line product replenishment from vendors and suppliers at competitive market pricing.
* Generate purchase orders.
* Maintain adequate inventory levels to ensure superior service levels to customers and sales team through use of industry standard Best Practice procedures.
* Negotiate prices for special promotions and programs.
* Achieve established gross profit levels while maintaining a competitive cost basis through negotiation and relationship development.
* Interact and communicate both written and verbally with sales team, customers and vendors in a timely and informative manner on market conditions, delivery schedules, and product information.
* Work in an environment that requires teamwork and the ability to work independently to maintain required job parameters.
* Develop interpersonal relationships which encourage openness, candor, and trust, both internally and externally.
* Identify and discount specific products that are slow moving, as well as dispose of the obsolete inventory by returning it to the vendor.
* Performs other related duties as assigned.

High School Diploma/GED or Equivalent Experience

3+ years' foodservice distribution experience or 1+ years' purchasing experience

Proficient with Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel)

Demonstrated excellent organizational and time management skills

Performance Foodservice, PFG’s broadline distributor, maintains a unique relationship with a variety of local customers, including independent restaurants and hotels, healthcare facilities, schools, and quick-service eateries. A team of sales reps, chefs, consultants, and other experts builds close relationships with customers — providing advice on improving operations, menu development, product selection, and operational strategies. The pay range is $95,000.00 - $171,000.00

Pay is based on several factors which vary based on position. These include labor markets and in some instances may include education, work experience and certifications. In addition to your pay, Target cares about and invests in you as a team member, so that you can take care of yourself and your family. Target offers eligible team members and their dependents comprehensive health benefits and programs, which may include medical, vision, dental, life insurance and more, to help you and your family take care of your whole selves. Other benefits for eligible team members include 401(k), employee discount, short term disability, long term disability, paid sick leave, paid national holidays, and paid vacation. Find competitive benefits from financial and education to well-being and beyond at https://corporate.target.com/careers/benefits.

**About us:**

Working at Target means helping all families discover the joy of everyday life. We bring that vision to life through our values and culture. Learn more about Target here.

A role in Buying means working with several diverse vendors to choose the best product mix, both in-store and online. We help determine where to localize, while calibrating market positioning and acting as brand managers. Here, you’ll own a wide SKU count so that your work is varied and challenging. Through cross-functional collaboration, instinct and creativity, you will be the expert on the guest, the market and the competition.

A **Senior Buyer** helps create omni-channel growth by planning profitable and locally relevant assortments using your grasp of guest shopping behavior, assortment requirements and competitors. You will influence and negotiate with vendors to achieve results and identify gaps and opportunities. Your flexibility in reacting to business results and your ability to translate financial metrics and data into actionable strategies will be critical. You will lead cross-functional teams to drive category results while managing progress toward sales and margin goals. Your partnerships with product designers and/or category mangers and vendors will help guide product development as you source appropriately for your category. You will interact with Associate Buyers, Senior Merchandise Specialists, the Pricing and Promotion Center of Excellence, Planning, Site Merchandising, the Item Center of Excellence and many other expert partners in support of your promotional planning work across channels.

Core responsibilities of this job are described within this job description. Job duties may change at any time due to business needs.

**About you:**

* Four-year degree or equivalent experience
* 4+ years of Merchandising experience
* Strong strategic and analytical skills to grow a business
* Strong collaboration skills to partner with cross-functional team
* Flexible, resilient and comfortable working in “grey areas” that are constantly changing

This position will operate as a Hybrid/Flex for Your Day work arrangement based on Target’s needs. A Hybrid/Flex for Your Day work arrangement means the team member’s core role will need to be performed both onsite at the Target HQ MN location the role is assigned to and virtually, depending upon what your role, team and tasks require for that day. Work duties cannot be performed outside of the country of the primary work location, unless otherwise prescribed by Target. Click here if you are curious to learn more about Minnesota.

**Benefits Eligibility**

Please paste this url into your preferred browser to learn about benefits eligibility for this role: https://tgt.biz/BenefitsForYou\\_E

**Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA)**

In compliance with state and federal laws, Target will make reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities. If a reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, please reach out to candidate.accommodations@HRHelp.Target.com. Non-accommodation-related requests, such as application follow-ups or technical issues, will not be addressed through this channel.

Application deadline is : 10/16/2026
