At Revlon, we create beauty innovations for everyone that inspire confidence and ignite joy every day.

Breaking beauty boundaries is in our company's DNA. Since its game-changing launch of the first opaque nail enamel in 1932 (and later, the first long-wear foundation), Revlon has provided consumers with high-quality product innovation, performance, and sophisticated glamour. Elizabeth Arden made waves as a woman-led beauty company in the 1920s. In 1931, Almay became the original hypoallergenic, fragrance-free beauty brand.

Today, Revlon resiliently continues its legacy as a leading global beauty company. Our diverse portfolio—which consists of some of the world's most iconic brands and product offerings in color cosmetics, skincare, hair color & care, personal care, and fragrances—is sold around the world through prestige, professional, mass, and direct-to-consumer retail channels. These brands include Revlon, Revlon Professional, Elizabeth Arden, Almay, American Crew, CND, Cutex, Mitchum, Sinful Colors, Creme of Nature, Christina Aguilera, John Varvatos, Juicy Couture, Ed Hardy and more.

We honor our heritage, embrace change, and applaud diversity. We champion our employees and celebrate our consumers.

We are Revlon, together, transforming beauty.

**This role is an Onsite Role:** This role requires full-time presence at our Oxford, North Carolina office.

**Overview:**

The **MRO Buyer II** is responsible for procuring the MRO (maintenance, repair, and operations) goods and services which keep the plant running effectively. At the highest level, this position must be internal customer focused; striving to provide the highest quality service and support to our internal customers while providing the most optimal total cost for MRO products and services. This position requires a strict attention to detail, excellent communication, and follow-up skills. The ideal candidate for this role must be very organized, highly motivated, and able to multi-task in a fast-paced environment.

**Responsibilities:**

* Assist Storeroom Manager with development of purchasing strategy for select MRO categories, including but not limited to considerations of spot buys vs. long-term contracting
* Resolve supplier issues relating to quality, delivery, and pricing
* + Monitor and document vendor performance
* Support management in strategic MRO cost savings projects
* Cooperate with production, maintenance, engineering, and other departments in the development of MRO material requirements, facility services, and indirect spend
* Determine most cost-effective and efficient methods for ordering (e.g., bulk orders)
* Track usage, inventory cost, YOY savings and spend of all indirect materials and services
* Identify alternative vendors or products that meet the specifications (In- Kind Replacement)
* Assist with the creation and compliance of MRO processes within and across departments to provide a reliable storeroom of critical spare parts
* Utilize Reports to trace and monitor Maximo purchase orders (open orders/back orders/late lines), and effectively communicate with the Stores Manager, engineering, maintenance, and production personnel of item availability, order lead-time and order status
* Maintain Maximo files, records and documents related to all purchasing activities including primary and alternate vendor sources, vendor pricing, MFG name/MFG#, drawings, machine information (serial numbers), work order information for future referencing.
* Maintain accurate lead-times and ROP/EOQ for optimal inventory levels, adjust conversion factors and standard costs as required.
* Track and report KPI's: (On-time delivery, service rate, stock out analysis, etc.)
* Process new item setups and commodity code assignments
* Process POs in SAP, receive all purchased items by approving invoices through ARIBA and resolve all invoice conflicts associated with accounts payable
* Assist with cycle count program, processes, and training; perform root-cause analysis, record, and report findings; utilize data for improvement initiatives.
* Investigate and resolve inventory discrepancies as required.
* Serve as a primary contact in Central Stores for customer issues or concerns; ensure issues or concerns are resolved quickly and to the customers' satisfaction.
* Work with team members to develop/improve processes for continuous improvement initiatives.
* Works with cross-functional teams (Maintenance Areas) for E&O determination / parts standardization / improvements / new setups / zero balance inventories
* Manage P-Card orders in Maximo and SAP Concur
* Assist with internal customers at the parts counter when required.
* Maintain safety standards and appearance of facility (GMP) as it pertains to their working environment.
* Other Duties as Assigned

**Who you are:**

* Minimum of 5 years MRO Purchasing experience
* Computer literacy, advanced level of Microsoft Excel experience to include pivot table development and other features
* An abili

About Us:

Flow Control Group (FCG) is a leading provider of fluid handling, process, and industrial automation solutions across North America. We are a 100% employee-owned organization made up of over 3,000 team members and 115+ entrepreneurial brands, each empowered to think big, move fast, and bring innovative ideas to life.

At FCG, we believe in the power of partnership and entrepreneurship. We work collaboratively across our brands to drive growth, unlock new opportunities, and deliver real impact for our customers, combining local expertise with national strength.

Visit our Website: flowcontrolgroup.com

Job Description:

**Position Summary:**

The Senior Buyer is responsible for sourcing and purchasing materials, components, fabricated products, and services supporting the company’s manufacturing and distribution operations. This role will focus on products and engineered solutions sold to data-center customers, including air compressors, pumps, valves, piping systems, fabricated skids, and related equipment.

The successful candidate will have extensive purchasing experience in both manufacturing and distribution environments, strong knowledge of ERP and material-planning systems, and the technical ability to understand engineered products, drawings, specifications, bills of material, and customer requirements. This position will work closely with Engineering, Operations, Sales, Quality, Inventory Management, and suppliers to ensure materials are available at the right cost, quality, and delivery performance.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Source and purchase air compressors, pumps, valves, piping components, fabricated skids, motors, controls, instrumentation, and related materials used in data-center applications.
* Manage purchasing activities for both stocked distribution products and engineered-to-order manufacturing projects.
* Review customer requirements, bills of material, engineering drawings, specifications, and production schedules to determine material requirements.
* Issue requests for quotation, analyze supplier proposals, negotiate pricing and commercial terms, and issue purchase orders.
* Develop sourcing strategies that improve product availability, reduce total cost, shorten lead times, and strengthen supply-chain continuity.
* Work closely with Engineering and Project Management to source technically compliant components for custom skid packages and integrated systems.
* Monitor purchase orders, supplier acknowledgments, production schedules, and delivery commitments to ensure materials arrive on time.
* Identify potential material shortages, long-lead-time items, and supply risks before they affect customer delivery or manufacturing schedules.
* Maintain accurate purchasing data within the ERP system, including supplier information, pricing, lead times, order quantities, and delivery dates.
* Use ERP-generated demand, inventory levels, forecasts, customer orders, and production requirements to make purchasing decisions.
* Balance inventory availability with working-capital objectives, stocking policies, customer demand, and service-level expectations.
* Negotiate supplier pricing, payment terms, freight terms, warranties, stocking agreements, and other commercial conditions.
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with manufacturers, distributors, fabricators, and strategic supply partners.
* Evaluate supplier performance based on quality, delivery, cost, responsiveness, and technical capability.
* Participate in supplier business reviews, corrective-action activities, and supplier-development initiatives.
* Collaborate with Quality Assurance to resolve supplier nonconformances, defective materials, documentation issues, and corrective actions.
* Support cost-reduction, value-engineering, standardization, and supplier-consolidation initiatives.
* Assist Sales and Estimating with supplier quotations, material costs, lead times, and sourcing strategies for data-center opportunities.
* Ensure purchasing activities comply with company policies, contractual requirements, customer specifications, and applicable quality standards.
* Maintain appropriate purchasing documentation, supplier records, quotations, certifications, and audit trails.
* Perform other supply-chain and purchasing responsibilities as assigned.

**Education and Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Engineering, Operations Management, or a related discipline required.
* Minimum of seven years of progressive purchasing, sourcing, or supply-chain experience.
* Demonstrated purchasing experience within both manufacturing and distribution environments.
* Experience sourcing industrial equipment and components such as air compressors, pumps, valves, piping, controls, instrumentation, fabricated assemblies, or skid-mounted systems strongly preferred.
* Experience supporting data-center, mission-critical infrastructure, industrial construction, mechanic

description:
**About the Role:**

The Purchasing Agent plays a critical role in managing the procurement process to ensure that the organization acquires goods and services at the best possible cost, quality, and delivery terms. This position involves evaluating suppliers, negotiating contracts, and maintaining strong vendor relationships to support operational efficiency and cost-effectiveness. The Purchasing Agent collaborates closely with internal departments to understand their needs and align purchasing strategies accordingly. By monitoring market trends and supplier performance, the agent helps mitigate risks and identify opportunities for savings and process improvements. Ultimately, this role ensures that the supply chain operates smoothly, supporting the organization's overall business objectives and growth.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* High school diploma or equivalent; bachelor’s degree in business, supply chain management, or related field preferred and 3 years purchasing experience required Or an equivalent combination of relevant education and/or experience.
* Proven experience in purchasing, procurement, or supply chain roles.
* Strong understanding of purchasing procedures and contract negotiation.
* Proficiency with procurement software and Microsoft Office Suite.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in business administration, supply chain management, or a related discipline.
* Certification such as Certified Professional in Supply Management (CPSM) or Certified Purchasing Professional (CPP).
* Experience working with ERP systems like Meditech, Lawson, and Oracle
* Knowledge of relevant laws and regulations affecting procurement.
* Demonstrated ability to analyze market trends and supplier performance data.

**Responsibilities:**

* Identify and evaluate potential suppliers to ensure quality, cost-effectiveness, and reliability.
* Negotiate prices, terms, and contracts with vendors to secure advantageous purchasing agreements.
* Process purchase orders and ensure timely delivery of goods and services to meet organizational needs.
* Collaborate with internal teams such as production, finance, and logistics to forecast demand and coordinate procurement activities.
* Monitor supplier performance and resolve any issues related to quality, delivery, or compliance.
* Maintain accurate records of purchases, pricing, and supplier communications for reporting and auditing purposes.
* Stay informed about market trends, new products, and industry developments to make informed purchasing decisions.

**Skills:**

The Purchasing Agent uses negotiation skills daily to secure favorable terms and build strong supplier relationships, ensuring cost savings and quality compliance. Analytical skills are essential for evaluating supplier proposals, market trends, and purchase data to make informed decisions that align with organizational goals. Communication skills facilitate effective collaboration with internal teams and external vendors, ensuring clarity and efficiency throughout the procurement process. Proficiency with procurement software and ERP systems enables the agent to manage purchase orders, track deliveries, and maintain accurate records seamlessly. Additionally, problem-solving skills are applied to address supply chain disruptions or quality issues promptly, maintaining operational continuity.

description:
**Purchaser/Buyer Agent**

**Join Our Team:**

We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive **Purchaser/Buyer Agent** to join our growing team. This role is responsible for managing the purchasing process from order placement through fulfillment, building strong vendor relationships, negotiating competitive pricing, and ensuring timely delivery of products. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys problem-solving, and excels at coordinating with suppliers, customers, and internal teams.

If you are highly organized, customer-focused, and enjoy working in purchasing with vendors and sales teams to keep operations running smoothly, we'd love to hear from you.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Create, process, and manage purchase orders with suppliers, vendors, and manufacturers.
* Coordinate product procurement and fulfillment to ensure accurate and timely delivery.
* Negotiate pricing, terms, and delivery schedules with suppliers to maximize value and cost savings.
* Maintain strong relationships with vendors and manufacturers while monitoring supplier performance.
* Track and follow up on order status, shipments, backorders, and delivery schedules.
* Process and distribute purchase orders, invoices, and related purchasing documentation.
* Review and analyze purchasing reports and ad hoc data to support business decisions.
* Ensure customer requirements are accurately communicated and executed, including:
+ Product specifications and configurations
+ Quantity increases or decreases
+ Split shipments and multiple orders
+ Special customer requirements
+ Multiple shipping locations
* Serve as a liaison between suppliers, customers, sales teams, and internal departments regarding order status, updates, delays, and fulfillment issues.
* Resolve purchasing and fulfillment discrepancies while maintaining a high level of customer service.
* Maintain accurate records and data within company systems and purchasing platforms.

**Qualifications Required:**

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Excel and Word.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong customer service and relationship-building abilities.
* Exceptional attention to detail and organizational skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong problem-solving and follow-up skills.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.

**Preferred:**

* Experience in purchasing, procurement, order management, supply chain, inside sales support, or related roles.
* Knowledge of IT, technology, or Audio Visual (AV) products and solutions.
* Experience working with ERP systems such as NetSuite, Quosal, or similar platforms.
* Experience negotiating pricing and managing vendor relationships.

**What You'll Bring:**

* A sense of urgency and ownership.
* Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills.
* A customer-first mindset.
* The ability to build productive relationships with suppliers and internal stakeholders.
* A commitment to accuracy, efficiency, and continuous improvement.

**Compensation & Benefits:**

* Competitive salary
* Medical, dental, and vision coverage
* 401(k) plan
* Paid vacation
* Additional company perks

**About GST**

About Golden Star Technology (GST)
Founded in 1985 and headquartered in Cerritos, CA, Golden Star Technology (GST) is a leading provider of IT and AV solutions, serving businesses, enterprise organizations, educational institutions, and government agencies nationwide. Through strategic partnerships with industry-leading technology manufacturers, GST delivers innovative solutions, customized services, and exceptional customer support.

Recognized by the Los Angeles Business Journal as one of LA's Best Places to Work for seven consecutive years, GST has also earned numerous industry awards and accolades for excellence, growth, innovation, and customer service. Our success is driven by a commitment to teamwork, integrity, accountability, and continuous professional development.

For more information, please visit www.gstinc.com

Are you a highly organized and detail-oriented Buyer ready to be at the center of a fast-paced manufacturing environment? Exxelia is seeking a dedicated individual to manage purchasing activities for our manufacturing goods and services. In this role, you will be instrumental in a variety of essential functions, from preparing and tracking purchase orders to negotiating with suppliers to ensure cost-effectiveness and timely delivery. If you're a proactive problem-solver with a knack for building strong supplier relationships, this is an excellent opportunity to make a tangible impact on our operational success.

**Responsibilities**

* Manage all purchasing activities by preparing, approving, and tracking purchase orders, ensuring accuracy in the Sage MRP system, and resolving any issues related to specifications, pricing, or delivery with suppliers.
* Cultivate and maintain strong relationships with suppliers through regular communication and negotiation of pricing, quality, and delivery schedules.
* Collaborate with the sourcing team to identify and evaluate new and alternative suppliers for specific commodities and custom designs.
* Partner with the production staff to maintain inventory accuracy in the Sage MRP system for automatic re-order points.
* Work closely with the Quality Assurance team to uphold and improve purchasing standards in line with ISO, AS9100, and 13485 regulations.
* Contribute to overall operational goals by partnering with the Finance team on reporting and inventory management, and by participating in planning and decision-making to achieve targets in product cost, quality, inventory, and delivery.
* Facilitate product validation, first article inspection, incoming inspection, and source inspection processes.
* Manage and resolve invoice discrepancies.
* Perform additional duties as assigned.

**Required Qualifications**

* Experience as a Buyer or similar role in a manufacturing environment.
* Proven ability to source, select and manage a diverse supply base.
* Intermediate to advanced proficiency in Excel.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Office and Google Workspace.
* High school diploma or equivalent.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Hands-on experience with an MRP system, inventory management and cost/price analysis.
* Working knowledge of manufacturing standards – ISO, 13485, FDA, AS9100.

Exxelia is committed to equal opportunity for all, without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, citizenship, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or any other protected characteristic.

Job Type: Full-time

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Application Question(s):

* Will you now, or in the future, require sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g. H-1B visa status)?

Ability to Commute:

* Longwood, FL 32750 (Required)

Work Location: In person

It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they are doing!

We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.

### **Position Summary**

The Equipment Buyer is responsible for the procurement and inventory management of equipment, replacement parts, components, and related materials that support equipment sales, manufacturing, service, and operational activities. This role ensures the timely acquisition of materials from approved suppliers while maintaining appropriate inventory levels to meet customer demand and business objectives.

In addition to purchasing responsibilities, the Equipment Buyer supports shipping and receiving activities, coordinates equipment logistics, provides shipment tracking and status updates, and assists Equipment Operations through inventory management, order fulfillment, and continuous improvement initiatives. This position works closely with Equipment Engineering, Commercial, Manufacturing, Warehousing, Customer Service, and Operations teams to ensure the efficient execution of equipment orders and projects.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Process and manage purchase orders for equipment, replacement parts, components, fabricated assemblies, and related materials from approved suppliers.
* Monitor supplier acknowledgments, lead times, delivery schedules, and open purchase orders to ensure timely material availability and order fulfillment.
* Expedite orders and proactively resolve supply delays, shortages, backorders, damaged shipments, receiving discrepancies, and other supplier-related issues.
* Maintain accurate purchasing, supplier, inventory, and item master data within company ERP systems.
* Manage inventory levels by monitoring reorder points, safety stock levels, lead times, and inventory performance to minimize stockouts while optimizing inventory investment.
* Support inventory accuracy through cycle counts, audits, transaction management, and ongoing review of inventory-related activities.
* Coordinate inbound and outbound shipments with suppliers, carriers, warehouses, and internal stakeholders, including freight coordination, shipment tracking, receiving support, and inventory transfers.
* Provide timely shipment status updates and tracking information to internal teams and customers to ensure clear communication and on-time delivery.
* Support Equipment Operations through inventory planning, order fulfillment, project coordination, and material availability for equipment builds, service activities, installations, and customer commitments.
* Maintain equipment-related records, purchasing documentation, operational data, and order status information.
* Collaborate closely with Equipment Engineering, Commercial, Manufacturing, Service, Warehousing, Customer Service, and Operations teams to support equipment projects and customer requirements.
* Participate in continuous improvement initiatives focused on procurement efficiency, inventory optimization, logistics performance, and operational excellence.
* Maintain a customer-focused mindset while identifying opportunities to improve purchasing processes, inventory management, order fulfillment, and overall operational effectiveness.

### **Travel**

* Minimal travel required, approximately 5%.

### **Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Operations Management, Logistics, or a related field preferred.
* Equivalent combinations of education, training, and relevant experience will be considered.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel; experience with Microsoft Dynamics or other ERP systems preferred.
* Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* High level of accuracy, attention to detail, and data integrity.
* Ability to effectively manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Demonstrated ability to work both independently and collaboratively across cross-functional teams.
* Customer-focused mindset with a commitment to delivering exceptional service to internal and external stakeholders.
* Must be eligible to work in the United States without sponsorship now or in the future.
Must live within commutable distance of Sharonville, OH.

Job Title: **GLOBAL SUPPLY CHAIN PLANNER / BUYER**

Department: Supply Chain

Reports To: Supply Chain Manager

Job level: P2

Band: 7

FLSA Status: Exempt

Hours/Work Days: 40 hours per week (Monday through Friday)

Telecommuting Eligibility: In Office

Location: Essex Junction, VT

Last update (date): March 2026

**PRIMARY EMPLOYMENT OBJECTIVES**

The Global Supply Chain Planner is responsible for translating demand into executable supply plans that ensure material availability, optimize inventory levels, and support global operations across Revision’s supply network.

This role owns supply planning, inventory positioning, and mid- to long-term material readiness, coordinating closely with internal stakeholders and external partners—including international assembly operations—to ensure alignment between demand, supply, and operational execution.

The position serves as a key cross-functional leader within the organization, directly interfacing with Finance, Operations, Product Management, and Marketing to align supply chain decisions with business objectives. This role oversees the planning and procurement of inventory, ensuring the right materials are available at the right time while balancing cost, service, and working capital.

**SPECIFIC ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Supply Planning & ERP Ownership**

* Translate demand forecasts, customer orders, and business inputs into supply and purchasing requirements using ERP systems (Syteline)
* Define and maintain planning inputs including lead times, order policies (safety stock and reorder points), and planning assumptions
* Review and validate system-generated planning outputs to ensure accuracy and feasibility

**Inventory Strategy & Management**

* Define and maintain target inventory levels across finished goods and components
* Balance service levels, inventory investment, and operational constraints
* Identify and proactively manage risks related to shortages, excess inventory, and obsolescence
* Drive actions to optimize inventory health and support business performance

**Global Supply Coordination**

* Coordinate material flow and supply requirements between U.S. operations and international assembly partners
* Ensure materials are available in the right location at the right time to support production schedule
* Align supply timing with production plans, assembly operations, and business priorities

**Supply Risk Identification & Resolution**

* Proactively identify constraints, shortages, and risks impacting production and customer delivery
* Lead cross-functional recovery planning with Operations, Logistics, and Scheduling
* Communicate material risks, impacts, and mitigation plans clearly to stakeholders
* Escalate critical supply risks and trade-offs to Supply Chain leadership

**SIOP Support & Planning Integration**

* Own supply-side inputs into the SIOP process, including supply plans, inventory projections, and constraints
* Partner directly with:
* + Finance to align inventory strategy with working capital and financial targets
+ Operations to ensure production feasibility and schedule alignment
+ Product Management & Marketing to support product launches, demand changes, and lifecycle planning
* Ensure alignment between demand signals and supply capabilities across the organization

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Serve as a primary point of contact for material availability and supply-related decisions
* Communicate regularly with production and assembly teams on:
* + Critical inventory delivery dates
+ Shortages and constraints (e.g., “hot items”)
+ Recovery plans and priorities
* Ensure alignment between planning outputs and operational execution

**Performance Monitoring & Continuous Improvement**

* Develop and track key supply chain metrics, including, inventory turns, service levels, shortages and backorders, and planning accuracy
* Identify and implement improvements in planning processes, ERP parameters, and supply chain performance
* Drive increased visibility and clarity in supply chain decision-making through data and reporting

**KNOWLEDGE, SKILL & EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS**

* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, or related field
* 5+ years of experience in supply chain planning, material planning, or operations planning
* Strong experience with ERP/MRP systems (Syteline preferred)
* Deep understanding of supply chain planning concepts (lead times, safety stock, demand variability)
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Ability to operate independently and make informed decisions
* Advanced Excel skills and data analysis capability
* U.S. Government Authorization required.

**WORK ENVIRONMENT (****include physical requirements****)**

* Office environment with interaction with manufacturing environment
* Some travel may be required to Revision Suppliers

**Job Description**
===================

Procures materials and services through negotiation techniques. Reviews requisitions to determine that proper specifications or purchase descriptions are included in solicitation documents. Evaluates bids or proposals for compliance with specifications or purchase descriptions and applicable clauses. Procurement obligation authority limited to $35,000.

**Duties and Responsibilities**

- Procures hardware, office supplies, project parts material, cryogenics, gasses, fuels, and other commodities. May administer Blanket Purchase Agreements (BPA).

- Procures commodities using Firm Fixed Price and Time and Material contract types.

- Develops, prepares, and presents, requirements and terms and conditions in requests for bids or proposals.

- Negotiates and awards purchase orders with a value not to exceed $35K. May assist on purchase orders with a value in excess of the authority limit.

- Administers the terms and conditions of purchase orders and evaluates vendor performance.

- Analyzes proposed prices/costs. Evaluates technical and audit reports, forecasts price trends and other economic factors necessary to make an award.

- Provides Procurement support to the inventory manager, warehouse personnel, and receiving inspectors at Greenbelt and Wallops Flight Facility.

- Completes actions independently and makes recommendations based on nature of assignment, experience, and judgment.

- Reviews inventory records to identify purchase orders which should be closed based on receiving documentation and updates current status in AMMS.

- Performs clerical and other tasks required to maintain the purchase order files in proper order.

- Complies with the Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR), Uniform Commercial Code (UCC), TRAX Purchasing Manual, and contracting principles; laws, regulations, policies, and procedures governing contractor procurement for a federal agency.

- Contacts vendors to obtain information on the status of open purchase order and advises Material Coordinators and Buyers of latest status.

- Coordinates with vendors, Receiving, Inventory Management, Procurement, Accounting and Physical distribution personnel, as required, to resolve shipment/receiving discrepancies.

- Performs other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications**
==================

**Required Skills and Qualifications**

- Two years procurement, acquisition and contracting experience.

- Associate degree in business, economics, accounting, finance, or another business-related field.

- One year of relevant professional-level work experience may be substituted for one year of required education. Relevant professional-level experience is defined as work experience must be at a professional-level in Federal Purchasing and Acquisitions.

- Specialized experience which has equipped the applicant with knowledge of the Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR), Uniform Commercial Code (UCC) and contracting principles; laws, regulations, policies, and procedures governing the Federal Purchasing/Acquisition process.

- Experience with large ERP supply and accounting systems.

- Experience in cost/price analysis and negotiation techniques.

- Experience with Cost and Price analysis and purchases that are awarded on a competitive or noncompetitive basis.

- Experienced in purchasing in a Certified Purchasing System (CPS) environment is desired.

- Intermediate or advanced skills in Excel are required.

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

- Highly developed analytical, critical thinking and problem-solving skills.

- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail is a top priority.

- Must share a commitment to maintaining a positive, collaborative work environment while simultaneously optimizing individual performance and contribution.

**Physical Demands and Working Conditions**

- The work of this position is performed in an environmentally controlled office environment.

- Must be capable of sitting and entering data on a computer keyboard for extended periods of time.

- Must be able to view computer monitor for extended periods of time.

- Reasonable accommodation can be made to enable people with disabilities to perform their duties and responsibilities

- Must be a U.S. Citizen.

- Must possess a valid driver's license, without special restrictions.

- Must be able to successfully complete a background screening.

- Must possess or be able to obtain a public trust clearance prior to employment and maintain public trust clearance for the duration of employment.

Department: Engineering

Location: Dallas, TX

Shift: M-F 8A-4:30P

Job Type: On-Site

**Why Children's Health?**

At Children's Health, our mission is to Make Life Better for Children, and we recognize that their health plays a crucial role in achieving this goal.

Through our cutting-edge treatments and affiliation with UT Southwestern, we strive to deliver an extraordinary patient and family experience, ensuring that every moment, big or small, contributes to their overall well-being.

Our dedication to promoting children's health extends beyond our organization and encompasses the broader community. Together, we can make a significant difference in the lives of children and contribute to a brighter and healthier future for all.

Summary:

The Materials Procurement Specialist II is a valued position for the Procurement Team of Engineering at Children's Health Systems of Texas (CHST). This individual will contribute to all aspects of the rapid flowing Procurement Program, which applies to Dallas & forty-eight off-site campuses. As a team player, it is the shared responsibility of the Procurement Specialists to cost-effectively maintain the inventory of Engineering to ensure, that the department has the appropriate supplies, tools, parts, and equipment needed to create a safe and functioning environment for patients and staff. This specialist is also responsible for maintaining detailed records of what has been distributed to all Engineering personnel, to monitor the frequency of use for accountability, and inventory replenishment. Furthermore, The Materials Procurement Specialist must also simultaneously monitor the multi-million dollar engineering materials budget, making certain that all Purchase Orders for materials & outside services are properly processed, paid and closed; while maintaining detailed records of all expenses for creating monthly reports.

Responsibilities:

* Maintaining Inventory: The primary responsibility of the Procurement Team is to ensure that Engineering has the parts, supplies, tools, and equipment needed to keep Children’s Hospital facilities operating at safe capacities. The Materials Procurement Specialist II must be familiar with the on-hand inventory, identifying high frequency moving items, and the keeping of appropriate stock levels maintained. The equipment and supply area must be kept organized, labeled, and sectioned to accommodate each division within the department, so that parts and supplies can be found easily and quickly. These departmental divisions include Electricians, Plant Operators, Painters, Lock Smiths, and Maintenance Mechanics; for the main campus, and 48 offsite locations.
* Maintaining Tools and Equipment: The Procurement Specialist II must contribute to maintaining the tools and equipment for Engineering. Tools and equipment that are used for check out & return need to be inventoried and checked weekly, to ensure that they are functioning safely for use; this is for any possible emergency that may occur. This individual must make sure that Tools loaned out to employees are returned in a timely manner, and in good condition. When issued tools become damaged or lost, (discuss with supervisors as needed) replacement tools must also be kept on-hand at all times to allow operations to continue seamlessly without delay. Damaged or lost equipment must be repaired or replaced as soon as possible. For tools that are permanently assigned to an Engineering employee at the time of hire, the Procurement Specialist must ensure that they are documented and returned upon the day the employee is no longer with the company.
* Research: A major responsibility of this position is reviewing all purchases to ensure that specific standards are met for product quality, price, availability, and lead times for delivery. The procurement Specialist II must thoroughly research all parts, supplies, tools, and outside services that are needed, to guarantee good quality that is also cost effective. This involves contacting manufactures, and appropriate vendors to determine which ones have the most cost effective pricing, with the most suitable E.T.A. It is essential for the Procurement Specialist to be familiar with our main vendors, their products, and the dependability of their service. This person must utilize good communication with the requesting Engineers to gain a full understanding of all parts being requested to order, what they are needed for, why they are needed, and determining which parts will be needed again. This type of research is important for building the inventory, and reducing the possibility of errors that lead to return procedures. At Children's Health, our mission is to Make Life Better for Children, and we recognize that their health plays a crucial role in achieving this goal.

Through our cutting-edge treatments and affiliation with UT Southwestern, we strive to deliver an extraordinary patient and family experience, ensuring that every moment, big or small, contributes to their overall well-being.

Our dedication to promoting children's health extends beyond our organization and encompasses the broader community. Together, we can make a significant difference in the lives of children and contribute to a brighter and healthier future for all.

Summary:
  
The Materials Procurement Specialist II is a valued position for the Procurement Team of Engineering at Children's Health Systems of Texas (CHST). This individual will contribute to all aspects of the rapid flowing Procurement Program, which applies to Dallas & forty-eight off-site campuses. As a team player, it is the shared responsibility of the Procurement Specialists to cost-effectively maintain the inventory of Engineering to ensure, that the department has the appropriate supplies, tools, parts, and equipment needed to create a safe and functioning environment for patients and staff. This specialist is also responsible for maintaining detailed records of what has been distributed to all Engineering personnel, to monitor the frequency of use for accountability, and inventory replenishment. Furthermore, The Materials Procurement Specialist must also simultaneously monitor the multi-million dollar engineering materials budget, making certain that all Purchase Orders for materials & outside services are properly processed, paid and closed; while maintaining detailed records of all expenses for creating monthly reports.

* Maintaining Inventory: The primary responsibility of the Procurement Team is to ensure that Engineering has the parts, supplies, tools, and equipment needed to keep Children’s Hospital facilities operating at safe capacities. The equipment and supply area must be kept organized, labeled, and sectioned to accommodate each division within the department, so that parts and supplies can be found easily and quickly. At Midrex, you will do work that matters alongside people who believe you matter. The work won’t be easy, but it will be worth it. You’ll be part of a great team—with plenty of autonomy—to bring out your best. And you’ll be well compensated and have a best-in-class benefits package. Take a look:

* Competitive benefits effective from Day 1

* Dollar-for-dollar 401(k) matching (up to 6%)

* Profit sharing with 401(k) kicker

* Generous overtime for qualified positions

* 4 weeks of paid vacation

* Tuition reimbursement

* Raffles for professional sports tickets

* Half-day Fridays

* Flexible home/office work practices

* Paid time to volunteer

* Employee recognition awards

Since 1987, Midrex has been the world leader in direct reduction technology, offering the best proven method for decarbonization in the iron and steel industry available today. Our rapid growth is transforming the steel industry and our planet. And none of it would be possible without our people, who bring vision, compassion, and extraordinary expertise to this work every day. So, if you’re looking to do big work in a small-team environment, Midrex is just the place for you.

The Junior Buyer / Expeditor provides purchasing and expediting support for industrial machinery and materials for domestic and international projects. Duties frequently require negotiation to achieve results.

**Supervisory Responsibilities:**

* None

**Duties/Responsibilities:**

* Review requisitions for completeness, issue inquiries to qualified vendors, and coordinate technical reviews
* Analyze vendor quotations for compliance with requisition requirements. Develop relationships with vendors to obtain favorable delivery, schedule, price, and commercial terms and conditions
* Place purchase orders for technical items and large volume commodity items in coordination with project schedules utilizing current ERP and MRP systems.
* Provide frequent, timely and results-oriented vendor expediting to verify and influence manufacturing schedules, shipping schedules or drawing/document submittal schedules.
* Utilize the ERP System as it relates to the Project Procurement Department's expediting functions (i.e. update all salient schedule milestones for material acquisition, manufacturing progress, shipping schedule/actual, etc.).
* Utilize the file sharing and MRP System in all aspects as they relate to the Project Procurement Department's expediting functions.
* Monthly maintenance of the Estimate to Complete (ETC) Spread Sheet for multiple projects that lists anticipated vendor billings and anticipated revenues from clients.
* Liaise with either/both Midrex Global Logistics and the clients' designated freight forwarders to effect shipments.
* Establish and keep current the individual Purchase Order files within the ERP System regarding expediting matters.
* Attend the weekly shipping meetings and utilize the information gained to update the ETC's per project.
* Establish lines of contact with Midrex site management to ensure that all field purchase orders are accurate

**Skills/Abilities:**

Required:

* Strong communication skills, both written and verbal
* Ability to learn and take on new responsibility
* Organized with attention to detail
* Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite or related software
* Ability to build relationships with all levels of suppliers' staff and Company teammates

Preferred:

* Experience in an industrial work environment or internship
* Working knowledge of ISO related requirements
* Proficient with a typical ERP system
* Proficient with a typical MRP document control systems

**Education and Experience:**

* High school diploma, post-high school or Bachelor of Science / Bachelor of Arts Degree preferred in Engineering or Business Administration

**Travel Requirements:**

* 0% - 10% International and Domestic based on project demands

**Physical Requirements:**

* Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
* Ability to move around a project site, including climbing structures.

**Other Duties:**

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Midrex is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing employment opportunities to all qualified individuals without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or any other protected status in accordance with all applicable laws. In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, Midrex will provide reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities and encourages both prospective and current employees to discuss potential accommodations with the People and Culture department.

description:
**Commodity Buyer**

**Autocar, LLC**

**Location Birmingham, AL**

Are you a strategic thinker with a passion for supplier relationships, cost optimization, and supply chain excellence? Join **Autocar**, one of the most respected names in the vocational truck industry and play a key role in shaping the future of our supply chain.

As a **Commodity Buyer**, you will be part of a dynamic and collaborative supply chain team responsible for developing and implementing sourcing strategies for key commodities. This role offers the opportunity to work cross-functionally with engineering, supplier development, manufacturing, and supplier partners to drive quality, innovation, cost savings, and operational excellence.

**What You'll Do**

In this role, you will:

* Perform daily procurement activities supporting prototype, development, and production requirements
* Manage logistics, quality, and financial interactions with suppliers
* Develop, negotiate, and implement commodity strategies that improve supplier performance and maximize value
* Lead supplier negotiations and establish supply agreements aligned with business objectives
* Contribute technical and commercial roadmaps while actively participating in the Autocar buyer network
* Drive initiatives focused on Quality, Delivery, Cost, Project Management, and Risk Mitigation
* Partner with Engineering and Supplier Development teams to identify, monitor, and mitigate supply chain risks
* Forecast cost trends and identify opportunities for cost reduction and continuous improvement
* Build strong relationships with internal stakeholders and external suppliers to ensure supply chain success

**What You Bring**

We are looking for candidates who will demonstrate:

* A collaborative mindset and desire to work toward a common purpose
* Strategic thinking with the ability to understand both internal and external market dynamics
* Flexibility and adaptability in a fast-paced environment
* Strong communication and influencing skills
* Analytical problem-solving abilities with a systematic approach
* Process-driven decision making and execution
* High integrity and commitment to doing what is right
* The ability to build lasting supplier and stakeholder relationships

**Preferred Qualifications**

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Business, or a related field preferred

**Experience**

* 2+ years of purchasing or buyer experience preferred
* Recent engineering graduates with a strong interest in supply chain and procurement are encouraged to apply
* Automotive or commercial vehicle industry experience is a plus
* Experience working in complex supply chain environments preferred

**Skills**

* Proven supplier negotiation and relationship management skills
* Strong business acumen and agility in decision making
* Knowledge of sourcing processes, systems, tools, and methodologies
* APICS, CPIM, CSCM, or other supply chain certifications are advantageous
* Ability to translate data into actionable insights and communicate effectively with stakeholders
* Strong customer focus with the ability to adapt to changing priorities and requirements

**Why Autocar?**

At Autocar, we build trucks that work as hard as the people who depend on them. Our employees are empowered to make an impact, challenge the status quo, and contribute to a culture of continuous improvement and innovation.

When you join Autocar, you'll be part of a team that values:

* Accountability
* Collaboration
* Innovation
* Customer Focus
* Professional Growth

If you're ready to help drive sourcing excellence and contribute to a world-class supply chain organization, we'd love to hear from you.

**Location: Birmingham, AL**

* **Birmingham is one of the Southeast’s most dynamic and affordable cities**, recognized nationally as a growing business hub and an attractive destination for professionals. The area offers a lower cost of living than many major metropolitan markets, a thriving culinary and entertainment scene, and convenient access to lakes, parks, and weekend destinations throughout the region.
* **Enjoy the best of both worlds**—our Autocar facility is located just **20 minutes from downtown Birmingham**, providing easy access to the city’s amenities while maintaining a convenient commute.

**About Autocar**

Autocar, LLC headquartered in Birmingham, AL, is not just another severe-duty vocational truck manufacturer - we built America’s first motor truck. description:
**What You’ll Do**

The Senior Buyer – Subcontracted Manufacturing at Johnson Screens is responsible for advanced procurement activities, including supplier negotiations, supplier performance management, and the maintaining strategic supplier relationships. This role requires a strong understanding of procurement and manufacturing processes as well as the ability to drive cost-effective sourcing decisions while maintaining quality standards and delivery commitments.

The position will primarily support engineering and the New Brighton manufacturing facility by managing outsourced/subcontracted production activities. Responsibilities include collaborating with internal stakeholders to understand requirements, setting up operating systems to manage flow of information and process steps, communicating specifications and expectations to suppliers, quoting with multiple sources of supply, comparing supplier capabilities, issuing purchase orders, and tracking orders through delivery. The Senior Buyer is accountable for ensuring suppliers deliver high-quality products on time to meet both production schedules and customer delivery commitments.

* Manage procurement records, SAP settings, subcontracted production routers, POs, and like items to ensure accuracy in order details, supplier agreements, and pricing.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure that material and service needs align with production schedules and operational requirements.
* Influencing cross-functional teams and projects to ensure successful execution based on supply base’s ability to meet lead times and pricing.
* Conduct RFQs (Request for Quote) on applicable parts including searching for and validating new suppliers with more advantageous terms and capabilities.
* Create routers in SAP for subcontracted manufacturing steps as well as guiding engineering on these steps through the BOM creation process.
* Creating purchase orders and subcontracted work orders and processing them through procurement and planning systems.
* Ensuring purchased goods meet quality, quantity, and delivery standards.
* Building and maintaining strong relationships with key suppliers.
* Managing planning parameters and stock levels to ensure adequate lead time and inventory on hand while avoiding overstocking.
* Monitoring MRP and project plans to plan purchases and minimize stockouts.
* Ensuring all purchases comply with company policies and industry regulations.
* Maintain accurate records of purchases, contracts, and supplier information.
* Review and analyze purchase requisitions and ensure accurate order placement in line with company standards, updating planning parameters and routers when requisitions are not aligned to actual project or production needs
* Preparing reports on purchasing activities, inventory at suppliers, costs, and supplier performance and other key performance metrics.
* Monitor supplier performance and communicate any delivery or quality issues to Procurement Leadership.
* Assist in supplier evaluations and participate in supplier development initiatives.
* Negotiate with suppliers to obtain favorable terms, pricing, and delivery schedules.
* Performs other duties as assigned.

**What You Bring**

* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Industrial Engineering, or equivalent experience.
* Minimum 7+ years of experience procuring outsourcing or subcontracted manufacturing activities in a manufacturing environment.
* Strong negotiation skills and knowledge of procurement best practices including SAP expertise within the procurement and subcontracted manufacturing processes
* 10+ years of SAP procurement and production planning module experience required.
* Excellent communication and organizational skills.
* 5+ years of experience coordinating outsourcing activities in an engineered or make to order environment.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and work effectively in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Continuous Improvement mindset, with experience facilitating cross-functional continuous improvement projects preferred.
* Familiarity with technical drawings and specifications; ability to read and interpret technical drawings and specifications preferred.
* Advanced Excel skills required.
* Desire to influence and lead change, support and mentor junior staff members and cross-functional stakeholders and hold peers accountable to ensure supplier supply chain and operational execution is in alignment with customer expectations.

**Why Johnson Screens is a Great Place to Work:**

At Johnson Screens, we value open-mindedness, competence, collaboration, and integrity. We support our people with competitive total rewards, comprehensive benefits, and continuous development – so everyone can work with confidence and deliver results that matter.

**Compensation**

Base salary of $85,000-$110,000

**Shared Cost Benefits**

Medical and Prescription Drug Insurance, Dental Insurance, 401

When you’ve been around for more than a century, you know a thing or two! At Day & Zimmermann, we take our lifetime of experience and make things better! Our 37,000+ employees help bring big ideas to life every day. We’re pushing the boundaries of innovation in construction & engineering, operations & maintenance, staffing, and security & defense. **We're looking for an experienced** **Buyer****.**

The Buyer procures materials, supplies, equipment, and services that support Hawthorne Army Depot operations. The role manages sourcing, supplier evaluation, negotiations, purchase order and subcontract administration, and supplier performance while supporting compliant, cost-effective, and timely procurement outcomes.

**This position is located on site in Hawthorne, NV.**

**As the** **Buyer****, here’s the work you’ll do:**

* Procures materials, supplies, equipment, and services required to support depot operations through competitive sourcing, negotiations, and supplier selection activities. Evaluates supplier capabilities, pricing, quality, and performance to obtain best value while managing procurement risks and ensuring continuity of operations.
* Administers purchase orders, subcontracts, and service agreements throughout the procurement lifecycle. Ensures contractual terms, required clauses, certifications, and supporting documentation comply with applicable regulations, customer requirements, and company policies.
* Reviews procurement actions for compliance with Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR), Uniform Commercial Code (UCC), contract requirements, and internal procedures. Identifies, evaluates, and mitigates contractual, financial, supplier, and performance risks associated with procurement activities.
* Monitors purchase orders and subcontracts to ensure timely delivery, receipt, modification, closeout, and supplier performance evaluation. Conducts cost and price analyses and documents procurement decisions to support purchasing actions and audit requirements.
* Supports administration of the Small Business Program by identifying qualified suppliers and monitoring subcontracting activity. Assists with reporting requirements and supplier outreach initiatives that support customer and company objectives.
* Maintains compliance with company policies, safety requirements, and the Code of Ethics and Standards of Business Conduct. Performs other duties of the same or lower level of difficulty as assigned and may be assigned occasional duties of a higher level of difficulty.

**This role is for you if you have these skills:**

* Working knowledge of procurement, purchasing, subcontract administration, and supplier management practices needed to execute assigned procurement actions.

* Working knowledge of FAR, UCC, contract requirements, and commercial purchasing practices needed to evaluate and document compliant procurement decisions.

* Ability to analyze supplier proposals, pricing, terms, and procurement risk to support sound sourcing and negotiation decisions.

* Ability to plan and prioritize multiple procurement actions, maintain complete records, and meet operational and contractual deadlines.
* Working proficiency with Microsoft Office and enterprise procurement or ERP systems used to create, track, and administer purchasing transactions.

**And if you have these qualifications:**

* Associate’s Degree (AA) in Procurement/Purchasing, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or a related field; an equivalent combination of relevant education and experience may be considered..
* 3+ years Total experience in procurement or purchasing, including sourcing, supplier evaluation, purchase order or subcontract administration, and cost/price analysis. Working experience with FAR and government-contract procurement requirements is required.

*In compliance with this state’s pay transparency laws, the hourly pay range for this role is $61,680- $92,520. **DEPARTMENT:** Procurement

**REPORTS TO:** Buyer Lead

**Purpose and Scope**

The Buyer at SageMFG is responsible for sourcing, negotiating, and purchasing materials and services essential for the company’s operations. This role involves collaborating with vendors, managing inventory levels, and ensuring timely deliveries to support production and other business needs.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Identify and evaluate potential suppliers and vendors.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with existing and new suppliers.
* Negotiate contracts and terms to secure advantageous agreements.
* Generate and manage purchase orders accurately.
* Monitor order statues and ensure timely delivery of materials.
* Address any discrepancies or issues related to orders.
* Conduct cost analysis to identify opportunities for cost savings.
* Work closely with other departments to adhere to budgetary constraints.
* Monitor and maintain optimal inventory levels.
* Implement strategies to minimize excess or obsolete inventory.
* Collaborate with various departments, including production, logistics, and quality assurance, to understand their material needs.
* Stay informed about industry trends, market conditions, and pricing.
* Recommend alternative materials or suppliers to improve efficiency and cost-effectiveness.
* Email correspondence.
* Meeting attendance as assigned.
* Use of company software to perform day-to-day tasks.
* Strategic sourcing
* Coordination with Engineering department
* Bill of Material (BOM) verification
* Forecasting components
* Other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s of degree in Business, Supply Chain Management, or a related field.
* Proven experience in procurement, purchasing, or a similar role.
* Strong negotiation and communication skills.
* Knowledge of supply chain management and procurement processes.
* Familiarity with ERP systems and procurement software.
* Negotiation skills.
* Analytical and strategic thinking.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Detail-oriented and organizational skills.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite and procurement software

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this position. Are you a quality-focused professional who excels in driving accuracy and impeccable service in our fulfillment and manufacturing? Are you looking to be an integral part of a top-performing division within a technology-driven, growing organization that continuously invests in the training and development of its employees? If so, welcome to ALOM!

We are a global, high-volume, solutions-providing, and service-driven supply chain management company. Our award-winning leadership develops and implements highly optimized product delivery strategies for our customers, representing leading brands in the energy, technology, and medical industries. ALOM is an exciting company committed to equal opportunities for all people. Every minute of every day, our staff and systems have a positive impact on manufacturing, e-commerce, fulfillment, and logistics operations worldwide. To achieve this level of excellence, we demand that each team member delivers with excellence every single day.

ALOM is a destination for passionate, talented, and service-oriented professionals. We continually invest in our employees, reward bold thinking, promote teamwork, and focus on community engagement. Our inclusive culture is built on diversity, acceptance, respect, belongingness, and operational excellence. See your career grow in an environment where fresh ideas, results, and professional development are encouraged. Sound exciting?

**Summary**

Join our Supply Base team as a Print Purchasing Buyer and keep our 3PL operations supplied with packaging, hardware, printed collateral, and media duplication. You will source suppliers, negotiate pricing, and issue purchase orders that meet client needs, working closely with our warehouse, kitting, and fulfillment teams.

### **You will have the opportunity to:**

* Source and qualify new suppliers across packaging, hardware, and printed materials
* Negotiate pricing and terms that drive cost savings and supply continuity
* Partner with warehouse, kitting, and fulfillment teams to keep materials available on time
* Contribute to supplier reviews and scorecards and explore how AI tools can improve procurement

### **Here's what you need to succeed in the role:**

* A very solid foundation and hands-on experience with print purchasing practices, terminology, and processes
* Strong supplier management and negotiating skills, and experience in supplier compliance management
* Strong interpersonal skills working with internal and external clients and suppliers
* Excellent written and verbal communication
* Able to work within a cross-functional team under tight deadlines
* Strong organizational and self-motivational skills
* Ability to analyze and resolve a variety of issues simultaneously
* Proficiency in Windows, Microsoft Office, and Excel. Intuitive or Catapult experience is a plus
* Minimum of three to five years of print buying and general purchasing experience in the printing industry.

### **You will be responsible for:**

* Driving the print procurement strategy and process from vendor qualifications and selection through product delivery
* Optimize our utilization of suppliers based on capabilities, location, quality
* In a hands-on manner, project manage quote requests for timely and high-quality results. This includes issuing quote requests, checking initial quotes for accuracy, and requesting any needed additional information, communicating internally and externally.
* In a hands-on manner, project manage print orders, coordinating and managing timelines for each project, sending electronic print files to suppliers, and following up on any artwork issues or supplier issues. Preparing and/or understanding detailed print specifications and evaluate proofs for accuracy and quality.
* Using your expertise and creativity, help our customers improve their quality, cost and sustainability efforts in a consultative role
* Collaborate internally with other departments, such as Quality and Account Management, and externally with suppliers and artwork providers. Manage all relationships in a collaborative and respectful manner, using sound ethical judgment in conducting business.

**Compensation**

Compensation is determined based on relevant skills and experience, the position’s location, internal equity, and local market considerations. We regularly review our pay practices to help ensure employees are compensated fairly for comparable work.

We offer competitive salaries, benefits including health and welfare coverage, 401(k) match, and paid leaves. **Bottom line:** ALOM is a great place to work! We encourage you to submit your resume and be a part of a growing, firmly established, and success-driven company that values its staff.

**Introduction**
----------------

The Buyer1 is responsible for purchasing and negotiating materials, equipment and key production components from vendors. The Buyer 1 is assigned specific inventory items and vendors as needed for production in two USA plants and is required to have inventory on hand at all times in order to satisfy production demands.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Places, tracks and expedites orders with suppliers worldwide.
* Monitors stock levels in SAP on a daily basis to satisfy production demand.
* Pro-actively expedite orders to meet customer requirements.
* Develop and maintain personal contacts and partnerships with suppliers.
* Support for Team Leads, Sr. Buyers as needed for project and tasks.
* Assists purchasing and other departments to locate new suppliers and obtain quotes on materials.
* Responsible to manage supplier shortages and every day activities for assigned commodities (MRP) and work together closely to support Senior Buyers in all aspects of operational supplier management.
* Responsible for resolving quality cases that apply to suppliers which are managed by the buyer.
* Assists Team Leads, Sr. Buyers in implementation of short and long term market trends for responsible commodities.
* Works with Warehouse staff to resolve goods receipt issues.
* Evaluates and adjusts purchasing master data in SAP under guidance of Team Leads and Sr. Buyers.
* Work closely with accounting to resolve any discrepancies in a timely manner.

**Required Expertise**
----------------------

* Bachelor's Degree in business or related field strongly preferred. (High School Diploma/GED required)
* Must have 4+ years purchasing experience.
* Negotiation experience.
* Experienced in use of Microsoft programs and ERP-System.
* SAP experience preferred.
* Experience working according to ISO 9001 Quality Management System.
* Must be a team player with clear and concise communication skills, written and verbal.

People at Belimo

Smart buildings start with dedicated people. We bring talented people together and foster an environment to succeed. At Belimo, respect, trust, and support across departments help ideas move quickly into real-world solutions, because we achieve more together than we ever could alone. .

About Belimo

Belimo is the global market leader in the development, production, and sales of field devices for the energy-efficient control of heating, ventilation and air-conditioning systems. The focus of our core business is on damper actuators, control valves, sensors and meters. Founded in 1975, the company has been listed on the Swiss Exchange (SIX) since 1995.

Compensation & Benefits

Belimo is committed to paying all employees in a fair, equitable and transparent manner. The base pay for this position ranges from $65,000 - $80,000 annually with a target performance bonus of 7% of an employee’s annual base salary. Compensation is based on several factors including geographic location and may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, education and experience. Belimo is a total compensation company which includes a comprehensive benefits package including a full range of medical, financial, and other competitive benefits. Belimo is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. #WeAreBelimo

**Job Details**

**Division:** **Nucor Warehouse Systems**

**Location:** **Los Angeles, CA, United States**

**Other Available Locations:** **N/A**

**Welcome to Nucor, where our unique culture sets us apart. Joining Nucor means becoming part of North America's largest steel and steel products manufacturer, offering unmatched career opportunities and stability. We are known for our innovative sustainability practices and are the continent's largest recycler. Our vibrant culture, built on personal connections and teamwork, empowers every team member with the freedom to innovate and contribute to our collective success. Experience a workplace where safety, efficiency, and meaningful personal connections define every day, enriching both our teammates and the communities we serve.**

**Nucor supports its teammates with top-tier benefits like Medical, Dental, Vision, and Disability Insurance, 401K and Roth accounts, Profit sharing, Pay-for-performance bonuses, Paid parental leave, Tuition reimbursement, Stock program, Scholarships and more.**

**Basic Job Functions:**
------------------------

Nucor Warehouse Systems is hiring a Purchasing Agent to join our team in Vernon, CA. The position’s key responsibilities are to support manufacturing operations by coordinating procurement activities for raw materials while always looking for ways to drive costs down.

**Responsibilities:**

* Responsible for raw material procurement and vendor management.
* Managing requisitions and purchase order executions in Dynamics D365.
* Develop reliable and qualified sources of supply for products and components.
* Assist in production planning and inventory control of raw materials.
* Identify opportunities for cost reduction and coordinate with operating departments on cost savings and improved processes.

Safety is the most important part of all jobs within Nucor; therefore, candidates must be able to demonstrate the ability to initiate, lead, and uphold safety policies, practices, procedures, and housekeeping standards at all times.

**Minimum Qualifications:**
---------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in business or supply chain management; or in place of a degree, 4 years of related work experience in purchasing, supply chain management, or another related field.
* Microsoft Excel proficiency.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills.
* Be able to work with limited supervision and high motivation.

**Preferred Qualifications:**
-----------------------------

* Previous experience working for a manufacturing company preferred.
* Previous ERP experience.

***Nucor is an Equal Opportunity Employer and a drug-free workplace***

**Position Overview**
A growing packaging, automation, and industrial solutions company is seeking a meticulous and proactive full-time Junior Buyer to support procurement operations and ensure timely sourcing and availability of products. This position entails working closely with suppliers, sales teams, and operations to maintain inventory, manage purchase orders, and support customer demand in the company's packaging automation equipment division.

**Responsibilities**

* Create and manage purchase orders
* Communicate with suppliers regarding pricing, lead times, and order status
* Monitor inventory levels and assist with replenishment planning
* Coordinate with sales and operations to meet customer needs
* Resolve purchasing, delivery, and product issues
* Maintain accurate purchasing and vendor records
* Assist with supplier negotiations and relationship management
* Support logistics and shipment coordination
* Participate in process improvement initiatives

**Qualifications**

* 1-3 years of purchasing, procurement, inventory, or administrative experience preferred
* Strong organizational and communication skills
* Detail-oriented with excellent follow-through
* Proficient in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
* Experience with ERP or purchasing systems is a plus
* Eagerness to learn and grow within a procurement career

**Compensation & Benefits**

* $26-$33/hr (based on experience)
* Healthcare benefits & PTO
* Career growth and development opportunities

**About the Employer**

Our client is a well-established packaging and industrial solutions provider serving businesses throughout the Northeast. For more than 30 years, the company has helped customers improve operational efficiency through packaging supplies, automation equipment, technical expertise, and consultative service. As demand for automation continues to accelerate, the company is investing heavily in expanding its machinery and equipment offerings and is seeking talented professionals to help drive the next phase of growth.

**EEO Statement:**
*Topaz HR is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.*

**Please Note:**
*Topaz HR is conducting this search on behalf of a client. The employer's name will be disclosed during the interview process.*
