**Who we are****:**

Maravai LifeSciences translates extraordinary science into everyday miracles, helping biotech, biopharma, and life sciences companies everywhere deliver novel vaccines, therapeutics, and diagnostics. We are global leaders in providing products and services within the fields of nucleic acid production and biologics safety testing to many of the world's leading biopharma, vaccine, diagnostics, and cell and gene therapy companies.

At Maravai, we believe that diverse perspectives are the foundation of innovation. Through an inclusive and equitableculture where every team member is inspired to bring their best selves to work, we cultivate an environment in which we can lead together, providing differentiated value to our customers, and enabling the miracles of science. For over 35 years, Maravai's portfolio companies have served as a catalyst for innovative, lifesaving technology for humanity. Pioneering nucleotide research since its inception, we are now leading the way in the rapidly expanding mRNA market.

**Your next role as a Miracle Maker**

Maravai LifeSciences is seeking a #MiracleMaker to join our purchasing team as a Staff Procurement Specialist. The Staff Procurement Specialist plays a critical role in supporting supply chain operations, through managing the planning and procurement of products, materials, and services. This individual will be supporting planning, forecasting, finite scheduling, and schedule adherence to meet long term growth and profitability targets. This position will develop and execute procurement strategies that optimize costs while ensuring adequate supply levels to meet Alphazyme's evolving business needs, as well as develop and maintain crucial configurations with Alphazyme's ERP system. Key responsibilities include vendor management, systems management, purchase order processing, and cross-functional collaboration to maintain seamless operations. The ideal candidate has a proven track record of analyzing, organizing, and implementing procurement strategies, along with strong interpersonal skills to effectively coordinate with internal stakeholders, external vendors, and clients.

**How you will make an impact:**

* Procure products, materials, and services to support business operations.
* Identify cost-saving opportunities and communicate vendor alternatives.
* Track purchase history, manage orders, and maintain accurate records.
* Verify order receipts, process purchase requisitions, and ensure documentation.
* Build and manage vendor relationships, negotiate contracts, and optimize costs.
* Maintain and optimize configuration of NetSuite ERP for increased efficiency and streamlined workflows.
* Collaborate with internal teams to align procurement with business needs.
* Schedule and coordinate service procurement with impacted departments.
* Monitor procurement expenses and report key insights to management.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, quality, and safety standards.
* Participate in continuous improvement initiatives for the department and organization.
* Participate in collaborative culture of Production planning to build structure and processes across business units
* Responsible for ensuring daily raw materials and finished goods needs are known and secured through collaboration with Manufacturing, Quality, Procurement, and Logistics/Warehouse
* Provide guidance and trending information to buyers to optimize stock position of raw materials
* Participate in the development of a high performing culture focused on critical KPI's such as Revenue, On-Time Delivery, Schedule Adherence, and Quality/First-Time Pass
* Review and plan requirements for acceptable inventory, find and evaluate raw material supply sources, coordinate procurement efforts, and determine the level of need for the procured items
* Monitor and adjust daily, weekly, and monthly schedules based on production and sales performance
* Analyze work order releases with respect to capacity planning and material requirements
* Manage daily quality checks to the supply/demand processes
* Perform other related duties as required or assigned

**The skills and experience that you will bring:**

* Bachelor's degree in business, supply chain/procurement, life sciences, or a related field, with 3+ years of relevant experience in planning and procurement/purchasing in a manufacturing environment preferred
* Experience with ERP/MRP systems, such as NetSuite and Microsoft Office products required
* Experience in industry procedures, costs, and terms
* Experience with compiling and following strict budgets
* Experience scheduling both non-recurring and recurring production needs
* CPIM/APICS certification a plus
* Experience with 21 CFR 820, ICH Q7, ISO 9001, and/or ISO 13485 requirements a plus
* Self-motivated and able to organize and prioritize multiple tasks
* Able to multi-task, prioritize, and manage time effectively
* Ability to physically stand, bend, squat and lift up to 30 pound

At Parker Aerospace, we develop technologies and innovative solutions that enable reliable, efficient and increasingly sustainable flight for the lifecycle of the aircraft, including aftermarket support. Our passionate people with deep engineering expertise, together with our breadth of differentiated technologies, ensure that we make the extraordinary happen and continue to shape the future of aviation in partnership with our customers.

As a member of our team, you are instrumental in fulfilling our mission: 'Enabling Engineering Breakthroughs that Lead to a Better Tomorrow.' Pursuing a career at Parker presents unlimited opportunities for both professional and personal development. Working with some of the most brilliant minds in the industry, your contributions will be pivotal in developing innovative technologies and products, significantly contributing to Parker’s goal of addressing the world’s most pressing engineering challenges. At Parker, our team members belong, matter and make a difference.

The Commercial Flight Controls Division, headquartered in beautiful Ogden, Utah, is a global leader in aerospace flight controls. We are the preferred supplier of flight control solutions for the commercial, regional, business jet and advanced air mobility marketplace by offering a premier customer experience with superior engineered products that exceed our customer and regulatory requirements.

We’ve broken ground with more-electric technology and electromechanical flight control systems. Looking ahead we’re further improving flight control actuation for traditional and advanced air mobility (AAM) aircraft with new technologies and manufacturing advancements.

**Position Summary**

The Buyer obtains the best quality, service, and value for products and services through effective bidding, negotiation, and supplier management. Identifies manufacturing needs, identifies and selects suppliers, initiates purchase orders, and arranges for delivery. Provides parts, equipment, services, and materials of limited scope and complexity.

**Essential Functions**

* Identifies and recommends suppliers by investigating potential suppliers, researching parts, equipment, machinery, services, and materials availability.
* Conducts supplier site visits and evaluates them as to production capability, performance, delivery, and other key business criteria.
* Purchases parts, equipment, and materials by preparing request for quotations and submitting purchase orders with approved suppliers. Issues purchase orders and agreements that accurately reflect price, schedule, terms, and conditions as negotiated with suppliers. Maintains accurate lead times for assigned commodities.
* Evaluates bids for standard and non-standard items. Selects suppliers for lower cost items or items of limited scope and complexity and negotiates price, delivery, quality and service.
* Monitors and evaluates supplier performance. Advises appropriate personnel of impending supplier failure to fulfill contractual agreements that may delay production or delivery.
* Resolves shipment quality discrepancies by mediating supplier/manufacturing issues. Facilitates the resolution of issues by arranging and participating in conferences between suppliers and company personnel.
* Negotiates and settles damage claims, rejections, losses, return of materials, over-shipments, cancellations and engineering changes with suppliers.
* Provides parts, equipment, and materials information by answering questions and requests.
* Prepares reports by collecting, analyzing, and summarizing information and trends.
* Participates in continuous improvement activities and provides suggestions for cost reduction and improved efficiency.
* Maintains professional and technical knowledge by attending educational workshops, reviewing trade publications, establishing networks, and/or participating in professional associations.
* Complies with federal, state, and aerospace industry regulations; ensures adherence to requirements and advises management on needed actions. Complies with Government/Commercial Practices Manual (GPM/CPM) policies and procedures.

description:
At Aeon, we design, build, and fly low-cost, modular, weapon systems for ground and air platforms. We take pride in our dynamic and small team that allows us to iterate, build and test quickly. If you are looking to solve hard technical problems with a team of passionate engineers in a hands-on, fast-paced environment, Aeon is the place for you.

We are building next-generation defense solutions, with programs in active development and in low-rate production. We are hiring a Senior Buyer Contracts and Procurement to oversee procurement and negotiation for both direct and indirect hardgoods and services. This position will help transform the current ad hoc and unstructured procurement process into a disciplined, scalable and compliant acquisition function for AEON.

This strategic procurement opportunity will report to the VP of Supply Chain and work closely with the engineering and manufacturing organizations to stand up a procurement process to support business needs. This role is perfect for entrepreneurial self-starters, that work well in start-up cultures where creativity and flexibility is critical. Because we operate under the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) and U.S. Government contracting requirements, fluency in export-controlled and defense-regulated supply chains is essential to this role.

### **What you’ll do at Aeon:**

* Lead end-to-end materials Procurement for assigned categories in support of IRAD and Production requirements

* Develop dashboards and track KPI’s such as: order placements, order acknowledgements, on-time delivery and 3 way (PO, Invoice, and Receipt) match exception, etc. that achieve customer expectations

* Manage component shortage prioritization and mitigation to reduce impact to the schedule

* Facilitate Root Cause and Corrective Action (RCCA) process for Supplier nonconformances, and manage the successful graduation and solution of those identified issues

* Create Vendor Managed Inventory (VMI) and lead weekly supplier fulfillment communications

* Support Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) tool implementation timelines and requirements

* Support the implementation of supplier compliance to AS9100 inclusive of qualification and on-boarding

* Negotiate supplier contract terms, secure year over year cost reductions, and facilitate multi-source component awards to ensure continuity of supply

### **We’d love to hear from you if you have:**

* 7+ years of progressive supply chain, procurement, and operations experience, including significant time in aerospace, defense, or another ITAR-regulated hardware environment

* Proven experience building supplier relationships and implementing strategies that reduce risk and improve cost of goods sold

* Experience in manufacturing organizations that specialize in prototype development, new product introduction (NPI) and full rate manufacturing operations

* Strong ERP/MRP fluency, driving success through carefully crafted and managed KPI’s, with full accountability for assigned procurement categories and dashboard metrics

* Excellent negotiation, communication, and cross-collaboration skills

* Strong experience in high reliability electronics, precision machining, castings, and/or Printed Circuit Board Assembly supply chain operations

* Understanding of current compliance to: Import, Export, ITAR, BAA, DPAS and Incoterms

### **While it’s not required, it would be an added plus if you have:**

* Aerospace Defense startup supply chain experience

* Lean Six Sigma certification

* Familiarity with quality management systems and supplier quality engineering

* APICS/ASCM (CPIM, CSCP), ISM (CPSM), or export compliance certifications

* Undergraduate degree in Business, Engineering, or Supply Chain is a plus

### **What We Offer:**

**Fully Company-Sponsored Health Benefits**: Enjoy comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage at no cost to you, including coverage for eligible dependents, plus HSA and FSA options.

**Team Events & Company Celebrations**: Connect with colleagues through team-building activities, employee events, and celebrations.

**Complimentary Daily Lunches**: Enjoy company provided lunches served onsite each workday.

**Snacks & Beverages**: Enjoy complementary snacks, drinks, and refreshments available throughout the workday.

### **Equal Employment Opportunity & Disclaimer**

Requires U.S. person status under ITAR (U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident, or protected non‑citizen such as refugee/asylee) due to access to ITAR‑controlled defense articles or technical data.

This job description is intended to outline the general nature and key responsibilities of the position. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or qualifications required. Job duties and responsibilities may be modified, expanded, or adjusted at any time to meet business needs, with or without notice.

**About the Role:**
**Fermi Forward Discovery Group, LLC (FFDG)** manages and operates Fermilab on behalf of the US Department of Energy Office of Science (DOE). Within FFDG, the **Finance Division** provides safe, efficient, effective financial operations in support of the Laboratory's high-energy physics program in accordance with all laws, regulations, and DOE requirements. Within the section, the Procurement Department is responsible for acquiring goods and services for the entire Laboratory. It provides helpful, professional support for all procurement requirements from the development of initial plans and requirements to subcontract closeout.

Under general direction, the **Procurement Manager I** will lead one or more teams of subcontracting and procurement professionals within the Procurement organization. This position provides procurement liaison support for FFDG projects, ensuring effective management of acquisition planning, solicitation, negotiation, award, and subcontract administration for routine to highly complex and high-value contractual arrangements. Responsibilities include close collaboration with internal customers, FFDG project teams, support personnel, subcontractors, and the DOE, all while ensuring compliance with established procurement policies, contract law, commercial practices, and federal procurement regulations.

**What your day-to-day as a Procurement Manager I at Fermilab will look like:**

* Plans and develops subcontracting requirements; provides guidance and recommendations to Project Managers, project team members, senior Laboratory Managers, and other Laboratory customers, and guide Procurement team members throughout this process.
* Communicates the Laboratory mission, Procurement goals, specific project acquisition objectives, and supports implementation through the execution of processes that guide the long term and day-to-day operation of FFDG Procurement.
* Communicates essential information between Procurement leadership, project managers and the Procurement staff, in a timely and effective manner.
* Participates in project meetings such as those with Project Management, and other project related groups. Continuously interacts with subcontractors.
* Supports FFDG compliance and self-assessment activities, such as the Balanced Scorecard.
* Supports audits and assessments, contractor procurement system reviews; collaborates with the DOE Fermi Site Office (FSO); ensures team compliance with the prime contract and applicable acquisition regulations; contribute to and support Procurement metrics gathering and reporting.
* May provide people supervision or leadership of a team including hiring, promotions, performance reviews, training, disciplinary actions, team exits, and other duties as assigned.
* Performs other duties as assigned by supervisor.
* Abides by and is responsible for performing all duties in accordance with all environmental, health and safety regulations and practices pertinent to this position.

description:
**This Position**

This position is responsible for managing the perpetual school supply procurement operation of The Public Education Foundation (PEF). This position will be responsible for the procurement management of both the Classroom In A Box program as well as traditional retail functions of the Teacher Superstore, as dictated by the peaks of teacher demand under the direction of PEF Senior Management. This position will also be responsible for collaborating with PEF’s Volunteer management staff to optimize the function of volunteer activities around school supply events and distribution. This position reports to and is directly responsible to the Co-President/CFOO.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

The list of Essential Duties is not exhaustive and may be supplemented.

1. Assist in the processing of new inventory and stocking shelves.

2. Establish and ensure proper par levels for necessary supplies are ordered and stocked.

3. Review and reconcile sign in sheets to individual teacher sales history.

4. Ensure store appearance and equipment is maintained in a clean and consistent manner.

5. Maintain required financial and inventory reporting as prescribed.

6. Conduct monthly inventory cycle counts and lead physical count at fiscal year-end.

7. Serve as a liaison for donation pick-ups and deliveries.

8. Provide exceptional customer service during retail operation(s).

9. Accurately sort, organize and process incoming purchases and donations.

10. Coordinate deliveries or incoming donations and assist with loading/unloading if necessary.

11. Move and stage items using a pallet jack or other equipment.

12. Pull inventory from warehouse as requested for placement in the store, targeted giving and/or delivery.

13. Assist in ensuring the store is properly prepared for retail operation(s).

14. Other duties as assigned.

**Position Expectations:**

1. Effective written and verbal communication skills with all levels of staff and external audiences.

2. Possess reasonable analytical skills, sound judgement, and willingness to take direction and provide constructive feedback.

3. Ability to deal with a range of personality styles and behaviors in a tactful, pleasant and personable manner.

4. Ability to multi-task, prioritize, and reprioritize in order to meet deadlines.

5. Self-starter with attention to detail and excellent organization skills.

6. Ability to manage projects with minimal supervision.

7. Professional and diplomatic demeanor and conduct in all interactions, both internally and externally.

8. Able to work under pressure, while maintaining attention to details and meeting deadlines.

9. Strong organizational skills and basic software competencies in Microsoft Excel and Word.

10. Ability to work flexible hours when required.

11. Ability to lift up to 50 pounds frequently.

**Position Requirements**

Education and Training:

1. High school graduation or other equivalent (i.e. GED, foreign equivalency, etc.).

2. Demonstrate engagement in life-long learning.

3. Minimum three (3) years successful experience in a similar or related position.

Work Environment:

1. Strength: Medium - Heavy

⸺ Occasionally: 50-100lbs.

⸺ Frequently: 25-50lbs.

⸺ Constantly: 10-20lbs.

2. Physical Demands: Frequent sitting, standing, walking, pushing, pulling, stopping, kneeling, climbing, crouching, reaching, handling, and repetitive fine motor activities. Stamina to remain seated and maintain concentration for an extended period of time. Hearing and speech to facilitate in-person communication, via video conference and computers, or over the telephone. Vision: Frequent near and far acuity and color vision. Vision to read printed and online materials, or other monitoring devices.

3. Environmental Conditions: Varies – from climate-controlled office setting, to work outdoors in temperatures ranging from mild/moderate to extreme cold/heat. Exposure to noise levels ranging from moderate to mild and occasional to frequent time periods.

4. Examples of Normal Equipment/Supplies Used to Perform Tasks: pallet jack, computers, printers, telephones, etc.

Pay: $63,000.00 - $70,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 403(b)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

About the Position

Covenant Jewelry Buyers is a growing jewelry and precious-metals buying company in Naples, Florida. We purchase gold, silver, jewelry, diamonds, coins, watches, and other valuables directly from the public.

We are looking for a confident, personable, and highly motivated salesperson to join our team as a Jewelry Buyer.

Little to no jewelry experience is needed. We can teach you how to evaluate jewelry, precious metals, coins, watches, and other valuables. What we need is someone who is already a great communicator and salesperson, comfortable speaking with customers, able to negotiate and close deals, and capable of learning quickly.

What You'll Do

* Meet one-on-one with customers looking to sell their valuables
* Build trust and create an excellent customer experience
* Evaluate items and make purchase offers
* Negotiate confidently and close deals
* Learn to identify and evaluate jewelry, precious metals, coins, watches, and diamonds
* Accurately document purchases and follow company procedures
* Maintain a professional, welcoming environment
* Work closely with our team to improve sales and buying performance

Who We're Looking For

We are looking for someone who is outgoing, articulate, trustworthy, competitive, and great with people. You should be comfortable discussing money, negotiating, overcoming objections, and asking for the deal.

You should be a fast learner and strong speaker who can absorb new information quickly and confidently communicate it to customers.

Previous sales experience is strongly preferred. Experience in jewelry, precious metals, luxury goods, automotive sales, real estate, or other high-ticket sales is a plus, but jewelry experience is not required.

Our Faith & Culture

Covenant Jewelry Buyers is a Christian company, and our Christian faith and values are an important part of our company culture and the way we conduct business.

We strive to operate with honesty, integrity, respect, compassion, and a genuine commitment to serving others. Every team member is expected to uphold our standards of honesty, professionalism, respect, integrity, and exceptional customer service and contribute to a positive and consistent environment for our customers and team.

What We Value

We value integrity, work ethic, strong communication, personal responsibility, willingness to learn, and results. Covenant is growing quickly, and there is significant opportunity for the right person to develop their skills, take on greater responsibility, and grow with the company.

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: $25.00 - $30.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Work Location: In person

About Us:

Welcome to Quality Stainless Inc., founded in 1985 in Minneapolis, MN. We serve the sanitary food and beverage, biopharm, semiconductor, and industrial stainless steel markets as a stocking distributor of 304L and 316L, aluminum, and other specialty alloys. We specialize in quick turnaround custom fabrication and machining, solving system problems and advising on liquid, gas, and vacuum applications.

Visit our Website: qualitystainless.net

Job Description:

The Buyer is an early-career procurement professional who supports purchasing activities across multiple distribution sites in the industrial PVF (pipe, valves, and fittings) industry. Independently purchases assigned commodity/product categories; understands schedule, class, material, and connection requirements; manages suppliers; analyzes inventory; handles shortages; understands documentation requirements.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Execute purchasing activities for direct and indirect materials to support business operations across multiple sites.
* Create, release, and manage purchase orders in the ERP system, ensuring accuracy of pricing, quantities, and delivery dates.
* Coordinate with suppliers to confirm orders, track shipments, and resolve delivery, quality, or invoice discrepancies.
* Support multi-site material requirements by monitoring demand signals, inventory levels, and transfer needs.
* Maintain and update ERP item master data, including lead times, reorder points, reorder quantities, supplier assignments and product pricing.
* Collaborate with production planning, operations, and logistics teams to ensure material availability aligns with production schedules.
* Assist in supplier performance tracking, including on-time delivery and responsiveness metrics.
* Support sourcing and cost-reduction initiatives by gathering supplier data, quotes, and market information.
* Ensure procurement transactions comply with company policies and established purchasing procedures.
* Participate in continuous improvement efforts related to purchasing processes, data accuracy, and supplier communication.

**Education and Experience**
----------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Operations Management, Business Administration, or a related field preferred.
* 2–4 years of purchasing, materials, or supply chain experience within the industrial plastics industry.
* Exposure to multi-site purchasing or distribution environments required.
* Experience using ERP/MRP systems in a manufacturing or distribution environment.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and other Microsoft Office applications.

**Background, Skills, and Abilities**
-------------------------------------

* Foundational understanding of Metallic industrial Piping, valves, and fittings, suppliers, and manufacturing processes with comprehension of grades, finishes, forms, and related processing services.
* Able to recognize standards/ specifications such as ASTM, ASME, ANSI, and sanitary/hygienic requirements applicable
* Up to date with the current industrial PVF market to negotiate for competitive pricing
* Strong organizational skills with attention to detail and data accuracy.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and respond effectively to changing production needs.
* Effective communication skills for working with suppliers and internal teams.
* Analytical mindset with the ability to identify purchasing and inventory issues.
* Desire to grow into advanced sourcing, planning, and leadership roles within procurement.

**Job Summary**: Works in a largely independent manner under the general oversight of the Procurement Coordinator to perform various duties related to purchasing and contracting products and/or equipment, in a professional and timely manner for CaroMont Health, to include CRMC, CMG practices, Hospice and Courtland Terrace Nursing Home. This includes but is not limited to the accurate and timely creation and issue of purchase orders, sourcing non catalog items needed by departments, the management of vendors, price negotiation, and provides pertinent documentation and information to track performance. Communicates with vendors concerning organizational expectations for product delivery and/or installation and to provide other information pertaining to orders. Manages the organization’s Procurement Card process. Responsible for recording and tracking product returns to ensure credits or replacement product is received in a timely manner. Provides purchase order and invoice information to Medical Records and Business Services requested by insurance companies for verification of charge(s). Researches and resolves accruals and identifies root cause and possible solution(s). Acquires data from primary and/or secondary data sources and analyzes and interprets it for cost savings and standardization opportunities. Identify, analyze, and interpret trends or patterns in utilization of products. Performs other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications****:** Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university required. Minimum of 2-4 years of purchasing experience required; or Associate’s degree with 5-7 years of purchasing experience required; or High School diploma with 8-10 years of purchasing experience required; healthcare experience and/or experience with contracting preferred. Must possess excellent oral and written communication skills, decision making capabilities, organizational skills, analytical ability for performing effective quantitative analyses, Microsoft Office (Excel, Word) skills, sourcing, and time management skills. Demonstrated ability to work within a team environment. Certification with a professional organization is preferred.

description:
Experience with fasteners, electrical supplies, safety products, tools, shop supplies, or industrial consumables.

Experience with one or more of the following:

**Job Overview**

We are an independent MRO (Maintenance, Repair & Operations) supply fulfillment company with several large commercial and industrial contracts and approximately $3-$4 million in annual sales.

We are looking for an experienced **Purchasing/Procurement Specialist** **with real-world industrial MRO product knowledge.**

**IMPORTANT: This is NOT a general purchasing or procurement position.**

We are **not** looking for someone whose primary experience is purchasing software, general office supplies, or procurement administration without hands-on knowledge of industrial products.

The successful candidate should understand the products we sell and the customers we serve.

Our business is similar to companies such as **Fastenal, Kimball Midwest, Lawson Products, MSC Industrial Supply, Grainger, and other industrial MRO distributors.**

**The Experience We Are Looking For**

The ideal candidate will have **hands-on experience working in the industrial supply/MRO distribution industry,** particularly with:

* Fastners
* Bolts, nuts, washers, and screws
* Threaded rod and related hardware
* Industrial hardware
* Electrical supplies
* Safety/PPE products
* Hand and power tools
* Shop supplies
* Industrial consumables
* Maintenance supplies
* Fleet and heavy-equipment supplies
* Bearing and related industrial products
* Material handling products
* Other products commonly sold through industrial MRO distributors

**Strong fastener knowledge is especially important.**

We need someone who can look at a customer's request and understand what they are asking for - including specifications such as thread size, diameter, length, grade, material, finish, head style, drive type, and other relevant product characteristics.

You should be comfortable talking with vendors and customers about industrial products **without having to start from scratch every time a product is a product is unfamiliar.**

**Who we are looking for**

We strongly prefer candidates who have previously worked for, or in a similar environment to:

* Fastenal
* Kimball Midwest
* Lawson Products
* MSC Industrial Supply
* Graigner
* Industrial Distributors
* Fastener distributors
* Industrial supply houses
* MRO fulfillment companies
* Manufacturers or distributors serving heavy equipment, manufacturing, construction, waste/recycling, fleet, or other industrial customers

Experience in **outside sales, inside sales, counter sales, customer service, purchasing, or inventory management within the industrial MRO industry** may be valuable, provided the candidate has strong product knowledge.

**What This Person Will Actually Do**

This position goes well beyond entering purchase orders.

You will be responsible for helping our company source the right products at the right price and with the required timeframe.

Responsibilities include:

* Source industrial MRO products from manufacturers and distributors.
* Review customer requirements and determine the appropriate product.
* Compare equivalent products from different manufacturers.
* Obtain competitive pricing.
* Negotiate pricing and terms with suppliers.
* Identify alternate products when the requested item is unavailable.
* Research hard-to-find and obsolete products.
* Expedite critical orders.
* Follow up on backorders and delayed shipments
* Monitor vendor lead times and availability
* Help maintain appropriate inventory levels.
* Work closely with our sales team to support customer requirements.
* Help identify opportunities to improve margins.
* Develop relationships with manufacturers and distributors.
* Resolve product, pricing, quantity, and shipping discrepancies.
* Handle multiple urgent requirements simultaneously.

Work independently and make purchasing decisions without constant supervision.

**A Major Part of This Job: Product Knowledge**

**You should be able to recognize and understand industrial products.**

For example, if a salesperson gives you a request for a particular fastener, we expect you to understand what information is important and know how to find the correct product.

You should be comfortable researching questions such as:

"I need a 3/8"-16 flange head thread cutting bolt, 1-1/2" long, zinc plated"

Or:

"The customer needs a replacement Grade 8 fastener but the original manufacturer is out of stock"

Or:

"We need an equivalent to this particular industrial PPE, electrical component, tool, or shop supply."

You don't necessarily need to know every product we sell on day one, but you **must have a strong foundation in industrial/MRO products and the ability to quickly learn and identify products.**

**This position is NOT a Good Fit if..**

Please do not apply if your experience is limited primarily to:

* General corporate purchasing
* Office supplies
* Procurement software
* Purchase-order

**Please review the job details below.**
----------------------------------------

Intuitive Machines - West is seeking a Component Buyer to support procurement of Electrical, Electronic, and Electromechanical (EEE) parts and precision-machined flight and non-flight hardware for spacecraft programs. This role is critical to ensuring on-time, cost-effective, and quality-compliant sourcing of long-lead and mission-critical flight components in support of aggressive spacecraft build schedules.

The ideal candidate has experience navigating aerospace-grade component sourcing, understands EEE parts qualification and traceability requirements, and can manage supplier relationships for both electronic components and precision machined/fabricated parts.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Source, negotiate, and purchase EEE parts (semiconductors, connectors, passives, relays, etc.) and machined/fabricated flight hardware in accordance with program schedules and specifications.
* Issue and manage purchase orders, ensuring compliance with engineering specifications, quality requirements (AS9100), and export control regulations (ITAR/EAR).
* Track long-lead items and obsolescence risk for EEE components; support Last Time Buy (LTB) and alternate part qualification efforts.
* Coordinate with Engineering, Quality, and Program Management to resolve technical and schedule issues with suppliers.
* Manage supplier performance, delivery schedules, and cost/quality/on-time delivery (QCD) metrics.
* Negotiate pricing, terms, and lead times with suppliers (both manufacturers and distributors), and machine shops for multiple company sites
* Maintain and update procurement records, including certificates of conformance, material certifications, and traceability documentation required for flight hardware.
* Support Material Review Board (MRB) activities related to nonconforming purchased hardware.
* Identify and mitigate supply chain risks, including counterfeit parts risk for EEE components.
* Support make/buy analysis and sourcing strategy development for new programs.

**Minimum Requirements**

* Must be a U.S. Citizen or Permanent Resident
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain Management, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* 3+ years of procurement/buying experience in aerospace, defense, or a related high-reliability manufacturing environment.
* Experience purchasing EEE components and/or precision machined hardware to engineering drawings and specifications.
* Familiarity with flight hardware quality/traceability requirements (e.g., certs of compliance, material certs, source inspection).
* Understanding of export control regulations (ITAR/EAR) as they apply to procurement.
* Strong negotiation, organizational, and cross-functional communication skills.
* Proficiency with ERP/MRP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, or similar) and Microsoft Office/Excel.
* Ability to work in multiple systems (support multiple sites)

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with obsolescence management and alternate/second-source qualification for EEE parts.
* Familiarity with AS9100/ISO 9001 quality systems.
* Experience working with machine shops on precision-machined aerospace components (tolerances, materials, surface finishes).
* Knowledge of counterfeit parts avoidance practices (AS5553 or similar).
* Experience with long-lead procurement planning for spacecraft or satellite programs.

The successful candidate’s starting pay will fall within the salary range provided below and is determined based on job-related factors, including, but not limited to, the experience, qualifications, knowledge, skills, geographic work location, and market conditions. Candidates with the minimum necessary experience, qualifications, knowledge, and skillsets for the position should not expect to receive the upper end of the pay range.

The base pay for this position within California is: $87,000.00 - $145,000.00 annually.

For all other states, we use geographic cost of labor as an input to develop market-driven ranges for our roles, and as such, each location where we hire may have a different range.

We offer a comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off, health and welfare insurance, and 401(k) to eligible employees. More information on our benefits will be shared with candidates as they move forward in the recruitment process.

The application window is three days from the date the job is posted and will remain posted until a qualified candidate has been identified for hire. If the job is reposted regardless of reason, it will remain posted three days from the date the job is reposted and will remain reposted until a qualified candidate has been identified for hire.

The date of posting can be found on the Lanteris Space Systems Career page at the top of each job

**Additional Locations:**
**Requisition ID:** 28117

Spartan Emergency Response (Spartan ER) is a leading designer, manufacturer and distributor of custom emergency response vehicles, cabs, and chassis. Driven by a commitment to quality and innovation, Spartan and its portfolio of brands Spartan Fire Apparatus and Chassis, Smeal Fire Apparatus, and Ladder Tower (LT) offer a broad range of apparatus to meet specific requirements and demands of the fire service industry. Spartan has a rich history in fire apparatus manufacturing with over 250 years of combined experience.

Spartan Emergency Response is part of Terex Corporation, a global designer and manufacturer of specialized vehicles and equipment, including fire and emergency vehicles, waste and recycling equipment, RV's, and machinery supporting construction, utilities, and infrastructure. With operations across the U.S. and globally, we are committed to safety, innovation, and quality while building products our customers depend on every day.

**Job Summary:**

The Buyer II position researches and selects vendors to solicit quotes and is responsible for the procurement of a medium scope, quantity, and dollars of repetitive assemblies, parts, and services. Requires considerable knowledge of specific materials, vendors, and market conditions. The Buyer II will be responsible for daily purchasing tasks including but not limited to; maintaining stock levels, viewing open purchase requisitions, creating Pos building supplier relationships, following up on open orders, and providing customer updates on outstanding purchase orders. Buyer II will use best practices and experience to ensure that the company is getting the best prices possible and optimum order quantities. Also, monitor the performance of the suppliers to ensure the attainment of objectives in quality, delivery, service, and cost.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

This list of duties and responsibilities is not all inclusive and may be expanded to include other duties and responsibilities, as management may deem necessary from time to time.

* Utilization of a Computerized MRP system to ensure Purchase Orders are created and reviewed in a timely and accurate manner, in support of manufacturing requirements.
* On-going expediting of items on the Backlog Report to ensure report integrity which will be used to communicate between customer service and the warehouse.
* Routinely interact and communicate with suppliers that purchase order details (manufacture number, description, and pricing), and delivery requirements are accurately and clearly defined (delivery date based on manufacturing/customer requirements, considering transportation, inspection, and/or any internal processes).
* Maintain delivery confirmation detail in the computer system.
* Assure the flow of product, which does not meet our standards or expectations, is clearly documented and processed through the defective materials process.
* Review and resolve receiving and invoice discrepancies, as required by receiving or accounts payable, to ensure timely payments are made to suppliers.
* Review open requirements, expedite, delay, or cancel orders where necessary.
* Track supplier OTTR, OTIF, and Lead Time, and ensure MOQ = EOQ.
* As needed engage with suppliers to resolve supply solvency issues.
* The first line of defense for price increases, leveraging a broader team to drive results by mitigating increases.
* Attend Karrass Negotiation Skills training within the first year of hire.

**Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:**

* Strong negotiation skills.
* Analytical and highly motivated individual, with acute attention to detail.
* Ability to prioritize, manage, and meet deadlines for multiple tasks simultaneously, in a fast paced and continually evolving manufacturing environment.
* Demonstrated ability in participation, engagement, and promotion of a “team” atmosphere.
* Strong communication skills, both verbal and written.
* Demonstrated ability in computer operations, specifically Microsoft office, data mining, & crystal report.
* Demonstrated ability with problem solving, i.e. short/long term corrective action resolution, root cause analysis, 5 why principle, etc.
* Experience and working knowledge in Accounting preferred, but not required.
* Experience with supplier and vendor management .
* Intermediate to advanced experience and working knowledge of Microsoft excel, i.e., formulas, queries, macros, etc.).

**Education and/or Experience:**

* 2+ years of experience in purchasing, within a Manufacturing environment.
* Bachelor’s degree in business and/or experience in purchasing preferred, but not strictly required.

**Work Environment/Conditions:**

* Office work environment, production floor as needed
* Personal protective equipment required while on the plant floor:
+ Safety glasses, or prescription safety glasses with side shields
+ Earplugs
+ Steel-toed shoes

*Terex Corporation is committed

------------------------------------

* Develop category strategies informed by supply and demand, market dynamics, and cost drivers.

* Identify and mitigate material supply risks in partnership with procurement category managers and cross-functional teams.
* Support Research and Development initiatives and manage inbound supply considerations for innovation projects.
* Implement enterprise procurement initiatives across assigned brands.
* Gather data and conduct risk-and-reward analyses for purchasing bids and specification change initiatives.
* Collaborate across functions to manage raw material inventories and minimize loss or obsolescence.
* Deliver accurate monthly forecasts and communicate changes in material costs and market drivers to stakeholders.
* Monitor supplier quality and service performance with internal customers.
* Champion corrective actions and quality improvement plans with facilities, Quality Assurance, Research and Development, and suppliers.

**Ingredients Required for Your Success**
-----------------------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Supply Chain, Business, or a related field.
* 2+ years of experience in Purchasing, Supply Chain, or Finance.
* Experience working in a matrixed environment with changing priorities.
* Project management and conflict management experience.
* Continuous improvement mindset with a focus on efficiency.
* Experience using Systems, Applications, and Products in Data Processing software or a comparable enterprise resource planning system.
* Advanced Excel skills, including formulas, pivot tables, and data relationships.
* Advanced PowerPoint presentation development skills.
* Experience working with Power Business Intelligence reporting.
* Experience supporting procurement digital initiatives.
* Familiarity with artificial intelligence tools and Copilot functionality.
* Minimal travel required.
* Availability to work in the office 3 days per week, Tuesday through Thursday.

Based in St. Louis, Core & Main is a leader in advancing reliable infrastructure™ with local service, nationwide®. As a specialty distributor with a focus on water, wastewater, storm drainage and fire protection products and related services, Core & Main provides solutions to municipalities, private water companies and professional contractors across municipal, non-residential and residential end markets, nationwide. With over 370 locations across the U.S., the company provides its customers local expertise backed by a national supply chain. Core & Main’s 5,700 associates are committed to helping their communities thrive with safe and reliable infrastructure. Visit **coreandmain.com** to learn more.

**Job Summary**

Maintain and sustain a proactive channel of communication with management regarding purchasing and inventory decisions impacting their business. Generate performance reports for underperforming product lines, and initiate resolution plan of action.

**Major Tasks, Responsibilities and Key Accountabilities**

* Evaluates daily purchasing reports, prioritizes purchase orders by critical need; and ensures orders meet the optimal levels to maximize profit and sales.
* Obtains confirmations, verifies pricing and quantities, follows up with vendors to correct issues or re-request confirmations, attaches confirmations to POs, and manages confirmations record.
* Performs all purchase transactions for assigned categories.
* Works the Back Order Queue and Expedite Queue and keeps ship dates accurate for the field. Works with vendors for updated information regarding shipments.
* Conducts analysis and correction of price discrepancies utilizing accounting business partnerships.
* Leverages management input to ensure target freight levels are achieved to maximize profit margins.
* Evaluates and manages dead stock materials, no calc, and aged inventory. Manages inventory /fill rates for assigned categories.
* Negotiates prices with vendors. Proactively seeks out products/vendors in order to obtain best pricing as appropriate.
Handles some commodity purchasing under the general direction of the Purchasing leader.

**Nature and Scope**

* Demonstrates skill in data analysis techniques by resolving missing/incomplete information and inconsistencies/anomalies in more complex research/data.
* Nature of work requires increasing independence; receives guidance only on unusual, complex problems or issues. Work review typically involves periodic review of output by a supervisor and/or direct "customers" of the process.
May provide general guidance/direction to or train junior level support personnel or professional personnel.

**Work Environment**

* Located in a comfortable indoor area. Any unpleasant conditions would be infrequent and not objectionable.
Typically requires overnight travel less than 10% of the time.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Must be a minimum of 18 years of age or older
Must pass pre-employment assessment(s) if applicable

**Education and Experience**

Typically requires BS/BA in a related discipline. Generally 2-5 years of experience in a related field; certification is required in some areas OR MS/MA and generally 2-4 years of experience in a related field. Certification is required in some areas.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Broad-based procurement and inventory experience.
* Product experience.

Core & Main is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. Employment at Core & Main is based solely on a person’s merit and qualifications directly related to professional competence. Core & Main does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of race, creed, color, religion, national origin, nationality, ancestry, age, disability, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding), affectional or sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, status with regard to public assistance, citizenship, or any other basis protected by law.

None of the questions in this application are intended to elicit information regarding any protected characteristics, nor imply any limitation, illegal preferences or discrimination based upon non-job-related information or protected characteristics.

For more information, please visit https://www.eeoc.gov

**About the Role**
We are seeking a detail-oriented and analytical Junior Buyer Planner to join our Supply Chain team. In this role, you will support procurement, inventory planning, supplier management, and production scheduling activities to ensure the efficient flow of materials and timely fulfillment of business needs. The ideal candidate has experience in purchasing, inventory management, ERP systems and is eager to grow within a dynamic supply chain environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Create, review, and manage purchase orders to ensure timely delivery of materials and products.
* Maintain accurate ERP system data, including supplier information, lead times, minimum order quantities (MOQs), pricing, and purchase order status.
* Monitor inventory levels and analyze purchasing trends to support efficient inventory management and replenishment planning.
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders, including Production, Operations, Logistics, and Supply Chain teams, to identify and fulfill procurement requirements.
* Communicate with suppliers to confirm order status, delivery schedules, and resolve supply-related issues.
* Support demand planning, material requirements planning (MRP), and production scheduling activities.
* Prepare purchasing and inventory reports to support decision-making and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Assist with logistics coordination, supplier performance tracking, and supply chain optimization projects.
* Provide backup support across Purchasing, Logistics, Production Scheduling, and other supply chain functions as required.
* Ensure compliance with company procurement policies and procedure

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in **Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, Business Analytics**, or a related field.
* Minimum **2 years of experience** in purchasing, procurement, buying, inventory planning, supply chain coordination, materials planning, or a related role.
* Experience working with **ERP systems** (SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, NetSuite, or similar).
* Advanced proficiency in **Microsoft Office**, particularly Excel (PivotTables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, data analysis).
* We are seeking candidates who reside within a reasonable commuting distance of Northvale, NJ. REQUIRED

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with **MRP (Material Requirements Planning)** and inventory control processes.
* Exposure to manufacturing, distribution, or production environments.

**Total Rewards & Benefits**

* Health & Wellness: Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance.
* Financial Security: Company-paid Life Insurance and Long-Term Disability (LTD).
* Retirement Planning: 401(k) plan with a generous company match to help you save for the future.
* Paid Time Off: Accrue PTO to recharge, plus paid Holidays throughout the year.

If so, **Goodway Technologies** may be the place for you.

Goodway Technologies is a growing, entrepreneurial company that develops and markets innovative industrial maintenance solutions used by customers around the world. Our products support critical applications across commercial HVAC, facility management, manufacturing, power generation, maritime, and other industrial markets.

We are looking for a motivated and resourceful **Buyer/Planner I** to join our Purchasing team in Stamford, CT. This is a hands-on role for someone who wants to develop a broad understanding of **purchasing, material planning, inventory management, logistics, and supplier relationships**.

You will work closely with suppliers and virtually every major function within the company—including Sales, Customer Service, Engineering, Production, Quality, Logistics, and Finance—to keep materials flowing and help the business meet its goals.

**The Opportunity**

As a Buyer/Planner I, you will help ensure that we have the **right materials, in the right quantities, at the right time and at the right cost**.

You will manage day-to-day purchasing and planning activities, monitor supplier performance, respond to changing customer demand, and help identify opportunities to improve inventory, cost, delivery, and overall supply chain performance.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys **ownership, problem-solving, collaboration, and continuous improvement**.

**Purchasing & Supplier Management**

* Identify material requirements and issue purchase orders for production materials.
* Obtain supplier acknowledgements and proactively expedite or de-expedite orders as business needs change.
* Maintain accurate expected delivery dates and purchasing information in the Epicor ERP system.
* Develop strong, productive relationships with suppliers through regular communication and sharing of forecasts and business requirements.
* Identify and recommend potential new suppliers when opportunities arise.
* Support cost-reduction initiatives by negotiating volume discounts, family pricing, and other commercial agreements.
* Partner with Quality to quickly resolve supplier corrective actions, non-conformances, and quality-related issues.

**Logistics & International Supply Chain**

* Coordinate with suppliers, carriers, freight forwarders, and internal stakeholders to ensure timely and cost-effective delivery of materials.
* Support international shipments and ensure appropriate HTS classification of parts being shipped internationally.
* Work with suppliers and warehouse teams to align purchasing quantities with available storage capacity and operational requirements.
* Monitor inbound shipments and proactively address potential delays or supply disruptions.

**Planning & Inventory Management**

* Use MRP requirements, production plans, and forecasts to ensure material availability.
* Monitor customer demand and collaborate with Sales to incorporate changing forecasts into purchasing decisions.
* Maintain accurate ERP/MRP system data to generate effective purchase orders and manufacturing jobs.
* Work with Production to ensure appropriate lead times and capacity considerations are incorporated into production schedules.
* Maintain inventory planning parameters, stocking levels, and ordering inputs within the ERP system.
* Help identify and mitigate excess inventory, obsolete inventory, and out-of-stock risks.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

You will work closely with teams across the organization, including:

* **Suppliers** – to ensure purchase orders are confirmed, fulfilled, and delivered on time.
* **Sales** – to manage changing demand and minimize out-of-stock and over-stock situations.
* **Customer Service** – to support customer needs and enable sales growth.
* **Accounts Payable** – to resolve invoice discrepancies and support timely supplier payments.
* **Purchasing** – to share best practices and continuously improve purchasing processes.
* **Engineering** – to address supplier obsolescence and identify opportunities for material consolidation and complexity reduction.
* **Production** – to establish and maintain finished-goods and raw-material stocking strategies, including Kanban levels.

**What We're Looking For**

description:
The Buyer I supports the purchasing team by ordering materials, parts, equipment, and supplies needed for the organization. This role helps ensure that items are ordered at a good price, meet quality standards, and arrive on time. The Buyer I works with vendors, tracks orders, and assists with day-to-day purchasing tasks to keep operations running smoothly.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Coordinate procurement of required products and services from intent to purchase through delivery

* Communicate requirements of assigned commodities, including technical specifications, compliance, quality and schedule requirements
* Request and evaluate quotes for assigned commodities when needed
* Negotiate best value and terms with suppliers to achieve lowest possible cost that meets quality, quantity, inventory and schedule requirements
* Generate purchase orders that comply with company, customer, contractual, and government regulations
* Manage and maintain required documentation for purchasing, including orders, amendments and shipping notices
* Apply Total Cost of Acquisition principle to short and long term buying decisions
* Realign purchase order schedules to support demand with lowest impact on DSI while maintaining cost and production continuity objectives
* Support the bid and proposal process
* Develop strong supplier relationships for assigned commodities
* Develop and implement cost reduction initiatives to ensure favorable PPV
* Identify risk and escalate issues when appropriate for mitigation
* Support development of supplier agreements for assigned commodities
* Meet with supplier representatives, conduct quarterly business reviews with key suppliers
* Monitor supplier performance, provide feedback to support corrective action plans
* Perform other tasks as assigned by supervisor

**Job Requirements**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Finance, Operations, Supply Chain Management, Business or a technical discipline preferred
* Minimum 1-3 years successful purchasing experience
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office software
* Excellent organizational skills

**About our Company**

Amphenol Borisch Technologies (ABT), a division of Amphenol Corporation, is an industry leader in providing high-reliability electronic systems for Aerospace and Defense companies across the globe. ABT is focused on expanding the company’s industry presence by providing customers with superior quality and service combined with advanced manufacturing capabilities. ABT is headquartered in Grand Rapids, MI and has locations in Nogales, Mexico, Mesa, AZ and London, Ontario.

**Benefits We Offer****:** At Amphenol Borisch Technologies, we provide a wide range of benefits for our permanent full-time employees. Highlights include:

*UNITED STATES*

* Unique full-time work schedule that includes every other Friday off
* Full Medical, Dental and Prescription Drug Insurance
* Flexible Spending Accounts
* Generous 401(k) match
* Company-paid and Voluntary Life Insurance plans
* Paid Holidays and Paid Time Off Days
* Reimbursement Programs (Gym, Tuition, etc.)
* Paid time off to volunteer
* Company-Paid Short Term Disability

*CANADA*

* Full benefits package
* Company-paid and Voluntary Life Insurance plans
* Paid Holidays and Paid Time Off Days
* Reimbursement Programs (Gym, Tuition, etc.)
* Pension plan
* Paid parental leave

Amphenol Borisch Technologies is an equal opportunity employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status.

Build Your Career Where You Matter

Join CBX Solutions, the nation’s leading provider of architectural doors, frames, hardware, specialty products, and complete security integration services.

At CBX Solutions, trust and communication are the foundation of how we work. We foster an inclusive, collaborative culture where your voice is heard, your ideas matter, and your career has room to grow. Whether you're a problem-solver, innovator, or passionate about service, you’ll thrive here. Be part of a team that invests in your future, celebrates your success, and values your contribution.

Why Work With Us?

We’re committed to your success, personally and professionally. You’ll have access to:

* Comprehensive Benefits: Health, dental, vision, prescription coverage, life insurance, and 401(k) with company match.
* Work-Life Balance: Generous paid time off for rest, family, and self-care.
* Career Growth: You’ll benefit from continuous learning, mentorship, and leadership training including access to CBX University, our in-house development program.
* Supportive Culture: Innovation, creativity, and teamwork are at the heart of everything we do.

Responsible for management and control of all door and frame processes and products at the location and ensures that all procedures surrounding inventory control are properly executed. Works to achieve optimized inventory levels. Projects future usage changes and understands their impact. Sources/Releases work orders to Shop Foreman. Coordinates with internal and external customers regarding material orders and delivery dates.

Essential Functions

* Review/adjust detailed PO costs for completeness and accuracy
* Check project master for special quote numbers, terms, etc.
* Review vendor PO cost with detailed cost
* Update sales order before each sourcing session
* Source all material to PO’s as requested and transmit PO and supporting documents to vendor
* Enter all order acknowledgements; verify costing, enter promise dates, order #, etc.
* Order stock wood doors, stock hollow metal, and associated items
* Manage Expense Item Inventory in conjunction with Shop Foreman
* Source or alternate source material to be pulled from stock
* Create work orders and send to shop foreman with only materials requiring fabrication (door and frame shop)
* Review anticipated labor hours and source for in house production or direct shipment to site by manufacturer
* Answer manufacturers questions
* Other duties as assigned by supervisor

Minimum Qualifications

* High School Diploma or GED Required
* College Degree preferred
* Proficiency with MS Office Suite, ERP systems, etc.
* Must pass pre-employment background check and drug test

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

* Good communication skills
* Basic math skills and data input skills
* General knowledge of commercial doors, frames, and hardware
* Familiarity with general commercial construction practices

Physical Demands

Must be able to stand and walk for much of the day. Ability to lift 5-25 pounds frequently and ability to lift up to 50 pounds occasionally.

Work Environment

Worker is subject to frequent heavy lifting and operation of forklift.

Qualification Requirements

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed above are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Equal Opportunity Employer

CBX Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

We are a VEVRAA Federal Contractor and give priority referral to protected veterans. We are committed to taking affirmative action to employ and advance in employment qualified minorities, women, individuals with disabilities, and protected veterans.

**SUMMARY**

Mortenson is currently seeking a **Project Buyer I or II – Power Delivery** to support the Power Delivery Operating Group. This role focuses on building supplier relationships, managing procurement activities, and ensuring timely delivery of materials and equipment for the construction of substations, wind collection systems, and transmission lines.

Minneapolis, MN

**This position offers opportunities at both levels 1 and 2, allowing candidates to apply based on their experience and qualifications. Compensation for this role is determined based on factors such as experience and location.**

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Purchase equipment and materials at the best value while meeting quality, quantity, and specification requirements (e.g., transmission line steel, substation steel, high and medium voltage electrical equipment, enclosures, MV cable).
* Plan material needs early in the projects design phase to secure long-lead and critical-path items.
* Solicit bids, analyze quotations, and select suppliers based on cost and schedule competitiveness.
* Ensure buyouts align with budgets and manage procurement risks and compliance.
* Interpret technical specifications and confirm supplier compliance.
* Draft and execute purchase agreements and coordinate with Risk team on surety requirements.
* Track orders from placement through delivery and communicate status to project teams.
* Conduct quarterly job site and supplier visits to strengthen relationships.
* Effectively work and build relationships with those of diverse backgrounds and organizational levels
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**Project Buyer I**

* Collaborate with project, estimating, and design phase teams to align supply chain strategies with project goals and schedules.
* Learn contract administration and procurement risk management processes.
* Support order tracking and reporting for assigned projects.
* Assist with supplier communications and issue resolution.

**Project Buyer II**

* Lead procurement strategy development for assigned projects by collaborating with project, estimating, and design phase teams to align supply chain strategies with project goals and schedules.
* Lead risk mitigation planning for critical equipment and long-lead materials.
* Lead supplier calls to monitor performance, resolve issues, and maintain strong partnerships.
* Drives supplier performance improvements and risk mitigation.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's Degree in business, supply chain management, construction management or related discipline, or equivalent combinations of technical training and/or related experience
* Ability to handle multiple procurement activities simultaneously while maintaining accuracy and timeliness
* Knowledge of construction processes, equipment, and/or materials, purchasing processes, and procedures
* Negotiating, organizing, planning, verbal, and communication skills
* Strong customer service and analytical skills
* Active listening skills and effective communication including openness to diverse input and feedback
* Software experience
* Current driver's license

**A few benefits offered include:**

* Medical and prescription drug plans that includes no additional cost vision coverage
* Dental plan
* 401k retirement plan with a generous Mortenson match

* Employer paid Life, AD&D, and disability insurance
* No-Cost mental health tool and concierge with extensive work-life resources
* Tuition reimbursement
* Adoption Assistance
* Gym Membership Discount Program

+ **2-3+ years of procurement experience**
* **The base pay range for this role is $68,700 - $92,800**

**Project Buyer II**

* **MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:**
+ **5+ years of procurement experience**
* **The base pay range for this role is $76,200 - $114,300**

(Actual range is higher for the following office locations: Denver, CO and Chicago, IL – 5%, Seattle, WA, and Portland, OR – 10%, Washington, D.C. – 12.5%). This position is eligible for Mortenson’s incentive plan.

Purchasing Agent

In this role, you will provide support to departments with specific responsibility for implementing purchasing activities in compliance with mandated requirements, oversee daily activities, respond to a range of inquiries regarding the purchase process, and achieve agency objectives and goals within budget.

Requirements

* High School Diploma required, Associates Degree preferred.
* Minimum five (5) years purchasing experience, preferably in a non-profit environment.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office products.
* Experience with electronic procurement software applications.
* Ability to plan and manage multiple projects.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Excellent customer service skills including the ability to develop effective working relationships.
* Utilize purchasing industry best practices.

Essential Functions

* Administer bidding processes and contracts for vendor performance and compliance within established limits including preparation of specifications, issuing purchase orders, etc. for the purpose of securing goods and/ or services within budget and in compliance with regulatory requirements.
* Compiles data from a wide variety of sources including vendors, staff, public agencies, etc., for the purpose of analyzing issues, ensuring compliance with a wide variety of purchasing policies and procedures.
* Researches contracts, suppliers, equipment, and regulations, including evaluating vendors for the purpose of determining their capability for performing to established specifications.
* Negotiates with vendors for the purpose of obtaining the most advantageous terms and conditions, resolving purchasing issues, and/ or ensuring purchases are within agency requirements.
* Maintains purchasing information, files, and records for the purpose of ensuring the availability of documentation and compliance with established policies and regulatory guidelines.
* Stays current by participating in educational opportunities.

Apply online at www.acld.org or text us for more information at 516-732-3979.

Reporting to a Team Lead, Supervisor or Manager, the Buyer I is in an entry-level administrative professional responsible for the proposal or procurement of low dollar, high volume commodities and/or services.

Responsibilities:

* **Proposals:**
+ Reviews the Bill of Material (BOM); creates a Request for Quote (RFQ) form; contacts vendors for quote information; follows up on quote requests; prepares completed proposal packet for review by team lead or manager
+ Works with team lead to ensure BOM details are present; works with departments and program managers for clarification
+ Processes proposals per departmental procedures; continues to revalidate the proposals until win/loss
* **Procurement:**
+ Receives Purchase Requisition list (PR) and prioritizes per program needs; verifies pricing and delivery is current; applies purchase order (PO); verifies and enters any missing information in Costpoint; creates electronic folder for review and approval of all purchase orders
+ Notifies the Program Manager of any part, delivery or other discrepancies for review and approval prior to proceeding with Purchase Order (PO) placement
+ May complete a QA104 part number change request form
+ Submits PO to vendor for acceptance; follows up as required; cancels PO as required
+ Has minimal knowledge to source parts and services; relies on pricing history to select vendors
+ Utilizes the Approved Vendor List; develops vendor relationships; may identify new vendors; makes recommendation to leadership
+ Utilizes system generated reports for quotation data, backup justification, work assignments and PO past due dates
+ Communicates effectively; ensures system notes are provided; requests assistance with purchasing efforts; may respond to facility inquiries and issues to support the purchasing process
+ Utilizes the FAR and DFARS daily for compliance.
+ Performs other duties as assigned

Qualifications:

**Education:**

* High School Diploma or GED required; Bachelors’ degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Contracts Procurement, Finance/Accounting or equitable field preferred

**Experience:**

* Previous purchasing experience preferred; one-year experience in buying equipment, supplies, parts, services a plus

Any combination of education/experience may be substituted for job requirements at the recommendation of the hiring manager and approval of the COO or higher.

**Thank you for your interest in joining our staff at Calvary Church**.

The staff of our vibrant evangelical, non-denominational church is committed to being and making authentic followers of Jesus as we serve together using our gifts and talents.
To apply, send your resume and any other requested materials to the **Calvary Human Resources Department** at HR@calvarychurch.com

- Procurement Specialist

Full-Time

The Procurement Specialist will oversee purchasing and vendor management across Calvary’s ministries, facilities, IT, and administrative areas. This role is responsible for identifying the best value and pricing for purchases, developing strong vendor relationships, negotiating contracts, and identifying cost-saving and bulk-purchasing opportunities.

Key responsibilities include coordinating purchasing requests and approvals, preparing purchase orders, managing vendor documentation, assisting with procurement policies and procedures, conducting competitive bids and RFPs, and helping ensure that vendors and purchasing decisions align with the Calvary Articles of Faith, policies and procedures, and applicable legal and compliance requirements.

Qualified candidates should have a Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Finance, or a related field, along with 3–5 years of experience in procurement, purchasing, or vendor management. Strong negotiation, analytical, organizational, and communication skills are essential. Experience managing large purchasing budgets is preferred, and purchasing certifications such as CPSM or CPPO are a plus.

Calvary Church membership is preferred.

Interested candidates should submit a resume and cover letter to Calvary Human Resources at HR@calvarychurch.com.

**Company Description**

**Join the Alto-Shaam Team**

Virtually Tour our Facility:**https://app.cloudpano.com/tours/piGHjskWR**

Whether you're just beginning your career or have years of experience—you've come to the right place. Working at Alto-Shaam means you’re part of a passionate team of people all working together towards one common goal. We want you on our team, because you believe in getting better every day. That kind of continuous improvement is what leads to promotions, pay raises, and company-wide innovation.

Since 1955, Alto-Shaam has pioneered industry-leading foodservice equipment that anticipates and responds to industry needs. Our solutions have helped generations of foodservice professionals enhance their menus while providing a greater return on their investment.

**Job Description**

**The ideal candidate for a Buyer/Planner would be able to do the following:**

*Planning & Inventory Management:*

* Analyze MRP, safety stocks, reorder points, and service requirements ensuring adequate requisitions are released to support value stream production plans.
* Collaborate with Commodity Managers & Engineering to successfully implement engineering changes while minimizing excess and obsolete material.
* Process requisitions into purchase orders and obtain acknowledgement from suppliers.
* Ensure the timely delivery of raw materials needed to maintain the flow of production at the pace of our customers, while achieving the lowest possible cost of ownership for Alto-Shaam by properly maintaining master data within Oracle Fusion.
* Manage the procurement of materials, components, and services necessary for production.

*Supplier Performance:*

* Ensure suppliers meet delivery requirements through regular follow-up and proactive expediting. Provide proper escalation in the event production will experience a shortage.
* Maintain good supplier relations and represent Alto-Shaam in a professional and ethical manner while driving suppliers to meet delivery and quality expectations.

*Supply Chain Optimization:*

* Develop and execute strategies to create inbound transportation efficiencies across all site-specific suppliers, including exploration of returnable packaging, resulting in lower total cost of ownership.
* Lead and collaborate on structured problem-solving activities targeted at quality, supplier performance and process improvement.
* Trained in and adheres to the procedures outlined in the TA-390 Supply Chain Training Matrix

**Qualifications**

**For a candidate to be successful as a Buyer/Planner they must have:**

* Minimum of three (3) years of experience in purchasing, materials management, or supply management in a manufacturing environment.
* Bachelors’ degree or equivalent experience required. Emphasis in Business, Mathematics, Supply Chain, or Operations Management preferred.
* Demonstrated experience in Supply Chain Management best practices. CPSM or APICS certification preferred.
* Customer service orientated with a focus to deliver on-time results.
* Proven experience and skillset with ERP systems, including Oracle is required.
* Strong analytical skills; Ability to interpret and communicate technical information with a high level of detail and accuracy with internal and external stakeholders.
* Team-oriented professional with strong collaboration, networking, and communication skills, able to effectively drive project execution with internal and external organizations.
* Demonstrated proficiency in computer skills inclusive of all Microsoft Business Suite. Oracle Fusion experience is a plus.
* Travel is less than 5%.

**Additional Information**

For more information about our benefits, job duties, and company values, go to

https://www.alto-shaam.com/en
