**Craft Your Career with Brasscraft Manufacturing Company!**

**POSITION SUMMARY:**

The Maintenance, Repair, and Operations (MRO) Planner/Buyer plays a crucial role in enhancing plant efficiency by purchasing indirect items to support daily operations of the plant as it relates to tooling, supplies, equipment, and materials. You will work closely with various departments to forecast needs, procure supplies, maintain optimal inventory levels to minimize downtime. Additionally, you will negotiate contracts, track maintenance costs, and ensure compliance with safety standards. Your analytical skills and attention to detail will be essential in identifying areas for improvement and driving cost savings across the site.

**PRINCIPAL FUNCTIONAL RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Develop and analyze monthly cost summaries by machine, work order, and MRO supplies to drive cost improvements across the site.
* Track and quote current service providers monthly, ensuring timely and quality completion of required work as per agreements.
* Execute annual contracts with service vendors, negotiating terms and pricing for services rendered.
* Establish reorder point triggers in the database to initiate purchase orders for goods and services.
* Issue purchase orders based on reorder points for general MRO goods and replenish direct purchases as needed.
* Follow up on past due purchase orders to ensure timely deliveries and prevent facility downtime.
* Process urgent requests from the plant to prevent extended downtime.
* Source maintenance goods and manage third-party repairs of motors, drives, and miscellaneous items.
* Substitute obsolete parts within the facility for MRO goods.
* Maintain tool crib stocking strategies annually and manage all tool crib activities.
* Ensure contractor safety requirements are met in compliance with company standards.
* Collaborate with maintenance to schedule preventive maintenance (PM) with contractors monthly.
* Schedule contractors for necessary work related to general production or capital expenditure (Capex) projects as directed by maintenance.
* Track costs associated with capital projects in the CMMS database.
* Close out Capex projects and apply asset tags to the accounting database.
* Manage critical spare inventory through the CMMS.
* Organize monthly meetings to review all costs associated with operations.
* Identify areas for improvement in both pricing and consumption.

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor’s degree in business or related field or a minimum of 2 years of experience in inventory management, procurement, or a related role in a manufacturing environment
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, Outlook)
* Ability to analyze data, develop cost effective maintenance plans, and identify areas for improvement.
* High attention to detail to ensure accuracy in planning and execution
* Ability to manage multiple tasks, prioritize effectively, and maintain detailed records
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills; and demonstrated successful ability to build positive partnerships, while working collaboratively with cross-functional business teams.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Experience in Material Control and Work Order Management
* Familiarity with the plumbing industry and products
* Intermediate knowledge of Excel
* Proficiency in inventory management software and ERP systems.
* Experience using CMMS for planning and tracking maintenance activities.
* Demonstrated experience in Inventory Control Procedures
* Experience in negotiating and managing supplier contracts.
* Familiarity with safety and regulatory compliance in a manufacturing environment.

**Hiring Range:** $54,500 - $70,000

Actual compensation may vary based on various factors including experience, education, geographic location, and/or skills.

**ABOUT US**

Brasscraft Manufacturing Company is a leading manufacturer and distributor of high-quality water and gas flow control products, plumbing service, and repair parts for the new construction and repair/remodel markets. Headquartered in Novi, Michigan, Brasscraft supports a wide array of channel partners including wholesalers, retailers, and specialty dealers, who serve residential and commercial markets across the Americas. Brasscraft has set the plumbing standard for over 75 years, with industry leading brands including BrassCraft® and Plumbshop®.

Brasscraft (the “Company”) is an equal opportunity employer, and we want to have the best available persons in every job. The Company makes employment decisions only based on merit. It is the Company’s policy to prohibit discrimination in any employment opportunity (including but not limited to recruitment, employment, promotion, salary increases, benefits, termination and all other terms and conditions of employment) based on race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, genetic information, pregnancy, religious creed, national origin, ancestry, age, physical/menta

As a family company, we serve people and communities. When you work at Meijer, you’re provided with career and community opportunities centered around leadership, personal growth and development. Consider joining our family – take care of your career and your community!

**Meijer Rewards**

* Weekly pay
* Scheduling flexibility
* Paid parental leave
* Paid education assistance
* Team member discount
* Development programs for advancement and career growth

Please review the job profile below and apply today!

The Construction Procurement Buyer role procures services, fixtures and equipment for the Meijer Properties organization. The role is responsible to strike an optimal balance between cost, quality, delivery and service in a fast-paced environment; Work closely with the business stakeholders to give the organization a competitive advantage; and evaluate supplier’s capabilities, negotiate and administer contracts as necessary. The Buyer may participate in the writing of specifications, prepares bid forms and handles bidding process, analyzes bid results and makes recommendations, awards business, authorizes and signs purchase orders.

**What You'll Be Doing:**

* Generates new and/or revises purchase orders, using the Procurement system. Verifies supplier product information, shipping information, delivery dates, budget codes, taxes, commodity codes and other related information.
* Manages supplier relationships and performance for their categories. Monitors and communicates quality, cost, and delivery performance issues to suppliers, business users, and others, to determine the gap and take corrective action.
* Spot source items to fill demands from purchase requisitions, requests for quotations, supplier performance, etc.
* Prepare and / or modify specifications
* Conduct inquiry preparation, purchasing, expediting, quote analysis, and auditing for compliance to contract / negotiated price
* Manages commodity performance metrics/trends and reports results to departmental leadership.
* Develops cost savings, inventory, supplier and item complexity reduction goals.
* Occasionally supports the expediting of shipments for timely deliveries
* Builds, manages and reports new store, remodel and project fixture and equipment budget status/costs for the categories under management
* Supports process flow for the creation and approval of Meijer team member requisitions.
* Collaborate with Vendor Accounting, Suppliers, and Meijer locations to research and resolve discrepancies with purchase orders. Informs appropriate personnel on status of issues as requested.
* Oversees and participates in the study and design of new innovation, fixtures, equipment and/or services.
* This job profile is not meant to be all inclusive of the responsibilities of this position; may perform other duties as assigned or required.

**What You'll Bring With You (Qualifications):**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business or Supply Chain preferred.
* 2+ years of professional purchasing experience.
* Purchasing, supplier collaboration, or supply chain experience
* Reviewing, verifying, and processing requisitions and purchase orders.
* Time management skills.
* Strong customer service orientation
* Strong communication skills.
* Works well in teams.
* Strong financial/analytical acumen.
* Independently motivated
* Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite.
* Results oriented.
* Effectively interfaces with all levels and departments within the organization.

description:
Help grow a safer, cleaner, healthier future for everyone, every day.

**Who are we?**

https://www.cosasco.com/

Cosasco is an industrial product company providing leading edge integrated corrosion and erosion monitoring systems, including non-intrusive and intrusive technologies. Since 1950, Cosasco has provided solutions for such diverse industries as oil and gas, petrochemical, water treatment, chemical, pulp and paper, pharmaceutical, and utilities.

Cosasco is a subsidiary of Halma plc (“Group”). Halma plc is listed on the London Stock Exchange whose purpose is to create a safer, cleaner, healthier future for everyone every day! Halma plc has a current market capitalization of approximately £7 billion. The group has nearly 50 businesses operating through four sectors (Medical, Environmental & Analysis, Process Safety, Infrastructure Safety) in more than 20 countries and major operations in Europe, North and South America and Asia, supplying customers in 160 countries and employing more than 6,600 people worldwide.

The Senior Buyer will be responsible for driving procurement, supplier performance, and Supply Chain Cost Out (Supplier Transition) projects. This role requires strong leadership internally as well as with suppliers, precise order management, and clear communication. The Buyer must manage multiple priorities in a global supply chain.

**Duties & Responsibilities**

* Procurement & Sourcing: Own an end-to-end procurement process — including RFQ preparation, quote analysis, supplier selection, price and term negotiation, PO placement, and order follow-up — in accordance with internal procedures and in alignment with system demand (ERP), technical drawings, qualified manufacturer listings (QML/QPL), and applicable customer or regulatory documentation.
* Delivery Management: Own end-to-end purchase order delivery management, including supplier schedule alignment, expediting, recovery planning, and risk mitigation to ensure on-time fulfillment of production demand.
* Supplier Relationship Management: Develop, Onboard, and Manage supplier performance following processes and leveraging business reviews, scorecards and other tools.
* Support strategic sourcing initiatives to drive Cost Out at the commodity level.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams for logistics, discrepant material resolution, project needs, documentation requirements.
* Support process improvement, daily standups.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Engineering, or a related field and/or CPSM/CPIM preferred).
* 5–7 years of experience in procurement with focus on machined components, forgings, castings, or similar technical commodities.
* Background in mechanical engineering a plus.
* Strong knowledge of industrial supply chain standards, specifications, and regulatory requirements; Knowledge of Oil & Gas industry a plus.
* Excellent communication skills (verbal and written) and with ability to work across cultures and time zones.
* Proficiency with Microsoft applications, ERP systems (Epicor preferred, SAP, Oracle), and LEAN principles.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple priorities.

Work Conditions and Physical Requirements:

* This is an in-office position, based out of Santa Fe Springs, CA
* Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer
* Must work most hours overlapping production
* Must be able to lift up to 15 pounds at times
* Some travel may be required, up to 10%

The anticipated salary range for this position is $80,000 to $105,000 annually, with final compensation determined based on experience, skills, and qualifications.

Cosasco is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. We consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic.

#Cosasco

description:
**Tweddle Group**

For 70 years, clients have relied on Tweddle Group's breadth of services and global acuity to efficiently develop products and services that communicate with vehicle owners and service personnel. As a leading international automotive communications and publishing solutions provider, Tweddle Group combines our unique expertise in Information Development, Management, and Delivery to revolutionize the owner's information kit process. Tweddle Group was the first company to replace and enhance printed owner materials with a customer-friendly user guide, DVD, and mobile phone application. Additionally, we provide service personnel with the information required to accurately diagnose and repair vehicle concerns.

In 2021, Tweddle Group merged with CJK Group, increasing our global reach in the way of 16 additional locations. With offices in the US, India, Belgium, and Italy, we're dedicated to providing information solutions around the world.

Our culture is one that values teamwork, learning, and continuous improvement. We offer a competitive salary and benefits package, as well as opportunities to advance within our company. If you are looking to join a team with a professional environment, consistent growth, and profitability, then Tweddle Group is the place for you.

**Job Summary:**

This role is responsible for managing the end-to-end procurement and strategic sourcing process for domestic commodities and services (including MRO purchases). The ideal candidate acts as a collaborative, customer-focused team member who drives cost savings while maintaining strong supplier relationships.

**Duties/Responsibilities:**

* Support all aspects of the procurement process for strategic sourcing..
* Perform Best Practices in purchase of select commodities/services.
* Uphold a team-oriented, customer-focused and outward mindset environment within Purchasing role.
* Able to represent the Purchasing team in a professional, knowledgeable and empathic manner.
* Proactively build valuable partnerships with new and/or existing suppliers, domestic and international.
* Identify, develop and audit a committed supply base capable of supporting corporate objectives.
* Strong negotiations expertise and respect of supplier relationships, resulting in achievement of annual savings goals and cost reduction initiatives.
* Define and implement innovative improvement efforts within Purchasing and related cross-functional teams, including value-add initiatives and cross-training for risk management purposes.
* Comply with inventory valuation/turn goals, participate in physical inventories.
* Effectively support and communicate continuous improvement requests for supplier quality issues.
* Measurable performance in resolving delivery, quality and payment discrepancies.
* Participate in certification audits for TS/IATF16949, FSC, environmental, etc.
* Maintain Approved Vendors List and related performance measurements, with adherence to TS/IATF16949 quality procedures.
* Review and promote service/supply agreements to best protect corporate interests.
* Exhibit a passion to learn and grow as a valuable member of Tweddle's team.

Our full-time positions come with an array of excellent benefits including comprehensive healthcare coverage, a pension plan, flexible spending accounts and even a tuition reimbursement program.

**Job Description:**

**JOB SUMMARY**

* The Buyer III is responsible for performing all facets of County government procurement including but not limited to preparing and coordinating Invitation for Bids (IFB) and Requests for Proposals, awarding contracts, preparing, reviewing and awarding County purchase orders.
The goal of the Buyer III, as directed by the Director and Deputy Director of Purchasing, is to meet the purchasing needs of County departments within the guidelines of State and County policies and procedures.

**REPORTING RELATIONSHIPS**

* This position supervises the Operations Team comprised of two (2) Buyer I (Warehouse) positions and a Courier position.
The Buyer III will report directly to the Deputy Director of Purchasing.

**ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS**

* Manage the day-to-day workflow of Operations Team, as it relates to the timely receipt and delivery of mail, office supplies, and other goods.
* Supervise, manage, and evaluate work of Operations Team, providing coaching and mentoring as necessary.
* In consultation with Director, interview and make recommendations regarding new hires, terminations and other needed discipline within the Operations Team.
* Performs Operations Team evaluations and updates job descriptions, after consultation with Director.
* Assists with the training and development of Purchasing Team to ensure sufficient cross-trained to maintain continuity departmental of services.
* Identify and address, after consultation with Deputy Director and/or Director, operational practice and performance inefficiencies.
* Update process and procedure documents, as assigned by the Deputy Director or Director.
* Prepare, issue and review Invitation for Bids (IFB), Requests for Proposals (RFP), Requests for Quotations (RFQ), and Requests for Information (RFI).
* Act as the purchasing representative to County departments and commodities, as assigned by Director.
* Analyze and recommend purchasing strategy.
* Prepare and review County purchase orders.
* Prepare, review, and manage County contracts, as assigned, in consultation with the Director.
* Review and obtain any legal opinions needed throughout the procurement process.
* Provide guidance or instructions on procurement to County departments.
* Perform as a liaison between County and vendors.
* Oversee contractor or supplier performance.
* Establish and maintain County online vendor account access specific to the Purchasing Team.
* Assists in the supervision and coordination of multi-county and multi-municipality contracts.
* Provide coverage of Mailroom and Courier, as needed.
* Develop a working knowledge of cooperative contracts available for County procurement.
* Develop a working knowledge of online government resources, particularly State and Costars contracts.
* Develop an understanding with PA County Code, and Lancaster County’s policies and procedures.
* Advise the Director of Purchasing of any issues affecting the County or the County departments.
* Participate, where assigned by the Director, on the SPCCPB (Southeastern PA Cooperative Purchasing Board), PAPPA (PA Public Purchasing Association), and the Lancaster County Cooperative Purchasing Board.
* Help develop strategies for online procurement services.
* Participate, where assigned by the Director, on committees or special projects.
Perform other duties, tasks and special projects as required.

**OTHER SPECIFIC TASKS OR DUTIES**

Perform all other duties, tasks, and special projects related to position as required.

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration or a related field; OR
* Associate's degree in business administration or in a related field; **AND** Four or more years of related experience in performing the essential functions of this job; OR
* Four years of experience as a Buyer II; OR
Any equivalent combination of education, experience and training that provides the required knowledge skills and ability to perform this job

**KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES**

* Strong contract experience.
* Strong knowledge of procurement process.
* Strong project management skills.
* Ability to work independently and remain focused on task.
* Ability to handle and resolve problems in a timely manner.
* Excellent organizational skills.
* Able to carry tasks to completion.
* Accurate and detail oriented
* Strong knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite required. Knowledge of Workday benefic

description:
A career at Whole Foods Market is more than just the work you do- it's about your personal growth and creating meaningful change. Our purpose is to nourish people and the planet. That means improving how people eat, funding grants for school gardens, providing access to fresh and healthy food to people living within food deserts, alleviating poverty in developing countries, and so much more. Working with us means you are making a difference within your community and beyond. We aren't just a grocery store: we're world-changers. And with your help, we will continue to set the standards of excellence and revolutionize the grocery industry.

Orders, replenishes, and merchandises Specialty products and participates in regional programs for purchasing and promotions. Performs all functions related to breaking down deliveries and merchandising new products and stocking shelves. Assists Team Leader in organizing and developing promotional displays and maintaining OTS standards. All Whole Foods Market Retail jobs require ensuring a positive company image by providing courteous, friendly, and efficient service to customers and Team Members at all times. All positions must be performed in accordance with team and store Standard Operating Procedures. Further, Team Members must be prepared and able to perform the duties inherent in other Team Member job descriptions. All positions must strive to support WFM core values and goals, promote national, regional, and store programs and initiatives, and ensure adherence to all applicable health and safety regulations including Food Safety and regulatory duties required in the department.

**Job Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Purchases and replenishes Specialty items through proper buying procedures.
* Ensures orders are timely and accurate to monitor inventory turns.
* Understands why WFM products are different from conventional stores and explains differences to customers.
* Achieves and exceeds assigned / established margin and sales targets.
* Creates effective merchandising displays.
* Requests and ensures proper signage and pricing.
* Participates in national, regional and store promotional programs.
* Samples department products to customers.
* Oversees customer special order procedure.
* Processes invoices and returns.
* Maintains organized and safe back stock area.
* Analyzes and controls product waste and spoilage.
* Completes spoilage, sampling, temperature, and sweep worksheets as required.
* Arrives to work station on time, appropriately groomed, dressed and ready to work; works all scheduled shifts and attends required trainings and meetings.
* Provides excellent customer service, addresses needs of customers in a timely and effective manner and models suggestive selling techniques; answers phones and pages promptly and courteously.
* Maximizes sales potential through effective and proper procedures for prepping, storing, rotating, stocking, and merchandising product.
* Follows and complies, or ensures compliance, with established procedures, including Weights and Measures, health and sanitation, and safe work practices.
* Maintains, or ensures maintenance of, a clean and sanitary working and shopping environment; maintains equipment in accordance with WFM cleanliness and safety standards.
* Performs opening, mid, and closing duties as assigned; ensures accuracy of signs and pricing.
* Immediately reports safety hazards and violations.
* Performs other duties as assigned by store, regional, or national leadership. Performs other duties as assigned by store, regional, or national leadership.

**Job Skills**
--------------

* Extensive specialty knowledge, including production, distribution, seasonal availability, advances and trends.
* Familiarity and/or willingness to learn about products, nutritional information and other areas of study.
* Working knowledge and application of all specialty merchandising expectations.
* Demonstrates a desire to grow with the Specialty team.
* Ability to educate team on product knowledge and convey enthusiasm.
* Strong basic math skills.
* Knowledge and ability to use computer programs such as Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook and ordering systems.
* Strong to excellent communication skills and willingness to work as part of a team.
* Ability to deliver information in a clear and respectable manner to fellow Team Members, customers, and vendors.
* Ability to meet customer service expectations and standards in all interactions with customers, vendors, and Team Members.
* Ability to follow directions and procedures; effective time management and organization skills.
* Passion for natural foods and the mission of Whole Foods Market.
* Strong work ethic and ability to work in a fast-paced environment with a sense of urgency.
* Understanding of and compliance with WFM quality goals

**Experience**
--------------

* 12+ months retail experience

**Physical Requirements / Working Conditions**
---------------------------------

How you will contribute

* Maintain thorough knowledge of launch categories assigned and functions as a

strong resource for internal customers.

* Support and enable regional strategies for specific categories where applicable,

participate and lead cross functional teams as appropriate to bring continuous
improvements to projects.

* Support annual cost reduction strategies, including but not limited to: negotiate

pricing ensuring the lowest price up-front, source new business per the regional
category strategy, identify potential category and/or supplier opportunity areas
(e.g. standardization, supplier consolidation, etc.), communicate potential
opportunities internally, and initiate activities to assemble appropriate resources
to pursue opportunity areas.

* Work on ERP utilization in the purchasing function, create and maintain all

material documents, info records, purchasing contracts and lease agreements in
ERP or risk database, and utilize ERP reports to track costs and monitor spending.

procedures, and SAP in regard to all required transactions and reports.

in coordination with site procurement, site controller and site manager.

* Travel to sites with concern status with regards to a purchasing related

* Lead on Non Compliance Research and Resolution
* Participation in Launch

------------------

* Purchase indirect materials and services, capital equipment, packaging, MRO, and other categories of items as assigned, ensuring lowest total cost is achieved.

* Perform purchasing audits at plants to insure Plant Lead Requisitioners are following all processes and procedures.
* Travel to new business launch sites when required to support purchasing processes/functions until permanent position is filled, trained and functioning.
* Travel to sites with concern status with regards to a purchasing related issue/opportunity and/or the purchasing processes and resolve/stabilize.
* Other duties as assigned

* Bachelors Degree in Business, Supply Chain or similar field of study
* Knowledge of program and project management, experience within automotive or technology industries is desirable. Experience within SAP is preferred.
* Ability to negotiate as an agent on the company’s behalf, ensuring the company is represented in the best possible way.
* Ability to work well in cross-functional teams that include internal and external customers, and suppliers.

**We’re Watts. Together, we’re reimagining the future of water.**

We feel proud every day about what we do. We're all part of the same crucial mission, no matter what function we support - it's to provide safe, clean water for the world, and to protect our planet's most valuable resource.

**What we do:**

For 150 years, Watts has built best-in-class products that are trusted by customers in residential and commercial settings across the world. We are at the forefront of innovation, working with cutting-edge technology to provide smart and connected, sustainable water solutions for the future. Watts is a leading brand with a quality reputation — and we have a dynamic future ahead.

**Scope of Position**

This process-driven individual will be responsible for executing purchase orders generated by the MRP system and ensuring the accuracy of planning signals that drive replenishment. A strong understanding of master data and planning parameters—such as lead times, order quantities, and safety stock is critical to your success in this role. You will monitor MRP exceptions daily, follow up on supply issues, and validate that procurement activity aligns with system logic and real-world supplier performance.

This position reports to the Sr. Manager, MRP Buying. This role is hybrid and is based in North Andover, MA.

**Primary Job Duties and Responsibilities**

* Execute MRP-Driven procurement by reviewing and acting on MRP-generated purchase recommendations, ensuring on-time replenishment of components and finished goods and monitoring MRP exception messages
* Own Planning Parameter Accuracy, including auditing and updating master-data regularly
* Maintain data and system integrity and resolve misses generating cost, cash or service impact
* Conduct root cause analysis for service misses and recommend corrective actions
* Prioritize actions that improve service and deliver the “Right Product, Right Time” experience for customers
* Communicate effectively with internal stakeholders to ensure transparency and alignment across the supply chain
* Assume responsibility for other projects and duties as assigned by the Sr. Manager, MRP Buying or Company management
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives in planning workflows, data governance, and system usability

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in the field of operations or supply chain or similar field.
* Minimum of 2 years of relevant work experience.
* Proficiency with MRP and DRP.
* Understanding of S&OP process.
* Develop creative solutions to complex problems.
* Clearly communicate results of analysis in verbal and written formats.
* Ability to use PowerBI and Office software.
* Understanding of and adherence to applicable laws, codes, policies, regulations, and safety practices and procedures, as applicable.
* Must successfully establish employment eligibility and satisfactorily complete background checks, and required pre-employment testing as a condition of employment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Certification from APICS (CPIM or CSCP)

**General Applicable Company Competencies**

* Commitment to Watts’ values of integrity, accountability, continuous improvement and innovation, and transparency.
* Punctuality and dependability.
* Ability to be flexible and adapt to changing work priorities and stressful conditions.
* Adherence to all personnel policies, procedures, and standards of process as implemented by Watts.
* Maintain productive and collaborative relationships with other Watts employees.
* Adherence to Watts’ seven cultural beliefs: Growth Mindset, Customer-Focused Innovation, Constant Communication, Clear Goals, Collaborate Globally, Be Inclusive, and Take Action.

**Working Conditions**

While performing the job duties, you will be working in an office environment. You will be required to work in the office at the North Andover, MA location three days per week (Monday – Wednesday) and can work remotely two days per week (Thursday and Friday).

**Physical Requirements***:*Specific physical abilities required for this position include, but are not limited to:

* Ability to remain seated at a desk or workstation for extended periods.
* Ability to perform repetitive tasks like typing on a keyboard or using a mouse for extended periods.
* Ability to physically move around the office, organize or transport files, packages, or other office-related materials.
* Ability to read documents, use a computer, and perform data entry tasks.
* Ability to communicate clearly with management and coworkers, particularly in meetings or phone calls.
* Ability to operate standard office equipment such as computers, printers, phones, and copiers.
* Ability to occasionally lift and carry light objects, such as office supplies, documents, or small equipment.

As a Top-10 ENR Contractor, Gilbane is a family-owned business with 45 offices that has been shaping communities since 1870. Consistently recognized as one of the most reputable construction management firms in the country, Gilbane is committed to delivering projects safely and on-time. You will have the opportunity to build schools, labs, hospitals, corporate offices, sports arenas and more!

We are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

You are someone who acts inclusively, showing empathy and treating others with respect and dignity in order to uphold Gilbane’s core value of Caring and “People First” workplace culture. You seek to listen in order to understand and can convey information clearly. You’re a strong problem solver who can identify, prioritize, and implement alternatives for solutions, and you demonstrate adaptability by collaborating with others and supporting team members to achieve excellence. A self-starter who shows passion, commitment, and ownership all while delivering on business outcomes and driving results. You’re someone who identifies opportunities for new and improved ways of doing things that result in value-add solutions.

*Your core values match Gilbane’s: Integrity, Caring, Teamwork, Toughmindedness, Dedication to Excellence, Discipline, Loyalty, and Entrepreneurship.*

Gilbane offers employees multi-dimensional training opportunities through a number of resources. While managing your responsibilities to projects, you will be able to enroll in trainings through our award-winning Gilbane University to build leadership and technical skills. In addition, you would work with an experienced team which provides you with the opportunity to learn new industry skills every day. You will protect and promote the interests of both Gilbane and the client in all matters as well as demonstrating the personal characteristics of a developing leader.

* Manages multiple projects for the bid process from project kickoff to award including system set-up, bid package strategy, Project Manual creation, bid list management, draft, and review the bid package scope of work bid meetings, bid leveling, and recommendation to award
* Manages multiple projects for the contract process including preparing and entering contracts and procurement change orders, expediting negotiation of contract terms, and ensuring contract compliance
* Identifies and monitors current market conditions, Trade Contractors, trends, and costs
* Identifies opportunities and assists in the creation of strategy for the Diverse Owned Small Business (DOSB) utilization through the preconstruction process
* Develops relationships with Trade Contractors, Vendors, and Jobsite Personnel; manages established relationships across multiple projects while supporting internal and external customers
* Assists with developing a Master Bid List including expanding local Trade Partner networks and identifying DOSB partners across all tiers
* Recommends direction and decisions regarding the award of contracts based upon any strategic needs of multiple projects or of the Business Unit (BU)
* Provides guidance and coaching to operations personnel regarding purchasing process including during project activities, while teaching GU coursework, and during local peer group/ESG engagements
* Assists in training of department personnel
* Assists in developing a departmental budget, manages the budget, and assigns projects to it
* Assists in developing long term strategic planning and contingency plans while taking global issues into account
* Manages Trade Partner risk mitigation strategy and execution by coordinating with the operations teams, risk management team, and executive leadership team
* Effectively manages all relationships and quickly isolates the elevation risks
* Coaches and mentors less experienced team members
* Supports a positive and inclusive work environment

**EXPERIENCE/EDUCATION**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, or similar technical field
* 8+ years of experience managing/purchasing/procuring work of construction Trade Contractors
* Or equivalent combination of education and experience

* Strong negotiation and conflict resolution skills

description:
**About Critical Loop**

Critical Loop is shaping the next generation of energy systems by building the integrated edge grid of the future. Specializing in advanced energy management and battery control systems, Critical Loop empowers businesses and communities to seamlessly unite distributed energy resources for faster, more reliable, and affordable grid access. With deep expertise in grid modernization and a passion for creating resilient, responsive energy solutions, Critical Loop drives innovation at the intersection of technology and energy.

Critical Loop is seeking a hands-on Buyer to support daily purchasing, production, and inventory activities. This person will create and maintain purchase orders, follow up with suppliers, track deliveries, and keep purchasing records and reports current.

The right candidate is organized, accurate, and persistent with follow-up. They should be comfortable contacting suppliers, getting clear delivery commitments, and raising concerns early when materials may not arrive in time to support production.

This is a fully on-site role that will report to our Torrance HQ office.

**Responsibilities**

* **Purchase Order Administration:** Create, update, and manage purchase orders and Vendor Return Material Authorizations (VRMAs) accurately within company systems.
* Verify part numbers, quantities, pricing, approved supplier terms, shipping information, and required delivery dates before issuing purchase orders.
* Obtain supplier order acknowledgments and resolve differences between the purchase order and supplier confirmation.
* Follow up regularly with suppliers on open orders, confirm shipment dates, and obtain tracking information.
* Expedite materials when needed and promptly communicate delays, shortages, or changes to the Supply Chain Manager and affected teams.
* Maintain accurate open PO and material shortage reports, including current delivery dates, supplier updates, and next actions.
* Work with Production, Engineering, and the warehouse team to follow up on materials needed for upcoming builds.
* Support inventory accuracy by helping reconcile receiving records, quantity differences, and material discrepancies.
* Coordinate with suppliers and internal teams to resolve missing, incorrect, damaged, or rejected materials, including returns, replacements, and credits.
* Support Accounting with purchase order, receipt, and invoice discrepancies.
* Keep purchasing records and company systems accurate and follow established purchasing and approval procedures.

**Qualifications**

* At least two years of hands-on purchasing experience, preferably in a manufacturing environment.
* Experience creating and managing purchase orders, following up with suppliers, and tracking deliveries.
* Strong attention to detail and the ability to maintain accurate records.
* Clear communication skills and consistent follow-through with suppliers and internal teams.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, including maintaining trackers, sorting and filtering data, and using basic formulas.
* Familiarity with purchasing systems and basic inventory and receiving processes.
* Ability to manage several open orders and changing priorities while keeping urgent items visible.
* Willingness to work closely with production and warehouse teams to resolve day-to-day material issues.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience purchasing electrical or mechanical components for manufacturing.
* Familiarity with bills of materials (BOMs), part numbers, and revision control.
* Experience using Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems for purchasing and inventory.
* Familiarity with Material Requirements Planning (MRP) to identify what materials are needed, in what quantities, and when.
* Associate’s or bachelor’s degree in supply chain, business, or a related field preferred; relevant practical experience is equally valued.

**What Success Looks Like**

Purchase orders are accurate, supplier commitments are documented, reports are current, and production teams have clear visibility into material availability. Shortages and delays are raised early, and open issues are followed through to resolution.

Compensation Range: $75K - $85K

* Purchases the highest quality merchandise at the lowest possible price
* Prepares and manages order requests & purchase orders in purchasing software
+ Helps solicit bid proposals and review all staff order requisitions for goods and services
+ Updates and maintains user profiles, undelivered orders, returns & request for refunds
+ Sets up new ship-to accounts for punchout vendors
+ Manages the internal electronic catalog
+ Works with graphics dept and vendors on NEMS specialty orders
+ Works with staff and vendors on defective or unacceptable goods and determine corrective action
+ Troubleshoots software issues with the software tech support, when needed
* Researches and evaluates suppliers based on price, quality, selection, service, support, availability, reliability, production and distribution capabilities, and the supplier’s reputation and history
* Works with the Accounting department on invoice discrepancies
* Manages return of expired vaccines to manufacturers, for account credit.
* Runs open order reports monthly (or bi-weekly if necessary) and email staff to complete order receiving’s on delivered items, into our purchasing software.
* Assists the Purchasing Agent II or Purchasing Manager in negotiations, renewals, and administration of contracts with suppliers, vendors, and other representatives
* Maintains computerized procurement records; conducts one-on-one training on our procurement software
* Maintains communication and working relationships with vendors
* Assists with any special projects, as assigned.
* Must be able to lift packages up to 20 lbs
* Performs other job duties as required by manager/supervisor

* Completion of a high school diploma or equivalent
* Must be proficient in computers and ability to learn new applications
* Excellent communication, organizational and budgeting skills
* Demonstrated skills in problem identification, analysis, and resolution
* Detail oriented with a strong emphasis on accuracy and timelines
* Prior experience purchasing is a plus

**LANGUAGE:**

* Must be able to read, write and speak English fluently
* The ability to speak a second language is an asset

**STATUS:**

* This is an FLSA non-exempt position.
* This is not an OSHA high-risk position.
* This is a Full Time position.

Liza Fawcett is a PHR-certified HR professional with over 20 years of cross-industry experience. As a Fractional HR Director & Business Partner, she supports businesses through growth by stepping in to assist with HR-related needs. On behalf of our client, we are recruiting for a **Supply Planning & Procurement Manager**.

**Do you understand how plants grow AND have experience purchasing the materials needed to make that happen?**

If yes, read on...

**Why This Role Exists**

Plants don't wait, and neither do large-scale buyers who depend on perfectly timed product. If you understand plants, timing, and procurement at a deep level, this is a rare opportunity to join a respected operation and lead a critical function.

**What You’ll Do**

✔ Plan & coordinate the full growing cycle (2–3 months ahead)

✔ Order materials — right on time

✔ Keep schedules tight across Sales, Production & Growers

✔ Negotiate with vendors like a pro

✔ Keep ERP & inventory systems humming

**Why You’ll Love This Role**

✔ Family‑run, kind leadership, excellent reputation

✔ Down‑to‑earth, ranch‑style culture with hardworking, friendly people

✔ Full autonomy — you run the planning and procurement function

✔ Competitive Base Salary + Bonus program

✔ Medical, dental, vision, 401(k) + match

✔ Relocation assistance available

**What You Bring**

✔ Experience in horticulture, nursery, ag, or landscaping

✔ Expertise in purchasing or supply planning

✔ Deep understanding of plant growth → optimal bloom for a diverse range of outdoor plant varieties

✔ Strong negotiation & vendor management skills

✔ Excel, ERP, & inventory system experience

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Relocation assistance
* Vision insurance

Education:

* Bachelor's (Preferred)

Experience:

* ERP, inventory planning, or production management: 1 year (Preferred)
* Horticulture, nursery, agriculture, landscaping or related: 5 years (Preferred)
* Purchasing, procurement, inventory, or supply planning: 3 years (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

This position ensures that all purchases are aligned with company goals, project timelines, and budgets, while ensuring the highest standards of quality and efficiency. This role has an operational focus with an emphasis on customer service, strategic planning for business growth expectations, and day-to-day procure to pay processes.

**Essential Duties & Responsibilities**

* Procurement
* + Manages procurement of assigned goods/commodities in agreement with company policies and objectives
+ Manages transactional activities related to the quotation, purchase, and delivery of assigned goods/services
+ Reviews requisitions for accuracy and completeness
+ Continually works to improve data accuracy and system integrity
+ Monitors and drives cost reductions across procurement activities without compromising quality. Ensures value-for-money for all purchases.
+ Ensure accurate forecasting, stock levels, and timely deliveries of products and parts to avoid production delays

· · Supplier Management

o Manages supplier relationships, analyzes performance, and provides feedback

o Tracks and analyzes metrics to develop and implement improvement plans

o Actively pursues supply-base rationalization

o Manages issue resolution regarding defective material returns, corrective action requests, and invoicing

o Supports engineering change notices

**Other**

o Builds and maintains relationships with internal customers to identify and address needs and develop improvement opportunities

o Works with various departments to support projects and new product introductions

o Other duties as assigned

**Qualifications**

* Minimum 3 years purchasing/supply chain experience in a manufacturing environment, 5 years preferred
* MRP experience, SAP preferred

* Bachelor’s degree; or one to two year’s related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience

* Strong attention to detail and accuracy-Excellent organizational and time management skills
* Ability to work effectively both independently and in a team environment
* Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple projects simultaneously

* Strategic thinking and decision-making

**Supervisory Responsibilities:** No

**Physical Demands and Work Environment:**

Office Setting

* Choice of sitting or standing or alternating between them (stand-up desk optional)

* Keyboarding/typing on a computer for extended periods of time

* Moderate noise, i.e., phones, printer, light foot traffic

* Medium noise, i.e., manufacturing facility with machinery operating on factory floor with heavy traffic

description:
Science is a clinical stage, vertically integrated technology company focused on solving some of neuroscience’s hardest questions and most serious unmet medical needs. We work to restore quality of life to those with debilitating conditions for which there are no treatment options, creating devices aimed at restoring vision, cognition, and mobility to patients who have lost it. To support progress across our industry, we provide state-of-the-art components and vertically integrated infrastructure for others to build on via Science Foundry.

As a member of the Operations team, you will support the central operations of the Science team. Your strong organization and problem solving skills as well as attention to detail will enable engineers and scientists to meet our ambitious timelines and goals. We are seeking someone to support the day-to-day purchasing of the company. This job is perfect for individuals who thrive in fast-paced environments and are excited to work with and learn from engineers and scientists to build systems that ensure equipment and shipments are received and set up.

**Role Responsibilities:**

* Owning and optimizing company purchasing and procurement.
* Responsible for performing activities related to requesting quotations, negotiating pricing, supplier performance, supply chain risk, and placing purchase orders to suppliers for materials associated with R&D.
* Overseeing shipping and receiving processes, including accurately documenting incoming and outgoing shipments and monitoring supplier performance, addressing any quality or delivery issues promptly and effectively.
* Maintaining accurate records of procurement activities, including purchase orders, contracts, and related service and warranty agreements.
* Processing packaging shipping, and tracking domestic and international orders accurately, including scheduling of courier pickups and deliveries.
* Building relationships with important vendors to understand how they can impact our business and negotiate favorable terms
* Maintaining the cleanliness and organization of the shipping and receiving space.

**Key Qualifications:**

* High school diploma or equivalent; undergraduate degree preferred
* Experience building and maintaining successful relationships with customers and suppliers
* Prior experience in operations, organization, or logistics
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to establish and maintain effective systems
* Detail-oriented and capable of working independently with limited supervision
* Ability to lift and move heavy objects using proper lifting techniques
* Proficiency in using basic computer applications, including email and spreadsheets
* Excellent communication skills and a collaborative mindset
* Flexibility to adapt to changing priorities and tasks in a fast-paced environment
* Strong work ethic and reliability

**Salary/Pay Range:**

For individuals hired to work in California, Science Corporation is required by law to include a reasonable estimate of the compensation range for this role. The base salary range for this full-time position is $80,000 – $120,000 + equity + benefits. Individual pay is determined by various factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Please keep in mind that the equity portion of the offer is not included in these numbers.

**Benefits:**

At Science, our benefits are in place to support the whole you:

* Competitive salary and equity
* Medical, dental, vision and life insurance
* Flexible vacation and company-paid holidays
* Healthy meals and snacks provided for non-remote employees
* Paid parental, jury duty, bereavement, family care and medical leave
* Dependent Care Flexible Spending Account, subsidized by Science
* Flexible Spending Account
* 401(k)

Science Corporation is an equal opportunity employer. We strive to create a supportive and inclusive workplace where contributions are valued and celebrated, and our employees thrive by being themselves and are inspired to do their best work.

We seek applicants of all backgrounds and identities, across race, color, ethnicity, national origin or ancestry, citizenship, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or parental status, or disability. Applicants will not be discriminated against based on these or other protected categories or social identities. Science will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable federal, state and local laws.

**About the Job:**

In this role, you will execute the end-to-end procurement lifecycle for direct materials and services at Blue Origin, with a specialized focus on standard Commercial Off-The-Shelf (COTS) products, discrete electronic components, and aerospace-related hardware. You will process purchase requisitions into POs, issue RFQs/RFPs, perform competitive bid analyses, and execute supplier pricing and terms negotiations. Partnering with engineering and quality teams, you will manage post-award supplier performance, maintain On-Time Delivery (OTD), and navigate strict aerospace compliance and traceability standards.

**What We’re Looking For**

**Education & Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Business, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* 5+ years of procurement/purchasing experience, preferably in a direct buying capacity.
* Demonstrated experience procuring COTS products, discrete electronic components, and electronics hardware.
* Hands-on proficiency with enterprise ERP and procurement platforms (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Coupa).

**Must-Have Skills**

* **Direct & COTS Sourcing:** Full procurement lifecycle execution for direct materials, catalog buying standardization, discrete electronics, and COTS distributor management.
* **RFQs, RFPs & Negotiations:** Skilled in issuing solicitations, conducting competitive cost/bid evaluations, and negotiating pricing, terms, and conditions to drive cost savings.
* **Post-Award Supplier Management:** Proven capability tracking supplier commitment schedules, maintaining On-Time Delivery (OTD), and resolving invoice/delivery/quality issues.
* **Compliance & Recordkeeping:** Ability to maintain audit-ready procurement files in adherence to company policies, contractual requirements, and regulatory standards.

**Nice-to-Have Skills (Preferred)**

* Procurement experience in aerospace, defense, or highly regulated manufacturing environments.
* Familiarity with aerospace quality standards, compliance requirements, and strategic category management.
* Hands-on experience with Coupa and Costpoint ERP systems.
* Professional procurement certifications (e.g., CPM, CPSM, or equivalent).

description:
Headquartered in Nashville, TN – one of the fastest-growing and most exciting cities in the United States – August Bioservices is a privately-owned, high-growth, and high-impact Contract Development Manufacturing Organization (CDMO). As a US-based outsourcing partner that provides a wide array of expert drug discovery, drug formulation, and drug manufacturing services to pharma and biotech companies of all sizes, we play a vital role in the global pharmaceutical industry. Our work is instrumental in helping to develop molecules today that can become the life-changing therapies of tomorrow. To support our growth plans, August is investing significant capital in a two-phase expansion project – including building a new state-of-the-art facility adjacent to our current facility. For those seeking dynamic opportunities, rewarding career paths and a chance to make a difference in global health, come grow with August!

The Planner/Buyer is responsible for coordinating production planning and procurement activities to support the efficient manufacturing of pharmaceutical products. This role ensures raw materials, components, and services are available to meet production schedules while maintaining compliance with regulatory requirements and quality standards. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced, small-company environment and can balance strategic planning with hands-on execution.

### **Key Responsibilities:**

**Production Planning**

* Develop and maintain production schedules based on customer demand, forecasts, and capacity constraints

* Coordinate closely with manufacturing, quality, and warehouse teams to ensure schedule adherence

* Monitor production progress and adjust plans as needed to address delays or changes in demand

* Support new product introductions and tech transfers with planning and material readiness

**Procurement / Buying**

* Source and procure raw materials, packaging components, and services required for GMP manufacturing

* Issue and manage purchase orders; track order status to ensure on-time delivery

* Maintain appropriate inventory levels while minimizing excess and obsolete stock

* Identify and qualify suppliers in collaboration with Quality and Regulatory teams

* Negotiate pricing, lead times, and supply agreements where applicable

**Inventory & Materials Management**

* Monitor inventory levels and perform material requirements planning (MRP)

* Ensure accurate inventory records in ERP systems

* Collaborate with warehouse on receiving, storage, and material movement

* Manage safety stock levels and reorder points

**Cross-Functional Coordination**

* Partner with Quality Assurance to ensure materials meet GMP and regulatory standards

* Work with Finance on cost control, budgeting, and invoice reconciliation

* Communicate with customers (as needed) regarding timelines and material availability

* Support audits by providing documentation and traceability of materials

**Continuous Improvement**

* Identify opportunities to improve planning accuracy, supplier performance, and inventory turns

* Participate in process improvement initiatives and system enhancements

* Develop and track KPIs related to supply chain performance

* Other duties as assigned

### **Qualifications:**

**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Business, Life Sciences, or related field (or equivalent experience)

* 3+ years of experience in planning, procurement, or supply chain within pharmaceutical, biotech, or regulated manufacturing environment

* Experience in a contract manufacturing (CMO/CDMO) environment preferred

**Skills & Knowledge**

* Strong understanding of GMP requirements and regulated environments

* Proficiency with ERP/MRP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, or similar)

* Excellent organizational, problem-solving, and multitasking skills

* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a small, dynamic company setting

* Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills

* Analytical mindset with attention to detail

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* APICS/ASCM certification (e.g., CPIM or CSCP)

* Experience with demand planning and forecasting

* Familiarity with supplier qualification and audit processes

### **Work Environment:**

* Fast-paced, growth-oriented small company environment
* Requires frequent interaction with manufacturing and warehouse areas

At August Bioservices, Our Credo is our culture. Everything we do, we do with great care. We believe in the promise of discovery and the power of science to transform lives. We assert that excellence is not a static destination, but a standard, and an every-day measuring stick of our advancement. We aspire to unlock the potential in every person, every process and every molecule – from start to finish. We are committed to doing the right thing the first time and every time, meeting or exceeding all regulatory requirements. We strive to be exceptional, preferred and indispensable

the manufacturing of dietary supplements that meet company and customer quality specifications, price

points, and timelines.

This position contributes to furthering our reputation in the industry and the community of

effectively delivering products and services to our customers and to your coworkers with integrity.

A non-negotiable requirement of working for our Company is maintaining, modeling and acting in

accordance with the Core Values of Phoenix Formulations.

1. Internal and External Customer Service with a laser focus

2. Honesty and Integrity

3. Personal Accountability

4. Work smart, work hard

5. Making the lives we touch better today than yesterday

6. Creating wealth through profits and growth

**Essential Functions and Responsibilities to ensure the quality and safety of the product will include, but not**
**be limited to:**

* Review product specifications to maintain a working technical knowledge of the goods or services to

be purchased.
* Monitor and follow applicable laws and regulations.
* Locate and evaluate vendors, to determine product quality, availability and terms of sales and monitor the performance of existing vendors to determine needed changes.
* Study sales records, inventory levels of current stock, and analyze market and delivery systems to develop strategic purchasing programs that to maintain reasonable levels of inventory.
* Support Manager’s negotiations with suppliers, vendors, and other representatives.
* Purchase the highest quality merchandise at the lowest possible price for the needed quantities and time frame.
* Prepare reports regarding market conditions, merchandise costs, and vendor performance.
* Monitor shipments to ensure that goods come in on time and resolve problems related to unacceptable, undelivered, or goods that arrive late.
* Provide information or indication of problems to Management or Quality Assurance.
* Perform duties safely and to report unsafe conditions or actions.
* Reports to work regularly and on time.
* Assists in other duties as needed and directed.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Mathematical Skills – Accuracy with arithmetic, subtraction, multiplication, division, decimals, percentages, fractions, and basic algebra.
* Language Skills – Must be able to communicate complex concepts in English, verbally and in writing.
* Computer Skills – Must be proficient with Microsoft Office, Excel in particular and have a thorough understanding of inventory software, time keeping or other business related software.

**Preferred Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:**

* Skilled in monitoring, troubleshooting, critical thinking, process control, time management,

following through, relationship building, negotiation, and conflict resolution.
* Demonstrate strong attention to detail, orientation to quality, deductive reasoning, problem

sensitivity, problem solving, skilled at decision making, and customer service.
* Knowledge of food production processing, cGMP’s.

employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.

* Regularly required to sit, walk, or stand.

may be worn in certain situations.

* The employee is regularly required to talk on the phone, face to face, and use the computer or

* Frequent interaction with others.
* Completion of duties must be done within an allotted time which may create a sense of time

**COMPANY OVERVIEW:** Nelson Global engineers, manufactures, and distributes clean and efficient Air & Fluid Transfer, NVH, Complex Structural, Acoustic, and Thermal Management Solutions. Nelson Global partners with the World’s leading OEMs. With 22 global manufacturing and distribution facilities and unparalleled engineering and innovation capabilities, Nelson Global provides mission critical solutions with the highest degree of reliability at the lowest cost. Our dedication to serving our employees, partners, and the planet responsibly is realized across three pillars of sustainability – environmental, social, and governance. By empowering our people, reducing waste, and developing innovative and efficient systems, we support the communities and resources that spur the industries and technologies of the future.

**POSITION OVERVIEW:** This Position is accountable for transactional support and procurement of required materials and services needed to support the manufacturing organization while maintaining spend to budget monthly. This position is responsible for purchasing transactions, including the processing of requisitions and purchase orders. Must ensure compliance with company policies and procedures for best practices to ensure best total cost and minimum inventory while supporting production.

**HOURS:** Monday - Friday 40 hours a week.

**PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES & DUTIES:**

* Order material, expedite, move out, or cancel as appropriate to support production and drive cost and working capital results.
* Collaborate with sourcing team to identify sources of supply and pricing discrepancies
* Obtain information from suppliers concerning product, price, and delivery dates
* Identify and resolve issues, late deliveries, shortages, quality issues with vendors.
* Initiate and support continuous improvement activities to achieve improved efficiency.
* Process purchase requisitions for materials and services in ERP or Supplier Order Management systems and ensure system accuracy.
* Take ownership of open issues and ensure their timely resolution.
* Maintain effective supplier relationships and monitor supplier delivery performance.
* Maintain efficient Kan Ban System: ordering components, maintain correct card counts, update program to support new products as they come in.
* All other duties as assigned.

**REQUIRED EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS:**

* 1-2 years of manufacturing experience required.

**PREFERRED EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS:**

* Prior experience with inventory control buying/purchasing preferred.
* ERP experience desired (Oracle, SAP, Epicor)
* High School Diploma or GED
* Demonstrated computer skills
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel, TEAMS, and Access

**SKILLS AND ABILITIES:**

* Effective negotiation skills.
* Takes initiative to take ideas and direction and convert them to workable solutions with minimal supervision.
* Ability to handle oneself professionally and build rapport with all customers (internal/external) and suppliers.
* Keep work area safe and clean (5S- Sort, Straighten, Shine, Standardize, Sustain)
* Needs to be able to organize and prioritize workload to meet due dates and execute multiple work activities.
* Must be self-motivated and demonstrate a positive attitude.
* Adhere to all safety guidelines and PPE requirements
* Good computer skills (Microsoft Office experience: Excel, Word, Outlook, TEAMS)
* Good verbal and written communication skills
* Able to read and interpret company documents, such as safety rules, operating instructions, policies, and procedures
* Regular, consistent, and punctual attendance is required

**PHYSICAL AND MENTAL REQUIREMENTS-**The Indirect Buyer position is primarily an indoor office position. However, the incumbent may occasionally be in the manufacturing plant, which requires walking and standing on concrete and the use of required PPE.

Frequent sitting and/or standing

Occasionally walking

Occasional lifting or carrying up to a maximum of 25 pounds.

Occasional reaching at desk level, above shoulders, overhead, and below desk level.

Frequent use of a computer, keyboard, and mouse

Occasionally, learning new tasks.

Frequently remembering and focusing.

A frequent degree of organization is required

Frequently interpreting data and integrating information

Frequently reading and writing.

**Purchasing Manager**

Are you passionate about clean, sustainable eating? Enthusiastic about working in a people first culture, committed to living a good life and eating good food while being good people? Awesome! Keep reading…

**Who we are** –

Lancaster Farm Fresh Cooperative (LFFC) is a nonprofit organic farmers’ cooperative of over 120+ farmers in Lancaster County, Pennsylvania. We focus on creating healthy, high-quality foods from our highly maintained and enriched soils on our small-scale family farms. LFFC serves all of Eastern Pennsylvania, New York City, and most of the tri-state area by connecting the farmer and customer to deliver the best local organic produce, value-added products, and humanely raised and pastured animal products to retail establishments, co-ops, restaurants, and institutions.

**The perks of working here** –

* Competitive medical, dental, and vision coverage
* 401k with a 4% match
* Paid time off and paid sick days
* Free summer CSA (community supported agriculture) share
* Access to employee store with discounted organic food and drink and awesome LFFC-branded swag
* Being part of something that will make you feel good at the end of the day

**Position Summary** **–**

The Purchasing Manager directs and oversees all local, regional, and national food procurement programs. This role is responsible for establishing purchasing policies, inventory procedures, and operational guidelines across the organization. This role builds and maintains strong relationships with a large network of local farms, develops supplier contracts, and collaborates closely with Wholesale, CSA, Warehousing, and Transportation teams. This is an exempt position, requiring 45+ hours per week. This position reports directly to the Business Development Manager.

**Who you are –**

* 3–5+ years of experience in a procurement, supply chain, or purchasing management role.
* Bachelor’s degree in supply chain management, logistics, business administration, or a related field is preferred (equivalent experience considered).

* Proven ability to manage product categories while balancing quality, service, risk, and cost.
* Ability to run a successful procurement program in strict adherence to LFFC standards and guidelines.

* Enthusiasm for and commitment to working with farmers in the local organic food movement.
* Ability to build trusted partnerships with farmers, suppliers, customers, and internal colleagues.
* Ability to monitor budgets, profitability, and margins.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.

* Outstanding time management, organizational efficiency, and follow-up skills.
* High proficiency with Microsoft Office suite.
* Ability to work varied hours throughout the week and occasional weekends to accommodate changing department and seasonal needs.

**What you’ll be doing –**

* Direct and mentor a purchasing team of 7+ personnel, foster a collaborative, trusted, and high-performing environment.
* Oversee the purchasing budget through thoughtful spend analysis and cost management.
* Maintain inventory control and manage procurement data to support the buying and coordination needs of Wholesale, CSA, and other departments.

* Collaborate directly with the Executive Director and management teams to purchase local and regional farm products from both member and non-member farmers.
* Lead crop planning and product forecasting initiatives in partnership with local farms to ensure consistent, sustainable supply.
* Ensure all farms and vendors strictly comply with company guidelines regarding growing practices, animal husbandry, and food safety standards.

* Monitor regional growing conditions, weather impacts, emerging market trends, and crop availability to secure high-quality, sustainable produce and goods while successfully navigating seasonal supply fluctuations.
* Research, evaluate, and negotiate with vendors based on price, quality, and market trends to achieve optimal terms and product performance.
* Cultivate long-lasting, trust-based partnerships across all internal and external networks, with a dedicated emphasis on strengthening and supporting relationships with coop farms.

* Maintain, review, and report on key procurement records—including purchase history, product costs, planning targets, and inventory levels—to minimize product waste and optimize daily operations.
* Minimal regional travel required, a partial day trip about 4 times a year.

This job description is intended to describe the general requirements for the performance of this job. It is not a complete statement of duties, responsibilities, or requirements. Other duties, not listed here, may be assigned as necessary to ensure the proper operation of the team.

**Essential Functions / Tasks:**

**Requirements:**

**Physical:**

Vision

Ability to read data and the computer screen.

Hearing

Hearing required to hear customers and co-workers make requests.

Sense of Smell

Ability to smell is not relevant.

description:
Beehive Industries is dedicated to *Powering American Defense* by revolutionizing the design, development, and delivery of jet propulsion systems to support the warfighter. Through the integration of additive manufacturing, the company aims to meet the growing and urgent needs for unmanned aerial defense by dramatically improving a jet engine’s speed to market, fuel efficiency, and cost.

Founded in 2020, the company is headquartered in Centennial, Colorado, with additional facilities in Knoxville, Tennessee, Loveland Ohio, and Mount Vernon, Ohio. Beehive is committed to grow and advance the defense industrial base while manufacturing exclusively in the USA. This role will be located at our Cincinnati, Ohio facility.

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented Buyer to own and support execution of all outside processing and special process requirements in a fast-paced aerospace and defense environment. This role owns the supplier relationship and purchasing process for outside services including non-destructive testing, heat treatment, and other specialized manufacturing services

The Buyer works closely with Manufacturing, Quality, Engineering, Supply Planning, and Program teams to ensure outside processing is completed in accordance with purchase order requirements, customer specifications, applicable aerospace standards, and required delivery schedules.

This position is responsible for negotiating long term agreements, understanding supplier capacity and constraints, partnering with technical teams to qualify new sources and managing the complete outside-service process from purchase requisition through supplier execution.

**What You’ll Do...**

* Manage purchase orders and supplier relationships for all assigned outside processing and special process requirements.
* Manage RFQs/RFPs, supplier selection, bid analysis, negotiations, and contract execution.
* Ensure full compliance with FAR/DFARS requirements and all government contracting regulations throughout the procurement process.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with Engineering, Operations, Facilities, Quality, Finance, and Program Management teams to support business objectives.
* Negotiate pricing, payment terms, lead times, service agreements, and long-term supply arrangements.
* Develop and maintain supplier relationships to ensure performance in quality, delivery, cost, and responsiveness.
* Identify and execute cost reduction, process improvement, and supply chain risk mitigation initiatives.
* Maintain accurate procurement records, purchase orders, and sourcing documentation within ERP/MRP systems.
* Support audits and documentation requirements related to AS9100, ISO standards, and government contracting compliance.
* Own supplier delivery performance for outside processing requirements and proactively manage material through the supplier network.
* Coordinate shipment of material to and from outside processors to support production schedules.
* Monitor supplier lead times, work-in-process, capacity constraints, and potential delivery risks.
* Support long-term agreements, pricing agreements, blanket purchase orders, and other commercial strategies where appropriate

**You have...**

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, or related field preferred.

**Experience**

* 3–7+ years of purchasing or procurement experience in manufacturing, aerospace, defense, or highly regulated industries.

**Skills & Competencies**

* Demonstrated experience preparing, managing, and auditing procurement compliance documentation.
* Strong negotiation, analytical, and supplier management skills.
* Working knowledge of ERP/MRP systems
* Ability to read and interpret statements of work, and technical specifications
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and procurement analytics.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a deadline-driven environment.
* The ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. government issued security clearance is required. U.S. citizenship is required, as only U.S. citizens are eligible for a security clearance

**Nice to have...**

* Experience in aerospace, defense, precision machining, additive, or advanced manufacturing environments. Experience supporting lean manufacturing or continuous improvement initiatives.
* Experience with long-term supply agreements and logistics
* Experience with ERP/MRP systems such as NetSuite, SAP, Oracle, or similar.

If this sounds like you, please submit an application with your resume. This could be the opportunity you are looking for to expand your skills, contribute to a winning team, and work with talented people who love what they do and take pride in our mission.

Beehive Industries offers a comprehensive benefits package that includes group Medical, Dental, Life, and Short and Long-Term disability coverage from day one. We also offer a generous 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan with a Company match. Ever
