**This position reports to:**

Purchasing Manager

\\_\\_

The work model for the role is: **Onsite, Mebane, NC**.

In this role as **Buyer - ELSP**, you will have the opportunity to purchase materials according to required technical specifications, price, delivery schedule, and terms. Each day, you will ensure purchasing activities align with corporate purchasing policies and procedures. You will also showcase your expertise by identifying new suppliers in cooperation with the relevant category team.

**Your role and responsibilities:**

* Place purchase orders with suppliers for the procurement of production material as required by forecast and the production schedule; Monitor status of open purchase orders to ensure on-time delivery of all materials, including timely resolution, communication, and mitigation of future potential supply issues.
* Expedite or defer orders as required based on schedule/inventory discrepancies and/or adjustments; Determine and establish optimal inventory levels based on forecast, demand variation and material lead times.
* Coordinate material flows throughout product/BOM changes, obsolescence, and introduction of new suppliers and/or materials due to new product development or launches; Provide help & support to internal materials areas such as Receiving, Warehouse & Inventory Management to ensure proper transactions are done in the system.
* Manage and resolve issues regarding PO due to invoice discrepancies, returns and/or quality issues within the supplier data base.

**Qualifications for the role**

* **Bachelor degree** in Industrial Engineering, Business Administration, Supply Chain, or a related field.
* **Minimum 2 years of experience** in Materials, Planning, Purchasing, Inventory Management etc.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Advanced Excel, Outlook) and purchasing software, SAP preferred
* Strong planning and organizational skills; Analytical with a methodical approach to problem solving; Ability to work under pressure
* You are at ease communicating in English, written and verbal.
* Candidates must already have a work authorization that would permit them to work for ABB in the US.

**More about us**

ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. **Lumber Buyer**

**Position Summary**

Coop Construction is seeking an experienced **Lumber Buyer** to manage the purchasing of lumber, engineered wood products, sheathing, and related framing materials for multi-family and other construction projects.

The Lumber Buyer is responsible for obtaining competitive pricing, placing accurate material orders, coordinating deliveries, maintaining supplier relationships, and ensuring materials are available when required by the construction schedule.

This position works closely with **Estimating, Project Management, Superintendents, Purchasing, Accounting, and Field Operations** to control material costs and ensure projects receive the correct materials, in the correct quantities, at the correct time.

The ideal candidate will have strong knowledge of lumber products, framing materials, supplier pricing, construction schedules, and multi-family wood-frame construction.

* Studs and plates

* LSL

* Glulam
* I-joists
* Rim board
* Headers and beams
* OSB
* Plywood
* Blocking and backing materials
* Specialty framing materials
* Other materials required for Coop Construction's framing operations
* Review approved material takeoffs and purchase requirements.
* Convert estimated quantities into practical purchase orders.
* Verify material sizes, grades, lengths, quantities, and specifications before ordering.
* Purchase materials in accordance with project schedules.
* Coordinate multiple material orders across multiple projects.

* Prepare and issue accurate purchase orders.

* Ensure purchase orders identify the correct:
* Project

* Material

* Required delivery date
* Maintain organized purchasing records.
* Obtain confirmation from suppliers after orders are placed.

* Confirm supplier availability.
* Monitor backorders and delayed materials.
* Coordinate special delivery requirements.
* Verify delivery locations and site access.
* Communicate delivery changes to field personnel.
* Resolve delivery problems quickly.

* Monitor material availability and lead times.
* Identify potential shortages before they affect construction.
* Monitor long-lead engineered wood products.
* Coordinate early purchasing when appropriate.
* Avoid unnecessary material over-ordering.
* Track materials purchased versus estimated quantities.
* Monitor remaining material requirements throughout the project.
* Assist in reallocating unused materials between projects when practical.

* Compare actual purchase prices against estimated costs.
* Identify purchasing variances.
* Monitor supplier price changes.
* Identify cost-saving opportunities.
* Evaluate alternate suppliers.
* Evaluate acceptable material substitutions.
* Negotiate freight and delivery costs.
* Monitor project material budgets.
* Communicate significant price increases or budget concerns to management.

Pay is based on several factors which vary based on position. These include labor markets and in some instances may include education, work experience and certifications. In addition to your pay, Target cares about and invests in you as a team member, so that you can take care of yourself and your family. Target offers eligible team members and their dependents comprehensive health benefits and programs, which may include medical, vision, dental, life insurance and more, to help you and your family take care of your whole selves. Other benefits for eligible team members include 401(k), employee discount, short term disability, long term disability, paid sick leave, paid national holidays, and paid vacation. Find competitive benefits from financial and education to well-being and beyond at https://corporate.target.com/careers/benefits.

**About us:**

Working at Target means helping all families discover the joy of everyday life. We bring that vision to life through our values and culture. Learn more about Target here.

A role in Buying means working with several diverse vendors to choose the best product mix, both in-store and online. We help determine where to localize, while calibrating market positioning and acting as brand managers. Here, you’ll own a wide SKU count so that your work is varied and challenging. Through cross-functional collaboration, instinct and creativity, you will be the expert on the guest, the market and the competition.

A **Buyer** helps create omni-channel growth by planning profitable and locally relevant assortments using your grasp of guest shopping behavior, assortment requirements and competitors. You will influence and negotiate with vendors to achieve results and identify gaps and opportunities. Your flexibility in reacting to business results and your ability to translate financial metrics and data into actionable strategies will be critical. You will lead cross-functional teams to drive category results while managing progress toward sales and margin goals. Your partnerships with product designers and/or category managers and vendors will help guide product development as you source appropriately for your category. You will interact with Associate Buyers, Senior Merchandise Specialists, the Pricing and Promotion Center of Excellence, Planning, Site Merchandising, the Item Center of Excellence and many other expert partners in support of your promotional planning work across channels.

Core responsibilities are described within this job description. Job duties may change at any time due to business needs.

**About you:**

* Four-year degree or equivalent experience
* 1+ years of Merchandising experience
* Strong strategic and analytical skills to grow a business
* Strong collaboration skills to partner with Cross Functional Teams
* Flexibility, resilient and comfortable working in “grey areas” that are constantly changing

This position will operate as a Hybrid/Flex for Your Day work arrangement based on Target’s needs. A Hybrid/Flex for Your Day work arrangement means the team member’s core role will need to be performed both onsite at the Target HQ MN location the role is assigned to and virtually, depending upon what your role, team and tasks require for that day. Work duties cannot be performed outside of the country of the primary work location, unless otherwise prescribed by Target. Click here if you are curious to learn more about Minnesota.

Non-accommodation-related requests, such as application follow-ups or technical issues, will not be addressed through this channel.

description:
#### **Summary**

Responsible for the purchase of multiple commodities including raw materials, machined components, outside processing, and support services. Responsible for negotiating with manufacturers or service providers on prices and deliver dates to make sure they are in line with company goals and needs.

#### **Job Duties and Responsibilities**

Other tasks and duties may be required as directed.

* Create purchase orders (POs) for Raw material, Machined parts, Purchased parts and OSP Processes.
* Create Request for Quote (RFQ) for Raw material, Machined parts, Purchased parts and OSP Processes.
* Use discretion and independent judgment to procure components, materials and equipment that meet demand while making decisions on economic order quantities factoring in considerations such as price, delivery costs, demand levels, timing, market trends and potential for design changes/obsolescence.
* Align product deliveries to minimize inventory while ensuring that production and service needs are being met.
* Assess financial and schedule risks in order to recommend volume buys, etc.
* Review key purchasing drivers (lead time, safety stock, lot size) and identify areas where drivers need to be adjusted to ensure it meets the current needs of the business.
* Using quantitative skills/methods to analyze components/raw materials costs.
* Perform variance analyses for price changes.
* Monitor delinquent PO reports and Reschedule reports to ensure delivery needs are met.
* Follow up with suppliers on delivery of orders and manage change issues as they occur.
* Assist reconciling open PO report for accuracy, past due items, and work with accounting regarding invoicing discrepancies.
* Maintain suppliers’ manufacturing schedules to support in-house production.

#### **Qualification Requirements**

* **Education/Experience**
+ Bachelor’s Degree (B.A. or B.S.) from four-year college or university; or two to four years’ experience and/or training in a related field; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* **Language Skills**
+ Good command of the English language, both written and spoken.
+ Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals.
+ Ability to read, analyze, and interpret general business periodicals, professional journals, technical procedures, or governmental regulations.
+ Ability to write routine reports and correspondence.

description:
**Position Summary**

The Buyer is responsible for managing a designated group of supplier accounts based on product type or commodity and supporting the Purchasing Department’s organizational and operational objectives.

This role manages key aspects of the supplier relationship and sourcing process, including identifying and evaluating new suppliers, developing and managing sourcing strategies, obtaining and analyzing quotations, negotiating costs and terms, monitoring supplier delivery and quality performance, and supporting new product development and launch activities.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Research, evaluate, audit, and recommend new suppliers based on their ability to provide products or services that are strategically aligned with the current and future needs of Viking Corporation.
* Request, obtain, and analyze quotations from qualified suppliers to ensure product design and sourcing requirements are met.
* Coordinate with Viking’s Research & Development and Quality departments to ensure suppliers meet required product design and quality standards.
* Negotiate supplier costs, terms, and other commercial conditions to support overall cost targets.
* Manage and monitor supplier on-time delivery performance.
* Implement necessary corrective actions to address supplier performance issues.
* Manage total landed cost for assigned product types or commodities, including raw material costs, supplier processing costs, inventory costs, freight costs, and other applicable expenses.
* Monitor raw material cost trends and utilize market information to support supplier cost negotiations.
* Partner with suppliers to identify and implement Kaizen and continuous improvement initiatives that reduce costs and improve efficiency. Examples may include establishing consignment inventory programs, developing Kanban programs, and utilizing blanket orders with multiple releases to improve inventory turns.

**Job Qualifications | Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management plus a minimum of three years of purchasing/buying experience in a fast-paced manufacturing environment, or equivalent.
* Ability to travel up to 25% for supplier evaluations and audits.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to build strong working relationships with suppliers and internal departments.
* Ability to work independently and successfully complete projects to achieve established goals.
* Ability to lead internal teams in implementing changes and initiatives to reduce costs.
* Strong negotiation skills.
* Experience using an MRP system preferred.
* Experience purchasing brass castings, ductile iron castings, screw-machined parts, and/or steel stampings preferred.

If you're passionate about being a part of a team that values integrity, teamwork, and innovation, then Lexicon is the place for you. Join us and become a part of our growing family as we continue to build a brighter future together. Apply now to embark on an exciting journey with Lexicon!

**Lexicon Benefits**

* Health, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance
* HSA with Employer contributions
* Paid Holidays and Vacation
* 401k with company match
* Lexicon University

Our Lexicon University provides free career development and training, so employees can improve their skills in their chosen field, learn new skills in another area and build a career path that leads to job satisfaction and success for them and their families.

**Position Summary**

The Purchasing Agent supports daily Purchasing Department operations by issuing purchase orders, monitoring purchase order status and delivery, communicating with suppliers and internal stakeholders, and maintaining complete purchasing records.

**Purchasing Agent - Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Issue purchase orders for assigned shop buyouts and product categories.
* Expedite orders to support timely delivery and obtain proof of delivery.
* Communicate purchase order status with Project Managers and Shop Personnel
* Must be proficient in Microsoft Excel
* Run various reports in Tekla
* Maintain accurate virtual and hard copy files of purchase orders, purchase order requisitions, material receiving reports, and test reports
* Various clerical duties as assigned.
* The ability to work overtime and regular, punctual attendance is required.

**Purchasing Agent - Qualifications**

* High School diploma or equivalent with one year experience in purchasing experience preferred.
* Must have excellent organizational skills.

**Purchasing Agent - Physical Demands**

Requires frequent bending, stooping and lifting. Must be able to sit for extended periods of time and work directly on a computer. Must be able to lift and carry up to 25 pounds occasionally. All of the physical demands listed are essential functions.

**Join Our Team!**

Join WAVE and play a key role in supporting the procurement activities that keep our manufacturing and business operations running efficiently. As a Procurement Specialist / Buyer I, you will work across multiple functions and locations, partnering with internal teams and suppliers to source materials and services, manage purchasing activities, analyze spending trends, and support strategic procurement initiatives.

This position offers the opportunity to build relationships across Operations, Supply Chain, Finance, Engineering, Maintenance, and supplier partners while gaining exposure to sourcing, supplier management, procurement analytics, compliance, and business operations. Your work will directly contribute to ensuring the right goods and services are available at the right time, cost, and quality to support WAVE's continued success.

We are looking for a proactive, analytical, and customer-focused professional who enjoys solving problems, managing priorities, and collaborating with others to deliver results in a dynamic manufacturing environment.

**Responsibilities**

* Source and procure indirect materials, equipment, services, and maintenance-related purchases that support WAVE operations across multiple locations.
* Manage the purchasing process from supplier quotation through purchase order creation, order tracking, and delivery coordination.
* Evaluate suppliers and sourcing alternatives to support cost savings, quality, service, business continuity, and operational requirements.
* Build and maintain supplier relationships, serving as a primary point of contact for purchasing inquiries, delivery issues, and performance-related concerns.
* Support supplier onboarding, contract administration, and compliance activities, ensuring required documentation and records are maintained.
* Monitor supplier performance and open orders, expediting critical purchases and resolving supply, delivery, or service issues as needed.
* Partner with Operations, Engineering, Maintenance, Finance, and Supply Chain teams to understand business requirements and support purchasing needs.
* Prepare and analyze procurement data, including spend reports, supplier metrics, savings opportunities, and key performance indicators.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance procurement processes, reporting capabilities, supplier engagement, and overall efficiency.
* Ensure procurement activities comply with company policies, sourcing standards, audit requirements, and regulatory obligations.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Desired Experience**

* 2-4 years of experience in procurement, purchasing, sourcing, supplier management, supply chain, vendor management, finance, accounts payable, or related business functions.
* Experience working in a manufacturing, industrial, or multi-site environment preferred.
* Experience utilizing ERP systems, purchasing platforms, supplier portals, or financial systems.
* Experience managing purchase orders, supplier communications, contract administration, spend analysis, or procurement reporting.
* Working knowledge of sourcing methodologies, supplier management, and purchasing processes.
* Experience using SAP, Power BI, Power Apps, or similar business systems preferred.
* Professional certifications or coursework in procurement, supply chain, operations, or business disciplines are a plus.

**Knowledge, Skills & Abilities**

* Understanding of procurement, purchasing, supplier management, and business operations processes.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.
* Effective verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong customer service and relationship management capabilities.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, reporting tools, and ERP systems.
* Ability to analyze purchasing and supplier data to identify trends and opportunities.
* Ability to work collaboratively across functions and organizational levels.
* Continuous improvement mindset with a focus on process efficiency and operational effectiveness.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive business information appropriately.

**Compensation and Benefits**

Hiring Range: $61,583 - $75,383 annually

Individual compensation will be determined based on qualifications, relevant experience, skills, certifications, internal equity, and business considerations.

WAVE provides a comprehensive benefits package that includes:

* Medical, dental, and vision coverage
* Health savings and flexible spending accounts
* 401(k) savings plan with company contributions
* Paid time off and company holidays
* Life and disability insurance
* Employee assistance programs
* Professional development and training opportunities

**CAREER DESCRIPTION**
----------------------

**SENIOR PROCUREMENT BUYER**

*Salary may be negotiable within the range listed above, based on position requirements and successful candidate's qualifications, subject to appropriate authorization.*

**OPEN TO THE PUBLIC**
This recruitment will establish an open eligible list that will be used to fill current and futureSenior Procurement Buyerpositions. The eligible list established may also be used to fill positions in similar and/or lower classifications throughout the County of Orange.

**DEADLINE TO APPLY**

This recruitment will be open for a minimum of five (5) business days and will close on **Thursday****, October 15, 2026, at 11:59pm (PST).** Qualified applicants are encouraged to apply immediately.

**THE OPPORTUNITY**

The County Procurement Office has an exciting opportunity for a Senior Procurement Buyer. The Senior Procurement Buyer may train and monitor the work of staff engaged in the procurement of materials, supplies, equipment and preparation of contracts. In addition, this position performs the more difficult and complex tasks in the unit and interprets County and department policies, rules and regulations governing procurement activities and awarding of contracts. Incumbents will be expected to maintain up-to-date knowledge of the status of prices and general market conditions.

Major duties of the Senior Procurement Buyer include, but are not limited to:

* Preparing, reviewing and negotiating contracts and bid/proposal specifications.
* Interpreting and analyzing legislative and County laws, rules and regulations pertinent to procurement, solicitations, contract negotiation, and contract administration.
* Conducting complex value analysis and developing precise product specifications.
* Serving as a team lead and providing training and guidance to procurement and contracts staff.
* Performing contract management and contract administration.
* Selecting and preparing the appropriate solicitation documents, i.e., Invitation for Bid (IFB), Request for Qualifications (RFQ), Request for Information (RFI), or Request for Proposal (RFP).
* Obtaining the appropriate levels of approval from County Counsel, Risk Management, and the Orange County Board of Supervisors, as required.
* Negotiating and executing contracts for which competitive bidding is not required/appropriate.
* Determining appropriate sources of supply.
* Obtaining required insurance, bonds, and applicable endorsements.

**DESIRABLE QUALIFICATIONS AND CORE COMPETENCIES**

In addition to the minimum qualifications, the ideal candidate will possess at least one year of experience in procurement, contract administration, and managing complex solicitations.

In addition, the ideal candidate will also have extensive experience in the following core competencies:

**TECHNICAL KNOWLEDGE | TECHNICAL EXPERIENCE**

* Demonstrating extensive expertise in applying procurement principles, ethics, and best practices, while interpreting and integrating relevant Public Contract Codes, Government Codes and other Federal requirements.
* Ensuring full compliance with County and departmental procurement policies by accurately interpreting governing rules, regulations, and procedures to guide contract development and award processes.
* Preparing and analyzing complex solicitation and contract specifications, researching cooperative agreements, and selecting the most effective solicitation methods to achieve competitive, value-driven procurement outcomes.
* Evaluating supplier capacity, capability, and performance through detailed cost and value analyses.

**LEADERSHIP SKILLS**

* Effectively leading cross-departmental collaboration to ensure procurement strategies, solicitation documents, and contract awards align with County policies, operational needs, and long-term organizational objectives.
* Providing guidance to staff and end-users in developing precise specifications, value analyses, and approaches to support efficient, compliant, and cost-effective purchasing outcomes.
* Demonstrating strong leadership in negotiating complex contracts by motivating suppliers, influencing internal and external stakeholders, and securing contracts that align with County goals while maintaining fairness and transparency.
* Providing direction, mentorship, and technical expertise to procurement staff to strengthen team capability, enhance workflow efficiency, and ensure consistent adherence to procurement standards and best practices.

**ANALYSIS & PROBLEM-SOLVING SKILLS**

* Demonstrating strong analytical judgment by interpreting local ordinances and state and federal procurement regulations to ensure contractual decisions are compliant, defensible, and aligned with organizational requirements.
* Applying advanced research and statistical analysis techniques—including data, trend evaluation, and graphical interpretation—to assess market conditions,

description:
The Aerospace Corporation is the trusted partner to the nation’s space programs, solving the hardest problems and providing unmatched technical expertise. As the operator of a federally funded research and development center (FFRDC), we are broadly engaged across all aspects of space— delivering innovative solutions that span satellite, launch, ground, and cyber systems for defense, civil and commercial customers. When you join our team, you’ll be part of a special collection of problem solvers, thought leaders, and innovators. Join us and take your place in space.

**Job Summary**

The Supply Chain department manages all aspects of procurement for The Aerospace Corporation. As a **Strategic Sourcing Buyer Level IV – Indirect Goods and Services** , you will leverage your expertise in strategic sourcing, buying, supplier management, and category leadership to deliver competitive value across multiple business areas. You will partner with internal stakeholders and suppliers to drive operational efficiency, manage capital and operating costs, and support innovation while ensuring compliance with corporate and government procurement requirements.

**The selected candidate will be required to work a minimum of 4 days onsite at our facility in El Segundo, CA.**

**What You'll Be Doing**

* Lead the sourcing and buying of indirect goods and services—including construction, facilities maintenance/repair, and capital projects—to drive competitive value, supplier performance, and operational excellence across the enterprise
* Own and manage a diverse book of spend across indirect categories, identifying opportunities for cost savings, efficiency, and innovation
* Evaluate and improve sourcing activities, analyzing supplier performance, market conditions, and cost structures to identify competitive advantages
* Conduct formal market analysis to assess market trends, behaviors, and cost drivers—including construction and facilities market dynamics—to support sourcing strategy development
* Develop negotiations strategies, contract structures, and pricing models to ensure best-value outcomes and risk mitigation
* Administer sourcing events (RFPs, RFIs, RFQs), lead supplier selection, and manage negotiations and award processes in alignment with category strategies
* Forecast and plan product and service demand for assigned categories, construction/facilities projects, and capital expenditures, ensuring alignment with business needs
* Implement procedures and tools to continuously evaluate supplier performance, cost competitiveness, and deliverability
* Drive managing vendor relations post-award through Supplier Relationship Management (SRM), continuous improvement initiatives, and innovation across assigned categories

**What You Need to be Successful**

* Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Supply Chain, Construction Management, or related field required
* Minimum of (6) years of progressive experience in strategic sourcing, category management, or supplier/vendor management required
* Demonstrated experience sourcing and buying for construction and facilities-related categories (e.g., maintenance, repair, operations, capital projects, Job Order Contracts) strongly preferred
* Exceptional skills in Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook for efficient document preparation, data analysis, and communication
* In-depth understanding and hands-on experience managing the full procurement lifecycle—from sourcing strategy development to effective vendor relations management
* Proven ability to design, implement, and sustain rigorous procurement schedules
* Strong financial acumen to craft competitive pricing strategies, perform robust bid evaluations, and manage capital budgets with precision

**How You Can Stand Out**

* Advanced proficiency with Ariba and SAP systems to streamline sourcing and buying processes
* Proven track record in the aerospace sector, with experience navigating regulatory/quality standards
* Demonstrated ability to manage strategic purchasing agreements across indirect categories—including construction, facilities MRO, capital projects, IT, HR services, travel, and professional consulting

We offer a competitive compensation package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to our business. The grade-based pay range for this job is listed below. Individual salaries within that range are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge and skills.

(Min - Max)

$107,000.00 - $160,500.00Pay Basis: Annual

**Leadership Competencies**

Our leadership philosophy is simple: every employee, regardless of level and role, can demonstrate leadership. At Aerospace, our commitment is our people. To cultivate our talent and ensure that we have a strong pipeline of future leaders, we want individuals who:

* Operate Strategically
* Lead Change
* Engage with Impact
* Foster Innovation
* Deliv

description:
**YOU WILL BE:**

As Buyer, you will be responsible for the overall merchandising strategy and product direction within assigned categories or departments, aiming to meet or exceed sales, margin, and financial objectives. This role focuses on curating the most distinctive and high-quality merchandise that reflects Saks Global’s exceptional standards and aligns with customer needs and preferences. Leveraging competitive intelligence, customer insights, and business analysis, you will ensure a customer-centric assortment that drives performance. In addition to leading the purchasing and negotiation of merchandise, you will partner with Merchandise Planners to develop and execute strategies that maximize business opportunities. As the Buyer, you will also manage and mentor a team of Associate Buyers, Assistant Buyers, and Coordinators, fostering collaboration and ensuring alignment with business goals

**WHAT YOU WILL DO:**

Assortment Strategy

* Provide input on category and pre-season planning strategy in collaboration with Planners based on past performance and knowledge on trends/brand insights, and execute on the strategy throughout the season
* Build customer-centered assortment framework and allocation strategy based on customer and trend insights from Stores, Digital, CACI and Fashion and provide guidelines for allocation teams to follow
* Set strategies for product display and flow (e.g., launch dates, weeks of full-price selling, cross-sell opportunities, collection considerations) in alignment with guardrails from Planning and Marketing

Market Activities

* Lead market prep activities and attend market to select the best product in alignment with guardrails from Planning (e.g., Checkbook, OTB) and category direction from BP & Buying Leads (e.g., omni strategy, banner differentiation)
* Coordinate buys with brand partners, collaborate on exclusive merchandise, manage day-to-day communication around in-season brand performance, trending styles, chase opportunities and resolve escalated order management issues

In-Season Management

* Review daily performance reports and work closely with Planner counterparts to gather insights on trending products, categories, brands, etc., pull in-season levers to optimize performance and prepare for monthly OTB meetings to provide bottoms-up context and escalate opportunities and risks to Leads
* Serve as the owner of their business, constantly negotiating with Brand Partners throughout the season to improve performance (e.g., style swaps, capsules, RTVs, matrix expansion, markdowns)

Leadership Development

* Provide mentorship and hands-on training to Associate Buyers, Assistant Buyers, and Coordinators, equipping them with the business acumen and practical skills needed to become successful future Buyers

**WHAT YOU WILL BRING:**

Required Qualifications (Minimum Requirements):

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent retail experience.
* 5+ years of experience in a buying office with a strong understanding of buying operations and retail strategy.
* Proven business acumen with strong financial, analytical, and strategic planning skills.
* Expertise in retail math, including markup, margin planning, OTB, WOS, T/O, GMROI, and assortment planning.
* Demonstrated leadership and team management capabilities in fast-paced, dynamic environments.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills with the ability to build strong internal and vendor relationships.
* Strong customer focus with a results-driven mindset and ability to manage ambiguity.
* Highly organized with strong planning, prioritization, and conflict management skills.
* Strategic thinker with the agility to adapt to changing business needs.
Willingness to travel, including internationally, as needed.

**YOUR LIFE AND CAREER AT EXEMPLAR LUXURY GROUP:**

* Opportunity to work in a dynamic fast paced environment at a company experiencing growth and transformation
* Exposure to rewarding career advancement opportunities across the largest multi-brand luxury retailer from retail to distribution, to digital or corporate

* Comprehensive benefits package for all eligible full-time employees (including medical, vision and dental)
* An amazing employee discount

Benefits: We offer the following benefits for this position, subject to applicable eligibility requirements: medical insurance, dental insurance, vision insurance, 401(k) retirement plan, basic life insurance, supplemental life insurance, disability insurance, and a variety of additional voluntary benefits (such as critical illness, hospital and accident insurance).

Thank you for your interest with Exemplar Luxury Group. We look forward to reviewing your application.

The Building People delivers integrated solutions that connect technology, buildings, and people to optimize real estate performance, facility operations, and workforce outcomes. With over 450 contracts delivered across 187 project locations, we manage more than 1,700 facilities and support $38.5B in federal and commercial assets. Leveraging AI-driven automation, data analytics, and platform-agnostic systems, we create high-performing, future-ready environments that reduce cost, improve efficiency, and enable mission success. Founded in 2012, we now have over 450 employees supporting 23 federal agencies—making us a trusted leader in delivering technology-infused building solutions across the public sector.

The Building People is committed to fostering a workplace where every employee can thrive. Using tools like the Predictive Index, we thoughtfully align individual strengths with team needs -ensuring the right fit, the right role, and long-term success.

Our culture is rooted in integrity, innovation, and service. Through our growing philanthropy program, we support communities by focusing on gratitude, giving back, partnerships, and mentorship.

**Our Market Offerings Include:**

* Real Estate & Workplace
* Facilities Management
* Facilities Operations & Maintenance
* Project Management & Engineering
* Workforce Transformation & Organizational Design
* Mission Support
* Smart Buildings & Energy Efficiency
* Technology Solutions

Join our rapidly growing team and help shape the future of real estate, facilities, and community impact.

The Building People, LLC, has a position open for a full-time **Purchasing Agent**. This position would have to report to one of the following locations: Atlanta, GA, Birmingham, AL, Charlotte NC, Tampa, FL, or Nashville, TN. The Purchasing Agent serves customer needs through the placement of Government orders against established contracts (i.e. purchase orders and/or calls against BPAs or other FSS schedules, PBS regional/national IDIQs or other Government sources of supply. **This role requires 20-35 onsite hours at minimum to start and at least 20 hours onsite permanently, not a remote position.**

About the Role
We are seeking an experienced, high-judgment Automotive Used Vehicle Buyer to join our Chrysler Dodge Jeep Ram buying team. We are not looking for someone who simply clicks \\"buy\\" based strictly on software algorithms or appraisal figures. We need a savvy automotive professional who uses critical thinking, local market awareness, historical sales data, and has hands-on mechanical sense to acquire inventory that actually turns and generates real profit.

Key Responsibilities

* Strategic Inventory Acquisition: Evaluate, bid on, and acquire high-demand used vehicles through wholesale auctions, off-lease vehicles, rental fleets, and direct dealership networks.
* Smart Appraisals & Decision Making: Utilize market tools alongside real-world judgment to determine true retail viability, factoring in actual repair costs, turn-time, and local demand.
* Network Building: Actively develop, maintain, and expand purchasing channels across non-traditional sources, including regional dealership groups, fleet managers, and commercial accounts.
* Reconditioning Cost Assessment: Work closely with our service department to communicate about incoming vehicles and monitor reconditioning workflow to accurately estimate reconditioning expenses before acquiring inventory.
* Market Trend Tracking: Monitor regional sales trends, seasonal demand shifts, and wholesale/retail margins to ensure inventory stays aligned with dealer profit targets.

Qualifications & Requirements

* Strong verbal and written communication skills; ability to work seamlessly with sales managers, service department, and schedule timely transportation.
* Practical knowledge of vehicle mechanics, structural inspection, common wear items, and accurate repair cost estimation.
* High level of autonomy with the ability to manage daily purchasing goals independently.
* Proven track record in the retail or wholesale automotive industry (Dealership Buying, Used Car Management, Wholesale Sales, or Appraisals) is strongly preferred.
* Proficiency with with technology is required and experience with vAuto (Provision/Appraisals/Valuations) and Rapid Recon or similar tool is preferred.
* Auction experience is not required but preferred. Having an in-depth understanding of digital and physical wholesale auctions is critical to success in this role.

Benefits & Compensation

* Competitive compensation structure (Base + Commission)
* Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance options
* Paid time off (PTO) and holiday pay
* Clear career growth potential within a high-volume dealership environment

Equity Solar Puerto Rico ¡Juntos Encendemos Puerto Rico!

**Título del puesto: Warehouse & Procurement Manager/Gerente de Almacén y Compras**

* Ubicación: Guaynabo
* Modalidad: Presencial
* Empleo a tiempo completo
* Clasificación: Exenta

**Resumen del rol:**

El/la Warehouse & Procurement Manager será responsable de liderar integralmente las operaciones del almacén y los procesos de compras y abastecimientos de Equity Solar - Puerto Rico.

Esta posición tendrá responsabilidad directa sobre el control de inventario, recepción y despacho de materiales, organización del almacén, planificación de necesidades, compras, negociación con suplidores y disponibilidad oportuna de materiales para los equipos de instalación y servicio.

Además, será el responsable de desarrollar relaciones efectivas con suplidores, identificar nuevas alternativas de abastecimiento, comparar cotizaciones, negociar precios y términos comerciales y contribuir activamente a iniciativas de reducción de costos y eficiencia operacional.

Buscamos una persona organizada, análitica, orientada a resultados y con fuertes habilidades de negociación, capaz de combinar la administración diaria del almacén con una visión estratégica de procurement, inventario y supply chain.

**Responsabilidades Principales:**

1. Operaciones del Alamacén

* Liderar las operaciones diarias de recepción, almacenamiento, preparación y despacho de materiales y equipos.
* Coordinar los despachos diarios requeridos para instalacione, service calls y proyectos especiales.
* Garantizar que cada proyecto salga del almacén con los materiales, herramientas y equipos correspondientes.
* Mantener altos estándares de orden, limpieza, segurdidad y organización utilizando principios de 5S y mejores prácticas de warehouse management.
* Optimizar la distribución física del almacén para mejorar utilización de espacio, accesibilidad y eficiencia operacional.
* Coordinar entregas, recogidos y movimientos internos de materiales cuando aplique.
* Supervisar devoluciones, materiales defectuosos, garantías y equipos pendientes de reparación o reemplazo.
* Asegurar el cumplimiento de los procedimientos establecidos para entrada y salida de materiales.

2. Procurement, Compras y Abastecimiento

* Administrar los procesos de compras y abastecimiento de materiales, herramientas, equipos y consumibles requeridos por la operación.
* Identificar, evaluar y desarrollar relaaciones con suplidores locales y de Estados Unidos.
* Solicitar, analizar y comparar cotizaciones considerando precio, disponibilidad, calidad, garantías, tiempos de entrega y términos comerciales.

Overview:

Oversee an entire product line’s inventory levels and conduct buying in respective categories through collaboration with management, procurement and administration.

Must be Bilingual in Spanish/English.

Responsibilities:

* Identify customer needs in order to find possible new product offerings.
* Negotiate prices and consider the company’s profitability before placing orders.
* Builds and maintains professional relationships with our vendors and partners.
* Maintain proper inventory levels and ensure product supply is uninterrupted through inventory control and proper ordering procedures.
* Process and create purchase orders in the system.
* Strategize with management to develop promotional product lines or special offerings, depending on availability of various items.
* Partner with vendors in order to have a constant supply of popular inventory items throughout the year at prices that are within the company budget.
* Plan pricing strategies on various product lines to reach an agreement with suppliers that allow for optimal pricing.
* Establish reliable lines of contact with management team as orders are filled and invoices have been issued.
* Anticipate possible supply shortages depending on unpredictable variables and devise strategies to solve any problems with inventory supply.
* Publish inventory and ordering reports so that upper management and other departments can get a clear idea of progress or struggles.
* Work with the Warehouse Supervisor and Operations Manager to ensure deliveries satisfy the assigned purchase orders and report any back-ordered or missing products.
* Make purchase decisions in accordance with company procedures, FSMA regulations and Company Food Safety Plan.
* Collaborate with department managers to clarify purchase requisitions, identify departmental needs, and refine specifications for future purchase orders.

Qualifications:

* + 3-5 years retail experience, previous buying experience strongly preferred
+ Bachelor’s degree in business administration, marketing, supply chain management or another related field required.
+ Solid communication and negotiating skills.
+ Comprehensive understanding of MS Excel, MS Word and industry standard purchase order software platforms
+ Impeccable attention to detail.
+ Ability to work well with a team.
+ Able to thrive in a high-stress and fast-paced environment.
+ Willingness to take initiative and exercise independent judgement
+ Bilingual Spanish/English
+ Experience in the manufacturing industry and strong understanding of supply chain management concepts preferred

description:
As a family-owned and operated company, we feel a special obligation to the employees who comprise our Taco family. We are committed to offering employees access to the tools necessary to live long and productive lives. We strive to instill in all of our employees:

* A positive mental attitude that helps us to be a leader in the industry
* A commitment to building strong relationships, both inside and outside the organization
* A desire to learn, grow, and contribute to moving our strategy forward
* A need to create and to innovate

**Employment Type:** Regular Full-Time

**Shift:** 1st Shift

**Work Status:** Hybrid

**Position Summary**

The Senior Buyer for Product Development purchases products and services in accordance with established company policies and procedures. They research and manage approval of new vendors based on department needs in conjunction with corporate procurement and company standards. They mentor and support growth and development of the product development buyer. They are responsible for the timely delivery of products and services as required to support research, new product development and the new product launch production plan. They establish and maintain good company/vendor relationships as well as manage levels of raw inventory in accordance with company and department goals and objectives.

Measures of success:

* Timely management of new product handoff to production buyers and planners
* Accurately research and manage new vendor approval
* Improve/maintain project expense and capital to budget

**Responsibilities**

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

* Request quotes for raw materials, tooling, equipment, supplies, etc.
* Work with the quality department to request first article inspections (FAIs)
* Manage FIAs by ensuring all sign-offs received from required departments
* Provide resolution of rejected material by working with engineering and the vendor to take care of any issues and request new samples
* Develop, monitor, and receive purchase orders
* Lead and / or participate in supplier negotiation activities
* Work with customs broker and company legal assistant on international imports
* Work with engineering to resolve long lead items
* Transfer information over to the production buyers
* Research and manage new vendor approval
* Maintain new product development (NPD) project expense and capital
* Coach and mentor for skill and knowledge development of the product development buyer
* Support the development of new and existing buyers by mentoring and / or leading training sessions
* Develop and manage policies and procedures for product development purchasing in conjunction with corporate procurement and company standards
* Participate in the monthly Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP) process
* Perform other duties as requested

**Qualifications**

Required:

* Associate degree in Business
* 7+ years of experience in buying
* Experience with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel)
* Strong experience with Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems
* Excellent organizational, communication and teamwork skills
* Ability to maintain a professional working relationship with internal and external customers and suppliers
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Travel required to conferences, customer / rep sites, etc.

Preferred:

* Bachelor's degree in Business
* 10+ years of experience in buying

**Work Environment:**

This position works primarily in an office environment using computer and technology. Verbal and auditory capability are required. Occasional exposure in production plant where large equipment and noise are prevalent. Safety gear is required in these areas.

This position may work from home up to 1 day/week if performance is in good standing.

This position has no direct reports.

**Benefits**

With nearly 1,000 people working at Taco worldwide, each with their own story, you will discover a sense of community and diverse, intelligent colleagues who help us innovate, create and explore.

Taco employees benefit from a company that:

* Provides competitive salaries and benefits
* Offers tuition reimbursement, career development, and on-site training programs in our learning center
* Believes in sharing profits with its employees
* Is mindful about family, health and well-being
* Fosters conditions that allow people and communities to reach their full potential
* Embraces and celebrates diversity

Working with our clients across real estate, infrastructure, energy and natural resources, we transform together delivering outcomes that improve people’s lives. Working in partnership makes it possible to deliver the world’s most impactful projects and programs as we turn challenge into opportunity and complexity into success.

Our capabilities include program, project, cost, asset and commercial management, controls and performance, procurement and supply chain, net zero and digital solutions.

We are majority-owned by CBRE Group, Inc., the world’s largest commercial real estate services and investment firm, with our partners holding a significant minority interest. Turner & Townsend and CBRE work together to provide clients with the premier program, project and cost management offering in markets around the world.

**Job Description**

The Turner & Townsend Energy & Natural Resources Family is looking for a **Procurement Specialist** to join our growing team. ***Please note******:*** *This role will be* ***Houston, Texas based with travel to Eunice, New Mexico*** *up to 20% of the time.*

Roles and responsibilities include but not limited to:

* Strong knowledge of the full procurement process from developing tender documents through to evaluation, negotiation and contract documentation and tracking
* Interfacing with the client and other consultants at all project stages
* RFP issue and clarifications
* Attention to structure and detail
* Strong collaboration, negotiation skills, and reporting knowledge
* Plant EPC technical interface, plant EPC commercial matter
* SOX control responsibilities may be part of this role, which are to be adhered to where applicable

**Qualifications**

* Minimum 7 years of procurement or commercial experience in utility-scale solar, wind, or BESS, including EPC or BOP contracting
* Demonstrated experience running competitive RFPs, bid leveling, and contract negotiation for construction scopes
* Working knowledge of HV interconnection, civil, and site preparation scopes, and of plant EPC interface management

Strongly preferred:

* Experience with ECI, PCSA, and unit rate and quantity true-up structures
* Knowledge of local and regional civil and clearing contractors in active markets

**Additional Information**

**\\*On-site presence and requirements may change depending on our client's needs\\***

Our inspired people share our vision and mission. We provide a great place to work, where each person has the opportunity and voice to affect change.

**This position reports to:**

Procurement Team Lead

\\_\\_

**Your role and responsibilities:**

In this role, you will have the opportunity to purchase materials according to required technical specifications, price, delivery schedule, and terms. Each day, you will ensure purchasing activities align with corporate purchasing policies and procedures. You will also showcase your expertise by identifying new suppliers in cooperation with the relevant category team.

The work model for the role is: **Onsite** #Li-Onsite

This role is contributing to the **EL Services division in Florence, SC**

You will be mainly accountable for:

* Initiating Purchase Orders in the system, according to the purchase requisitions and in alignment with standard procedures, and confirming delivery with suppliers, monitoring, and tracking supplier performance to PO requirements.
* Negotiating agreements with main suppliers, and periodically renews price lists and terms and conditions.
* Recommending frame agreements to management and executing upon approval.
* Analyzing and evaluating bids to determine the optimal value.

**Our team dynamics**
You will join a dynamic, talented, high performing team, where you will be able to thrive.

**Qualifications for the role**

* Bachelor degree in supply chain, business, or technical field PLUS minimum 3 years experience in manufacturing, supply chain, or related business OR Associate degree PLUS minimum 5 years experience OR High School diploma/GED PLUS minimum 7 years of related experience.
* SAP or ERP experience required.
* Knowledge of ABB initiatives related to SAP Ariba and CFIN/FTP.
* Strong working knowledge of MS Office including Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook
* Excellent analytical and communication skills.
* Candidates must already have a work authorization that would permit them to work for ABB in the US.

**What's in it for you?**

We want you to bring your full self to work—your ideas, your energy, your ambition. You’ll have the tools and freedom to grow your skills, shape your path, and take on challenges that matter. Here, your work creates impact you can see and feel, every day.

ABB's Service Division partners with our customers to improve the availability, reliability, predictability and sustainability of electrical products and installations. The Division’s extensive service portfolio offers product care, modernization, and advisory services to improve performance, extend equipment lifetime and deliver new levels of operational and sustainable efficiency. We help customers keep resources in use for as long as possible, extracting the maximum value from them, and then recovering and regenerating products and materials at the end of their useful life.

description:
Join the team at J.W. Jung Seed Company, an industry leader in mail-order and retail gardening. With six garden centers across Wisconsin, Jung Seed Company ships thousands of quality seeds, plants, and gardening accessories to all 50 states.

The Seed & Green Goods Buyer sources, purchases, and manages the supply of seed and green goods to support the company’s product offerings, production needs, and customer demand. This position develops and maintains supplier relationships, negotiates pricing and terms, forecasts product needs, manages inventory levels, evaluates new varieties and products, and ensures products are purchased at the appropriate quality, quantity, cost, and timing.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Source and purchase seeds, including vegetable, flower, herb, and other garden seed varieties, based on company needs
* Source and purchase green goods, including annuals, perennials, and other live plant material as applicable
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with vendors
* Work with suppliers to determine product availability, pricing, quantities, and delivery schedules
* Obtain and compare supplier pricing, availability, minimum order quantities, freight costs, and terms
* Place orders and maintain accurate purchasing records
* Monitor supplier lead times and ensure products arrive according to seasonal and operational requirements
* Coordinate orders, substitutions, cancellations, crop availability, and other factors that may affect supply
* Maintain the company’s MOSA certification and ensure purchasing practices, supplier documentation, product sourcing, and recordkeeping remain compliant with applicable organic certification requirements
* Other duties as assigned

**Qualifications**

* High School Diploma or equivalent
* Strong understanding of basic mathematical concepts
* Strong communication and collaboration skills
* Strong attention to detail
* Excellent problem-solving and organizational skills
* Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and as part of a team
* Ability in a fast-paced environment
* Basic computer proficiency
* Willingness to learn and grow with the company

**Why Join Jung Seed Co.?**

* Insurance: Medical, Dental, Vision
* 401(k) with company match
* Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
* Paid Time Off
* Employee Discount
* A friendly, supportive, and passionate team

**Position Overview**
---------------------

**Position:** Procurement Specialist (Information Technology)

**Closing Date:** October 23, 2026

**Starting Salary:** $55,171 - $75,776 (CL 26 -27) Depending on experience and qualifications.

{Transfers within the Judiciary will be considered for a salary match up to the CL 27.}

**Location:** San Antonio, Texas

The Office of Information Technology for the United States District Court, United States Probation Office, and United States Pretrial Services Office for the Western District of Texas is currently seeking qualified applications for the position of Procurement Specialist. Procurement specialists perform and coordinate administrative, technical, and professional work related to ensuring that court units are supplied with the materials, equipment, and services required to function optimally, including ensuring compliance with the appropriate guidelines, policies, and internal controls. Procurement Specialists may lead the work of procurement services technicians or administrative support staff; however, their responsibilities do not typically involve formal supervisory responsibilities. Procurement Specialists perform advanced procurement activities requiring advanced knowledge of procurement policies and practices. Advanced procurement activities include preparing complicated specifications, negotiating service contracts, and preparing significant and large purchase documents. The incumbent maintains a Contracting Officer certification.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Maintain Contracting Officer certification by completing biennial continuing education requirements. As Contracting Officer, process and sign purchase orders and contracts for the purchase of products and services in the technology department. Ensure purchases are authorized, funding is available, the appropriate delegations of authority exist, and adequate competition takes place in accordance with the estimated dollar value of the procurement. Provide contract administration and oversight including record keeping to track expenditures.
* Ensure files are established and maintained for every solicitation, contract, and purchase action and are in compliance with the Guide to Judiciary Policy and local internal controls.
* Develop a variety of reports based on historical and current data, including statistics on procurement activities.
* Research procurement, administrative, and operational questions, problems, trends to identify areas for efficiencies/improvements.
* Evaluate requests for goods and services by ensuring they are allowable under limitations, restrictions, and policies, as well as determining availability of funds for items being purchased. Prepare reporting mechanisms to track expenditures for the department.
* Coordinate the efforts of various entities to ensure timeliness of complex purchase orders and contracts.
* Conduct product and project research, and prepare and present findings and recommendations.
* Make procurement recommendations for cyclical replacement of accountable property.
* Research, analyze, and evaluate suppliers based on price, quality, selection, service, support, availability, reliability, production, and distribution capabilities, as well as their reputation and history. Prepare specifications, solicitations, and Requests for Quotes (RFQs). Research products and equipment and prepare specifications. Obtain and review competitive bids, quotes, and proposals from vendors and contractors and discuss evaluations and review with requestors and subject matter experts, as applicable.
* Negotiate with vendors for the best price over contracted services and purchases. Evaluate and monitor contract performance to ensure compliance with contracted obligations; assist with clarifying contract requirements and resolving any conflicts.
* Establish and maintain sound professional relationships with suppliers. Resolve issues (e.g., pricing, quality, timing, claims, contract disputes, etc.) associated with terms and conditions of service agreements.
* Procure supplies, equipment, services, and furnishings from government and non-government sources through new contracts, competitive bids or existing government contracts. Plan and coordinate time and delivery of purchases.
* Identify and maintain lists of vendors and sources of supply for goods and services. Review, evaluate, verify, and process invoices and prepare payment requests. Update the inventory listing of property and conduct inventory reconciliations.
* Maintain financial reports for multiple agencies in relation to budget, spending, and forecasting.
* The employee in this position is responsible for contributing to a positive and productive work environment.
* Manage or assist with special projects and perform other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications & Preferred Qualifications**
---------------------------------------------

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:**

High school graduat

American Chrome & Chemicals (ACC) is the only chrome chemical producer in the Americas. Operating 5 production facilities in the United States, we are the leading global producer of high-quality chromium chemicals for a variety of applications. Reliability, safety and environmental sustainability drive our business along with our experienced and knowledgeable manufacturing and commercial teams. ACC produces the widest range of pigment grade chromic oxides in the world. Our oxide provides the most consistent color and has the tightest color specifications in the market today.

**Raw Materials Buyer**

**Position Summary**

The Raw Materials Buyer is responsible for supporting raw material procurement activities, supplier coordination, sourcing support, contract administration, inventory monitoring, and procurement execution across multiple manufacturing locations. This role supports strategic sourcing initiatives while developing commercial procurement capability through direct involvement in supplier negotiations, market analysis, and contract management.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Execute purchase orders for raw materials and assigned commodities.
* Monitor inventory levels and support continuity of supply.
* Coordinate delivery schedules and supplier communications.
* Support supplier negotiations and sourcing activities.
* Assist with preparation and administration of supplier agreements and contracts.
* Monitor raw material market trends and pricing activity.
* Support spend analysis and sourcing evaluations.
* Ensure procurement activities comply with company policies and governance requirements.

**Core Competencies**

* Strong analytical and organizational skills.
* Strong communication and supplier coordination capability.
* Commercial mindset with interest in strategic sourcing development.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
* Proficient in Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
* Familiarity with JD Edwards or similar ERP systems.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Business, Finance, Operations, or related field preferred.
* 2–5 years of procurement, purchasing, logistics, or manufacturing support experience.
* Chemical purchasing or industrial raw material buying experience preferred.
* Manufacturing or industrial procurement experience preferred.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Raw material inventory continuity
* Supplier delivery performance
* Purchase order accuracy
* Procurement cycle time
* ERP data accuracy

**Work Environment**

Office environment supporting manufacturing and procurement operations. Some travel may be required to support supplier visits, site coordination, or procurement activities.

**Benefits**

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Parental leave
* Vision insurance

**About Us**
------------

As part of The Freeman Company, Freemandesigns and delivers unforgettable moments that create a bond between audiences and our clients. It’s just one reason why we’re the leader in live events.

**Summary**
-----------

The Buyer is responsible for selecting and procuring quality products and services, including: maintaining supplier relationships, processing purchase orders, limited supplier negotiations, tracking orders, generating reports, creating and maintaining product catalogs and standard ordering procedures, and liaising with the Procurement team and internal stakeholders. The ideal candidate is driven, detail-oriented, and organized, with excellent communication skills, strong analytical skills, and the ability to multi-task and interact with leadership across the organization. The Buyer must work well in a team environment.

This position will support our Global Supply Chain team. It is eligible to work a hybrid schedule, generally requiring work in-office and/or show-site 2-3 days per week. The ideal candidate will be located in McCook, IL; however, we are also open to candidates based out of:

* Dallas, TX

**Essential Duties & Responsibilities**
---------------------------------------

* Manages and assists with day-to-day procurement processes
* + Identifies new procurement and cost savings opportunities
+ Establishes and maintains Coupa P2P catalogs including products and services descriptions, images, and pricing
+ Provides transactional support of requisitions, POs, and invoices to ensure accuracy
+ Provides buyer role triage support to obtain proper reviews of applicable requisitions that could require sourcing events
+ Compiles metric/reporting on all regional and/or category transactional activity
+ Enables suppliers by reviewing contracts and setting up the appropriate PO structure to capture spend details in Coupa
+ Maintains internally managed catalogs by coordinating with the supplier, procurement team peers and business users
+ Assists and/or manages the product price change process in accordance with contract terms and/or negotiated terms
+ Tracks and reports on supplier related issues, failures, and quality defects
+ Works as a team with other Buyers to cover temporary vacancies and develop buying strategies that can be duplicated throughout the department
+ Develops and focuses on continuous improvement of standard operating procedures; trains others on P2P system and Procurement processes and tools
* Ensures excellent customer service to all customers/stakeholders (internal and external)
* + Manages efforts to resolve internal/external stakeholder issues
+ Manages day-to-day supplier relations and escalations; Communicate updates and issues to leadership and internal stakeholders both verbally and written form
+ Promotes Coupa user adoption by improving catalog usability and established, preferred suppliers
* Assist in developing and implementing procurement projects and programs
* + Coordinates and facilitates meetings internally as well as externally with suppliers
+ Assigned categories and is responsible for developing category plans to include sourcing and contract opportunities resulting in company and/or region-specific savings
+ Represents designated regions and categories as a subject matter expert for the purpose of reporting, contract development, supplier evaluations, and development/execution of procurement strategy
* Maintains monthly supplier performance measurement reports and facilitates monthly/quarterly performance review meetings with preferred suppliers
* Performs other duties as assigned

**Education & Experience**
--------------------------

* Bachelor’s Degree from an accredited 4 year college or university is preferred, High School Diploma or equivalaent with relevant work experience is required
* At least (5) five years of related work experience; trade show, event, retail or hospitality industry experience is preferred
* Experience with a Procure-to-Pay (P2P) platform such as Coupa and SAP SRM as a heavy end-user, technical owner, implementer, buyer or system administrator is strongly preferred
* Procure-to-pay solution experience a plus
* Proficient in Microsoft Office applications including: PowerPoint, Excel, Word, Outlook and SharePoint

**Certificates, Licenses, Registrations**
-----------------------------------------

CPSM or CSCP Certified is preferred

**What We Offer**
-----------------

The Freeman Company provides benefits that aim to empower our people and their families to thrive mentally, physically, and financially. These are a handful of the types of programs and benefits our full-time people may be eligible for. There may be some variances in specific benefits across regions.

* Medical, Dental, Vision Insurance
* Tuition Reimbursement
* Paid Parental Leave
* Life, Accident and Disability
* Retirement with Company Match
* Paid Time Off

**Diversity Commitment**
---------------

**Sportsman Boats & Phenom Yachts | Summerville, SC**
**Full-Time | Salaried Exempt | Monday–Thursday**

### ***Made for the Days that Matter.***

At Sportsman Boats & Phenom Yachts, every boat we build depends on having the right materials, at the right time, and at the right quality. As a **Buyer**, you’ll play an important role in keeping production moving by managing purchase orders, working with suppliers, monitoring inventory, and finding opportunities to improve cost and efficiency.

You’ll own the purchasing process from placing the order through delivery and work closely with suppliers and internal teams to make sure our production schedule stays on track. Buyer Job Description

### **What You'll Do**

* Place purchase orders for production materials and components using our ERP system, email, phone, and supplier portals
* Manage purchase orders from order confirmation through delivery
* Work with suppliers to adjust delivery dates when production schedules change
* Compare suppliers based on **price, quality, and lead time**
* Look for opportunities to reduce costs
* Monitor inventory levels to prevent shortages and reduce excess or obsolete inventory
* Source, quote, and order custom and non-standard parts
* Maintain accurate purchasing records, including purchase orders, receipts, and supplier billing
* Perform manual inventory counts and reconcile them with the ERP system
* Support receiving, shipping, and local part pickups when needed
* Help develop and improve lean purchasing processes and procedures
* Work with others across the business to keep materials moving and production on schedule
* Take on additional responsibilities as needed Buyer Job Description

### **What We're Looking For**

We're looking for someone who is organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable working in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

You should have:

* Strong Microsoft Office skills
* Mechanical aptitude
* Clear written and verbal communication skills
* Strong organization and time management skills
* Analytical and problem-solving skills
* Strong attention to detail
* The ability to adapt when priorities and production schedules change

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Business Management, Engineering, or a related field
* Experience with or knowledge of ERP systems

**Experience in purchasing, supply chain, manufacturing, or a related environment is a plus.**

### **What Your Day Will Look Like**

This is a hands-on purchasing role that combines office work with time in our manufacturing and warehouse environment. You’ll spend time managing purchase orders and supplier relationships while also staying connected to the materials and parts moving through production.

Parts of the warehouse are not air-conditioned, and the role requires regular sitting, standing, walking, stooping, and bending. You must be able to lift up to 25 pounds.

### **Schedule**

This is a **full-time, salaried exempt position**, typically Monday–Thursday, 5:00 a.m.- 3:45 p.m. Occasional evening or weekend work may be required based on department needs.

### **Why This Role Matters**

The Buyer plays an important role in keeping Sportsman Boats & Phenom Yachts moving. By making sure we have the right materials when we need them—and balancing quality, cost, inventory, and production needs—you'll directly support our ability to build quality boats and deliver them on schedule.

This job operates in a manufacturing plant environment which sometimes involves working outside in hot humid conditions.

Sportsman Boats is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. We maintain a drug-free workplace and perform pre-employment substance abuse testing.

Apply online or come by our office at 113 Sportsman Way, Summerville, SC 29483.

**Job Description:**

Performs specialized procurement and complex administrative work for the Procurement Office. The work involves the procurement of large dollar cost and/or complex goods and services for the County. The position serves as a technical resource to County departments/divisions regarding procurement. Assists the Procurement Division Chief in procurement management and carrying out assigned administrative and office tasks associated with the County's procurement program and relative to the procurement of materials, equipment and services. Independently performs work handling new, complex problems and deviations encountered. Work is performed under general supervision of the Procurement Division Chief and Senior Procurement Specialist.

**Essential Job Functions**

Develops and prepares formal Invitation to Bids (ITB) and Request for Proposals (RFP) to include invitation, instructions, specifications, scope of services, special conditions, general conditions, proposal forms, and legal advertisements for procurement involving $30,000 or more, as established by the County.

Develops and prepares informal Request for Quotes (RFQ) and Request for Proposals (RFP) to include specifications, scope of services, special conditions, general conditions, proposal forms, and required notification to potential bidders for procurement.

Maintains procurement website and develops formal and informal bid specifications with input from end users for amounts set by the Director of requesting department.

Works closely with internal stakeholders and external vendors to develop and implement procurement strategies to improve efficiency and reduce costs while ensuring compliance with Section 6-101 of the Code of Public Local Laws of Calvert County and established Calvert County Government Procurement System Administrative Procedures and other directives and expressed policies.

Schedules and conducts pre-bid meetings; conduct public bid openings.

Performs detailed analyses of all elements of cost, compliance with contract provisions, verifies insurance and bonds, and conducts other due diligence on received submittals to determine responsiveness and responsibility of proposers.

Awards contracts for informal bids.

Prepares contract amendments for legal review by the County Attorney’s Office. Obtains required signatures by all parties for full execution.

Responds to Freedom of Information Act Requests (FOIA) regarding bid submittals and contract documentation in conjunction with the County Attorney’s Office.

Reviews purchase requisitions for accuracy and completeness. Ensures compliance with established Calvert County Procurement Administrative Policies & Procedures, other directives and expressed policies. Provides procurement advice to using agencies on policies and procedures.

Solicits prices, interviews, and negotiates contracts with vendors in accordance with procurement procedures. Inspects samples and procures materials, stock and equipment based on quality and price.

Conducts orientation for prospective bidders.

Communicates orally and in writing with internal staff, external clientele, and the general public to provide information and to interpret and explain procurement policies, procedures, rules and regulations. Interacts with department heads, division chiefs, vendors, and contractors on procurement matters. Recommends actions in accordance with procurement regulations.

Assists contract project managers on matters such as payments, claims, and contractual changes to ensure requirements of the contract are met.

Contacts state and local governments to determine if contracts are available in which the County can participate.

Updates and manages the County’s Procurement page on the County’s public website.

Works with other procurement personnel to ensure efficient utilization of funds.

Provide hands-on support to County employees in utilizing procurement Workday software and database. Offer guidance on navigating the systems, entering data, and generating reports.

**Other Duties**

Performs related work as required. May collaborate with the Procurement Division Chief in overseeing the day-to-day operations of the Procurement Office and assume the responsibilities of the Procurement Division Chief during their absence.

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities (These are pre-employment KSA that apply only to Essential Job Functions.)**

Knowledge of-

* County procurement policies and procedures and Federal, State and Local laws pertaining to Public Procurement.
* Administrative practices and procedures as applied to the operations of a procurement function.
* Use of various computer software applications, including financial information systems and Microsoft Office, to include but not limited to, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.

Ability to-

* Execute technical procurement tasks proficiently.
* Proactively solve problems in a positive environment.
* Effectively interact with the public and collaborate
