Buyer II will be responsible for the procurement of a wide variety of commodities and/or services, some of which may be highly technical and require complex procurement standards and procedures such as cost/price analysis and negotiation.

Responsibilities:

* Reviews requisitions, plans, prepares invitations for bids/requests for proposals and purchase orders, evaluates bids, and conducts market research
* Utilizes the FAR and DFARS daily for compliance
* Works with various departments on a daily basis such as program management, planning, manufacturing operations accounting, quality, and engineering, shipping, and receiving
* Assists and advises user agency staff and maintains contacts with vendors
* Requires daily use of high-level communication—including written and verbal skills
* Performs other duties as assigned

Qualifications:

**Education:**

* BS/BA in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Contracts/Procurement, Finance/Accounting or equitable field required. \\*Master’s degree a plus

**Experience:**

* 2-3 years minimum purchasing experience with a working knowledge of the Federal procurement rules and regulations. Experience in buying equipment, supplies, parts, services and other unique commodities a plus.

*Note:* In lieu of years of 3 years’ experience, candidates with Master’s Degree in relevant field of study listed above may be considered or if degree is in non–related field at least 5 years of experience may be considered

* Ability to obtain and maintain DoD security clearance if/when required

Any combination of education/experience may be substituted for job requirements at the recommendation of the hiring manager and approval of the COO and CEO*.*

Property Description:

Located in Mid-Beach, Cadillac Hotel & Beach Club is a 357-room oceanfront resort blending iconic Art Deco design with modern luxury. Part of Autograph Collection Hotels, the property offers a European Riviera-inspired experience infused with Miami’s vibrant energy.

With direct beach access, two resort-style pools, and elevated dining, the hotel fosters a culture of personalized hospitality where team members create memorable, meaningful guest experiences.

Overview:

Are you a motivated and detail-oriented individual with a passion for procurement and supply chain management? We are seeking a dynamic Purchasing Manager to join our team and take charge of our purchasing operations. As a key member of our team, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the smooth procurement of goods and services, optimizing costs, and maintaining strong vendor relationships. With your high energy, enthusiasm, and strategic mindset, you will contribute to the success of our organization by driving operational efficiency and delivering exceptional value to our guests. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment and have a knack for negotiation and problem-solving, this is the perfect opportunity to showcase your skills and make a significant impact in the hospitality industry.

Responsibilities:

* Develop and implement effective procurement strategies to meet the organization's needs.
* Source and evaluate suppliers, negotiate contracts, and manage vendor relationships.
* Oversee the purchasing process, ensuring timely and cost-effective procurement of goods and services.
* Collaborate with various departments to determine purchasing requirements and specifications.
* Monitor inventory levels and optimize inventory management procedures.
* Conduct market research to identify cost-saving opportunities and industry trends.
* Maintain accurate records of purchases, contracts, and pricing agreements.
* Lead a team of purchasing professionals and provide guidance and support.

Qualifications:

* Must have a High School diploma or GED equivalent
* Minimum 3 year of related experience
* Read, write and speak English fluently
* Ability to communicate effectively with the public and other Team Members

Benefits:

Davidson Hospitality Group is an award-winning, full-service hospitality management company overseeing hotels, restaurants, dining and entertainment venues across the US. A trusted partner and preferred operator for Hilton, Hyatt, Kimpton, Marriott, and Margaritaville, Davidson offers a unique entrepreneurial management style and owners’ mentality that provides the individualized personal service of a small company, enhanced by the breadth and depth of skill and experience of a larger company. In keeping with the company’s heritage of delivering value, Davidson is comprised of four highly specialized operating verticals: Davidson Hotels, Pivot, Davidson Resorts and Davidson Restaurant Group.

In keeping with the company’s heritage of delivering value to its owners and team members, Davidson offers a rich benefit program with a variety of benefits designed to enrich the lives and well-being of our team members and their families.

* Multiple Tiers of Medical Coverage
* Dental & Vision Coverage
* 24/7 Teledoc service
* Free Maintenance Medications
* Pet Insurance
* Hotel Discounts
* Tuition Reimbursement
* Paid Time Off (vacation, sick, bereavement, and Holidays).
* 401K Match

Working at Davidson is like nowhere else. It’s less of a job, more of a calling. It’s part career, part revolution. Because whatever you do here, you play a part in helping redefine the way quality hospitality is delivered to our guests, our clients, our partners, and each other.

EOE AA- Minorities/Females/Vet/Disability/Gender Identity/Sexual Orientation

Davidson Hospitality is a drug free workplace. Pre-employment drug test and background check required. We participate in E-Verify.

C&Y Global Inc. is one of the fastest growing scrap-metal recycling companies, with warehouses in Houston, Dallas, Chicago, Kansas City, St. Louis, Cleveland, Oakland, Atlanta, Oklahoma and Denver. From our establishment in 2004, our revenue has increased steadily. We are looking for high potential candidates who are interested in a long term career.

**Hours:** Monday- Friday; 8am- 5:00pm

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**
**Responsible for the purchasing of non-ferrous scrap metals.**

* Develop and grow partnerships with international and domestic customers. Includes consistent communication and regular travel to meet end objectives.
* Negotiating skills that combine the characteristics of a professional relationship and a well-developed strategy.
* Provide excellent customer focus to result in client satisfaction.
* Understand market trends within the non-ferrous metals markets.
* Assist in developing strategic plans for generating new sources and sales of raw material.

* Minimum of 3+ to 5+ years of successful experience in the non-ferrous scrap industry.
* Extensive professional network of suppliers and customers within the non-ferrous metals industry.
* The ability to excel under pressure, manage multiple tasks simultaneously, rapidly process information and make decisions based on market dynamics.
* Team player with the ability to build relationships and effectively interact both internally and externally with people at all levels of the organization.
* Excellent negotiations skills.
* Microsoft Office experience.
* Demonstrated ability to influence others and effect change.
* Highest level of personal and professional integrity.

**Benefits**

* Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance Covered 100% for Employees
* Knowledge sharing and continuous training
* Paid Time off – 1 week Vacation after 1 year employment, 2 weeks after 2 years and 3 weeks after 3 years
* Retirement benefits – 401K
* Free Friday lunch every week
* Performance Bonus Program (EOY)

**Job Type:** Full-time, In person

**Who We Are:**

Lippert is a leading, global manufacturer and supplier of highly engineered products and customized solutions, dedicated to shaping, growing and bettering the RV, marine, automotive, commercial vehicle and building products industries. We combine our strategic manufacturing capabilities with the power of our winning team culture to deliver unrivaled customer service, award-winning innovation, and premium products to all of our customers.

**Why We are Different:**

At Lippert, Everyone Matters. This is not just a tagline or empty promise; it is who we are. We have intentionally created a culture that values and celebrates our team members’ unique and varied backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. We strive to give our team members a deeper sense of purpose at work, and we continue to build a better work environment by aligning our cultural and business strategies with the needs of our team members.

**What You will Get:**

* A unique, inclusive and supportive company culture.
* Comprehensive benefit offerings including medical, dental, vision, 401k with employer match, vacation, and more!
* Fair and competitive compensation.
* Career development and mentoring and opportunities to grow.
* Holiday, personal and vacation days.

**Summary/Objective:**

The Purchasing Agent/Buyer obtains requirements by verifying, preparing, and forwarding purchase orders; verifies receipt of items; authorizes payment.

**Required Education and Experience**

* Must be a team player and be able to work alone in a fast-paced environment.
* Ability to analyze and support inventory, so we can optimize inventory turns and reduce costs.
* Display Lippert’s Core Values: Positive Attitude, Team Play with Trust, Passionate about Winning, Honesty-Integrity-Candor, Caring about People.
* Understanding of ERP systems (D365 preferred).
* Strong Microsoft Office Skills – specifically Word and Excel.
* Ability to take initiative, set priorities, learn quickly, and take ownership of assigned projects.

**Essential Functions:**

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

* Verifies purchase requisitions by comparing items requested to master list; clarifying unclear items; recommending alternatives.
* Forwards available inventory items by verifying stock; scheduling delivery.
* Prepares purchase orders by verifying specifications and price; obtaining recommendations from suppliers for substitute items; obtaining approval from requisitioning department.
* Obtains purchased items by forwarding orders to suppliers; monitoring and expediting orders.
* Verifies receipt of items by comparing items received to items ordered; resolves shipments in error with suppliers.
* Authorizes payment for purchases by forwarding receiving documentation.
* Keeps information accessible by sorting and filing documents.
* Provides purchasing planning and control information by collecting, analyzing, and summarizing data and trends.
* Updates job knowledge by participating in educational opportunities.

Accomplishes purchasing and organization mission by completing related results as needed.

**Competencies:**

* Technical Capacity.
* Financial Management.
* Communication Proficiency.
* Time Management.
* Decision Making.

**Supervisory Responsibility:**

This role does not have any supervisory responsibility upon hiring.

**Physical Demands:**
This is largely a sedentary role; however, some filing is required. This would require the ability to lift files, open filing cabinets and bending or standing on a stool, as necessary. This position requires the ability to occasionally lift office products and supplies, up to 20 pounds.

**Position Type/Expected Hours of Work**

This is a full-time salary position, and hours/days of work are decided by production schedules and your reporting manager.

**Travel:**

Travel will be minimal and would be primarily local during the business day.

**Work Authorization/Security Clearance**

Must be legally authorized to work in the United States.

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the Team Member for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

**Job Details**

**Division:** **Nucor Construction, Inc**

**Location:** **Charlotte, NC, United States**

**Other Available Locations:** **N/A**

**Welcome to Nucor, where our unique culture sets us apart. Joining Nucor means becoming part of North America's largest steel and steel products manufacturer, offering unmatched career opportunities and stability. We are known for our innovative sustainability practices and are the continent's largest recycler. Our vibrant culture, built on personal connections and teamwork, empowers every team member with the freedom to innovate and contribute to our collective success. Experience a workplace where safety, efficiency, and meaningful personal connections define every day, enriching both our teammates and the communities we serve.**

**Nucor supports its teammates with top-tier benefits like Medical, Dental, Vision, and Disability Insurance, 401K and Roth accounts, Profit sharing, Pay-for-performance bonuses, Paid parental leave, Tuition reimbursement, Stock program, Scholarships and more.**

**Basic Job Functions:**
------------------------

Safety is the most important part of all jobs within Nucor; therefore, candidates must be able to demonstrate the ability to initiate, lead, and uphold safety policies, practices, procedures, and housekeeping standards at all times.

The Construction Buyer responsibilities include but are not limited to supporting the Nucor Construction team and Division capital project teams, through fulfillment of procurement needs in a timely and cost-effective manner by:

* Developing and maintaining relationships with key internal & external vendors/contractors
* Evaluating vendors’ product and/or service capabilities
* Procuring materials & maintaining project files for capital projects to ensure timely delivery for project execution
* Understanding internal purchase accounting to ensure orders are recorded for appropriate amounts
* Ensuring compliance with Nucor Corporation & Division specific purchasing processes, policies, and controls
* Ensuring contracts are in place and executing statement of works or order acknowledgements as applicable

Must be willing to work before and after regularly scheduled work hours as business conditions warrant.

This position is a fully in-office role located in Charlotte, NC and requires up to 50% travel to divisions, especially green field projects.

**Minimum Qualifications:**
---------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Business or related field or 5 years of relevant experience
* Two or more years of purchasing related experience.

**Preferred Qualifications:**
-----------------------------

* Construction materials purchasing experience
* Oracle or other large ERP experience
* Contract experience

***Nucor is an Equal Opportunity Employer and a drug-free workplace***

Job Description:

Alutiiq Professional Consulting, LLC a subsidiary of Afognak Native Corporation has an opportunity for a **Senior Buyer - Corporate**. The Senior Corporate Buyer is responsible for the strategic sourcing, procurement, and supplier management of goods and services supporting the company's corporate functions and commercial operations.

This role serves as a trusted procurement advisor to stakeholders, leading sourcing activities, managing supplier relationships, negotiating commercial agreements, and ensuring timely, cost-effective procurement of products and services. The Senior Corporate Buyer will help drive value through spend management, process improvement, risk mitigation, and supplier performance management while maintaining compliance with company policies and procurement best practices.

This position offers a hybrid work schedule, working three days per week from our corporate office in Anchorage, Alaska.

* Lead sourcing and procurement activities for corporate and indirect spend categories and direct commercial operations.
* Manage the complete procurement lifecycle from requisition through contract execution and purchase order issuance
* Develop sourcing strategies that balance cost, quality, service, risk, and supplier performance.
* Conduct competitive bidding activities, including Requests for Proposal (RFPs), Requests for Quotations (RFQs), and Requests for Information (RFIs).
* Evaluate supplier proposals and prepare recommendations for award.
* Establish and maintain strong supplier partnerships that support business objectives.
* Monitor supplier performance against established expectations and service requirements.
* Resolve supplier performance, delivery, quality, and invoicing issues
* Support executive-level purchasing requirements with professionalism and confidentiality.
* Act as the primary procurement contact for assigned corporate functions and collaborate with departmental leaders to understand business requirements and procurement needs.
* Coordinate with Legal, Finance, IT Security, and other stakeholders to facilitate contract reviews and approvals.
* Ensure procurement activities comply with company policies, delegated authority requirements, and ethical sourcing standards.
* Maintain complete procurement documentation and purchasing records.
* Support internal and external audit activities as required.
* Track sourcing projects and report realized savings and business benefits.
* Recommend process improvements that increase efficiency and stakeholder satisfaction.

Pay Range: $65,000 to $80,000 Annually

**Job Requirements:**

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Finance, Economics, or a related field preferred.
* Minimum 5 years of progressive procurement, sourcing, or purchasing experience preferred.
* Must be a U.S. Citizen.
* Demonstrated experience supporting corporate or indirect procurement categories.
* Strong experience negotiating commercial agreements and supplier contracts.
* Knowledge of procurement principles, strategic sourcing methodologies, and supplier management practices.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Excellent verbal, written, and presentation communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Proficiency with ERP, purchasing, and procurement systems. Deltek CostPoint preferred.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Office 365 skills.
* Experience sourcing: IT software and SaaS solutions, Professional services and consulting, Employee benefits and HR-related services, Facilities and corporate services.

description:
A career at Whole Foods Market is more than just the work you do- it's about your personal growth and creating meaningful change. Our purpose is to nourish people and the planet. That means improving how people eat, funding grants for school gardens, providing access to fresh and healthy food to people living within food deserts, alleviating poverty in developing countries, and so much more. Working with us means you are making a difference within your community and beyond. We aren't just a grocery store: we're world-changers. And with your help, we will continue to set the standards of excellence and revolutionize the grocery industry.

Orders, replenishes, and merchandises produce and participates in regional programs for purchasing and promotions. Monitors inventory control and replenishes product based upon WFM ordering standards. Assists in organizing and developing promotional displays and maintaining OTS standards. All Whole Foods Market Retail jobs require ensuring a positive company image by providing courteous, friendly, and efficient service to customers and Team Members at all times. All positions must be performed in accordance with team and store Standard Operating Procedures. Further, Team Members must be prepared and able to perform the duties inherent in other Team Member job descriptions. All positions must strive to support WFM core values and goals, promote national, regional, and store programs and initiatives, and ensure adherence to all applicable health and safety regulations including Food Safety and regulatory duties required in the department.

**Job Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Purchases and replenishes produce through proper buying procedures.
* Monitors and acts upon open PO reports for both purchases and credits in an accurate and timely manner.
* Controls spoilage and shrink, achieves turn goals, participates in inventory.
* Completes spoilage, sampling, temperature, and sweep worksheets as required.
* Maximizes sales potential through effective and proper procedures for stocking and merchandising products.
* Ensures orders for product are timely and accurate to monitor inventory turns.
* Oversees customer special order procedure.
* Analyzes and controls product transfers, waste, and spoilage.
* Supports leadership in conducting inventories.
* Maintains financial profitability by meeting and exceeding purchasing and sales targets
* Arrives to work station on time, appropriately groomed, dressed and ready to work; works all scheduled shifts and attends required trainings and meetings.
* Provides excellent customer service, addresses needs of customers in a timely and effective manner and models suggestive selling techniques; answers phones and pages promptly and courteously.
* Maximizes sales potential through effective and proper procedures for prepping, storing, rotating, stocking, and merchandising product.
* Follows and complies, or ensures compliance, with established procedures, including Weights and Measures, health and sanitation, and safe work practices.
* Maintains, or ensures maintenance of, a clean and sanitary working and shopping environment; maintains equipment in accordance with WFM cleanliness and safety standards.
* Performs opening, mid, and closing duties as assigned; ensures accuracy of signs and pricing.
* Immediately reports safety hazards and violations.
* Performs other duties as assigned by store, regional, or national leadership.

**Job Skills**
--------------

* Extensive produce product knowledge, including production, distribution, seasonal availability, advances, and trends.
* Familiarity and/or willingness to learn about products, nutritional information, and other areas of study.
* Working knowledge and application of all produce-related merchandising expectations.
* Demonstrates a desire to grow with the Produce team.
* Ability to educate team on product knowledge and convey enthusiasm.
* Strong basic math skills.
* Knowledge and ability to use computer programs such as Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook, and ordering systems
* Strong to excellent communication skills and willingness to work as part of a team.
* Ability to deliver information in a clear and respectable manner to fellow Team Members, customers, and vendors.
* Ability to meet customer service expectations and standards in all interactions with customers, vendors, and Team Members.
* Ability to follow directions and procedures; effective time management and organization skills.
* Passion for natural foods and the mission of Whole Foods Market.
* Strong work ethic and ability to work in a fast-paced environment with a sense of urgency.
* Understanding of and compliance with WFM quality goals.

**Experience**
--------------

* 12+ months retail experience.

**Physical Requirements / Working Conditions**
----------------------------------------------

* Must be able to lift 50 pounds.
* In an 8-hour work day: standing/walking 6-8 hours.
* Hand use: single grasping, fin

description:
**Are you a Sales professional who is interested in working with jewelry?**

**Look no further!**

GoldMax is seeking an outgoing Sales Rep to be our primary Jewelry and Precious Metals Buying Specialist in our new Marietta location! You will buy and sell jewelry daily from in-store retail customers. No experience necessary...we will teach you our proven techniques on how to identify and purchase gold, silver and platinum jewelry, coins, and bullion and provide you with continuous support so we can succeed as a team.

This isn't your typical sales role. Instead of chasing leads or making cold calls, you'll focus on acquiring high-quality inventory through a welcoming, informative process. Success is measured by the quality and volume of inventory you purchase—not outbound sales.

Every day at GoldMax is an opportunity to encounter unique collections and learn more about this exciting industry!

**Who we are:**

Established in 2009, GoldMax has been one of the nation’s largest jewelry buyers for the past fifteen years. In this time, we have had the pleasure of serving over 200,000 customers in our area, making us one of the largest precious metals buyers in the southeast!

**GoldMax provides**:

* Extensive and continuous education from Day One
* A professional, safe, and comfortable office type of setting
* A positive work environment with room for growth and advancement within our company
* A team mentality with a solid support structure in place
* Access to buying precious metals for your own portfolio
* Full-time hours with performance-based bonuses!

**As a full-time employee with GoldMax, your typical responsibilities would include:**

* Building rapport with each guest and educating them on the selling process
* Assessing, pricing, purchasing, and securing guests’ gold, silver, and platinum jewelry using the industry knowledge and skills we will provide
* Filling out and processing paperwork about the items you purchase
* Miscellaneous tasks behind computer during downtime

**The ideal candidate for this position would have:**

* Previous sales/customer service experience
* Stellar interpersonal skills with a welcoming, professional, and dynamic personality
* English/Spanish bi-lingual speaking skills a plus
* Basic computer proficiency
* An appreciation/passion for the jewelry industry and a desire to learn
* A flexible schedule

**No experience in the jewelry industry required – We will train you!**

We offer a competitive compensation package, including **base salary plus uncapped commissions!**

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: $60,000.00 - $75,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Professional development assistance

Language:

* English (Required)

Work Location: In person

**Snapshot of the Role**

At Husco, we don’t just offer jobs- we create opportunities to shape the future of manufacturing. As a Procurement Manager, you’ll step into a high impact role where strategy meets innovation. You will be responsible for overseeing the procurement function- developing and implementing procurement strategies and managing the site procurement team. You will have direct involvement in strategic planning, supplier management, and ensuring the efficient and cost-effective procurement of materials and services. Ready to make your mark?

**What You’ll be Doing:**

* **Material Availability and Continuity of Supply**: Ensure the availability of materials to meet production plans at our factories. This includes active participation in the weekly and monthly SIOP process, providing supply base capacity and inventory position updates, and ensuring supplier schedules are closely reviewed to avoid material outages and minimize working capital
* **Commercial Optimization:** Identify and implement total cost of ownership saving opportunities and drive procurement efficiency. Develop and manage the procurement budget, ensuring cost control and optimization. Analyze spend data and changing global supply chain cost factors and develop strategies to reduce costs and improve value for Husco.
* **Team Leadership:** Manage and mentor the procurement team, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and excellence. Set performance goals and conduct regular reviews to ensure team alignment and performance against Husco’s objectives. Provide training and professional development opportunities for team members to enhance their skills and capabilities. Use ERP business systems and Power BI tools to manage procurement activities.

**What You’ll Need:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, or related field. Master’s degree or postgraduate degree preferred.
* 7 years of experience in procurement or supply chain management within the manufacturing industry with at least 3 years of leadership experience.
* Strong strategic thinking, leadership, and negotiation skills. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to support up to 10% domestic and international travel.
* Authorized to work in the United States.

**What We Offer:**

* Competitive pay and benefits
* 100% tuition reimbursement and support for continued learning
* 401(k) program with company match
* 3 weeks of paid time off + 12 paid holidays
* Ample volunteer opportunities
* Employee-led clubs and sports teams

**Who We Are:**
Imagine a place where your career can soar, where innovation meets excellence, and where your contributions truly matter. Welcome to Husco.

Here, you’ll find the freedom to shape your work and leave a lasting impact. We believe in empowering you to grow personally and professionally, continuously enhancing your skills and knowledge.

Your role at Husco goes beyond the ordinary – you’ll be at the forefront of supporting teams that developinnovative hydraulic and electro-mechanical systems that enhance efficiency and performance. These products make a real difference globally, building the communities we live in, growing the food that feeds us, and enhancing transportation around the world.

Join our vibrant, industry-leading team and experience a culture that values your creativity, dedication, and drive. Together, we’re not just achieving goals; we’re setting new standards and making a positive impact every day.

**Join our team committed to the highest quality healthcare!**

**POSTION SUMMARY:**

The Purchasing Manager is responsible for identifying, negotiating, and securing the best sources for materials, equipment, and supplies. This role will maintain vendor relationships and collaborate with managers/supervisors to streamline operations and ensure cost-effective purchases from requisition to receipt. The Purchasing Manager will oversee the inventory control process including inventory adjustments, material transfers, and cycle counts to ensure compliance with company policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements.

**JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Establish, implement, and update purchasing policies, utilizing best practice and monitors compliance with such.
* Train and manage all aspects of the inventory control clerk’s role.
* Place orders for clinical supplies, equipment, and other related items to maintain inventory and prevent interruptions in service delivery.
* Place orders for non-clinical supplies utilizing the purchasing request system. Monitor and update the on-line purchasing log to keep staff notified as to the status of the purchasing requests.
* Review all purchase requests for completeness, authorization, and compliance with organizational policies and procedures.
* Act as immunization coordinator for the state of Wisconsin Vaccine for Children Program (VFC) including completion of state required training, certification, and yearly re-certification.
* Act as immunization coordinator for clients not covered under the VFC program.
* Perform cost analysis for non-VFC immunization pricing twice yearly and provide report to the finance and coding departments.
* Manage assigned vendors and supplier contracts based on price, quality, support and reliability.
* Review assigned vendors list and provide purchasing reports to the Facilities and Purchasing Director as needed.
* Analyze supply demand trends and maintain par levels accordingly.
* Continuously improve the purchasing process, keeping with changing organizational needs and best practice, including recommendations for efficient and timely acquisition of supplies.
* Oversee the purchasing budget and track expenses to ensure adherence to financial targets.
* Collaborate with Accounts Payable to verify invoices against purchase orders.
* Manage time keeping for all Purchasing and Facility personnel, keep direct aware of vacation requests.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Must possess a bachelor’s degree or equivalent.
* Required to have a minimum of two years’ purchase order, processing inventory/supply management experience.
* Must possess a valid Wisconsin driver’s license, provide proof of insurance, and have reliable transportation.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, including Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint.
* Must have excellent organizational, written and oral communication skills.
* Prior experience having direct reports preferred.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Strong attention to detail is a must.
* Able to relate well to people from diverse ethnic and cultural backgrounds.
* Self-motivated, flexible, and capable of working independently while managing multiple priorities.

description:
The Purchasing Manager is responsible for daily activities of the purchasing function at NEMS. They are responsible for maintaining relationships with vendors or suppliers and upkeep trends and prices to identify forecasting demands to minimize purchasing cost.

**ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:**

* Able to perform job duties of Purchasing Agent II.
* Review purchase orders for accuracy and to make the best prices are obtained
* Approve purchase and track their progress to make sure orders are filled correctly
* Evaluate, select, and establish relationships with vendors
* Negotiate contracts for good and services
* Oversee the ordering of materials, supplies and equipment from vendors by buyers
* Analyze and implement purchasing process and delivery systems
* Manage and direct employees involved in purchasing
* Monitors day-to-day activities in addition to assigning work to employees
* Track and report key functional metrics to reduce expenses and improve effectiveness
* Supervise all audit activities and evaluate purchase orders and payments
* Manage and support project implementations
* Manage supplier contracts
* Maintains all reports for inventory
* Performs other job duties as required by manager/supervisor.

* Completion of a four year degree from an accredited university.
* 1+ years of supervisor experience or 4+ years of purchasing experience.
* Must be proficient in computers and ability to learn new applications.
* Excellent communication, organizational and budgeting skills.
* Demonstrated skills in problem identification, analysis and resolution.
* Detail oriented with a strong emphasis on accuracy and timelines.

**LANGUAGE:**

* Must be able to read, write and speak English fluently
* The ability to speak a second language is an asset

**STATUS:**

* This is an FLSA exempt position.
* This is not an OSHA high-risk position.
This is a Full Time position.

NEMS BENEFITS: Competitive benefits, including free medical, dental and vision insurance for employee, spouse and/or children; and company contribution to 401(k).

description:
The Estimator / Purchasing Manager is responsible for preparing accurate construction estimates, managing vendor and subcontractor relationships, negotiating pricing, issuing purchase orders and trade contracts, and maintaining the company's cost database. This position plays a critical role in ensuring every home is built on budget while maintaining quality standards and construction schedules.

This individual works closely with sales, project management, accounting, and the field to ensure seamless project execution from contract signing through completion.

**Compensation:**

$70,000 - $100,000

**Responsibilities:**

**Estimating**

* Prepare detailed budgets for custom and spec homes.
* Develop preliminary estimates from conceptual plans.
* Perform quantity takeoffs for labor and materials.
* Review architectural plans and specifications for completeness.
* Identify value engineering opportunities.
* Verify pricing accuracy before construction contracts are executed.
* Maintain standardized cost templates for all home models.
* Prepare change order pricing.

**Purchasing**

* Solicit bids from subcontractors and suppliers.
* Negotiate labor and material pricing.
* Maintain preferred vendor relationships.
* Issue purchase orders for all materials.
* Execute subcontractor agreements.
* Monitor supplier lead times.
* Coordinate deliveries with construction schedules.
* Resolve pricing discrepancies.

**Qualifications:**

* Experience in preparing detailed budgets for custom and spec homes.
* Ability to develop preliminary estimates from conceptual plans.
* Proven track record of performing quantity takeoffs for labor and materials.
* Skill in reviewing architectural plans and specifications for completeness.
* Experience in identifying value engineering opportunities.
* Ability to verify pricing accuracy before construction contracts are executed.
* Proficiency in maintaining standardized cost templates for all home models is a plus, but not required.

**About Company**

We’ve proudly served Central Wisconsin since 2019, crafting exceptional homes prioritizing transparency. Empowered by industry-leading software, keeping our customers informed and involved throughout the process, building trust with clients every step of the way.

Summary:

**Who We Are**

White Lodging develops and operates a portfolio of award-winning, premium-brand hotels, rooftop bars and restaurants in some of the country’s best cities to live. We know that the hospitality business, like life, is how you make people feel. That’s where you come in. You’ll help bring the virtue of hospitality to life while we create an environment that allows you to be your best self and grow.

Responsibilities:

**What You’ll Do**

* Oversee purchasing, receiving, storage, and distribution of all food and beverage products.
* Maintain strong compliance with procurement programs and vendor standards.
* Manage the receipt, inspection, storage, and inventory tracking of all products delivered to the hotel.
* Conduct and supervise monthly inventories and reconcile discrepancies between physical and recorded inventory.
* Serve as the property expert for purchasing systems and platforms, including Clearsky and related tools.
* Coordinate closely with Accounting to support accurate and efficient month-end processes.
* Monitor product quality, vendor deliveries, shortages, and discrepancies, and communicate issues to leadership.
* Maintain accurate inventory rotation, labeling, and storage procedures to minimize waste and shrinkage.
* Develop purchasing forecasts and assist with budgeting and cost allocation across departments.
* Manage vendor relationships and procurement contracts to ensure quality, cost efficiency, and service standards.
* Lead the safe transport and delivery of products throughout the hotel.
* Monitor slow-moving inventory and recommend solutions to improve inventory control and reduce costs.

**What You’ll Bring**

* Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills when working with vendors, leaders, and associates.
* Experience using inventory management systems and Microsoft Office tools.
* Knowledge of purchasing operations, inventory control, and vendor management.
* Ability to supervise, train, and lead a team effectively.

Other information:

**What You Can Look Forward To**

* Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance (starting Day 1)
* Paid Parental Leave
* Vacation/Paid Time Off (PTO) with rollover
* 401(k) with company match
* Life Insurance and Disability Insurance
* DailyPay option
* Complimentary wellness tools
* Unlimited referral bonuses
* Leadership development and tuition reimbursement
* Discounts on hotel rooms, dining, and other travel/entertainment experiences
* Multiple hotels in each market = more opportunities for growth

White Lodging is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all associates.

Enveloped by views of the White House, St. John’s Church, and the scenic Lafayette Park, the 5-star accommodations at The Hay-Adams are the embodiment of refined residence. To insure that all food items received meet the approved criteria established by the hotel Food and Beverage/Purchasing Departments. Conducts a thorough, but prompt, inspection of every delivery to ascertain proper specification factors to determine acceptability.

* Check shipment by comparing it with Daily Order Sheet and invoice to insure that what we are receiving is what was ordered (quantity, price, quality state, size, count, weight tolerance and acceptable expiration date). Fill and deliver food requisitions for all outlets.

* If shipment is correct, time stamp and sign driver's and hotel copies of invoice. Place the hotel stamp on front side of invoice and sign next to "Received By".

* If shipment is received with delivery slip or memo invoice, follow same procedure and fill out a "goods received without invoice" form (completed after inspection).

* Submit daily a progress report to Purchasing for outstanding deliveries.

* Directs the traffic of all incoming items until they have been properly dated, priced, labeled or tagged. * Labels all incoming bread and bakery deliveries as to outlet or banquet function.

* Conduct random spot-checks of all perishable items for proper storing and packaging to guard against quality loss due to over-exposure to storage temperatures, improper rotation, etc.

* Assists and directs inventory documentaries along with the Storeroom Manager as necessary.

* Assists Storeroom Clerks in filling requisitions and sanitation maintenance daily.

* Assist in conducting End-Of-Month Physical Inventory.

* Verify, receive and **rotate** all orders using proper HACCAP procedures (work with vendors & managers to ensure this)

* Check all goods for quantity & quality. Anything that is incorrect, notify deliverer & manager to ensure proper credit.

* Cleanliness of following areas: Beer cooler, Walk-in Coolers, Freezer, dry storage, receiving area. Keep clear of all boxes; take all trash from these areas to the dumpster. Break down all boxes for disposal.

* Records and reports shortages and discrepancies.

* Responsible for maintaining accurate records of shipping and receiving related transactions

* Delivery of F&B items to each guest floor as your manager dictates

* Perform any reasonable duties as required and directed by the Director of F&B

To perform this job successfully an individual must be able to perform each essential duty to a satisfactory standard. Previous experience facilitating shipments

Ability to work flexible hours and overtime, including weekends and holidays, when needed

**Supervisory Responsibilities:** N/A

**Language Skills:** must be able to understand, speak, read and write Basic English. Must be able to read and comprehend simple instructions. Be able to effectively present information to customers, clients and other employees within the organization

* Full-time, permanent position with a trusted employer.
* Comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, and a competitive 401(k) plan.
* 401(k) with a 50% match up to the first 10% contribution, helping you plan for a secure future
* Paid training and professional development opportunities to grow your HR expertise and advance your career.
* Tuition reimbursement, wellness programs, and generous paid time off to support your personal and professional well-being.
* Engage in a collaborative, people-first culture with appreciation events, recognition programs, and team-building activities throughout the year.

**Position Responsibilities****:**

* Lead Purchasing Analysts to ensure accuracy in forecasts and performance. Champion a culture that motivates the Purchasing team to improve supply chain outcomes and to provide high-quality customer service. Ensure completion and proper execution of work procedures.

* Responsible for planning and purchasing inventory for multiple suppliers, to support multi-tiered distribution network and manage relationships with suppliers while leading the Purchasing Analysts within the region
* Develop team through quality performance management and development plans in order to create adequate succession plans for Purchasing Supervisors and Analysts
* Translate the detailed marketing, sales, and corporate forecasts in order to maintain adequate inventory levels that are balanced according to service level outcomes
* Proactively monitor inventory health and surplus/deficit to identify systemic issues Create and implement action plans with tactical partners for short term answers, while partnering with optimization team to develop long term solutions
* Other duties as assigned

**Required****Education****and Experience:**

* Bachelor's Degree with 4 plus years of related experience and 0 to 1 plus years of leadership experience or High School Diploma/General Education Diploma with 7 plus years of specific experience and 2 to 3 plus years of leadership experience

The League is a non-profit 501(c)(3) organization registered as a public charity with the Secretary of the Commonwealth. It maintains a professional staff at its headquarters in Boston and its training center in Worcester.

**Position Summary:**

The **Contracts & Procurement Manager** will play a crucial role in upholding regulatory compliance and mitigating potential risks within the PCA and its subsidiaries. This position offers a unique opportunity to contribute to the enhancement of organizational processes, compliance, and risk management frameworks across Massachusetts and beyond. This role would support the MLCHC as well as IHE, CPG, and CSP as referenced above. This position reports directly to the Senior Associate General Counsel.

The Contracts & Procurement Manager will prepare, review, negotiate, and administer contracts and solicitation requests, and shall serve as the main point of contact for all contract request assignments and managing the League's contract and document management software system (as well as a future contract and document management software that the League may transition to). **Supervisory Responsibilities:** None.

+ Assist attorneys with contract request assignments, as needed, including periodically checking contract management software to ensure that all requests have been assigned to the appropriate attorney, ensuring that the contract management allocation tracker is up-to-date in coordination with the attorneys, and providing other assistance as needed at the direction of the attorneys.
+ Review contracts against Vendor Risk Assessment Checklist, including but not limited to reviewing quality standards, budget, and other considerations, and raise up any issues or potential issues pertaining to budgetary issues, procurement issues, compliance with contract terms, etc.
+ Serve as the main point-of-contact and file locator for all League files and contracts.
+ Prepare and present a monthly report to Senior Leadership on executed contracts and contract requests.
+ Coordinate with IT or vendor on technological solutions that address situations or challenges that may arise regarding the contracting process.
+ Identify and escalate potential compliance or operational risks associated with vendor contracts, procurement practices, or contract performance.
+ Support internal audits, external audits, and compliance reviews related to procurement and contracting activities.
+ Play a pivotal role in researching and investigating potential other contract management software for the League to transition to, as well as oversee RFP/RFQ process, as set forth in more detail below.

* Functional Reasoning: Requires the ability to apply principles of influence systems such as supervision, managing, leading, teaching, directing, planning, coordinating and controlling. **Overview**
------------

This is a provisional appointment.

Under administrative direction, this role will oversee the procurement function for all Fire Department units and appropriate outside entities as necessary.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Responsible for being the primary contact in City Purchasing for the Fire Department, including supplying specifications, assistance in the bidding/RFP process as requested and assistance in contract execution.
* Develops supplier management strategies and transitions in key product and service areas and works with City Purchasing to ensure their execution as appropriate.
* Implements and manages all supplier contracts with one- to three-year terms.
* Adheres to all procurement laws including 30B and Chapter 149.
* Works closely with the Law department for clarification and interpretation of contract law.
* Responsible for working with staff to develop specifications for supplies, equipment, and service contracts.
* Responsible for the development and monitoring of supplier performance measures.
* Develops and implements procedures to promote efficiency and improved performance, including cost control programs.

**Minimum Entrance Qualifications**
-----------------------------------

* A minimum of five (5) years of progressive experience in financial analysis, budgeting, and/or accounting is required.
* Procurement experience is preferred.
* A bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university is preferred and may be substituted for two (2) years of experience.
* Demonstrated and proven organizational skills for compliance and reporting purposes.
* A broad knowledge of procurement, supplier management, and vendor relationship management.
* Past experience with procurement laws, e.g., 30B and Chapter 149 preferred.
* Ability to define or recommend procurement and supplier management strategies and recommend solutions.
* Demonstrated financial analysis skills in a business setting using PC-based software packages (e.g., Excel, Microsoft Word, Access, etc.) or other appropriate technology.
* Prior experience with an integrated financial management system (e.g., PeopleSoft, Oracle, etc.) preferred.
* Proven communication skills, both oral and written, including e-mail.
* Proven ability to assume responsibility and to carry out assignments independently.
* A basic understanding of public safety and governmental operations is preferred.

**BOSTON RESIDENCY REQUIRED**

**Title:** 2 Vacancies (Procurement Manager – Software & Technology AND Procurement Manager – Facilities & Construction)

### **Job Summary**

Provides leadership and oversight for complex public procurement activities, including competitive solicitations, contract administration, procurement operations, and compliance with State of Illinois procurement laws and University policies. University Benefit Highlights:

* Insurance benefits, including health, dental, vision, and life
* Retirement and supplemental retirement planning options

a. Work experience performing duties comparable to those performed at the Procurement Officer level of this series or in positions of comparable responsibility[i].

AND/OR

b. College credit for course work in any field

* 30 semester hours equals six (6) months
* 60 semester hours or Associate's Degree equals one (1) year (12 months)
* 90 semester hours equals two (2) years (24 months)
* 120 semester hours or a Bachelor's Degree equals three (3) years (36 months)
* Master Degree or higher equals four (4) years (48 months)

### **Preferred Qualifications**

1. Certified Public Procurement Officer (CPPO), Certified Professional Public Buyer (CPPB) or similar credentials.

2. Experience with e-procurement or ERP systems (e.g., Unimarket, Banner, Workday, Jaggaer)

3. Proficient use of Microsoft Office

4. Two (2) or more years of full time (or part-time equivalent) progressively responsible procurement or contracting experience with State of Illinois code.

Core Work Hours: Monday - Friday; 8:00 a.m. - 4:30 p.m.

**Together, we own our company, our future, and our shared success.**

As an employee-owned company, our people *are* Black & Veatch. We put them at the center of everything we do and empower them to grow, explore new possibilities and use their diverse talents and perspectives to solve humanity's biggest challenges in an ever-evolving world. With over 100 years of innovation in sustainable infrastructure and our expertise in engineering, procurement, consulting and construction, together we are building a world of difference.

**Company :** Black & Veatch Corporation

**Req Id :** 117267

**Opportunity Type :** Staff

**Relocation eligible :** No

**Full time/Part time :** Full-Time

**Project Only Hire :** No

**Visa Sponsorship Available:** No

**Why Black & Veatch?**

At Black & Veatch, you’ll be part of work that matters—designing, creating, and building the infrastructure communities rely on every day, from concept through execution.

We care about how the work gets done as much as what we build. Safety is built into every decision, and people look out for each other—speaking up, collaborating, and doing the right thing because it affects real lives.

You’ll work alongside teams solving complex challenges and turning ideas into solutions that perform in the real world—gaining hands-on experience across projects, technologies, and disciplines.

Ownership shows up in how we work. We take responsibility for outcomes, follow through on commitments, and take pride in what we deliver. As a 100% employee-owned company, employees share in the long-term success we build together.

With flexible ways of working and meaningful development opportunities, you’ll build a career you can be proud to stand behind.

**The Opportunity**
-------------------

As the Project Procurement Manager 1 you'll have the opportunity to:

* Perform assigned procurement activities for a proposal(s) or project(s).
* Lead others with procurement responsibilities while requiring minimal supervision.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Purchases assigned equipment, construction, and service contracts for projects following established policies and procedures
* Assists in project setup of procurement related activities
* Executes and manages the procurement process on assigned contracts including bid list preparation, solicitation of quotes, and evaluating, negotiating and awarding of contracts.
* Leads negotiations for assigned procurements and/or construction contracts
* Collaborates to resolve complex claims or other contract issues
* Ensures contract documents are issued correctly and on schedule
* Assists with the development and monitoring of project budgets and schedules (man-hours, cost, procurement milestone durations)
* Assists with the establishment and/or monitoring of procurement goals
* Monitors project procurement activities and reports status
* May develop, create and lead presentations to internal and external client and joint venture partners
* May be responsible for soliciting budgetary pricing for equipment, material, or labor to support estimating/proposal efforts for a project or projects
* May also lead and coordinate the entire budgetary pricing effort on a project or projects
* Files appropriate documents and follows filing rules
* Acts in capacity of a "lead person"
* Does not have management responsibility for the professionals to whom they provide work direction
* Possible positions receiving direction: Procurement Representative, Procurement, Administrator, Expediter

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* BA or BS degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, Technical / Engineering, Construction Management or related field preferred
* Years of relevant experience can substitute for a degree

**Preferred Skills:**

* Proficient Analytics
* Creation and Interpretation
* Strong Attention to Detail
* Proficient Budget Development and Management
* Strong Communication - Written and Oral
* Strong Computer Skills - Databases and MS Office
* Strong Contract Comprehension
* Strong Data Entry
* Proficient Mathematics
* Strong Organizational Skills
* Proficient Presentation Skills
* Strong Problem Solving
* Proficient Process and Technical Writing
* Proficient Project Process Management
* Proficient Schedule and Planning Understanding
* Basic Training Development
* Basic Workflow and Team Management

**Minimum Qualifications**
--------------------------

* Minimum of seven (7) years of relevant experience.
* All applicants must be able to complete pre-employment onboarding requirements (if selected) which may include any/all of the following: criminal/civil background check, drug screen, and motor vehicle records search, in compliance with any applicable laws and regulations.

**Work Environment/Physical Demands**
-------------------------------------

Jbsite: Denver, CO

**Join WW Clyde – Where You Work Matters**

At WW Clyde, we build more than infrastructure—we build careers. For 100 years, we’ve delivered challenging heavy civil projects. Our reputation for safety, innovation, and quality is driven by our people. We invest in your growth, empower you with the latest technology, and provide clear pathways for advancement.

**Job Summary:** We're looking for a Parts Purchasing Agent in the Denver, Colorado area.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Visualize, fulfill, and implement the vision and core values.
* Prepare written inquiries or obtain verbal or written quotes for vendor supplied items and subcontracts in compliance with requisitions and/or specifications.
* Receive vendor bids, evaluate bids considering price, delivery date, past performance of vendor, etc. to determine successful bidder.
* Negotiate terms/conditions of and place purchase orders. Negotiate and issue purchase change orders.
* Expedite awarded purchase orders when necessary to insure timely delivery.
* When required, handle third party rental contracts and awards, renewals, and terminations. Maintain files and chart all rental orders.
* Coordinate invoice problems with vendor and accounting; delivery requirements with vendor and supervision; quality requirements with Engineering and QC, as appropriate.
* Prepare all required documentation for each purchase order.
* Establish/maintain working contact with vendors. Meet with sales and vendor representatives as required.

**Why Work for WW Clyde?**

* **Competitive Compensation & Benefits:** Health, dental, vision, life insurance, 6% 401(k) match, profit sharing, paid holidays, and PTO.
* **Performance-Based Bonus:** Rewarding your dedication and project success.
* **Career Development:** Ongoing training, mentorship, and clear advancement paths.
* **Stable, Respected Employer:** Join a century‑strong leader in heavy civil construction.

*\\*As part of our hiring process,* ***all candidates are subject to a comprehensive background check****. Please note that our company maintains a strict policy regarding certain convictions. Applicants with a* ***DUI or felony conviction may not meet eligibility requirements*** *for employment in this position.****.****\\**

**Posting Closes:** Open until filled
W.W. Clyde and Co. is an Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer.

* Job Type: Full-time
* Pay: $22.00+ depending on experience

* Follow up on orders and updates system deliveries
* Set up and negotiate new vendors and payment terms

* Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals. Ability to write routine reports and correspondence. Ability to speak effectively before groups of customers or employees of Company.

* Ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out instructions furnished in written, oral, or diagram form. Ability to deal with problems involving several concrete variables in standardized situations.
* Knowledge of Microsoft and some kind of ERP system CMMS or Syteline
* Ability to learn and use the CMMS (IMaint) software and ERP software (Syteline). Versatile in the use of Pc's including all components of Microsoft Office.
* General understanding of basic Adobe PDF functions
* Basic understanding of GL Codes
* Ability to work in a high volume fast paced manufacturing environment
* Ability to organize and work cross departmentally

**Experience & Education**

* One year certificate from college or technical school; or three years related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

**Physical Demands**

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Finance Purchasing Agent 2

**GENERAL DUTIES**

This class of positions encompasses responsible purchasing of a variety of materials with varying degree of latitude. For independent initiative and judgment and supervisory work of a major subdivision in a large bureau or purchasing organization. There are three assignment levels within this class of positions. All personnel perform related work.

Assignment Level I

Under general supervision, with limited latitude for independent or unreviewed action or decision in accordance with standard procedures and legal requirements, performs work of limited difficulty and responsibility in one or more of the following areas:

* Is responsible for the purchase of a volume and variety of materials in assigned fields.
* Reviews purchasing requisitions, checking descriptions and specifications to determine their accuracy and adequacy and consults with department and agencies to adjust possible discrepancies.
* Analyzes market conditions in relation to recent, current, and anticipated purchases.
* Prepares proposals for bidding on items to be purchased.
* Develops lists of prospective bidders.
* Reviews bids and quotations to determine most reasonable price in relation to market conditions and responsibility of bidders and makes recommendations based on these determinations.
* Examines samples of items to determine compliance with specifications or standards, suggesting substitute items when desirable.
* Interviews and corresponds with vendors, business representatives and contractors.
* Analyzes trade journals, catalogs, directories and other technical material with respect to market and price conditions.
* Prepares necessary purchasing documents in accordance with procurement requirements.
* May supervise Assistant Purchasing Agents and clerical personnel.
* Keeps records and makes copies.

Assignment Level II

Under general supervision, with considerable latitude for independent or unreviewed action or direction, in accordance with standard procedures and legal requirements, handles more complex problems in one or more of the following:

* Is responsible for the purchasing of materials in assigned fields which involve a large expenditure of money and the more complex purchasing problems that are continual in nature, due to such factors as seasonal variations, number and variety of items, frequency and extent of emergency purchases, complicated and non-standard nature of items purchased, and liabilities and consequences resulting from purchasing errors.
* May incidentally perform duties described under Assignment Level I.

Assignment Level III

Under direction, with wide latitude for independent or unreviewed action or decision, performs supervisory work in one or more of the following, after having performed duties at Assignment Level I and/or II at least two years:

* Supervises and coordinates the purchasing activities of a subdivision consisting of two or more commodity units.
* Makes investigations in relation to purchase and handles special assignments as required.
* Reviews contract and calendar proposals before advertising.
* Approves recommendations for contract awards, contract modifications, buy-against transactions, formal requests for time extension on contracts, etc.
* Supervises various activities in connection with open market transactions.
* Supervises personnel in the titles of Assistant Purchasing Agents and other clerical personnel.
* May incidentally perform duties described under lower Assignment Levels.
* May, during temporary absence of immediate superior, perform the duties of that individual.

**CONTRACT TITLE**

Purchasing Agent

**FLSA**

Non-exempt

The City University of New York’s Department of Facilities Planning, Construction, and Management (FPCM), through its recently formed Office of Facilities Maintenance, Operation, and Emergency Response, will lead the university's shared facilities services operations. The newly envisioned shared facilities services model will operate through the university’s four regional maintenance hubs, supported by the business and administration teams operating from the facility's central office. The strategic goal of the shared facilities services is to ensure a standardized, professional level of facility operations, and centralized oversight for the maintenance and upkeep of CUNY’s portfolio of 300 buildings and 26 million square feet of educational facilities.

FPCM is seeking a Purchasing Agent to support the Office of Facilities Operation and Emergency Response. Reporting to the Facilities Procurement Director, the successful candidate will collaborate with the Accounts Payable, Property Management, and FPCM departments to develop, document, and enhance the end-to-end procure-to-pay process. Working in a team-oriented environment, the candidate will identify opportunities to streamline workflows and improve operational efficiency.

**Salary: $40,000 to $100,000**

**Summary**

The **Used Car Buyer** is responsible for sourcing, evaluating, and purchasing pre-owned vehicles to support dealership inventory needs. This role uses market analysis, appraisal expertise, and negotiation skills to acquire quality vehicles while maximizing profitability and meeting sales objectives.

**Responsibilities:**

* Source and acquire quality pre-owned vehicles through customer trade-ins, direct purchases, auctions, and online marketplaces.
* Conduct vehicle appraisals and accurately assess market value, condition, reconditioning requirements, and profitability potential.

* Negotiate vehicle purchases with customers, wholesalers, auction representatives, and other vendors.
* Utilize inventory management and market pricing tools to evaluate vehicle demand and competitive pricing.
* Collaborate with sales, service, and management teams to ensure timely acquisition, reconditioning, and merchandising of inventory.
* Maintain accurate records of purchases, appraisals, and vehicle acquisition activities while adhering to company policies and compliance requirements.

**Qualifications**

**Qualifications:**

* Minimum of 2 years of automotive sales, vehicle acquisition, inventory management, or dealership experience preferred.
* Strong knowledge of vehicle valuation, market trends, auction processes, and used vehicle inventory management.
* Proven negotiation and relationship-building skills with the ability to secure profitable vehicle purchases.
* Ability to analyze market data, pricing reports, and inventory metrics to support acquisition decisions.
* Excellent communication, organizational, and time management skills.
* Proficiency with dealership management systems, appraisal tools, and automotive inventory software.

**Additional Requirements:**

* Valid driver’s license with an acceptable driving record
* Must be legally authorized to work in the United States

* $40,000 to $100,000
* Hourly plus commission

The position also may also pay a production bonus based on individual or team performance that may range from $0.00 (if baseline benchmarks are not met) without any fixed upper limit.)*

**Schedule:**

* Full Time
* Monday through Saturday availability
* Sundays off

* Comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision coverage
* Company-paid life insurance
* 401(k) retirement plan with company match (Traditional and Roth options)
* Generous paid time off and paid parental leave
* Ongoing training and professional development to support career growth
* A collaborative, performance-driven work environment

description:
**Overview**

We are seeking a proactive and detail-oriented Purchasing Agent to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will be responsible for managing procurement activities, negotiating with vendors, and ensuring the timely acquisition of materials and services essential for operational success. Your expertise in purchasing and materials management will drive efficiency, cost savings, and strong vendor relationships. This position offers an exciting opportunity to contribute to a fast-paced environment where strategic sourcing and inventory control are key to our growth.

**Duties**

* Collaborate with internal departments to determine procurement needs and specifications
* Conduct direct negotiations with vendors to secure optimal pricing, terms, and delivery schedules
* Maintain effective communication with vendors to ensure timely order fulfillment and resolve any supply issues
* Manage supplier relationships through regular performance reviews and vendor relationship management practices
* Analyze Excel data and spreadsheets to identify cost-saving opportunities and optimize procurement strategies
* Support inventory management initiatives by monitoring stock levels, conducting cycle counts, and implementing inventory control measures
* Coordinate with supply chain management teams to streamline procurement processes within MRP (Material Requirements Planning) systems

**Experience**

* Proven experience in purchasing or procurement roles within manufacturing or supply chain environments
* Knowledge of materials management, inventory control, and supply chain management principles
* Demonstrated ability in vendor negotiation, sourcing, and vendor relationship management
* Proficiency in using spreadsheets and Excel for data analysis and reporting purposes
* Experience supporting purchasing management systems and procurement software tools
* Excellent communication skills for vendor interaction and internal collaboration
* Ability to analyze pricing strategies and leverage supply chain insights for cost efficiencies

Join us as a Purchasing Agent and become a vital part of our mission to optimize procurement operations while fostering strong vendor partnerships. Your expertise will help us maintain seamless supply chain processes that support our growth ambitions. We value energetic professionals eager to make an impact through strategic sourcing, negotiation excellence, and innovative inventory management.

Pay: $22.00 - $25.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Benefits:

* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

**Senior Procurement Specialist**

**Summary:**
Responsible for performing operational or consulting support in one or more areas of the acquisition life cycle or program/project functional area, to include: purchasing/procurement, source selection, training, research, business process improvement, policy development, financial analysis, automated systems development/analysis/ implementation, federal government project or program management, federal statutes and regulations, acquisition or contracting management.

**This role requires but is not limited to:**

* Responsible for planning, scheduling and conducting all phases of procurement project(s)
* Applies in-depth understanding of Agencies' mission, organizational interrelationships, and priorities to support the full acquisition lifecycle
* Strong hands-on partnership with program office to develop their pre-award procurement artifacts such as acquisition plans, SOW, market research requirements documents, and independent government cost estimates
* Utilization of Excel in daily work to create/troubleshoot IGCE
* Acquisition Strategy Support
* Market Research and Market Surveys
* Post-Award Contract Administration Support-This may include making sure invoices are paid on time, assisting with performance concerns, making sure deliverables are received on time, and assisting with any contract modifications such as administrative changes, option years, CLIN realignments, etc.
* Complex procurement strategy
* Solicitation/RFP/RFI development
* Experience supporting major program acquisitions
* Support for contract negotiations
* Contract closeout activities
* Experience with award briefings, policy interpretation, contract file audits, precedent/waiver support, de-obligation management
* May serve as a Team Lead and/or perform peer/quality review support

**Requirements:**

* BA/BS degree plus 10 years of experience
* Prior FAC-C II or III certification or industry equivalent highly desirable
* Experience that demonstrates in-depth knowledge of the Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR), agency specific regulations, and acquisition streamlining initiatives and reforms.
* Experience to include conducting comprehensive acquisition/procurement/contract management support activities including developing task lines in PWS/SOW.
* Prior experience using the PRISM contract writing system, and the Federal Financial Management System (FFMS)
* Prior experience using APFS and G-Invoicing desirable
* Ability to elicit requirements from program office subject matter experts to draft high-quality, procurement documentation independently
* Experience with Grants/Cooperative Agreements and Un-definitized Contracting Actions/Letter Contracts highly desirable
* Advanced Excel skills to draft independent government cost estimates with detailed bases of estimate
* High aptitude with Microsoft Office Suite to include Teams, Word and Excel
* Experience with file collaboration and management in SharePoint highly desired
* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills and experience working with varied groups of stakeholders
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment, balancing multiple procurement actions simultaneously
* High degree of initiative and follow-through to ensure procurement actions are completed within prescribed timelines

**Clearance Required:**

* Client Fitness with Entry on Duty (EOD)

* Client or Secret and above highly desired

* Current Client badges highly desired

*Integrity is an Equal Opportunity Employer who is dedicated to hiring and retaining a diverse workforce. We will not discriminate against any applicant or employee for employment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex/gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, veteran status, disability, or any other protected class.*

description:
**Entry-Level Procurement Specialist**

**RCI Custom**

**Start Your Career in Supply Chain & Purchasing**

RCI Custom is looking for a motivated and detail-oriented **Entry-Level Procurement Specialist** to join our growing team. If you’re someone who enjoys problem-solving, working with vendors, and keeping operations running smoothly, this is a great opportunity to build a long-term in purchasing and supply chain management.

You’ll work closely with our Shop Operations team to ensure materials and components are ordered, tracked, and delivered on time to support production.

**What You’ll Do**

* Assist with purchasing raw materials, electronic components, and outside services
* Create and manage purchase orders using our ERP system
* Communicate with vendors regarding pricing, availability, and delivery updates
* Track open orders and help ensure on-time delivery of materials
* Review incoming materials and support documentation accuracy
* Kit parts for production work orders
* Help maintain organized purchasing and inventory records

**What You’ll Learn**

* Procurement and supply chain fundamentals
* Vendor communication and relationship management
* Inventory control and material planning
* ERP systems (JobBoss)
* ISO 9001:2015 quality standards
* Cost control and purchasing strategies

**What We’re Looking For**

* High school diploma or equivalent (associate’s degree is a plus)
* Basic skills in Microsoft Excel and Outlook
* Strong attention to detail and organization
* Good communication and problem-solving skills
* Ability to manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment
* Positive attitude and willingness to learn

**Nice to Have (Not Required)**

* Exposure to manufacturing, electronics, or warehouse environments
* Basic understanding of inventory or purchasing processes

**Why Join RCI Custom?**

* Great entry point into a growing field with career advancement opportunities
* Hands-on training and mentorship
* Collaborative team environment
* Opportunity to learn valuable, transferable business skills
* Health benefits
* 401k
* Paid time off & holidays

**Apply Today**

If you’re ready to start your career in procurement and be part of a team that keeps operations moving, we’d love to hear from you.

Pay: $18.00 - $20.00 per hour

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

* Pet coverage for your furry friends.
