**WHO WE ARE**

Crossmedia is the global media independent. We’re committed to doing media and business the right way, guided by the principles of TRUST, REASON and the Pursuit of HAPPINESS. Crossmedia US was founded in NY in 2000 and is one of the largest minority-owned full-service media planning & buying agencies in the nation. We are 500+ Crossmedians worldwide with big ambitions to continue to grow with soul.

We focus on what media agencies should do: create innovative connections between brands and people regardless of channel or budget. And we do it in an honest way. We are and always have been a values-based organization. We earn our clients TRUST by ensuring media transparency in our business model and objectivity in decision-making. We apply REASON & logic to finding solutions to our clients' greatest business challenges. The Pursuit of HAPPINESS matters to us. Big time. We invest in each colleagues’ professional & personal wellbeing and growth. It’s why we have countless initiatives, clubs & cultural events dedicated to our people and why we have been the top ranked media agency named to Ad Age’s Best Places to Work for the past seven years in a row.

We have offices in the US, London and Germany. Our client roster includes U.S. Bank, Invesco, Newell Brands, NASCAR, Planet Fitness, American Cancer Society, Ricola, Herschend Family Entertainment, Zalando, Edible Arrangements, Citizens Bank, and more.

**YOUR ROLE**

We’re looking for a bright Assistant Buyer, Integrated Media Investment to help manage day-to-day responsibilities of paid media campaign management. A naturally curious mind, resourcefulness, a love for numbers and a passion for advertising are a must.

The Assistant Buyer supports the execution, maintenance, and reporting of media buys across traditional and digital channels. This is an entry-level role designed for a motivated, detail-oriented individual looking to build foundational experience in media planning and buying. You’ll work closely with internal teams, vendors, and media partners to ensure campaigns are executed accurately and efficiently, while learning about pricing strategy, media performance, and client servicing.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Campaign Execution & Support**

* Assist in the preparation of media authorizations and insertion orders to activate buys
* Enter campaign data and maintain accurate records across internal systems (e.g., OneStrata, Investment Trackers)
* Help manage timelines and deliverables, ensuring vendors receive specs and assets on time
* Monitor campaign pacing and delivery, flagging any under- or over-delivery to the team

**Reporting & Optimization**

* Compile weekly and monthly campaign performance reports, pulling data from media partners, platforms, and internal dashboards
* Analyze delivery vs. planned metrics and assist in optimization recommendations
* Help create and update post-buy analyses for client presentations

**Financial & Administrative Support**

* Track billing and work with finance teams to resolve discrepancies or reconcile vendor invoices
* Maintain budget trackers and assist in updating actuals vs. planned spend
* Organize documentation including contracts, screenshots, and proof of performance

**Vendor & Partner Collaboration**

* Communicate directly with vendors to confirm buys, gather reporting data, and resolve execution issues
* Attend vendor meetings and take notes to assist the broader team in evaluating new opportunities

**Internal Collaboration & Learning**

* Attend and note take during team meetings, client briefings, and status calls as appropriate
* Participate in training sessions to deepen knowledge of media buying systems, analytics tools, and the media landscape
* Stay informed on media industry trends, competitive campaigns, and emerging platforms

**REQUIREMENTS:**

* Bachelor’s in Advertising, Marketing or related field
* A very high proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite tools, and especially be a wiz with Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook
* Strong attention to detail and highly organized
* Must have a love for numbers and a high numerical aptitude
* Excellent communication skills
* Eagerness to learn and adaptability
* A strong interest and knowledge of Media Buying and Planning
* Previous marketing, advertising or media agency experience are a plus.

Please note this role requires a candidate with proximity to our NY office. We offer a hybrid work setting with employees working both onsite and from home. Assistants are in the office an average of two days a week for training, collaboration, and overall learning.

Salary range is $43k - $50k. Commensurate with experience. Compensation is determined on the skills, qualifications, certifications, tenure in the industry, and experience of the applicant along with the requirements of the position.

description:
**Who We Are:**

With office locations in Pittsburgh and Chicago, Gatesman is a privately held, fully integrated marketing communications agency with expertise in advertising, digital, analytics, public relations, social media, and performance media. We don’t shy away from the unknown and thrive on the speed of business. We solve business challenges by using data, and a human filter to fuel our marketing solutions- whether it’s building brand awareness, improving reputation, launching new products, or publishing brand narratives. We maintain our client relationships with an industry leading tenure of 7+ years on average.

**Position Summary**

The Assistant Media Planner/Buyer is responsible for providing administrative and analytical support in the development, execution, and maintenance of media plans while acquiring a working knowledge of cross-department collaboration and problem solving within a fast-paced, full-service ad agency. The Assistant Media Planner/Buyer works closely with media managers to develop and implement media campaigns tailored to reach specific audiences as efficiently and effectively as possible, taking into account current media consumption habits to ensure scale and relevance of each media buy.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Work with media team managers on development, negotiation, implementation, tracking, measurement, and optimization of media campaigns
* Develop and present POVs, media analyses, and recommendations to agency team and clients
* Meet with vendor representatives to further knowledge of available media opportunities and assess them for possible inclusion in future media planning
* Utilize consumer data and media measurement tools such as Kantar, MRI-Simmons, and SEMRush to conduct research and generate appropriate reports (target audience development and media consumption, competitive analysis, performance tracking, budget reporting, etc.)
* Reconcile monthly billing invoices and discrepancies to ensure agency and client budget compliance
* Ensure orders are sent and received by agency vendors
* Become proficient at navigating self-serve media platforms (Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, Facebook Ads, Manager, LinkedIn Ads, etc.) to aid in setup of campaigns, monitor spend, and access reporting to analyze performance of in-market campaigns
* Compile media reports from various software and social platforms
* Coordinate deliverables with account team, including collecting creative specs, relaying creative deadlines, and assisting in campaign setup and QA
* General assistance to the Media Department as needed

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelors degree in Marketing, Advertising, Communications, or a related field
* 1-2 years of experience in media planning, advertising, or a related role
* Fast learner who easily adapts to various agency and client demands
* A strong work ethic with the self-motivation needed to exceed expectations
* Familiarity with digital media buying platforms (Google Ads, Facebook Ads, etc.) preferred
* Knowledge of programmatic advertising and media buying processes
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Exemplary organizational and multi-tasking abilities
* The drive and ability to prioritize while working on multiple assignments under deadline pressures
* A passion for media, advertising and staying updated with industry trends

Compensation: $40,000-$50,000 base salary range exclusive of fringe benefits. Final base salary compensation will be determined on factors such as geographic location, skills, education and/or experience. The range listed represents the full base salary range for this role. Hiring at the maximum of the range is not typical, allowing for future salary growth. We also offer a generous compensation and benefits package, with additional information listed below.

**Gatesman Benefits:**

* Hybrid Work Schedule
* Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance available on the first day of employment
* FSA/HSA’s
* 401k with an employer match
* Unlimited PTO
* Flex Friday’s
* 13 Holiday’s including time off between Christmas and New Years

We maintain our client relationships with an industry leading tenure of 7+ years on average.

The Assistant Media Planner/Buyer is responsible for providing administrative and analytical support in the development, execution, and maintenance of media plans while acquiring a working knowledge of cross-department collaboration and problem solving within a fast-paced, full-service ad agency. The Assistant Media Planner/Buyer works closely with media managers to develop and implement media campaigns tailored to reach specific audiences as efficiently and effectively as possible, taking into account current media consumption habits to ensure scale and relevance of each media buy.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Work with media team managers on development, negotiation, implementation, tracking, measurement, and optimization of media campaigns
* Develop and present POVs, media analyses, and recommendations to agency team and clients
* Meet with vendor representatives to further knowledge of available media opportunities and assess them for possible inclusion in future media planning
* Utilize consumer data and media measurement tools such as Kantar, MRI-Simmons, and SEMRush to conduct research and generate appropriate reports (target audience development and media consumption, competitive analysis, performance tracking, budget reporting, etc.)
* Reconcile monthly billing invoices and discrepancies to ensure agency and client budget compliance
* Ensure orders are sent and received by agency vendors
* Become proficient at navigating self-serve media platforms (Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, Facebook Ads, Manager, LinkedIn Ads, etc.) to aid in setup of campaigns, monitor spend, and access reporting to analyze performance of in-market campaigns
* Compile media reports from various software and social platforms
* Coordinate deliverables with account team, including collecting creative specs, relaying creative deadlines, and assisting in campaign setup and QA
* General assistance to the Media Department as needed

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelors degree in Marketing, Advertising, Communications, or a related field
* 1-2 years of experience in media planning, advertising, or a related role
* Fast learner who easily adapts to various agency and client demands
* A strong work ethic with the self-motivation needed to exceed expectations
* Familiarity with digital media buying platforms (Google Ads, Facebook Ads, etc.) preferred
* Knowledge of programmatic advertising and media buying processes
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Exemplary organizational and multi-tasking abilities
* The drive and ability to prioritize while working on multiple assignments under deadline pressures
* A passion for media, advertising and staying updated with industry trends

Compensation: $40,000-$50,000 base salary range exclusive of fringe benefits. Final base salary compensation will be determined on factors such as geographic location, skills, education and/or experience. The range listed represents the full base salary range for this role. Hiring at the maximum of the range is not typical, allowing for future salary growth. We also offer a generous compensation and benefits package, with additional information listed below.

**Gatesman Benefits:**

* Hybrid Work Schedule
* Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance available on the first day of employment
* FSA/HSA’s
* 401k with an employer match
* Unlimited PTO
* Flex Friday’s
* 13 Holiday’s including time off between Christmas and New Years
* Paid Maternity and Paternity Leave
* Strong culture and supportive working environment

description:
Who you work with matters.

We are looking for a licensed real estate agent who wants to develop a productive business working with buyers while earning rewarding commissions. This opportunity provides coaching, accountability, and established systems designed to help you create opportunities now while building the foundation for consistent future business.

You will gain experience working with buyers from the first conversation through a successful closing. This includes conducting buyer consultations, understanding client needs, identifying properties, coordinating showings, preparing offers, negotiating terms, and helping clients navigate important decisions throughout their purchase.

Along the way, you will strengthen the skills needed to turn new conversations into appointments and appointments into active clients. You will learn how consistent prospecting, thoughtful follow-up, and strong client communication can create a growing pipeline of buyers while generating future repeat and referral opportunities.

You will work alongside experienced real estate professionals who provide practical coaching, guidance, and support throughout the process. The focus is on helping you become more confident in buyer conversations, improve your sales and negotiation skills, stay organized with your opportunities, and establish productive daily routines.

If you enjoy working with people, value accountability, and want to build a real estate business centered around buyer relationships and consistent production, we would like to connect with you.

Interested? Apply now.

**Compensation:**

$150,000+ at plan commissions

**Responsibilities:**

* Prepare representation contracts, purchase agreements, closing statements, deeds, and leases for a successful close
* Assist buyer clients with the home purchase process including budgeting and options with a mortgage lender
* Speak and engage with pre-qualified leads to figure out their wants and needs in a home
* Act as the intermediary between the client and the listing agent to ensure a smooth real estate transaction
* Arrange showings, show homes, and participate in open houses for prospective buyers

* Follow the team plan
* Set buyer appointments
* Lead follow-up
* Execute consultations
* BRE signed
* Close sales
* CRM and database mastery

**Qualifications:**

* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
* Show a track record of real estate success
* Sufficient knowledge of the local real estate market and recent trends in the industry
* Valid U.S. driver’s license with the ability to travel by car

* **A real estate license is required in order to work with clients and earn commissions**
* Sales experience
* Must live in Orange County
* Must have working rights in the USA

**About Company**

This is an opportunity to be part of one of Orange County's top-producing teams, with over 265 million in closed volume in the past 12 months.

Enjoy the benefits of a turnkey operation with LEADS provided, a full marketing team, 2 full admin assistants, a dedicated listing coordinator, and a supportive manager. We offer weekly training and ongoing professional development, all within a great local OC office and team environment.

If you are currently active and in production or on a team and just looking to raise your ability to produce more and, more importantly, grow more, and want to explore the opportunity. All inquiries must have a California Real Estate license and be passionate about growing and succeeding, and being part of an incredible community.

To maintain all parts areas and inventory on a daily basis. To assist in the ordering of parts, supplies, and equipment.

**Essential Duties/Responsibilities**

Nothing in this job description restricts management's right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time.

* Bar coding parts and putting on shelf and keeping an accurate inventory
* Ordering and receiving parts and equipment
* Keeping supply area's clean and orderly
* Complete all paperwork daily
* All parts areas are to be kept neat and clean.
* Bar code and label parts upon arrival.
* Arrange and store parts in appropriate bins.
* Order parts when needed and ensure stock is in appropriate and designated location.
* Keep accurate inventory records and assist in completing month-end reports, enter inventory count in automated system.
* Count and maintain boiler fuel inventory and other crucial items expected to be in stock and available for use by Production Dept when needed.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Ability to read and write.
* Excellent attendance
* Computer skills
* Knowledge of how to use parts catalogs.
* Ability to use a calculator to perform addition and subtraction functions.
* Must be able to climb 1 to 2 flights of stairs frequently.
* Ability to lift 75 lbs.
* Able to operate a "Bob Cat"/case loader and forklift and other rental machinery
* Maintain all working areas by keeping them clean and neat at all times
* Must be a self-starter and operate this department with a minimum of supervision
* Able to assess a situation and formulate a proper course of action
* Use equipment in a safe manner as instructed by management
* Work safely and observe all safety rules
* Hazards may and include, but are not limited to cuts, burns, slips and trips

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Must be willing to work all shifts, over-time and weekends as needed.
* Expected to perform other duties as assigned.

Position Summary:

**Amerit Fleet Solutions**, one of the leading Fleet Maintenance Companies in the U.S., is looking to hire an experienced **Light/Medium Duty** **Parts Coordinator****.** The Parts Coordinator reports directly to Purchasing Manager and will be responsible for inside parts ordering activity. To succeed as a Parts coordinator, you must be able to build and maintain productive, long-lasting relationships with internal teammates and meet central purchasing objectives.

**The benefits of belonging – what’s in it for you?**

* Competitive hourly pay – paid weekly, every Friday
* Full benefits within 30 days
* Medical, dental, vision, prescription drug coverage, life insurance, disability insurance
* 401(k) program with company match
* Paid vacation, holidays, and sick time
* Commitment to your safety through boot and prescription safety glasses reimbursement
* Career and learning development with an extensive training program through our Amerit University
* Employee referral program, up to $500 bonus
* ASE certification program with fee reimbursement and bonus
* Employee recognition platform that includes opportunities to redeem points for merchandise
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* 24/7 nurse triage line
* Employee discounts on cell phone service and entertainment tickets
* Employee resource groups (ERGs) that foster inclusion
* Wellness and fitness programs through our providers

**Full Time**

**Shifts Available:**

Sunday - Thurs | (Sun 8am-5pm), (Mon-Thurs 9am-6pm)

Sunday - Thurs (Sun 8am-5pm) and (Mon-Thurs 9am- 6pm)

Essential Duties & Responsibilities:

* Build and maintain set amount clients and internal customers
* Work with internal customers in a professional, courteous manner
* Become familiar with client’s vehicle assignments
* Locate parts that are difficult to find and negotiate with vendors to ensure the best deal
* Accurately quote parts and input information into our management system
* Track lost sales
* Assist other parts coordinators when necessary
* Perform other duties as assigned

Key Competencies and Minimum Education:

* Minimum 3 years’ experience in a highly competitive market; prior success selling wholesale auto parts particularly in aftermarket industry preferred
* Knowledge of light/medium duty parts/vehicles
* Exceptional phone skills: positive, enthusiastic, and attentive tone to help the internal customers feel comfortable during the conversation, clear enunciation, exceptional listening skills
* Excellent negotiation, interpersonal and communication skills (both written and verbal)
* Knowledgeable and Passionate about exceptional customer service
* Ability to build and maintain lasting business relationships
* ASE certifications in P1 and P2 preferred.
* Results focused, producer, closer, committed to growth
* Experience with POS system a plus
* Proficient in MS Office applications, specifically MS Word and Excel preferred
* Time management and organizational skills
* Ability to act and operate independently to accomplish objectives
* Position requires an individual with an outgoing and assertive personality to take initiative, be pro-active, be very positive, and have a “can-do attitude.”

description:
**NPI/Indirect Buyer**

The **NPI/Indirect Buyer** is responsible for leading sourcing, procurement, and supplier engagement activities that support successful New Product Introduction (NPI) initiatives and indirect procurement programs across CONMED's global operations. This role serves as the primary sourcing liaison between Global Sourcing, R&D, Engineering, Operations, Planning, Supplier Quality, Product Management, and key business stakeholders to ensure supplier capability, material readiness, cost competitiveness, and supply continuity throughout the product development and launch lifecycle.

The NPI/Indirect Buyer supports supplier selection, qualification, commercial negotiations, and procurement execution for both product launch activities and indirect spend categories, including capital equipment, tooling, facilities, MRO, professional services, logistics, and IT. This role balances strategic sourcing principles with operational execution to support speed-to-market objectives, operational efficiency, risk mitigation, and cost optimization.

**\\*\\*\\*This is a remote position\\*\\*\\***

**Key Responsibilities**

**New Product Introduction (NPI)**

* Lead sourcing and procurement activities for assigned NPI projects from concept through commercial launch.
* Participate as the purchasing representative on cross-functional product development teams.
* Develop sourcing strategies for new components, assemblies, tooling, equipment, and services required for product launches.
* Identify, evaluate, onboard, and manage suppliers capable of supporting new technologies and product requirements.
* Ensure supplier capacity, tooling, lead times, and manufacturing readiness align with launch schedules.
* Drive supplier participation in design reviews, development activities, and technical discussions.

**Indirect Procurement & Strategic Sourcing**

Snipp is a global loyalty and promotions technology company working with major consumer brands, retailers, QSRs, beverage companies, and their agencies. You'll own day-to-day media buying and performance optimization across paid digital channels, balancing campaign goals, audience strategy, budget pacing, creative performance, and measurable return.

You'll manage paid media campaigns from planning through wrap-up, partnering with Client Services, Sales, Creative, Analytics, and external platform or agency partners. You'll translate campaign objectives into channel plans, audiences, budgets, flighting, testing strategies, and reporting that clients and internal teams can understand and act on. * Monitor campaign pacing and performance daily or as required, and optimize toward agreed KPIs such as reach, impressions, CPM, CPC, CTR, CPA, conversion rate, ROAS, or other client-specific outcomes.
* Run structured tests across audiences, creative, placements, bidding approaches, landing experiences, and channel mix, and document what changed and why.
* Maintain accurate budgets and forecasts, flag under- or over-pacing early, and recommend reallocations before performance or delivery becomes an escalation.

* Strong Excel or spreadsheet skills and the ability to analyze performance data, spot anomalies, and communicate recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Comfort working with distributed teams and clients across time zones, with occasional schedule flexibility around launches, reporting deadlines, or campaign issues.

**Media Buyer**

**Remote, United States | Full-Time | Exempt | Reports to Media Director**

**About Us**
============

Simplifying out-of-home (OOH), that is what working at ODN is all about. As one of the fastest-growing OOH media placement firms in the country, ODN partners with agencies and advertisers to deliver strategic, high-impact campaigns.

Our highly collaborative team works closely with OOH vendors across North America to secure the best placements and competitive rates for our clients. From Outdoor Advertising and Experiential Marketing to DOT and large-format printing, ODN provides end-to-end solutions that bring brands to life in the real world.

**About the Role**
==================

The Media Buyer is a key member of ODN’s high-performing, client-focused media team, responsible for delivering strategic, fiscally responsible, and effective media plans that exceed client expectations. This role is actively involved in the full media lifecycle—from planning and purchasing through implementation and analysis—while maintaining alignment with ODN’s standards and culture.

This role is ideal for an organized, adaptable media professional with 3+ years of media planning or buying experience who can manage budgets, coordinate with clients and vendors, and execute accurate, timely media plans in a fast-paced remote environment.

Using ODN’s proprietary media planning platform, the Media Buyer works closely with clients, vendors, production partners, and internal teams to ensure seamless execution and support long-term growth for both clients and ODN.

**What You Will Be Doing**
==========================

* Execute media planning and buying responsibilities with a client-first approach, strong attention to detail, fiscal responsibility, and close collaboration across teams.
* Develop and implement strategic, accurate, and timely media plans tailored to client goals.
* Manage assigned media budgets responsibly, including accurate tracking, reporting, and execution.
* Collaborate with vendors and internal production teams to coordinate delivery and implementation.
* Maintain client satisfaction through effective communication, responsiveness, and attention to detail.
* Partner across departments to ensure the accuracy and effectiveness of all media plans.
* Stay informed on industry trends and proactively identify new opportunities for client media strategies.
* Coordinate experiential, digital, traditional, programmatic, and non-traditional out-of-home media.
* Support the Media Director and management team with projects and attend client meetings, presentations, and out-of-state market visits.

**What You Will Need to Be Successful**
=======================================

* Strong client service skills and the ability to build productive relationships with clients and vendors.
* A high level of organization with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* A collaborative mindset with a proactive, solution-oriented approach.
* Demonstrated fiscal responsibility and attention to detail when managing media budgets.
* Familiarity with traditional, digital, experiential, and programmatic OOH media formats preferred.
* Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment and quickly adjust plans and priorities as needs evolve.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Excel, Word, and PowerPoint; familiarity with media planning platforms is a plus.
* Bachelor’s degree in advertising, marketing, communications, or a related field preferred.
* 3+ years of experience in media planning or buying; OOH experience is preferred, and agency or vendor experience.

**Remote Work & Physical Requirements**
=======================================

This full-time, exempt role operates in a fully remote work environment. Standard business hours are generally Monday through Friday, approximately 8:30 a.m. to 5:30 p.m.; however, employees are expected to work the hours necessary to fulfill role responsibilities, which may occasionally include evenings or weekends.

* Sit or stand at a computer workstation for extended periods.
* Use standard home office equipment such as a computer, keyboard, mouse, telephone, and printer.
* Communicate effectively by phone, email, and video conferencing tools.
* Maintain a dedicated home workspace that is safe, ergonomically appropriate, professional, and free from distractions during working hours.
* Occasionally lift and carry items up to 15 pounds, such as a laptop, files, or office supplies.
* Travel approximately 10–15%, including overnight, out-of-state market visits; additional occasional travel may occur for client meetings, training, team meetings, company events, or the annual company retreat.

**What We Offer**
=================

* Competitive base pay within the posted range, based on experience, skills, and business needs.
* Comprehensive benefits package, including Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, and supplement

**For more than 20 years, AEG has played a pivotal role in transforming sports and live entertainment. Annually, we host more than 160 million guests, promote more than 10,000 shows and present more than 22,000 events around the world. We are committed to innovation, artistry, and community, and leverage the power of our 300+ venues, leading sports franchises, marquee music brands, integrated entertainment districts, premier ticketing platform and global sponsorship activations, to create memorable moments that give the world reason to cheer.**

**Our business is interwoven with the human mind and heart, and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive company that reflects the artists, athletes, and fans that we host; reach beyond traditional boundaries to support the communities in which we operate; and minimize our impact on the environment by adopting sustainable practices throughout our business operations.**

**If you want to be challenged to up your game and make a difference, then join us in giving the world reason to cheer!**

**A Brief Overview**
The **Talent Buyer** is responsible for building relationships, identifying talent and confirming profitable shows. This position will create budgets, map scaling for venues and build offers for artists. Additionally, the Talent Buyer will compile all relevant documents and ensure that all shows are settled accurately. They will also work in conjunction with management to identify and build festivals.

**Essential Functions**

* Buy profitable talent by actively reaching out to agents with booking possibilities. Respond to inbound requests from agents and artist management. Follow-up on leads from other talent buyers.
* Negotiate offer details with music agents for artist performances. Gather all relevant information to build offer and present to artist management.
* Networking and building relationships with agents, artist management, venue managers and other potential clients. Maintain current client relationships.
* Oversee the marketing and ticketing of events. Confirm show details and artist requests with marketing and ticketing departments. Ensure that shows go on sale and tickets are being sold.
* Create show or event budgets. Monitor spending and make sure that event stays in budget.
* Travel to cover road shows, events, festivals and seek new clients, projects and partners. Handle the settlement of shows when necessary.
* Work with managers on potential festival projects. Identify potential third party venue and festival sites for events. Assist on festival and concert projects as assigned by manger. Develop creative properties that can be grown into annual events.

**Required Qualifications**

* BA/BS Degree (4-year) In Marketing, Public Relations, or a related area
* 4-6 years Of related work experience
* Previous experience in the music industry with demonstrated ability to assess current music trends
* Previous experience supervisor, leading, and/or mentoring team
* Knowledge of general accounting principles
* General understanding of ticketing systems
* Computer savvy and skilled in MS Office (Outlook, Word and Excel); knowledge of social media platforms
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Must have an outgoing personality with the ability to build and cultivate relationships.
* Exceptional negotiation skills with an ability to analyze complex documents
* Ability to work independently to perform job, as well as in a team environment
* Must have established contacts and relationships in the music industry
* Must be able to work a flexible schedule which may include nights, weekends and holidays.

**Payscale: $**82,500.00 - $90,000.00 annually

**Bonus:***This position is eligible for a bonus under the current bonus plan requirements.*

**Benefits:** ***Full-time:*** *We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes: medical, dental and vision insurance, paid holidays, vacation and sick time, company paid basic life insurance, voluntary life insurance, parental leave, 401k Plan (with a current employer match of 3%), flexible spending and health savings account options, and wellness offerings.*

AEG reserves the right to change or modify the employee's job description whether orally or in writing, at any time during the employment relationship. AEG may require an employee to perform duties outside their normal description.

AEG's policy is to hire the most qualified applicants, and we comply with all applicable federal, state and local employment laws in making hiring and employee decisions. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate against applicants or employees on the basis of race, color, marital status, disability, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected status recognized by applicable federal, state or local law.

***Employer does not offer work visa sponsorship for this position.***

description:
We are bringing paid media in-house. Google and Meta have been run externally, and we want someone in the US who plans and judges every dollar against US and Canadian goals. You will own the accounts, the budget and the results, with a creative partner beside you and a director who wants to see your plan, not approve your bids.

Twelve months in, our paid media will be one of the most reliable growth engines in the business. You will have built a well-structured, high-performing Google and Meta program that scales with confidence, with every dollar tied to the company plan and reported against it month by month. Conversion and demand generation will each run on their own budget and scorecard, Triple Whale will be the trusted source of truth for what works, and a steady test rhythm will keep the creative team building against real results. Leadership will be able to look at paid and know exactly what it is delivering, what the next dollar will return, and where we should push next.

**What you will do**

* Own strategy and account structure for search such as Google Ads (Search, Shopping, Performance Max, YouTube) and ChatGPT Ads along with social channels like Meta (Facebook, Instagram), with room to test TikTok and Pinterest.
* Run the conversion budget against revenue and ROAS, and the demand-generation budget against upper-funnel KPIs, and report them separately.
* Make Triple Whale the measurement backbone: define KPIs, keep attribution clean, and use Moby to automate what can be automated.
* Write ad briefs with our Ad Creative designer, agree the test plan, and feed performance back so each round is sharper than the last.
* Pull winning organic content from the social team into paid tests.
* Deliver a monthly readout: what changed, why, and what happens next.

**What we are looking for**

Required:

* 3 or more years hands-on buying on both Google Ads and Meta for an ecommerce brand, where you owned the account.
* Current Google Ads and Meta certifications.
* Confidence with reporting and attribution: you can reconcile platform-reported results with a multi-touch attribution tool (Triple Whale or similar) and explain what is really driving revenue.
* Experience managing a monthly budget in the tens of thousands without sign-off on every change.
* Daily use of AI tools in your work, and the ability to show how.

Preferred:

* Triple Whale experience.
* Experience marketing to trades or building-products buyers.
* Comfort with YouTube and video-first campaigns.

**About Rubio Monocoat**

Rubio Monocoat makes plant-based, single-coat wood finishes used by flooring contractors, furniture makers, architects and designers, and serious DIYers. The brand was founded in Belgium and the North American business runs from Spicewood, Texas, selling direct to consumers and through dealers, distributors and national retail partners across the US and Canada. The marketing team is small and growing, and this is one of several roles being added this year.

**How we work**

We are a small team that works closely, moves quickly and gives each other real ownership. Each person owns a lane and is trusted to bring the plan, not wait for a brief, and we back each other up when it counts. We are curious, we share what we learn, and we like improving how we work as much as the work itself. That includes being AI-forward: we use AI tools every day to work smarter and expect you to bring that same savvy. Spicewood is ideal, hybrid works if you can come in when needed, and we will definitely consider remote for the right person.

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Employee discount
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Professional development assistance
* Vision insurance

Work Location: Remote

**Job Details for Procurement Specialist**
==========================================

Court Name/Organization

Texas Western District Court

Overview of the Position

The Office of Information Technology for the U.S. District Court, U.S. Probation Office, and U.S. Pretrial Services Office for the Western District of Texas is currently seeking qualified applications for the position of Procurement Specialist. Procurement specialists perform and coordinate administrative, technical, and professional work related to ensuring that court units are supplied with the materials, equipment, and services required to function optimally, including ensuring compliance with the appropriate guidelines, policies, and internal controls. Procurement Specialists may lead the work of procurement services technicians or administrative support staff; however, their responsibilities do not typically involve formal supervisory responsibilities. Procurement Specialists perform advanced procurement activities requiring advanced knowledge of procurement policies and practices. Advanced procurement activities include preparing complicated specifications, negotiating service contracts, and preparing significant and large purchase documents. The incumbent maintains a Contracting Officer certification.

Location

San Antonio, TX

Opening and Closing Dates

10/07/2026 - 10/23/2026

Appointment Type

Permanent

Classification Level/Grade

CL 26-27

Salary

Not specified

Announcement Number

USDC 27-01

**Position Description**
------------------------

The Procurement Specialist performs duties and responsibilities such as, but not limited to, the following:

* Maintain Contracting Officer certification by completing biennial continuing education requirements. As Contracting Officer, process and sign purchase orders and contracts for the purchase of products and services in the technology department. Ensure purchases are authorized, funding is available, the appropriate delegations of authority exist, and adequate competition takes place in accordance with the estimated dollar value of the procurement. Provide contract administration and oversight including record keeping to track expenditures.
* Ensure files are established and maintained for every solicitation, contract, and purchase action and are in compliance with the Guide to Judiciary Policy and local internal controls.
* Develop a variety of reports based on historical and current data, including statistics on procurement activities.
* Research procurement, administrative, and operational questions, problems, trends to identify areas for efficiencies/improvements.
* Evaluate requests for goods and services by ensuring they are allowable under limitations, restrictions, and policies, as well as determining availability of funds for items being purchased. Prepare reporting mechanisms to track expenditures for the department.
* Coordinate the efforts of various entities to ensure timeliness of complex purchase orders and contracts.
* Conduct product and project research, and prepare and present findings and recommendations.
* Make procurement recommendations for cyclical replacement of accountable property.
* Research, analyze, and evaluate suppliers based on price, quality, selection, service, support, availability, reliability, production, and distribution capabilities, as well as their reputation and history. Prepare specifications, solicitations, and Requests for Quotes (RFQs). Research products and equipment and prepare specifications. Obtain and review competitive bids, quotes, and proposals from vendors and contractors and discuss evaluations and review with requestors and subject matter experts, as applicable.
* Negotiate with vendors for the best price over contracted services and purchases. Evaluate and monitor contract performance to ensure compliance with contracted obligations; assist with clarifying contract requirements and resolving any conflicts.
* Establish and maintain sound professional relationships with suppliers. Resolve issues (e.g., pricing, quality, timing, claims, contract disputes, etc.) associated with terms and conditions of service agreements.
* Procure supplies, equipment, services, and furnishings from government and non-government sources through new contracts, competitive bids or existing government contracts. Plan and coordinate time and delivery of purchases.
* Identify and maintain lists of vendors and sources of supply for goods and services. Review, evaluate, verify, and process invoices and prepare payment requests. Update the inventory listing of property and conduct inventory reconciliations.
* Maintain financial reports for multiple agencies in relation to budget, spending, and forecasting.
* The employee in this position is responsible for contributing to a positive and productive work environment.
* Manage or assist with special projects and perform other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications**
---------------

**Summary:**
Our assistant buyers are entrepreneurial, motivated, business owners who strive to present our customers with thoughtfully and responsibly curated assortments. They develop, maintain, and implement frame assortments for each network brand, by segment and capacity. The Assistant Buyer will partner with the Buyers to create an assortment strategy at the segment/cluster level. They analyze and manage the process of reviewing frame sales by collection, by network brand and segment, to meet GMROI, sales mix and initial mark up objectives.

Pay and Pay Class

**Pay:** $18.88 - $24.21 Hourly

**Pay Class:** Full Time & Remote

**Essential Responsibilities:**
1. Development and maintenance of optimum assortments by category/collection to match assortment segmentation strategy, including store specific needs by capacity, sales volume, and demographics.

1. Communicate and manage assortment changes in conjunction with the merchandising, inventory, and visual merchandising departments in the company.

3. Analyze sales trends by frame collection by segment for each network brand, bi-annually, or as needed, to recommend merchandising assortment changes per cluster, to optimize profit dollars

4. Assist buyers with selection and organization of samples for each category.

5. Responsible for requesting all new samples and coordination of samples.

6. Assist buyers with SKU attribute set up, partnering with vendors as needed

7. Assist buyers with keying in orders, frame samples, selling reports and any other processes on an as needed basis.

8. Respond to store questions and requests and take action to satisfy any customer or store issues

**Education:**

* High School Diploma, Associate degree, or equivalent work experience
* Bachelor’s degree preferred

**Experience & Background:**

* Three - Five (5) years of related work experience
* Strong organizational skills and ability to execute detailed tasks and processes
* Strong customer focus
* Proficient in Microsoft Office including PowerPoint and Excel

**Language Skills:**

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills

**Mathematical Skills:**

* Strong retail math skills
* Ability to compute rate, ratio, and percent and to draw and interpret graphs

**Reasoning Ability:**

* Strong critical thinking; enjoys solving complex problems
* Ability to think logically in following procedures and instructions

Essential Responsibilities related to Physical Demands/Work Environment:

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an associate to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of this job, the associate is frequently required to sit, use hands to finger, handle or feel, and talk or hear. The associate is frequently required to stand, walk, and reach with hands and arms. The associate must frequently lift and/or move up to 20 pounds. Required repetitive motion of sitting and using hands to finger and feel. The noise level in this location is moderate (use of computers, printers and machines).

**Media Planning**

We are looking for a full time Media Buyer & Planner to join our team of professionals!

**About Us -**

We are an established provider of medical treatments for a variety of men's health issues. We have a history of satisfied patients because we offer experience and expertise in a professional clinic atmosphere

**Job Summary:**

The Media Buyer & Planner is responsible for planning, negotiating, purchasing, and optimizing paid media across multiple channels to effectively reach target audiences and meet marketing objectives. This role analyzes market data, manages media budgets, and works closely with internal teams and external media partners to maximize campaign performance and return on investment.

**Compensation: $55,000 to $65,000 Annual Salary plus Bonus Opportunities**

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Media Planning:**

* Develop strategic media plans aligned with campaign goals, target audiences, and budget parameters
* Research and analyze market trends, audience data, and competitive activity
* Select appropriate media channels including digital, social, TV, radio, and print
* Forecast campaign reach, frequency, and performance metrics

**Media Buying:**

* Negotiate rates, placements, and added value with media vendors and partners
* Purchase media inventory within approved budgets and timelines
* Manage insertion orders, contracts, and media schedules
* Ensure all placements meet brand, legal, and regulatory requirements

**Campaign Management & Optimization:**

* Monitor live campaigns and make data-driven optimizations to improve performance
* Track KPIs such as impressions, clicks, conversions, CPA, and ROI
* Troubleshoot delivery issues and work with vendors to resolve discrepancies

**Budget & Reporting:**

* Manage media budgets and ensure accurate billing and reconciliation
* Maintain detailed records of spend, pacing, and performance
* Provide regular performance updates and insights to stakeholders

**Collaboration**:

* Maintain strong relationships with media vendors and agency partners
* Stay current on emerging media trends, platforms, and best practices

**Qualifications:**

* 2–5 years of experience in media planning and/or media buying
* Strong understanding of digital and traditional media channels
* Experience with media buying platforms and analytics tools (e.g., Google Ads, Meta, DSPs, Google Analytics)
* Excellent negotiation, analytical, and organizational skills
* Ability to manage multiple campaigns and deadlines simultaneously

**Preferred Skills:**

* Experience in performance marketing and conversion-driven campaigns
* Familiarity with compliance-driven industries (e.g., healthcare, finance)
* Strong Excel and reporting skills
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills

**Work Environment:**

* Fast-paced, deadline-driven marketing environment
* May require collaboration with external vendors and agencies

We believe in the importance of developing a professional staff and seeks to offer training and advancement opportunities from within.

We provide equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or genetics.

About Crown Gold Exchange

Don't have experience? No problem we will train you to be an expert Gold Buyer! Crown Gold Exchange is a well-established and growing leader in the precious metals industry. We are known for fair pricing, transparency, and a customer-first approach. Our team works directly with clients during important financial moments, which requires trust, clarity, and strong communication.

We focus on building a workplace where people can grow, learn the business deeply, and develop long-term careers. Training and mentorship are part of how we operate, not an afterthought.

Position Overview

We are seeking an outgoing, self-motivated Gold Buyer with strong sales instincts and customer service skills. This role involves working directly with clients who are selling gold, silver, platinum, diamonds, and coins. You will guide customers through the selling process, evaluate items according to company standards, and ensure each interaction feels professional and respectful.

This position also includes general office responsibilities and requires comfort handling both phone and in-person conversations.

Key Responsibilities

* Work directly with customers interested in selling precious metals and related items
* Test, evaluate, and price items based on established company guidelines
* Explain the buying process clearly and confidently to customers
* Answer incoming phone calls and respond to in-person inquiries
* Maintain accurate records and handle general office tasks
* Complete other duties as assigned

What We’re Looking For

* Strong communication and people skills (Bilingual is a Plus)
* Sales or customer-facing experience preferred
* Comfortable learning valuation basics and following structured pricing standards
* Reliable, punctual, and professional in appearance and conduct
* Able to work independently while contributing to a team environment

Important Application Requirement

As part of our hiring process, Indeed provides a short initial phone interview with voice response questions.

Applicants who submit an application without completing the Indeed phone interview will not be reviewed.

If you are interested in a role where your communication skills matter and your work directly impacts customers, we encourage you to apply and complete all steps in the application process.

Job Types: Full-time

Application Question(s):

* What is the most challenging situation you faced at your last job and how did you overcome it?

Shift:

* Day Shift
* M-F 10am - 6pm and Sat 10AM - 4PM

Work Location: Santa Ana

Pay: $45,000.00 - $65,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

**Job Summary**

The Procurement Manager, Major Projects, serves as the primary Procurement partner for assigned major transmission capital projects or programs. Embedded within the project team, this senior individual contributor leads procurement integration across materials, equipment, services, construction, supplier capacity, and contracting activities to support successful project delivery.

Working through influence across Procurement, Supply Chain, Engineering, Construction, and Project Controls, the role develops and oversees the integrated procurement plan, anticipates and mitigates risks, aligns procurement activities with project milestones, and provides executive-level visibility into procurement readiness and performance. While not responsible for category strategy, supplier relationship ownership, material tracking, or overall project execution, this position coordinates these capabilities into a unified procurement strategy that supports project success.

**Job Description**

Where Putting the Customer First Powers Everything We Do!

**What You'll Do:**

* Serve as the primary procurement liaison and single point of coordination for assigned major projects, partnering closely with Project Managers, Project Directors, and project leadership.
* Develop, maintain, and drive the integrated project procurement plan, ensuring alignment with engineering, construction, commissioning, and project milestones.
* Translate project schedules and business objectives into coordinated procurement, sourcing, contracting, supplier, and material execution plans.
* Represent project material and capacity requirements within the Transmission COE portfolio planning process and incorporate prioritization decisions into project execution plans.
* Maintain procurement dashboards and risk registers that provide visibility into milestones, supplier capacity, material status, commercial issues, actions, decisions, and executive reporting.
* Coordinate cross-functional execution across Transmission COE, Category Management, PPO, Sourcing, Contracts, Engineering, Project Controls, Construction, Logistics, and other stakeholders.
* Establish clear accountability, decision paths, and escalation processes to resolve procurement issues and risks.
* Partner with Procurement teams to address supplier performance, capacity constraints, category strategies, and commercial considerations.
* Communicate procurement readiness, key risks, mitigation plans, and critical decisions to project leadership.
* Leverage analytics, systems, and continuous improvement practices to enhance sourcing effectiveness, contract visibility, supplier performance, and project outcomes.

**What We're Looking For:**

**Education/Experience:**

* Bachelor's degree in a related field and 8 years of relevant experience.
* Associate's degree in a related field and 10 years of relevant experience; or
* High School Diploma/GED and 12 years of relevant experience.
* Demonstrated success leading complex cross-functional initiatives without direct authority.
* Strong knowledge of procurement processes, contracting, supplier management, supply markets, manufacturing lead times, and delivery assurance.
* Experience supporting large capital, utility, energy, transmission, infrastructure, industrial, or engineering projects.
* Strong stakeholder management, collaboration, and executive communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting transmission, utility, energy, EPC, or infrastructure capital projects.
* Knowledge of project controls, critical path scheduling, commissioning, and construction sequencing.
* Experience managing procurement risks on projects exceeding $100M in capital investment.
* PMP, CPSM, CPSD, SCM, or similar professional certification.
* Experience operating in matrixed and portfolio-based organizations.

Join the Malarkey team, innovators in roofing technology with pioneering rubberized asphalt shingles designed for superior durability and sustainability. At Malarkey, we take pride in our most important asset - our employees.

We’re seeking a Plant Buyer who's ready to be part of our mission to manufacture and deliver innovative, performance-driven building products with unmatched service and integrity. Our focus is creating longer-lasting, environmentally responsible roofing solutions that can withstand all weather conditions.

**Job Title:** Plant Buyer| **Req ID:** 18283 | **HR Contact:** Elizabeth Bertapelle| **Location:** Building Envelope - Portland, OR

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

The Plant Buyer is responsible for supporting the day-to-day purchasing needs of the manufacturing facility, with primary responsibility for indirect spending, Maintenance, Repair and Operations (MRO) materials, and plant services. This position ensures the plant has the materials, parts, supplies, equipment, and services needed to operate safely, reliably, and efficiently while maintaining appropriate cost, quality, service, and inventory controls.

**WHAT YOU'LL ACCOMPLISH**

* Manage purchasing activities for plant indirect spend, including MRO parts and supplies, tools, safety supplies, operating consumables, equipment, and contracted services.
* Partner with Maintenance, Operations, and storeroom personnel to understand routine, planned, emergency, and shutdown requirements and ensure necessary materials and services are available to support plant operations, including inventory and critical spare parts.
* Process purchase requisitions and purchase orders accurately and timely in accordance with company procurement policies, approval requirements, delegated authority, and established financial controls.
* Source and evaluate suppliers based on cost, quality, availability, lead time, service, and overall value; obtain competitive quotes and negotiate pricing, terms, delivery expectations, and service requirements within established authority levels.

The Accountant II supports department-wide financial operations for the Harris County Purchasing Agent by performing accounting, revenue, expense, and financial reporting activities across eight divisions. The essential functions include, but are not limited to the following:

* Learn all aspects of nonferrous pricing, grading preparation and shipment
* Inspects customer material to determine the nonferrous commodity
* Uses a computer to purchase the nonferrous material
* Inspects product to determine compliance with the company's specifications, ISRI Specs, quality control system for compliance with legal requirements, and shipping conformity to specified standards
* Load and unload trucks using forklift
* Review and prepare necessary documentation to ensure accuracy of materials received and freight loaded in accordance with schedules, supervisory direction, and required federal and state compliance
* Operate dealer nonferrous scale when required
* Maintains neat and orderly work areas
* Complies, promotes and supports all environmental and safety policies
* The employee maybe assigned to special projects or required to perform other duties not listed above, which may vary from time to time as determined by management, to meet company needs

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The items below are representative of the knowledge, skills, abilities, education, and experience required or preferred.

* This position requires the ability to effectively establish and maintain cooperative working relationships within a diverse multicultural environment.
* Ability to read, analyze, and interpret general business periodicals, technical procedures, or governmental regulations.
* Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from groups of managers, clients, customers, and the general public.
* Ability to apply concepts such as fractions, percentages, ratios, and proportions to practical situations.
* Must be intermediate in Microsoft Office software.
* This position requires the ability of basic hand tool usage, basic mechanical ability, some equipment operation, supervisor or lead experience, problem-solving, good handwriting, and written communication.
* This position requires the ability to operate forklifts or skid steers.

description:
**Job Title: Buyer Produce / Supermarket**

Buyer is responsible for the profitable procurement and timely delivery of products for assigned lines. Works closely with the Sr. Director of Purchasing and Senior Buyers to achieve the goals of the company. Provides supply chain/inventory management for promotionally active categories and corresponding financial accountabilities. Procures products in accordance with all policies and procedures established by the company.

**Key Responsibilities include:**

· Order products to meet forecasted demand.

· Obtain best possible product costs, quality and service at all times.

· Ensure that established policies and procedures are understood and adhered to.

· Strive to obtain inventory and turn goals, while maintaining service level and minimizing distress

· Interface with other departments and division personnel to accomplish job functions. Develop and maintain good working relationships with vendors, store operations, distribution center and division office personnel.

· Review acquisition costs to ensure items purchased are at the lowest cost consistent with considerations of quality, reliability of source, and urgency of need.

· Assess current inventory, market conditions, availability, and promotional impact to forecast order quantities and make recommendations to the merchandising team.

· Conduct post-promotional reviews and analysis to determine if promotional requirements were met and develop solutions for problem areas.

· Review and resolve inventory issues at store level as a result of allocations or order issues. \\* Review and analyze daily and weekly reports to monitor costs, quality, service level, inventory turns, and distress and make adjustments as needed.

· Visit stores, as needed, to monitor programs, obtain store feedback and to assess overall implementation effectiveness.

· Manage Accounts Payable variance processes for distribution sourced items to ensure correct prices have been invoiced.

· Resolve store billing questions by researching discrepancies submitted at store level with Store Billing and entering credits where appropriate or providing resolution.

· Maintain all necessary department files and records.

· Coordinate with Warehouse Operations to maintain the proper product flow through the facility, in a timely manner.

· Remote access (buying system) from home or off-site location when necessary.

**Education Requirements:**

Bachelor's Degree in Business Management, Economics, Accounting or Finance.

**Qualifications:**

Minimum of 3 plus years of Produce Purchasing or Vendor Management experience in industry or retail grocery.

Marketing/Logistics experience preferred or strong understanding of store operations and merchandising methodologies and practices.

Understanding of grocery procurement, logistics, inventory management, marketing, accounting and financial management practices.

Excellent organizational and analytical skills; ability to take initiative and make fact- based decisions.

**Job Title: Buyer Produce / Supermarket**

Buyer is responsible for the profitable procurement and timely delivery of products for assigned lines. Works closely with the Sr. Director of Purchasing and Senior Buyers to achieve the goals of the company. Provides supply chain/inventory management for promotionally active categories and corresponding financial accountabilities. Procures products in accordance with all policies and procedures established by the company.

**Key Responsibilities include:**

· Order products to meet forecasted demand.

· Obtain best possible product costs, quality and service at all times.

· Ensure that established policies and procedures are understood and adhered to.

· Strive to obtain inventory and turn goals, while maintaining service level and minimizing distress

· Interface with other departments and division personnel to accomplish job functions. Develop and maintain good working relationships with vendors, store operations, distribution center and division office personnel.

· Review acquisition costs to ensure items purchased are at the lowest cost consistent with considerations of quality, reliability of source, and urgency of need.

· Visit stores, as needed, to monitor programs, obtain store feedback and to assess overall implementation effectiveness.

· Manage Accounts Payable variance processes for distribution sourced items to ensure correct prices have been invoiced.

· Resolve store billing questions by researching discrepancies submitted at store level with Store Billing and entering credits where appropriate or providing resolution.

· Maintain all necessary department files and records.

· Coordinate with Warehouse Operations to maintain the proper product flow through the facility, in a timely manner.

description:
**JOB SUMMARY**

The **Buyer** **(Home Organization)** plays a critical role in shaping and executing the category strategy for a designated department. With a strong understanding of product development, pricing architecture, and customer behavior, the Buyer is responsible for building a compelling, brand-right assortment that drives both financial results and customer engagement. This role requires a blend of creativity, analytical skills, and market insight to deliver innovative product stories that differentiate the brand and meet evolving customer expectations.

The ideal candidate is a well-rounded merchant with a passion for products and a strong ability to translate insights into strategy. They will lead cross-functional teams, including Planning, Sourcing, and Go-to-Market partners, ensuring each category reflects a clear vision, a strong value proposition, and meaningful differentiation in the market.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**

* **Cross-Functional Team Leadership**
Demonstrates the ability to lead and inspire cross-functional teams, including individuals who do not report directly. Success in this role requires strong influence, collaboration, and communication skills to foster alignment and drive high performance across diverse teams. The ability to build consensus and lead through influence is a crucial competency for an At-Home Buyer.
* **Category Strategy & Assortment Planning**
Develop and execute customer-focused merchandise strategies and seasonal assortment plans that support financial objectives and reflect brand values.
* Partner with Planning & Sourcing to build season assortment plans; Planning to own input & management of the tool, with support from Buyer on item intent & retail and sourcing for cost confirmation.
* **Product Expertise & Development**
Act as the category product expert, with deep knowledge of quality tiers, construction, pricing, and brand-appropriate product selection. Lead curation of newness and product stories that create customer excitement and drive productivity.
* **Business & Financial Management**
Partner with Planning to build merchandise financial plans and by-door assortments. Manage Open to Buy and take decisive action in-season to achieve sales, margin, and inventory goals.
* **Vendor & Sourcing Collaboration**
Communicate category/item strategy and target expectations to sourcing, ensuring sourcing's ability to negotiate costs, improve margins, and optimize the vendor matrix based on strategic needs of the business. Build and maintain strong relationships with key product partners.
* I **n-Season Performance Optimization**
Analyze weekly, monthly, and seasonal sales data to identify risks and opportunities. React quickly to trends and adjust strategies to maximize profitability.
* **Inventory & Markdown Management**
Collaborate with Planning on assortment intent and season priorities. While planning will manage inventory levels and markdown strategies that balance margin and sell-through, it will be imperative to provide the inputs to ensure strategic goals are met.
* **Market & Competitive Analysis**
Conduct structured competitive shops and gather marketplace intelligence to inform strategy, uncover whitespace, and ensure assortment differentiation.
* **Cross-Functional Execution**
Work closely with Marketing, eCommerce/Digital and Visual Merchandising to ensure cohesive go-to-market execution and alignment on brand and business goals.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor’s degree, or equivalent experience.
* 5-7 years of experience in buying, merchandising, or category management in a retail or consumer-focused organization.
* Strong product sensibility and understanding of pricing, quality, and customer value
* Demonstrated ability to build product assortment and deliver financial results
* Strong analytical, negotiation, and communication skills
* Passionate about the customer, brand storytelling, and product innovation

Overview:

Systems Planning and Analysis, Inc. (SPA) delivers high-impact, technical solutions to complex national security issues. With over 50 years of business expertise and consistent growth, we are known for continuous innovation for our government customers, in both the US and abroad. Our exceptionally talented team is highly collaborative in spirit and practice, producing Results that Matter. Come work with the best! We offer opportunity, unique challenges, and clear-sighted commitment to the mission. SPA: Objective. Responsive. Trusted.

The Joint, Office of the Secretary of Defense, Interagency Division provides expert support services to a range of customers spanning across the Department of Defense, Federal Civilian, and international markets. JOID provides a diverse portfolio of analytical and programmatic capabilities to help our customers make informed decisions on their most challenging issues.

SPAs NATO Allied Command Transformation Group within JOID provides capability development, portfolio management, program management, quality management, cost estimation analysis, standardization, reporting, software solutions and information management, and capability management support. We also provide an improved capability requirements capture process, including the generation, documentation and tracing of user requirements, with appropriate technical scrutiny, over the entire lifecycle of the requirements from capability definition through capability realization and capability usage.

We have a near-term need for a Contract/Procurement Specialist to provide onsite support out of Supreme Allied Command Transformation located in Norfolk, VA.

Responsibilities:

The candidate will provide comprehensive contracting and procurement support to NATO and the designated Contracting Officer throughout the full acquisition lifecycle. Responsibilities will include supporting acquisition planning, SOW reviews, RFIs, industry Questions & Answers, proposal evaluations, solicitation debriefs, contract documentation, and procurement actions supporting NATO conferences, workshops, and other operational requirements. Support day-to-day contract administration, including purchases under $40K, obtaining quotes, preparing purchase orders, processing contract amendments and invoices, monitoring contractor compliance, maintaining contractor databases, tracking option periods, and supporting contract closeout. Ensure procurement records and supporting documentation are accurate, complete, and maintained in accordance with NATO procurement procedures and applicable contract file management requirements. Assist NATO with specialized acquisition activities, including Foreign Military Sales (FMS), Acquisition and Cross-Servicing Agreements (ACSA), and NATO Security Investment Program (NSIP) requirements. The candidate will support NSIP project execution, CIRIS data entry, annual contract reviews, and other procurement activities while coordinating closely with NATO Contracting Officers, the COTR, stakeholders, and industry to ensure acquisition actions are timely, compliant, and effectively executed.

Qualifications:

**Required:**

* Bachelor's degree with at least 24 semester hours of business-related courses, DAWIA/NCMA/CIPs certification in Contracting, or equivalent.
* 5+ years of demonstrable experience working in procurement and/or contracting conducting a full range of contracting activities.
* 2+ years of demonstrable experience working pre-award, award, and post-award phases on competitively awarded contracts interpreting and applying statutes, regulations, policies and procedures.
* Demonstrated understanding of Statement of Work (SOW) development and ability to translate user requirements into tangible, measurable outcomes.
* Demonstrated experience working closely with cross-functional teams and facilitating collaboration across technical, financial, and operational domains.
* Demonstrated experience with contract administration and management.
* Demonstrated ability to interpret complex procurement requirements into actionable timelines, strategies, and execution.
* Excellent tactful written and oral communication skills.
* Fluent in English (written and oral).
* Active NATO or National SECRET clearance.
* Citizenship in NATO member nation.
* Able to work fully onsite based on client needs.

**Desired:**

* Demonstrated experience conducting procurement in a NATO command.
* Demonstrated experience with NSIP contracting rules.
* Demonstrated experience with CIRIS.
* Demonstrated experience with NATO Financial System (Oracle) CNAFS/FINs or equivalent.
* Familiarity with NATO-specific procurement rules and requirements.
* Demonstrated experience with Agile Procurement Strategies to include MVPs, Sprints, and Prototypes.
* Experience as a Warranted Contracting Officer with authority to award or administer in excess of Level B (40,000 euros) or national equivalent.

description:
**About**

Macy’s is proudly America’s Department Store. There’s a reason we’ve been around for 160 years. Customers come to us for fashion, value, and high-quality products. Now is an exciting time to join Macy’s. The face of retail is changing, and change requires innovation.

Online sales are booming at Macy’s. Our Distribution Center teams are key to our success in the modern retail landscape. They make sure that products arrive at our stores - and each customer’s doorstep - on time, in perfect condition. Behind the scenes, a lot goes into getting products to customers. When a shopper makes an online purchase, we plan, prep, and package the merchandise to get it delivered as quickly and efficiently as possible – across the country and around the world. It takes a lot of smart people working together to make that happen, and so there are many roles you can play, including (but not limited to): material handlers, equipment drivers, inventory control, packers, quality assurance, safety specialists, asset protection, and many more. Whatever role you play – we value you as a colleague. Choose the challenge that’s right for you!

**Job Overview**

The Staffing Specialist is responsible for maintaining and ensuring the proper staffing and scheduling levels for the Macy's Distribution Centers. The role is also responsible for expense analysis related to staffing and ensuring compliance with the financial components of the Corporate Audit.

**Essential Functions**

* Work with Operations management team to ensure appropriate staffing
* Partner with operations to create week out staffing schedule with daily updates.
* Analyze current staffing levels vs. projected workload to determine correct FT/PT staffing ratios in order to maximize productivity
* Partner with HR to provide staffing recommendations
* Follow company work rules/guidelines for calling in associates
* Run weekly query to ensure min/max hours are sustained for each associate
* Validate accurate timekeeping in Kronos, confirm schedules and make corrections to clockings
* Ensure associates book to correct GL account
* Maintain Learning Matrix-cross training spreadsheet for all part-time associates
* Maintain overtime and average hours reports
* Review and maintain expense controls
* Provide information necessary to complete ROF, and assist with seasonal/annual budget planning.
* Monitor and review monthly expenditures vs. budget and provide meaningful variance analysis, as directed by Finance Manager.
* Assist in closing process to ensure timely and accurate booking of expense and allocations
* Other functions deemed necessary by management.

**Qualifications and Competencies**

* 2 Year / Associate Degree
* 2-5 Years Experience
* Must be able to:
+ Understand, communicate effectively and present information to customers, co-workers, and all levels of management
+ Read and understand employment policies and safety rules/procedures in English
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Excellent organizational skills and analytical skills
* Sound judgment & decision making skills
* Displays leadership qualities
* PC skills – MS Word, Excel, Kronos
* Ability to work independently
* Excellent training and follow up skills
* Good problem solver
* Flexible work schedule
* Excellent motivational skills
* Provide accurate reporting and analysis.
* Team player
* Maintain confidentiality
* Sense of urgency

**Essential Physical Requirements**

* Position requires prolonged periods of standing/walking around store or department
* May involve reaching, crouching, kneeling, stooping, climbing ladders, depth perception and color vision
* Frequent use of computers and other technology necessary to perform job duties, including handheld electronic equipment
* Frequently lift/move up to 25lbs.

**Supply Chain Only and Colleagues Working in a Supply Chain Facility except in locations governed by a Collective Bargaining Agreement:**

Random drug testing for all colleagues will be conducted on a monthly or semi-monthly basis, depending upon factors including but not limited to the size of the facility and the number of colleagues on roll. Colleagues will be randomly selected for testing by a third party. Testing must be completed on the same workday the colleague is informed of selection for testing, absent extenuating circumstances. In all circumstances, testing must be completed within 24 hours of notification

*This job description is not all-inclusive and may not apply to colleagues covered by a collective bargaining agreement. Macy's Inc. reserves the right to amend this job description at any time. Macy's Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to an inclusive work environment.*
